The **degree** $\deg(v)$ counts the edges incident to $v$ (parallel edges one by one, a loop twice); a degree-0 vertex is isolated.

The **handshake lemma** is the first theorem of graph theory: $\sum_{v \in V} \deg(v) = 2m$. The reason is one sentence long — every edge has two endpoints, so it is counted once at each end. Its famous corollary: **the number of odd-degree vertices is even**, because even-degree vertices contribute an even amount while the total $2m$ is even. Sorting the degrees in non-increasing order gives the **degree sequence**; a non-negative integer sequence realized by some simple graph is called **graphical**. Graphicality cannot be decided by necessary conditions alone: an even total or a maximum degree below n is not enough — $(3, 3, 3, 1)$ has even sum 10 yet is not graphical. The exact criteria are the **Havel–Hakimi algorithm** (repeatedly discard the largest degree $d$ and subtract 1 from the next $d$ degrees, recursively) and the **Erdős–Gallai inequalities** (see the formulas).

Graph theory also needs a vocabulary for “walking”: a **walk** is an alternating vertex-edge sequence in which consecutive edges meet; a **trail** repeats no edge; a **path** repeats no vertex. Closed versions are closed walks and circuits, and a circuit with no repeated vertex is a **cycle** (length at least 3). Two vertices are connected when a path joins them; a graph is **connected** when every pair is, and a maximal connected subgraph is a **connected component**. Two graphs are **isomorphic** when they differ only by renaming vertices while preserving adjacency. Degree, connectivity and cycles run through the whole subject: degrees drive Eulerian circuits, cycles drive trees and bipartite graphs, and connectivity underlies spanning trees and planarity.

formulas.note: 图的记号：n 为顶点数、m 为边数；后面的全部计数都归结到这两个数与各顶点的度数。
formulas.noteEn: Notation for a graph: n vertices, m edges; all later counting is expressed through them and the degrees.

formulas.note: 握手引理：度数之和等于边数的两倍；简单图、多重图、含自环图（自环算 2 度）一概成立。
formulas.noteEn: Handshake lemma: the degree sum is twice the number of edges, for simple graphs, multigraphs and loops alike (a loop counts twice).

formulas.note: 奇度顶点个数必为偶数：所以不存在 7 个顶点、每点度都为 3 的简单图（7 × 3 = 21 是奇数）。
formulas.noteEn: The number of odd-degree vertices is even: no simple graph on 7 vertices has all degrees 3 (7 × 3 = 21 is odd).

formulas.note: 简单图的度与边数上界；m = C(n, 2) 当且仅当是完全图 K_n。
formulas.noteEn: Degree and edge bounds for a simple graph; m = C(n, 2) holds exactly for the complete graph K_n.

formulas.latex: d_1 \ge d_2 \ge \cdots \ge d_n \ \text{可图化} \iff \sum_{i=1}^{k} d_i \le k(k-1) + \sum_{i=k+1}^{n} \min(d_i, k) \quad (1 \le k \le n) \ \text{且总和为偶数}
formulas.note: Erdős–Gallai 判别法：这一族不等式加上总和为偶数，才是可图化的充要条件；只想排除序列时，先查总和是否为偶数。
formulas.noteEn: Erdős–Gallai criterion: graphical if and only if the sum is even and these inequalities hold for every k; for quick exclusions, check the even sum first.

properties: 握手引理及其推论对一切无向图成立（重边逐条计数、自环算 2 度）；奇度顶点个数为偶数，因此不存在 7 个顶点、每点度都为 3 的简单图，而 K4（4 点）与 K3,3（6 点）这类 3-正则图的顶点数必为偶数。
简单图中每个顶点的度满足 0 ≤ deg(v) ≤ n − 1，边数满足 m ≤ C(n, 2)；取到最大边数 C(n, 2) 的图是完全图 K_n，它的每个顶点度都是 n − 1。
补图：简单图中 deg_G(v) + deg_Ḡ(v) = n − 1，且 m_G + m_Ḡ = C(n, 2)——一个图与它的补图的边恰好拼成完全图。
度序列「总和为偶数」只是必要条件，不充分：序列 (3, 3, 3, 1) 的总和 10 是偶数却不可图化；Havel–Hakimi 递推与 Erdős–Gallai 不等式才是充要判据。
同构的图有相同的度序列，但反之不成立：6 个顶点的圈 C6 与两个三角形 C3 ∪ C3 的度序列都是 (2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2)，前者连通、后者不连通，并不相同。
propertiesEn: The handshake lemma and its corollary hold for every undirected graph (parallel edges counted one by one, a loop twice); the number of odd-degree vertices is even, so no simple graph on 7 vertices has all degrees 3, while 3-regular graphs such as K4 (4 vertices) and K3,3 (6 vertices) must have evenly many vertices.
In a simple graph every degree satisfies 0 ≤ deg(v) ≤ n − 1 and m ≤ C(n, 2); equality in the edge bound holds exactly for the complete graph K_n, whose vertices all have degree n − 1.
Complement: in a simple graph deg_G(v) + deg_{Ḡ}(v) = n − 1 and m_G + m_Ḡ = C(n, 2) — the edges of a graph and those of its complement exactly tile the complete graph.
An even degree sum is only necessary, not sufficient: (3, 3, 3, 1) has sum 10 yet is not graphical; Havel–Hakimi and Erdős–Gallai are the exact criteria.

Isomorphic graphs share the same degree sequence, but not conversely: the 6-cycle C6 and the disjoint union C3 ∪ C3 both have degree sequence (2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2), yet one is connected and the other is not.

plot.title: 小图两例：左 C₄ 各点度数为 2；右图度数列 2、3、2、1，度数和 8 = 2×4

examples.problem: 判断度序列 $(3, 3, 2, 2, 2)$ 是否可图化；若可图化，构造一个实现该度序列的图，并用握手引理核对边数。
examples.solution: 第一步数总和：$3 + 3 + 2 + 2 + 2 = 12$。由握手引理 $2m = 12$，得 $m = 6$——边数必须是 6，这是必要条件。第二步用 Havel–Hakimi 递推：序列 $(3, 3, 2, 2, 2)$，抹去最大度 3，把随后的三个度数各减 1，得 $(2, 1, 1, 2)$，重排为 $(2, 2, 1, 1)$；抹去 2，随后两个度数各减 1，得 $(1, 0, 1)$，重排为 $(1, 1, 0)$；抹去 1，随后的一个度数减 1，得 $(0, 0)$；全部归零，递推正常结束——序列可图化。第三步构造：取 5 个顶点的圈 $v_1 v_2 v_3 v_4 v_5 v_1$（5 条边，每点度 2），再加弦 $v_1 v_3$（1 条边）：此时 $\deg(v_1) = \deg(v_3) = 3$，其余三点度都是 2，恰好是 $(3, 3, 2, 2, 2)$；总边数 $5 + 1 = 6 = m$，度数之和 $3 + 3 + 2 + 2 + 2 = 12 = 2 \times 6$ ✓（已用 python 复核：Havel–Hakimi 判定可图化，所构造图的度数正是该序列）。

examples.problem: 证明：任意图中奇度顶点的个数都是偶数；并回答——是否存在「7 个人，每人恰好认识另外 3 人」的认识关系（把「认识」看成简单图）？
examples.solution: 由握手引理，$\sum_{v \in V} \deg(v) = 2m$ 是偶数。把顶点按度数的奇偶分成两组：偶度组的度数之和是偶数，于是奇度组的度数之和 $= 2m - \text{（偶度组之和）}$ 也是偶数；而若干个奇数相加为偶数，只能是加数的个数为偶数——即奇度顶点共有偶数个。再看 7 人问题：若每人恰好认识 3 人，对应的 7 个顶点度数全为 3，奇度顶点有 7 个，是奇数，与上证结论矛盾（等价地，$\sum \deg = 7 \times 3 = 21$ 应是偶数 $2m$，矛盾）。所以这样的群体不存在（python 复核：21 为奇数，不可能等于 2m）。反过来，由这条推论，凡是每个顶点度都为 3 的 3-正则图，顶点数必为偶数，例如 K4 与 K3,3。

nodes.title: 树与生成树
nodes.summary: 树是连通且无环的图：它等价于任意两点间有唯一路径，也等价于边数恰为 n−1；每个连通图都含有生成树。
nodes.summaryEn: A tree is a connected acyclic graph, equivalently one with a unique path between any two vertices or with exactly n−1 edges; every connected graph contains a spanning tree.
nodes.definition:
**树**是连通且无环的图；不含环的图统称**森林**，森林的每个连通分支都是一棵树。单个顶点的平凡图按约定也是树；路径、星形（一个中心连接其余所有顶点）都是树的例子。树中度数为 1 的顶点叫**叶**。树是「最没有冗余」的图：删掉任何一条边都会断开，添加任何一条新边都会成圈。

对 n 个顶点的图 T，以下命题**互相等价**：(i) T 是树（连通且无环）；(ii) T 连通且恰有 $n - 1$ 条边；(iii) T 无环且恰有 $n - 1$ 条边；(iv) T 的任意两个顶点之间**恰有唯一一条路径**。证明的枢纽是森林公式：n 个顶点、c 个连通分支的森林恰有 $m = n - c$ 条边（对边数归纳可得）。由它，(iii) 中 $n - 1 = n - c$ 迫使 $c = 1$，图连通；(ii) 中若含圈，删去圈上一边仍连通，反复操作会得到一个边数不足的连通图，与「连通图至少有 n − 1 条边」矛盾，故无环；至于 (iv)：两点间若有两条不同路径就围出一个圈，若含圈则圈上两点至少有两条路径，两个方向都说明唯一路径与「连通且无环」一致。注意：单独说「恰有 n − 1 条边」**不能**推出是树——例如一个三角形（3 顶点、3 边）与一条 3 顶点的路径（3 顶点、2 边）拼成的 6 顶点图恰有 $5 = 6 - 1$ 条边，却既含圈又不连通；必须配上「连通」或「无环」之一。

**生成树**是包含原图全部顶点的树形子图（即 n 个顶点、$n - 1$ 条边的连通无环子图）。**连通图必有生成树**：只要图里还有圈，删去圈上的一条边，连通性不受影响，反复操作直到无圈；非连通图则对每个连通分支各取生成树，合起来叫**生成森林**。生成树一般远不止一棵：Cayley 公式说完全图 $K_n$ 恰有 $n^{n-2}$ 棵生成树，例如 $K_4$ 有 $4^2 = 16$ 棵。带权图（每条边带长度、成本等权重）中总权重最小的生成树叫**最小生成树**，两个经典算法是：**Kruskal 算法**把边按权重从小到大排序，依次尝试加入，不成圈就收下（用并查集判断两端是否已连通）；**Prim 算法**从一个起点出发，每次把连接「已选顶点」与「未选顶点」的最短边拉进来。两者都基于同一条**割性质**：跨越任意一个割的最短边一定属于某棵最小生成树，因此贪心不会误入歧途。
nodes.definitionEn:
A **tree** is a connected acyclic graph; an acyclic graph in general is a **forest**, and each component of a forest is a tree. The one-vertex graph is a tree by convention, and paths as well as stars (one center joined to all other vertices) are trees. A degree-1 vertex of a tree is called a **leaf**. Trees have no redundancy at all: deleting any edge disconnects them, and adding any new edge creates a cycle.

For a graph T on n vertices the following are **equivalent**: (i) T is a tree (connected and acyclic); (ii) T is connected and has exactly $n - 1$ edges; (iii) T is acyclic and has exactly $n - 1$ edges; (iv) any two vertices of T are joined by **exactly one path**. The pivot is the forest formula $m = n - c$ for a forest with c components (proved by induction on the number of edges). Hence in (iii), $n - 1 = n - c$ forces $c = 1$ and the graph is connected; in (ii), a cycle could be broken edge by edge while keeping connectivity, producing a connected graph with too few edges, contradicting the fact that a connected graph has at least $n - 1$ edges, so (ii) is acyclic. As for (iv): two distinct paths between a pair of vertices trace out a cycle, and conversely a cycle already gives two paths between its vertices, so the unique-path property matches “connected and acyclic” in both directions. Beware: “exactly $n - 1$ edges” alone does not make a tree — a triangle (3 vertices, 3 edges) together with a disjoint 3-vertex path (3 vertices, 2 edges) forms a 6-vertex graph with $5 = 6 - 1$ edges that is both cyclic and disconnected; connectedness or acyclicity must accompany the edge count.

A **spanning tree** is a tree-shaped subgraph containing all vertices of the graph (n vertices, $n - 1$ edges, connected and acyclic). **Every connected graph has a spanning tree**: as long as a cycle remains, delete one of its edges — connectivity survives — and repeat; for a disconnected graph one takes a spanning tree inside each component, obtaining a **spanning forest**. Spanning trees are usually far from unique: Cayley's formula states that $K_n$ has exactly $n^{n-2}$ of them, so $K_4$ has $4^2 = 16$. In a weighted graph (edges carry lengths or costs) a spanning tree of least total weight is a **minimum spanning tree**. Two classic algorithms are **Kruskal's**, which sorts the edges by weight and adds each edge that closes no cycle (a union-find structure tracks connectivity), and **Prim's**, which grows from one vertex by repeatedly taking the shortest edge leaving the chosen set. Both rest on the same **cut property**: a cheapest edge across any cut belongs to some minimum spanning tree, so the greedy choice is safe.

formulas.latex: T \text{ 是树} \iff T \text{ 连通且无环} \iff T \text{ 的任意两顶点间恰有唯一路径}
formulas.note: 树的两个核心刻画；唯一路径性质常用于证明：两条不同路径会围出圈，圈上两点又会有两条路径。
formulas.noteEn: The two core characterizations of trees; unique paths are used constantly in proofs, since two distinct paths create a cycle.

formulas.latex: m = n - 1 \qquad (T \text{ 为 } n \text{ 顶点的树})
formulas.note: 等价链条：连通无环 ⇔ 连通且 m = n − 1 ⇔ 无环且 m = n − 1；单说「m = n − 1」必须有「连通」或「无环」作前提。
formulas.noteEn: The equivalence chain: connected and acyclic iff connected with m = n − 1 iff acyclic with m = n − 1; the edge count needs connectedness or acyclicity as companion.

formulas.latex: G \text{ 连通} \iff G \text{ 含有生成树}, \qquad \text{生成树边数} = n - 1
formulas.note: 生成树的存在性刻画，也是「连通图至少有 n − 1 条边」的来源；非连通时对各分支取生成树合成生成森林。
formulas.noteEn: Existence of spanning trees, which also yields “a connected graph has at least n − 1 edges”; for disconnected graphs one builds a spanning forest.

formulas.note: Cayley 公式（τ 记生成树棵数）：K4 的 6 条边中取 3 条共 C(6, 3) = 20 种，其中 16 种是生成树、4 种是三角形（python 暴力枚举复核）。
formulas.noteEn: Cayley's formula (τ counts spanning trees): among the C(6,3) = 20 triples of edges of K4, exactly 16 form spanning trees and 4 form triangles (checked by brute force in Python).

formulas.latex: T \ (n \ge 2) \text{ 至少含两个叶顶点}
formulas.note: 证明用度数之和：若至多一个叶，则度数之和至少为 1 + 2(n − 1) = 2n − 1，但树只有 2m = 2n − 2，矛盾；n = 10 时即 18 < 19（python 复核）。
formulas.noteEn: Proved via the degree sum: with at most one leaf the sum would be at least 1 + 2(n − 1) = 2n − 1, but a tree has 2m = 2n − 2; for n = 10 this reads 18 < 19 (checked in Python).

properties: 树中每条边都是割边（桥）：删去任意一条边，树恰断成两棵子树；反过来，若连通图中能删去一条边后仍连通，说明该边在某个圈上，原图不是树。
树满足极值性质：保持 n 个顶点与连通性，边数不能少于 n − 1；保持无环，边数不能多于 n − 1——树同时是「最小连通图」与「最大无环图」。
森林公式：n 个顶点、c 个连通分支的森林恰有 n − c 条边；因此在无环的前提下，边数 n − 1 迫使 c = 1，图必连通，也就是树。
n ≥ 2 的树至少有两个叶（反证 + 握手引理，见例题）；删去一个叶及其关联边，剩下的图仍是树，这为归纳证明提供标准的归纳步骤。
生成树存在 ⇔ 图连通；各连通分支的生成树合起来是生成森林。带权图的最小生成树可由 Kruskal（边排序 + 并查集）或 Prim（逐点生长）在多项式时间求出，正确性依据是同一条割性质。
propertiesEn: Every edge of a tree is a bridge: deleting any edge splits the tree into two smaller trees; conversely, if deleting an edge of a connected graph leaves it connected, that edge lies on a cycle and the graph was not a tree.

Trees are extremal: with n vertices and connectivity kept, the edge count cannot drop below n − 1; with acyclicity kept, it cannot rise above n − 1 — a tree is at once the minimal connected graph and the maximal acyclic graph.
Forest formula: a forest with n vertices and c components has exactly n − c edges; in particular an acyclic graph with n − 1 edges must have c = 1, hence is a tree.
Every tree with n ≥ 2 has at least two leaves (contradiction plus the handshake lemma; see the example); deleting a leaf and its edge leaves a tree, the standard induction step.

A spanning tree exists iff the graph is connected; the spanning trees of the components form a spanning forest. In weighted graphs, Kruskal's (sort edges plus union-find) or Prim's (grow from one vertex) finds a minimum spanning tree in polynomial time, justified by the cut property.

elements.text: 生成树（绿）：3 = 4−1 条边，仍连通、无环

plot.title: K₄ 与它的一棵生成树（绿色 3 = 4−1 条边）：连通、无环，两点间路径唯一

examples.problem: 六个城市 A, B, C, D, E, F 之间可修路段的成本（单位：万元）为：AB = 4，AC = 2，BC = 1，BD = 5，CD = 8，CE = 3，DE = 6，EF = 7，DF = 9，BE = 10，AD = 11。求用最少成本把所有城市连成一片的最小生成树与总成本。
examples.solution: 先把边按权重排序：BC(1)、AC(2)、CE(3)、AB(4)、BD(5)、DE(6)、EF(7)、CD(8)、DF(9)、BE(10)、AD(11)。用 Kruskal 算法依次尝试：选 BC(1)；选 AC(2)，此时 {A, B, C} 连通；选 CE(3)，{A, B, C, E} 连通；AB(4) 的两端已连通，加入会成圈，弃掉；选 BD(5)，D 并入；DE(6) 成圈弃掉；选 EF(7)，F 并入——六个城市全部连通。共选 5 = 6 − 1 条边，总成本 $1 + 2 + 3 + 5 + 7 = 18$ 万元，边集 {BC, AC, CE, BD, EF} 无圈且连通，是一棵生成树。已用 python 复核：Kruskal 与 Prim 两种算法独立计算均得总权重 18 ✓。最优性由割性质保证：每一步收下的都是跨当前割的最短边，不会错过任何一棵最小生成树。

examples.problem: 设 T 是一棵 n ≥ 2 个顶点的树。证明：T 至少有两个叶（度为 1 的顶点）。
examples.solution: 树有 $m = n - 1$ 条边，由握手引理 $\sum_{v} \deg(v) = 2(n - 1)$。又因 n ≥ 2 的树连通，每个顶点的度至少为 1。反证：假设 T 至多含一个叶。若一个叶也没有，则所有顶点的度都 ≥ 2，度数之和 ≥ 2n > 2n − 2，矛盾；若恰有一个叶，则其余 n − 1 个点的度都 ≥ 2，度数之和 ≥ 1 + 2(n − 1) = 2n − 1 > 2n − 2，同样矛盾。两种情形都不成立，故 T 至少有两个叶。∎ 例如 n = 10 的树度数之和为 18，若至多一个叶则总和至少 19，确实不可能（python 复核 18 < 19 ✓）。

nodes.title: 欧拉回路与哈密顿回路
nodes.summary: 欧拉问题要求经过每条边恰好一次（有简洁的度数判据），哈密顿问题要求经过每个顶点恰好一次（至今没有简单的充要条件，Dirac 与 Ore 只是充分条件）。
nodes.summaryEn: Eulerian problems traverse every edge exactly once and have a clean degree criterion, while Hamiltonian problems visit every vertex exactly once and admit no known simple criterion; Dirac's and Ore's theorems give sufficient conditions only.
nodes.definition:
**欧拉回路**是经过图中每条边**恰好一次**并且回到出发点的**闭迹**；如果只要求经过每条边恰好一次、不要求回到起点，则称为**欧拉路径**（欧拉迹）。问题的原型是 1736 年欧拉的**哥尼斯堡七桥问题**，它被公认为图论的开端。要注意欧拉问题关心的是**边**：每条边不多不少走一次，至于顶点经过几次、是否重复，不作要求。

判定准则既简单又完整。设 $G$ 忽略孤立点后连通，则：$G$ 有**欧拉回路** $\iff$ 每个顶点的度都是偶数；$G$ 有**欧拉路径** $\iff$ 奇度顶点的个数为 $0$ 或 $2$。恰为 $0$ 时，欧拉路径其实就是回路，因此路径条件**不能**写成「奇度顶点恰为 $2$ 个」——那样会漏掉回路这一大情形；恰为 $2$ 时，路径必须以这两个奇度顶点为两个端点。必要性很好想：沿欧拉路径走一遍，除起点与终点外的每个顶点都是「进来一次、出去一次」，度数被两两配对，只能是偶数；起点与终点各多出一次，为奇数。所以奇度顶点只能有 $0$ 个（回到起点）或 $2$ 个（真正的开路径）。充分性可用 **Hierholzer 算法**：先随手走圈，再把还没用到的圈「拼接」进已经走过的圈里，最终覆盖所有边；Fleury 算法提供了另一种可行走法。

**哈密顿路径**是经过图中每个顶点**恰好一次**的路径；闭合版本叫**哈密顿回路**。与欧拉问题只差「边」和「点」一字，难度却天壤之别：**哈密顿问题没有已知的简单充要条件**（「图是否有哈密顿回路」是经典的 NP-完全问题），我们手里只有充分条件与必要条件这两类工具。两个著名的**充分条件**：**Dirac 定理**——若 $n \ge 3$ 且每个顶点的度都至少 $n/2$，则图必有哈密顿回路；**Ore 定理**——若 $n \ge 3$ 且任意两个**不相邻**顶点的度数之和都至少 $n$，则图必有哈密顿回路。方向务必记牢：满足条件必存在回路，但存在回路不必满足条件（C5 就是反例）；Ore 的适用范围更广，因为 Dirac 条件成立时 Ore 条件自动满足（每个度都 $\ge n/2$，不相邻两点的度数之和自然 $\ge n$），反之不然。常见的**必要条件**：若删去某 $k$ 个顶点后剩下的图连通分支超过 $k$，就不可能有哈密顿回路（对哈密顿路径则是不超过 $k + 1$）。
nodes.definitionEn:
An **Eulerian circuit** is a closed trail that uses every edge of a graph **exactly once**; if the trail must use every edge exactly once but need not return to its starting point, it is an **Eulerian path** (Eulerian trail). The prototype is Euler's 1736 answer to the **Königsberg bridge problem**, commonly regarded as the birth of graph theory. Note that Eulerian questions concern **edges**: every edge is walked exactly once, while vertices may be visited repeatedly.

The criterion is both simple and complete. Suppose $G$ is connected apart from isolated vertices: $G$ has an **Eulerian circuit** $\iff$ every vertex has even degree, and $G$ has an **Eulerian path** $\iff$ the number of odd-degree vertices is $0$ or $2$. When it is $0$ the “path” is in fact a circuit, so the path condition must **not** be paraphrased as “exactly two odd-degree vertices” — that would lose the circuit case; when it is $2$ the path must start and end at those two odd vertices. Necessity is immediate: along an Eulerian path every vertex other than the two ends is entered and left equally often, pairing up its edges, so its degree is even; each end contributes one unpaired edge and is odd. Hence there can only be $0$ odd vertices (closed circuit) or $2$ (a genuine open path). Sufficiency can be proved by the **Hierholzer algorithm**: walk circles, splice unused circles into the circles already walked, and eventually cover all edges; Fleury's algorithm offers another route.

A **Hamiltonian path** visits every vertex of the graph **exactly once**, and a closed such walk is a **Hamiltonian cycle**. One word apart from the Eulerian problem — “vertex” instead of “edge” — yet worlds apart in difficulty: **no simple necessary and sufficient condition for Hamiltonicity is known** (deciding whether a Hamiltonian cycle exists is NP-complete), so only sufficient and necessary tools are available. Two famous **sufficient conditions**: **Dirac's theorem** — if $n \ge 3$ and every vertex has degree at least $n/2$, then a Hamiltonian cycle exists; **Ore's theorem** — if $n \ge 3$ and every pair of **non-adjacent** vertices has degree sum at least $n$, then a Hamiltonian cycle exists. The direction matters: satisfying a condition guarantees a cycle, but a cycle need not satisfy the condition (C5 is the counterexample). Ore's hypothesis is the weaker one: when Dirac's condition holds, every two non-adjacent vertices automatically have degree sum at least $n$, but not conversely. A standard **necessary condition**: if deleting some $k$ vertices leaves more than $k$ connected components, no Hamiltonian cycle exists (for Hamiltonian paths the bound is $k + 1$).

formulas.latex: G \text{ 忽略孤立点后连通，且所有顶点度为偶数} \iff G \text{ 含欧拉回路}
formulas.note: 欧拉回路的完整判定：连通性（忽略孤立点）与「全偶度」两个条件都不能少。
formulas.noteEn: The exact criterion for an Eulerian circuit: connected apart from isolated vertices, with all degrees even.

formulas.latex: G \text{ 忽略孤立点后连通，且奇度顶点数为 } 0 \text{ 或 } 2 \iff G \text{ 含欧拉路径}
formulas.note: 欧拉路径的完整判定：0 个奇度点（实为回路）或 2 个奇度点（路径以它们为端点）；写成「恰 2 个」就漏掉了 0。
formulas.noteEn: The exact criterion for an Eulerian path: 0 odd-degree vertices (then it is a circuit) or 2 (the path starts and ends at them); writing “exactly 2” silently drops the 0.

formulas.latex: n \ge 3, \quad \delta(G) \ge \frac{n}{2} \implies G \text{ 含哈密顿回路（Dirac）}
formulas.note: Dirac 定理：δ ≥ n/2 是哈密顿回路的充分条件，不是必要条件；δ 记最小度。
formulas.noteEn: Dirac's theorem: δ ≥ n/2 guarantees a Hamiltonian cycle; it is sufficient, not necessary (δ is the minimum degree).

formulas.latex: n \ge 3 \text{ 时：}\deg(u) + \deg(v) \ge n \text{ 对一切不相邻顶点对 } u, v \implies G \text{ 含哈密顿回路（Ore）}
formulas.note: Ore 定理：对不相邻顶点对提出度数和要求；δ ≥ n/2 时该条件自动满足，故 Ore 比 Dirac 适用范围更广。
formulas.noteEn: Ore's theorem constrains the degree sums of non-adjacent pairs; it is automatically satisfied when δ ≥ n/2, so Ore covers more graphs than Dirac.

formulas.latex: G \text{ 含哈密顿回路} \implies \forall S \subseteq V: \ c(G - S) \le |S|
formulas.note: 删点必要条件：删去 k 个顶点后连通分支超过 k 个，就必非哈密顿；星形图 K1,3 删去中心剩 3 > 1 个分支。
formulas.noteEn: A necessary condition: if removing k vertices leaves more than k components the graph is not Hamiltonian; the star K1,3 loses its center and leaves 3 > 1 components.

properties: 欧拉路径条件中「0 或 2 个奇度顶点」缺一不可：0 个时是回路，2 个时是真正的开路径；又因为奇度顶点个数总是偶数，出现 1、3 个奇度点的情形不可能。
欧拉判定很快（数度数 + 连通性检查即可，线性时间），哈密顿判定却是 NP-完全的：看起来对称的两个问题，计算复杂度截然不同。
哈密顿回路的必要条件：对任意子集 S ⊆ V 有 c(G − S) ≤ |S|（对哈密顿路径则 ≤ |S| + 1）。例如星形图 K1,3 删去中心后剩 3 个分支 > 1，故无哈密顿回路。
二部图的哈密顿回路上左右两侧交替出现，所以必有 |L| = |R|；若只存在哈密顿路径，则两侧顶点数相差不超过 1。
Dirac 与 Ore 都是充分条件，绝非充要：C5 有哈密顿回路，但最小度 2 < 5/2，且不相邻顶点对的度数和为 4 < 5，两个条件都不满足。
propertiesEn: Both options in “0 or 2 odd-degree vertices” are essential: 0 gives a circuit, 2 gives a genuine open path; since the number of odd-degree vertices is always even, 1 or 3 odd vertices can never occur.

Eulericity is easy to decide (count degrees plus one connectivity check, linear time), whereas Hamiltonicity is NP-complete: an apparently symmetric pair of problems with utterly different complexity.

Necessary condition for Hamiltonian cycles: c(G − S) ≤ |S| for every subset S of vertices (for Hamiltonian paths, ≤ |S| + 1). The star K1,3, deprived of its center, leaves 3 > 1 components and is not Hamiltonian.
A Hamiltonian cycle in a bipartite graph alternates between the two sides, so |L| = |R| is necessary; a Hamiltonian path forces the side sizes to differ by at most 1.

Dirac's and Ore's conditions are sufficient but far from necessary: C5 has a Hamiltonian cycle, yet its minimum degree 2 < 5/2 and every non-adjacent pair has degree sum 4 < 5, so neither condition holds.

plot.title: 柯尼斯堡七桥：四块陆地度数 5、3、3、3 全为奇数，不能一笔画走完 7 座桥

examples.problem: 把哥尼斯堡七桥问题抽象成图：4 个顶点、7 条边的多重图，四个顶点的度数分别为 3, 3, 3, 5。(1) 是否存在经过每座桥恰好一次的路线（欧拉回路或欧拉路径）？(2) 若拆去北岸与中央岛屿之间两座平行桥中的一座，结论如何变化？
examples.solution: (1) 四个顶点的度全是奇数，奇度顶点有 4 个。欧拉路径存在要求奇度顶点数为 0 或 2，4 不在其中——所以无论是欧拉回路（要求 0 个奇度点）还是不要求回到起点的欧拉路径，都不存在，这就是七桥问题无解的原因。核对：度数之和 $3 + 3 + 3 + 5 = 14 = 2 \times 7$，与 7 座桥吻合（python 复核 ✓）。(2) 拆去两座平行桥中的一座后，它的两个端点度数各减 1：北岸变为 2、中央岛屿变为 4，南岸与东岛保持 3、3。此时图仍连通且恰有 2 个奇度顶点，故存在欧拉路径，且必须以两个奇度顶点为端点；python 用 Hierholzer 算法找出一条：南岸 → 中央岛屿 → 北岸 → 东岛 → 中央岛屿 → 南岸 → 东岛，恰好经过剩下 6 座桥各一次 ✓。

examples.problem: (1) 用 Dirac 定理判断二部图 K3,3 是否有哈密顿回路，并给出一条；(2) 说明 Dirac 与 Ore 条件只是充分条件：5 阶圈 C5 有哈密顿回路，却不满足这两个条件。
examples.solution: (1) K3,3 有 n = 6 个顶点，每个顶点的度都是 3（左右两侧各 3 个点，每个点连对面全部 3 个点），最小度 δ = 3 = n/2，满足 Dirac 定理的条件，因此必有哈密顿回路。具体一条为 $1 \to 4 \to 2 \to 5 \to 3 \to 6 \to 1$（左侧 1, 2, 3，右侧 4, 5, 6；相邻顶点始终分属两侧，6 个顶点各经过一次），python 暴力枚举复核 ✓。(2) C5 的 n = 5，最小度 δ = 2 < 5/2 = 2.5，不满足 Dirac；C5 中不相邻的顶点对度数和均为 2 + 2 = 4 < 5，也不满足 Ore。但 C5 本身就是一条哈密顿回路。这说明两个条件都只是**充分条件**：它们能保证哈密顿回路，却不能用来否定；哈密顿问题至今没有简单的充要条件。

nodes.title: 二部图与匹配
nodes.summary: 二部图等价于不含奇圈；匹配是两两不相邻的边集，霍尔定理用「任意左点的邻居并集足够大」完整刻画了能饱和左侧全体的匹配何时存在。
nodes.summaryEn: Bipartite graphs are exactly the graphs without odd cycles; matchings are sets of disjoint edges, and Hall's theorem characterizes when a matching saturates the whole left side by comparing every subset of left vertices with its neighborhood.
nodes.definition:
若可以把图的顶点集分成两部分 $L$ 与 $R$，使**每条边**都连接 $L$ 中的一个点与 $R$ 中的一个点（同一部分内部没有边），就说这个图是**二部图**（二分图），记作 $G = (L \cup R, E)$。等价说法：二部图恰好是**可以用 2 种颜色染色**使相邻顶点异色的图。核心判定定理：**图是二部图 ⇔ 它不含长度为奇数的圈**，这是完整的等价，两个方向都成立。必要性：沿奇圈行走，颜色必须「黑、白、黑、白……」交替，走完奇数条边后回到起点却要求与起点异色，矛盾；充分性：任取一点，按与它距离的奇偶染两色，若出现同色顶点相邻，沿线走回必然围出一个奇圈。树与森林没有圈，自然都是二部图；$K_{m,n}$（左 m 个点、右 n 个点之间全连线）是二部图的标准例子。

**匹配**是两两没有公共端点的边集；一条边「盖住」它的两个端点。包含边数最多的匹配叫**最大匹配**，其边数记作 $\nu(G)$；盖住全部顶点的匹配叫**完美匹配**——二部图有完美匹配时显然必须 $|L| = |R|$。匹配刻画的是「互不冲突的配对」：把两组对象一一配上对，每个对象至多参与一对。

**霍尔定理（婚配定理）**给出匹配能饱和整个 L 的完整判据：存在一个盖住 L 中每个顶点的匹配，**当且仅当对任意子集 $S \subseteq L$ 都有 $|N(S)| \ge |S|$**，其中 $N(S)$ 是 S 中所有顶点的邻居之并。量词结构是要害：必须对**每一个**子集 S 成立——任意 k 个左顶点，它们的邻居合起来至少要有 k 个——只检查单个顶点的邻居数远远不够。必要性显然：S 中每个顶点都要配到不同的邻居，这些邻居全在 $N(S)$ 里。充分性的标准证明用**增广路**：若匹配没有饱和 L，从某个未饱和的左点出发交替走「非匹配边、匹配边、非匹配边……」，要么找到一条增广路把匹配变大，要么沿着可达点汇出集合 S 使 $|N(S)| = |S| - 1 < |S|$，与条件矛盾。当 $|L| = |R|$ 时，把霍尔条件用于 L 就得到完美匹配的判据。

匹配理论还有两个漂亮的对偶结果：**König 定理**说二部图中最大匹配的边数等于盖住所有边所需的最少顶点数；**k-正则二部图**（每个顶点的度都是 k ≥ 1，两侧大小相同）必有完美匹配。二部匹配可以建模成网络流，用最大流最小割定理统一证明霍尔定理与 König 定理，这也是运筹学中「分配问题」的理论基础。
nodes.definitionEn:
A graph is **bipartite** when its vertex set can be split into two parts $L$ and $R$ so that **every edge** joins a vertex of $L$ to a vertex of $R$ (no edge inside a part); we write $G = (L \cup R, E)$. Equivalently, bipartite graphs are exactly the graphs that admit a **2-coloring** in which adjacent vertices get different colors. The central criterion: **a graph is bipartite iff it contains no cycle of odd length**, a complete equivalence in both directions. Necessity: walking along an odd cycle forces the colors to alternate, so after an odd number of edges the starting vertex would need the opposite color from itself; sufficiency: color each vertex by the parity of its distance from a fixed vertex, and a same-colored adjacent pair would close an odd cycle. Trees and forests have no cycles at all and are therefore bipartite; $K_{m,n}$ (all edges between m left vertices and n right vertices) is the standard example.

A **matching** is a set of edges no two of which share an endpoint; an edge “covers” its two endpoints. A matching with the largest possible number of edges is a **maximum matching**, its size written $\nu(G)$; a matching covering every vertex is **perfect** — for a bipartite graph this forces $|L| = |R|$. Matchings formalize non-conflicting pairings in which each object takes part in at most one pair.

**Hall's theorem** (the marriage theorem) gives the exact criterion for a matching saturating all of L: such a matching exists **if and only if $|N(S)| \ge |S|$ for every subset $S \subseteq L$**, where $N(S)$ is the union of the neighborhoods of the vertices in S. The quantifier is the crux: the condition must hold for **every** subset — any k left vertices together need at least k neighbors — and checking single vertices is far from enough. Necessity is clear: each vertex of S needs a distinct neighbor, all lying in $N(S)$. The standard proof of sufficiency uses **augmenting paths**: if a matching fails to saturate L, alternate unmatched and matched edges starting from an unsaturated left vertex; either an augmenting path enlarges the matching, or the reachable left vertices form a set S with $|N(S)| = |S| - 1 < |S|$, contradicting the hypothesis. When $|L| = |R|$, applying Hall's condition to L yields a perfect matching.

Two beautiful duality results complete the picture: **König's theorem** states that in a bipartite graph the size of a maximum matching equals the minimum number of vertices needed to cover all edges, and every **k-regular bipartite graph** (all degrees k ≥ 1, equal side sizes) has a perfect matching. Bipartite matching can be modeled as network flow, and the max-flow min-cut theorem proves both Hall's and König's theorems — the theoretical core of assignment problems in operations research.

formulas.latex: G \text{ 是二部图} \iff V(G) = L \sqcup R \text{ 且每条边连接 } L \text{ 与 } R \iff G \text{ 不含奇圈}
formulas.note: 二部性的三个等价刻画；「不含奇圈」是最好用的判定（等价说法：2-可染色），两个方向都成立。
formulas.noteEn: Three equivalent views of bipartiteness; “no odd cycle” is the handiest test (equivalently: 2-colorable), valid in both directions.

formulas.latex: \forall S \subseteq L: \ |N(S)| \ge |S| \iff G \text{ 存在饱和 } L \text{ 全部顶点的匹配}
formulas.note: 霍尔定理：量词「任意子集 S」不能弱化为「任意单点」，否则会误判；反例见例题。
formulas.noteEn: Hall's theorem: the quantifier over all subsets cannot be weakened to single vertices, or the test misfires; see the counterexample.

formulas.latex: |L| = |R| \text{ 时：霍尔条件} \iff G \text{ 有完美匹配}
formulas.note: 完美匹配判据：两侧大小相同时，「饱和 L」就等于「盖住所有顶点」。
formulas.noteEn: The perfect-matching criterion: with equal sides, saturating L means covering every vertex.

formulas.note: König 定理：最大匹配边数（ν）等于最小顶点覆盖点数（τ）；一般图不成立，C5 上 ν = 2 而 τ = 3。
formulas.noteEn: König's theorem: maximum matching size ν equals minimum vertex cover size τ; it fails for general graphs, where C5 has ν = 2 but τ = 3.

formulas.latex: G \text{ 为 } k\text{-正则二部图 } (k \ge 1) \implies G \text{ 有完美匹配}
formulas.note: 由霍尔定理证明：S 中每个点贡献 k 条边，全部落在 N(S) 内，故 k|N(S)| ≥ k|S|，即 |N(S)| ≥ |S|。
formulas.noteEn: Proved by Hall: the k|S| edges leaving S all land in N(S), so k|N(S)| ≥ k|S|, i.e. |N(S)| ≥ |S|.

properties: 二部性的实质是「没有奇圈」：树、森林、偶圈都是二部图；任何非二部图都含有奇圈。偶圈与奇圈的区分正是二部性的分水岭。
匹配的边两两不相邻，故 |M| ≤ ⌊n/2⌋；二部图中还有 |M| ≤ min(|L|, |R|)，完美匹配要求 |L| = |R| 且每个顶点都被盖住。
霍尔条件的量词：必须对全部子集 S ⊆ L 验证 |N(S)| ≥ |S|。只验证单点是常见错误——「每人都有 2 个可选岗位，但 2 个岗位要分给 3 个人」时，整体条件就会失败。
增广路刻画：匹配 M 是最大匹配 ⇔ 不存在关于 M 的增广路（起点和终点都是未饱和点、边在「非匹配—匹配」间交替的路）。这给出求最大匹配的多项式时间算法（匈牙利算法），也是霍尔定理充分性的证明骨架。
对偶与算法：二部图中最大匹配大小等于最小顶点覆盖大小（König 定理），并与网络最大流最小割对应；由此可得 k-正则二部图必有完美匹配，例如 K3,3。一般图无此对偶（C5：最大匹配 2、最小顶点覆盖 3）。
propertiesEn: Bipartiteness really means “no odd cycle”: trees, forests and even cycles are all bipartite, while every non-bipartite graph contains an odd cycle. The even-versus-odd distinction is the watershed.
Edges of a matching are pairwise disjoint, so |M| ≤ ⌊n/2⌋; in a bipartite graph also |M| ≤ min(|L|, |R|), and a perfect matching requires |L| = |R| with every vertex covered.

The quantifier in Hall's condition: one must check |N(S)| ≥ |S| for all subsets S of L. Checking single vertices is a common mistake — three people each having two choices among the same two jobs guarantees no full assignment.

Augmenting-path characterization: M is maximum iff no augmenting path for M exists (an alternating path whose two ends are unsaturated). This yields the polynomial-time Hungarian algorithm and underlies the proof of Hall's theorem.

Duality and algorithms: in bipartite graphs the maximum matching size equals the minimum vertex cover size (König), matching the max-flow min-cut correspondence; hence every k-regular bipartite graph such as K3,3 has a perfect matching. General graphs lack this duality (C5: maximum matching 2, minimum vertex cover 3).

examples.problem: 五名学生甲、乙、丙、丁、戊申请五个岗位 1, 2, 3, 4, 5，各人会做的岗位为：甲 {1, 2}，乙 {2, 3}，丙 {1, 3, 4}，丁 {4, 5}，戊 {5}。能否安排每人恰好做一项自己会做的岗位、且每个岗位至多一人？用霍尔定理判断并给出一种安排。
examples.solution: 把学生看成左部 L、岗位看成右部 R，边表示「会做」。按霍尔定理，需要检验每一个非空子集 $S \subseteq L$ 是否都满足 $|N(S)| \ge |S|$（共 $2^5 - 1 = 31$ 个子集）。挑几个最「紧」的看：$\{甲, 乙\}$ 的邻居是 {1, 2, 3}，3 ≥ 2；$\{丁, 戊\}$ 的邻居是 {4, 5}，2 ≥ 2；$\{乙, 丁, 戊\}$ 的邻居是 {2, 3, 4, 5}，4 ≥ 3；$\{甲, 乙, 丙\}$ 的邻居是 {1, 2, 3, 4}，4 ≥ 3。python 枚举全部 31 个子集复核，未发现任何违反者，故霍尔条件成立，存在饱和全部五名学生的匹配。一种安排：甲 → 1，乙 → 2，丙 → 3，丁 → 4，戊 → 5——逐项检查都落在各自会做的集合内 ✓；python 的匈牙利算法也求出大小为 5 的匹配 ✓。

examples.problem: 四名申请者 a、b、c、d 与四个岗位 1, 2, 3, 4，可做集合为 a {1, 2}，b {1, 2}，c {1, 2}，d {3, 4}。能否实现完美匹配？霍尔定理在哪个子集处失败？实际最大匹配有多大？
examples.solution: 考察 S = {a, b, c}：三人合起来只会做 {1, 2} 这两个岗位，$|N(S)| = 2 < 3 = |S|$，霍尔条件失败（python 枚举确认 {a, b, c} 是唯一的违反子集），因此不存在饱和 {a, b, c} 的匹配，更谈不上完美匹配。注意每个**单个**申请者都有至少 2 个选择，逐个看毫无异样——这正说明量词「任意 k 个左顶点」不能弱化为「每个左顶点」。实际最大匹配为 3，例如 a → 1、b → 2、d → 3：三人配对后 {a, b, c} 中剩下的 c 已无岗可配（1、2 都被占用），边数 $3 < 4$；python 的匈牙利算法复核最大匹配大小正是 3 ✓。

nodes.title: 平面图与欧拉公式
nodes.summary: 平面图可画在平面上而不让边相交；连通平面图满足 v − e + f = 2（面含外部面），由此得到边数上界与 K5、K3,3 的非平面性。
nodes.summaryEn: A planar graph can be drawn in the plane without edge crossings; connected planar graphs satisfy v − e + f = 2 with the outer face counted, which yields edge bounds and the non-planarity of K5 and K3,3.
nodes.definition:
如果一个图能画在平面上，使**顶点位置互异、每条边是连续曲线、任意两条边除公共端点外不相交**，就称它是**平面图**，这样的画法叫**平面嵌入**。嵌入把平面分割成若干区域，每个区域叫一个**面**；唯一无界的区域叫**外部面**（无穷面），其余为**内部面**。面是「画法」的属性：同一个平面图的不同嵌入中，面的形状可以不同，但对连通平面图，面的**个数**固定——由下面的欧拉公式决定。

**欧拉公式**：若连通平面图有 v 个顶点、e 条边、f 个面（**含外部面**），则 $v - e + f = 2$。它最早来自多面体：简单多面体的顶点数、棱数、面数总满足这个等式（正四面体 $4 - 6 + 4 = 2$，正方体 $8 - 12 + 6 = 2$，正十二面体 $20 - 30 + 12 = 2$）。证明思路很干净：先取图的一棵生成树（含 $v - 1$ 条边）画好，此时平面只有一个面；再把剩下的 $e - v + 1$ 条边一条条补回去，每补一条边，因为两端已连通，恰好劈开一个已有面、多出一个新面，于是 $f = 1 + (e - v + 1)$，移项即得欧拉公式。对不连通的平面图，公式要改成 $v - e + f = 1 + c$（c 为连通分支数）：外部面只算一次，每个分支单独贡献。

欧拉公式最常用的形式是它的推论。设 G 是 $v \ge 3$ 的**连通**简单平面图：每个面至少由 3 条边围成（连通性不可省——如 K₂ 加孤立点，唯一的面边界长度为 2），而每条边被两侧的面共用，把各面度数相加时每条边恰好贡献 2，于是 $3f \le 2e$；代入欧拉公式得 $e \le 3v - 6$。若无三角形（例如二部图，每个面至少 4 条边），可得更强的 $e \le 2v - 4$；一般地，围长为 g 时 $e \le g(v-2)/(g-2)$。这些不等式立刻推出两个经典事实：$K_5$ 有 $e = 10 > 3 \times 5 - 6 = 9$，$K_{3,3}$ 没有三角形但有 $e = 9 > 2 \times 6 - 4 = 8$——它们都不是平面图。**库拉托夫斯基（Kuratowski）定理**给出完整刻画：图是平面图当且仅当它不含 $K_5$ 或 $K_{3,3}$ 的**细分**（把某些边替换成长路径得到的图）。

平面图还配有**对偶图**：给定连通平面图的一个嵌入，在每个面里放一个对偶顶点，每条原边两侧的两个面之间连一条对偶边，得到的图 $G^*$ 叫对偶图。对偶满足 $v^* = f$、$e^* = e$、$f^* = v$，自然满足同样的欧拉公式。平面性、对偶性与「简单平面图平均度小于 6」这些事实，共同构成地图染色问题（四色定理）的舞台。
nodes.definitionEn:
A graph is **planar** if it can be drawn in the plane so that **distinct vertices sit at distinct points, every edge is a continuous arc, and two edges meet only at a shared endpoint**; such a drawing is a **planar embedding**. An embedding cuts the plane into regions called **faces**; the unique unbounded region is the **outer face**, the others are inner faces. Faces belong to the drawing: different embeddings of one planar graph may have differently shaped faces, but for a connected planar graph the **number** of faces is fixed — it is determined by Euler's formula below.

**Euler's formula**: if a connected planar graph has v vertices, e edges and f faces (**the outer face included**), then $v - e + f = 2$. It grew out of polyhedra: for a convex polyhedron the counts always satisfy it (tetrahedron $4 - 6 + 4 = 2$, cube $8 - 12 + 6 = 2$, dodecahedron $20 - 30 + 12 = 2$). The proof is clean: draw a spanning tree of the graph first (v − 1 edges), which leaves exactly one face; then add the remaining $e - v + 1$ edges one at a time. Because the endpoints of each such edge are already connected, adding it splits one existing face into two, increasing the face count by 1, so $f = 1 + (e - v + 1)$ and Euler's formula follows. For a disconnected planar graph the formula becomes $v - e + f = 1 + c$ with c components: the outer face is counted once, each component contributing separately.

The most useful consequences concern **connected** simple planar graphs with $v \ge 3$ (connectedness cannot be dropped: K₂ plus an isolated vertex has a single face of boundary length 2). Every face is bounded by at least 3 edges while each edge is shared by the faces on its two sides, so summing face degrees counts every edge exactly twice and $3f \le 2e$; combined with Euler's formula this gives $e \le 3v - 6$. Without triangles (for instance bipartite graphs, whose faces have length at least 4) the stronger bound $e \le 2v - 4$ holds; in general, girth g yields $e \le g(v-2)/(g-2)$. Two classical facts drop out immediately: $K_5$ has $e = 10 > 3 \times 5 - 6 = 9$, and $K_{3,3}$ is triangle-free yet has $e = 9 > 2 \times 6 - 4 = 8$ — neither is planar. **Kuratowski's theorem** gives the complete characterization: a graph is planar iff it contains no **subdivision** of $K_5$ or $K_{3,3}$ (a subdivision replaces edges by longer paths).

Planar graphs come with a **dual graph**: fix an embedding of a connected planar graph, place a dual vertex inside each face, and for every original edge draw a dual edge joining the faces on its two sides. The dual $G^*$ satisfies $v^* = f$, $e^* = e$, $f^* = v$ and obeys the same Euler formula. Planarity, duality and the fact that a simple planar graph has average degree below 6 together form the stage for map-coloring problems (the four-color theorem).

formulas.latex: v - e + f = 2 \qquad (G \text{ 为连通平面图，} f \text{ 含外部面})
formulas.note: 欧拉公式：面数必须把外部面算进去，否则公式不成立；不连通时为 v − e + f = 1 + c。
formulas.noteEn: Euler's formula: the outer face must be included in f; for a disconnected graph it reads v − e + f = 1 + c.

formulas.note: 面度数（围出该面的边数）之和为 2e：每条边被两侧的面各用一次；桥的两侧是同一个面，也计 2 次。
formulas.noteEn: Face degrees (boundary lengths) sum to 2e: each edge is used once by each side; a bridge borders one face on both sides and still counts twice.

formulas.note: 围长版边数上界：g = 3 得 e ≤ 3v − 6（简单平面图），g = 4（无三角形，例如二部图）得 e ≤ 2v − 4。
formulas.noteEn: The girth bound: g = 3 gives e ≤ 3v − 6 for simple planar graphs, and g = 4 (triangle-free, e.g. bipartite) gives e ≤ 2v − 4.

formulas.latex: v^* = f, \qquad e^* = e, \qquad f^* = v
formulas.note: 对偶图的基本关系（对连通平面图的一个嵌入）：顶点数与面数互换，边数不变。
formulas.noteEn: Dual-graph relations for an embedding of a connected planar graph: vertex and face counts swap, the edge count stays.

formulas.latex: G \text{ 平面} \iff G \text{ 不含 } K_5 \text{ 或 } K_{3,3} \text{ 的细分}
formulas.note: Kuratowski 定理：平面性的完整刻画；细分指把边替换成长路径，细分不改变平面性。
formulas.noteEn: Kuratowski's theorem: the complete characterization of planarity; subdividing edges into longer paths does not affect planarity.

properties: 欧拉公式的连通性前提：不连通时 v − e + f = 1 + c（c 为连通分支数）。例如两个不相交的三角形：v = 6、e = 6、f = 3，得 6 − 6 + 3 = 3 = 1 + 2 ✓。计算面数时若不把外部面算进去，公式立刻失效。
简单平面图有 e ≤ 3v − 6（v ≥ 3）；无三角形（例如二部图）时加强为 e ≤ 2v − 4。取等号当且仅当图**连通**、且每个面（含外部面）都恰由 3 条边 / 4 条边围成——三角剖分与四边形剖分（不连通时一般取不到等号，如三角形加一个孤立点）。
简单平面图的平均度为 2e/v < 6，因此任何简单平面图都含度数不超过 5 的顶点；这是处理平面图问题的标准归纳起点（五色定理的证明即以此起步）。
K5 与 K3,3 是两个基本的非平面图：K5 直接用 e ≤ 3v − 6 判非平面，K3,3 需用二部图加强版 e ≤ 2v − 4；由 Kuratowski 定理，任何非平面图都含有这两个图之一的细分，非平面性最终都归结到它们。
五种正多面体都满足欧拉公式：正四面体 4 − 6 + 4 = 2、正方体 8 − 12 + 6 = 2、正八面体 6 − 12 + 8 = 2、正十二面体 20 − 30 + 12 = 2、正二十面体 12 − 30 + 20 = 2，数值全部复核 ✓。
propertiesEn: Euler's formula presumes connectivity: in general v − e + f = 1 + c with c components. Two disjoint triangles give v = 6, e = 6, f = 3 and 6 − 6 + 3 = 3 = 1 + 2 ✓. Leaving out the outer face breaks the formula immediately.

A simple planar graph satisfies e ≤ 3v − 6 (v ≥ 3); if it is triangle-free (e.g. bipartite) the stronger e ≤ 2v − 4 holds. Equality holds exactly when the graph is **connected** and every face including the outer one has boundary length 3 or 4 — triangulations and quadrangulations (for disconnected graphs equality generally fails, e.g. a triangle plus an isolated vertex).

The average degree of a simple planar graph is 2e/v < 6, so every such graph contains a vertex of degree at most 5; this is the standard induction step for planar arguments (the five-color theorem starts here).

K5 and K3,3 are the two basic non-planar graphs: K5 is killed by e ≤ 3v − 6, while K3,3 needs the bipartite bound e ≤ 2v − 4. By Kuratowski's theorem every non-planar graph contains a subdivision of one of them, so non-planarity always reduces to these two.

All five Platonic solids obey Euler's formula: tetrahedron 4 − 6 + 4 = 2, cube 8 − 12 + 6 = 2, octahedron 6 − 12 + 8 = 2, dodecahedron 20 − 30 + 12 = 2, icosahedron 12 − 30 + 20 = 2 — every count rechecked ✓.

plot.title: K₄ 的平面画法：v = 4、e = 6、f = 4（含外部面），满足 v − e + f = 2

examples.problem: 正方体的顶点与棱构成图 G：8 个顶点、12 条边、每个顶点度 3。(1) 用欧拉公式求面数；(2) 验证各面度数之和等于 2e；(3) 比较 e ≤ 3v − 6 与二部图加强版 e ≤ 2v − 4，哪个取等号？为什么？
examples.solution: (1) G 是连通平面图，v = 8、e = 12，由 $v - e + f = 2$ 得 $f = 2 - v + e = 2 - 8 + 12 = 6$：平面画法中是 5 个内部面加 1 个外部面，恰好对应正方体的 6 个面（哪个面画成外部面不影响 f 的值）。(2) 每个面都恰由 4 条边围成，面度数总和为 $6 \times 4 = 24$，而 $2e = 2 \times 12 = 24$，相等 ✓（python 复核）。(3) $3v - 6 = 18$，$e = 12 < 18$ 未取等；而 $2v - 4 = 12 = e$，取等号。原因：G 是二部图（按顶点坐标的奇偶可染成两色，每条棱连接异色点），没有三角形，且每个面都是四边形，正是 $e \le 2v - 4$ 取等号的四边形剖分情形。

examples.problem: 用边数不等式证明 K5 与 K3,3 都不是平面图；并说明为什么对 K3,3 必须使用二部图版本的加强不等式。
examples.solution: 对 K5：v = 5 ≥ 3 且是简单图。若它是平面图，则必须满足 $e \le 3v - 6 = 3 \times 5 - 6 = 9$；但 $K_5$ 有 $e = \binom{5}{2} = 10 > 9$，矛盾，故 K5 非平面。对 K3,3：v = 6、e = 3 × 3 = 9。先试一般不等式：$3v - 6 = 12 \ge 9$，拦不住它；但 K3,3 是二部图，没有三角形，平面嵌入中每个面至少由 4 条边围成，可以用加强版 $e \le 2v - 4 = 2 \times 6 - 4 = 8$；而 $e = 9 > 8$，矛盾，故 K3,3 也非平面。这两个图正是「平面性的基本障碍」：由 Kuratowski 定理，任何非平面图都含有 K5 或 K3,3 的细分（python 复核：10 > 9 ✓；9 ≤ 12 但 9 > 8 ✓）。

nodes.title: 图的染色
nodes.summary: 给图的顶点分配颜色使相邻点异色，所需的最少颜色数称为色数；四色定理说平面图 4 色就够。
nodes.summaryEn: A proper coloring assigns colors to vertices so that adjacent vertices differ; the minimum number of colors is the chromatic number, and planar graphs need at most four.
nodes.definition:
给图 $G=(V,E)$ 的每个顶点分配一种颜色，如果**相邻的两个顶点颜色总不相同**，就称这是一次**正常染色**（proper coloring）。只允许用 $k$ 种颜色时，称 $G$ 为 **$k$-可染的**；使正常染色成为可能的最小颜色数叫作 $G$ 的**色数**，记作 $\chi(G)$。换个说法，$\chi(G)$ 就是把顶点集划分成最少数目**独立集**（同色类）的个数，而 $\chi(G)=1$ 当且仅当图没有边。

两个基准例子锁定直觉：完全图两两相邻，颜色必须两两不同，$\chi(K_n)=n$；偶圈红蓝交替即可，$\chi(C_{2k})=2$；奇圈交替到最后一圈会撞色，必须启用第三种颜色，$\chi(C_{2k+1})=3$。

色数与图的两个基本参数关系密切。**团数** $\omega(G)$（最大团的大小）给出下界：团内任两点相邻、必须异色，故 $\chi(G)\ge\omega(G)$；**独立数** $\alpha(G)$ 给出另一个下界 $\chi(G)\ge |V|/\alpha(G)$，因为每个色类都是独立集。上界方面有一个万能但粗糙的贪心论证：按任意顺序逐点染色，每点只需避开已染色邻居的颜色，而邻居数不超过最大度 $\Delta$，于是 $\chi(G)\le\Delta(G)+1$。

最著名的结论是**四色定理**：任何**平面图**的色数都不超过 4。它由 Appel 与 Haken 于 1976 年公布计算机辅助证明，是第一个本质上依赖计算机验证的著名数学定理；$K_4$ 是平面图且 $\chi(K_4)=4$，说明 4 不能再小。一般图没有这样的小上界（$\chi(K_n)=n$），而且判定 $k\ge 3$ 是否可着色是 NP-完全问题——求色数正是「上界容易、精确值困难」的典型。
nodes.definitionEn:
Assign a color to every vertex of a graph $G=(V,E)$. If adjacent vertices always receive different colors, the assignment is a **proper coloring**. When only k colors are allowed and a proper coloring exists, G is **k-colorable**; the least such k is the **chromatic number** $\chi(G)$. Equivalently, $\chi(G)$ is the smallest number of **independent sets** (color classes) whose union is V, and $\chi(G)=1$ exactly when G has no edge.

Two benchmarks fix intuition: every two vertices of a complete graph are adjacent, so $\chi(K_n)=n$; an even cycle alternates two colors, $\chi(C_{2k})=2$; an odd cycle must repeat a color somewhere, so $\chi(C_{2k+1})=3$.

The chromatic number interacts with two basic parameters. The **clique number** $\omega(G)$ gives a lower bound, since a clique on k vertices needs k distinct colors: $\chi(G)\ge\omega(G)$. The **independence number** $\alpha(G)$ gives another, because every color class is independent: $\chi(G)\ge |V|/\alpha(G)$. For an upper bound a greedy argument always works: color the vertices in any order, giving each the first color unused by its already colored neighbours; since a vertex has at most $\Delta$ neighbours, $\chi(G)\le\Delta(G)+1$.

The most famous result is the **four color theorem**: every **planar** graph satisfies $\chi\le 4$. Appel and Haken announced a computer-assisted proof in 1976 — the first famous theorem whose proof depends essentially on machine verification — and $K_4$, planar with $\chi(K_4)=4$, shows that four cannot be reduced. General graphs admit no such small bound ($\chi(K_n)=n$), and deciding k-colorability for $k\ge 3$ is NP-complete: computing the chromatic number is a textbook case of an easy upper bound hiding a hard exact value.

formulas.note: 色数的定义：正常染色所需的最少颜色数；同色的顶点集（色类）一定是独立集。
formulas.noteEn: Definition: the least number of colors in a proper coloring; every color class is an independent set.

formulas.latex: G\text{ 二部}\iff\chi(G)\le 2\iff G\text{ 不含奇圈}
formulas.note: 二部图能用两色交替染；反之 2-可染图的顶点天然分成两类。含奇圈时两色必在最后一条边上冲突。
formulas.noteEn: Bipartite ⇔ 2-colorable ⇔ no odd cycle: two colors conflict exactly along an odd cycle.

formulas.note: 两个标准下界：团数与独立数。$C_5$ 中 $\omega=2$、$|V|/\alpha=5/2$，给出 $\chi(C_5)\ge 3$，而真值正是 3。
formulas.noteEn: The clique and independence bounds; for C5 they give χ ≥ 3, which is attained.

formulas.note: 贪心上界，对一切图成立，但通常不最优：$K_{3,3}$ 的 $\Delta=3$ 而 $\chi=2$。
formulas.noteEn: The greedy upper bound holds for all graphs but is usually loose: K33 has Δ=3 yet χ=2.

formulas.latex: G\text{ 连通且非完全图、非奇圈}\implies\chi(G)\le\Delta(G)
formulas.note: Brooks 定理（1941）：把贪心上界收紧一格；连通图中 $\chi=\Delta+1$ 的恰好只有完全图与奇圈。
formulas.noteEn: Brooks' theorem (1941) sharpens the greedy bound; among connected graphs only complete graphs and odd cycles have χ = Δ+1.

properties: 四色定理：任何平面图 $\chi\le 4$（Appel–Haken，1976，计算机辅助；1996 年 Robertson–Sanders–Seymour–Thomas 给出简化证明）；$K_4$ 说明 4 色可能必需。四色猜想早在 1852 年提出，而五色定理（Heawood，1890）容易得多。
下界可以不取等：$C_5$ 的 $\omega=2$ 而 $\chi=3$；用 Mycielski 构造可以造出无三角形但色数任意大的图，最小的例子是 11 个顶点的 Grötzsch 图（$\chi=4$）。
贪心上界 $\chi\le\Delta+1$ 与 Brooks 定理合起来给出完整的「最坏情形」图像：连通图中只有完全图与奇圈真正需要 $\Delta+1$ 种颜色，其余都满足 $\chi\le\Delta$。
二部性就是 2-可染性：$\chi\le 2$ 当且仅当无奇圈；沿 BFS 或 DFS 交替染两色即可线性判定，染色冲突恰好暴露出一条奇圈。
propertiesEn: Four color theorem: every planar graph has χ ≤ 4 (Appel–Haken 1976, computer-assisted; simplified by Robertson–Sanders–Seymour–Thomas in 1996), and K4 shows that four colors can be necessary; the conjecture dates back to 1852, while the five color theorem (Heawood 1890) is much easier.

Lower bounds need not be tight: ω(C5)=2 while χ(C5)=3, and Mycielski's construction produces triangle-free graphs of arbitrarily large chromatic number, the smallest being the 11-vertex Grötzsch graph with χ=4.
Together with Brooks' theorem, the greedy bound completes the worst-case picture: among connected graphs only complete graphs and odd cycles really need Δ+1 colors; all others satisfy χ ≤ Δ.
Bipartiteness is 2-colorability: χ ≤ 2 if and only if there is no odd cycle, decided in linear time by alternating two colors along a BFS or DFS, where a conflict reveals an odd cycle.
The chromatic polynomial P_G(k), the number of proper k-colorings, is a polynomial in k, and χ(G)=min{k:P_G(k)>0}; for example P_{C5}(k)=(k−1)^5−(k−1) gives P_{C5}(3)=30 and P_{C5}(2)=0.

examples.problem: 轮图 $W_5$ 由一个五边形 $C_5$ 与一个中心点组成，中心与五边形的五个顶点都相邻。求 $\chi(W_5)$，并与贪心上界、Brooks 上界、四色定理对照。
examples.solution: 记中心为 $h$。先求下界：外圈是奇圈，$\chi(C_5)=3$，故 $\chi(W_5)\ge 3$。若只给 3 种颜色：$C_5$ 不是 2-可染的，外圈必须用满 3 种颜色；而 $h$ 与全部外圈顶点相邻，它的颜色必须与这 3 种都不同——3 色不够，故 $\chi(W_5)\ge 4$。再给上界：把外圈按 1, 2, 1, 2, 3 顺次染（逐边检验都异色），$h$ 染 4，得到正常染色，故 $\chi(W_5)\le 4$。合起来 $\chi(W_5)=4$。对照：$\Delta(W_5)=5$，贪心只保证 $\chi\le 6$；Brooks 定理给 $\chi\le 5$（$W_5$ 连通、非完全、非奇圈）；$W_5$ 是平面图，四色定理给 $\chi\le 4$，恰好取等。穷举复核：3-染色共 $3^6=729$ 种全部失败（0 种），4-染色共 $4^6=4096$ 种中恰有 120 种成立，与 $\chi=4$ 一致。

examples.problem: 求 $K_{3,3}$ 与 $C_5$ 的色数，并检验贪心上界 $\Delta+1$ 与 Brooks 上界在这两张图上是否紧。
examples.solution: 对 $K_{3,3}$：两侧各三点，把一侧全染 1、另一侧全染 2 即正常染色，而它有边故不能 1 色，所以 $\chi(K_{3,3})=2$。这里 $\Delta=3$：贪心只保证 $\chi\le 4$，Brooks 保证 $\chi\le 3$，都比真值松（穷举 2-染色恰有 2 种，即两色互换）。对 $C_5$：奇圈，$\chi(C_5)=3$，与 $\Delta+1=2+1=3$ 恰好取等——这正是 Brooks 定理的例外情形（奇圈），因此不矛盾；穷举：2-染色为 0 种，3-染色恰有 30 种（与 $P_{C_5}(3)=2^5-2=30$ 吻合）。结论：$K_{3,3}$ 说明上界只是上界，$C_5$ 说明例外情形真实存在。

nodes.title: 拉姆齐定理初步
nodes.summary: 无论怎样对完全图的边作红蓝二染色，点数足够多时必出现同色完全子图；最小的例子是 $R(3,3)=6$。
nodes.summaryEn: However the edges of a large enough complete graph are two-colored, a monochromatic clique must appear; the smallest example is R(3,3)=6.
nodes.definition:
把完全图 $K_n$ 的每条边染成红色或蓝色。**拉姆齐数** $R(s,t)$ 定义为：保证「出现红色 $K_s$ 或蓝色 $K_t$」（二者出现其一即可）的最小顶点数。用**箭头记号**说就是 $n\to(s,t)$——$K_n$ 的**每一种**红蓝二染色都含红色 $K_s$ 或蓝色 $K_t$，而 $R(s,t)=\min\{n:n\to(s,t)\}$。注意两个方向的量词不同：证明 $R(s,t)\le n$ 必须对**所有**染色论证；证明 $R(s,t)>n$ 只需给出**一种**避开两种单色子图的染色。

最小的非平凡例子是 $R(3,3)=6$，也就是「六个人里必有三人互相认识，或三人互相不认识」——熟人关系看作红边、陌生看作蓝边。两个方向各有味道：$R(3,3)>5$ 靠构造，把 5 个顶点排在正五边形上，五条边染红、五条对角线染蓝，红色图与蓝色图都同构于 $C_5$，都不含三角形；$R(3,3)\le 6$ 靠鸽笼原理，任取一个顶点 $v$，它的 5 条边中至少有 $\lceil 5/2\rceil=3$ 条同色，检查这 3 个另一端点之间的三条边即可收尾（完整论证见例题）。

**Ramsey 定理**（Ramsey 1930；Erdős–Szekeres 1935 独立得到）保证这类数一定存在：对任意 $s,t\ge 2$，$R(s,t)$ 是有限数；颜色数换成 $k$、边换成 $r$ 元子集（超图情形）结论同样成立，记作 $n\to(s_1,\dots,s_k)^r$。**无穷版本**更漂亮：$\omega\to(\omega,\omega)$——对自然数集的所有二元子集任意红蓝染色，总存在一个无穷子集，其所有二元子集同色。而且无穷版本可以推出有限版本：若每个 $n$ 都存在「无单色 $K_s$、$K_t$」的坏染色，所有坏染色按限制关系构成一棵有限分叉的无穷树，用 König 引理取出一条无穷路径，就得到 $\mathbb{N}$ 上的坏染色，与无穷版本矛盾。

拉姆齐数体现了「完全无序中必含秩序」，但精确值极难求。目前确定的只有零星几个：$R(3,3)=6$、$R(3,4)=9$、$R(3,5)=14$、$R(4,4)=18$、$R(4,5)=25$，而 $R(5,5)$ 的精确值至今未知。上下界都呈指数增长却相距甚远：$2^{s/2}\le R(s,s)\le 4^{s-1}$，确定指数中的最佳常数是当代组合学的著名难题。
nodes.definitionEn:
Color every edge of the complete graph $K_n$ red or blue. The **Ramsey number** $R(s,t)$ is the least number of vertices that guarantees a red $K_s$ or a blue $K_t$ (either one suffices). In **arrow notation**, $n\to(s,t)$ means every red-blue coloring of $K_n$ contains a red $K_s$ or a blue $K_t$, and $R(s,t)=\min\{n:n\to(s,t)\}$. Note the two quantifier directions: proving $R(s,t)\le n$ requires an argument for **every** coloring, while proving $R(s,t)>n$ requires only **one** coloring that avoids both monochromatic subgraphs.

The smallest nontrivial case is $R(3,3)=6$, the statement that among six people there are three pairwise acquainted or three pairwise unacquainted (acquaintance = red edge, stranger = blue edge). Both directions have content. $R(3,3)>5$ comes from a construction: place 5 vertices on a pentagon, color the sides red and the diagonals blue; the red graph and the blue graph are both copies of $C_5$, hence triangle-free. $R(3,3)\le 6$ comes from pigeonhole: pick any vertex v; among its 5 edges at least $\lceil 5/2\rceil=3$ share a color, and inspecting the three edges among the other endpoints finishes the argument (full proof in the examples).

**Ramsey's theorem** (Ramsey 1930; independently Erdős and Szekeres 1935) guarantees such numbers exist: $R(s,t)$ is finite for all $s,t\ge 2$. Replacing two colors by k colors and edges by r-subsets (hypergraphs) works as well, written $n\to(s_1,\dots,s_k)^r$. The **infinite version** is even cleaner: $\omega\to(\omega,\omega)$ — any red-blue coloring of the pairs of natural numbers has an infinite subset all of whose pairs share one color. The infinite version implies the finite one: if bad colorings with no monochromatic $K_s$ or $K_t$ existed for every n, they would form an infinite finitely branching tree under restriction, and König's lemma would produce a bad coloring of $\mathbb{N}$, contradicting the infinite version.

Ramsey numbers embody the motto that complete disorder is impossible, yet exact values are extremely hard. Only a few are known: $R(3,3)=6$, $R(3,4)=9$, $R(3,5)=14$, $R(4,4)=18$ and $R(4,5)=25$, while $R(5,5)$ is still unknown. The bounds grow exponentially but remain far apart: $2^{s/2}\le R(s,s)\le 4^{s-1}$, and pinning down the best exponent is a famous open problem.

formulas.latex: n\to(s,t):\ \text{对 }K_n\text{ 的任意红蓝二染色，必含红色 }K_s\text{ 或蓝色 }K_t
formulas.note: 箭头记号的含义；一般 $k$ 色、$r$ 元子集的版本写作 $n\to(s_1,\dots,s_k)^r$。
formulas.noteEn: The arrow notation; the general k-color, r-subset version is written n→(s1,…,sk)^r.

formulas.note: 定义与基本性质：红蓝互换给出对称性；$R(2,t)=t$——要躲开红色 $K_2$ 就不能有红边，于是必须点数少于 $t$ 才躲得开蓝色 $K_t$。
formulas.noteEn: Definition, symmetry by swapping colors, and the base case R(2,t)=t: avoiding a red K2 means avoiding red edges, so at least t vertices force a blue Kt.

formulas.note: Erdős–Szekeres 递推（证明见例题）及其迭代推论；取 $s=t$ 得 $R(s,s)\le\binom{2s-2}{s-1}<4^{s-1}$。
formulas.noteEn: The Erdős–Szekeres recurrence and its iterated consequence; for s=t it gives R(s,s) ≤ C(2s−2, s−1) < 4^{s−1}.

formulas.note: 已知精确值的少数几个（前四个由 Greenwood–Gleason 1955 算出）；$R(5,5)$ 至今未定，已知下界仅 43。
formulas.noteEn: The few known exact values (the first four due to Greenwood–Gleason 1955); R(5,5) is still open, with 43 only as a lower bound.

formulas.note: 对角拉姆齐数的指数级夹逼：下界来自 Erdős 1947 的计数（概率）方法，上界来自递推；两侧差距意味着指数常数仍未确定。
formulas.noteEn: Exponential bounds for the diagonal case: the lower bound via Erdős's counting (probabilistic) method of 1947, the upper bound via the recurrence.

properties: 已知值与未知值：$R(3,3)=6$、$R(3,4)=9$、$R(3,5)=14$、$R(4,4)=18$ 由 Greenwood 与 Gleason 于 1955 年确定（$R(4,4)=18$ 的下界正是用模 17 的二次剩余构造，见例题）；$R(4,5)=25$ 直到 1995 年才由 McKay 与 Radziszowski 算清；$R(5,5)$ 至今未知。
上下界的手段不对称：上界（$R\le n$）必须对一切染色给出论证，典型工具是鸽笼与递推；下界（$R>n$）只需一个染色构造，典型工具是代数构造（如 Paley 图）或概率方法。
无穷版本 $\omega\to(\omega,\omega)$ 可以借助 König 引理推出有限版本——「无穷 ⇒ 有限」的这层逻辑是组合学与数理逻辑的经典交汇点。
同族现象：对整数集染色得到 Schur 定理（任意有限染色都有同色的 $x,y,x+y$），对算术级数寻找则得到 van der Waerden 定理；它们都是「大结构必含规则子结构」的拉姆齐型结论。
计算难度：$R(5,5)$ 的精确值至今未知（下界 43 来自构造，上界来自理论估计）；穷举在 $n=6$ 时已需计算机（$K_6$ 有 $2^{15}=32768$ 种染色），而对 $n=43$ 的完全图穷举 $2^{903}$ 种染色完全不现实——这正是下界靠构造、上界靠理论的原因。
propertiesEn: Known versus unknown values: R(3,3)=6, R(3,4)=9, R(3,5)=14 and R(4,4)=18 were settled by Greenwood and Gleason in 1955 (their lower bound for R(4,4) uses quadratic residues mod 17, see the examples); R(4,5)=25 was only determined in 1995 by McKay and Radziszowski; R(5,5) remains unknown.

Upper and lower bounds are proven by different means: R ≤ n needs an argument valid for every coloring (pigeonhole, induction), whereas R > n needs only one explicit coloring (algebraic constructions such as Paley graphs, or probabilistic methods).
The infinite version ω→(ω,ω) implies the finite one via König's lemma — a classic meeting point of combinatorics and mathematical logic.

Many Ramsey-type relatives exist: coloring the integers yields Schur's theorem (some monochromatic x, y, x+y), while looking for arithmetic progressions yields van der Waerden's theorem; all say that a large structure must contain a regular substructure.

Computational difficulty: R(5,5) is still unknown (43 is a lower bound from constructions, upper bounds come from theory); brute force already needs a computer at n=6 (K6 has 2^15 = 32768 colorings), and at n=43 one would face 2^903 colorings — which is why lower bounds come from constructions and upper bounds from theory.

examples.problem: 证明 $R(3,3)=6$（两个方向都要给出）。
examples.solution: **先证 $R(3,3)>5$（构造）**：把 5 个顶点编号 0,1,2,3,4 排在正五边形上，边 $\{i,j\}$ 染红当且仅当 $i-j\equiv\pm 1\pmod 5$（五条边），其余（五条对角线）染蓝。红色图与蓝色图都同构于 $C_5$，而 $C_5$ 不含三角形，故这个染色既没有红三角形也没有蓝三角形，$R(3,3)\ge 6$。**再证 $R(3,3)\le 6$（鸽笼）**：设 $K_6$ 已被任意红蓝二染色，取顶点 $v$。$v$ 连出 5 条边，颜色只有两种，由鸽笼原理至少 $\lceil 5/2\rceil=3$ 条同色；设 $va,vb,vc$ 为红色。现在看 $a,b,c$ 之间的三条边：若其中有红边（例如 $ab$），则 $v,a,b$ 组成红色三角形；若一条红边都没有，则 $ab,bc,ca$ 全蓝，$a,b,c$ 本身是蓝色三角形。两种情形都出现单色三角形，故 $6\to(3,3)$，$R(3,3)\le 6$。**结论**：$R(3,3)=6$。**穷举复核**：$K_5$ 共 $2^{10}=1024$ 种染色，恰有 12 种不含单色三角形（恰好是红图为 $C_5$ 的标号方式数 $4!/2=12$）；$K_6$ 共 $2^{15}=32768$ 种染色，无一能避免。

examples.problem: 证明递推 $R(s,t)\le R(s-1,t)+R(s,t-1)$，并用它计算 $R(3,3)$ 与 $R(4,4)$ 的上界；说明 $R(4,4)=18$ 还差哪一半。
examples.solution: **递推证明**：令 $N=R(s-1,t)+R(s,t-1)$，设 $K_N$ 已任意二染色，取顶点 $v$，它连出 $N-1$ 条边。若其中红边至少 $R(s-1,t)$ 条，把这些红邻居取出，记为顶点集 $A$（$|A|\ge R(s-1,t)$）：在 $A$ 上若无蓝色 $K_t$，则必有红色 $K_{s-1}$，它与 $v$ 一起组成红色 $K_s$——两种情形都达标。若红边不足 $R(s-1,t)$ 条，则蓝边至少 $(N-1)-(R(s-1,t)-1)=R(s,t-1)$ 条，同样论证。故 $N\to(s,t)$。**代入基值**：$R(2,t)=t$，于是 $R(3,3)\le R(2,3)+R(3,2)=3+3=6$；再用 $R(3,4)\le R(2,4)+R(3,3)=4+6=10$ 与对称性，得 $R(4,4)\le R(3,4)+R(4,3)\le 10+10=20$。若已知 $R(3,4)=9$（Greenwood–Gleason），同一递推立即收紧为 $R(4,4)\le 9+9=18$。**还差的一半**：上界 $\le 18$ 有了，下界需要构造 17 个点的染色，使红蓝都无 $K_4$。取顶点为模 17 的剩余类，边染红当且仅当两数之差是模 17 的二次剩余（即 $1,2,4,8,9,13,15,16$）：因为 $17\equiv 1\pmod 4$，红图的补图与红图同构，逐项检查 4 点组可知红蓝都不含 $K_4$，故 $R(4,4)>17$，即 $R(4,4)\ge 18$。两半合起来 $R(4,4)=18$。（编程复核：对全部 $\binom{17}{4}=2380$ 个 4 点组检查，红色 $K_4$ 与蓝色 $K_4$ 的个数都是 0。）

nodes.title: 网络流：最大流最小割
nodes.summary: 在有容量的有向网络中，最大流的值恰等于最小割的容量；用残量网络上的增广路可以逐步构造出最大流。
nodes.summaryEn: In a capacitated directed network the maximum flow value equals the minimum cut capacity, and augmenting paths in the residual network construct a maximum flow.
nodes.definition:
**网络**是一张有向图，每条弧 $(u,v)$ 带有非负**容量** $c(u,v)$，并指定两个特殊顶点：**源** $s$ 与**汇** $t$。**流** $f$ 给每条弧指派一个数值 $f(u,v)$，满足两条基本约束：**容量约束** $0\le f(u,v)\le c(u,v)$，以及**流守恒**——除 $s$、$t$ 外每个顶点的流入量等于流出量。流的值 $|f|$ 定义为源点的净流出（由守恒它也等于汇点的净流入）。管道网络是标准图景：容量是管子的粗细，流是水流量，水在中间节点既不产生也不消失。

**割**是把顶点集分成含 $s$ 的集合 $S$ 与含 $t$ 的集合 $T$ 的一种划分，割的**容量**只累加从 $S$ 指向 $T$ 的弧：$c(S,T)=\sum_{u\in S,\,v\in T}c(u,v)$。两个细节最容易记错：只数 $S\to T$ 方向的弧（从 $T$ 回到 $S$ 的弧不计），而且计的是**容量**而不是流量。对任意流 $f$ 与任意割 $(S,T)$ 都有 $|f|\le c(S,T)$：流值等于跨割的净流量，其中 $S\to T$ 的分量受容量限制、$T\to S$ 的分量非负，于是「最大流 ≤ 最小割」总是成立。

**最大流最小割定理**（Ford–Fulkerson 1956）断言等号成立：最大流的值恰等于最小割的容量。证明是构造性的，围绕**残量网络**展开：每条弧的剩余容量是 $c(u,v)-f(u,v)$，若某条从 $s$ 到 $t$ 的**增广路**上处处还有剩余容量，就沿路把流增大到瓶颈值（沿途最小剩余容量）。当再也找不到增广路时，从 $s$ 出发沿剩余容量为正的弧能到达的顶点构成集合 $S$（$t\notin S$），它定义的割满足：每条 $S\to T$ 弧都**饱和**（流量恰等于容量）、每条 $T\to S$ 弧流量为 0，于是流值恰好等于割容量。「没有增广路 ⇔ 当前流最优 ⇔ 存在同值的割」三件事同时发生。

一个漂亮的推论是**整数性**：容量全为整数时，每步增广的瓶颈值是正整数，算法在有限步内终止，给出**整数最大流**；写成线性规划后约束矩阵是全幺模矩阵，因此存在整数最优解。最大流最小割因此成为组合优化最完美的样板：最优值与最优性证书（割）都能显式拿到。它与二部图匹配、Menger 定理、线性规划对偶都有直接联系；另外，若容量允许实数、又任选增广路，朴素 Ford–Fulkerson 可能不终止（见性质栏），改用 BFS 选最短增广路的 Edmonds–Karp 算法即可保证多项式时间。
nodes.definitionEn:
A **network** is a directed graph in which every arc $(u,v)$ carries a non-negative **capacity** $c(u,v)$, together with two distinguished vertices: a **source** $s$ and a **sink** $t$. A **flow** $f$ assigns a number $f(u,v)$ to each arc subject to two rules: the **capacity constraint** $0\le f(u,v)\le c(u,v)$, and **conservation** — at every vertex other than s and t, the total inflow equals the total outflow. The value $|f|$ is the net outflow from the source (by conservation it also equals the net inflow at the sink). The pipe network is the standard picture: capacities are pipe widths, flow is the water, and nothing is created or lost at intermediate vertices.

A **cut** partitions the vertices into a set $S$ containing s and a set $T$ containing t, and its **capacity** adds up only the arcs pointing from S to T: $c(S,T)=\sum_{u\in S, v\in T}c(u,v)$. Two details are easily misremembered: only S→T arcs count (arcs going back from T to S do not), and capacities, not flows, are summed. For every flow and every cut, $|f|\le c(S,T)$: the flow value equals the net flow across the cut, where the S→T part is limited by capacities and the T→S part is non-negative, giving maximum flow ≤ minimum cut at once.

The **max-flow min-cut theorem** (Ford–Fulkerson 1956) asserts equality: the maximum flow value equals the minimum cut capacity. The proof is constructive and revolves around the **residual network**: the residual capacity of an arc is $c(u,v)-f(u,v)$, and whenever an **augmenting path** from s to t has positive residual capacity everywhere, the flow is increased along it by the bottleneck value (the smallest residual capacity on the path). When no augmenting path remains, the set $S$ of vertices reachable from s along positive residual arcs ($t\notin S$) defines a cut in which every S→T arc is **saturated** (flow equals capacity) and every T→S arc carries zero flow; the flow value then equals the cut capacity. Thus the three statements — no augmenting path, the flow is optimal, a cut of equal value exists — hold all at once.

A striking corollary is **integrality**: with integer capacities every augmenting step gains a positive integer, so the algorithm terminates and yields an **integer maximum flow**; in the LP formulation the constraint matrix is totally unimodular, hence integral optimal solutions exist. Max-flow min-cut is therefore the perfect showcase of combinatorial optimization: both the optimal value and an optimality certificate (the cut) can be exhibited explicitly. It connects directly to bipartite matching, Menger's theorem and LP duality; note also that with real capacities and careless augmenting, the naive Ford–Fulkerson method may fail to terminate (see the properties), while choosing shortest augmenting paths by BFS (Edmonds–Karp) guarantees polynomial time.

formulas.note: 容量约束与流守恒；采用反对称记账 $f(u,v)=-f(v,u)$，两个方向的流量可合并书写。
formulas.noteEn: Capacity constraints and conservation, with the antisymmetric convention f(u,v)=−f(v,u).

formulas.note: 流值：源点的净流出；由守恒它等于汇点的净流入，也等于跨任意割的净流量。
formulas.noteEn: The value of the flow: net outflow from the source, equal to the net inflow at the sink and to the net flow across any cut.

formulas.note: 割容量只算 $S\to T$ 的弧、只算容量；$T\to S$ 的弧不进总量（方向写反是经典错误）。
formulas.noteEn: Cut capacity sums only arcs from S to T, and capacities rather than flows; reverse arcs do not count.

formulas.note: 弱对偶的推导：净流量中第一项不超过割容量、第二项非负，故任意流不超过任意割。
formulas.noteEn: Weak duality: in the net flow the first term is bounded by the cut capacity and the second is non-negative.

formulas.note: 最大流最小割定理：等号由「无增广路时取残量可达集为 $S$」构造达到；整数容量时两端都有整数最优解。
formulas.noteEn: The max-flow min-cut theorem: equality is attained by taking S as the residual reachable set when no augmenting path remains.

properties: 弱对偶与最优性判据：$|f|\le c(S,T)$ 对一切流与割成立；只要某条流与某个割取等，两者立即都是最优的。算法上「残量网络中不存在 $s\to t$ 路径」与最优性等价，并顺带给出取等的割。
整数性：容量为整数时存在整数最大流（Ford–Fulkerson 每步增广整数值，有限步终止）；对应线性规划的约束矩阵全幺模，最优解自动落在整数格点上（与线性规划对偶一节互链）。
算法与终止性：整数容量下朴素 Ford–Fulkerson 必定终止（流值每步至少 +1，且以割容量为上界）；实数容量时任选增广路可能不终止、甚至收敛到小于最大值的流（Zwick 的构造），但一旦终止，无增广路仍保证最优。Edmonds–Karp 用 BFS 选最短增广路，复杂度 $O(VE^2)$，与容量数值大小无关。
组合推论：二部图最大匹配可建模为最大流（源到左侧、中间、右侧到汇的容量全取 1），整数流对应匹配、最小割对应最小顶点覆盖，于是 König 定理「最大匹配 = 最小顶点覆盖」是本定理的特例；更一般地，Menger 定理指出边不相交 $s$-$t$ 路径的最大条数等于最小 $s$-$t$ 割的容量。
对偶语言：最大流是线性规划，其 LP 对偶恰好是最小割问题，「强对偶」即最大流最小割；互补松弛给出最优性证书——流最优当且仅当存在割使每条 $S\to T$ 弧饱和、每条 $T\to S$ 弧流量为零。
propertiesEn: Weak duality and an optimality criterion: |f| ≤ c(S,T) always holds, and equality for a single flow-cut pair certifies both as optimal; absence of an s→t path in the residual network is equivalent to optimality and produces the matching cut.

Integrality: integer capacities admit an integer maximum flow (each Ford–Fulkerson augmentation is integral and the process terminates); the LP constraint matrix is totally unimodular, so optimal solutions are automatically integral.

Termination: with integer capacities naive Ford–Fulkerson terminates (the value grows by at least 1 and is bounded by any cut capacity); with real capacities, careless augmentation may fail to terminate or even converge below the maximum (Zwick's construction), though any terminating run is optimal. Edmonds–Karp picks shortest augmenting paths by BFS in O(VE²), independent of the capacity magnitudes.

Combinatorial consequences: maximum bipartite matching becomes a max-flow problem (all capacities 1); integer flows are matchings and min cuts are vertex covers, so König's theorem (maximum matching = minimum vertex cover) is a special case; more generally Menger's theorem states that the maximum number of edge-disjoint s–t paths equals the minimum s–t cut capacity.

Duality: max flow is a linear program whose dual is exactly the min cut problem, so strong duality is the theorem; complementary slackness yields optimality certificates — a flow is optimal iff some cut has every S→T arc saturated and every T→S arc empty.

plot.title: 小流网络：边标「流量/容量」，最大流 = 最小割 = 5（割 {s} 容量 3+2）

examples.solution: 逐步增广：① 沿 $s\to v_1\to v_3\to t$，瓶颈 $\min(16,12,20)=12$，流值 12；② 沿 $s\to v_2\to v_4\to t$，瓶颈 $\min(13,14,4)=4$，流值 16；③ 沿 $s\to v_2\to v_4\to v_3\to t$，四条弧剩余容量为 $13-4=9$、$14-4=10$、$7$、$20-12=8$，瓶颈 $\min(9,10,7,8)=7$，流值 $16+7=23$。守恒检验：$v_1$ 进 12 出 12；$v_2$ 进 $4+7=11$、出 11；$v_4$ 进 11、出 $7+4=11$；$v_3$ 进 $12+7=19$、出 19，全部平衡。**找割**：在此流下从 $s$ 出发沿剩余容量为正的弧可达 $\{s,v_1,v_2,v_4\}$（$s\to v_1$ 余 4，$s\to v_2$ 余 2，$v_2\to v_4$ 余 3；而 $v_1\to v_3$、$v_4\to v_3$、$v_4\to t$ 都已饱和，$t$ 不可达）。取 $S=\{s,v_1,v_2,v_4\}$、$T=\{v_3,t\}$，则 $S\to T$ 的弧只有 $v_1\to v_3$（12）、$v_4\to v_3$（7）、$v_4\to t$（4），割容量 $12+7+4=23$，恰等于流值；$T\to S$ 的弧 $v_3\to v_2$ 流量为 0，所以净流量也是 23。由最大流最小割定理，23 既是最大流值也是最小割容量。**程序复核**：枚举全部 $2^4=16$ 个含 $s$ 不含 $t$ 的割，最小容量确为 23，且上述割是取到最小值的割；注意 $s$ 的两条出弧总容量 $16+13=29$ 只是平凡上界。

examples.problem: 3 人 A、B、C 各能承担的任务为：A 可做 1、2；B 可做 2、3；C 可做 1、3。用最大流求最大匹配，并读出最小顶点覆盖。
examples.solution: **建模**：加源 $s$ 与汇 $t$；$s$ 到每人一条容量 1 的弧（每人至多承担一件事），人到自己能做的任务一条容量 1 的弧（只能承担能做的事），每个任务到 $t$ 一条容量 1 的弧（每件事至多一人做）。**求流**：三条单位增广路 $s\to A\to 2\to t$、$s\to B\to 3\to t$、$s\to C\to 1\to t$ 互不冲突，流值 3；由整数性，它对应匹配 $A{-}2$、$B{-}3$、$C{-}1$，恰好覆盖全部 6 条「能胜任」边中的 3 条互不相邻的边，是完美匹配，故最大匹配为 3。**读覆盖**：$S=\{s\}$ 是一个割，容量为 $s\to A,B,C$ 三条弧之和 $1+1+1=3$；$S'=\{s,A,B,C,1,2,3\}$（除 $t$ 外全部）也是割，容量为 $1\to t$、$2\to t$、$3\to t$ 之和 3。两个最小割分别对应顶点覆盖「全部人」$\{A,B,C\}$ 与「全部任务」$\{1,2,3\}$，大小都是 3——这正是 König 定理：二部图的最大匹配数等于最小顶点覆盖数。**程序复核**：暴力枚举得最大匹配 3、最小顶点覆盖 3，与流值一致。

nodes.title: 极值图论与 Turán 定理
nodes.summary: 极值图论问「不含给定子图的图最多有多少条边」；Turán 定理给出 ex(n,K_{r+1})，唯一的极值图是完全 r 部平衡图。
nodes.summaryEn: Extremal graph theory asks how many edges an F-free graph can have; Turán's theorem gives ex(n,K_{r+1}), attained uniquely by the balanced complete r-partite graph.
nodes.definition:
固定一个禁止出现的图 $F$。用 $\mathrm{ex}(n,F)$ 表示 $n$ 个顶点、**不含 $F$ 的副本**的图中边数的最大值（子图按通常意义理解，不必是导出子图）。例如 $\mathrm{ex}(n,K_3)$ 就是「没有三角形的 $n$ 点图最多有几条边」。极值图论不只问这个数值，还问**达到最大值的图长什么样**（极值图的结构与唯一性），以及超过阈值后 $F$ 会出现多少次。顶点数不够时没有约束：$n\le r$ 时 $\mathrm{ex}(n,K_{r+1})=\binom n2$，因为 $K_n$ 本身还装不下 $K_{r+1}$。

历史上第一个非平凡结果是 **Mantel 定理**（1907）：不含三角形的 $n$ 点图至多 $\lfloor n^2/4\rfloor$ 条边，唯一极值图是平衡完全二部图。它的推广即 **Turán 定理**（Turán 1941）：不含 $K_{r+1}$ 的 $n$ 点图至多有 $\left(1-\frac1r\right)\frac{n^2}{2}$ 条边（平衡时的精确值），等号只在**完全 $r$ 部平衡图** $T_r(n)$ 达到——把顶点尽量均匀地分成 $r$ 类，异类之间全连边、同类内部不连边。$T_r(n)$ 不含 $K_{r+1}$ 是鸽笼原理的直接推论：$r+1$ 个顶点分进 $r$ 类，必有两个顶点同类，从而不相邻。

精确记账要注意余数。设 $n=qr+s$（$0\le s<r$，即 $s=n\bmod r$），$T_r(n)$ 有 $s$ 个类大小为 $q+1$、$r-s$ 个类大小为 $q$，边数为 $t_r(n)=\left(1-\frac1r\right)\frac{n^2}{2}-\frac{s(r-s)}{2r}$；$r\mid n$ 时第二项为零，退化为干净的 $\left(1-\frac1r\right)\frac{n^2}{2}$。这里有一个容易踩的坑：**不要**把公式随手写成 $\left\lfloor\left(1-\frac1r\right)\frac{n^2}{2}\right\rfloor$。取 $n=12$、$r=8$：该式给出 63，而真值是 $t_8(12)=62$——$\binom{12}{2}$ 减去 4 个二元类内部的 4 条边，即 $66-4=62$。

Turán 定理是「密度阈值」思想的源头：它把「不含某个团」翻译成「边数不超过某条抛物线」，再由 Erdős–Stone 定理由色数推广到任意禁用图：$\mathrm{ex}(n,F)=\left(1-\frac1{\chi(F)-1}\right)\frac{n^2}{2}+o(n^2)$（$\chi(F)\ge 2$），其中 $F=K_{r+1}$（$\chi=r+1$）正是 Turán 定理。它与色数、团数、独立数、拉姆齐数乃至图极限理论都有紧密联系，是组合学中引用最广的定理之一。
nodes.definitionEn:
Fix a forbidden graph $F$. Let $\mathrm{ex}(n,F)$ denote the maximum number of edges in an n-vertex graph that contains **no copy of F** as a subgraph (in the ordinary, not necessarily induced, sense). For instance $\mathrm{ex}(n,K_3)$ is the most edges a triangle-free n-vertex graph can have. Extremal graph theory asks not only for the value but also for the **structure of the extremal graphs** (and their uniqueness), and for how many copies of F must appear once the threshold is passed. When there are too few vertices nothing is forbidden: for $n\le r$, $\mathrm{ex}(n,K_{r+1})=\binom n2$, since $K_n$ itself is too small to contain $K_{r+1}$.

The first nontrivial result is **Mantel's theorem** (1907): a triangle-free n-vertex graph has at most $\lfloor n^2/4\rfloor$ edges, and the unique extremal graph is the balanced complete bipartite graph. Its generalization is **Turán's theorem** (Turán 1941): a $K_{r+1}$-free graph on n vertices has at most $\left(1-\frac1r\right)\frac{n^2}{2}$ edges (the exact value when r divides n), with equality only for the **balanced complete r-partite graph** $T_r(n)$ — split the vertices as evenly as possible into r classes, join every pair of vertices from different classes and none inside a class. That $T_r(n)$ is $K_{r+1}$-free follows from pigeonhole: r+1 vertices placed into r classes leave two in the same class, hence non-adjacent.

The exact count requires care with remainders. Write $n=qr+s$ with $0\le s<r$ (so $s=n\bmod r$); then $T_r(n)$ has s classes of size $q+1$ and $r-s$ classes of size q, with $t_r(n)=\left(1-\frac1r\right)\frac{n^2}{2}-\frac{s(r-s)}{2r}$ edges. When $r\mid n$ the correction vanishes and the clean form $\left(1-\frac1r\right)\frac{n^2}{2}$ is exact. One common trap: do **not** replace the formula by $\left\lfloor\left(1-\frac1r\right)\frac{n^2}{2}\right\rfloor$. Take $n=12$, $r=8$: the floor version gives 63, while the truth is $t_8(12)=62$, namely $\binom{12}{2}$ minus the 4 internal edges of the four parts of size 2.

Turán's theorem launched the density threshold paradigm: it translates the absence of a large clique into an edge bound, and the Erdős–Stone theorem extends it to arbitrary forbidden graphs through the chromatic number: $\mathrm{ex}(n,F)=\left(1-\frac1{\chi(F)-1}\right)\frac{n^2}{2}+o(n^2)$ for $\chi(F)\ge 2$, of which $F=K_{r+1}$ (so $\chi=r+1$) is exactly Turán's theorem. The theorem is tightly linked to chromatic and clique numbers, independence numbers, Ramsey numbers and graph limit theory, and is among the most quoted results in combinatorics.

formulas.note: Turán 定理：数值与极值构造；等号时 $G\cong T_r(n)$（唯一）。$r=2$ 就是 Mantel 定理。
formulas.noteEn: Turán's theorem: the value and the extremal construction; equality forces G ≅ T_r(n), uniquely. The case r=2 is Mantel's theorem.

formulas.note: 一般的精确边数（含余数修正）；$r\mid n$ 时退化为 $\left(1-\frac1r\right)\frac{n^2}{2}$。不要写成 floor 形式：$(n,r)=(12,8)$ 时 floor 给 63，正确值是 62。
formulas.noteEn: The exact edge count with the remainder correction; for r | n it reduces to the clean form. Do not use the floor version: (n,r)=(12,8) yields 63 by flooring but 62 in truth.

formulas.note: Mantel 定理（$r=2$）：唯一极值图是平衡完全二部图 $K_{\lfloor n/2\rfloor,\lceil n/2\rceil}$。$r=2$ 时余数修正总小于 1，floor 写法恰好正确。
formulas.noteEn: Mantel's theorem (r=2): the unique extremal graph is the balanced complete bipartite graph; here the correction is always below 1, so the floor form happens to be correct.

formulas.note: 完全多部图的边数记账：全部 $\binom n2$ 条边减去各类内部的边；类规模越平均、减掉的越少，这就是「平衡」最优的原因。
formulas.noteEn: Edge count of a complete multipartite graph: all pairs minus the pairs inside classes; balancing the class sizes minimizes the loss, which is why balance is optimal.

formulas.note: 定理的逆否形式：边数一旦超过 Turán 阈值就必含 $K_{r+1}$，色数也随之至少 $r+1$——极值边数与团数、染色之间的桥梁。
formulas.noteEn: Contrapositive form: exceeding the Turán threshold forces a K_{r+1}, hence ω ≥ r+1 and χ ≥ r+1 — the bridge between extremal edge counts, cliques and coloring.

properties: 唯一性：等号时 $G\cong T_r(n)$，即完全 $r$ 部图且各类规模相差不超过 1。经典证明用 Zykov 对称化：对不相邻的两点，把度小者「克隆」成度大者的样子，边数不减且保持 $K_{r+1}$-free，反复操作化为完全多部图，再用均值不等式把各类调平。

Mantel 情形（$r=2$）：$e\le\lfloor n^2/4\rfloor$，等号唯一取在 $K_{\lfloor n/2\rfloor,\lceil n/2\rceil}$。一个漂亮证明：三角形-free 时每条边 $uv$ 没有公共邻点，故 $d(u)+d(v)\le n$；对全部边求和得 $\sum_v d(v)^2\le ne$，与 Cauchy–Schwarz 不等式 $\sum_v d(v)^2\ge 4e^2/n$ 联立即得 $e\le n^2/4$。
与色数、团数的桥梁：$\omega(G)\le r$ 等价于 $G$ 不含 $K_{r+1}$，故 $e(G)\le t_r(n)$；反过来 $e(G)>t_r(n)$ 保证 $\omega(G)\ge r+1$ 且 $\chi(G)\ge r+1$。染色数与边数之间的这类不等式是 Turán 定理最常见的用法。

一般禁用图的推广（Erdős–Stone–Simonovits）：$\mathrm{ex}(n,F)=\left(1-\frac1{\chi(F)-1}\right)\frac{n^2}{2}+o(n^2)$，主项只由色数决定；二分图 $F$ 是例外——此时 $\mathrm{ex}(n,F)=o(n^2)$，例如 $\mathrm{ex}(n,K_{s,t})=O(n^{2-1/s})$（Kővári–Sós–Turán）。
超图没有类似的干净定理：Turán 本人提出的三元超图情形（不含完全三元超图 $K_4^{(3)}$ 的最大边数密度的猜想值 $5/9$）至今未解决——「唯一极值图」这样的结论在图的情形其实是相当特殊的。
propertiesEn: Uniqueness: equality forces G ≅ T_r(n), a complete r-partite graph whose classes differ in size by at most 1. The classical proof is Zykov symmetrization: for a non-adjacent pair, clone the lower-degree vertex onto the higher-degree one, which never decreases the edge count and preserves K_{r+1}-freeness, reducing the problem to complete multipartite graphs, balanced by AM–GM.

The Mantel case (r=2): e ≤ ⌊n²/4⌋ with K_{⌊n/2⌋,⌈n/2⌉} as the unique extremal graph. A neat proof: in a triangle-free graph every edge uv satisfies d(u)+d(v) ≤ n, so summing gives Σd² ≤ ne, which combined with Cauchy–Schwarz Σd² ≥ 4e²/n yields e ≤ n²/4.

Bridge to clique and chromatic numbers: ω(G) ≤ r is the same as K_{r+1}-freeness, hence e(G) ≤ t_r(n); conversely e(G) > t_r(n) forces ω(G) ≥ r+1 and χ(G) ≥ r+1. Inequalities of this type are the most common use of Turán's theorem.

General forbidden graphs (Erdős–Stone–Simonovits): ex(n,F) = (1 − 1/(χ(F)−1)) n²/2 + o(n²), the leading term depending only on the chromatic number; bipartite F is the exception, where ex(n,F) = o(n²), e.g. ex(n,K_{s,t}) = O(n^{2−1/s}) (Kővári–Sós–Turán).

Hypergraphs have no comparably clean theorem: the 3-uniform case raised by Turán himself (the density of K_4^{(3)}-free hypergraphs, conjectured to be 5/9) is still open — uniqueness of the extremal graph is in fact special to the graph case.

examples.problem: 用 Mantel 定理的证明方法求 $\mathrm{ex}(6,K_3)$，并指出极值图。
examples.solution: 设 $G$ 是 6 点无三角形图，边数为 $e$。三角形-free 的关键观察：对每条边 $uv$，$u$ 与 $v$ 没有公共邻点（否则加上该点就是三角形），即 $N(u)\cap N(v)=\varnothing$，于是 $d(u)+d(v)=|N(u)\cup N(v)|\le 6$。对全部边求和：左边每条边 $uv$ 贡献 $d(u)+d(v)$，顶点 $v$ 恰在 $d(v)$ 条边中出现、每次贡献 $d(v)$，故 $\sum_{uv\in E}\bigl(d(u)+d(v)\bigr)=\sum_{v}d(v)^2\le 6e$。另一方面由 Cauchy–Schwarz 不等式，$\sum_v d(v)^2\ge\frac{(2e)^2}{6}=\frac{2e^2}{3}$。合并得 $\frac{2e^2}{3}\le 6e$，即 $e\le 9$。构造达到 9：平衡完全二部图 $K_{3,3}$ 有 $3\times 3=9$ 条边且不含三角形，故 $\mathrm{ex}(6,K_3)=9=\lfloor 6^2/4\rfloor$。**程序复核**：穷举全部 $2^{15}=32768$ 张 6 点图，无三角形者最多 9 条边；恰有 10 张达到 9 条边，全部同构于 $K_{3,3}$（对应把 6 个顶点分成两组的 $\binom 63/2=10$ 种标号方式），与唯一性吻合。

examples.problem: 求 $\mathrm{ex}(7,K_4)$，写出极值图并验证其不含 $K_4$；再检验公式在余数不为零时是否正确。
examples.solution: 用 Turán 公式：$n=7$、$r=3$，写成 $n=qr+s$ 得 $q=2$、$s=1$，于是 $t_3(7)=\left(1-\frac13\right)\frac{49}{2}-\frac{1\cdot 2}{2\cdot 3}=\frac{49}{3}-\frac13=16$。极值图 $T_3(7)$ 把 7 个顶点分成 3 类，规模为 3、2、2（即 $s=1$ 个类大小为 $q+1=3$，$r-s=2$ 个类大小为 $q=2$）；边数是三个类两两之间的完全连接：$3\times 2+3\times 2+2\times 2=6+6+4=16$ ✓（也等于 $\binom 72-\binom 32-\binom 22-\binom 22=21-3-1-1=16$）。**无 $K_4$ 的理由**：任取 4 个顶点放入 3 个类，鸽笼原理保证有两个同类、不相邻，故不构成 $K_4$。**最优性**：Turán 定理给出 $\mathrm{ex}(7,K_4)=t_3(7)=16$。**程序复核**：7 点图中边数为 16 的共 $\binom{21}{16}=20349$ 张，逐张检查含 $K_4$ 的情况，恰好有 105 张不含 $K_4$（= $T_3(7)$ 的全部标号方式数 $\binom 73\binom 42/2!=35\times 3=105$，且它们两两同构，印证唯一性）；而再添一条边（17 条边）后必然出现 $K_4$。**余数检验**：这里 $s=1\ne 0$，公式里的修正项 $-\frac{s(r-s)}{2r}=-\frac13$ 不可省略，$\frac{49}{3}\approx 16.333$ 减修正才得整数 16。

nodes.title: 命题逻辑与真值表
nodes.summary: 命题逻辑把原子命题用 ¬、∧、∨、→、↔ 拼成公式，真值表枚举一切赋值，为「重言式、矛盾式、可满足式」提供判定。
nodes.summaryEn: Propositional logic composes atomic propositions with ¬, ∧, ∨, →, ↔ into formulas; truth tables enumerate all valuations and decide tautologies, contradictions and satisfiable formulas.
nodes.definition:
命题逻辑研究**命题公式**。原子命题 $p, q, r, \dots$ 是最简单、不再分解的陈述；**联结词** $
eg$（否定）、$\wedge$（合取）、$\vee$（析取）、$	o$（蕴含）、$\leftrightarrow$（等值）把较短公式逐层拼成复合公式。联结词的含义完全由**真值表**规定，与命题的实际内容无关：$p	o q$ 只在前件 $p$ 真、结论 $q$ 假时为假，**其余情形（包括 $p$ 为假的全部情形）都为真**——「前件假则蕴含式为真」是最常被写错的一条，它正是等值式 $p	o q\Leftrightarrow
eg p\vee q$ 的直接体现。给定一组**真值赋值**（给每个原子命题指定真或假），公式的真值被唯一确定；含 $n$ 个不同原子命题的公式，真值表恰有 $2^n$ 行。

按真值表把公式分成三类：在**一切**赋值下都为真的叫**重言式**（永真式），如 $p\vee
eg p$；在一切赋值下都为假的叫**矛盾式**（永假式，也称不可满足式），如 $p\wedge
eg p$；**至少存在一组**赋值使其为真的叫**可满足式**。三类的关系要理清：重言式都可满足，可满足式未必重言；矛盾式恰是不可满足式；而 $\varphi$ 是重言式当且仅当 $
eg\varphi$ 不可满足。真值表是最朴素的判决程序：它总能在 $2^n$ 行内给出答案，但规模随 $n$ 指数增长——这提醒我们「判定」与「找证明」是两条不同的路（见 formal-proof-systems）。

两个公式**等值**（记 $\Leftrightarrow$）指真值表逐行相同；**等值演算**就是在等值定律——德摩根律、双重否定、分配律、蕴含律 $p	o q\Leftrightarrow
eg p\vee q$、逆否律 $p	o q\Leftrightarrow
eg q	o
eg p$ 等——之下的符号变形。这里要区分对象语言里的联结词 $\leftrightarrow$（本身有真值表）与元语言里的 $\Leftrightarrow$（断言两式等值，不是公式的一部分）。等值变形保持一切真值，因此可以像代数化简一样把公式化成范式来简化电路或核对论证。反面要牢记：$p	o q$ 与它的逆命题 $q	o p$、否命题 $
eg p	o
eg q$ 都**不等值**，只有逆否命题 $
eg q	o
eg p$ 才与原式等值。

五个联结词并不互相独立：$\{
eg,\wedge,\vee\}$ 已是**完备联结词集**，能表达一切真值函数；$\{
eg,	o\}$ 也完备（$\wedge$、$\vee$ 可由二者定义）；$n$ 个变元的真值函数共有 $2^{2^n}$ 个（两个变元恰有 16 个），所以「完备集」是把无穷张真值表压进有限符号的办法。反过来，$\{\wedge,\vee\}$ 不完备（造不出否定），$\{	o\}$ 单独更不行；而**与非**（NAND，$\uparrow$）与**或非**（NOR，$\downarrow$）各自单独就是完备集（Sheffer 竖线）——数字电路只用一种逻辑门就能搭建全部组合逻辑，正是这一事实的工程版本。联结词完备性也是后面用极少数公理模式刻画全部重言式的前提（见 formal-proof-systems、soundness-completeness）。
nodes.definitionEn:
Propositional logic studies **propositional formulas**. Atomic propositions $p, q, r, \dots$ are the simplest indecomposable statements; the **connectives** $
eg$ (negation), $\wedge$ (conjunction), $\vee$ (disjunction), $	o$ (implication) and $\leftrightarrow$ (equivalence) combine shorter formulas into compound ones. Their meaning is fixed entirely by **truth tables**, independent of subject matter: $p	o q$ is false only when the antecedent $p$ is true and the consequent $q$ is false, and **true in every other case—including all cases where $p$ is false**. That vacuous truth is the most frequently misstated line, and it is exactly the equivalence $p	o q\Leftrightarrow
eg p\vee q$. Once a **truth assignment** maps each atomic proposition to true or false, the formula's truth value is determined; a formula with $n$ distinct atoms has a truth table of exactly $2^n$ rows.

Truth tables sort formulas into three classes: **tautologies** (true under every assignment), such as $p\vee
eg p$; **contradictions** (false under every assignment, i.e. unsatisfiable), such as $p\wedge
eg p$; and **satisfiable formulas** (true under at least one assignment). The relationships matter: tautologies are satisfiable, satisfiable formulas need not be tautologies, contradictions are exactly the unsatisfiable formulas, and $\varphi$ is a tautology iff $
eg\varphi$ is unsatisfiable. Truth tables are the simplest decision procedure: they always answer within $2^n$ rows but grow exponentially—a reminder that deciding differs from proving (see formal-proof-systems).

Two formulas are **equivalent** (written $\Leftrightarrow$) when their truth tables agree row by row; **equational reasoning** rewrites formulas using equivalence laws—De Morgan, double negation, distributivity, the implication law $p	o q\Leftrightarrow
eg p\vee q$ and contraposition $p	o q\Leftrightarrow
eg q	o
eg p$. Keep apart the object-language connective $\leftrightarrow$ (which itself has a truth table) and the metalanguage symbol $\Leftrightarrow$ (the assertion that two formulas are equivalent, not part of any formula). Equivalence transformations preserve all truth values, so formulas can be simplified into normal forms much like algebraic expressions. Beware the converse and the inverse: $p	o q$ is **not** equivalent to $q	o p$ nor to $
eg p	o
eg q$; only the contrapositive $
eg q	o
eg p$ matches.

The five connectives are not independent: $\{
eg,\wedge,\vee\}$ is **functionally complete**, expressing every truth function; $\{
eg,	o\}$ is complete too (since $\wedge$, $\vee$ are definable from them); there are $2^{2^n}$ truth functions of $n$ variables (16 binary ones), so a complete set compresses all truth tables into finitely many symbols. By contrast $\{\wedge,\vee\}$ is not complete (it cannot express negation at all), and neither is $\{	o\}$ alone; but **NAND** ($\uparrow$) and **NOR** ($\downarrow$) each form a one-element complete set (Sheffer strokes)—the theoretical fact behind building all digital logic from a single gate type. Completeness of connectives also underlies describing all tautologies by a few axiom schemata (see formal-proof-systems, soundness-completeness).

formulas.latex:
eg(p\wedge q)\ \Leftrightarrow\ 
eg p\vee
eg q,\qquad 
eg(p\vee q)\ \Leftrightarrow\ 
eg p\wedge
eg q
formulas.note: 德摩根律：否定号可以「翻进」括号，∧ 与 ∨ 互换、各项取否；化简含否公式的第一工具。
formulas.noteEn: De Morgan's laws: negation flips into the brackets, swapping ∧ and ∨ and negating each part.

formulas.latex:
p	o q\ \Leftrightarrow\ 
eg p\vee q\ \Leftrightarrow\ 
eg q	o
eg p
formulas.note: 蕴含律与逆否律：蕴含可改写为析取（前件取否或结论真），或换成逆否命题；注意 q→p、¬p→¬q 都不等值。
formulas.noteEn: The implication law rewrites p→q as ¬p∨q; the contrapositive ¬q→¬p is equivalent too, while q→p and ¬p→¬q are not.

formulas.latex: p\wedge(q\vee r)\ \Leftrightarrow\ (p\wedge q)\vee(p\wedge r),\qquad p\vee(q\wedge r)\ \Leftrightarrow\ (p\vee q)\wedge(p\vee r)
formulas.note: 分配律：展开或提取公共因子；配合德摩根律可把任意公式化为析取范式或合取范式。
formulas.noteEn: Distributive laws expand or factor; together with De Morgan they convert any formula into disjunctive or conjunctive normal form.

formulas.note: 排中律与矛盾律：1、0 分别表示恒真与恒假；这两条是重言式与矛盾式的原型，化简时最先消去。
formulas.noteEn: Excluded middle and contradiction: 1 and 0 stand for constantly true and constantly false; the prototypes of tautology and contradiction.

formulas.note: 上箭头 ↑ 是 NAND、下箭头 ↓ 是 NOR；注意 {∧,∨} 不在其中——它无法表达否定。
formulas.noteEn: The up-arrow is NAND and the down-arrow is NOR; note {∧,∨} is absent because it cannot express negation.

properties: 对每一组真值赋值，每个命题公式恰有一个真值；因此等值、重言、矛盾、可满足都可由枚举 2ⁿ 行判定——命题逻辑的判定问题是可解的。
三类公式互为否定地成对：φ 重言 ⟺ ¬φ 不可满足；φ 矛盾 ⟺ ¬φ 重言；既非重言又非矛盾的公式（偶然式）与它的否定都可满足。
替换定理：若 A ⇔ B，则在任何公式中把子公式 A 替换为 B，所得公式与原公式等值——这是等值演算「步步保真」的根据。
联结词完备性是对表达能力的精确刻画：{¬,∧,∨}、{¬,→}、{↑}、{↓} 完备；{∧,∨} 不完备，因为它只能生成单调真值函数，无法实现否定。
蕴含不可交换：(p→q)→(q→p) 不是重言式（p 假、q 真时整个蕴含着取假值）；等值箭头 ↔ 与单方向箭头 → 有本质区别。
propertiesEn: Under each truth assignment every formula has exactly one truth value; equivalence, tautologicity, contradictoriness and satisfiability are all decidable by enumerating the 2ⁿ rows—propositional logic is decidable.
The three classes come in negated pairs: φ is a tautology iff ¬φ is unsatisfiable, and φ is a contradiction iff ¬φ is a tautology; a contingency (neither) is satisfiable together with its negation.
Substitution theorem: if A ⇔ B, replacing a subformula A by B inside any formula yields an equivalent formula—this is what makes equational reasoning sound step by step.
Functional completeness measures expressive power precisely: {¬,∧,∨}, {¬,→}, {↑} and {↓} are complete, while {∧,∨} is not—it generates only monotone truth functions and can never express negation.
Implication does not commute: (p→q)→(q→p) is not a tautology (it fails when p is false and q is true); the biconditional ↔ and the one-way arrow → are genuinely different connectives.

examples.problem:
用真值表判断 $\varphi=(p	o q)\vee(q	o p)$ 是否重言式；再验证等值式 $
eg(p	o q)\Leftrightarrow p\wedge
eg q$ 与 $p	o q\Leftrightarrow
eg q	o
eg p$，并说明 $(p	o q)	o(q	o p)$ 为何不是重言式。
examples.solution:
按 $(p,q)=(1,1),(1,0),(0,1),(0,0)$ 四行枚举。第一式：$p	o q$ 取 $1,0,1,1$，$q	o p$ 取 $1,1,0,1$，逐行取析取得 $1,1,1,1$——$\varphi$ 对全部四组赋值都为真，是**重言式**（含义：任意两个命题间的蕴含至少有一个方向成立）。等值核对：$
eg(p	o q)$ 与 $p\wedge
eg q$ 都只在 $(1,0)$ 行为真，其余为假，逐行相同；$p	o q$ 与 $
eg q	o
eg p$ 的真值行同为 $1,0,1,1$，完全一致。而 $(p	o q)	o(q	o p)$ 在 $(0,1)$ 行：前件 $p	o q=1$、后件 $q	o p=0$，整个蕴含式取 $0$，故不是重言式——蕴含方向不能交换。以上四类核对由程序枚举 $2^2=4$ 组赋值逐项验证，无一行例外。

examples.problem: 用等值演算证明 $((p\wedge q)\to p)$ 是重言式，并用程序逐对核对每一步变形保持等值。
examples.solution:
逐步变形（每步都是等值式）：\[(p\wedge q)	o p\ \Leftrightarrow\ 
eg(p\wedge q)\vee p\ \Leftrightarrow\ (
eg p\vee
eg q)\vee p\ \Leftrightarrow\ (p\vee
eg p)\vee
eg q\ \Leftrightarrow\ \mathbf{1}\vee
eg q\ \Leftrightarrow\ \mathbf{1}.\] 第一步用蕴含律 $A	o B\Leftrightarrow
eg A\vee B$；第二步用德摩根律；第三步用交换律与结合律把 $p$ 与 $
eg p$ 聚到一起；第四步用排中律 $p\vee
eg p\Leftrightarrow\mathbf{1}$；末步用恒等律 $\mathbf{1}\vee
