The potential is then found by integration: from $u_x=M$ get $u=\int M\,dx+\varphi(y)$, then use $u_y=N$ to determine $\varphi'(y)$ and integrate.

When $M_y\neq N_x$ one may multiply by a nonzero function $\mu(x,y)$ chosen so that $\mu M\,dx+\mu N\,dy$ becomes exact; such a $\mu$ is called an **integrating factor**. Multiplying by it does not change the solutions (it can only add curves where $\mu=0$). There is no universal recipe for integrating factors, but if $(M_y-N_x)/N$ depends on $x$ alone then $\mu=e^{\int f(x)dx}$, with a similar rule depending on $y$ alone. The integrating factor of a first-order linear equation is precisely a special case.

formulas.note: 一阶微分方程的对称形式，$x,y$ 地位对等。
formulas.noteEn: The symmetric form of a first-order equation, treating $x$ and $y$ symmetrically.

formulas.note: 恰当性判别法（单连通区域内，$M,N$ 有连续偏导数）。
formulas.noteEn: The exactness test (on a simply connected region, with $M,N$ continuously differentiable).

formulas.note: 求势函数的标准步骤：先对 $x$ 积分，再用 $u_y=N$ 定出 $\varphi$。
formulas.noteEn: Standard recipe for the potential: integrate in $x$ first, then use $u_y=N$ to find $\varphi$.

formulas.note: 积分因子 $\mu$ 的定义式：乘上它以后方程变为恰当方程。
formulas.noteEn: Defining equation for an integrating factor $\mu$: after multiplication the equation becomes exact.

formulas.note: 两种特殊情形，前提是相应的商只含单个变量。
formulas.noteEn: Two special cases, valid when the corresponding quotient depends on a single variable.

expression.text: M(x, y) dx + N(x, y) dy = 0，恰当 ⟺ ∂M/∂y = ∂N/∂x
expression.note: 通解写在势函数等值线的隐式形式里，通常不（也无法）把 $y$ 解出来。
expression.noteEn: The general solution is left implicit as a level curve of the potential; solving explicitly for $y$ is usually impossible.

properties: 恰当性等价于向量场 $(M,N)$ 是保守场（无旋场），$u$ 就是它的势函数；「单连通」条件排除了绕洞积分不为零的障碍。
通解 $u(x,y)=C$ 是隐式的，积分曲线族恰是 $u$ 的等值线，曲线切向与向量 $(M,N)$ 处处正交。
积分因子不唯一：恰当方程可以看作 $\mu\equiv 1$ 的情形，若 $\mu$ 是积分因子，则任何只含 $u$ 的因子 $g(u)\mu$ 仍是积分因子。
一阶线性方程 $y'+P(x)y=Q(x)$ 写成 $(P(x)y-Q(x))dx+dy=0$ 后，$(M_y-N_x)/N=P(x)$，其积分因子 $e^{\int P\,dx}$ 正是解线性方程时用的那一个。
积分因子通常无法用初等函数表出，教材只系统讨论 $\mu=\mu(x)$ 与 $\mu=\mu(y)$ 两种特殊情形。
propertiesEn: Exactness means the vector field $(M,N)$ is conservative (irrotational) with potential $u$; the simply connected hypothesis rules out nonzero circulation around holes.
The general solution $u(x,y)=C$ is implicit; solution curves are precisely the level curves of $u$, and their tangent direction is everywhere perpendicular to $(M,N)$.
Integrating factors are not unique: an exact equation corresponds to $\mu\equiv 1$, and if $\mu$ is an integrating factor then so is $g(u)\mu$ for any function $g$ of $u$.
Written as $(P(x)y-Q(x))dx+dy=0$, a first-order linear equation has $(M_y-N_x)/N=P(x)$; its integrating factor $e^{\int P\,dx}$ is exactly the one used in the linear theory.
Integrating factors usually cannot be written in elementary form, so textbooks discuss systematically only the cases $\mu=\mu(x)$ and $\mu=\mu(y)$.

plot.title: 势函数 u = x² + y² 的等值线：积分曲线 u(x, y) = C

examples.problem: 验证方程 $(3x^{2}+2xy)\,dx+(x^{2}+4y^{3})\,dy=0$ 是恰当方程，并求其通解。
examples.solution:
记 $M=3x^{2}+2xy$，$N=x^{2}+4y^{3}$。计算偏导数

$$\dfrac{\partial M}{\partial y}=2x,\qquad \dfrac{\partial N}{\partial x}=2x.$$

两者相等且区域是单连通的，所以方程是恰当方程，存在势函数 $u$ 使 $du=M\,dx+N\,dy$。

由 $u_x=3x^{2}+2xy$ 对 $x$ 积分：$u=x^{3}+x^{2}y+\varphi(y)$。再由 $u_y=x^{2}\cdot 1+\varphi'(y)=x^{2}+4y^{3}$ 得 $\varphi'(y)=4y^{3}$，取 $\varphi(y)=y^{4}$。

所以通解为

$$x^{3}+x^{2}y+y^{4}=C.$$

记 $M=3xy+y^{2}$，$N=x^{2}+xy$。先检查恰当性：$\dfrac{\partial M}{\partial y}=3x+2y$，$\dfrac{\partial N}{\partial x}=2x+y$，两者不等，方程不是恰当方程。

尝试积分因子。计算

$$\dfrac{M_y-N_x}{N}=\dfrac{(3x+2y)-(2x+y)}{x^{2}+xy}=\dfrac{x+y}{x(x+y)}=\dfrac{1}{x},$$

只与 $x$ 有关，故取 $\mu=e^{\int\frac{1}{x}dx}=x$。原方程乘 $x$ 得

$$(3x^{2}y+xy^{2})\,dx+(x^{3}+x^{2}y)\,dy=0.$$

再验证：$\dfrac{\partial}{\partial y}(3x^{2}y+xy^{2})=3x^{2}+2xy=\dfrac{\partial}{\partial x}(x^{3}+x^{2}y)$，确为恰当方程。

取 $u=\int(3x^{2}y+xy^{2})\,dx=x^{3}y+\dfrac{1}{2}x^{2}y^{2}+\varphi(y)$，由 $u_y=x^{3}+x^{2}y+\varphi'(y)=x^{3}+x^{2}y$ 得 $\varphi'(y)=0$，取 $\varphi=0$。

于是通解为 $x^{3}y+\dfrac{1}{2}x^{2}y^{2}=C$，也可写成 $x^{2}y(2x+y)=C$。

nodes.title: 一阶微分方程的应用
nodes.summary: 用一阶方程刻画「变化率由当前状态决定」的实际问题：指数增长与衰减、牛顿冷却、混合问题与逻辑斯蒂增长。
nodes.summaryEn: First-order equations model processes whose rate of change is determined by the current state: exponential growth and decay, Newton cooling, mixing problems and logistic growth.
nodes.definition:
许多实际问题的共同结构是：某个量 $y$ 的变化率可以写成它当前状态（有时还含时间）的函数，即

$$\dfrac{dy}{dt}=f(t,y).$$

把这句话翻译成微分方程、再配上初始条件求解，就是应用题的基本流程。

四类经典模型：① **指数增长与衰减**：变化率与当前量成正比，$\dfrac{dy}{dt}=ky$，解为 $y=y_{0}e^{kt}$，$k>0$ 对应人口、细菌的增长，$k<0$ 描述放射性衰变与药物代谢；② **牛顿冷却**：物体的温度以与「环境温差」成正比的速度变化，$\dfrac{dT}{dt}=-k(T-T_{m})$；③ **混合问题**：容器中溶质的变化率 = 流入速率 − 流出速率，对充分搅拌的盐水桶有 $\dfrac{dS}{dt}=c_{\text{in}}r_{\text{in}}-\dfrac{S}{V}r_{\text{out}}$；④ **逻辑斯蒂增长**：资源有限时增长率受抑制，$\dfrac{dP}{dt}=rP\left(1-\dfrac{P}{K}\right)$。

这些方程都是变量分离或线性方程，属于可解类型。解出之后还要回到实际情境检验：初值是否满足、长期趋势如何（趋于 $K$ 还是无限增长）、何时达到某个阈值。写方程前先核对单位与量纲，往往能提前发现建模错误。
nodes.definitionEn:
Many real problems share one structure: the rate of change of a quantity $y$ is determined by its current state (and possibly time), that is

$$\dfrac{dy}{dt}=f(t,y).$$

Translating that sentence into a differential equation and adding an initial condition is the basic workflow of modelling.

Four classical models: ① **exponential growth and decay**: the rate is proportional to the current amount, $\dfrac{dy}{dt}=ky$, with solution $y=y_{0}e^{kt}$; $k>0$ covers populations and bacteria, $k<0$ covers radioactive decay and drug clearance. ② **Newton cooling**: temperature changes at a rate proportional to the difference from the surroundings, $\dfrac{dT}{dt}=-k(T-T_{m})$. ③ **Mixing problems**: the rate of change of solute equals inflow minus outflow; for a well-stirred tank, $\dfrac{dS}{dt}=c_{\text{in}}r_{\text{in}}-\dfrac{S}{V}r_{\text{out}}$. ④ **Logistic growth**: limited resources suppress the growth rate, $\dfrac{dP}{dt}=rP\left(1-\dfrac{P}{K}\right)$.

All these are separable or linear and therefore solvable. After solving, one should return to the application: does the initial value fit, what is the long-term trend (approach $K$ or grow without bound), and when is a given threshold reached? Checking units before writing the equation often catches modelling mistakes early.

formulas.note: 指数增长（$k>0$）与指数衰减（$k<0$）模型。
formulas.noteEn: Exponential growth ($k>0$) and decay ($k<0$).

formulas.note: 放射性衰变与半衰期：半衰期只由衰减常数 $\lambda$ 决定。
formulas.noteEn: Radioactive decay and half-life: the half-life depends only on the decay constant $\lambda$.

formulas.note: 牛顿冷却定律：温差按指数规律消失，温度最终趋于环境温度。
formulas.noteEn: Newton's law of cooling: the temperature gap decays exponentially and the temperature tends to the ambient value.

formulas.note: 混合问题：流入 − 流出；流入流出速率相等时体积 $V$ 不变，方程为线性。
formulas.noteEn: Mixing problem: inflow minus outflow; if the rates are equal, $V$ is constant and the equation is linear.

formulas.note: 逻辑斯蒂增长：$P\to K$（环境容量），在 $P=K/2$ 处增长最快。
formulas.noteEn: Logistic growth: $P\to K$ (the carrying capacity), with fastest growth at $P=K/2$.

expression.text: 变化率 = 比例系数 × 当前状态（+ 修正项）
expression.note: 先用文字写出「谁的变化率等于什么」，再判断它属于增长、冷却、混合还是逻辑斯蒂模型。
expression.noteEn: First write, in words, what rate of change equals what; then identify the model type.

properties: 指数模型的标志是「增长率与当前量成正比」，其解要么单调增、要么单调减，永远不变号。
半衰期、倍增时间与初始量无关：$t_{1/2}=\ln 2/\lambda$ 只由比例系数决定，这正是碳定年法可行的原因。
牛顿冷却中温差 $T-T_{m}$ 按指数衰减，物体最终趋于环境温度，且与环境温度的差距越大降温越快。
混合问题在流入速率等于流出速率时体积不变，方程关于溶质总量是一阶线性方程，解最终趋于平衡值 $c_{\text{in}}V$。
逻辑斯蒂解从正初值出发单调趋近环境容量 $K$，曲线呈 S 形，$P=K/2$ 处增长最快；初值超过 $K$ 则单调下降到 $K$。
propertiesEn: The hallmark of an exponential model is a rate proportional to the current amount; its solutions are monotone and never change sign.
Half-lives and doubling times are independent of the initial amount: $t_{1/2}=\ln 2/\lambda$ depends only on the rate constant, which is why carbon dating works.
Under Newton cooling the gap $T-T_{m}$ decays exponentially; the body tends to ambient temperature, faster when the gap is larger.
When inflow and outflow rates are equal, the volume of a mixing tank stays constant, the equation for the solute is linear, and the solution approaches the equilibrium value $c_{\text{in}}V$.

A logistic solution with positive initial value increases monotonically towards the carrying capacity $K$ along an S-shaped curve, growing fastest at $P=K/2$; an initial value above $K$ decreases monotonically towards $K$.

plot.title: 指数增长与指数衰减：dy/dt = ky

examples.problem: 一杯 $90\,{}^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ 的水放在 $20\,{}^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ 的房间里，$10$ 分钟后水温降到 $60\,{}^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$。若用牛顿冷却定律建模，水温降到 $30\,{}^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ 还需要多长时间？
examples.solution:
设水温为 $T(t)$，环境温度 $T_{m}=20$，牛顿冷却方程为

$$\dfrac{dT}{dt}=-k(T-20).$$

令 $\theta=T-20$，则 $\theta'=-k\theta$，得 $\theta=70e^{-kt}$（由 $T(0)=90$ 得 $\theta(0)=70$），即 $T=20+70e^{-kt}$。

代入 $T(10)=60$：$40=70e^{-10k}$，所以 $e^{-10k}=\dfrac{4}{7}$，$k=\dfrac{1}{10}\ln\dfrac{7}{4}\approx 0.0560$。

再令 $T=30$：$10=70e^{-kt}$，即 $e^{-kt}=\dfrac{1}{7}$，$kt=\ln 7$，故

$$t=\dfrac{\ln 7}{\frac{1}{10}\ln\frac{7}{4}}=\dfrac{10\ln 7}{\ln 7-\ln 4}\approx 34.8\ \text{分钟}.$$

即从第 $10$ 分钟起还需约 $24.8$ 分钟（从开始算起约 $34.8$ 分钟）水温降到 $30\,{}^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$。

examples.problem: 一容器内盛有 $1000\ \mathrm{L}$ 盐水，含盐 $20\ \mathrm{kg}$。以 $10\ \mathrm{L/min}$ 的速度注入含盐 $0.1\ \mathrm{kg/L}$ 的盐水，同时以相同速度排出充分搅拌的混合液。求任意时刻容器内的含盐量 $S(t)$，以及含盐量达到 $60\ \mathrm{kg}$ 所需的时间。
examples.solution:
注入与排出速率相同，体积始终为 $1000\ \mathrm{L}$。由「变化率 = 流入 − 流出」：

$$\dfrac{dS}{dt}=0.1\times 10-\dfrac{S}{1000}\times 10=1-\dfrac{S}{100},\qquad S(0)=20.$$

这是一阶线性方程 $S'+\dfrac{S}{100}=1$。积分因子 $e^{t/100}$，得 $\left(Se^{t/100}\right)'=e^{t/100}$，积分得

$$S=100+Ce^{-t/100}.$$

由 $S(0)=20$ 得 $C=-80$，所以

$$S(t)=100-80e^{-t/100}\ (\mathrm{kg}).$$

令 $S=60$：$60=100-80e^{-t/100}$，即 $e^{-t/100}=\dfrac{1}{2}$，得 $t=100\ln 2\approx 69.3$ 分钟。含盐量最终趋于平衡值 $100\ \mathrm{kg}$。

nodes.title: 可降阶的高阶方程
nodes.summary: 三类可用代换降阶的二阶方程：$y''=f(x)$ 直接积分；$y''=f(x,y')$ 令 $p=y'$；$y''=f(y,y')$ 令 $p=y'$ 且 $y''=p\,\mathrm{d}p/\mathrm{d}y$。
nodes.summaryEn: Three types of second-order equations reducible to first-order problems: y''=f(x) by direct integration, y''=f(x,y') with p=y', and y''=f(y,y') with p=y' and y''=p dp/dy.
nodes.definition:
高阶方程一般不好解，但有三类二阶方程可以通过代换把阶数降下来，降阶后得到的往往就是已经会解的变量分离方程或线性方程。核心思想是：**方程里「缺少」哪个变量，就把另一个变量拉进来定义新未知函数**。

**类型一** $y''=f(x)$：右端只含 $x$。连续积分两次即可，通解中自然出现 $C_{1}x+C_{2}$，例如 $y''=\sin x$ 的解是 $y=-\sin x+C_{1}x+C_{2}$。

**类型二** $y''=f(x,y')$：方程不显含 $y$。令 $p=y'$，则 $y''=p'$，方程化为以 $p$ 为未知函数的一阶方程 $p'=f(x,p)$；解出 $p=P(x,C_{1})$ 后再积分一次得 $y$。

**类型三** $y''=f(y,y')$：方程不显含 $x$。仍令 $p=y'$，但把 $p$ 看作 $y$ 的函数，由链式法则

$$y''=\dfrac{dp}{dx}=\dfrac{dp}{dy}\cdot\dfrac{dy}{dx}=p\dfrac{dp}{dy},$$

于是方程化为 $p\dfrac{dp}{dy}=f(y,p)$，也是关于 $p(y)$ 的一阶方程。

每降一阶就出现一个新的任意常数，二阶方程的通解应含两个相互独立、不能再合并的常数。另外，用 $p$ 或 $y$ 作分母时，要单独检查 $p\equiv 0$（即常数解）是否也是方程的解。
nodes.definitionEn:
Higher-order equations are generally hard, but three types of second-order equations can be reduced in order by a substitution, after which one usually faces a separable or linear equation. The guiding idea: whichever variable is missing from the equation is the one to trade for a new unknown function.

**Type 1**, $y''=f(x)$: the right side involves $x$ only. Integrate twice and the general solution automatically contains $C_{1}x+C_{2}$; for instance $y''=\sin x$ gives $y=-\sin x+C_{1}x+C_{2}$.

**Type 2**, $y''=f(x,y')$: the equation does not contain $y$. Put $p=y'$, so $y''=p'$, and the equation becomes a first-order equation $p'=f(x,p)$ for $p$; after solving $p=P(x,C_{1})$, integrate once more to obtain $y$.

**Type 3**, $y''=f(y,y')$: the equation does not contain $x$. Again put $p=y'$, but now regard $p$ as a function of $y$. The chain rule gives

$$y''=\dfrac{dp}{dx}=\dfrac{dp}{dy}\cdot\dfrac{dy}{dx}=p\dfrac{dp}{dy},$$

so the equation becomes $p\dfrac{dp}{dy}=f(y,p)$, again first order but now in $p(y)$.

Each reduction introduces a new arbitrary constant, and the general solution of a second-order equation should contain two independent constants that cannot be merged. Finally, whenever one divides by $p$ or by $y$, one must check separately whether $p\equiv 0$ (constant solutions) also solves the equation.

formulas.note: 类型一：连续积分两次，几何上 $y$ 是 $f$ 的二重积分。
formulas.noteEn: Type 1: integrate twice; geometrically $y$ is a double integral of $f$.

formulas.note: 类型二：方程缺 $y$，令 $p=y'$ 后降为一阶方程。
formulas.noteEn: Type 2: with $y$ missing, $p=y'$ lowers the order by one.

formulas.note: 类型三的关键恒等式：把对 $x$ 的导数换成对 $y$ 的导数。
formulas.noteEn: The key identity of type 3: convert the $x$-derivative into a $y$-derivative.

formulas.note: 类型三：方程缺 $x$，得到关于 $p(y)$ 的一阶方程。
formulas.noteEn: Type 3: with $x$ missing, one gets a first-order equation for $p(y)$.

formulas.note: 类型二的重要子情形：变量分离后直接积分。
formulas.noteEn: An important sub-case of type 2: separate variables and integrate.

expression.note: 缺 $y$ 用 $p'=y''$；缺 $x$ 用 $y''=p\,\mathrm{d}p/\mathrm{d}y$；两个都不缺就不能这样降阶。
expression.noteEn: Missing $y$: use $p'=y''$. Missing $x$: use $y''=p\,dp/dy$. If neither is missing, this reduction does not apply.

properties: 识别口诀：方程里不出现 $y$，令 $p=y'$ 且 $p'=y''$；不出现 $x$，令 $p=y'$ 且 $y''=p\dfrac{dp}{dy}$。
降阶要「分两步积分」：先解出 $p=y'$（得一个常数），再积分一次得到 $y$（得第二个常数）。
类型一 $y''=f(x)$ 的解曲线由 $f$ 唯一决定，只差一次函数的自由度，这正是两个积分常数的几何含义。
除以 $p$ 会丢掉 $p\equiv 0$ 的解，除以 $y$ 会丢掉常数解：例如 $yy''=(y')^{2}$ 中 $y\equiv C$ 也是解。
若方程同时显含 $y,y',y''$（如 $y''+y=0$），不能直接降阶，需要特征方程、级数或拉普拉斯变换等方法。
propertiesEn: Recognition rule: if $y$ is absent, put $p=y'$, $p'=y''$; if $x$ is absent, put $p=y'$ and $y''=p\dfrac{dp}{dy}$.
Reduction takes two integrations: solve first for $p=y'$ (one constant), then integrate again for $y$ (a second constant).
For type 1 the solution curve is determined by $f$ up to an affine function, which is exactly the geometric meaning of the two integration constants.
Dividing by $p$ loses the solutions with $p\equiv 0$, and dividing by $y$ loses constant solutions: in $yy''=(y')^{2}$, every $y\equiv C$ is a solution.
If the equation contains $y,y',y''$ simultaneously (for example $y''+y=0$), this reduction does not apply and one needs the characteristic equation, power series or Laplace transforms.

plot.title: y'' = f(x) 型：sin x 与 x² 都是两次积分的产物

examples.solution:
这是类型一，直接积分两次。第一次积分：

$$y'=\dfrac{x^{2}}{2}-\cos x+C_{1}.$$

代入 $y'(0)=0$：$0-1+C_{1}=0$，得 $C_{1}=1$，即 $y'=\dfrac{x^{2}}{2}-\cos x+1$。

第二次积分：$y=\dfrac{x^{3}}{6}-\sin x+x+C_{2}$，代入 $y(0)=0$ 得 $C_{2}=0$。所以

$$y=\dfrac{x^{3}}{6}-\sin x+x.$$

检验：$y'=\dfrac{x^{2}}{2}-\cos x+1$，$y''=x+\sin x$，且两个初值条件都满足。

方程不显含 $x$，属类型三。令 $p=y'$，并视 $p$ 为 $y$ 的函数，则 $y''=p\dfrac{dp}{dy}$，方程化为

$$yp\dfrac{dp}{dy}=p^{2}.$$

当 $p\neq 0$ 时两边除以 $yp$：$\dfrac{dp}{dy}=\dfrac{p}{y}$，分离变量得 $\dfrac{dp}{p}=\dfrac{dy}{y}$，积分得 $p=C_{1}y$。

由 $y(0)=1$，$y'(0)=2$ 知在 $y=1$ 处 $p=2$，于是 $C_{1}=2$，即 $\dfrac{dy}{dx}=2y$。解之得 $y=C_{2}e^{2x}$，再由 $y(0)=1$ 得 $C_{2}=1$，所以

$$y=e^{2x}.$$

另外 $y\equiv C$（即 $p\equiv 0$）也是原方程的一族解，求解时被除掉了。

nodes.title: 高阶线性方程解的结构
nodes.titleEn: Structure of Solutions of Linear Differential Equations
nodes.summary: 二阶线性齐次方程的通解是两个线性无关解的线性组合（$W\neq 0$ 判别）；非齐次方程的通解 = 齐次通解 + 一个特解。
nodes.summaryEn: The general solution of a second-order linear homogeneous equation is a combination of two linearly independent solutions (detected by $W\neq 0$); for a nonhomogeneous equation it is the homogeneous general solution plus one particular solution.
nodes.definition:
形如 $y''+P(x)y'+Q(x)y=f(x)$ 的方程称为**二阶线性方程**；$f(x)\equiv 0$ 时为线性**齐次**方程，否则为线性**非齐次**方程。线性方程理论最漂亮的地方在于：无论系数多复杂，解集的结构都可以完整说清楚。

齐次方程 $y''+P(x)y'+Q(x)y=0$ 的解满足**叠加原理**：若 $y_{1},y_{2}$ 是解，则任意常数组合 $C_{1}y_{1}+C_{2}y_{2}$ 仍是解。如果 $y_{1},y_{2}$ 线性无关（不存在不全为零的常数使 $k_{1}y_{1}+k_{2}y_{2}\equiv 0$），它们的线性组合就给出了全部解。判别线性无关的便捷工具是**朗斯基行列式**

$$W(y_{1},y_{2})=y_{1}y_{2}'-y_{1}'y_{2}:$$

$y_{1},y_{2}$ 线性无关当且仅当 $W(x)\neq 0$。

非齐次方程的解与它对应的齐次方程密不可分：若 $\bar y$ 是一个特解，则 $y$ 是方程的解当且仅当 $y-\bar y$ 是齐次方程的解，因此

$$y=\underbrace{C_{1}y_{1}+C_{2}y_{2}}_{Y\ \text{齐次通解}}+\underbrace{\bar y}_{y^{*}\ \text{一个特解}}.$$

推论：非齐次方程任意两个解之差必是齐次解；两非齐次解只有当常数之和为 1 的线性组合才仍是解。

对 $n$ 阶线性齐次方程，同一结论升维成立：恰有 $n$ 个线性无关解（基本解组），它们的任意线性组合就是通解。这背后是解的存在唯一性定理，也是「解集构成线性空间」这一线性代数观点在微分方程中的体现。
nodes.definitionEn:
An equation of the form $y''+P(x)y'+Q(x)y=f(x)$ is a **second-order linear equation**; it is **homogeneous** when $f(x)\equiv 0$ and **nonhomogeneous** otherwise. The beauty of the linear theory is that, however complicated the coefficients, the structure of the solution set can be described completely.

Solutions of the homogeneous equation $y''+P(x)y'+Q(x)y=0$ obey the **superposition principle**: if $y_{1},y_{2}$ solve it, so does any combination $C_{1}y_{1}+C_{2}y_{2}$. If $y_{1},y_{2}$ are linearly independent (no nontrivial constants satisfy $k_{1}y_{1}+k_{2}y_{2}\equiv 0$), their combinations give all solutions. Linear independence is detected by the **Wronskian**

$$W(y_{1},y_{2})=y_{1}y_{2}'-y_{1}'y_{2}:$$

the two solutions are linearly independent exactly when $W(x)\neq 0$.

Nonhomogeneous equations are tied to their homogeneous partners: if $\bar y$ is one particular solution, then $y$ solves the equation if and only if $y-\bar y$ solves the homogeneous equation, so

$$y=\underbrace{C_{1}y_{1}+C_{2}y_{2}}_{Y\ \text{homogeneous general solution}}+\underbrace{\bar y}_{y^{*}\ \text{one particular solution}}.$$

Consequently, the difference of any two solutions of the nonhomogeneous equation is a homogeneous solution; a linear combination of two nonhomogeneous solutions is again a solution only when the coefficients sum to 1.

For an $n$-th order linear homogeneous equation the same statement holds in higher dimension: there are exactly $n$ linearly independent solutions (a fundamental system), and their combinations form the general solution. This rests on the existence–uniqueness theorem and expresses the linear-algebra viewpoint that the solution set is a linear space.

formulas.note: 齐次方程通解：两个线性无关解的线性组合（叠加原理）。
formulas.noteEn: General solution of the homogeneous equation: combinations of two linearly independent solutions.

formulas.note: 朗斯基行列式，用来判别两个解是否线性无关。
formulas.noteEn: The Wronskian, used to test linear independence.

formulas.note: 判别定理；在系数连续的区间上 $W$ 或恒不为零、或恒为零。
formulas.noteEn: The criterion; on an interval of continuity of the coefficients, $W$ is either everywhere nonzero or identically zero.

formulas.note: 非齐次通解 = 对应齐次通解 + 一个特解。
formulas.noteEn: General solution of the nonhomogeneous equation = homogeneous general solution + one particular solution.

formulas.note: 叠加原理（$L$ 为线性微分算子）：右端可拆项分别求特解再相加。
formulas.noteEn: Superposition ($L$ a linear differential operator): a right-hand side that splits allows solving each piece separately and adding.

expression.text: y'' + P(x)y' + Q(x)y = f(x)
expression.note: 「先解齐次，再找一个特解，两者相加」是所有线性方程求解的总步骤。
expression.noteEn: Solve the homogeneous equation first, find one particular solution, then add: the universal plan for linear equations.

properties: 齐次方程的全部解构成线性空间（二维），通解就是基本解组的线性组合。
刘维尔公式：$W(x)=W(x_{0})e^{-\int_{x_{0}}^{x}P(t)\,dt}$，说明 $W$ 不可能只在个别点为零——要么恒不为零，要么恒为零。
非齐次方程的两个解之差是齐次解，因此非齐次方程的解集是解空间平移一个特解得到的仿射集。
叠加原理对右端成立：$f=f_{1}+f_{2}$ 时，分别求 $f_{1},f_{2}$ 对应的特解，其和就是原方程的特解。
$n$ 阶线性齐次方程恰有 $n$ 个线性无关解；这与初值条件 $y(x_{0}),y'(x_{0}),\dots,y^{(n-1)}(x_{0})$ 恰好 $n$ 个自由度相匹配。
propertiesEn: The solution set of the homogeneous equation is a two-dimensional linear space, and the general solution is a combination of a fundamental system.
Liouville's formula $W(x)=W(x_{0})e^{-\int_{x_{0}}^{x}P(t)\,dt}$ shows the Wronskian cannot vanish at isolated points only: it is either everywhere nonzero or identically zero.
The difference of two solutions of a nonhomogeneous equation is homogeneous, so its solution set is a translate (an affine set) of the solution space.
Superposition applies to the right-hand side: if $f=f_{1}+f_{2}$, particular solutions for $f_{1}$ and $f_{2}$ can be found separately and added.
An $n$-th order linear homogeneous equation has exactly $n$ linearly independent solutions, matching the $n$ degrees of freedom in the initial data $y(x_{0}),y'(x_{0}),\dots,y^{(n-1)}(x_{0})$.

functions.label: y1 + y2 = sin x + cos x（通解的一支）

plot.title: y'' + y = 0 的两个线性无关解与它们的组合

examples.problem: 验证 $y_{1}=\cos x$、$y_{2}=\sin x$ 都是 $y''+y=0$ 的解，计算朗斯基行列式说明它们线性无关，并写出通解。
examples.solution:
求导：$y_{1}''=-\cos x=-y_{1}$，所以 $y_{1}''+y_{1}=0$；同理 $y_{2}''=-\sin x=-y_{2}$，故两者都是解。

计算朗斯基行列式：

$$W=\cos x\cdot\cos x-(-\sin x)\cdot\sin x=\cos^{2}x+\sin^{2}x=1\neq 0.$$

所以 $y_{1},y_{2}$ 线性无关，通解为

$$y=C_{1}\cos x+C_{2}\sin x.$$

（附：由 $y(0)=0$，$y'(0)=1$ 可得 $C_{1}=0$，$C_{2}=1$，特解 $y=\sin x$。）

examples.problem: 验证 $y^{*}=-x$ 是 $y''-y=x$ 的一个特解，写出该方程的通解；并说明任意两个解之差满足什么方程。
examples.solution:
代入 $y^{*}=-x$：$(y^{*})''-y^{*}=0-(-x)=x$，所以 $y^{*}=-x$ 确为特解。

对应齐次方程 $y''-y=0$ 的特征方程 $r^{2}-1=0$ 给出 $r=\pm 1$，齐次通解为 $Y=C_{1}e^{x}+C_{2}e^{-x}$。

由解的结构定理，非齐次通解为

$$y=C_{1}e^{x}+C_{2}e^{-x}-x.$$

若 $y_{1},y_{2}$ 是任意两个解，则 $(y_{1}-y_{2})''-(y_{1}-y_{2})=x-x=0$，即两解之差满足齐次方程——这正是「非齐次通解 = 齐次通解 + 特解」的另一面。

nodes.title: 常系数齐次线性方程
nodes.titleEn: Homogeneous Linear Equations with Constant Coefficients
nodes.summary: 方程 $ay''+by'+cy=0$ 的解由特征方程 $ar^{2}+br+c=0$ 的根决定：两实根给指数解，重根补 $xe^{rx}$，复根给带指数因子的三角函数。
nodes.summaryEn: Solutions of ay''+by'+cy=0 follow the roots of ar²+br+c=0: distinct real roots give exponentials, a repeated root brings in xe^(rx), and complex roots give trigonometric solutions with an exponential factor.
nodes.definition:
形如 $ay''+by'+cy=0$（$a,b,c$ 为常数，$a\neq 0$）的方程称为**常系数二阶线性齐次方程**。因为系数是常数，可以尝试指数型解 $y=e^{rx}$：代入得 $(ar^{2}+br+c)e^{rx}=0$，而 $e^{rx}\neq 0$，于是必须有

$$ar^{2}+br+c=0.$$

这个二次方程称为**特征方程**，它的根称为**特征根**。求解微分方程的问题就此化为解一个二次方程的问题。

按判别式 $\Delta=b^{2}-4ac$ 分三种情形：

**（1）$\Delta>0$**：两个不同实根 $r_{1},r_{2}$，两个线性无关解 $e^{r_{1}x},e^{r_{2}x}$，通解 $y=C_{1}e^{r_{1}x}+C_{2}e^{r_{2}x}$；

**（2）$\Delta=0$**：二重根 $r$，只得到 $e^{rx}$ 一个解，第二个解用 $xe^{rx}$ 补上，通解 $y=(C_{1}+C_{2}x)e^{rx}$；

**（3）$\Delta<0$**：共轭复根 $r=\alpha\pm\beta i$，把复值解 $e^{(\alpha+\beta i)x}$ 拆成实部与虚部，通解 $y=e^{\alpha x}(C_{1}\cos\beta x+C_{2}\sin\beta x)$。

三种情形的直观含义是「解的生长方式」：正实根指数增长，负实根指数衰减，复根的实部 $\alpha$ 控制振幅趋势、虚部 $\beta$ 控制振荡频率。给定初值 $y(x_{0})=y_{0},\ y'(x_{0})=y_{0}'$，两个常数恰好能被唯一确定（因为 $W\neq 0$）。
nodes.definitionEn:
An equation of the form $ay''+by'+cy=0$ with constant coefficients ($a\neq 0$) is a **homogeneous linear equation with constant coefficients**. Since the coefficients are constant, it is natural to try an exponential solution $y=e^{rx}$: substituting gives $(ar^{2}+br+c)e^{rx}=0$, and since $e^{rx}\neq 0$ we must have

$$ar^{2}+br+c=0.$$

This quadratic is called the **characteristic equation**, and its roots are the **characteristic roots**. Solving the differential equation thus reduces to solving a quadratic.

According to the discriminant $\Delta=b^{2}-4ac$ there are three cases:

**(1) $\Delta>0$**: two distinct real roots $r_{1},r_{2}$, two independent solutions $e^{r_{1}x},e^{r_{2}x}$, general solution $y=C_{1}e^{r_{1}x}+C_{2}e^{r_{2}x}$;

**(2) $\Delta=0$**: a repeated root $r$; one solution is $e^{rx}$ and the second is $xe^{rx}$, giving $y=(C_{1}+C_{2}x)e^{rx}$;

**(3) $\Delta<0$**: complex conjugate roots $r=\alpha\pm\beta i$; splitting the complex solution $e^{(\alpha+\beta i)x}$ into real and imaginary parts gives $y=e^{\alpha x}(C_{1}\cos\beta x+C_{2}\sin\beta x)$.

Intuitively, the characteristic roots describe how solutions grow: a positive real root means exponential growth, a negative one exponential decay, while for complex roots the real part $\alpha$ controls the amplitude trend and the imaginary part $\beta$ controls the frequency. Initial data $y(x_{0})=y_{0},\ y'(x_{0})=y_{0}'$ determine the two constants uniquely, because the Wronskian of the fundamental system never vanishes.

formulas.note: 常系数二阶线性齐次方程的标准形式。
formulas.noteEn: Standard form of a second-order homogeneous linear equation with constant coefficients.

formulas.note: 特征方程与判别式；设 $y=e^{rx}$ 代入即可得到。
formulas.noteEn: The characteristic equation and its discriminant, obtained by substituting $y=e^{rx}$.

formulas.note: 两个不同实根情形：两个纯指数解的线性组合。
formulas.noteEn: Two distinct real roots: combinations of two exponential solutions.

formulas.note: 二重根情形：第二个解 $xe^{rx}$ 由降阶法得到。
formulas.noteEn: Repeated root: the second solution $xe^{rx}$ comes from reduction of order.

formulas.latex: \Delta<0:\quad y=e^{\alpha x}\left(C_{1}\cos\beta x+C_{2}\sin\beta x\right),\qquad r=\alpha\pm\beta i
formulas.note: 共轭复根情形：指数振幅 × 振荡（实部控振幅、虚部控频率）。
formulas.noteEn: Complex conjugate roots: oscillatory solutions with exponential amplitude; the real part controls the envelope and the imaginary part the frequency.

expression.text: ay'' + by' + cy = 0   ⟷   ar² + br + c = 0
expression.note: 把微分方程问题翻译成二次方程问题：解出特征根，再按三种情形对号入座。
expression.noteEn: Translate the differential equation into a quadratic: find the roots, then read off the solution according to the three cases.

properties: 特征根只由系数 $a,b,c$ 决定，与初值无关；同一方程的一切解都由这几个根生成。
两个不同实根情形的解至多有一个零点：$C_{1}e^{r_{1}x}+C_{2}e^{r_{2}x}=e^{r_{1}x}(C_{1}+C_{2}e^{(r_{2}-r_{1})x})$ 中括号内是单调函数。
重根情形必须乘 $x$：$xe^{rx}$ 正是把降阶法用在已知解 $e^{rx}$ 上得到的结果。
复根情形必振荡：$\beta$ 决定角频率（周期 $2\pi/\beta$），$\alpha<0$ 振荡衰减、$\alpha>0$ 振幅增大、$\alpha=0$ 为纯周期振荡。
解集是二维线性空间；给定 $y(x_{0}),y'(x_{0})$ 后通解中的两个常数被唯一确定，对应初值问题的存在唯一性。
propertiesEn: The characteristic roots depend only on $a,b,c$, never on the initial data; every solution is generated by these roots.
In the two-distinct-real-roots case a solution has at most one zero, since $C_{1}e^{r_{1}x}+C_{2}e^{r_{2}x}=e^{r_{1}x}(C_{1}+C_{2}e^{(r_{2}-r_{1})x})$ and the bracket is monotone.
In the repeated-root case the extra factor $x$ is mandatory: $xe^{rx}$ is exactly what reduction of order produces from the known solution $e^{rx}$.
Complex roots always mean oscillation: $\beta$ fixes the frequency (period $2\pi/\beta$); $\alpha<0$ damps the oscillation, $\alpha>0$ amplifies it and $\alpha=0$ gives a pure periodic oscillation.
The solution set is a two-dimensional linear space; initial data $y(x_{0}),y'(x_{0})$ determine the two constants uniquely, in agreement with the existence–uniqueness theorem.

plot.title: 三种特征根情形的解曲线：增长、衰减与振荡

examples.solution:
特征方程 $r^{2}+4r+13=0$，判别式 $\Delta=16-52=-36<0$，根为

$$r=\dfrac{-4\pm\sqrt{-36}}{2}=\dfrac{-4\pm 6i}{2}=-2\pm 3i.$$

即 $\alpha=-2$，$\beta=3$。由复根公式，通解为

$$y=e^{-2x}\left(C_{1}\cos 3x+C_{2}\sin 3x\right).$$

由于 $\alpha=-2<0$，这是振幅按指数衰减的振荡解；若取初值 $y(0)=1,\ y'(0)=0$，可解得 $C_{1}=1$，$C_{2}=\dfrac{2}{3}$。

nodes.title: 常系数非齐次线性方程
nodes.titleEn: Nonhomogeneous Linear Equations with Constant Coefficients
nodes.summary: 通解 = 齐次通解 + 一个特解；自由项为 $P_m(x)e^{\lambda x}$ 或含三角函数时，用待定系数法求特解，特征根重合时乘 $x^{k}$ 修正。
nodes.summaryEn: The general solution is the homogeneous solution plus one particular solution; for right-hand sides P_m(x)e^(λx) or trigonometric terms, use undetermined coefficients, multiplying by x^k under resonance.
nodes.definition:
方程 $ay''+by'+cy=f(x)$（$f\not\equiv 0$）称为**常系数非齐次线性方程**。由线性方程解的结构定理，它的通解等于对应齐次方程的通解与任意一个特解之和：

$$y=\underbrace{C_{1}y_{1}+C_{2}y_{2}}_{Y}+\underbrace{y^{*}}_{\text{一个特解}}.$$

因此求解只分两步：先用特征方程法解齐次方程，再找出一个特解。当自由项 $f(x)$ 是「多项式 × 指数函数」型 $f(x)=P_{m}(x)e^{\lambda x}$（$P_{m}$ 是 $m$ 次多项式）时，可设**试解**

$$y^{*}=x^{k}Q_{m}(x)e^{\lambda x},$$

其中 $Q_{m}$ 是待定的 $m$ 次多项式，$k$ 是 $\lambda$ 作为特征根的重数（不是特征根取 0，是单根取 1，是二重根取 2）。为什么要乘 $x^{k}$？如果 $\lambda$ 恰好是特征根，$e^{\lambda x}$ 本身就是齐次解，直接代入会被微分算子消掉、系数无法确定，乘上足够的 $x$ 才能让试解与齐次解「错开」。

当 $f(x)=e^{\alpha x}\left(A\cos\beta x+B\sin\beta x\right)$ 时，试解取

$$y^{*}=x^{k}e^{\alpha x}\left(a\cos\beta x+b\sin\beta x\right),$$

其中当 $\alpha+\beta i$ 是特征根时 $k=1$，否则 $k=0$（二次方程的非实根只可能是单根，所以 $k$ 不超过 1）。更一般地，$f(x)=e^{\alpha x}\left[P_{m}(x)\cos\beta x+Q_{n}(x)\sin\beta x\right]$ 时，试解中的多项式取 $\max\{m,n\}$ 次。

把试解代回原方程，比较同类项系数，即可解出待定多项式——「待定系数法」因此得名。如果自由项是若干项之和，可先用叠加原理分别求特解再相加。
nodes.definitionEn:
An equation $ay''+by'+cy=f(x)$ with $f\not\equiv 0$ is a **nonhomogeneous linear equation with constant coefficients**. By the structure theorem for linear equations, its general solution is the general solution of the associated homogeneous equation plus one particular solution:

$$y=\underbrace{C_{1}y_{1}+C_{2}y_{2}}_{Y}+\underbrace{y^{*}}_{\text{one particular solution}}.$$

So the work has two steps: solve the homogeneous equation via its characteristic equation, then find a single particular solution. When the right-hand side is a polynomial times an exponential, $f(x)=P_{m}(x)e^{\lambda x}$ with $P_{m}$ of degree $m$, try

$$y^{*}=x^{k}Q_{m}(x)e^{\lambda x},$$

where $Q_{m}$ is an undetermined polynomial of degree $m$ and $k$ is the multiplicity of $\lambda$ as a characteristic root (0 if it is not a root, 1 for a simple root, 2 for a double root). Why the factor $x^{k}$? If $\lambda$ is a characteristic root, then $e^{\lambda x}$ already solves the homogeneous equation, and substituting it into the operator annihilates it, leaving no way to match the coefficients; multiplying by enough powers of $x$ shifts the trial solution away from the homogeneous solutions.

For $f(x)=e^{\alpha x}\left(A\cos\beta x+B\sin\beta x\right)$ one tries

$$y^{*}=x^{k}e^{\alpha x}\left(a\cos\beta x+b\sin\beta x\right),$$

where $k=1$ if $\alpha+\beta i$ is a characteristic root and $k=0$ otherwise (nonreal roots of a quadratic are always simple, so $k$ never exceeds 1). More generally, for $f(x)=e^{\alpha x}\left[P_{m}(x)\cos\beta x+Q_{n}(x)\sin\beta x\right]$, the polynomials in the trial solution have degree $\max\{m,n\}$.

Substituting the trial solution back into the equation and matching coefficients determines the unknown polynomial, which is why the method is called *undetermined coefficients*. If the right-hand side is a sum of several terms, superposition lets one find particular solutions separately and add them.

formulas.note: 解的结构：齐次通解 + 一个特解。
formulas.noteEn: Structure: homogeneous general solution plus one particular solution.

formulas.note: 多项式 × 指数型自由项的试解；$k$ 为 $\lambda$ 作特征根的重数。
formulas.noteEn: Trial solution for a polynomial times exponential; $k$ is the multiplicity of $\lambda$ as a characteristic root.

formulas.latex: f(x)=e^{\alpha x}\left(A\cos\beta x+B\sin\beta x\right)\ \Longrightarrow\ y^{*}=x^{k}e^{\alpha x}\left(a\cos\beta x+b\sin\beta x\right)
formulas.note: 三角函数型自由项；$\alpha+\beta i$ 是特征根时 $k=1$，否则 $k=0$。
formulas.noteEn: Trigonometric right-hand side; $k=1$ when $\alpha+\beta i$ is a characteristic root, otherwise $k=0$.

formulas.latex: f(x)=e^{\alpha x}\left[P_{m}(x)\cos\beta x+Q_{n}(x)\sin\beta x\right]\ \Longrightarrow\ y^{*}=x^{k}e^{\alpha x}\left[R_{l}(x)\cos\beta x+S_{l}(x)\sin\beta x\right],\ l=\max\{m,n\}
formulas.note: 一般形式的试解：多项式取两端的较高次数，且正弦、余弦项都要设。
formulas.noteEn: General trial solution: use the higher degree $\max\{m,n\}$ and include both sine and cosine terms.

formulas.latex: k=\begin{cases}0, & \lambda\ \text{不是特征根}\\ 1, & \lambda\ \text{是单特征根}\\ 2, & \lambda\ \text{是二重特征根}\end{cases}
formulas.note: 共振修正规则：特征根重合的重数决定乘 $x^{k}$ 的多少。
formulas.noteEn: Resonance rule: the multiplicity of the characteristic root decides the power of $x$.

expression.text: 通解 = 齐次通解 Y + 一个特解 y*
expression.note: 试解形式由自由项 $f$ 的类型与特征根决定：同型、重根乘 $x^{k}$。
expression.noteEn: The trial solution mirrors the type of $f$, with an $x^{k}$ factor under resonance.

properties: 通解结构：任意一个特解加上齐次通解都是原方程的解，这就是为什么只需找「一个」特解。
先解齐次（拿到特征根），再设特解；试解形式取决于 $f(x)$ 的类型与特征根是否重合，而不是取决于初值。
若 $\lambda$（或 $\alpha+\beta i$）不是特征根，则 $k=0$，试解与 $f$ 同型；是特征根时乘 $x^{k}$，这一现象常称为共振。
多项式系数要配齐：$f$ 是 $m$ 次多项式，$Q_{m}$ 就要设出全部 $m+1$ 个系数，漏项会矛盾。
propertiesEn: Structure: any particular solution plus the homogeneous general solution solves the equation, which is why one particular solution suffices.
Solve the homogeneous equation first to obtain the characteristic roots, then set up the trial solution; its form depends on the type of $f$ and on resonance, not on initial data.
If $\lambda$ (or $\alpha+\beta i$) is not a characteristic root then $k=0$ and the trial solution mirrors $f$; if it is a root one multiplies by $x^{k}$ — the phenomenon called resonance.
All polynomial coefficients must be included: if $f$ has degree $m$, the polynomial $Q_{m}$ needs all $m+1$ unknown coefficients, otherwise matching fails.
Superposition: for $f=f_{1}+f_{2}$, particular solutions $y_{1}^{*}+y_{2}^{*}$ for the separate pieces add up to a particular solution for $f$.

plot.title: y'' + y = x：齐次解 + 特解 = 通解

examples.problem: 求 $y''-y=e^{x}$ 的通解。
examples.solution:
齐次方程 $y''-y=0$ 的特征方程 $r^{2}-1=0$ 给出 $r=\pm 1$，故 $Y=C_{1}e^{x}+C_{2}e^{-x}$。

自由项 $f=e^{x}$，$\lambda=1$ 恰是特征方程的单根，共振，故 $k=1$，设 $y^{*}=axe^{x}$，则

$$y^{*'}=a(x+1)e^{x},\qquad y^{*''}=a(x+2)e^{x}.$$

代入方程：$a(x+2)e^{x}-axe^{x}=2ae^{x}=e^{x}$，得 $a=\dfrac{1}{2}$，于是 $y^{*}=\dfrac{x}{2}e^{x}$。通解为

$$y=C_{1}e^{x}+C_{2}e^{-x}+\dfrac{x}{2}e^{x}.$$

（若不乘 $x$ 而设 $y^{*}=ae^{x}$，代入左边得 $0$，无法等于 $e^{x}$，这正是需要 $k=1$ 修正的原因。）

examples.problem: 求 $y''+y=2\sin x$ 的通解。
examples.solution:
齐次方程 $y''+y=0$ 的特征方程 $r^{2}+1=0$ 给出 $r=\pm i$，故 $Y=C_{1}\cos x+C_{2}\sin x$。

自由项 $2\sin x$ 对应 $\alpha=0$，$\beta=1$，而 $\alpha+\beta i=i$ 是特征根，共振，故设

$$y^{*}=x(a\cos x+b\sin x).$$

求导：$y^{*'}=a\cos x-ax\sin x+b\sin x+bx\cos x$；再求导并合并得

$$(y^{*})''+y^{*}=-2a\sin x+2b\cos x.$$

（求导后 $x\cos x$、$x\sin x$ 项恰好抵消，只剩常数系数项，这正是共振时把「无法匹配」的部分暴露出来的原因。）

令 $-2a\sin x+2b\cos x=2\sin x$，比较系数得 $a=-1$，$b=0$。于是 $y^{*}=-x\cos x$，通解为

$$y=C_{1}\cos x+C_{2}\sin x-x\cos x.$$

nodes.title: 欧拉方程
nodes.summary: 形如 $ax^{2}y''+bxy'+cy=0$ 的方程，用 $x=e^{t}$ 或直接试解 $y=x^{r}$ 化为常系数问题；指标方程的根决定幂函数解的形式。
nodes.summaryEn: Equations ax²y''+bxy'+cy=0 are reduced to constant-coefficient form by x=e^t or by the trial y=x^r; the roots of the indicial equation determine the power-function solutions.
nodes.definition:
**欧拉方程**（也叫柯西–欧拉方程）是系数与自变量幂次「配套」的线性方程：

$$ax^{2}y''+bxy'+cy=0\qquad(a\neq 0,\ x>0),$$

$x^{2}$ 配 $y''$、$x$ 配 $y'$、常数配 $y$。做换元 $x=e^{t}$（即 $t=\ln x$）时，由链式法则

$$xy'=\dfrac{dy}{dt},\qquad x^{2}y''=\dfrac{d^{2}y}{dt^{2}}-\dfrac{dy}{dt},$$

原方程就化为常系数方程 $a\ddot y+(b-a)\dot y+cy=0$（点表示对 $t$ 求导），用特征方程法解出后，把 $t$ 换回 $\ln x$ 即可。

也可以直接试解 $y=x^{r}$：代入得 $x^{r}\left[ar(r-1)+br+c\right]=0$，故非零解要求**指标方程**

$$ar(r-1)+br+c=0.$$

它与换元后常系数方程的特征方程是同一个二次方程——因为 $x=e^{t}$ 把幂函数 $x^{r}$ 变成了指数函数 $e^{rt}$。

指标方程的根按三种情形给出解：两个不同实根 $r_{1}\neq r_{2}$ 给 $C_{1}x^{r_{1}}+C_{2}x^{r_{2}}$；二重根 $r$ 时第二个解补上 $\ln x$ 因子，通解 $x^{r}(C_{1}+C_{2}\ln x)$；共轭复根 $\alpha\pm\beta i$ 给 $x^{\alpha}\left[C_{1}\cos(\beta\ln x)+C_{2}\sin(\beta\ln x)\right]$——这里的 $\ln x$ 扮演了常系数情形中自变量 $x$ 的角色。由于换元要求 $x>0$，通常在 $x>0$ 上讨论；若问题定义在 $x<0$，作 $x=-e^{t}$ 换元（或把结果中的 $x$ 换成 $|x|$、$\ln x$ 换成 $\ln|x|$）。
nodes.definitionEn:
An **Euler equation** (also called a Cauchy–Euler equation) is a linear equation whose coefficients match the powers of the independent variable:

$$ax^{2}y''+bxy'+cy=0\qquad(a\neq 0,\ x>0),$$

with $x^{2}$ paired with $y''$, $x$ with $y'$, and a constant with $y$. The substitution $x=e^{t}$ (that is, $t=\ln x$) gives, by the chain rule,

$$xy'=\dfrac{dy}{dt},\qquad x^{2}y''=\dfrac{d^{2}y}{dt^{2}}-\dfrac{dy}{dt},$$

so the equation becomes the constant-coefficient equation $a\ddot y+(b-a)\dot y+cy=0$ (dots are $t$-derivatives). Solve it by the characteristic equation and replace $t$ by $\ln x$.

Equivalently, one may try $y=x^{r}$ directly: substitution gives $x^{r}\left[ar(r-1)+br+c\right]=0$, so a nonzero solution requires the **indicial equation**

$$ar(r-1)+br+c=0.$$

This is the same quadratic as the characteristic equation of the transformed equation, because $x=e^{t}$ turns the power $x^{r}$ into the exponential $e^{rt}$.

The roots of the indicial equation produce three cases: distinct real roots $r_{1}\neq r_{2}$ give $C_{1}x^{r_{1}}+C_{2}x^{r_{2}}$; a double root $r$ requires a factor $\ln x$ in the second solution, giving $x^{r}(C_{1}+C_{2}\ln x)$; complex conjugate roots $\alpha\pm\beta i$ give $x^{\alpha}\left[C_{1}\cos(\beta\ln x)+C_{2}\sin(\beta\ln x)\right]$ — here $\ln x$ plays the role that $x$ played in the constant-coefficient case. Since the substitution needs $x>0$, the equation is usually treated there; for $x<0$ use $x=-e^{t}$ (or replace $x$ by $|x|$ and $\ln x$ by $\ln|x|$).

formulas.latex: x=e^{t}:\quad xy'=\dot y,\qquad x^{2}y''=\ddot y-\dot y\ \Longrightarrow\ a\ddot y+(b-a)\dot y+cy=0
formulas.note: 换元公式：把欧拉方程化为常系数方程（点表示对 $t$ 求导）。
formulas.noteEn: Substitution formulas: they turn the Euler equation into a constant-coefficient equation (dots are $t$-derivatives).

formulas.note: 指数（指标）方程：与换元后常系数方程的特征方程等价。
formulas.noteEn: The indicial equation; equivalent to the characteristic equation of the transformed equation.

formulas.note: 两个不同实根：两个幂函数解。
formulas.noteEn: Two distinct real roots: two power-function solutions.

formulas.note: 二重根：第二个解是 $x^{r}\ln x$，与常系数重根情形对应。
formulas.noteEn: Double root: the second solution is $x^{r}\ln x$, matching the constant-coefficient repeated-root case.

formulas.note: 共轭复根：解在 $(0,+\infty)$ 上振荡，频率随 $\ln x$ 变化。
formulas.noteEn: Complex conjugate roots: oscillations on $(0,+\infty)$ whose frequency varies with $\ln x$.

expression.text: ax²y'' + bxy' + cy = 0   (a ≠ 0, x > 0)
expression.note: 识别口诀：导数的阶数与系数的 $x$ 幂次相同；换元 $x=e^{t}$ 与试解 $y=x^{r}$ 两条路殊途同归。
expression.noteEn: Recognition rule: the power of $x$ in each coefficient equals the order of the derivative. The substitution $x=e^{t}$ and the trial $y=x^{r}$ are two routes to the same place.

properties: 解都是幂函数 $x^{r}$ 型（重根时补 $\ln x$ 因子），因此在 $x=0$ 附近常出现奇性，例如 $x^{-1}$ 或 $\ln x$ 项。
指标方程与换元后常系数方程的特征方程是同一个二次方程，三种根情形与常系数情形一一对应。
复根情形 $x^{\alpha}\cos(\beta\ln x)$ 在 $(0,+\infty)$ 上振荡：$x\to 0^{+}$ 时振荡越来越快，$x\to+\infty$ 时越来越慢。
重根时第二个解 $x^{r}\ln x$ 可由降阶法得到，也可对特征方程「求导」直接读出。
在 $x<0$ 上讨论时可作 $x=-e^{t}$ 换元，或把解中的 $x$ 换成 $|x|$、$\ln x$ 换成 $\ln|x|$。
propertiesEn: Solutions are powers $x^{r}$ (with a $\ln x$ factor in the repeated case), so singular behaviour near $x=0$ is typical, for instance terms like $x^{-1}$ or $\ln x$.
The indicial equation coincides with the characteristic equation after substitution, so the three root cases match the constant-coefficient ones one to one.
In the complex case $x^{\alpha}\cos(\beta\ln x)$ oscillates on $(0,+\infty)$: the oscillations speed up as $x\to 0^{+}$ and slow down as $x\to+\infty$.
For a double root the second solution $x^{r}\ln x$ can be obtained by reduction of order, or read off by differentiating the indicial equation.
On $x<0$ one substitutes $x=-e^{t}$, or replaces $x$ by $|x|$ and $\ln x$ by $\ln|x|$ in the final answer.

plot.title: 欧拉方程的幂函数解 y = x^r（x > 0）

examples.solution:
代入 $y=x^{r}$，指标方程为

$$r(r-1)-3r+4=r^{2}-4r+4=(r-2)^{2}=0,$$

得二重根 $r=2$。此时第二个线性无关解是 $x^{2}\ln x$，故通解为

$$y=x^{2}\left(C_{1}+C_{2}\ln x\right).$$

换元核对：$x=e^{t}$ 后方程为 $\ddot y-4\dot y+4y=0$，特征根为二重根 $2$，解 $(C_{1}+C_{2}t)e^{2t}=x^{2}(C_{1}+C_{2}\ln x)$，两种方法一致。

代入 $y=x^{r}$，指标方程为

$$r(r-1)+r+4=r^{2}+4=0,$$

得共轭复根 $r=\pm 2i$，即 $\alpha=0$，$\beta=2$。所以通解为

$$y=C_{1}\cos(2\ln x)+C_{2}\sin(2\ln x).$$

换元核对：$x=e^{t}$ 后方程为 $\ddot y+4y=0$，通解 $C_{1}\cos 2t+C_{2}\sin 2t$，回代 $t=\ln x$ 即得上式。

nodes.title: 线性微分方程组
nodes.summary: 形如 x' = Ax 的一阶线性方程组（A 为 n×n 常数矩阵），解集是 n 维线性空间，通解由基解矩阵统一表示。
nodes.summaryEn: First-order linear systems x' = Ax with a constant n×n matrix A; their solutions form an n-dimensional space described by a fundamental matrix.
nodes.definition:
设 $A$ 是 $n \times n$ 常数矩阵，$x = x(t)$ 是 $n$ 维列向量，方程组

$$x' = A x$$

称为**一阶线性微分方程组**（常系数、齐次）。按分量写开就是：每个未知函数的导数，都是所有未知函数的线性组合。反过来，任意一个 $n$ 阶线性常微分方程，都可以通过引入新变量 $x_1 = y,\ x_2 = y',\ \dots,\ x_n = y^{(n-1)}$ 化为这种一阶方程组，所以研究它就能统一处理全部线性问题。

若 $x_1(t), \dots, x_n(t)$ 是 $n$ 个线性无关的解，把它们按列拼成矩阵 $\Phi(t)$，则 $\Phi$ 满足

$$\Phi'(t) = A\Phi(t), \qquad \det \Phi(t) \neq 0,$$

称为**基解矩阵**（fundamental matrix）。线性方程组的全部解恰好构成一个 $n$ 维线性空间：只要取定一个基解矩阵，通解就能写成简洁的矩阵形式 $x = \Phi(t)c$。

**叠加原理**是这一切的根源：若 $x_1, x_2$ 都是解，则它们的任意线性组合仍是解。这与「非零解集是 $n$ 维空间」结合，就给出了通解的完整结构。
nodes.definitionEn:
Let $A$ be a constant $n\times n$ matrix and $x=x(t)$ an $n$-dimensional column vector. The system

$$x' = Ax$$

is a **first-order linear system of differential equations** with constant coefficients. Componentwise, the derivative of every unknown is a linear combination of all the unknowns. Conversely, any linear ODE of order $n$ becomes such a first-order system by setting $x_1=y,\ x_2=y',\ \dots,\ x_n=y^{(n-1)}$.

If $x_1(t),\dots,x_n(t)$ are linearly independent solutions, the matrix $\Phi(t)$ with these solutions as columns satisfies

$$\Phi'(t)=A\Phi(t),\qquad \det\Phi(t)\neq 0,$$

and is called a **fundamental matrix**. The solution set is exactly an $n$-dimensional vector space, so the general solution has the compact form $x=\Phi(t)c$ once one fundamental matrix is known.

The **superposition principle** is the reason: any linear combination of solutions is again a solution.

formulas.note: 一阶线性齐次方程组的标准形式：系数矩阵 $A$ 是常数矩阵
formulas.noteEn: Standard form of a first-order linear homogeneous system; the coefficient matrix $A$ is constant

formulas.note: 基解矩阵的两个条件：满足矩阵微分方程，且行列式处处不为零
formulas.noteEn: The two conditions for a fundamental matrix: it solves the matrix ODE and its determinant is nowhere zero

formulas.note: 通解公式：任意常向量 $c$ 给出一个解，反过来每个解都可以这样表示
formulas.noteEn: General solution: every constant vector $c$ gives a solution, and every solution arises this way

formulas.latex: x = c_1 x_1(t) + c_2 x_2(t) + \cdots + c_n x_n(t)
formulas.note: 叠加原理：n 个线性无关解的任意线性组合仍是解
formulas.noteEn: Superposition: any linear combination of $n$ linearly independent solutions is again a solution

formulas.note: 刘维尔公式（$A$ 为常数矩阵时）：Wronski 行列式要么恒为零，要么处处不为零
formulas.noteEn: Liouville's formula for constant $A$: the Wronskian is either identically zero or nowhere zero

expression.text: x' = A x，其中 A 为 n×n 常数矩阵，x 为 n 维列向量
expression.note: 线性体现在：方程关于未知函数及其导数都是一次的，且不含常数项（齐次）。
expression.noteEn: Linearity means the equations are first degree in the unknowns and their derivatives, with no constant terms (homogeneous).

properties: 解集是 $n$ 维线性空间：取定一个基解矩阵 $\Phi$，一切解恰好是 $x = \Phi(t)c$，其中 $c$ 任意
叠加原理：两个解的和、一个解的常数倍仍是解，这是线性性的直接推论
Wronski 行列式 $W(t)=\det\Phi(t)$ 要么处处为零、要么处处不为零，由刘维尔公式 $W(t)=W(0)e^{t\operatorname{tr}A}$ 保证
两个基解矩阵只相差一个常数可逆矩阵：若 $\Phi_1, \Phi_2$ 都是基解矩阵，则 $\Phi_2 = \Phi_1 C$，$C$ 为可逆常数矩阵
$n$ 阶线性方程 $y^{(n)} + \cdots = 0$ 总可化为一阶线性方程组（令 $x_k = y^{(k-1)}$），因此本理论覆盖所有线性问题
propertiesEn: The solution set is an $n$-dimensional vector space: with one fundamental matrix $\Phi$, every solution is $x=\Phi(t)c$ for arbitrary $c$
Superposition principle: sums of solutions and scalar multiples of solutions are solutions
The Wronskian $W(t)=\det\Phi(t)$ is either identically zero or nowhere zero, guaranteed by Liouville's formula $W(t)=W(0)e^{t\operatorname{tr}A}$
Any two fundamental matrices differ by a constant invertible matrix: $\Phi_2=\Phi_1 C$
Every $n$-th order linear ODE can be written as a first-order linear system via $x_k=y^{(k-1)}$

plot.title: x' = Ax（A = [[0, -1], [1, 0]]）：轨线是绕原点的圆，中心

examples.problem: 求方程组 $x' = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 2 \end{pmatrix} x$ 的基解矩阵与通解。
examples.solution:
记 $A = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 2 \end{pmatrix}$。先求特征值：由 $(1-\lambda)(2-\lambda)=0$ 得 $\lambda_1 = 1$，$\lambda_2 = 2$。

对 $\lambda_1 = 1$：解 $(A-I)v = \begin{pmatrix} 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 \end{pmatrix}v = 0$，得特征向量 $v_1 = (1, 0)^{\mathsf T}$，对应解 $x_1(t) = e^{t}(1, 0)^{\mathsf T}$。

对 $\lambda_2 = 2$：解 $(A-2I)v = \begin{pmatrix} -1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 \end{pmatrix}v = 0$，得特征向量 $v_2 = (1, 1)^{\mathsf T}$，对应解 $x_2(t) = e^{2t}(1, 1)^{\mathsf T}$。

两个解线性无关，以它们为列得到基解矩阵 $\Phi(t) = \begin{pmatrix} e^{t} & e^{2t} \\ 0 & e^{2t} \end{pmatrix}$，且 $\det\Phi(t) = e^{3t} \neq 0$。通解为
$$x(t) = c_1 e^{t}\begin{pmatrix} 1 \\ 0 \end{pmatrix} + c_2 e^{2t}\begin{pmatrix} 1 \\ 1 \end{pmatrix}.$$

examples.problem: 把二阶方程 $y'' + y = 0$ 化为一阶线性方程组，并写出通解。
examples.solution:
令 $x_1 = y$，$x_2 = y'$，则 $x_1' = x_2$，$x_2' = y'' = -y = -x_1$，即
$$x' = \begin{pmatrix} 0 & 1 \\ -1 & 0 \end{pmatrix} x.$$
特征值为 $\pm i$，对应解为三角函数：$x_1 = c_1\cos t + c_2\sin t$，$x_2 = x_1' = -c_1\sin t + c_2\cos t$。验证：$x_2' = -c_1\cos t - c_2\sin t = -x_1$，满足方程。

nodes.title: 矩阵指数与基解矩阵
nodes.summary: 用 e^{At} = Σ (At)^k / k! 直接给出线性方程组 x' = Ax 的基解矩阵与初值问题的解。
nodes.summaryEn: The matrix exponential e^{At} = Σ (At)^k/k! is a fundamental matrix and solves the initial value problem x' = Ax, x(0) = x₀.
nodes.definition:
把标量指数函数 $e^{at} = \sum (at)^k/k!$ 的级数直接搬到矩阵上：对任意 $n \times n$ 常数矩阵 $A$，定义

$$e^{At} = I + At + \frac{A^2t^2}{2!} + \frac{A^3t^3}{3!} + \cdots = \sum_{k=0}^{\infty} \frac{(At)^k}{k!},$$

称为**矩阵指数**。这个级数对任何矩阵 $A$ 与任何实数 $t$ 都绝对收敛，它把指数函数的大部分好性质都继承了下来，是研究线性方程组 $x' = Ax$ 的核心工具。

对级数逐项求导得 $\frac{d}{dt}e^{At} = A e^{At} = e^{At}A$，并且 $e^{A \cdot 0} = I$。因此 $\Phi(t) = e^{At}$ 同时满足基解矩阵的两个条件（$\Phi' = A\Phi$ 且 $\det \Phi \neq 0$），本身就是一个基解矩阵；初值问题 $x' = Ax,\ x(0) = x_0$ 的解就是

$$x(t) = e^{At}x_0.$$

计算时，若 $A$ 可对角化 $A = PDP^{-1}$（$D$ 为对角阵），则 $e^{At} = Pe^{Dt}P^{-1}$，其中 $e^{Dt}$ 只需把对角元换成 $e^{\lambda_i t}$；若 $A$ 不能对角化，可借助若尔当标准形或用 $e^{At} = e^{\lambda t}e^{(A-\lambda I)t}$ 处理。
nodes.definitionEn:
Copy the scalar series $e^{at}=\sum (at)^k/k!$ to matrices: for a constant $n\times n$ matrix $A$,

$$e^{At}=I+At+\frac{A^2t^2}{2!}+\frac{A^3t^3}{3!}+\cdots=\sum_{k=0}^{\infty}\frac{(At)^k}{k!},$$

is the **matrix exponential**. The series converges absolutely for every matrix $A$ and every real $t$. Term-by-term differentiation gives $\frac{d}{dt}e^{At}=Ae^{At}=e^{At}A$ and $e^{A\cdot 0}=I$, so $\Phi(t)=e^{At}$ meets both requirements of a fundamental matrix and the unique solution of $x'=Ax,\ x(0)=x_0$ is

$$x(t)=e^{At}x_0.$$

If $A=PDP^{-1}$ is diagonalizable, then $e^{At}=Pe^{Dt}P^{-1}$, with $e^{Dt}$ obtained by taking $e^{\lambda_i t}$ on the diagonal; otherwise use the Jordan form or the identity $e^{At}=e^{\lambda t}e^{(A-\lambda I)t}$.

formulas.note: 矩阵指数的定义：把标量指数级数中的数换成矩阵
formulas.noteEn: Definition: the scalar exponential series with scalars replaced by matrices

formulas.latex: \frac{d}{dt} e^{At} = A e^{At} = e^{At} A, \qquad e^{A \cdot 0} = I
formulas.note: 矩阵指数满足的矩阵微分方程与初始条件（$A$ 与 $e^{At}$ 可交换）
formulas.noteEn: The matrix ODE and initial condition satisfied by $e^{At}$; $A$ commutes with its exponential

formulas.note: 初值问题 $x' = Ax,\ x(0) = x_0$ 的解（由存在唯一性，它是唯一解）
formulas.noteEn: Solution of the initial value problem $x'=Ax,\ x(0)=x_0$, unique by the existence-uniqueness theorem

formulas.latex: A = PDP^{-1} \;\Rightarrow\; e^{At} = P e^{Dt} P^{-1}
formulas.note: 可对角化时的计算公式：对角阵的指数就是对对角元取指数
formulas.noteEn: Computation when $A$ is diagonalizable: exponentiate the diagonal entries

formulas.note: 矩阵指数永远可逆，且行列式由迹决定（与刘维尔公式一致）
formulas.noteEn: The matrix exponential is always invertible; its determinant is governed by the trace (Liouville's formula)

expression.text: e^{At} = I + At + A²t²/2! + A³t³/3! + … = Σₖ (At)^k / k!
expression.note: 对任意 n×n 常数矩阵 A 与实数 t 都收敛；它是 x' = Ax 的一个基解矩阵。
expression.noteEn: Converges for every constant matrix A and every real t; it is a fundamental matrix for x' = Ax.

properties: 初始值与可逆性：$e^{A \cdot 0} = I$，且对一切 $t$ 有 $(e^{At})^{-1} = e^{-At}$，$\det e^{At} = e^{t\operatorname{tr}A} > 0$，矩阵指数总可逆
求导法则：$\frac{d}{dt}e^{At} = A e^{At} = e^{At}A$，$A$ 与自己的指数总是可交换的
$AB = BA$ 时才有 $e^{A+B} = e^{A}e^{B}$；$AB \neq BA$ 时该式一般不成立，这是与标量指数最大的区别
可对角化情形：$A = PDP^{-1} \Rightarrow e^{At} = Pe^{Dt}P^{-1}$；$e^{At}$ 的特征值是 $e^{\lambda_i t}$，特征向量与 $A$ 相同
$\Phi(t) = e^{At}$ 是标准基解矩阵：任意基解矩阵都可写成 $e^{At}C$，初值问题的解为 $x(t) = e^{At}x_0$
propertiesEn: Initial value and invertibility: $e^{A\cdot 0}=I$, $(e^{At})^{-1}=e^{-At}$, and $\det e^{At}=e^{t\operatorname{tr}A}>0$
Differentiation: $\frac{d}{dt}e^{At}=Ae^{At}=e^{At}A$; $A$ always commutes with its exponential
$e^{A+B}=e^{A}e^{B}$ holds only when $AB=BA$; in general it fails, unlike the scalar case
Diagonalizable case: $A=PDP^{-1}$ gives $e^{At}=Pe^{Dt}P^{-1}$; the eigenvalues of $e^{At}$ are $e^{\lambda_i t}$ with the same eigenvectors
$\Phi(t)=e^{At}$ is the standard fundamental matrix; every other one is $e^{At}C$, and $x(t)=e^{At}x_0$ solves the initial value problem

plot.title: A = [[2, -1], [1, 2]]（λ = 2 ± i）：解 x(t) = e^{At}x₀ 沿螺旋线向外发散

examples.problem: 求 $A = \begin{pmatrix} 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 \end{pmatrix}$ 的矩阵指数 $e^{At}$，并用它解初值问题 $x' = Ax,\ x(0) = (1, 2)^{\mathsf T}$。
examples.solution:
先算幂：$A^2 = \begin{pmatrix} 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 \end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix} 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 \end{pmatrix} = 0$，所以 $k \ge 2$ 时 $A^k = 0$（幂零矩阵），级数在第 2 项后自动截断：
$$e^{At} = I + At = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & t \\ 0 & 1 \end{pmatrix}.$$
于是
$$x(t) = e^{At}\begin{pmatrix} 1 \\ 2 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} 1 + 2t \\ 2 \end{pmatrix}.$$
验证：$x' = (2, 0)^{\mathsf T}$，而 $Ax = \begin{pmatrix} 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 \end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix} 1+2t \\ 2 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} 2 \\ 0 \end{pmatrix}$，且 $x(0) = (1, 2)^{\mathsf T}$，均满足。

examples.problem: 用对角化方法求 $A = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 2 \end{pmatrix}$ 的矩阵指数 $e^{At}$。
examples.solution:
特征值为 $\lambda_1 = 1$，$\lambda_2 = 2$，对应特征向量 $(1, 0)^{\mathsf T}$ 与 $(1, 1)^{\mathsf T}$，故
$$P = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 \end{pmatrix}, \qquad D = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 \end{pmatrix}, \qquad P^{-1} = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & -1 \\ 0 & 1 \end{pmatrix}.$$
由公式 $e^{At} = Pe^{Dt}P^{-1}$，其中 $e^{Dt} = \begin{pmatrix} e^{t} & 0 \\ 0 & e^{2t} \end{pmatrix}$，得
$$e^{At} = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 \end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix} e^{t} & 0 \\ 0 & e^{2t} \end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix} 1 & -1 \\ 0 & 1 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} e^{t} & e^{2t} - e^{t} \\ 0 & e^{2t} \end{pmatrix}.$$
检验：$t = 0$ 时得单位矩阵；第一列 $e^{t}(1, 0)^{\mathsf T}$ 与第二列也分别满足 $x' = Ax$。

nodes.title: 相平面与平衡点
nodes.summary: 把平面自治系统的解画成相平面上的轨线，用平衡点处系数矩阵的特征值对系统做定性分类。
nodes.summaryEn: Drawing solution curves of a planar autonomous system in the phase plane and classifying equilibria through eigenvalues.
nodes.definition:
对平面自治系统

$$x' = f(x, y), \qquad y' = g(x, y),$$

以 $(x, y)$ 为坐标的平面称为**相平面**：每个点处放一个速度向量 $(f, g)$，整个平面成为一个方向场；从初始点出发的解 $(x(t), y(t))$ 描出的曲线称为**轨线**（轨道、相轨线）。轨线的形状与参数化无关，记录的是运动的「路线」而不是「时刻」。

若点 $(x^*, y^*)$ 满足 $f(x^*, y^*) = 0$ 且 $g(x^*, y^*) = 0$，则该处速度为零，常值函数 $(x, y) \equiv (x^*, y^*)$ 是解，称该点为**平衡点**（奇点）。由解的存在唯一性：轨线要么就是平衡点本身，要么永远不经过平衡点；不同轨线不相交。

对线性系统 $x' = Ax$，平衡点类型完全由 $A$ 的特征值决定，而特征值是特征方程 $\lambda^2 - (\operatorname{tr}A)\lambda + \det A = 0$ 的根：两个不相等的实根时看符号（同号是结点，异号是鞍点）；共轭复根时看实部（负是稳定焦点、正是不稳定焦点、零是中心）；重根时得到结点。相平面上轨线的整体分布图案称为系统的**相图**，平衡点附近轨线的局部形态就是它的类型。
nodes.definitionEn:
For the planar autonomous system

$$x'=f(x,y),\qquad y'=g(x,y),$$

the $(x,y)$-plane is the **phase plane**: at each point sits the velocity vector $(f,g)$, so the plane becomes a direction field, and the curve traced by a solution $(x(t),y(t))$ is a **trajectory** (orbit). It records the route of the motion, not the timing.

A point $(x^*,y^*)$ with $f(x^*,y^*)=0$ and $g(x^*,y^*)=0$ is an **equilibrium** (critical point): the constant functions $x\equiv x^*$, $y\equiv y^*$ solve the system. By existence and uniqueness every trajectory either is an equilibrium or never passes through one, and distinct trajectories never cross.

For a linear system $x'=Ax$ the type of the equilibrium is determined by the eigenvalues of $A$, i.e. the roots of $\lambda^2-(\operatorname{tr}A)\lambda+\det A=0$: real roots of the same sign give a node, roots of opposite signs a saddle; complex roots give a focus if their real part is nonzero, a center if it is zero; a repeated root gives a node as well. The overall pattern of trajectories in the phase plane is the **phase portrait**, and the local pattern of trajectories near an equilibrium is its **type**.

formulas.latex: x' = f(x, y), \qquad y' = g(x, y)
formulas.note: 平面自治系统：右端不显含 $t$，方向场不随时间改变
formulas.noteEn: Planar autonomous system: the right side does not contain $t$, so the direction field is time-independent

formulas.note: 平衡点（奇点）方程：速度向量为零的点
formulas.noteEn: Equilibrium equations: points where the velocity vector vanishes

formulas.note: 线性系统的特征方程，$\lambda$ 即 $A$ 的特征值
formulas.noteEn: Characteristic equation of the linear system; its roots are the eigenvalues of $A$

formulas.note: 迹与行列式等于特征值之和与积：不用解方程就能判断符号组合
formulas.noteEn: Trace and determinant equal the sum and product of the eigenvalues: quick sign tests without solving

formulas.note: 判别式：$\Delta>0$ 两实根（结点或鞍点），$\Delta<0$ 共轭复根（焦点或中心），$\Delta=0$ 重根（结点）
formulas.noteEn: Discriminant: $\Delta>0$ gives two real roots (node or saddle), $\Delta<0$ complex roots (focus or center), $\Delta=0$ a repeated root (node)

expression.text: x' = f(x, y),  y' = g(x, y)；平衡点：f = g = 0
expression.note: 相平面上每点画一个方向向量，轨线处处与方向场相切。
expression.noteEn: Each point of the phase plane carries a direction vector; trajectories are everywhere tangent to the field.

properties: 两实根 $\lambda_1 \neq \lambda_2$：同号且都为负得稳定结点，同号且都为正得不稳定结点；异号（$\det A = \lambda_1\lambda_2 < 0$）得鞍点，鞍点一定不稳定
共轭复根 $\alpha \pm \beta i$（$\beta \neq 0$）：$\alpha < 0$ 是稳定焦点（轨线螺旋卷入），$\alpha > 0$ 是不稳定焦点（螺旋卷出），$\alpha = 0$ 是中心（闭轨，稳定但非渐近稳定）
重根 $\lambda$：若 $A = \lambda I$，每个方向都是特征方向，轨线沿直线进出原点，称为真结点；若 $A \neq \lambda I$（只有一个特征方向），轨线只沿一个方向相切着趋近或远离，称为退化结点；$\lambda < 0$ 时都渐近稳定
轨线不相交：由解的存在唯一性，过每个非平衡点恰有一条轨线；闭轨对应周期解
迹-行列式速判：$\det A < 0$ 鞍点；$\det A > 0$ 且 $\operatorname{tr}A < 0$ 稳定（结点或焦点）；$\det A > 0$ 且 $\operatorname{tr}A > 0$ 不稳定；$\operatorname{tr}A = 0$ 且 $\det A > 0$ 为中心
propertiesEn: Two distinct real roots: both negative give a stable node, both positive an unstable node; opposite signs ($\det A<0$) give a saddle, which is always unstable

Complex roots $\alpha\pm\beta i$ with $\beta\neq 0$: $\alpha<0$ gives a stable focus (spiralling in), $\alpha>0$ an unstable focus (spiralling out), $\alpha=0$ a center (closed orbits; stable but not asymptotically stable)

Repeated root $\lambda$: if $A=\lambda I$ every direction is an eigen-direction (proper node, straight-line orbits); if $A\neq\lambda I$ there is only one eigen-direction (degenerate node); both are asymptotically stable when $\lambda<0$
Trajectories never cross: uniqueness gives exactly one trajectory through each non-equilibrium point; closed orbits correspond to periodic solutions

Trace-determinant test: $\det A<0$ saddle; $\det A>0$ with $\operatorname{tr}A<0$ stable (node or focus); $\det A>0$ with $\operatorname{tr}A>0$ unstable; $\operatorname{tr}A=0$ with $\det A>0$ a center

plot.title: x' = -x, y' = -2y 的相平面：轨线汇入稳定结点

examples.problem: 判断系统 $x' = -x,\ y' = -2y$ 的平衡点 $(0, 0)$ 的类型，并描述轨线的走向。
examples.solution:
$A = \begin{pmatrix} -1 & 0 \\ 0 & -2 \end{pmatrix}$，特征值 $\lambda_1 = -1$，$\lambda_2 = -2$：两个不相等的负实根，所以 $(0,0)$ 是**稳定结点**。
解为 $x = c_1 e^{-t}$，$y = c_2 e^{-2t}$。因为 $|\lambda_2| > |\lambda_1|$，$y$ 分量衰减得更快：当 $t \to \infty$ 时 $y/x \sim (c_2/c_1)e^{-t} \to 0$，所以轨线以 $x$ 轴（$\lambda_1 = -1$ 对应的慢特征方向）为切线方向趋近原点；只有恰好落在坐标轴上的轨线才沿直线进出。

examples.problem: 判断 $x' = x,\ y' = -y$ 的平衡点类型，并指出稳定与不稳定方向。
examples.solution:
特征值为 $\lambda_1 = 1$，$\lambda_2 = -1$，异号，所以 $(0,0)$ 是**鞍点**，一定不稳定。解为 $x = c_1 e^{t}$，$y = c_2 e^{-t}$。
沿 $y$ 轴（$c_1 = 0$）的轨线趋于原点，是稳定方向（稳定流形）；沿 $x$ 轴（$c_2 = 0$）的轨线远离原点，是不稳定方向（不稳定流形）。其余轨线先被拉近 $y$ 轴，再沿 $x$ 轴甩出去，形成马鞍形图案——这正是「鞍点」名字的来源。

nodes.title: 稳定性理论
nodes.summary: 李雅普诺夫意义下的稳定、渐近稳定与不稳定，以及用线性化（雅可比矩阵特征值）判定非线性系统平衡点的稳定性。
nodes.summaryEn: Lyapunov stability — stable, asymptotically stable, unstable — and the linearization test via Jacobian eigenvalues.
nodes.definition:
设 $x^*$ 是系统 $x' = f(x)$ 的平衡点（$f(x^*) = 0$）。若对任意 $\varepsilon > 0$ 都存在 $\delta > 0$，只要初始点满足 $\|x(0) - x^*\| < \delta$，就有对一切 $t \ge 0$ 成立 $\|x(t) - x^*\| < \varepsilon$，则称 $x^*$ 是**稳定的**（李雅普诺夫意义）。直观说：初值足够接近时，解永远不跑远——只要求「留在附近」，不要求「跑回来」。

在稳定的基础上，若还存在 $\delta > 0$，使 $\|x(0) - x^*\| < \delta$ 时有 $x(t) \to x^*$（$t \to \infty$），则称 $x^*$ **渐近稳定**。稳定但不渐近稳定是可能的：中心就是典型——轨线被限制在闭轨上绕圈，永远不靠近原点。若 $x^*$ 连稳定都不是，则称**不稳定**：初值随便偏一点，解也可能离开给定的范围。

对非线性系统，最常用的手段是**线性化**：在平衡点处求雅可比矩阵 $J = Df(x^*)$，看它的特征值。若所有特征值的实部都不为零（这样的平衡点称为**双曲平衡点**），则非线性系统在该点的稳定性类型与线性化系统 $x' = Jx$ 完全相同：实部全为负 $\Rightarrow$ 渐近稳定；只要有一个实部为正 $\Rightarrow$ 不稳定。若出现实部为零的特征值（非双曲），线性化不能下结论，需要李雅普诺夫函数等进一步分析。
nodes.definitionEn:
Let $x^*$ be an equilibrium of $x'=f(x)$, i.e. $f(x^*)=0$. It is **stable** in the Lyapunov sense if for every $\varepsilon>0$ there is $\delta>0$ such that $\|x(0)-x^*\|<\delta$ implies $\|x(t)-x^*\|<\varepsilon$ for all $t\ge 0$: solutions that start close enough stay close forever.

If in addition $x(t)\to x^*$ as $t\to\infty$ whenever $\|x(0)-x^*\|<\delta$, the equilibrium is **asymptotically stable**. Stability without asymptotic stability really occurs: near a center the trajectories are closed orbits that never approach the origin. If the equilibrium is not stable it is **unstable**: however small the perturbation, some solution leaves a given neighborhood.

For nonlinear systems one usually **linearizes**: compute the Jacobian $J=Df(x^*)$. If every eigenvalue of $J$ has nonzero real part (a **hyperbolic** equilibrium), the nonlinear system has exactly the same stability type as $x'=Jx$: all real parts negative means asymptotically stable; one positive real part means unstable. If some eigenvalue has zero real part (non-hyperbolic), linearization is inconclusive and further tools such as Lyapunov functions are needed.

formulas.note: 稳定性的 ε–δ 定义：近处出发的解永远不离开给定范围
formulas.noteEn: The ε–δ definition of stability: solutions starting nearby never leave a prescribed neighborhood

formulas.note: 渐近稳定 = 稳定 + 收敛：在稳定之上再要求解真的趋向平衡点
formulas.noteEn: Asymptotic stability = stability plus convergence: solutions not only stay close but tend to the equilibrium

formulas.note: 线性系统 $x' = Ax$ 零解渐近稳定的充要条件：所有特征值的实部都为负
formulas.noteEn: Criterion for $x'=Ax$: the origin is asymptotically stable iff every eigenvalue has negative real part

formulas.note: 双曲平衡点：此时非线性系统的稳定性与线性化系统一致；有实部为零的特征值则失效
formulas.noteEn: Hyperbolic equilibrium: here the nonlinear stability matches the linearization; a zero real part invalidates the test

formulas.note: 李雅普诺夫方程：对任意正定 $Q$ 存在正定解 $P$，则 $x'=Ax$ 渐近稳定；$V(x)=x^{\mathsf T}Px$ 沿轨线递减
formulas.noteEn: Lyapunov equation: if some positive definite $P$ solves it for a positive definite $Q$, the system is asymptotically stable; $V(x)=x^{\mathsf T}Px$ decreases along orbits

expression.note: 先有稳定，再加收敛才叫渐近稳定；两者不可混为一谈。
expression.noteEn: Stability plus convergence gives asymptotic stability; the two notions must not be confused.

properties: 稳定 $\neq$ 渐近稳定：中心（如 $x'=y,\ y'=-x$）的解保持 $x^2+y^2$ 不变，有界但不趋于原点，是稳定而非渐近稳定的典型例子
二维线性系统速判：$\operatorname{tr}A<0$ 且 $\det A>0$ 时渐近稳定（稳定结点或稳定焦点）；$\det A<0$ 或 $\operatorname{tr}A>0$ 时不稳定；$\operatorname{tr}A=0$ 且 $\det A>0$ 时是中心，稳定但非渐近稳定
双曲平衡点（$\operatorname{Re}\lambda_i \neq 0$ 全成立）可以用线性化直接定性：实部全负则渐近稳定，有一个实部为正则不稳定
非双曲情形（实部为零）线性化失效：可能是中心、也可能是稳定或不稳定的非线性平衡点，必须结合高阶项分析
李雅普诺夫第二方法：若存在正定函数 $V$ 使 $\dot V \le 0$ 沿轨线成立，则平衡点稳定；若除平衡点外 $\dot V < 0$，则渐近稳定
propertiesEn: Stable is not the same as asymptotically stable: near a center (e.g. $x'=y,\ y'=-x$) solutions keep $x^2+y^2$ constant — bounded but not converging; stable yet not asymptotically stable
Quick test in the plane: asymptotically stable when $\operatorname{tr}A<0$ and $\det A>0$; unstable when $\det A<0$ or $\operatorname{tr}A>0$; a center when $\operatorname{tr}A=0$ and $\det A>0$
At a hyperbolic equilibrium (all $\operatorname{Re}\lambda_i\neq 0$) linearization decides the type: all real parts negative means asymptotically stable, one positive real part means unstable
Non-hyperbolic cases (zero real part) are inconclusive: the nonlinear equilibrium may be a center or stable/unstable; higher-order terms must be examined
Lyapunov's second method: a positive definite $V$ with $\dot V\le 0$ proves stability; with $\dot V<0$ off the equilibrium, asymptotic stability

marks.label: 平衡点：稳定焦点（渐近稳定）

plot.title: 稳定焦点 x' = -x + y, y' = -x - y：轨线螺旋卷入原点，V = x² + y² 递减

examples.problem: 讨论非线性系统 $x' = -x + y^2,\ y' = -2y$ 的平衡点 $(0,0)$ 的稳定性。
examples.solution:
先求雅可比矩阵：
$$J(x,y) = \begin{pmatrix} -1 & 2y \\ 0 & -2 \end{pmatrix}, \qquad J(0,0) = \begin{pmatrix} -1 & 0 \\ 0 & -2 \end{pmatrix}.$$
特征值为 $-1$ 与 $-2$，实部都为负且都不为零，所以 $(0,0)$ 是双曲平衡点。由线性化定理，原非线性系统在 $(0,0)$ 处**渐近稳定**（类型与线性化一致：稳定结点）。注意这个结论是局部的——只保证初始点充分接近原点时解收敛。

examples.problem: 系统 $x' = y,\ y' = -x$ 的零解稳定吗？渐近稳定吗？
examples.solution:
这是线性系统，$A = \begin{pmatrix} 0 & 1 \\ -1 & 0 \end{pmatrix}$，特征值 $\lambda = \pm i$，实部为零，线性化不能直接给出结论，需要直接分析。
沿轨线计算
$$\frac{d}{dt}(x^2 + y^2) = 2x x' + 2y y' = 2xy - 2xy = 0,$$
所以 $x^2 + y^2 \equiv$ 常数，轨线是以原点为中心的圆。初值在半径为 $\delta$ 的圆内时，解永远落在该圆上：取 $\delta = \varepsilon$ 即知零解**稳定**。但解沿圆周运动，永远不趋近原点，所以**不是渐近稳定**。这说明中心是稳定的平衡点，却不是渐近稳定的——两个概念必须分清。

nodes.title: 幂级数解法
nodes.titleEn: Power Series Solutions of Differential Equations
nodes.summary: 在常点处把解写成幂级数 y = Σ aₙ(x−x₀)ⁿ，代入方程比较系数得到递推关系，逐项求出解。
nodes.summaryEn: Writing the solution as a power series about an ordinary point and deriving a recurrence relation for the coefficients.
nodes.definition:
对二阶线性方程

$$y'' + p(x)y' + q(x)y = 0,$$

若 $p$、$q$ 在 $x_0$ 处都解析（可以在 $x_0$ 附近展成幂级数），就称 $x_0$ 是方程的**常点**。在常点附近，解可以写成幂级数

$$y = \sum_{n=0}^{\infty} a_n (x - x_0)^n.$$

把它代回方程，通过合并求和、移动指标，让两边都变成 $(x-x_0)^n$ 的形式，再比较同次幂的系数，就得到系数之间的**递推关系**。

初值 $y(x_0) = a_0$、$y'(x_0) = a_1$ 直接给出前两个系数，递推关系则决定其余全部系数：由此得到两个线性无关的级数解，通解是它们的线性组合。求解中最常用的技巧，就是「把每一项都整理成同一个幂次为通项的形式，再令系数相等」。

级数解在 $|x - x_0| < R$ 内收敛，其中 $R$ 至少等于从 $x_0$ 到 $p$、$q$ 的最近奇点的距离；若 $p$、$q$ 是整函数（如 Airy 方程 $y'' = xy$），解在全实轴上收敛。Bessel 方程、Legendre 方程这类不能用初等函数表示解的经典方程，正是靠幂级数（或广义幂级数）给出解的。
nodes.definitionEn:
Consider a second-order linear equation

$$y''+p(x)y'+q(x)y=0.$$

If $p$ and $q$ are analytic at $x_0$ (expandable in powers of $x-x_0$), then $x_0$ is an **ordinary point**. Near it we seek a power series solution

$$y=\sum_{n=0}^{\infty}a_n(x-x_0)^n.$$

Substituting into the equation, shifting indices so that both sides are written as powers of $(x-x_0)$, and matching coefficients of equal powers yields a **recurrence relation** for the coefficients.

The initial data $y(x_0)=a_0$, $y'(x_0)=a_1$ fix the first two coefficients; the recurrence determines all the rest, producing two linearly independent series solutions whose linear combinations give the general solution.

The series converges for $|x-x_0|<R$, where $R$ is at least the distance from $x_0$ to the nearest singularity of $p$, $q$; if $p$, $q$ are entire (as for the Airy equation $y''=xy$), the solutions converge on the whole real line. Classical equations such as Bessel's and Legendre's, whose solutions are not elementary functions, are solved exactly in this way.

formulas.note: 常点 $x_0$ 处解的标准幂级数假设，$a_0 = y(x_0)$
formulas.noteEn: The power-series ansatz at an ordinary point; $a_0=y(x_0)$

formulas.latex: y' = \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} n a_n (x - x_0)^{n-1}, \qquad y'' = \sum_{n=2}^{\infty} n(n-1) a_n (x - x_0)^{n-2}
formulas.note: 逐项求导：幂级数在收敛区间内部可以任意次求导
formulas.noteEn: Term-by-term differentiation: a power series may be differentiated as often as needed inside its interval of convergence

formulas.note: Airy 方程 $y'' = xy$ 的递推关系：代入并比较 $x^n$ 的系数得到
formulas.noteEn: Recurrence for the Airy equation $y''=xy$, obtained by comparing coefficients of $x^n$

formulas.note: Airy 方程的两个线性无关幂级数解，$a_0$、$a_1$ 由初值决定
formulas.noteEn: Two independent series solutions of the Airy equation; $a_0$, $a_1$ come from the initial data

formulas.note: 初值与系数的关系：解的前两项直接由初值给出
formulas.noteEn: Initial data as coefficients: the first two coefficients are exactly the initial values

expression.text: y = Σₙ₌₀^∞ aₙ (x − x₀)ⁿ
expression.note: 在常点附近假设解为幂级数，代入方程后逐项比较系数求递推关系。
expression.noteEn: Assume a power series near an ordinary point, substitute, and match coefficients to get a recurrence.

properties: 常点处一定有幂级数解：$p$、$q$ 在 $x_0$ 解析时，方程有两个线性无关的幂级数解，收敛半径至少是 $x_0$ 到最近奇点的距离
递推关系逐项确定系数：由 $a_0$、$a_1$ 出发，每一步都由前面的系数唯一确定后一个系数
初值由前两个系数给出：$a_0 = y(x_0)$，$a_1 = y'(x_0)$，与二阶方程初值问题的存在唯一性吻合
多项式系数方程必可用此法：如 Airy 方程 $y'' = xy$（$p = 0$，$q = -x$ 处处解析），解在全实轴上收敛；Bessel、Legendre 方程也这样处理
奇点处需用广义幂级数（Frobenius 方法）：当 $x_0$ 是正则奇点时，改设 $y = x^r\sum a_n x^n$，解可能含 $\ln x$ 项
propertiesEn: Power series solutions always exist at an ordinary point: if $p$, $q$ are analytic at $x_0$, there are two independent series solutions with radius at least the distance to the nearest singularity
The recurrence fixes the coefficients one by one, starting from $a_0$ and $a_1$
Initial values become the first coefficients: $a_0=y(x_0)$, $a_1=y'(x_0)$, in line with the uniqueness theorem for the IVP
Equations with polynomial coefficients are always accessible: for $y''=xy$ (Airy) the solutions converge everywhere; Bessel and Legendre equations are handled in the same way
At singular points one uses generalized series (Frobenius): set $y=x^r\sum a_nx^n$; logarithmic terms may appear

plot.title: Airy 方程 y″ = xy 的两个幂级数解（截断近似）

examples.problem: 用幂级数法求 Airy 方程 $y'' = xy$ 满足 $y(0) = 1$、$y'(0) = 0$ 的解的前几个非零项。
用幂级数法解初值问题 $y' = y,\ y(0) = 1$，并把结果求和。
examples.solution:
设 $y = \sum_{n=0}^{\infty} a_n x^n$，则 $y' = \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} n a_n x^{n-1}$。两边都写成 $x^m$ 的幂：
$$\sum_{m=0}^{\infty} (m+1)a_{m+1}x^m = \sum_{m=0}^{\infty} a_m x^m,$$
比较系数得 $(m+1)a_{m+1} = a_m$，即递推关系 $a_{m+1} = \dfrac{a_m}{m+1}$。由 $a_0 = y(0) = 1$：
$$a_1 = 1, \quad a_2 = \frac{1}{2}, \quad a_3 = \frac{1}{6}, \quad \dots, \quad a_n = \frac{1}{n!}.$$
于是 $y = \sum_{n=0}^{\infty} \dfrac{x^n}{n!} = e^x$——幂级数解法把解直接「算」成了指数函数，也验证了 $y = e^x$ 的泰勒级数就是解法得到的解。

nodes.title: 解的存在唯一性定理
nodes.summary: 皮卡-林德勒夫定理：f 连续且关于 y 满足李普希茨条件时，初值问题在某个区间内存在唯一解，可由皮卡迭代逐步逼近。
nodes.summaryEn: The Picard–Lindelöf theorem: continuity plus a Lipschitz condition in y guarantee a unique local solution, constructed by Picard iteration.
nodes.definition:
考虑一阶初值问题

$$y' = f(x, y), \qquad y(x_0) = y_0.$$

**皮卡-林德勒夫定理**（存在唯一性定理）说：若 $f(x,y)$ 在矩形区域 $R = \{(x,y): |x - x_0| \le a,\ |y - y_0| \le b\}$ 上连续，且关于 $y$ 满足**李普希茨条件**——存在常数 $L > 0$，使 $R$ 内任意两点都有

$$|f(x, y_1) - f(x, y_2)| \le L|y_1 - y_2|,$$

那么存在 $h > 0$，使初值问题在区间 $|x - x_0| \le h$ 上有且仅有一个解。

「唯一」和「局部」是理解定理的关键。唯一性保证相平面上过每一点至多有一条积分曲线，这正是轨线不相交、相图能整体绘制的前提；局部性说明解未必能延伸到很远处——例如 $y' = y^2,\ y(0) = 1$ 的解 $y = 1/(1-x)$ 在 $x = 1$ 处爆破，只能存在于 $(-\infty, 1)$ 上。

定理的证明是构造性的：把微分方程等价地改写成积分方程 $y(x) = y_0 + \int_{x_0}^{x} f(t, y(t))\,dt$，再从常函数 $y_0(x) \equiv y_0$ 出发做**皮卡迭代**

$$y_{n+1}(x) = y_0 + \int_{x_0}^{x} f(t, y_n(t))\,dt.$$

可以证明这个函数列在 $|x - x_0| \le h$ 上一致收敛，极限函数就是那个唯一解。

实践中验证李普希茨条件常用一个更强的充分条件：若 $\partial f/\partial y$ 在 $R$ 上连续，则由中值定理 $f$ 自动满足李普希茨条件。条件失效时唯一性可能真的瓦解：$y' = \sqrt{|y|},\ y(0) = 0$ 在 $y = 0$ 处不满足此条件，过原点的解确实不止一个。
nodes.definitionEn:
Consider the initial value problem

$$y'=f(x,y),\qquad y(x_0)=y_0.$$

The **Picard–Lindelöf theorem** states: if $f(x,y)$ is continuous on the rectangle $R=\{|x-x_0|\le a,\ |y-y_0|\le b\}$ and satisfies a **Lipschitz condition** in $y$ — there is $L>0$ with

$$|f(x,y_1)-f(x,y_2)|\le L|y_1-y_2|$$

for all points of $R$ — then there is $h>0$ such that the problem has exactly one solution on $|x-x_0|\le h$.

Both words matter. Uniqueness means at most one integral curve passes through each point of the phase plane, which is what allows trajectories never to cross and phase portraits to be drawn. Localness means the solution need not extend far: $y'=y^2,\ y(0)=1$ has the solution $y=1/(1-x)$, which blows up at $x=1$ and lives only on $(-\infty,1)$.

The proof is constructive: rewrite the ODE as the integral equation $y(x)=y_0+\int_{x_0}^{x}f(t,y(t))\,dt$ and run **Picard iteration**

$$y_{n+1}(x)=y_0+\int_{x_0}^{x}f(t,y_n(t))\,dt$$

from $y_0(x)\equiv y_0$. The sequence converges uniformly on $|x-x_0|\le h$ and its limit is the unique solution.

In practice the Lipschitz condition is verified through a stronger sufficient condition: if $\partial f/\partial y$ is continuous on $R$, the mean value theorem makes $f$ Lipschitz. When the hypothesis fails uniqueness can genuinely break down: for $y'=\sqrt{|y|},\ y(0)=0$ the function is not Lipschitz at $y=0$, and indeed more than one solution passes through the origin.

formulas.note: 一阶初值问题：定理讨论的标准对象
formulas.noteEn: The first-order initial value problem studied by the theorem

formulas.note: 关于 $y$ 的李普希茨条件：保证方程不会对相邻初值过度「敏感」
formulas.noteEn: Lipschitz condition in $y$: it prevents extreme sensitivity to nearby initial data

formulas.latex: y_{n+1}(x) = y_0 + \int_{x_0}^{x} f(t, y_n(t))\,dt, \qquad y_0(x) \equiv y_0
formulas.note: 皮卡迭代序列：从常函数出发反复积分，一致收敛到唯一解
formulas.noteEn: Picard iterates: repeated integration starting from the constant function; they converge uniformly to the unique solution

formulas.note: 等价的积分方程：初值问题有解等价于它有连续解，这是迭代的出发点
formulas.noteEn: The equivalent integral equation; the IVP is solvable exactly when this integral equation has a continuous solution

formulas.note: 存在区间的估计：解至少能在 $|x - x_0| \le h$ 上存活
formulas.noteEn: Estimate of the existence interval: the solution exists at least on $|x-x_0|\le h$

expression.text: y' = f(x, y), y(x₀) = y₀；f 连续 + 关于 y 李普希茨 ⇒ 局部存在唯一解
expression.note: 皮卡迭代从常函数 y₀ 出发，逐次积分逼近唯一解。
expression.noteEn: Picard iteration starts from the constant y₀ and approaches the unique solution by repeated integration.

properties: 两个条件各司其职：f 连续保证「存在」，关于 y 的李普希茨条件保证「唯一」；最常用的验证方式是 $\partial f/\partial y$ 连续
唯一性有两个重要推论：过每点至多一条积分曲线，轨线互不相交，相图才能成为「不交叉的曲线族」
定理是局部的：只保证在小矩形对应的区间上存在；解可能在有限处爆破，如 $y' = y^2,\ y(0)=1$ 的解在 $x=1$ 处发散
皮卡迭代是构造性的：迭代序列 $y_n$ 一致收敛到解，同时给出逐次逼近的计算方法
定理可推广到方程组与高阶方程：写成一阶向量形式 $x' = f(t, x)$ 后结论不变；对线性系统 $x' = Ax$（$f$ 关于 $x$ 全局李普希茨），解在整条实轴上存在唯一
propertiesEn: The two hypotheses play different roles: continuity gives existence, the Lipschitz condition gives uniqueness; a convenient sufficient test is that $\partial f/\partial y$ is continuous
Uniqueness implies that at most one integral curve passes through each point, so trajectories never cross and the phase portrait is well defined
The theorem is local: the solution is guaranteed only on a small interval and may blow up, as $y'=y^2,\ y(0)=1$ does at $x=1$
Picard iteration is constructive: the iterates converge uniformly to the solution and provide successive approximations
It extends to systems and higher-order equations via the vector form $x'=f(t,x)$; for linear systems $x'=Ax$ ($f$ is globally Lipschitz) solutions exist and are unique on the whole real line

plot.title: y' = x + y 的斜率场：过每一点的解曲线唯一，不同解曲线不相交

examples.problem: 对初值问题 $y' = x + y^2,\ y(0) = 1$，说明它在原点附近存在唯一解。
examples.solution:
取包含 $(0,1)$ 的任意有界矩形 $R$。$f(x,y) = x + y^2$ 在 $R$ 上连续；并且
$$\frac{\partial f}{\partial y} = 2y$$
在 $R$ 上连续，于是有界，设 $|2y| \le L$。由中值定理，对 $R$ 内任意 $y_1, y_2$，
$$|f(x,y_1) - f(x,y_2)| = |y_1^2 - y_2^2| = |y_1 + y_2|\,|y_1 - y_2| \le L|y_1 - y_2|,$$
即 $f$ 关于 $y$ 满足李普希茨条件。由存在唯一性定理，该初值问题在 $x = 0$ 附近的一段区间上存在且唯一解。

examples.problem: 说明 $y' = \sqrt{|y|},\ y(0) = 0$ 为什么会有多个解，并指出与定理中哪条假设有关。
examples.solution:
函数 $f(y) = \sqrt{|y|}$ 连续，但在 $y = 0$ 处不满足李普希茨条件：考察比值
$$\frac{|f(y) - f(0)|}{|y - 0|} = \frac{\sqrt{|y|}}{|y|} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{|y|}} \to \infty \quad (y \to 0),$$
不存在使不等式对 $y = 0$ 附近所有点成立的常数 $L$。结果唯一性确实失效：$y \equiv 0$ 是一个解；而 $y = x^2/4$（$x \ge 0$）也是解，因为此时 $y' = x/2$，而 $\sqrt{|y|} = \sqrt{x^2/4} = x/2$，两者相等。把 $0$ 解与 $x^2/4$ 解在 $x = 0$ 处拼接，还能构造出无穷多个过原点的解。这条反例说明：定理中的李普希茨条件是保证唯一性的关键假设，不能省略。

nodes.title: 指数与指数幂
nodes.summary: 把指数的概念从整数扩充到分数与实数，用根式与分数指数幂互相转化。
nodes.summaryEn: Extending exponents from integers to fractions and reals, converting freely between radicals and rational powers.
nodes.definition:
指数最初表示「几个相同的数相乘」，即 $a^n$ 是 $n$ 个 $a$ 相乘。为了让它对分数也说得通，我们规定**分数指数幂**：

$$a^{\frac{m}{n}} = \sqrt[n]{a^m} \quad (a>0,\ m,n \in \mathbb{N}^+,\ n>1)$$

也就是说，**分母做根指数，分子做被开方数的指数**。这样 $a^{1/2}=\sqrt{a}$、$a^{2/3}=\sqrt[3]{a^2}$。

为什么必须要求 $a>0$？因为当 $a$ 为负数时，偶次方根在实数范围内没有意义，例如 $(-8)^{1/2}$ 不是实数。规定了底数为正之后，指数幂就可以进一步扩充到**任意实数**指数，并且保留全部幂运算法则。

这套记号是后续指数函数、对数乃至微积分的基石：只有把 $a^x$ 对一切实数 $x$ 都有定义，才谈得上画出连续的指数曲线。

幂运算有两条「主干」：同底数相乘除、幂的幂；再配合积与商的幂，就构成了完整的指数律。
nodes.definitionEn:
An exponent originally means "how many copies of the base are multiplied", i.e. $a^n$ is the product of $n$ factors of $a$. To make sense of fractional exponents we define **rational powers**:

$$a^{\frac{m}{n}} = \sqrt[n]{a^m} \quad (a>0,\ m,n \in \mathbb{N}^+,\ n>1)$$

That is, **the denominator becomes the index of the radical and the numerator becomes the power of the radicand**, so $a^{1/2}=\sqrt{a}$ and $a^{2/3}=\sqrt[3]{a^2}$.

Why must $a>0$? Because when $a$ is negative, even roots are not real numbers: $(-8)^{1/2}$ is undefined over the reals. Once the base is restricted to positive numbers, powers extend smoothly to **arbitrary real exponents** while keeping all the power laws.

This notation is the foundation of exponential functions, logarithms and calculus: only when $a^x$ is defined for every real $x$ can we draw a continuous exponential curve.

Two "trunk" rules organise everything: multiplying/dividing like bases, and a power of a power. Together with powers of products and quotients they form the complete laws of exponents.

formulas.note: 分数指数幂与根式的互化：分母做根指数，分子做幂指数
formulas.noteEn: Converting between rational powers and radicals: denominator is the radical index, numerator the power

formulas.note: 同底数幂相乘，指数相加；这是指数律的核心
formulas.noteEn: Multiplying like bases adds exponents; the core of the exponent laws

formulas.note: 同底数幂相除，指数相减
formulas.noteEn: Dividing like bases subtracts exponents

formulas.note: 幂的幂，指数相乘
formulas.noteEn: A power of a power multiplies exponents

formulas.note: 负指数与零指数：由「指数相减得零」自然导出
formulas.noteEn: Negative and zero exponents, derived from subtracting equal exponents

expression.note: 底数 a 必须为正数；分母 n 是根指数，分子 m 是幂指数。
expression.noteEn: The base a must be positive; the denominator n is the radical index and the numerator m is the power.

properties: 分数指数幂只在 $a>0$ 时对一切有理指数有定义，负数底数会破坏偶次根式的实数性
根式与分数指数幂可以互相转化：$\sqrt[n]{a^m}=a^{m/n}$，根号内整体提出指数可写成乘法
所有的整数指数幂运算法则对分数指数幂、实数指数幂依然成立
$0$ 的正分数指数幂为 $0$，但 $0$ 的零指数幂与负指数幂无意义
propertiesEn: Rational powers are defined for every rational exponent only when $a>0$; negative bases break the realness of even roots
Radicals and rational powers convert both ways: $\sqrt[n]{a^m}=a^{m/n}$, and an exponent inside a radical can be pulled out as a factor
All integer exponent laws continue to hold for rational and even real exponents
$0$ raised to a positive rational power is $0$, but $0^0$ and $0$ to a negative power are undefined

plot.title: 分数指数幂的图像（a>0）

examples.problem: 用分数指数幂表示 $\dfrac{\sqrt{a}\cdot\sqrt[3]{a^2}}{a^{\frac{1}{6}}}$（$a>0$）。

nodes.title: 指数方程与不等式
nodes.summary: 利用指数函数的单调性，把指数方程与不等式化归为普通方程与不等式。
nodes.summaryEn: Using the monotonicity of exponentials to reduce exponential equations and inequalities to ordinary ones.
nodes.definition:
含有未知数在**指数位置**的方程叫**指数方程**，例如 $2^{x+1}=8$；含有未知数在指数位置的不等式叫**指数不等式**，例如 $3^{2x-1}>27$。

解这类问题的核心工具是**单调性**。因为指数函数 $y=a^x$ 是一一函数，所以当底数相同时

$$a^{f(x)}=a^{g(x)} \iff f(x)=g(x)$$

对一切实数都成立。对不等式，只需记住：$a>1$ 时不等号方向不变，$0<a<1$ 时不等号方向反转。这样指数问题就「降级」为一次、二次方程或不等式。

遇到不同底数时，常用的技巧有：化同底（如 $4^x=2^{2x}$）、两边取对数、换元令 $t=a^x$（$t>0$）。换元时千万不要忘记 $t>0$ 这个隐含条件，它常常是筛掉增根的关键。

很多实际问题，如复利、半衰期、人口模型，最终都归结为解一个指数方程，因此这套方法既是技巧也是应用入口。
nodes.definitionEn:
An **exponential equation** has the unknown in the exponent, e.g. $2^{x+1}=8$; an **exponential inequality** does too, e.g. $3^{2x-1}>27$.

The key tool is **monotonicity**. Since $y=a^x$ is one-to-one, for equal bases

$$a^{f(x)}=a^{g(x)} \iff f(x)=g(x)$$

always holds. For inequalities just remember: the inequality direction is preserved when $a>1$ and reversed when $0<a<1$. In this way exponential problems are reduced to linear or quadratic ones.

With different bases the standard tricks are: write everything over a common base (e.g. $4^x=2^{2x}$), take logarithms of both sides, or substitute $t=a^x$ with $t>0$. Never forget the hidden condition $t>0$ when substituting — it is what removes extraneous roots.

Real problems such as compound interest, half-life and population models all end up as an exponential equation, so these methods are both technique and gateway to applications.

formulas.note: 同底法：底数相同则指数相等，这是解指数方程的主线
formulas.noteEn: Same-base method: equal bases force equal exponents

formulas.note: 底数大于 1 时不等号方向不变
formulas.noteEn: For $a>1$ the inequality direction is preserved

formulas.note: 底数小于 1 时不等号方向反转，这是最常见的失分点
formulas.noteEn: For $0<a<1$ the direction is reversed — the most common pitfall

formulas.note: 不同底数时两边取对数的基本做法
formulas.noteEn: Taking logarithms when the right side is not a power of $a$

formulas.note: 换元法：化为关于 $t$ 的二次方程，注意 $t>0$ 的取舍
formulas.noteEn: Substitution: reduces to a quadratic in $t$ with the constraint $t>0$

expression.text: a^f(x) = a^g(x)  ⟺  f(x) = g(x)
expression.note: 前提是底数相同且 a>0, a≠1；不同底数需先化同底。
expression.noteEn: Valid for a common base with $a>0,\ a\neq 1$; otherwise convert to a common base first.

properties: 指数函数一一对应，所以同底指数相等必然推出指数相等，不会漏解也不会增解
解不等式时底数大小决定不等号是否变号：$a>1$ 不变，$0<a<1$ 反转
换元 $t=a^x$ 后必须附加 $t>0$，舍去非正根
底数不同时可两边取同底对数，充分利用对数与指数的互化
指数式恒为正，所以形如 $a^{f(x)}=b$ 当 $b\le 0$ 时直接无解
propertiesEn: The exponential is one-to-one, so equal powers of a common base force equal exponents — no solutions lost or gained
The base decides whether the inequality sign flips: unchanged for $a>1$, reversed for $0<a<1$
After substituting $t=a^x$ we must keep $t>0$ and discard non-positive roots
For different bases, take logarithms of both sides, exploiting the exponential–logarithm equivalence
Exponentials are always positive, so $a^{f(x)}=b$ has no solution when $b\le 0$

plot.title: 解 2^x = 8：递增曲线与 y = 8 交于 x = 3；绿色区域：2^x ≥ 8 ⟺ x ≥ 3

examples.problem: 解不等式 $\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)^{2x-1} > 27$。
examples.solution: 化为同底：$\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)^{2x-1} > 3^3 = \left(\frac{1}{3}\right)^{-3}$。底数 $0<\frac{1}{3}<1$，函数单调递减，故不等号反转：$2x-1<-3$，即 $x<-1$。解集为 $(-\infty,-1)$。

nodes.title: 对数
nodes.summary: 对数是「已知底数与幂求指数」的逆运算，把乘法变成加法。
nodes.summaryEn: The logarithm answers "what exponent gives this power", turning multiplication into addition.
nodes.definition:
如果 $a>0$、$a\neq 1$，并且

$$a^b=N$$

那么就把指数 $b$ 叫做**以 $a$ 为底 $N$ 的对数**，记作

$$b=\log_a N$$

其中 $a$ 叫底数，$N$ 叫真数。注意**真数必须为正**：$a^b$ 永远是正的，所以 $\log_a N$ 只对 $N>0$ 有意义。

对数的本质就是「把指数单独解出来」。正因为如此，指数运算里繁琐的乘法、除法、开方，在对数运算里变成了加法、减法、系数相乘——这就是历史上对数被称作「节省计算的天才发明」的原因，它让天文计算从数月缩短到数天。

常用的两种特殊对数：以 $10$ 为底的**常用对数**记作 $\lg N$，以自然常数 $e$ 为底的**自然对数**记作 $\ln N$。在高等数学中，$\ln$ 出现的频率远高于其他底数，因为它的导数形式最简洁。

牢记两条看似平凡却极重要的恒等式（其中 $N>0$）：$\log_a 1=0$ 和 $\log_a a=1$，它们是所有对数计算的出发点。
nodes.definitionEn:
If $a>0$, $a\neq 1$ and

$$a^b=N$$

then the exponent $b$ is called the **logarithm of $N$ to base $a$**, written

$$b=\log_a N$$

Here $a$ is the base and $N$ the argument. Note that **the argument must be positive**: $a^b$ is always positive, so $\log_a N$ only makes sense for $N>0$.

A logarithm simply "solves the exponent out". Consequently the cumbersome multiplications, divisions and roots of exponential work become additions, subtractions and scalar multiples — which is why logarithms were celebrated as a genius labour-saving invention that cut astronomical computations from months to days.

Two special bases are standard: the **common logarithm** base $10$, written $\lg N$, and the **natural logarithm** base $e$, written $\ln N$. In advanced mathematics $\ln$ dominates all other bases because its derivative is the simplest.

Two identities look trivial but matter enormously (with $N>0$): $\log_a 1=0$ and $\log_a a=1$. All logarithm computations start from them.

formulas.note: 对数的定义：指数与对数的互化，是一切运算的起点
formulas.noteEn: Definition: the exponential–logarithm conversion, starting point of everything

formulas.note: 积的对数等于对数的和（真数都为正）
formulas.noteEn: The log of a product is the sum of logs (positive arguments)

formulas.note: 商的对数等于对数的差
formulas.noteEn: The log of a quotient is the difference of logs

formulas.note: 幂的对数：指数可以提到对数前面
formulas.noteEn: The log of a power: exponents come out as coefficients

formulas.note: 两条互逆恒等式，说明指数与对数互为逆运算
formulas.noteEn: Two inverse identities showing exponentials and logarithms undo each other

expression.text: log_a(N) = b  ⟺  a^b = N   (a>0, a≠1, N>0)
expression.note: 底数 a 正且不等于 1，真数 N 必须为正；lg 表示以 10 为底，ln 表示以 e 为底。
expression.noteEn: Base $a$ positive and not 1, argument $N$ positive; $\lg$ is base 10 and $\ln$ is base $e$.

properties: 定义域限制：底数 $a>0$ 且 $a\neq 1$，真数 $N>0$；这两条是解对数题的第一道关卡
真数相等、底数相同时对数相等；反之对数相等也推出真数相等（一一对应）
对数的运算法则只对正的乘积因子成立，$\log_a(M+N)\neq \log_a M+\log_a N$
换底公式 $\log_a N=\frac{\log_c N}{\log_c a}$ 把任意底数统一到常用底数
propertiesEn: Domain conditions: base $a>0$, $a\neq 1$ and argument $N>0$ — the first hurdle in every logarithm problem
$\log_a 1=0$ and $\log_a a=1$, since $a^0=1$ and $a^1=a$
Equal arguments with equal bases give equal logs, and conversely; the map is one-to-one
The laws apply to positive factors only: $\log_a(M+N)\neq \log_a M+\log_a N$
The change-of-base formula $\log_a N=\frac{\log_c N}{\log_c a}$ converts every base to a common one
