示意：样本均值从上方逼近 μ

plot.title: 大数定律示意：样本均值被越来越紧地夹在期望 μ = 1 附近

examples.problem: 掷一枚均匀骰子 $n=100$ 次，$X_i$ 为第 $i$ 次点数，$\bar X$ 为平均点数。用切比雪夫不等式估计 $P(|\bar X - 3.5| \ge 0.5)$ 的上界。
examples.solution:
均匀骰子 $E(X_i) = 3.5$，$\operatorname{Var}(X_i) = \frac{91}{6} - 3.5^2 = \frac{35}{12}$。样本均值的方差
$$\operatorname{Var}(\bar X) = \frac{35/12}{100} = \frac{7}{240} \approx 0.0292.$$
切比雪夫不等式给出
$$P(|\bar X - 3.5| \ge 0.5) \le \frac{7/240}{0.5^2} = \frac{7}{60} \approx 0.117,$$
即平均点数偏离 3.5 超过 0.5 的概率不超过约 11.7%。

examples.problem: 抛一枚均匀硬币 $n = 10000$ 次，$\nu_n$ 为正面次数。估计 $P\left(\left|\frac{\nu_n}{n} - 0.5\right| \ge 0.02\right)$ 的上界。
examples.solution:
频率 $\nu_n/n$ 的期望为 $p = 0.5$，方差为
$$\operatorname{Var}\left(\frac{\nu_n}{n}\right) = \frac{p(1-p)}{n} = \frac{0.25}{10000} = 2.5 \times 10^{-5}.$$
由切比雪夫不等式，
$$P\left(\left|\frac{\nu_n}{n} - 0.5\right| \ge 0.02\right) \le \frac{2.5 \times 10^{-5}}{0.02^2} = 0.0625,$$
频率与 0.5 相差超过 0.02 的概率不超过 6.25%，而且 $n$ 越大这个上界越小——这正是伯努利大数定律的定量版本。

nodes.title: 中心极限定理
nodes.summary: 大量独立同分布随机变量之和经标准化后依分布收敛于标准正态：无论原来什么分布，正态总在极限处出现。
nodes.summaryEn: Sums of many i.i.d. variables, once standardized, converge in distribution to the standard normal: normality emerges in the limit regardless of the original distribution.
nodes.definition:
大数定律说样本均值趋于常数 $\mu$，但没有说明它是「怎样」围绕 $\mu$ 波动的。**中心极限定理**（CLT）回答的正是这个问题：设 $X_1, \dots, X_n$ 独立同分布，均值 $\mu$、方差 $0 < \sigma^2 < \infty$，把和标准化为

$$Z_n = \frac{\sum_{i=1}^n X_i - n\mu}{\sigma\sqrt{n}} = \frac{\bar X_n - \mu}{\sigma/\sqrt{n}},$$

则当 $n \to \infty$ 时，$Z_n$ 的分布**收敛于标准正态分布 $N(0,1)$**（林德伯格-莱维定理）。

它的威力在于普适性：$X_i$ 可以是均匀、指数、伯努利……只要独立同分布且方差有限，标准化和都会趋于正态。于是当 $n$ 足够大时可用

$$\sum_{i=1}^n X_i \approx N(n\mu,\ n\sigma^2), \qquad \bar X_n \approx N\!\left(\mu, \frac{\sigma^2}{n}\right)$$

来近似计算概率，这解释了大样本统计中正态分布无处不在。历史上最早的特例是**棣莫弗-拉普拉斯定理**：二项分布 $B(n,p)$ 的标准化趋于标准正态。

注意收敛方式：CLT 是**依分布收敛**——$Z_n$ 的分布函数逐点趋于标准正态分布函数 $\Phi$，而不是依概率收敛：$Z_n$ 本身并不依概率收敛于某个随机变量。这与大数定律的收敛类型不同。
nodes.definitionEn:
The law of large numbers says the sample mean tends to the constant $\mu$; it does not describe how the mean fluctuates around $\mu$. The **central limit theorem** (CLT) answers that: for i.i.d. variables $X_1,\dots,X_n$ with mean $\mu$ and variance $0<\sigma^2<\infty$, standardize the sum as

$$Z_n = \frac{\sum_{i=1}^n X_i - n\mu}{\sigma\sqrt{n}} = \frac{\bar X_n - \mu}{\sigma/\sqrt{n}},$$

then as $n\to\infty$ the distribution of $Z_n$ **converges to the standard normal $N(0,1)$** (Lindeberg–Lévy theorem).

Its power is universality: whether the $X_i$ are uniform, exponential or Bernoulli, as long as they are i.i.d. with finite variance, the standardized sum becomes normal. For large $n$ one may use

$$\sum_{i=1}^n X_i \approx N(n\mu,\ n\sigma^2), \qquad \bar X_n \approx N\!\left(\mu, \frac{\sigma^2}{n}\right),$$

which is why the normal distribution pervades large-sample statistics. The earliest special case is the **De Moivre–Laplace theorem**: standardized binomial variables converge to the standard normal.

Note the type of convergence: the CLT is **convergence in distribution** — the CDF of $Z_n$ tends pointwise to the standard normal CDF $\Phi$, not convergence in probability: $Z_n$ itself does not converge in probability to any random variable.

formulas.note: 林德伯格-莱维中心极限定理：标准化和依分布收敛于标准正态。
formulas.noteEn: Lindeberg–Lévy CLT: the standardized sum converges in distribution to the standard normal.

formulas.note: 样本均值形式的 CLT：均值误差以 σ/√n 为尺度呈正态波动。
formulas.noteEn: Sample-mean form: the error of the mean fluctuates normally on the scale $\sigma/\sqrt{n}$.

formulas.note: 依分布收敛的实用形式：用标准正态分布函数 Φ 近似任意区间概率。
formulas.noteEn: The practical form: interval probabilities are approximated with the standard normal CDF $\Phi$.

formulas.note: 棣莫弗-拉普拉斯定理：二项分布是 CLT 的伯努利特例（Sₙ 为成功次数）。
formulas.noteEn: De Moivre–Laplace theorem: binomial is the Bernoulli special case of the CLT.

formulas.note: 大样本近似：和与均值的分布都可用正态近似，均值的误差量级是 σ/√n。
formulas.noteEn: Large-sample approximation for sums and means; the error of the mean has order $\sigma/\sqrt{n}$.

properties: 收敛方式是依分布收敛：$Z_n$ 的分布函数逐点趋于 $\Phi$；不是依概率收敛——$Z_n$ 自身并不趋于某个固定随机变量，这是 CLT 与 LLN 的本质区别
条件：独立同分布、方差存在且 $0 < \sigma^2 < \infty$；不要求原分布对称或接近正态，$n$ 越大、原分布越接近正态，近似越好
棣莫弗-拉普拉斯定理是 CLT 的特例：伯努利分布的和（二项分布）标准化后趋于标准正态，通常当 $np \ge 5$ 且 $n(1-p) \ge 5$ 时近似效果较好
与大数定律互补：LLN 说明样本均值依概率收敛到 μ，CLT 说明围绕 μ 的波动量级为 σ/√n 且近似正态
CLT 解释了正态分布在自然与统计中无处不在：置信区间与假设检验的大样本理论都以它为基础
propertiesEn: The convergence is in distribution: the CDF of $Z_n$ tends pointwise to $\Phi$; it is not convergence in probability, as $Z_n$ does not tend to a fixed random variable
Assumptions: i.i.d. variables with $0<\sigma^2<\infty$; no symmetry or near-normality of the original distribution is required
The De Moivre–Laplace theorem is the Bernoulli special case; the normal approximation to binomial is good when $np\ge 5$ and $n(1-p)\ge 5$
Complementing the LLN: the law says the mean converges in probability to $\mu$, the CLT describes its $\sigma/\sqrt{n}$-scale normal fluctuation
The CLT explains why the normal distribution is everywhere in nature and statistics; large-sample confidence intervals and tests rest on it

functions.label: n = 2 的标准化和密度（两均匀变量之和）

plot.title: 中心极限定理：标准化和的密度随 n 增大逼近标准正态（蓝：φ(x)，粉：n = 2）

examples.problem: 抛一枚均匀硬币 100 次，$S$ 为正面次数。用中心极限定理近似 $P(S \le 55)$（含连续性修正）。
examples.solution:
$S \sim B(100,\ 0.5)$，$E(S) = 50$，$\operatorname{Var}(S) = 100 \times 0.5 \times 0.5 = 25$，标准差为 5。标准化 $Z = \frac{S - 50}{5}$ 近似服从 $N(0,1)$。

用连续性修正把 $S \le 55$ 写成 $S \le 55.5$：
$$P(S \le 55) \approx P\left(Z \le \frac{55.5 - 50}{5}\right) = P(Z \le 1.1) = \Phi(1.1) \approx 0.8643.$$

examples.problem: 设 $X_1, \dots, X_{100}$ 独立同分布，$E(X_i) = 3$，标准差 $\sigma = 2$。近似计算 $P(2.6 \le \bar X \le 3.4)$。
examples.solution:
$\bar X$ 的期望为 3，标准差为 $\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}} = \frac{2}{10} = 0.2$。标准化后
$$P(2.6 \le \bar X \le 3.4) = P\left(\frac{2.6-3}{0.2} \le Z \le \frac{3.4-3}{0.2}\right) = P(-2 \le Z \le 2) \approx \Phi(2) - \Phi(-2) = 2\Phi(2) - 1 \approx 0.9545.$$
注意这里只用到了 $n = 100$ 和两个总体数字特征，没有用到 $X_i$ 的具体分布，这正是 CLT 普适性的体现。

nodes.title: 总体、样本与统计量
nodes.summary: 总体是研究对象的全体及其分布，简单随机样本是独立同分布地抽出的观测，统计量则是不含未知参数的样本函数——统计推断的一切都从这三个概念出发。
nodes.summaryEn: The population is the whole collection of objects of study with its distribution, a simple random sample consists of i.i.d. observations, and a statistic is a sample function free of unknown parameters; all of statistical inference starts here.
nodes.definition:
把所有研究对象的全体称为**总体**，组成总体的每个对象称为**个体**。实际研究中更关心对象的某个数量指标 $X$（如灯泡寿命、植株高度），因此常说「总体 $X$」：它既是一切可能取值的集合，也带着自己的分布函数 $F(x)$。个体个数有限时称有限总体，否则称无限总体。抽样之前谁会被抽中是随机的，所以每次观测的结果都是随机变量。

从总体中按机会均等的方式抽取 $n$ 个个体，得到 $X_1,\dots,X_n$。若每个 $X_i$ 都与总体 $X$ 同分布，并且 $X_1,\dots,X_n$ **相互独立**，就称它们是容量为 $n$ 的**简单随机样本**，简称样本。这两条要求合起来就是「独立同分布」，记作 $X_i\;\text{i.i.d.}\sim F$。独立性保证各次观测互不影响，同分布保证每次观测都来自同一个总体——这正是对「随机抽取」的数学刻画。抽样后得到的一组具体数值 $x_1,\dots,x_n$ 称为**样本观测值**。

不含任何未知参数的样本函数称为**统计量**。例如 $X_1+\cdots+X_n$、$\bar X$、$\max\{X_i\}$ 都是统计量；而 $\frac{\bar X-\mu}{\sigma/\sqrt n}$ 在 $\mu,\sigma$ 未知时含有未知参数，它不是统计量。统计量抽样前是随机变量、抽样后是数。整个数理统计的基本思路可以概括为：用统计量（及其抽样分布）去推断总体的未知特征。
nodes.definitionEn:
The whole collection of all objects of study is called the **population**, and each object in it an **individual**. In practice one studies a numerical characteristic $X$ of the objects (lifetime, height, ...), so people speak of the population $X$: both the set of all possible values and its distribution function $F(x)$. A population is finite or infinite according to whether the number of individuals is finite. Before sampling it is random who will be drawn, hence every observation is a random variable.

Drawing $n$ individuals from the population in an equal-chance way gives $X_1,\dots,X_n$. If every $X_i$ has the same distribution as $X$ and $X_1,\dots,X_n$ are **mutually independent**, they form a **simple random sample** of size $n$. The two requirements together are called independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.), written $X_i\;\text{i.i.d.}\sim F$: independence says the observations do not influence each other, identical distribution says they all come from one population — the mathematical description of random drawing. The concrete numbers $x_1,\dots,x_n$ obtained afterwards are the **sample observations**.

A function of the sample that contains no unknown parameter is called a **statistic**. For instance $X_1+\cdots+X_n$, $\bar X$ and $\max\{X_i\}$ are statistics, while $\frac{\bar X-\mu}{\sigma/\sqrt n}$ is not a statistic when $\mu,\sigma$ are unknown. A statistic is a random variable before sampling and a number afterwards. The whole of statistics can be summarised as: use statistics, and their sampling distributions, to infer unknown features of the population.

formulas.note: 样本均值：样本的重心，用来估计总体均值 μ。
formulas.noteEn: Sample mean: the centre of gravity of the data, used to estimate the population mean μ.

formulas.note: 【关键】样本方差的分母是 n−1 而不是 n，这样才有 E(S²)=σ²，是无偏估计；写成 n 就会系统性低估 σ²。
formulas.noteEn: Key point: the sample variance divides by n−1, not by n, so that E(S²)=σ² and the estimator is unbiased; dividing by n would systematically underestimate σ².

formulas.note: 无偏性：在独立同分布样本下，样本方差的期望恰好等于总体方差。
formulas.noteEn: Unbiasedness: for an i.i.d. sample the expectation of the sample variance equals the population variance.

formulas.note: 简单随机样本的独立同分布假设，F 为总体分布函数。
formulas.noteEn: The i.i.d. assumption of a simple random sample; F is the population distribution function.

formulas.note: 计算样本方差时的常用简化公式：先算平方和，再减去 nX̄²。
formulas.noteEn: A handy identity for computing the sample variance: sum of squares minus n times the squared mean.

properties: 简单随机样本要求独立同分布：各次观测互不影响，且都来自同一个总体分布。
统计量只能由样本构成，不能含任何未知参数；含未知参数的样本函数不是统计量。
样本均值 X̄ 与样本方差 S² 是最常用的两个统计量，分别刻画数据的中心位置与离散程度。
由大数定律，样本矩（如 X̄）依概率收敛到相应的总体矩，这是矩估计的根据。
样本方差分母取 n−1 才无偏；若取 n，则 E=((n−1)/n)σ²<σ²，平均总偏低。
propertiesEn: A simple random sample must be i.i.d.: the observations do not influence one another and all come from the same population distribution.
A statistic may only involve the sample and must contain no unknown parameter; a sample function containing unknown parameters is not a statistic.
The sample mean X̄ and the sample variance S² are the two most used statistics, describing centre and spread of the data.
By the law of large numbers, sample moments such as X̄ converge in probability to the corresponding population moments, which justifies the method of moments.
Dividing by n−1 makes S² unbiased; dividing by n gives expectation ((n−1)/n)σ², an average underestimate of σ².

plot.title: 样本均值的抽样分布：n 越大越集中

examples.problem: 设总体 $X\sim N(50,4^2)$，从中抽取容量 $n=16$ 的简单随机样本。求 $E(\bar X)$、$D(\bar X)$，并求 $P(\bar X>52)$。
examples.solution:
由独立同分布，$E(\bar X)=\mu=50$，$D(\bar X)=\dfrac{\sigma^2}{n}=\dfrac{16}{16}=1$，即 $\bar X\sim N(50,1)$。于是
$$P(\bar X>52)=1-\Phi(2)\approx 0.0228,$$
其中 $\Phi$ 为标准正态分布函数：样本均值超过 52 的概率约为 2.3%。

examples.problem: 对样本观测值 $2,4,4,4,5,5,7,9$ 计算样本均值 $\bar X$ 与样本方差 $S^2$。

nodes.title: 抽样分布与三大分布
nodes.summary: 统计量的分布叫抽样分布；正态总体下样本均值与样本方差分别服从正态与 χ² 分布、二者独立，并由此生成 t 与 F 分布——它们是区间估计与假设检验的概率基础。
nodes.summaryEn: The distribution of a statistic is a sampling distribution; for normal populations the sample mean and variance are normal and χ², are independent, and generate the t and F distributions — the basis of interval estimation and testing.
nodes.definition:
统计量的分布称为**抽样分布**。它一般依赖于总体分布与样本容量 $n$，是区间估计与假设检验的概率基础。正态总体下有三个由标准正态出发构造的分布最为重要，合称三大分布。

**χ² 分布**：设 $Z_1,\dots,Z_n$ 独立同服从 $N(0,1)$，则 $\chi^2=Z_1^2+\cdots+Z_n^2$ 服从自由度为 $n$ 的 χ² 分布，记作 $\chi^2(n)$。它是 $n$ 个独立标准正态变量的平方和，取值非负、分布右偏，自由度就是平方项的个数。

**t 分布**：设 $Z\sim N(0,1)$，且 $\chi^2(n)$ 与 $Z$ 独立，则 $t=\dfrac{Z}{\sqrt{\chi^2(n)/n}}$ 服从自由度为 $n$ 的 t 分布，记作 $t(n)$。它相当于把正态变量用它自己的、带随机性的尺度去标准化：关于 0 对称，峰值更低、尾部更厚，$n\to\infty$ 时趋于 $N(0,1)$。

**F 分布**：若 $\chi^2(m)$ 与 $\chi^2(n)$ 独立，则 $F=\dfrac{\chi^2(m)/m}{\chi^2(n)/n}$ 服从分子自由度 $m$、分母自由度 $n$ 的 F 分布，记作 $F(m,n)$。凡是两个方差之比的问题，都由它来处理。

**关键结论**：设 $X_1,\dots,X_n$ 是来自正态总体 $N(\mu,\sigma^2)$ 的简单随机样本，则
$$\bar X\sim N\!\left(\mu,\frac{\sigma^2}{n}\right),\qquad \frac{(n-1)S^2}{\sigma^2}\sim\chi^2(n-1),$$
并且 $\bar X$ 与 $S^2$ **相互独立**。独立性是正态总体特有的奇迹；把前两条与独立性结合起来，立即得到 $t=\dfrac{\bar X-\mu}{S/\sqrt n}\sim t(n-1)$——这正是 σ 未知时构造区间估计与检验的入口。
nodes.definitionEn:
The distribution of a statistic is called a **sampling distribution**. It generally depends on the population distribution and the sample size $n$, and it is the probabilistic foundation of interval estimation and hypothesis testing. For normal populations three distributions built from the standard normal matter most, collectively called the three great distributions.

**χ² distribution**: if $Z_1,\dots,Z_n$ are i.i.d. $N(0,1)$, then $\chi^2=Z_1^2+\cdots+Z_n^2$ has the χ² distribution with $n$ degrees of freedom, written $\chi^2(n)$: a sum of $n$ squared independent standard normal variables, non-negative and right-skewed, one degree of freedom per square.

**t distribution**: if $Z\sim N(0,1)$ and $\chi^2(n)$ is independent of $Z$, then $t=\dfrac{Z}{\sqrt{\chi^2(n)/n}}$ follows the t distribution with $n$ degrees of freedom, $t(n)$. It standardises a normal variable with its own random scale: symmetric about 0, lower peak and heavier tails than $N(0,1)$, approaching normal as $n\to\infty$.

**F distribution**: if $\chi^2(m)$ and $\chi^2(n)$ are independent, then $F=\dfrac{\chi^2(m)/m}{\chi^2(n)/n}$ follows the F distribution with numerator degrees of freedom $m$ and denominator degrees of freedom $n$, written $F(m,n)$. It is the tool for ratios of two variances.

**Key result**: let $X_1,\dots,X_n$ be a simple random sample from $N(\mu,\sigma^2)$. Then $\bar X\sim N(\mu,\sigma^2/n)$, $\dfrac{(n-1)S^2}{\sigma^2}\sim\chi^2(n-1)$, and $\bar X$ and $S^2$ are **independent** — a miracle special to the normal population. Combining these facts yields at once $t=\dfrac{\bar X-\mu}{S/\sqrt n}\sim t(n-1)$, the gateway to inference about μ when σ is unknown.

formulas.note: χ²(n) 的定义：n 个独立标准正态变量的平方和。
formulas.noteEn: Definition of χ²(n): a sum of n squared independent standard normal variables.

formulas.note: t 分布的定义，其中 Z 与 χ²(n) 相互独立。
formulas.noteEn: Definition of the t distribution, with Z and χ²(n) independent.

formulas.note: F 分布的定义：两个独立 χ² 变量各自除以自由度后相比。
formulas.noteEn: Definition of the F distribution: two independent χ² variables, each divided by its own degrees of freedom.

formulas.note: 正态总体下的两个精确分布；且 X̄ 与 S² 相互独立。
formulas.noteEn: The two exact distributions for a normal population; moreover X̄ and S² are independent.

formulas.note: 单样本 t 统计量：用样本标准差 S 代替 σ 后服从 t(n−1)。
formulas.noteEn: The one-sample t statistic: replacing σ by the sample standard deviation S gives a t(n−1) distribution.

properties: χ²(n) 的期望为 n、方差为 2n，取值非负、分布右偏。
t(n) 关于 0 对称，峰比标准正态低、尾比标准正态厚；n≥30 后与 N(0,1) 已很接近。
F(m,n) 取正值且右偏；若 F~F(m,n)，则 1/F~F(n,m)。
X̄ 与 S² 相互独立是正态总体特有的结论，对非正态总体一般不成立。
(n−1)S²/σ²~χ²(n−1) 把样本方差与总体方差联系起来，是 σ² 区间估计与检验的基础。
propertiesEn: χ²(n) has mean n and variance 2n; it is non-negative and right-skewed.
t(n) is symmetric about 0 with a lower peak and heavier tails than N(0,1); for n≥30 it is already close to normal.
F(m,n) is positive and right-skewed; if F~F(m,n) then 1/F~F(n,m).
The independence of X̄ and S² is special to normal populations and generally fails for other populations.
(n−1)S²/σ²~χ²(n−1) links the sample variance to σ² and underlies interval estimation and testing for σ².

plot.title: χ²(3)、t(3) 与标准正态的密度对比

examples.problem: 设 $X_1,\dots,X_6$ 是来自正态总体 $N(\mu,\sigma^2)$ 的样本，求 $P(S^2>2\sigma^2)$。
examples.solution:
由 $(n-1)S^2/\sigma^2\sim\chi^2(n-1)$ 得 $\dfrac{5S^2}{\sigma^2}\sim\chi^2(5)$。事件 $S^2>2\sigma^2$ 等价于
$$\frac{5S^2}{\sigma^2}>10,$$
故 $P(S^2>2\sigma^2)=P(\chi^2(5)>10)\approx 0.0752$，约为 7.5%。

examples.problem: 设总体 $N(\mu,\sigma^2)$ 的样本容量 $n=10$，写出用于推断 μ 的 t 统计量，并求其双侧 0.05 临界值。
examples.solution:
由 $\dfrac{(n-1)S^2}{\sigma^2}\sim\chi^2(9)$ 且与 $\bar X$ 独立，得
$$t=\frac{\bar X-\mu}{S/\sqrt{10}}\sim t(9).$$
双侧 0.05 临界值为 $t_{0.025}(9)\approx 2.2622$，即 $P(|t|>2.2622)=0.05$：当 $|t|$ 超过约 2.262 时，在 5% 水平下拒绝 μ=μ₀。

expression.text: X̄ ~ N(μ, σ²/n)，(n−1)S²/σ² ~ χ²(n−1)，t ~ t(n−1)
expression.note: 三个核心抽样分布（正态总体）
expression.noteEn: The three core sampling distributions (normal population)

nodes.title: 点估计：矩估计与极大似然
nodes.titleEn: Point Estimation: Method of Moments and Maximum Likelihood
nodes.summary: 用一个统计量 θ̂ 去估计未知参数 θ：矩估计用样本矩代替总体矩，极大似然估计取使样本出现可能性最大的参数；无偏性、有效性与一致性是评价估计量的三条标准。
nodes.summaryEn: Estimate an unknown parameter by a statistic: the method of moments equates sample and population moments, while maximum likelihood picks the parameter making the observed sample most likely; unbiasedness, efficiency and consistency judge the result.
nodes.definition:
用样本算出的一个统计量 $\hat\theta=\hat\theta(X_1,\dots,X_n)$ 去估计总体的未知参数 $\theta$，称为**点估计**：估计量代入观测值后得到估计值。常用的两条路线是矩估计与极大似然估计。

**矩估计**：用样本矩代替总体矩。若总体的一阶矩 $E(X)$ 含有未知参数，就令 $\bar X=E(X)$ 解出参数；一般地，有几个待估参数就列出几个矩方程（通常用前几阶原点矩），联立求解。矩估计直观、几乎总能算出显式解，但精度未必最好。

**极大似然估计**：把样本的联合密度（离散情形为分布律）看成参数 $\theta$ 的函数
$$L(\theta)=\prod_{i=1}^n f(x_i;\theta),$$
称为似然函数。哪个 $\theta$ 使「已经观测到这组样本」的可能性最大，就取哪个作为估计。由于 $\ln$ 单调递增，$\ln L$ 与 $L$ 在同一点取最大，而乘积取对数后化为求和、便于求导：写出对数似然 $\ln L(\theta)=\sum_{i=1}^n\ln f(x_i;\theta)$，令
$$\frac{d\ln L(\theta)}{d\theta}=0,$$
解出 $\hat\theta$ 即为极大似然估计（必要时再验证确为最大值点）。

评价估计量常用三条标准：**无偏性**，即 $E(\hat\theta)=\theta$，长期平均不偏高也不偏低；**有效性**，两个无偏估计中方差更小者更有效；**一致性**，$n\to\infty$ 时 $\hat\theta$ 依概率收敛到 $\theta$，数据越多估计越准。
nodes.definitionEn:
Estimating an unknown parameter $\theta$ of the population by a statistic $\hat\theta=\hat\theta(X_1,\dots,X_n)$ is called **point estimation**; substituting the observations gives a numerical estimate. Two routes dominate.

**Method of moments**: replace population moments by sample moments. If the first moment $E(X)$ involves the unknown parameter, solve $\bar X=E(X)$ for it; in general, as many moment equations (usually the first few origin moments) as there are parameters are written down and solved simultaneously. It is intuitive and almost always explicit, though not necessarily accurate.

**Maximum likelihood**: view the joint density of the sample (probability mass in the discrete case) as a function of $\theta$,
$$L(\theta)=\prod_{i=1}^n f(x_i;\theta),$$
the likelihood function, and take the value of $\theta$ that makes the observed sample most likely. Since $\ln$ is increasing, $\ln L$ and $L$ are maximised at the same point, and the logarithm turns the product into a sum that is easy to differentiate: write the log-likelihood $\ln L(\theta)=\sum_{i=1}^n\ln f(x_i;\theta)$ and solve the likelihood equation
$$\frac{d\ln L(\theta)}{d\theta}=0$$
for $\hat\theta$ (checking that it is indeed a maximum if necessary).

Three standard criteria judge an estimator: **unbiasedness**, $E(\hat\theta)=\theta$, no systematic gain or loss on average; **efficiency**, among unbiased estimators the one with smaller variance; **consistency**, $\hat\theta$ converges in probability to $\theta$ as $n\to\infty$, so more data means a better estimate.

formulas.note: 矩估计：样本 k 阶原点矩代替总体 k 阶原点矩（左边为样本矩，右边为总体矩）。
formulas.noteEn: Method of moments: the sample k-th origin moment replaces the population k-th origin moment.

formulas.note: 似然函数与对数似然：乘积取对数后化为求和。
formulas.noteEn: Likelihood and log-likelihood: taking logarithms turns the product into a sum.

formulas.note: 似然方程：求导、令零，解出极大似然估计。
formulas.noteEn: The likelihood equation: differentiate, set to zero, and solve for the maximum likelihood estimate.

formulas.note: 无偏性：估计量的期望等于被估参数。
formulas.noteEn: Unbiasedness: the expectation of the estimator equals the parameter.

formulas.note: 一致性：样本量趋于无穷时估计量依概率收敛到真值。
formulas.noteEn: Consistency: the estimator converges in probability to the true value as the sample grows.

properties: 矩估计计算简单、总能列出方程，但可能低效：如 U(0,θ) 的矩估计 2X̄ 就不如极大似然估计 max{Xᵢ}。
极大似然估计在正则条件下具有一致性、渐近正态性与渐近有效性；且若 θ̂ 是 θ 的 MLE，则 g(θ̂) 是 g(θ) 的 MLE（不变性）。
样本方差 S² 是 σ² 的无偏估计，但样本标准差 S 并不是 σ 的无偏估计。
无偏估计可能不唯一；在无偏估计中方差最小者称为最小方差无偏估计，方差达到下界者称为有效估计。
估计量是随机变量，随样本而变；对一个具体样本算出的是估计值，评价优劣要看估计量的分布。
propertiesEn: Moment estimation is simple and always yields equations, but can be inefficient: for U(0,θ) the moment estimator 2X̄ is worse than the MLE max{Xᵢ}.
Under regularity conditions the MLE is consistent, asymptotically normal and asymptotically efficient; moreover g(θ̂) is the MLE of g(θ) (invariance).
The sample variance S² is unbiased for σ², but the sample standard deviation S is not unbiased for σ.
Unbiased estimators need not be unique; the one with the smallest variance is the minimum-variance unbiased estimator.
An estimator is a random variable changing with the sample; one sample gives one estimate, and quality is judged from the estimator's distribution.

examples.problem: 设总体 $X$ 的密度为 $f(x;\lambda)=\lambda e^{-\lambda x}\ (x>0)$，样本观测值为 $0.5,\ 0.9,\ 1.6,\ 2.0,\ 1.0$。求 λ 的矩估计与极大似然估计。
examples.solution:
总体均值 $E(X)=\dfrac{1}{\lambda}$。**矩估计**：令 $\frac{1}{\lambda}=\bar X$，得 $\hat\lambda=\dfrac{1}{\bar X}$。
**极大似然**：$L(\lambda)=\lambda^5 e^{-\lambda\sum x_i}$，$\ln L=5\ln\lambda-\lambda\sum x_i$，令
$$\frac{5}{\lambda}-\sum_{i=1}^{5}x_i=0\ \Longrightarrow\ \hat\lambda=\frac{5}{\sum x_i}.$$
两种方法给出同一结果。代入数据 $\sum x_i=6.0$，$\bar X=1.2$，得 $\hat\lambda=\dfrac{5}{6}\approx 0.833$。

examples.problem: 设总体 $X\sim U(0,\theta)$，样本观测值为 $0.3,\ 1.2,\ 0.7,\ 2.4,\ 1.9$，分别求 θ 的矩估计与极大似然估计。
examples.solution:
$E(X)=\dfrac{\theta}{2}$，矩估计为 $\hat\theta=2\bar X=2\times 1.3=2.6$。
极大似然函数为 $L(\theta)=\theta^{-5}$（当 $\theta\ge\max x_i$ 时），随 θ 增大而减小，故
$$\hat\theta_{\text{MLE}}=\max_i\{x_i\}=2.4.$$
两个估计值不同：矩估计只看均值，而 MLE 直接盯住「上界必须不小于样本最大值」这一点，通常更贴近 θ 的真实含义。

expression.text: θ̂ = θ̂(X₁,…,Xₙ)（不含未知参数的样本函数）
expression.note: 点估计量：随机变量；代入样本后得估计值
expression.noteEn: A point estimator is a statistic; a numerical estimate follows after substituting the sample

nodes.title: 区间估计与置信区间
nodes.summary: 置信区间给出一个随机区间，使未知参数以概率 1−α 被覆盖：σ 已知时用 z 分位数，σ 未知时用 t 分位数，区间长度正比于 1/√n。
nodes.summaryEn: A confidence interval is a random interval that covers the unknown parameter with probability 1−α: use z quantiles when σ is known, t quantiles when σ is unknown; the length is proportional to 1/√n.
nodes.definition:
点估计只给出一个数，却没有交代它离真值有多远。**区间估计**改为给出一个区间 $[\hat\theta_L,\hat\theta_U]$：反复抽样时，约有 $100(1-\alpha)\%$ 的区间能把未知参数 $\theta$ 罩住；这样构造的区间称为置信水平为 $1-\alpha$ 的**置信区间**，$\alpha$ 通常取 0.05 或 0.01。

构造一般用**枢轴量法**：找一个既含 $\theta$ 又含样本、但分布与 $\theta$ 无关的量（称枢轴量），例如当 σ 已知时 $Z=\dfrac{\bar X-\mu}{\sigma/\sqrt n}\sim N(0,1)$。在分布的两侧各留 $\alpha/2$ 的尾巴，
$$P\left(-z_{\alpha/2}\le\frac{\bar X-\mu}{\sigma/\sqrt n}\le z_{\alpha/2}\right)=1-\alpha,$$
再把中间的 $\mu$ 反解出来，就得到置信区间 $[\bar X-z_{\alpha/2}\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt n},\ \bar X+z_{\alpha/2}\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt n}]$。

关键抉择：σ 已知时用标准正态分位数 $z_{\alpha/2}$；σ 未知时把 σ 换成样本标准差 $S$，分布也随之从 $N(0,1)$ 变成 $t(n-1)$，必须改用 $t_{\alpha/2}(n-1)$。t 分位数比 z 分位数大一点，反映「σ 也要靠样本来估计」所付出的代价。区间宽度正比于 $\dfrac{1}{\sqrt n}$：样本量翻两番，区间才缩一半——精度是用样本量买来的。
nodes.definitionEn:
A point estimate gives one number but says nothing about how far it lies from the truth. **Interval estimation** instead produces an interval $[\hat\theta_L,\hat\theta_U]$; over repeated sampling about $100(1-\alpha)\%$ of such intervals cover the unknown parameter $\theta$. The resulting interval is a **confidence interval** with confidence level $1-\alpha$, with $\alpha$ usually 0.05 or 0.01.

The standard construction uses a **pivotal quantity**: a function of $\theta$ and the sample whose distribution does not depend on $\theta$, for example $Z=\dfrac{\bar X-\mu}{\sigma/\sqrt n}\sim N(0,1)$ when σ is known. Leaving a tail of $\alpha/2$ on each side gives
$$P\left(-z_{\alpha/2}\le\frac{\bar X-\mu}{\sigma/\sqrt n}\le z_{\alpha/2}\right)=1-\alpha,$$
and solving the inequalities for $\mu$ yields the interval $[\bar X-z_{\alpha/2}\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt n},\ \bar X+z_{\alpha/2}\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt n}]$.

The decisive choice: when σ is known use the normal quantile $z_{\alpha/2}$; when σ is unknown replace it by the sample standard deviation $S$, which changes the distribution from $N(0,1)$ to $t(n-1)$, so $t_{\alpha/2}(n-1)$ must be used. The t quantile is a little larger than the z quantile — the price of estimating σ as well. The width is proportional to $\dfrac{1}{\sqrt n}$: quadrupling the sample size only halves the interval; precision is bought with data.

formulas.note: σ 已知时 μ 的置信区间（z 分位数，标准正态法）。
formulas.noteEn: Confidence interval for μ when σ is known (normal quantiles).

formulas.note: σ 未知时 μ 的置信区间（t 分位数，用样本标准差 S）。
formulas.noteEn: Confidence interval for μ when σ is unknown (t quantiles, using the sample standard deviation S).

formulas.note: 置信水平 1−α 的含义：反复抽样时约 100(1−α)% 的区间覆盖 θ。
formulas.noteEn: Meaning of level 1−α: over repeated sampling about 100(1−α)% of the intervals cover θ.

formulas.note: 方差 σ² 的置信区间，由 (n−1)S²/σ²~χ²(n−1) 反解得到。
formulas.noteEn: Confidence interval for σ², obtained by inverting (n−1)S²/σ²~χ²(n−1).

formulas.note: 大样本下比例 p 的置信区间（p̂ 为样本比例）。
formulas.noteEn: Large-sample confidence interval for a proportion p, with p̂ the sample proportion.

properties: 区间一旦算出，它要么包含 θ 要么不包含，不能再谈概率；1−α 描述的是构造方法的长期成功率。
同样的样本下，置信水平越高区间越宽：越可靠就越不精确。
σ 未知而用 S 代替时必须改用 t 分位数；n 较大时 t 与 z 分位数接近，可用 z 近似。
区间长度正比于 1/√n：n 增大 4 倍区间缩窄一半，也可由精度要求反推所需样本量。
与假设检验对偶：1−α 置信区间不包含 μ₀，等价于水平 α 的双侧检验拒绝 H₀: μ=μ₀。
propertiesEn: Once a concrete interval is computed it either covers θ or not; 1−α describes the long-run success rate of the method.
For the same sample, a higher confidence level gives a wider interval: reliability and precision trade off.
When σ is unknown and replaced by S one must use t quantiles; for large n they are close to z quantiles.
The length is proportional to 1/√n; quadrupling n halves the interval, and a target precision determines the required sample size.
Duality with testing: a 1−α interval excludes μ₀ exactly when the level-α two-sided test rejects H₀: μ=μ₀.

plot.title: 95% 置信区间与点估计

examples.problem: 某药片有效成分含量 $X\sim N(\mu,\sigma^2)$，σ 未知。抽取 $n=16$ 片测得 $\bar x=10.0$ mg，$s=0.8$ mg，求 μ 的 95% 置信区间。
若由长期生产记录已知 $\sigma=0.8$ mg，抽取 $n=25$ 片测得 $\bar x=10.2$ mg，求 μ 的 95% 置信区间。

expression.note: σ 未知时总体均值 μ 的双侧置信区间
expression.noteEn: Two-sided confidence interval for μ when σ is unknown

nodes.title: 假设检验
nodes.summary: 先立原假设 H₀ 与备择假设 H₁，再用样本决定是否拒绝 H₀：第一类错误是「弃真」（概率 α），第二类错误是「取伪」；p 值是在 H₀ 下出现当前或更极端结果的概率。
nodes.summaryEn: Set a null hypothesis H₀ against an alternative H₁, then let the sample decide about rejecting H₀: a type I error rejects a true H₀ (probability α), a type II error keeps a false H₀; the p-value is the probability, under H₀, of a result at least as extreme.
nodes.definition:
**假设检验**先对总体的分布或参数提出一个假设，再用样本判断这个假设是否与数据矛盾。通常把需要保护的、想否定的命题作为**原假设** $H_0$（如「新药无效」），把与之对立的命题作为**备择假设** $H_1$（如「新药有效」）；证据足够强就拒绝 $H_0$，否则只能说不拒绝 $H_0$。

做判断可能犯两类错误：$H_0$ 实际为真却把它拒绝，叫**第一类错误**（弃真），概率记为 $\alpha$；$H_0$ 实际为假却没有拒绝它，叫**第二类错误**（取伪），概率记为 $\beta$。人们通常先限定 $\alpha$ 不超过某个小值（如 0.05），再在这一类检验中寻找使 $\beta$ 尽量小的方案。只控制第一类错误的检验称为**显著性检验**，$\alpha$ 称为**显著性水平**。

具体做法是选一个在 $H_0$ 下分布已知的**检验统计量**（如 z、t、χ²、F），把样本空间划分为**拒绝域** $W$ 与接受域：统计量落入 $W$ 就拒绝 $H_0$。等价地可以计算 **p 值**——在 $H_0$ 成立的前提下，出现「与当前样本同样极端或更极端」结果的概率：p 值越小，数据与 $H_0$ 越不相容，$p\le\alpha$ 时拒绝 $H_0$。注意 p 值不是「$H_0$ 为真的概率」，它是用样本算出的一个统计量。
nodes.definitionEn:
**Hypothesis testing** starts from a statement about the population distribution or its parameters and lets the sample decide whether that statement conflicts with the data. The claim to be protected and possibly rejected is the **null hypothesis** $H_0$ (for example, the new drug is ineffective); the opposite claim is the **alternative** $H_1$. If the evidence is strong enough, $H_0$ is rejected; otherwise one merely fails to reject it.

Two kinds of mistakes are possible: rejecting a true $H_0$ is a **type I error** (probability $\alpha$), and failing to reject a false $H_0$ is a **type II error** (probability $\beta$). Usually one first bounds $\alpha$ by a small value such as 0.05 and then, among such tests, seeks one with small $\beta$. A test controlling only the type I error is a **significance test**, and $\alpha$ is the **significance level**.

Concretely, choose a **test statistic** whose distribution under $H_0$ is known (z, t, χ², F), and split the sample space into a **rejection region** $W$ and an acceptance region: reject $H_0$ if the statistic falls in $W$. Equivalently, compute the **p-value** — the probability, assuming $H_0$ is true, of a result at least as extreme as the observed sample. The smaller the p-value, the less compatible the data are with $H_0$; reject when $p\le\alpha$. The p-value is computed from the sample and is not the probability that $H_0$ is true.

formulas.note: 双侧检验的原假设与备择假设；单侧检验的 H₁ 改为 μ>μ₀ 或 μ<μ₀。
formulas.noteEn: Null and alternative hypotheses of a two-sided test; for a one-sided test H₁ becomes μ>μ₀ or μ<μ₀.

formulas.note: σ 已知时的检验统计量：z 统计量。
formulas.noteEn: Test statistic when σ is known: the z statistic.

formulas.note: σ 未知时的检验统计量：t 统计量。
formulas.noteEn: Test statistic when σ is unknown: the t statistic.

formulas.note: 双侧检验的拒绝域：统计量落入两尾时拒绝 H₀（α 平分到两侧）。
formulas.noteEn: Rejection region of a two-sided test: reject H₀ when the statistic falls in either tail (α split equally).

formulas.note: 双侧 z 检验的 p 值；一般地 p 值是在 H₀ 下出现当前或更极端结果的概率，p≤α 时拒绝 H₀。
formulas.noteEn: p-value of a two-sided z test; in general the p-value is the probability under H₀ of a result at least as extreme, and one rejects when p≤α.

properties: 样本量固定时，第一类错误 α 与第二类错误 β 不能同时减小；要同时降低只能增大样本量。
不拒绝 H₀ 只说明证据不足，不等于 H₀ 为真；拒绝 H₀ 说明结果在统计上显著。
双侧检验把 α 平分到两尾；单侧检验把 α 全部放在一侧，取哪种由备择假设的方向决定。
检验与置信区间对偶：水平 1−α 的置信区间包含 μ₀，等价于双侧检验不拒绝 H₀: μ=μ₀。
p 值由样本算出、与预先选定的 α 无关，但通常仍与 α 比较来下结论；p 值越小，反对 H₀ 的证据越强。
propertiesEn: With a fixed sample size the type I error α and type II error β cannot both decrease; only a larger sample reduces both.
Failing to reject H₀ means insufficient evidence, not that H₀ is true; rejecting H₀ means the result is statistically significant.
A two-sided test splits α between the two tails; a one-sided test puts all of α on one side, chosen according to H₁.
Testing and confidence intervals are dual: the level-1−α interval contains μ₀ iff the two-sided test does not reject H₀: μ=μ₀.
The p-value is computed from the sample and is independent of a pre-chosen α, although it is usually compared with α; the smaller it is, the stronger the evidence against H₀.

plot.title: 双侧检验：两尾各 α/2 为拒绝域

examples.problem: 某包装机标称每袋装 500 g。抽查 $n=16$ 袋（设装袋量服从正态分布），测得 $\bar x=502.3$ g，$s=4.0$ g。取显著性水平 α=0.05，检验装袋量是否正常。
同一台机器，若已知 $\sigma=5$ g，抽查 $n=25$ 袋得 $\bar x=501.4$ g。取 α=0.05，检验 $H_0:\mu=500$。
examples.solution:
σ 已知，用 z 统计量：
$$z=\frac{501.4-500}{5/\sqrt{25}}=1.4.$$
双侧临界值 $z_{0.025}=1.96$，因 $|z|=1.4<1.96$，不拒绝 $H_0$：这一次的偏差还在随机波动可以解释的范围内。p 值 $=2(1-\Phi(1.4))\approx 0.1615$，远大于 0.05。两个小题说明：同样的检验思路，样本量与噪声大小不同，结论可能完全不同。

expression.text: |t| > t_{α/2}(n−1) 时拒绝 H₀
expression.note: 双侧 t 检验的拒绝规则（α 平分两尾）
expression.noteEn: Rejection rule of the two-sided t test (α split between the tails)

nodes.title: 卡方检验与方差分析
nodes.titleEn: Chi-Square Tests and Analysis of Variance
nodes.summary: 卡方检验比较观测频数与理论频数，自由度 k−1−r；方差分析把总平方和分解为 SST=SSA+SSE，用 F=(SSA/(k−1))/(SSE/(n−k)) 检验多组均值是否相等。
nodes.summaryEn: The χ² test compares observed with expected frequencies (degrees of freedom k−1−r), while analysis of variance splits SST=SSA+SSE and uses F=(SSA/(k−1))/(SSE/(n−k)) to compare several group means.
nodes.definition:
**卡方检验**处理分类数据。以拟合优度检验为例：把数据分成 $k$ 类，第 $i$ 类实际出现 $O_i$ 次，按 $H_0$ 指定的分布算出理论频数 $E_i$，则统计量
$$\chi^2=\sum_{i=1}^{k}\frac{(O_i-E_i)^2}{E_i}$$
在 $H_0$ 成立时近似服从 $\chi^2(k-1-r)$，其中 $r$ 是用样本估计的参数个数——每估计一个参数就多消耗一个自由度。$O_i$ 与 $E_i$ 相差越大，$\chi^2$ 越大，越倾向于拒绝 $H_0$。列联表的独立性检验完全类似，自由度换成 $(r-1)(c-1)$。

**方差分析**（ANOVA）用来同时比较多个正态总体的均值。设 $k$ 组、共 $n$ 个观测，把总离差平方和分解为组间与组内两部分：
$$SST=SSA+SSE,\qquad n-1=(k-1)+(n-k),$$
$SSA$ 度量各组均值之间的差异，$SSE$ 度量同组内部的随机波动。若各组均值相等，两者之比不应太大，于是构造
$$F=\frac{SSA/(k-1)}{SSE/(n-k)}\sim F(k-1,\ n-k),$$
做单侧（右侧）检验：$F$ 超过临界值 $F_\alpha(k-1,n-k)$ 就拒绝「各组均值全相等」。方差分析要求各组相互独立、来自正态总体且方差相同。
nodes.definitionEn:
The **χ² test** deals with categorical data. For a goodness-of-fit test, data fall into $k$ classes, class $i$ is observed $O_i$ times, and the expected frequency $E_i$ is computed from the distribution specified by $H_0$. Then
$$\chi^2=\sum_{i=1}^{k}\frac{(O_i-E_i)^2}{E_i}$$
is approximately $\chi^2(k-1-r)$ under $H_0$, where $r$ is the number of parameters estimated from the sample — each estimated parameter costs one degree of freedom. The larger the gaps between $O_i$ and $E_i$, the larger $\chi^2$ and the stronger the evidence against $H_0$. Tests of independence in a contingency table work the same way with $(r-1)(c-1)$ degrees of freedom.

**Analysis of variance** (ANOVA) compares several normal population means at once. With $k$ groups and $n$ observations in total, the total sum of squares splits into a between-group and a within-group part,
$$SST=SSA+SSE,\qquad n-1=(k-1)+(n-k),$$
where $SSA$ measures differences among group means and $SSE$ the random variation inside groups. If all means were equal this ratio should not be large, so one forms
$$F=\frac{SSA/(k-1)}{SSE/(n-k)}\sim F(k-1,\ n-k)$$
and applies a one-sided (right-tail) test: reject equal means when $F$ exceeds $F_\alpha(k-1,n-k)$. ANOVA assumes independent groups, normal populations and equal variances.

formulas.note: 拟合优度检验统计量：观测频数 Oᵢ 与理论频数 Eᵢ 的相对偏差平方和。
formulas.noteEn: Goodness-of-fit statistic: the sum of squared relative deviations of observed from expected frequencies.

formulas.note: 拟合优度检验的自由度；r 为用样本估计的参数个数，分布完全已知时 r=0。
formulas.noteEn: Degrees of freedom of the goodness-of-fit test; r is the number of estimated parameters (r=0 if the distribution is fully specified).

formulas.note: 总平方和分解为组间平方和与组内平方和，自由度同步分解。
formulas.noteEn: The total sum of squares splits into between-group and within-group parts, and so do the degrees of freedom.

formulas.note: 组间平方和与组内平方和的定义（nᵢ 为第 i 组样本量）。
formulas.noteEn: Definitions of the between-group and within-group sums of squares (nᵢ is the size of group i).

formulas.note: 单因素方差分析的检验统计量，单侧（右侧）检验。
formulas.noteEn: Test statistic of one-way ANOVA, used as a one-sided (right-tail) test.

properties: 拟合优度检验通常要求每类理论频数不小于 5，否则应合并类别或改用精确方法。
χ² 统计量非负，检验是单侧的：只看右侧尾部，偏差越大统计量越大。
方差分析显著只说明至少有一组均值与其它组不同，还需事后多重比较才能找出是哪一组。
两组均值比较时，方差分析等价于双侧 t 检验，且 F=t²。
方差分析要求各组独立、正态、等方差；条件不满足时结论可能失真。
propertiesEn: A goodness-of-fit test generally requires expected frequencies of at least about 5 per class; otherwise merge classes.
The χ² statistic is non-negative and the test is one-sided: only the right tail matters, larger deviations giving larger values.
A significant F only means at least one group mean differs; post-hoc multiple comparisons are needed to locate it.
For two groups ANOVA is equivalent to the two-sided t test, with F=t².
ANOVA assumes independent groups, normal populations and equal variances; violations can invalidate the conclusions.

examples.problem: 掷一颗骰子 120 次，六个面出现的次数依次为 $20,18,22,15,25,20$。取 α=0.05，检验骰子是否均匀。
用三种饲料喂养 12 头猪（每组 4 头），增重（kg）为：甲 $4,5,6,5$；乙 $7,8,9,8$；丙 $6,7,8,7$。取 α=0.05 用单因素方差分析检验三种饲料效果是否相同。

plot.title: χ² 分布密度：自由度 k = 2、4、8，k 越大峰值越靠右、曲线越平缓

nodes.title: 回归分析
nodes.summary: 一元线性回归用最小二乘拟合 ŷ=â+b̂x，其中 b̂=Sxy/Sxx、â=ȳ−b̂x̄；决定系数 R²=SSR/SST 度量直线对数据的拟合优度。
nodes.summaryEn: Simple linear regression fits ŷ=â+b̂x by least squares with b̂=Sxy/Sxx and â=ȳ−b̂x̄; the coefficient of determination R²=SSR/SST measures how well the line fits.
nodes.definition:
研究两个变量的依赖关系时，把其中一个当作自变量 $x$、另一个当作因变量 $Y$。**一元线性回归**假设
$$E(Y\mid x)=a+bx,$$
即平均而言 $Y$ 随 $x$ 线性变化，$a$、$b$ 是待估参数；斜率 $b$ 的含义是 $x$ 每增加 1 个单位，$Y$ 平均改变 $b$ 个单位。实际观测值一般不会严格落在直线上，还叠加着随机误差 $\varepsilon_i$；完整的回归模型为 $Y_i=a+bx_i+\varepsilon_i$，其中 $\varepsilon_i$ 相互独立且同服从 $N(0,\sigma^2)$（下文检验斜率的 $t$ 统计量正依赖这一正态性假设）。

**最小二乘**准则：选择 $\hat a,\hat b$ 使残差平方和 $\sum(y_i-\hat a-\hat bx_i)^2$ 最小。对两个参数求偏导并令其为零，可得
$$\hat b=\frac{S_{xy}}{S_{xx}}=\frac{\sum(x_i-\bar x)(y_i-\bar y)}{\sum(x_i-\bar x)^2},\qquad \hat a=\bar y-\hat b\,\bar x,$$
称 $\hat y=\hat a+\hat bx$ 为**经验回归直线**。第二式说明直线必过样本重心 $(\bar x,\bar y)$；第一式表明斜率等于 $x,y$ 的协变动与 $x$ 自身变动之比（要求 $S_{xx}>0$，即 $x$ 有变异）。

拟合优度用**决定系数**
$$R^2=\frac{SSR}{SST}=\frac{\sum(\hat y_i-\bar y)^2}{\sum(y_i-\bar y)^2},$$
它是回归平方和占总平方和的比例，满足 $0\le R^2\le 1$：点越贴近直线，$R^2$ 越接近 1。回归直线是否有统计意义，还要检验斜率 $H_0:b=0$，统计量 $t=\hat b/S_{\hat b}\sim t(n-2)$，其中 $S_{\hat b}=\hat\sigma/\sqrt{S_{xx}}$，$\hat\sigma^2=SSE/(n-2)$。
nodes.definitionEn:
When studying how two variables depend on each other, call one the predictor $x$ and the other the response $Y$. **Simple linear regression** assumes
$$E(Y\mid x)=a+bx,$$
so that on average $Y$ changes linearly with $x$; $a$ and $b$ are parameters, and the slope $b$ says by how much $Y$ changes on average when $x$ increases by one unit. Actual observations scatter around the line with random error.

The **least squares** principle chooses $\hat a,\hat b$ minimising the residual sum of squares $\sum(y_i-\hat a-\hat bx_i)^2$. Setting the two partial derivatives to zero yields
$$\hat b=\frac{S_{xy}}{S_{xx}}=\frac{\sum(x_i-\bar x)(y_i-\bar y)}{\sum(x_i-\bar x)^2},\qquad \hat a=\bar y-\hat b\,\bar x,$$
and $\hat y=\hat a+\hat bx$ is the **fitted regression line**. The second equation says the line always passes through the sample centroid $(\bar x,\bar y)$; the first says the slope is the joint variation of $x$ and $y$ divided by the variation of $x$ (so $S_{xx}>0$ requires variation in the predictor).

Goodness of fit is measured by the **coefficient of determination**
$$R^2=\frac{SSR}{SST}=\frac{\sum(\hat y_i-\bar y)^2}{\sum(y_i-\bar y)^2},$$
the fraction of the total variation explained by the regression, with $0\le R^2\le 1$: the closer the points lie to the line, the closer $R^2$ is to 1. Whether the line is statistically meaningful is checked by testing $H_0:b=0$ with $t=\hat b/S_{\hat b}\sim t(n-2)$, where $S_{\hat b}=\hat\sigma/\sqrt{S_{xx}}$ and $\hat\sigma^2=SSE/(n-2)$.

formulas.note: 最小二乘斜率：协变动 Sxy 除以自变量变动 Sxx。
formulas.noteEn: Least-squares slope: the joint variation Sxy divided by the variation Sxx of the predictor.

formulas.note: 截距公式；回归直线必过样本重心 (x̄, ȳ)。
formulas.noteEn: The intercept formula; the fitted line always passes through the centroid (x̄, ȳ).

formulas.note: 决定系数，取值 0≤R²≤1，越接近 1 线性拟合越好。
formulas.noteEn: Coefficient of determination, 0≤R²≤1: the closer to 1, the better the linear fit.

formulas.note: 残差方差的无偏估计；估计了两个参数 a、b，故分母为 n−2。
formulas.noteEn: Unbiased estimate of the error variance; two parameters a and b were estimated, hence n−2.

formulas.note: 斜率显著性检验：H₀: b=0，用 t(n−2) 分布。
formulas.noteEn: Significance test of the slope: H₀: b=0, using the t(n−2) distribution.

properties: 最小二乘残差之和为零，回归直线必过样本重心 (x̄, ȳ)。
斜率与相关系数满足 b̂ = r·s_y/s_x，两者符号相同：回归方向与相关方向一致。
R² 大只说明线性拟合好，不代表因果关系；非线性关系也可能给出较大的 R²。
Sxx>0 要求 x 有变异；若所有 x 相同，回归直线不唯一、斜率无定义。
预测宜在观测过的 x 范围内内插，向数据范围之外外推风险很大。
propertiesEn: The least-squares residuals sum to zero and the fitted line always passes through the sample centroid (x̄, ȳ).
The slope and the correlation coefficient satisfy b̂ = r·s_y/s_x, so they share the same sign.
A large R² means a good linear fit, not causation; even a strongly nonlinear relation can give a large R².
Sxx>0 requires variation in x; if all x are equal the line is not unique and the slope is undefined.
Predictions are safe mainly inside the observed range of x; extrapolation is risky.

plot.title: 散点与最小二乘回归直线

examples.solution:
$\bar x=3.5$，$\bar y=\dfrac{25.9}{6}\approx 4.3167$，$\sum(x_i-\bar x)^2=17.5$，$\sum(x_i-\bar x)(y_i-\bar y)=15.75$，于是
$$\hat b=\frac{15.75}{17.5}=0.9,\qquad \hat a=\bar y-\hat b\bar x=4.3167-0.9\times 3.5=1.1667,$$
经验回归直线为 $\hat y=1.1667+0.9x$（投入每增加 1 万元，销售额平均增加 0.9 万元）。回归平方和 $SSR=\sum(\hat y_i-\bar y)^2=14.175$，总平方和 $SST=\sum(y_i-\bar y)^2\approx 14.388$，故
$$R^2=\frac{SSR}{SST}=\frac{14.175}{14.388}\approx 0.985.$$
约有 98.5% 的销售额变异可由投入的线性关系解释。

expression.noteEn: Least-squares regression line computed from the six data points

nodes.title: 偏微分方程的基本概念
nodes.titleEn: Basic Concepts of Partial Differential Equations
nodes.summary: 含有未知多元函数及其偏导数的方程；分清方程的阶、线性性与齐次性，理解「通解含任意函数」与「定解条件」的含义。
nodes.summaryEn: Equations involving an unknown function of several variables and its partial derivatives; the ideas of order, linearity, homogeneity, arbitrary functions in general solutions, and initial/boundary data.
nodes.definition:
**偏微分方程**（partial differential equation，简称 PDE）是含有未知多元函数及其偏导数的方程。例如 $u_t=a^{2}u_{xx}$ 中的未知函数 $u(x,t)$ 依赖两个自变量，方程里同时出现对 $t$ 与对 $x$ 的导数——这正是它区别于常微分方程（ODE）的地方：ODE 的未知函数只依赖一个自变量。弦振动、温度扩散、静电场等大量物理问题都由 PDE 描述。

**阶**：方程中出现的最高阶偏导数的阶数就是方程的阶。$u_x+u_y=0$ 是一阶方程，$u_t=a^{2}u_{xx}$ 与 $u_{xx}+u_{yy}=0$ 都是二阶方程。**线性性**按未知函数及其导数出现的方式划分：未知函数与各阶偏导数都以一次方出现、系数只依赖自变量的是**线性**方程；最高阶偏导线性出现、系数只依赖自变量而低阶项可以非线性依赖 $u$ 的是**半线性**方程；最高阶偏导线性出现、但系数还依赖 $u$ 与低阶导数的是**拟线性**方程；最高阶偏导本身非线性的是**完全非线性**方程。右端为零（$L[u]=0$）时称方程**齐次**，右端非零（$L[u]=f$）时称**非齐次**。

PDE 的通解里含**任意函数**，而不是像 ODE 那样只含任意常数。例如 $u_{xy}=0$ 的通解是 $u=f(x)+g(y)$，其中 $f,g$ 是任意二次可微函数。要从通解中挑出确定的解，必须补充**定解条件**：对时间变量的**初始条件**（如 $u(x,0)=\varphi(x)$、$u_t(x,0)=\psi(x)$）与对空间区域边界 $\partial\Omega$ 的**边界条件**。

边界条件主要有三类：**Dirichlet 条件**直接给出边界上的函数值；**Neumann 条件**给出边界上的法向导数；**Robin 条件**给出法向导数与函数值的线性组合。初始条件与边界条件给得恰当，问题才是**适定**的（解存在、唯一、且连续依赖给定数据），这是应用中最关心的性质。
nodes.definitionEn:
The **partial differential equation** (PDE) is an equation involving an unknown function of several variables and its partial derivatives. In $u_t=a^{2}u_{xx}$ the unknown $u(x,t)$ depends on two independent variables, and derivatives with respect to both appear — this is what distinguishes PDEs from ODEs, whose unknown depends on a single variable. Vibrating strings, heat diffusion and electrostatic fields are all modelled by PDEs.

**Order**: the order of the highest partial derivative appearing in the equation. So $u_x+u_y=0$ is first order, while $u_t=a^{2}u_{xx}$ and $u_{xx}+u_{yy}=0$ are second order. **Linearity** is classified by how the unknown and its derivatives enter: a **linear** equation has $u$ and all its derivatives to the first power with coefficients depending only on the independent variables; a **semilinear** equation is linear in the highest derivatives with coefficients depending only on the independent variables, while lower-order terms may depend nonlinearly on $u$; a **quasilinear** equation is linear in the highest derivatives but their coefficients may depend on $u$ and lower derivatives; a **fully nonlinear** equation is nonlinear in the highest derivatives. If the right-hand side is zero ($L[u]=0$) the equation is **homogeneous**; otherwise it is **nonhomogeneous**.

The general solution of a PDE contains **arbitrary functions**, not merely arbitrary constants as in the ODE case. For instance $u_{xy}=0$ has the general solution $u=f(x)+g(y)$ with arbitrary twice differentiable $f$ and $g$. To single out one solution one has to add **conditions**: an **initial condition** in the time variable (e.g. $u(x,0)=\varphi(x)$, $u_t(x,0)=\psi(x)$) and **boundary conditions** on the boundary $\partial\Omega$ of the spatial region.

There are three standard boundary conditions: a **Dirichlet condition** prescribes the values of $u$ on the boundary; a **Neumann condition** prescribes the normal derivative; a **Robin condition** prescribes a linear combination of the normal derivative and the values of $u$. When the data are assigned appropriately the problem is **well posed** (existence, uniqueness and continuous dependence on the data), which is what applications require.

formulas.note: 偏微分方程的一般形式：未知函数 $u$ 与它的各阶偏导数满足的等式。
formulas.noteEn: General form of a PDE: an identity satisfied by the unknown function $u$ and its partial derivatives.

formulas.note: 方程的阶＝最高阶偏导数的阶数；与方程里出现多少个自变量、多少个导数项无关。
formulas.noteEn: The order equals the order of the highest partial derivative, regardless of how many independent variables or derivative terms appear.

formulas.note: 二阶线性方程的标准写法；$f\equiv 0$ 时齐次，$f\not\equiv 0$ 时非齐次。交叉项系数习惯写成 $2B$，这样下一节的判别式 $\Delta=B^{2}-AC$ 才取到对称形式。
formulas.noteEn: Standard form of a second-order linear equation: homogeneous when $f\equiv 0$, nonhomogeneous otherwise. Writing the cross term as $2B$ makes the discriminant $\Delta=B^{2}-AC$ symmetric.

formulas.note: 通解含任意函数：$u_{xy}=0$ 的通解由两个任意函数相加而成，任意常数只是它的特例。
formulas.noteEn: Arbitrary functions in general solutions: $u_{xy}=0$ is solved by a sum of two arbitrary functions, and arbitrary constants are only a special case.

formulas.latex: u\big|_{\partial\Omega}=g_1,\qquad \frac{\partial u}{\partial n}\Big|_{\partial\Omega}=g_2,\qquad \left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial n}+\sigma u\right)\Big|_{\partial\Omega}=g_3
formulas.note: 三类边界条件：Dirichlet（给边界上的函数值）、Neumann（给法向导数）、Robin（给法向导数与函数值的线性组合，$\sigma$ 为常数），$g_1,g_2,g_3$ 是已知数据；初始条件则形如 $u(x,0)=\varphi(x)$。
formulas.noteEn: Three boundary conditions: Dirichlet (values of $u$ on the boundary), Neumann (normal derivative) and Robin (a linear combination with a constant $\sigma$); $g_1,g_2,g_3$ are given data. An initial condition has the form $u(x,0)=\varphi(x)$.

properties: **阶与线性性**：$u_x+u_y=0$ 一阶线性，$u_t=a^{2}u_{xx}$ 二阶线性，$x\,u_{xx}=u_y$ 二阶线性但系数依赖自变量——阶只看最高阶偏导，线性看 $u$ 与其各阶导数是否一次出现。
**叠加原理**：线性齐次方程任意解的线性组合仍是解；非齐次方程的通解＝一个特解＋对应齐次方程的通解。
**通解含任意函数**：如 $u_{xy}=0$ 的通解 $u=f(x)+g(y)$；只有补充足够的定解条件，通解中的任意函数才能被确定。
**非线性方程的例子**：$u_t+u\,u_x=0$ 拟线性，$u_{xx}+u_{yy}=u^{3}$ 半线性，$u_{xx}u_{yy}-u_{xy}^{2}=0$ 完全非线性。
**适定性**（Hadamard）：定解条件＝初始条件＋边界条件；条件不足解不唯一，条件过多一般无解，适定即存在、唯一、稳定。
propertiesEn: **Order and linearity**: $u_x+u_y=0$ is first-order linear, $u_t=a^{2}u_{xx}$ is second-order linear, and $x\,u_{xx}=u_y$ is second-order linear with variable coefficients — order looks at the highest derivative, linearity at whether $u$ and its derivatives appear to the first power.

**Superposition**: any linear combination of solutions of a linear homogeneous equation is again a solution; for a nonhomogeneous equation the general solution is one particular solution plus the general solution of the associated homogeneous equation.
**Arbitrary functions**: the general solution of $u_{xy}=0$ is $u=f(x)+g(y)$; the arbitrary functions are pinned down only after enough conditions are imposed.
**Nonlinear examples**: $u_t+u\,u_x=0$ is quasilinear, $u_{xx}+u_{yy}=u^{3}$ is semilinear, and $u_{xx}u_{yy}-u_{xy}^{2}=0$ is fully nonlinear.

**Well posedness** (Hadamard): conditions consist of initial data plus boundary data; too few conditions leave the solution undetermined and too many usually make the problem unsolvable. Well posed means existence, uniqueness and stability.

examples.problem: 指出方程 $u_t+u\,u_x=0$ 与 $u_{xx}+u_{yy}=0$ 的阶、齐次性，并判断它们属于线性、半线性、拟线性还是完全非线性。
examples.solution: $u_t+u\,u_x=0$：最高阶偏导是一阶，故为一阶方程；右端为 $0$，是齐次方程；$u\,u_x$ 让方程非线性，但最高阶偏导 $u_t,u_x$ 仍一次出现且只在系数中依赖 $u$，所以是拟线性方程（无粘 Burgers 方程）。$u_{xx}+u_{yy}=0$：二阶、齐次、线性方程，也就是拉普拉斯方程。

examples.problem: 证明 $u_{xy}=0$ 的通解为 $u=f(x)+g(y)$，并解释为什么这里出现的是任意函数而不是任意常数。
examples.solution: 正向验证：若 $u=f(x)+g(y)$，则 $u_x=f'(x)$，再对 $y$ 求导得 $u_{xy}=0$，满足方程。反过来，若 $u_{xy}=0$，先对 $y$ 积分得 $u_x=h(x)$——对 $y$ 积分时「常数」可以依赖 $x$；再对 $x$ 积分得 $u=f(x)+g(y)$，其中 $g(y)$ 是第二次积分带出的、可以依赖 $y$ 的任意函数。偏微分方程每做一次不定积分，积分常数就可能升级为任意函数，这正是 PDE 通解的结构。

nodes.title: 一阶偏微分方程与特征线法
nodes.titleEn: First-Order PDEs and the Method of Characteristics
nodes.summary: 形如 $a\,u_x+b\,u_y=c$ 的一阶方程；沿特征方程 $\frac{dx}{a}=\frac{dy}{b}=\frac{du}{c}$ 确定的特征线，把偏微分方程化为常微分方程求解。
nodes.summaryEn: First-order equations $a\,u_x+b\,u_y=c$; along the characteristics given by $\frac{dx}{a}=\frac{dy}{b}=\frac{du}{c}$ the PDE reduces to an ODE.
nodes.definition:
**一阶偏微分方程**只含未知函数的一阶偏导数，最常见的形式是拟线性的 $a(x,y)\,u_x+b(x,y)\,u_y=c(x,y,u)$；当 $a,b,c$ 只依赖 $x,y$ 时它成为线性方程。传输方程 $u_t+c\,u_x=0$ 是最基本的模型：任意波形都以速度 $c$ 沿 $x$ 轴整体平移。

**特征线法的想法**：在解曲面 $u=u(x,y)$ 上找一条参数曲线 $(x(s),y(s))$，让全导数把两个偏导「打包」起来：$\frac{du}{ds}=u_x\frac{dx}{ds}+u_y\frac{dy}{ds}$。若选取 $\frac{dx}{ds}=a$、$\frac{dy}{ds}=b$，右端恰好就是 $a\,u_x+b\,u_y$，于是 PDE 沿这条曲线退化为 ODE $\frac{du}{ds}=c$。

把两个比例合并得到**特征方程** $\frac{dx}{a}=\frac{dy}{b}=\frac{du}{c}$：前两项给出平面上的曲线族（特征线），它们由 $dy/dx=b/a$ 决定；第三项决定解沿特征线的变化。因此求解分两步：先解出特征线 $x(s),y(s)$，再沿特征线积分 $du/ds=c$。

齐次方程 $a\,u_x+b\,u_y=0$ 的解沿每条特征线为常数，通解是特征线「首次积分」的任意函数 $u=F(\Phi(x,y))$，其中 $\Phi(x,y)=\mathrm{const}$ 就是特征线方程。拟线性方程的特征线依赖解本身，可能相交：相交处解的梯度爆破、经典解失效，需要引入广义解（激波），这是守恒律理论的开端。
nodes.definitionEn:
A **first-order PDE** contains only first partial derivatives of the unknown; the most common form is the quasilinear one $a(x,y)\,u_x+b(x,y)\,u_y=c(x,y,u)$, which becomes linear when $a,b,c$ depend on $x,y$ only. The transport equation $u_t+c\,u_x=0$ is the basic model: any profile translates along the $x$-axis with speed $c$.

**The idea of the method of characteristics**: on the solution surface $u=u(x,y)$ choose a parameter curve $(x(s),y(s))$ so that the chain rule bundles the two partial derivatives: $\frac{du}{ds}=u_x\frac{dx}{ds}+u_y\frac{dy}{ds}$. If we choose $\frac{dx}{ds}=a$ and $\frac{dy}{ds}=b$, the right-hand side is exactly $a\,u_x+b\,u_y$, so the PDE collapses to the ODE $\frac{du}{ds}=c$ along that curve.

Merging the two ratios gives the **characteristic equations** $\frac{dx}{a}=\frac{dy}{b}=\frac{du}{c}$: the first two determine a family of curves in the plane through $dy/dx=b/a$, and the third gives how $u$ varies along them. Solving therefore proceeds in two steps: find the characteristic curves $x(s),y(s)$, then integrate $du/ds=c$ along them.

For the homogeneous equation $a\,u_x+b\,u_y=0$ the solution is constant along each characteristic, and the general solution is an arbitrary function of the characteristic first integral, $u=F(\Phi(x,y))$ with $\Phi(x,y)=\mathrm{const}$ defining the characteristics. For quasilinear equations the characteristics depend on the solution itself and may cross: the gradient blows up, the classical solution breaks down, and one needs weak solutions (shock waves) — the starting point of conservation-law theory.

formulas.note: 一阶（拟）线性偏微分方程的标准形式（$a^2+b^2\neq 0$）；$c\equiv 0$ 时是齐次线性方程。
formulas.noteEn: Standard form of a first-order (quasilinear) PDE with $a^2+b^2\neq 0$; when $c\equiv 0$ it is homogeneous and linear.

formulas.note: 特征方程（特征线方程组）：前一项 $dx/a=dy/b$ 定义平面上的特征线，后一项给出 $u$ 沿特征线的变化。
formulas.noteEn: The characteristic equations: $dx/a=dy/b$ defines the characteristic curves in the plane, while the third ratio describes how $u$ varies along them.

formulas.note: 参数化形式：沿特征线 $(x(s),y(s))$，$u$ 满足常微分方程 $du/ds=c$。
formulas.noteEn: Parametrised form: along a characteristic $(x(s),y(s))$, the unknown satisfies the ODE $du/ds=c$.

formulas.note: 特征线的斜率与首次积分 $\Phi$；对 $a\,u_x+b\,u_y=0$，沿特征线 $du=0$，故 $u$ 在每条特征线上是常数。
formulas.noteEn: Slope of the characteristics and the first integral $\Phi$; for $a\,u_x+b\,u_y=0$ we have $du=0$ along characteristics, so $u$ is constant on each of them.

formulas.note: 齐次线性方程的通解：任意函数 $F$ 作用在特征线首次积分上。例：$u_x+u_y=0$ 的通解是 $u=F(y-x)$。
formulas.noteEn: General solution of the homogeneous linear equation: an arbitrary function $F$ of the characteristic first integral. For example $u_x+u_y=0$ has $u=F(y-x)$.

expression.text: a(x,y) u_x + b(x,y) u_y = c(x,y,u)
expression.note: 一阶（拟）线性偏微分方程；沿特征方程确定的方向，PDE 退化为常微分方程。
expression.noteEn: First-order (quasilinear) PDE; along the directions fixed by the characteristic equations it reduces to an ODE.

properties: 特征线是 $\dfrac{dy}{dx}=\dfrac{b}{a}$ 的积分曲线；在 $a,b$ 不同时为零的地方它们互不相交，把定义域铺成单参数曲线族。
沿每条特征线 PDE 退化成 ODE，所以「先解特征线、再沿特征线积分」是通用流程。
$a\,u_x+b\,u_y=0$ 的解沿特征线为常数，通解为 $u=F(\Phi(x,y))$，任意函数 $F$ 由初始或边界数据确定。
初始数据给定在与特征线横截的曲线上时，解在局部唯一存在（隐函数定理）；数据给在特征线上则可能无解或不唯一。
拟线性方程的特征线可以相交并形成激波（如 $u_t+u\,u_x=0$），越过相交时刻经典解失效，需要用弱解描述。
propertiesEn: Characteristics are the integral curves of $\dfrac{dy}{dx}=\dfrac{b}{a}$; where $a$ and $b$ do not both vanish they do not cross, foliating the domain by a one-parameter family of curves.
Along each characteristic the PDE becomes an ODE, so the standard recipe is: solve for the characteristics first, then integrate along them.
Solutions of $a\,u_x+b\,u_y=0$ are constant along characteristics and have the form $u=F(\Phi(x,y))$, with the arbitrary function $F$ fixed by initial or boundary data.

If the initial data are prescribed on a curve transversal to the characteristics, a unique local solution exists (implicit function theorem); data on a characteristic may give no solution or infinitely many.
For quasilinear equations characteristics can cross and form shock waves (e.g. $u_t+u\,u_x=0$); beyond the crossing time the classical solution fails and a weak solution is needed.

plot.title: 特征方程 dy/dx = y/x 的斜率场：特征线是过原点的直线 y = Cx

examples.problem: 用特征线法解初值问题 $u_x+2u_y=0$，$u(x,0)=\sin x$。
examples.solution:
特征方程为 $\dfrac{dx}{1}=\dfrac{dy}{2}=\dfrac{du}{0}$：由 $dx/1=dy/2$ 得 $y-2x=\mathrm{const}$，由 $du=0$ 得 $u$ 沿特征线为常数，故通解为 $u=f(y-2x)$。代入 $u(x,0)=f(-2x)=\sin x$，令 $z=-2x$ 得 $f(z)=\sin\left(-\dfrac{z}{2}ight)$，于是

$$u(x,y)=\sin\left(x- rac{y}{2}ight).$$

检验：$u_x=\cos\left(x- rac{y}{2}ight)$，$u_y=- rac{1}{2}\cos\left(x- rac{y}{2}ight)$，所以 $u_x+2u_y=0$ 恒成立，且 $u(x,0)=\sin x$。

特征方程为 $dx/1=dy/1=du/2$，特征线是 $y-x=\mathrm{const}$。参数化取 $x=s+x_0$，$y=s$，$u=2s+u_0$。在 $y=0$ 处 $s=0$、$x_0=x$，由初值得 $u_0=x^{2}$，于是

$$u(x,y)=2y+(x-y)^{2}.$$

检验：$u_x=2(x-y)$，$u_y=2-2(x-y)$，相加得 $u_x+u_y=2$；并且 $u(x,0)=x^{2}$，符合初值条件。

nodes.title: 二阶线性偏微分方程的分类
nodes.summary: 对 $A\,u_{xx}+2B\,u_{xy}+C\,u_{yy}+\cdots=0$，用判别式 $\Delta=B^{2}-AC$ 把方程分为双曲、抛物、椭圆三类（交叉项系数是 $2B$，判别式不是 $B^{2}-4AC$）。
nodes.summaryEn: Second-order linear PDEs are sorted into hyperbolic, parabolic and elliptic types by the discriminant $\Delta=B^{2}-AC$; the cross term carries coefficient $2B$, so the discriminant is not $B^{2}-4AC$.
nodes.definition:
二阶线性偏微分方程 $A\,u_{xx}+2B\,u_{xy}+C\,u_{yy}+D\,u_x+E\,u_y+F\,u=G$ 的「性格」主要由二阶项决定。把交叉项系数写成 $2B$（即 $B$ 是交叉项系数的一半）之后，**判别式**定义为 $\Delta=B^{2}-AC$。

$\Delta>0$ 时称**双曲型**（hyperbolic），$\Delta=0$ 时称**抛物型**（parabolic），$\Delta<0$ 时称**椭圆型**（elliptic）。务必使用 $\Delta=B^{2}-AC$，**不是**一元二次方程那样的 $B^{2}-4AC$：交叉项携带的系数是 $2B$，二次型 $(A,B,C)$ 的判别式本应是 $(2B)^{2}-4AC=4(B^{2}-AC)$，除以 $4$ 之后才得到标准形式 $B^{2}-AC$。

几何意义藏在特征线方程里：把特征线写成 $y=y(x)$，它满足 $A(y')^{2}-2B\,y'+C=0$。这个方程有两个实根、一个重根还是无实根，对应的恰好是 $\Delta>0$、$\Delta=0$、$\Delta<0$。所以双曲型有两族实特征线，抛物型只有一族（重根），椭圆型没有实特征线，其特征线是复的。

类型决定了定解条件怎么提：双曲型（波动方程）可以提 Cauchy 问题，扰动以有限速度沿特征线传播；抛物型（热方程）提初始条件加边界条件，具有无限传播速度与平滑效应；椭圆型（拉普拉斯方程）只提边界条件。在可逆的自变量变换下类型不变，并且可以化为相应的标准型。系数依赖自变量时类型还能逐点变化，形成混合型方程（如 $y\,u_{xx}+u_{yy}=0$）。
nodes.definitionEn:
The character of a second-order linear PDE $A\,u_{xx}+2B\,u_{xy}+C\,u_{yy}+D\,u_x+E\,u_y+F\,u=G$ is governed by its second-order terms. Once the cross term is written with coefficient $2B$ (so $B$ is half the cross coefficient), the **discriminant** is defined as $\Delta=B^{2}-AC$.

The equation is **hyperbolic** when $\Delta>0$, **parabolic** when $\Delta=0$ and **elliptic** when $\Delta<0$. One must use $\Delta=B^{2}-AC$, **not** the quadratic-formula expression $B^{2}-4AC$: the cross term carries the factor $2B$, so the discriminant of the quadratic form $(A,B,C)$ is $(2B)^{2}-4AC=4(B^{2}-AC)$, and dividing by $4$ yields the standard discriminant $B^{2}-AC$.

The geometric meaning lies in the characteristic equation: writing a characteristic as $y=y(x)$, it satisfies $A(y')^{2}-2B\,y'+C=0$. Whether this equation has two real roots, a double root, or no real root corresponds precisely to $\Delta>0$, $\Delta=0$ and $\Delta<0$. Hence hyperbolic equations have two families of real characteristics, parabolic ones a single family (double root), and elliptic ones no real characteristics at all.

The type dictates how data should be prescribed: for hyperbolic equations (wave equation) one poses a Cauchy problem and disturbances travel along characteristics with finite speed; for parabolic equations (heat equation) one imposes initial data plus boundary data, with infinite propagation speed and a smoothing effect; for elliptic equations (Laplace equation) only boundary data are prescribed. The type is invariant under invertible changes of the independent variables, and each type can be reduced to a canonical form. When the coefficients depend on the variables the type may change from point to point, producing mixed-type equations such as $y\,u_{xx}+u_{yy}=0$.

formulas.note: 二阶线性方程的一般形式；$A,B,C$ 是二阶项系数，交叉项写成 $2B$，判别式里的 $B$ 就是它。
formulas.noteEn: General second-order linear equation; $A,B,C$ are the second-order coefficients, the cross term is written $2B$, and the $B$ in the discriminant is exactly this half-coefficient.

formulas.note: 判别式。不是 $B^{2}-4AC$：因为交叉项系数为 $2B$，对应二次型的判别式是 $(2B)^{2}-4AC=4\Delta$，标准判别式取除以 $4$ 之后的结果。
formulas.noteEn: The discriminant. It is not $B^{2}-4AC$: since the cross coefficient is $2B$, the quadratic form has discriminant $(2B)^{2}-4AC=4\Delta$, and dividing by $4$ gives the standard form.

formulas.note: 三种类型：$\Delta>0$ 双曲型（如波动方程），$\Delta=0$ 抛物型（如热方程），$\Delta<0$ 椭圆型（如拉普拉斯方程）。
formulas.noteEn: The three types: hyperbolic for $\Delta>0$ (wave equation), parabolic for $\Delta=0$ (heat equation) and elliptic for $\Delta<0$ (Laplace equation).

formulas.note: 特征线方程，判别式为 $4\Delta$；实根的个数＝实特征线族的个数：两个实根对应双曲，重根对应抛物，无实根对应椭圆。
formulas.noteEn: The characteristic equation, whose own discriminant is $4\Delta$; the number of real roots equals the number of real characteristic families: two roots for hyperbolic, a double root for parabolic, none for elliptic.

formulas.note: 三个典型方程：波动方程 $A=1,B=0,C=-a^{2}$，双曲型；热方程没有 $u_{tt}$ 项，$A=0$，故 $\Delta=0$，抛物型；拉普拉斯方程 $A=C=1,B=0$，椭圆型。
formulas.noteEn: Three model equations: the wave equation has $A=1,B=0,C=-a^{2}$ and is hyperbolic; the heat equation has no $u_{tt}$ term, so $A=0$ and $\Delta=0$, parabolic; Laplace's equation has $A=C=1,B=0$ and is elliptic.

properties: 类型只由二阶项系数 $A,B,C$ 决定，低阶项 $D\,u_x+E\,u_y+F\,u$ 与右端 $G$ 都不影响分类。
类型在可逆自变量变换下不变（判别式的符号是不变量），且可化为标准型：双曲 $u_{\xi\eta}+\cdots=0$（或 $u_{\xi\xi}-u_{\eta\eta}+\cdots=0$），抛物 $u_{\xi\xi}+\cdots=0$，椭圆 $u_{\xi\xi}+u_{\eta\eta}+\cdots=0$。
实特征线族数由类型决定：双曲型两族、抛物型一族、椭圆型没有实特征线。
类型决定定解条件的提法：双曲型提 Cauchy 问题（两个初始条件），抛物型提初始条件＋边界条件，椭圆型只提边界条件。
系数可变时类型可以逐点变化：$y\,u_{xx}+u_{yy}=0$ 在 $y<0$ 为双曲、$y=0$ 为抛物、$y>0$ 为椭圆，是混合型方程。
propertiesEn: The type depends only on the second-order coefficients $A,B,C$; the lower-order terms $D\,u_x+E\,u_y+F\,u$ and the right-hand side $G$ do not affect it.

The type is invariant under invertible changes of the independent variables (the sign of the discriminant is an invariant), and each type admits a canonical form: hyperbolic $u_{\xi\eta}+\cdots=0$ (or $u_{\xi\xi}-u_{\eta\eta}+\cdots=0$), parabolic $u_{\xi\xi}+\cdots=0$, elliptic $u_{\xi\xi}+u_{\eta\eta}+\cdots=0$.
The number of real characteristic families is determined by the type: two for hyperbolic, one for parabolic, none for elliptic.

The type determines how data are prescribed: a Cauchy problem (two initial conditions) for hyperbolic equations, initial plus boundary data for parabolic equations, and boundary data only for elliptic equations.
When coefficients vary, the type can change from point to point: $y\,u_{xx}+u_{yy}=0$ is hyperbolic for $y<0$, parabolic on $y=0$ and elliptic for $y>0$ — a mixed-type equation.

examples.problem: 判断二阶方程 $u_{xx}+4u_{xy}+2u_{yy}+u=0$ 的类型。
examples.solution:
交叉项系数是 $4$，故 $B=\dfrac{4}{2}=2$；又 $A=1$，$C=2$，判别式

$$\Delta=B^{2}-AC=2^{2}-1\cdot 2=2>0,$$

所以方程是**双曲型**。常见错误是把判别式写成 $B^{2}-4AC$：若仍取 $B=2$，会得到 $2^{2}-4\cdot 1\cdot 2=-4<0$，把双曲型误判成椭圆型；另一种错误是忘了交叉项系数要除以 $2$。再次强调：交叉项系数是 $2B$，判别式是 $B^{2}-AC$。

examples.problem: 判断方程 $y\,u_{xx}+u_{yy}=0$ 在哪些区域是双曲型、抛物型、椭圆型，并写出 $y<0$ 时的特征线方程。
examples.solution: 这里 $A=y$，$B=0$，$C=1$，故 $\Delta=B^{2}-AC=-y$。于是 $y<0$ 时 $\Delta>0$，双曲型；$y=0$ 时 $\Delta=0$，抛物型；$y>0$ 时 $\Delta<0$，椭圆型——类型随点变化，是**混合型**方程（Tricomi 型）。特征线方程 $A(y')^{2}-2B\,y'+C=0$ 即 $y(y')^{2}+1=0$，仅当 $y<0$ 时有实解 $y'=\pm\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{-y}}$，与双曲区域一致。

nodes.title: 波动方程
nodes.summary: 一维波动方程 $u_{tt}=a^{2}u_{xx}$，$a>0$ 是波速；解是右行波与左行波的叠加，具有有限传播速度、能量守恒与时间可逆性。
nodes.summaryEn: The one-dimensional wave equation $u_{tt}=a^{2}u_{xx}$ with wave speed $a>0$; its solutions superpose left- and right-moving waves and enjoy finite propagation speed, energy conservation and time reversibility.
nodes.definition:
**波动方程**描述振动与波的传播：理想的弦、杆、声场和电磁场在小振幅近似下都归结为一维形式 $\dfrac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial t^{2}}=a^{2}\dfrac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}$，其中常数 $a>0$ 是**波速**（量纲为长度/时间），$a^{2}$ 由介质性质决定，例如弦上 $a^{2}=T/\rho$（张力除以线密度）。

方程可以因式分解：$\left(\partial_t-a\partial_x\right)\left(\partial_t+a\partial_x\right)u=0$。要让方程成立，只需让任一因子把 $u$ 变成零，因此形如 $u=F(x-at)$ 与 $u=G(x+at)$ 的函数都是解：前者是保持形状、以速度 $a$ 向右平移的**右行波**，后者是向左传播的**左行波**，一般解是二者的叠加。

给波动方程配定解条件有两种典型方式：全直线上的 **Cauchy 问题** $u(x,0)=\varphi(x)$、$u_t(x,0)=\psi(x)$，其显式解就是达朗贝尔公式（下一个知识点）；有限弦上的**初边值问题**则用分离变量与 Fourier 级数展开，得到驻波（振动模态）的叠加。

波动方程是**双曲型**方程的代表，两个重要特性是：**有限传播速度**——扰动以不超过 $a$ 的速度向外传播，某时刻某点只受有限区间内初值的影响；**能量守恒与时间可逆**——无阻尼时弦的动能与势能之和保持不变，且把 $t$ 换成 $-t$ 仍是解。这两点与热方程形成鲜明对照。
nodes.definitionEn:
The **wave equation** describes vibrations and wave propagation: an ideal string, a rod, sound and electromagnetic fields all reduce, in the small-amplitude approximation, to the one-dimensional form $\dfrac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial t^{2}}=a^{2}\dfrac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}$, where the constant $a>0$ is the **wave speed** (length per time) and $a^{2}$ is fixed by the medium, for instance $a^{2}=T/\rho$ for a string (tension over linear density).

The equation factors as $\left(\partial_t-a\partial_x\right)\left(\partial_t+a\partial_x\right)u=0$. It holds whenever either factor annihilates $u$, so any function of the form $u=F(x-at)$ or $u=G(x+at)$ is a solution: the first is a **right-moving wave** that travels to increasing $x$ with speed $a$ without changing shape, the second a **left-moving wave**, and the general solution superposes the two.

Two ways of adding data are typical. On the whole line one poses the **Cauchy problem** $u(x,0)=\varphi(x)$, $u_t(x,0)=\psi(x)$, whose explicit solution is d'Alembert's formula. On a finite string one solves an initial-boundary value problem by separation of variables and Fourier series, obtaining superpositions of standing waves (normal modes).

The wave equation is the prototype **hyperbolic** equation and has two hallmark features: **finite propagation speed** — a disturbance travels at most at speed $a$, so the solution at a point depends only on data in a finite interval; and **energy conservation with time reversibility** — without damping the sum of kinetic and potential energy is constant, and replacing $t$ by $-t$ keeps a solution a solution. Both contrast sharply with the heat equation.

formulas.note: 一维波动方程。$a>0$ 是波速；弦振动中 $a^{2}=T/\rho$（张力除以线密度）。
formulas.noteEn: The one-dimensional wave equation. $a>0$ is the wave speed; for a string $a^{2}=T/\rho$ (tension over linear density).

formulas.note: 算子因式分解：两个一阶算子分别对应沿 $x+at=\mathrm{const}$ 与 $x-at=\mathrm{const}$ 两个方向的导数。
formulas.noteEn: Operator factorisation: the two first-order factors act as directional derivatives along $x+at=\mathrm{const}$ and $x-at=\mathrm{const}$.

formulas.note: 通解：右行波与左行波之和，$F,G$ 任意二次可微。每一项波形不变，只作整体平移。
formulas.noteEn: General solution: the sum of a right-moving and a left-moving wave, with arbitrary twice differentiable $F,G$. Each keeps its shape and simply translates.

formulas.note: 两族特征线；扰动沿它们传播，这也是双曲型方程的两族实特征线。
formulas.noteEn: The two characteristic families along which disturbances travel; they are exactly the two real characteristic families of a hyperbolic equation.

formulas.note: 能量守恒（无源、无阻尼、无穷远处衰减）：动能（含 $u_t^{2}$）与势能（含 $u_x^{2}$）之和与 $t$ 无关。
formulas.noteEn: Energy conservation (no sources, no damping, decaying at infinity): the sum of kinetic energy (with $u_t^{2}$) and potential energy (with $u_x^{2}$) is independent of $t$.

expression.text: u_tt = a^2 u_xx（a > 0 为波速）
expression.note: 一维波动方程；解是右行波 F(x−at) 与左行波 G(x+at) 的叠加。
expression.noteEn: The one-dimensional wave equation; solutions superpose a right-moving wave F(x−at) and a left-moving wave G(x+at).

properties: 有限传播速度：$u(x,t)$ 只依赖 $\varphi(x\pm at)$ 与区间 $[x-at,\,x+at]$ 上的 $\psi$，该区间之外的初值不影响这个点。
叠加原理：任意多个行波解之和仍是解；两个反向行波叠加可以产生驻波，如 $\sin(x+t)+\sin(x-t)=2\sin x\cos t$。
时间可逆：$u(x,t)$ 是解则 $u(x,-t)$ 也是解（时间方向只出现二阶导数），与热方程的时间不可逆形成对比。
初值的光滑性决定解的光滑性：$\varphi\in C^{2}$、$\psi\in C^{1}$ 时得到经典解；数据不光滑时解只能按广义意义理解，间断沿特征线传播。
特征线 $x\pm at=\mathrm{const}$ 是信息的传播路径；按分类它满足 $\Delta=a^{2}>0$，是标准的双曲型方程。
propertiesEn: Finite propagation speed: $u(x,t)$ depends only on $\varphi(x\pm at)$ and on $\psi$ over the interval $[x-at,\,x+at]$; data outside this interval do not affect the point.
Superposition: any sum of travelling-wave solutions is again a solution; two counter-propagating waves can produce a standing wave, e.g. $\sin(x+t)+\sin(x-t)=2\sin x\cos t$.
Time reversibility: if $u(x,t)$ is a solution then so is $u(x,-t)$ (only second time derivatives appear), in contrast to the irreversibility of the heat equation.

Smoothness of the data governs smoothness of the solution: $\varphi\in C^{2}$ and $\psi\in C^{1}$ give a classical solution; for rougher data the solution is understood in a generalised sense, with discontinuities travelling along characteristics.
The lines $x\pm at=\mathrm{const}$ are the paths along which information travels; in the classification scheme the equation has $\Delta=a^{2}>0$ and is the standard hyperbolic example.

plot.title: 行波：波形 sin x 以速度 a 向右平移（取 a = 1，三个时刻的快照）

examples.problem: 验证 $u(x,t)=\sin(x-at)$ 满足波动方程 $u_{tt}=a^{2}u_{xx}$，并说明它的传播方向。
examples.solution: 求导：$u_x=\cos(x-at)$，$u_{xx}=-\sin(x-at)$；$u_t=-a\cos(x-at)$，$u_{tt}=-a^{2}\sin(x-at)$。于是 $u_{tt}=-a^{2}\sin(x-at)=a^{2}u_{xx}$，满足方程。波形是 $\sin$，随 $t$ 增大整体向 $x$ 正方向平移、速度为 $a$，故它是形如 $F(x-at)$ 的右行波。

examples.problem: 求解 Cauchy 问题 $u_{tt}=u_{xx}$（$a=1$），$u(x,0)=\sin x$，$u_t(x,0)=\cos x$。
examples.solution:
用达朗贝尔公式（$a=1$）：

$$u(x,t)= rac{1}{2}\left[\sin(x+t)+\sin(x-t)ight]+ rac{1}{2}\int_{x-t}^{x+t}\cos s\,ds.$$

由和差化积 $\sin(x+t)+\sin(x-t)=2\sin x\cos t$，而第二项等于 $ rac{1}{2}\left[\sin(x+t)-\sin(x-t)ight]=\cos x\sin t$，所以

$$u(x,t)=\sin x\cos t+\cos x\sin t=\sin(x+t).$$

检验：$u(x,0)=\sin x$，$u_t(x,0)=\cos x$，且 $u_{tt}=-\sin(x+t)=u_{xx}$——解是一个单个的右行波，正好与两个行波叠加成驻波再还原一致。

nodes.title: 达朗贝尔公式
nodes.summary: 一维波动方程 Cauchy 问题的显式解：$u=\frac{1}{2}\left[\varphi(x+at)+\varphi(x-at)\right]+\frac{1}{2a}\int_{x-at}^{x+at}\psi(s)\,ds$。
nodes.summaryEn: The explicit solution of the Cauchy problem for the 1D wave equation: half the initial displacement at the two characteristic points plus the integral of the initial velocity over $[x-at,x+at]$ divided by $2a$.
nodes.definition:
**达朗贝尔公式**（d'Alembert's formula，1747）给出一维波动方程 Cauchy 问题的显式解：对 $u_{tt}=a^{2}u_{xx}$（$-\infty<x<\infty$，$t>0$）与初值 $u(x,0)=\varphi(x)$、$u_t(x,0)=\psi(x)$，有\n\n$$u(x,t)=\frac{1}{2}\left[\varphi(x+at)+\varphi(x-at)\right]+\frac{1}{2a}\int_{x-at}^{x+at}\psi(s)\,ds.$$\n\n它由通解 $F(x-at)+G(x+at)$ 代入两个初值条件解出 $F$ 与 $G$ 得到。

逐项理解：第一项 $\frac{1}{2}\varphi(x-at)+\frac{1}{2}\varphi(x+at)$ 把初始位移分成两个**半高**的行波，分别以速度 $a$ 向右、向左传播——这正是系数 $\frac{1}{2}$ 的来源；第二项把初始速度 $\psi$ 在区间 $[x-at,\,x+at]$ 上积分再除以 $2a$，区间长度恰为 $2at$，代表初始速度对位移的累积贡献。要牢记三处细节：两个 $\frac{1}{2}$、分子里的 $1/(2a)$、以及积分上下限 $x-at$ 与 $x+at$。

把公式在 $t=0$ 处检查：第一项给出 $\frac{1}{2}[\varphi(x)+\varphi(x)]=\varphi(x)$，第二项积分为零，初始位移条件成立；对 $t$ 求导（积分用莱布尼茨公式）后再令 $t=0$，正负号相消后剩下 $\psi(x)$，初始速度条件也自动满足。

公式还直接读出因果结构：$(x,t)$ 处的解只依赖 $\varphi$ 在两点 $x\pm at$ 的值与 $\psi$ 在区间 $[x-at,\,x+at]$ 上的值，这就是**依赖区间**；区间外的初值变化不影响 $u(x,t)$，体现有限传播速度。半直线或有限区间上的问题可以通过奇偶延拓化为全直线问题。
nodes.definitionEn:
**d'Alembert's formula** (1747) gives the explicit solution of the Cauchy problem for the one-dimensional wave equation: for $u_{tt}=a^{2}u_{xx}$ ($-\infty<x<\infty$, $t>0$) with data $u(x,0)=\varphi(x)$ and $u_t(x,0)=\psi(x)$,\n\n$$u(x,t)=\frac{1}{2}\left[\varphi(x+at)+\varphi(x-at)\right]+\frac{1}{2a}\int_{x-at}^{x+at}\psi(s)\,ds.$$\n\nIt is obtained by substituting the general solution $F(x-at)+G(x+at)$ into the two initial conditions and solving for $F$ and $G$.

Reading it term by term: the first term $\frac{1}{2}\varphi(x-at)+\frac{1}{2}\varphi(x+at)$ splits the initial displacement into two **half-height** travelling waves moving right and left with speed $a$ — this is where the factor $\frac{1}{2}$ comes from. The second term integrates the initial velocity $\psi$ over $[x-at,\,x+at]$ and divides by $2a$; the interval has length $2at$ and accounts for the accumulated contribution of the initial velocity. Three details must be memorised: the two factors $\frac{1}{2}$, the factor $1/(2a)$, and the limits $x-at$ and $x+at$.

Checking at $t=0$: the first term gives $\frac{1}{2}[\varphi(x)+\varphi(x)]=\varphi(x)$ while the integral vanishes, so the initial displacement is reproduced; differentiating with respect to $t$ (Leibniz rule for the integral) and then setting $t=0$ leaves $\psi(x)$, so the initial velocity condition holds as well.

The formula also displays the causal structure directly: the solution at $(x,t)$ depends only on the values of $\varphi$ at the two points $x\pm at$ and on $\psi$ over $[x-at,\,x+at]$ — the **interval of dependence**. Data outside this interval cannot influence $u(x,t)$, which is finite propagation speed. Problems on a half-line or a finite interval can be reduced to the whole-line problem by odd or even extension.

formulas.note: 达朗贝尔公式。第一项来自初始位移，第二项来自初始速度；注意两个 $\frac{1}{2}$、因子 $\frac{1}{2a}$、积分区间 $[x-at,\,x+at]$（长度 $2at$）。
formulas.noteEn: d'Alembert's formula: the first term comes from the initial displacement, the second from the initial velocity. Mind the two factors $\frac{1}{2}$, the factor $\frac{1}{2a}$ and the interval $[x-at,\,x+at]$ of length $2at$.

formulas.note: 第一个初值条件的验证：$t=0$ 时积分退化为零，两端点合并为 $\varphi(x)$。
formulas.noteEn: Verification of the first initial condition: at $t=0$ the integral degenerates to zero and the two endpoints merge into $\varphi(x)$.

formulas.note: 对 $t$ 求导（莱布尼茨公式）。特别地 $u_t(x,0)=\frac{1}{2}[\psi(x)+\psi(x)]=\psi(x)$，与第二个初值条件一致。
formulas.noteEn: Differentiation in $t$ (Leibniz rule). In particular $u_t(x,0)=\frac{1}{2}[\psi(x)+\psi(x)]=\psi(x)$, matching the second initial condition.

formulas.note: 初始速度为零时，初始波形分裂成两个半高峰值的行波，方向相反、速度都是 $a$，每个只携带一半幅度。
formulas.noteEn: When the initial velocity vanishes, the initial profile splits into two half-height travelling waves moving in opposite directions with speed $a$, each carrying half the amplitude.

formulas.note: 依赖区间 $[x-at,\,x+at]$；从 $x_0$ 出发的信号在时刻 $t=|x-x_0|/a$ 到达 $x$，这与「波速为 $a$」完全一致。
formulas.noteEn: The interval of dependence $[x-at,\,x+at]$; a signal starting at $x_0$ reaches $x$ at time $t=|x-x_0|/a$, exactly as expected for wave speed $a$.

properties: 公式只涉及 $\varphi$ 的两点值与 $\psi$ 的区间积分，直接体现双曲型方程的有限传播速度与依赖区间。
$\psi=0$ 时解是两个半高行波 $\frac{1}{2}\varphi(x\mp at)$ 之和；单个脉冲会一分为二、反向传播，各带一半幅度。
只要 $\varphi$ 有二阶连续导数、$\psi$ 有一阶连续导数，公式就给出唯一的经典解；数据更弱时公式仍可作为广义解的定义。
半直线或有限区间上的问题可用奇延拓（Dirichlet 边界 $u=0$）或偶延拓（Neumann 边界 $u_x=0$）化成全直线问题，边界的反射等价于一个镜像波。
因果性与可逆性：$t$ 时刻的解只由过去光锥内的数据决定；方程对时间只有二阶导数，$t\to -t$ 后公式仍然成立。
propertiesEn: The formula involves only two point values of $\varphi$ and an integral of $\psi$ over an interval, making finite propagation speed and the interval of dependence explicit.
When $\psi=0$ the solution is the sum of two half-height travelling waves $\frac{1}{2}\varphi(x\mp at)$; a single pulse splits into two opposite-moving pulses, each carrying half the amplitude.
As soon as $\varphi\in C^{2}$ and $\psi\in C^{1}$, the formula gives the unique classical solution; for weaker data it still defines a generalised solution.

Problems on a half-line or a finite interval are reduced to the whole-line problem by odd extension (Dirichlet boundary $u=0$) or even extension (Neumann boundary $u_x=0$); a boundary reflection acts like a mirror wave.
Causality and reversibility: the solution at time $t$ is determined by data inside the past light cone, and because only a second time derivative occurs, the formula remains valid under $t\to -t$.

plot.title: 达朗贝尔公式：初始脉冲 φ(x)=e^(−x²) 分裂为左右两个半高行波（a=1, t=2）

examples.problem: 用达朗贝尔公式求解 $u_{tt}=u_{xx}$（$a=1$），$u(x,0)=0$，$u_t(x,0)=\cos x$。
examples.solution:
$\varphi=0$，第一项为零；第二项为

$$u(x,t)= rac{1}{2}\int_{x-t}^{x+t}\cos s\,ds= rac{1}{2}\left[\sin(x+t)-\sin(x-t)ight]=\cos x\sin t.$$

检验：$u(x,0)=0$，$u_t(x,0)=\cos x$，且 $u_{tt}=-\cos x\sin t=u_{xx}$，全部吻合。

由公式（$\psi=0$）：

$$u(x,t)= rac{1}{2}e^{-(x-t)^{2}}+ rac{1}{2}e^{-(x+t)^{2}}.$$

$t=2$ 时，两个半高峰值的高斯脉冲分别以 $x=2$ 与 $x=-2$ 为中心，随 $t$ 增大以速度 $1$ 继续向两侧分开；每个脉冲高度是原来的一半、形状不变，两个中心之间的距离为 $2at=4$。这就是「一个脉冲分裂成两个半高行波」的直观图像。

nodes.title: 热传导方程
nodes.summary: 热传导（扩散）方程 $u_t=a^{2}u_{xx}$；基本解是高斯形的热核 $\Phi=\frac{1}{2a\sqrt{\pi t}}e^{-x^{2}/(4a^{2}t)}$，解具有无限传播速度与立即变光滑的性质。
nodes.summaryEn: The heat (diffusion) equation $u_t=a^{2}u_{xx}$; its fundamental solution is the Gaussian heat kernel $\Phi=\frac{1}{2a\sqrt{\pi t}}e^{-x^{2}/(4a^{2}t)}$, and solutions propagate at infinite speed and become instantly smooth.
nodes.definition:
**热传导方程**（也称扩散方程）$\dfrac{\partial u}{\partial t}=a^{2}\dfrac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}$ 描述温度或浓度随时间的演化，$a^{2}>0$ 是热扩散系数（由导热系数、密度与比热决定）。它对时间只含一阶导数、对空间含二阶导数，所以初始条件只需给出 $t=0$ 时的分布，边界条件给出区间两端的约束。

物理直觉全在空间曲率里：$u_{xx}>0$ 处分布是凹向上的，该点温度低于邻近平均，热量流入使其升高；$u_{xx}<0$ 处相反。于是任何不均匀都会被逐渐抹平，这就是扩散的本质，也是方程属于抛物型的直观来源。

最基本的一步是求**基本解**：初值取 $\delta(x)$ 时解为**热核**\n\n$$\Phi(x,t)=\frac{1}{2a\sqrt{\pi t}}\exp\left(-\frac{x^{2}}{4a^{2}t}\right),\qquad t>0,$$\n\n它是宽度随 $\sqrt{t}$ 变大、峰值按 $1/\sqrt{t}$ 变低的高斯；任意初值 $\varphi$ 的 Cauchy 解是 $\Phi$ 与 $\varphi$ 的卷积。

热方程有两个「反直觉」但重要的性质：**无限传播速度**——初值是原点处的正脉冲时，任意小的 $t>0$ 后解对所有 $x$ 都是正的（远处只是极小），扰动的影响没有有限传播速度；**立即变光滑**——只要初值可积，$t>0$ 后解关于 $x$ 就无限次可微。此外时间不可逆，反向问题是严重不适定的。
nodes.definitionEn:
The **heat equation** (also called the diffusion equation) $\dfrac{\partial u}{\partial t}=a^{2}\dfrac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}$ describes the evolution of temperature or concentration, where $a^{2}>0$ is the thermal diffusivity (determined by conductivity, density and specific heat). It contains a first time derivative and a second space derivative, so an initial condition gives the distribution at $t=0$ and boundary conditions constrain the two ends of the interval.

The physical intuition lies in the spatial curvature: where $u_{xx}>0$ the profile is concave up, the point is cooler than its neighbours, and heat flows in to warm it; where $u_{xx}<0$ the opposite happens. Every nonuniformity is gradually smoothed out — the essence of diffusion and the intuitive reason why the equation is parabolic.

The basic building block is the **fundamental solution**: starting from the initial datum $\delta(x)$ one obtains the **heat kernel**\n\n$$\Phi(x,t)=\frac{1}{2a\sqrt{\pi t}}\exp\left(-\frac{x^{2}}{4a^{2}t}\right),\qquad t>0,$$\n\na Gaussian whose width grows like $\sqrt{t}$ while its peak decays like $1/\sqrt{t}$. For arbitrary initial data $\varphi$ the Cauchy solution is the convolution of $\Phi$ with $\varphi$.

Two properties of the heat equation are counter-intuitive yet essential: **infinite propagation speed** — from a positive pulse at the origin the solution is positive everywhere for every $t>0$, however small (exponentially tiny far away), so disturbances have no finite speed; and **instant smoothing** — as soon as the initial datum is integrable, the solution is infinitely differentiable in $x$ for $t>0$. The equation is also irreversible in time, and the backward problem is severely ill posed.

formulas.note: 一维热传导（扩散）方程，$a^{2}>0$ 是热扩散系数；常取标准形 $a^{2}=1$。
formulas.noteEn: The one-dimensional heat (diffusion) equation, with thermal diffusivity $a^{2}>0$; the normalised form $a^{2}=1$ is common.

formulas.note: 热核（基本解）。分母是 $2a\sqrt{\pi t}$，指数内的分母是 $4a^{2}t$——这两处最容易写错。
formulas.noteEn: The heat kernel (fundamental solution). The prefactor is $1/(2a\sqrt{\pi t})$ and the exponent has denominator $4a^{2}t$ — the two spots where mistakes are most common.

formulas.note: 热核是概率密度：总积分为 $1$（总热量守恒），$t\to 0^{+}$ 时在弱意义下收敛到 $\delta$ 函数。
formulas.noteEn: The heat kernel is a probability density: its integral is $1$ (conservation of total heat) and it converges weakly to $\delta(x)$ as $t\to 0^{+}$.

formulas.note: 任意初值 $u(x,0)=\varphi(x)$ 的 Cauchy 解＝热核与初值的卷积；每一步都在做「高斯加权平均」，所以解立即变光滑。
formulas.noteEn: The Cauchy solution with initial data $u(x,0)=\varphi(x)$ is the convolution of the heat kernel with $\varphi$; each application is a Gaussian-weighted average, which is why the solution is instantly smooth.

formulas.note: 能量耗散：方程乘 $u$ 后分部积分（边界项消失）即得；能量单调不增，解最终趋于常数。
formulas.noteEn: Energy dissipation: multiply the equation by $u$ and integrate by parts (boundary terms vanish); the energy is nonincreasing and the solution eventually decays to a constant.

expression.text: u_t = a^2 u_xx（t > 0，a^2 为热扩散系数）
expression.note: 一维热传导方程；基本解是高斯形的热核，解随时间变矮变宽。
expression.noteEn: The one-dimensional heat equation; its fundamental solution is the Gaussian heat kernel, and solutions flatten and spread as time grows.

properties: 无限传播速度：初值非负且不恒为零时，任意 $t>0$ 后的解对一切 $x$ 都大于零（热核为正）——与波动方程的有限传播速度形成鲜明对比。
平滑效应（正则化）：$t>0$ 后解关于 $x$ 无限次可微甚至实解析，初值的粗糙性被立刻抹平。
最大值原理：无源时内部不会出现新的最高或最低温度，极值由初值与边界控制，这也给出解的稳定性估计。
时间不可逆：方程对时间只有一阶导数，反向问题把高频扰动指数放大，严重不适定，是熵增方向的数学体现。
抛物型方程（判别式 $\Delta=B^{2}-AC=0$）；适定的提法是初始条件＋两端边界条件，两者缺一不可。
propertiesEn: Infinite propagation speed: starting from nonnegative data that are not identically zero, the solution is positive everywhere for every $t>0$ (the heat kernel is positive), in sharp contrast with the finite speed of the wave equation.
Smoothing (regularisation): for $t>0$ the solution is infinitely differentiable in $x$, indeed real analytic; roughness of the initial datum is wiped out immediately.
Maximum principle: with no sources no new maximum or minimum can appear in the interior; extremes are controlled by the initial and boundary data, which also yields stability estimates.

Irreversibility in time: only a first time derivative appears, and the backward problem amplifies high-frequency perturbations exponentially — severely ill posed, reflecting the direction of increasing entropy.
A parabolic equation (discriminant $\Delta=B^{2}-AC=0$); the well-posed formulation needs an initial condition plus boundary conditions at both ends, none of which can be dropped.

plot.title: 热核 Φ(x,t)：随 t 增大峰值按 1/√t 降低、宽度按 √t 增大（a=1）

examples.problem: 验证热核 $\Phi(x,t)=\frac{1}{2a\sqrt{\pi t}}e^{-x^{2}/(4a^{2}t)}$（$t>0$）满足热方程 $\Phi_t=a^{2}\Phi_{xx}$。
examples.solution:
取对数得 $\ln\Phi=- rac{x^{2}}{4a^{2}t}-\ln\left(2a\sqrt{\pi}ight)- rac{1}{2}\ln t$，逐项求导：

$$\Phi_t=\Phi\left( rac{x^{2}}{4a^{2}t^{2}}- rac{1}{2t}ight),\qquad \Phi_x=\Phi\cdot\left(- rac{x}{2a^{2}t}ight).$$

再求一次空间导数得 $\Phi_{xx}=\Phi\left( rac{x^{2}}{4a^{4}t^{2}}- rac{1}{2a^{2}t}ight)$，于是

$$a^{2}\Phi_{xx}=\Phi\left( rac{x^{2}}{4a^{2}t^{2}}- rac{1}{2t}ight)=\Phi_t,$$

所以热核在 $t>0$ 上满足热方程。（$t=0$ 处热核无定义，只能作为 $\delta$ 函数的极限来理解。）

examples.problem: 证明 $\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\Phi(x,t)\,dx=1$，并说明 $t$ 增大时热核的峰值与宽度如何变化。
examples.solution:
作代换 $x=2a\sqrt{t}\,z$，则 $dx=2a\sqrt{t}\,dz$，指数化为 $-z^{2}$：

$$\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\Phi\,dx= rac{1}{2a\sqrt{\pi t}}\cdot 2a\sqrt{t}\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}e^{-z^{2}}dz= rac{1}{\sqrt{\pi}}\cdot\sqrt{\pi}=1.$$

峰值 $\Phi(0,t)= rac{1}{2a\sqrt{\pi t}}$ 按 $t^{-1/2}$ 下降，而分布的标准差为 $\sqrt{2}\,a\sqrt{t}$，按 $\sqrt{t}$ 增长：热核随时间变矮、变宽，但总面积（总热量）恒为 $1$。

nodes.title: 拉普拉斯方程
nodes.summary: $\Delta u=u_{xx}+u_{yy}=0$；解是调和函数，方程属于椭圆型，是只带边界条件的边值问题（没有初始条件），描述稳态现象。
nodes.summaryEn: Laplace's equation $\Delta u=u_{xx}+u_{yy}=0$; its solutions are harmonic functions, the equation is elliptic, and it is a pure boundary value problem with no initial conditions, modelling steady states.
nodes.definition:
**拉普拉斯方程**是 $\Delta u=\dfrac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}+\dfrac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=0$（$n$ 维时 $\Delta u=\sum_{i=1}^{n}u_{x_ix_i}=0$），满足它的函数称为**调和函数**。它描述不随时间变化的**稳态**：热传导的平衡温度、无电荷区域的静电位、不可压无旋流的速度势都满足它。

从热方程可以看它的来历：稳态意味着 $\partial u/\partial t=0$，于是 $u_t=a^{2}u_{xx}$ 退化为 $u_{xx}=0$；在二维或更高维空间中就变成 $\Delta u=0$。方程不含时间导数，所以**只有边界条件、没有初始条件**：给定边界数据求内部值，统称边值问题，按边界条件的类型分为 Dirichlet、Neumann、Robin 三种。

按二阶方程的分类它属于**椭圆型**（$A=C=1$，$B=0$，判别式 $-1<0$）。椭圆型方程的解在区域内部非常光滑（实解析），并且满足两个漂亮的性质：**最大值原理**——非常数解不能在内部取得最大值或最小值，极值只能出现在边界；**均值性质**——一点处的值等于以该点为心的圆周或圆盘上的平均值。这两个性质是唯一性与稳定性证明的基本工具。

它的基本解 $\Gamma=\dfrac{1}{2\pi}\ln r$ 在除原点外处处调和，是构造**格林函数**、求解边值问题的出发点；但它在原点奇异、无界，所以不能充当含原点区域 Dirichlet 问题的解——这也从侧面说明：有界调和函数完全由边界值决定。
nodes.definitionEn:
**Laplace's equation** is $\Delta u=\dfrac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}+\dfrac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=0$ (in $n$ dimensions, $\Delta u=\sum_{i=1}^{n}u_{x_ix_i}=0$); its solutions are called **harmonic functions**.
