expression.noteEn: The elimination-plus-back-substitution process is recorded by the LU factorization; with row swaps it becomes $PA=LU$.

properties: 存在与唯一性：若 $A$ 的所有顺序主子式非零，则 Doolittle 分解（$L$ 单位下三角、$U$ 上三角）存在且唯一；一般非奇异矩阵借助列主元得到 $PA=LU$，理论上总能完成。
列主元消去法的乘数满足 $|m_{ik}|\le1$，能抑制舍入误差放大；主元很小时不选主元会使误差被 $|a_{ik}/a_{kk}|$ 放大，这是直接法失稳的主要来源。
计算量：消元约 $\frac{n^3}{3}$ 次乘法、回代约 $\frac{n^2}{2}$ 次，整体 $O(n^3)$，远优于按定义展开的指数级方法。
一次分解、多次求解：保存 $L$、$U$ 后，每个新右端项只需两次三角求解（各 $O(n^2)$），适合多右端项与迭代改进。
对称正定矩阵用 Cholesky 分解 $A=LL^{\top}$：运算量约 $\frac{n^3}{6}$、无须选主元、数值稳定；但方程组本身病态（条件数大）时解对扰动敏感，这与算法选择无关。
propertiesEn: Existence and uniqueness: if all leading principal minors of $A$ are nonzero, the Doolittle factorization ($L$ unit lower triangular, $U$ upper triangular) exists and is unique; for a general nonsingular matrix partial pivoting gives $PA=LU$, which always completes.

Partial pivoting keeps all multipliers within $|m_{ik}|\le1$, controlling rounding-error growth; a tiny pivot without row swaps amplifies errors by $|a_{ik}/a_{kk}|$, the main source of instability in direct methods.
Cost: about $\frac{n^3}{3}$ multiplications for elimination and $\frac{n^2}{2}$ for back substitution, i.e. $O(n^3)$ — far better than expanding by definition.
Factor once, solve many times: with $L$ and $U$ stored, each new right-hand side needs only two triangular solves ($O(n^2)$ each), ideal for many right-hand sides and iterative refinement.

For symmetric positive definite matrices the Cholesky factorization $A=LL^{\top}$ costs about $\frac{n^3}{6}$, needs no pivoting and is stable; but an ill-conditioned system remains sensitive to perturbations regardless of the algorithm.

examples.problem: 用高斯消元法解方程组 $2x_1+x_2-x_3=8$，$-3x_1-x_2+2x_3=-11$，$-2x_1+x_2+2x_3=-3$，并写出系数矩阵的 Doolittle 分解。
examples.solution:
增广矩阵为
$$\left(\begin{array}{ccc|c}2&1&-1&8\\-3&-1&2&-11\\-2&1&2&-3\end{array}\right).$$
第 1 步：$m_{21}=-\frac32$、$m_{31}=-1$，消去第 2、3 行的 $x_1$，得 $(0,\frac12,\frac12\,|\,1)$、$(0,2,1\,|\,5)$；第 2 步：$m_{32}=4$，消去第 3 行的 $x_2$，得 $(0,0,-1\,|\,1)$。回代：$x_3=-1$，$x_2=\frac{1-\frac12\cdot(-1)}{\frac12}=3$，$x_1=\frac{8-1\cdot3-(-1)\cdot(-1)}{2}=2$，所以 $x=(2,3,-1)^{\top}$。Doolittle 分解为
$$L=\begin{pmatrix}1&0&0\\-\frac32&1&0\\-1&4&1\end{pmatrix},\qquad U=\begin{pmatrix}2&1&-1\\0&\frac12&\frac12\\0&0&-1\end{pmatrix},$$
直接验证 $LU=A$；对同一 $A$ 更换右端项时，只需再做一次前代与回代。

examples.problem: 对对称正定矩阵 $A=\begin{pmatrix}4&2\\2&3\end{pmatrix}$ 求 Cholesky 分解，并用它解 $Ax=(6,5)^{\top}$。

nodes.title: 线性方程组的迭代解法
nodes.summary: 把 Ax=b 变成不动点迭代：雅可比逐点用旧值、高斯-赛德尔立即用新值；收敛的充要条件是迭代矩阵谱半径 ρ(B)<1，严格对角占优是充分条件而非必要条件，高斯-赛德尔通常更快但并非总是。
nodes.summaryEn: Turn Ax=b into a fixed-point iteration: Jacobi uses only old values while Gauss-Seidel uses updated values immediately; convergence holds if and only if the iteration matrix has spectral radius ρ(B)<1, strict diagonal dominance is a sufficient but not necessary condition, and Gauss-Seidel is usually but not always faster.
nodes.definition:
直接法作用于大型稀疏系统时会因「填元」而破坏稀疏性，迭代法则从初始猜测出发逐步改进。把系数矩阵按对角、严格下三角、严格上三角分解：$A=D+L+U$（$D$ 为对角部分，$L$、$U$ 分别为严格下三角与严格上三角部分）。**雅可比迭代**每步只用上一步的旧值计算全部新值：
$$x_i^{(k+1)}=\frac{1}{a_{ii}}\Big(b_i-\sum_{j\neq i}a_{ij}x_j^{(k)}\Big),\qquad i=1,\dots,n,$$
矩阵形式为 $x^{(k+1)}=B_Jx^{(k)}+D^{-1}b$，其中 $B_J=-D^{-1}(L+U)$ 称为雅可比迭代矩阵。

**高斯-赛德尔迭代**只改一处：计算 $x_i^{(k+1)}$ 时，前面已经算出的新值 $x_j^{(k+1)}$（$j<i$）立即投入使用：
$$x_i^{(k+1)}=\frac{1}{a_{ii}}\Big(b_i-\sum_{j<i}a_{ij}x_j^{(k+1)}-\sum_{j>i}a_{ij}x_j^{(k)}\Big),$$
矩阵形式为 $x^{(k+1)}=B_Gx^{(k)}+(D+L)^{-1}b$，$B_G=-(D+L)^{-1}U$。两者都收敛时，高斯-赛德尔通常只需要雅可比一半左右的迭代次数，代价是必须按分量顺序更新、不易并行。

收敛性判据：两种方法都是定常迭代 $x^{(k+1)}=Bx^{(k)}+f$，对任意初始向量都收敛的**充要条件是迭代矩阵的谱半径 $\rho(B)<1$**（$\rho$ 为特征值模的最大值）；此时误差按 $\rho(B)$ 的速率线性衰减：$\|x^{(k)}-x^{*}\|\lesssim\rho(B)^k\|x^{(0)}-x^{*}\|$。既然是充要条件，$ho(B)$ 比任何充分条件都准确，只是计算特征值本身也有代价。

实践中常用的**充分条件**是严格对角占优：若 $|a_{ii}|>\sum_{j\neq i}|a_{ij}|$（每个对角元的绝对值都严格大于同行其它元素绝对值之和）对每一行成立，则雅可比与高斯-赛德尔都收敛。务必记住它**只是充分条件、不是必要条件**：存在不严格对角占优却仍然收敛的矩阵，例如 $A=\begin{pmatrix}2&1\\1&1\end{pmatrix}$ 有 $\rho(B_J)=\frac{1}{\sqrt2}<1$。另外，对三对角（更一般地，正则排列）矩阵有 $\rho(B_G)=\rho(B_J)^2$，所以高斯-赛德尔通常把每步误差因子平方、快约一倍；但一般情形下它并非总是更快——存在雅可比收敛而高斯-赛德尔发散的系数矩阵，所以「高斯-赛德尔一定比雅可比快」的说法不成立。
nodes.definitionEn:
Direct methods lose sparsity on large systems, so iterative methods start from a guess and improve it. Split the matrix into diagonal, strictly lower and strictly upper parts: $A=D+L+U$. The **Jacobi iteration** uses only old values:
$$x_i^{(k+1)}=\frac{1}{a_{ii}}\Big(b_i-\sum_{j\neq i}a_{ij}x_j^{(k)}\Big),\qquad i=1,\dots,n,$$
in matrix form $x^{(k+1)}=B_Jx^{(k)}+D^{-1}b$, with the Jacobi iteration matrix $B_J=-D^{-1}(L+U)$.

The **Gauss-Seidel iteration** changes one thing: when computing $x_i^{(k+1)}$, the values already updated, $x_j^{(k+1)}$ with $j<i$, are used immediately:
$$x_i^{(k+1)}=\frac{1}{a_{ii}}\Big(b_i-\sum_{j<i}a_{ij}x_j^{(k+1)}-\sum_{j>i}a_{ij}x_j^{(k)}\Big),$$
in matrix form $x^{(k+1)}=B_Gx^{(k)}+(D+L)^{-1}b$, with $B_G=-(D+L)^{-1}U$. When both converge, Gauss-Seidel typically needs roughly half as many iterations as Jacobi, at the price of sequential updates that are harder to parallelize.

Convergence: both are stationary iterations $x^{(k+1)}=Bx^{(k)}+f$, and they converge from every starting vector **if and only if the spectral radius of the iteration matrix satisfies $\rho(B)<1$** ($\rho$ = largest eigenvalue modulus). The error then decays linearly at rate $\rho(B)$: $\|x^{(k)}-x^{*}\|\lesssim\rho(B)^k\|x^{(0)}-x^{*}\|$. Being an if-and-only-if criterion, $\rho(B)$ is sharp — computing eigenvalues has its own cost, though.

A convenient **sufficient** condition in practice is strict diagonal dominance: if $|a_{ii}|>\sum_{j\neq i}|a_{ij}|$ for every row, both Jacobi and Gauss-Seidel converge. Remember this is sufficient but **not necessary**: matrices failing it may still converge, e.g. $A=\begin{pmatrix}2&1\\1&1\end{pmatrix}$ has $\rho(B_J)=\frac{1}{\sqrt2}<1$. Moreover, for tridiagonal (more generally, consistently ordered) matrices $\rho(B_G)=\rho(B_J)^2$, so Gauss-Seidel typically squares the error factor and is about twice as fast; in general, however, it is not always faster — there are matrices where Jacobi converges while Gauss-Seidel diverges, so it is false that Gauss-Seidel is always faster than Jacobi.

formulas.note: 雅可比迭代及其迭代矩阵：每步只用旧值，各分量可以并行计算。
formulas.noteEn: The Jacobi iteration and its matrix: only old values are used, so all components can be updated in parallel.

formulas.note: 高斯-赛德尔迭代及其迭代矩阵：新值立即使用，通常收敛更快，但必须串行更新。
formulas.noteEn: The Gauss-Seidel iteration and its matrix: updated values are used at once, usually converging faster but requiring sequential updates.

formulas.note: 收敛的充要条件（谱半径判据）；误差衰减因子为 $\rho(B)$，$\|x^{(k)}-x^{*}\|\lesssim\rho(B)^k\|x^{(0)}-x^{*}\|$。
formulas.noteEn: The necessary and sufficient spectral radius criterion; the error decays with factor $\rho(B)$, i.e. $\|x^{(k)}-x^{*}\|\lesssim\rho(B)^k\|x^{(0)}-x^{*}\|$.

formulas.latex: |a_{ii}|>\sum_{j\neq i}|a_{ij}|\ (i=1,\dots,n)\ \Longrightarrow\ \text{Jacobi 与 G-S 均收敛}
formulas.note: 严格对角占优是充分条件而非必要条件：不占优时收敛与否要用 $\rho(B)$ 判断。
formulas.noteEn: Strict diagonal dominance is sufficient but not necessary: without it, convergence must be decided by $\rho(B)$.

formulas.note: 正则排列矩阵中高斯-赛德尔把每步误差因子平方，通常快约一倍；一般矩阵并无此保证（可能更慢甚至发散）。
formulas.noteEn: For consistently ordered matrices Gauss-Seidel squares the error factor per step, typically twice as fast; general matrices offer no such guarantee (it can be slower, even divergent).

expression.note: 两种迭代是同一个框架，区别只在迭代矩阵 $B_J$、$B_G$；收敛与否完全由 $\rho(B)$ 决定。
expression.noteEn: Both methods share one framework, differing only in the iteration matrix $B_J$ or $B_G$; convergence depends entirely on $\rho(B)$.

properties: 收敛的充要条件是迭代矩阵谱半径 $\rho(B)<1$；误差长期按 $\rho(B)^k$ 衰减，$\rho(B)$ 越小越快。既然是充要条件，不能用严格对角占优来「判定不收敛」。
严格对角占优蕴含两种方法都收敛；但这是充分不必要条件——例如 $A=\begin{pmatrix}2&1\\1&1\end{pmatrix}$ 不严格占优，而 $\rho(B_J)=\frac{1}{\sqrt2}\approx0.707<1$ 仍然收敛。
高斯-赛德尔通常比雅可比快：三对角（正则排列）矩阵满足 $\rho(B_G)=\rho(B_J)^2$，误差因子被平方；但对一般矩阵并不保证——存在雅可比收敛而高斯-赛德尔发散的例子。
实现与并行性：雅可比每步各分量互不依赖，适合向量化/并行计算；高斯-赛德尔必须按分量顺序更新，但通常迭代次数更少。
迭代法保持矩阵稀疏性、每步只需 $O(\mathrm{nnz})$ 量级的运算，适合大型稀疏系统；引入松弛因子的 SOR 方法可进一步加速（正则排列矩阵的最优因子为 $\omega=\frac{2}{1+\sqrt{1-\rho(B_J)^2}}$）。
propertiesEn: Convergence holds if and only if $\rho(B)<1$; the error decays like $\rho(B)^k$, faster for smaller $\rho(B)$. Since this is an equivalence, strict diagonal dominance cannot be used to certify divergence.

Strict diagonal dominance implies convergence of both methods, but it is only sufficient: e.g. $A=\begin{pmatrix}2&1\\1&1\end{pmatrix}$ is not strictly dominant yet $\rho(B_J)=\frac{1}{\sqrt2}\approx0.707<1$, so Jacobi converges.

Gauss-Seidel is usually faster than Jacobi: for tridiagonal (consistently ordered) matrices $\rho(B_G)=\rho(B_J)^2$; in general it is not guaranteed — there are matrices where Jacobi converges while Gauss-Seidel diverges.
Implementation and parallelism: Jacobi updates are independent and vectorize/parallelize easily; Gauss-Seidel must update sequentially but usually needs fewer iterations.

Iterative methods preserve sparsity and cost $O(\mathrm{nnz})$ per sweep, ideal for large sparse systems; SOR adds a relaxation factor for further speed-up (optimal $\omega=\frac{2}{1+\sqrt{1-\rho(B_J)^2}}$ for consistently ordered matrices).

examples.problem: 用雅可比与高斯-赛德尔迭代解方程组 $2x_1+x_2=5$，$x_1+3x_2=6$，从 $x^{(0)}=(0,0)$ 出发比较前两步的误差。
验证 $A=\begin{pmatrix}2&1\\1&1\end{pmatrix}$ 不是严格对角占优，但雅可比迭代仍然收敛。
examples.solution: 第二行 $|a_{22}|=1$ 不严格大于 $|a_{21}|=1$，故不满足严格对角占优。此时 $D=\mathrm{diag}(2,1)$，$B_J=-D^{-1}(L+U)=\begin{pmatrix}0&-\frac12\\-1&0\end{pmatrix}$，特征值为 $\pm\frac{1}{\sqrt2}$，$\rho(B_J)=\frac{1}{\sqrt2}\approx0.707<1$，由充要条件知雅可比收敛（同理 $B_G=\begin{pmatrix}0&-\frac12\\0&\frac12\end{pmatrix}$ 的谱半径为 $\frac12<1$，高斯-赛德尔也收敛）。这说明严格对角占优只是充分条件：不满足时应当用谱半径来判断。

nodes.title: 插值法：拉格朗日插值与牛顿插值
nodes.summary: 用次数不超过 n 的多项式穿过 n+1 个节点：插值多项式存在且唯一，拉格朗日形式给出显式构造，牛顿差商形式便于逐步加密节点。
nodes.summaryEn: A polynomial of degree at most n passing through n+1 data points: it exists and is unique, with explicit Lagrange and Newton divided-difference constructions and a remainder controlled by the (n+1)-st derivative.
nodes.definition:
给定区间 $[a,b]$ 上的 $n+1$ 个互异节点 $x_0<x_1<\cdots<x_n$ 及对应的函数值 $y_0,\dots,y_n$（来自已知函数 $f$ 或观测数据），求一个次数不超过 $n$ 的多项式 $P(x)$，使
$$P(x_i)=y_i,\qquad i=0,1,\dots,n.$$
这就是**插值问题**：$P$ 称为**插值多项式**，$x_i$ 称为插值节点。把 $P(x)=a_0+a_1x+\cdots+a_nx^n$ 代入条件，得到关于系数的线性方程组，其系数矩阵是**范德蒙德矩阵**，行列式为 $\prod_{i>j}(x_i-x_j)\neq0$，因此**插值多项式存在且唯一**：$n+1$ 个互异点唯一决定一个次数不超过 $n$ 的多项式。

**拉格朗日形式**把唯一性变成显式公式。对每个 $k$ 构造**基函数**
$$l_k(x)=\prod_{j\neq k}\frac{x-x_j}{x_k-x_j},$$
它是 $n$ 次多项式，满足 $l_k(x_i)=\delta_{ki}$（在 $x_k$ 处取 $1$、在其它节点处取 $0$），于是 $P(x)=\sum_{k=0}^{n}y_k\,l_k(x)$ 自动满足插值条件。这也顺便给出唯一性的简明证明：若 $P,Q$ 都插值，则 $P-Q$ 次数 $\le n$ 却有 $n+1$ 个零点，只能恒等于零。

**牛顿差商形式**是同一个多项式的另一种写法：
$$N(x)=f[x_0]+f[x_0,x_1](x-x_0)+f[x_0,x_1,x_2](x-x_0)(x-x_1)+\cdots,$$
其中 $k$ 阶差商由递推 $f[x_i,\dots,x_{i+k}]=\dfrac{f[x_{i+1},\dots,x_{i+k}]-f[x_i,\dots,x_{i+k-1}]}{x_{i+k}-x_i}$ 计算，手算时排成**差商表**。它的好处是：增加一个新节点只需在表尾续算，不必重做全部基函数。

**插值余项**：若 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上有 $n+1$ 阶导数，则对任意 $x\in[a,b]$，
$$R(x)=f(x)-P(x)=\frac{f^{(n+1)}(\xi)}{(n+1)!}\,\omega(x),\qquad \omega(x)=\prod_{i=0}^{n}(x-x_i),$$
其中 $\xi$ 介于 $x$ 与全部节点所张成的区间之内（依赖于 $x$）。误差在节点处为零、在节点之间被 $\omega$ 放大，因此节点越密通常越准；但这并不绝对——对 $f(x)=\dfrac{1}{1+25x^2}$ 取 $[−1,1]$ 上的等距节点，$n=10$ 时插值多项式在两端剧烈振荡（最大偏差约 $1.9$），这就是**龙格现象**，它催生了样条插值与切比雪夫节点等更稳健的方法。
nodes.definitionEn:
Given $n+1$ distinct nodes $x_0<x_1<\cdots<x_n$ in $[a,b]$ with values $y_0,\dots,y_n$ (from a known function $f$ or from data), find a polynomial $P(x)$ of degree at most $n$ such that
$$P(x_i)=y_i,\qquad i=0,1,\dots,n.$$
This is the **interpolation problem**; $P$ is the **interpolating polynomial**. Writing $P(x)=a_0+a_1x+\cdots+a_nx^n$ and substituting the conditions gives a linear system whose matrix is the **Vandermonde matrix** with determinant $\prod_{i>j}(x_i-x_j)\neq0$. Hence the interpolating polynomial **exists and is unique**: $n+1$ distinct points determine exactly one polynomial of degree at most $n$.

The **Lagrange form** turns uniqueness into an explicit formula. For each $k$ define the **basis functions**
$$l_k(x)=\prod_{j\neq k}\frac{x-x_j}{x_k-x_j},$$
which have degree $n$ and satisfy $l_k(x_i)=\delta_{ki}$ (equal to $1$ at $x_k$ and $0$ at the other nodes). Then $P(x)=\sum_{k=0}^{n}y_k\,l_k(x)$ interpolates automatically. This also yields a one-line proof of uniqueness: if $P$ and $Q$ both interpolate, then $P-Q$ has degree $\le n$ but $n+1$ zeros, so it vanishes identically.

The **Newton divided-difference form** is another way to write the same polynomial:
$$N(x)=f[x_0]+f[x_0,x_1](x-x_0)+f[x_0,x_1,x_2](x-x_0)(x-x_1)+\cdots,$$
where divided differences are built by the recursion $f[x_i,\dots,x_{i+k}]=\dfrac{f[x_{i+1},\dots,x_{i+k}]-f[x_i,\dots,x_{i+k-1}]}{x_{i+k}-x_i}$ and computed in a **divided-difference table**. Its advantage: adding a new node only requires extending the table, not rebuilding all basis functions.

The **interpolation remainder** reads: if $f$ has $n+1$ derivatives on $[a,b]$, then for every $x\in[a,b]$,
$$R(x)=f(x)-P(x)=\frac{f^{(n+1)}(\xi)}{(n+1)!}\,\omega(x),\qquad \omega(x)=\prod_{i=0}^{n}(x-x_i),$$
with $\xi$ lying between $x$ and the nodes (it depends on $x$). The error vanishes at the nodes and is amplified between them by $\omega$, so denser nodes usually help — but not always: for $f(x)=\dfrac{1}{1+25x^2}$ on equally spaced nodes in $[−1,1]$, the degree-$10$ interpolant oscillates wildly near the ends (maximum deviation about $1.9$). This is the **Runge phenomenon**, which motivated spline interpolation and Chebyshev nodes.

formulas.note: 插值问题的提法。系数矩阵是范德蒙德矩阵，行列式不为零，所以插值多项式存在且唯一。
formulas.noteEn: The interpolation problem. The coefficient matrix is Vandermonde with nonzero determinant, so the interpolating polynomial exists and is unique.

formulas.note: 拉格朗日基函数：每个 $l_k$ 在 $x_k$ 处为 1、在其它节点处为 0；基函数之和恒等于 1。
formulas.noteEn: Lagrange basis functions: $l_k$ equals 1 at $x_k$ and 0 at the other nodes, and the basis sums to 1 identically.

formulas.note: 拉格朗日插值公式：由基函数的 $\delta$ 性质，代入每个节点都恰好得到 $y_k$。
formulas.noteEn: Lagrange's formula: the delta property of the basis makes $P(x_i)=y_i$ for every node.

formulas.note: 插值余项（误差公式）：要求 $f$ 有 $n+1$ 阶导数，$\xi$ 介于 $x$ 与节点之间。可推出误差上界 $|R(x)|\le\frac{M_{n+1}}{(n+1)!}|\omega(x)|$。
formulas.noteEn: The interpolation remainder: it needs $n+1$ derivatives of $f$, with $\xi$ between $x$ and the nodes. It yields the bound $|R(x)|\le\frac{M_{n+1}}{(n+1)!}|\omega(x)|$.

formulas.note: 牛顿差商形式与差商递推；与拉格朗日形式给出同一个多项式，只是按节点逐个添加。
formulas.noteEn: Newton's divided-difference form and the recursion; it gives the same polynomial as the Lagrange form, built node by node.

expression.text: P(x) = Σ yₖ lₖ(x)
expression.note: 拉格朗日表示：插值多项式是基函数的线性组合，系数就是节点函数值 $y_k$。
expression.noteEn: Lagrange representation: the interpolant is a linear combination of the basis functions with the data values as coefficients.

properties: 存在唯一性：$n+1$ 个互异节点唯一决定一个次数不超过 $n$ 的插值多项式；证明用范德蒙德行列式或「两个解之差有 $n+1$ 个零点」。
拉格朗日基满足 $l_k(x_i)=\delta_{ki}$ 且 $\sum_k l_k(x)\equiv1$：前者保证插值、后者说明常函数能被精确重现。
余项公式 $R(x)=\frac{f^{(n+1)}(\xi)}{(n+1)!}\omega(x)$ 给出误差结构：节点处误差为零，节点之间由 $\omega$ 放大；$\xi$ 未知，一般用于估计误差上界。
拉格朗日与牛顿形式给出同一个多项式；牛顿差商形式便于逐步添加节点（差商表只加一行），适合流水式计算。
龙格现象：等距节点上高阶插值多项式可能剧烈振荡、随节点加密不收敛（如 $1/(1+25x^2)$ 在 $[-1,1]$ 上），所以实用中更常用分段低次插值、三次样条或切比雪夫节点。
propertiesEn: Existence and uniqueness: $n+1$ distinct nodes determine exactly one interpolant of degree at most $n$; prove it via the Vandermonde determinant or by noting that the difference of two solutions has $n+1$ zeros.
The Lagrange basis satisfies $l_k(x_i)=\delta_{ki}$ and $\sum_k l_k(x)\equiv1$: the first property gives interpolation, the second shows constants are reproduced exactly.
The remainder $R(x)=\frac{f^{(n+1)}(\xi)}{(n+1)!}\omega(x)$ reveals the error structure: zero at the nodes and amplified in between by $\omega$; $\xi$ is unknown, so it is used for error bounds.
The Lagrange and Newton forms give the same polynomial; the divided-difference form makes adding a node cheap (extend one row of the table), ideal for incremental computation.

Runge phenomenon: with equally spaced nodes a high-degree interpolant can oscillate badly and fail to converge as nodes are added (e.g. $1/(1+25x^2)$ on $[-1,1]$); piecewise low-degree interpolation, cubic splines or Chebyshev nodes are the practical cure.

functions.label: 10 次插值多项式 P₁₀（11 个等距节点）

plot.title: 龙格现象：等距节点上的高阶插值多项式在两端剧烈振荡

examples.problem: 已知 $f$ 在 $x=1,2,4$ 处取值 $0,2,12$，用差商表写出牛顿插值多项式。

nodes.title: 三次样条插值
nodes.summary: 分段三次多项式拼成的插值函数，整体二阶连续可导；由三弯矩方程加两个边界条件唯一确定，光滑稳定、没有龙格现象。
nodes.summaryEn: A piecewise cubic interpolant that is twice continuously differentiable on the whole interval, determined uniquely by the three-moment equations plus two boundary conditions — smooth, stable and free of the Runge phenomenon.
nodes.definition:
三次样条的思路是把区间分段，每段用一个低次多项式，再让相邻两段在节点处光滑地接起来。设节点 $x_0<x_1<\cdots<x_n$ 与函数值 $y_0,\dots,y_n$。若函数 $S$ 满足：
1. 在每个子区间 $[x_i,x_{i+1}]$ 上 $S$ 是三次多项式
$$S_i(x)=a_i+b_i(x-x_i)+c_i(x-x_i)^2+d_i(x-x_i)^3;$$
2. 插值条件 $S(x_i)=y_i$（$i=0,\dots,n$）；
3. **整体二阶连续可导**，即 $S\in C^2[x_0,x_n]$：每个内节点处 $S$、$S'$、$S''$ 都连续；
则称 $S$ 为**三次样条插值函数**。

自由度计数：$n$ 段共有 $4n$ 个待定系数，插值条件 $n+1$ 条、内节点连续性条件 $3(n-1)$ 条，共 $4n-2$ 条，因此还缺 **2 个边界条件**。常用的三类是：**自然边界** $S''(x_0)=S''(x_n)=0$；**固定（夹持）边界** $S'(x_0)=y_0'$、$S'(x_n)=y_n'$（端点导数已知）；**周期边界** $S'(x_0)=S'(x_n)$、$S''(x_0)=S''(x_n)$（适用于周期数据）。在这三类边界条件下，三次样条插值函数都存在且唯一。

实际求解用**三弯矩方程**：记 $h_i=x_{i+1}-x_i$，$M_i=S''(x_i)$，则每个内节点满足
$$\mu_i M_{i-1}+2M_i+\lambda_i M_{i+1}=d_i,$$
其中 $\mu_i=\dfrac{h_{i-1}}{h_{i-1}+h_i}$，$\lambda_i=1-\mu_i$，$d_i=\dfrac{6}{h_{i-1}+h_i}\Big[\dfrac{y_{i+1}-y_i}{h_i}-\dfrac{y_i-y_{i-1}}{h_{i-1}}\Big]$。系数矩阵三对角且**严格对角占优**，故存在唯一并可用追赶法（Thomas 算法）以 $O(n)$ 的代价解出全部 $M_i$，再代回分段公式
$$S_i(x)=\frac{M_i(x_{i+1}-x)^3+M_{i+1}(x-x_i)^3}{6h_i}+\Big(\frac{y_i}{h_i}-\frac{M_ih_i}{6}\Big)(x_{i+1}-x)+\Big(\frac{y_{i+1}}{h_i}-\frac{M_{i+1}h_i}{6}\Big)(x-x_i).$$

若 $f\in C^4$，固定边界下的误差满足 $\max|f-S|\le\dfrac{5}{384}h^4\max|f^{(4)}|$（$h=\max h_i$），即 $O(h^4)$ 的高阶收敛，而且不会像高阶多项式插值那样出现端点振荡。
nodes.definitionEn:
Cubic spline interpolation splits the interval into pieces, uses a low-degree polynomial on each piece, and joins the pieces smoothly at the nodes. Given nodes $x_0<x_1<\cdots<x_n$ with values $y_0,\dots,y_n$, a function $S$ is called a **cubic spline interpolant** if:
1. on each subinterval $[x_i,x_{i+1}]$, $S$ is a cubic polynomial
$$S_i(x)=a_i+b_i(x-x_i)+c_i(x-x_i)^2+d_i(x-x_i)^3;$$
2. $S(x_i)=y_i$ for $i=0,\dots,n$;
3. **$S$ is twice continuously differentiable**, i.e. $S\in C^2[x_0,x_n]$: at every interior node $S$, $S'$ and $S''$ are continuous.

Counting degrees of freedom: $n$ pieces carry $4n$ coefficients, while interpolation gives $n+1$ conditions and continuity at interior nodes gives $3(n-1)$ conditions — $4n-2$ in total. So **two boundary conditions** are still needed. The three standard choices are: **natural boundary** $S''(x_0)=S''(x_n)=0$; **clamped boundary** $S'(x_0)=y_0'$, $S'(x_n)=y_n'$ (known endpoint slopes); **periodic boundary** $S'(x_0)=S'(x_n)$, $S''(x_0)=S''(x_n)$ (periodic data). Under any of these, the cubic spline interpolant exists and is unique.

Computationally one solves the **three-moment equations**. Let $h_i=x_{i+1}-x_i$ and $M_i=S''(x_i)$; then at every interior node
$$\mu_i M_{i-1}+2M_i+\lambda_i M_{i+1}=d_i,$$
with $\mu_i=\dfrac{h_{i-1}}{h_{i-1}+h_i}$, $\lambda_i=1-\mu_i$, $d_i=\dfrac{6}{h_{i-1}+h_i}\Big[\dfrac{y_{i+1}-y_i}{h_i}-\dfrac{y_i-y_{i-1}}{h_{i-1}}\Big]$. The coefficient matrix is tridiagonal and strictly diagonally dominant, so the solution is unique and the Thomas algorithm computes all $M_i$ in $O(n)$ time; substituting back gives
$$S_i(x)=\frac{M_i(x_{i+1}-x)^3+M_{i+1}(x-x_i)^3}{6h_i}+\Big(\frac{y_i}{h_i}-\frac{M_ih_i}{6}\Big)(x_{i+1}-x)+\Big(\frac{y_{i+1}}{h_i}-\frac{M_{i+1}h_i}{6}\Big)(x-x_i).$$

If $f\in C^4$, the clamped spline satisfies $\max|f-S|\le\dfrac{5}{384}h^4\max|f^{(4)}|$ with $h=\max h_i$ — high-order $O(h^4)$ convergence without the endpoint oscillations of high-degree polynomial interpolation.

formulas.note: 定义：每段是三次多项式，整体二阶连续可导——比分段线性光滑，比高次多项式稳定。
formulas.noteEn: Definition: a cubic on each piece, globally $C^2$ — smoother than piecewise linear, more stable than a single high-degree polynomial.

formulas.note: 三弯矩方程（内节点）。$M_i=S''(x_i)$；右端 $d_i=\frac{6}{h_{i-1}+h_i}\big[\frac{y_{i+1}-y_i}{h_i}-\frac{y_i-y_{i-1}}{h_{i-1}}\big]$，系数矩阵三对角且严格对角占优。
formulas.noteEn: The three-moment equations at interior nodes, with $M_i=S''(x_i)$ and right-hand side $d_i=\frac{6}{h_{i-1}+h_i}\big[\frac{y_{i+1}-y_i}{h_i}-\frac{y_i-y_{i-1}}{h_{i-1}}\big]$; the matrix is tridiagonal and strictly diagonally dominant.

formulas.note: 三类常用边界条件。补上其中任意一类（两个条件）后，三次样条插值函数存在且唯一。
formulas.noteEn: The three standard boundary conditions; adding any one pair makes the cubic spline interpolant exist and be unique.

formulas.note: 解出三弯矩后计算样条值的分段公式：只用到相邻两个节点上的 $y$ 与 $M$。
formulas.noteEn: The piecewise evaluation formula once the moments are known; it uses only the data and moments at two adjacent nodes.

formulas.note: 误差估计：$O(h^4)$ 的收敛速度远快于分段线性（$O(h^2)$），且不存在龙格式振荡。
formulas.noteEn: Error bound for the clamped spline: $O(h^4)$ convergence, far better than piecewise linear ($O(h^2)$), with no Runge-type oscillation.

expression.text: S(x) 分段三次，S ∈ C²[x₀, xₙ]
expression.note: 每段三次、整体二阶连续，这两条决定了样条的形状与光滑性。
expression.noteEn: Cubic on each piece and globally $C^2$: these two requirements shape the spline and guarantee its smoothness.

properties: 整体二阶连续可导（$C^2$），因此图像光滑、曲率连续，不会像高阶插值那样在端点剧烈振荡。
三类边界（自然、固定、周期）下三次样条插值都存在且唯一；三弯矩方程组三对角且严格对角占优，追赶法 $O(n)$ 求解。
误差：固定边界下 $\max|f-S|\le\frac{5}{384}h^4\max|f^{(4)}|$；自然边界内部也是 $O(h^4)$，但端点附近当 $f''\neq0$ 时可能退化到 $O(h^2)$。
局部性：改变一个数据点只影响附近的少数几段（三对角结构），不像全局多项式那样牵一发而动全身。
自然三次样条具有最小弯曲性质：在所有满足插值条件的 $C^2$ 函数中，它使 $\int_{x_0}^{x_n}(S'')^2\,dx$ 最小，即「曲率能量」最小。
propertiesEn: Globally $C^2$: the curve and its curvature are continuous, with none of the wild endpoint oscillations of high-degree interpolation.

With any of the three boundary types (natural, clamped, periodic) the cubic spline interpolant exists and is unique; the three-moment system is tridiagonal and strictly diagonally dominant, solvable by the Thomas algorithm in $O(n)$.

Error: for clamped boundary conditions $\max|f-S|\le\frac{5}{384}h^4\max|f^{(4)}|$; for the natural spline the interior is still $O(h^4)$, but near the endpoints it may degrade to $O(h^2)$ when $f''\neq0$.
Locality: changing one data point affects only a few neighbouring pieces (tridiagonal structure), unlike a global polynomial where everything moves.
The natural cubic spline has the least-bending property: among all interpolating $C^2$ functions it minimizes $\int_{x_0}^{x_n}(S'')^2\,dx$, the bending energy of the curve.

functions.label: 自然三次样条（同样 11 个节点）

plot.title: 三次样条插值：同一批等距节点上的光滑逼近（对比龙格函数）

examples.problem: 用 $[-1,1]$ 上的 11 个等距节点分别做 10 次多项式插值和自然三次样条插值，逼近 $f(x)=\frac{1}{1+25x^2}$，比较误差。
examples.solution: 两种方法都严格穿过全部 11 个节点，但表现完全不同：10 次多项式在 $|x|\approx0.94$ 处冲到约 $1.96$，与 $f$ 的最大偏差约 $1.92$（龙格现象）；自然三次样条的最大偏差仅约 $0.022$，且曲线光滑。同为插值，分段三次加 $C^2$ 光滑性的方案稳定得多。

nodes.title: 最小二乘拟合
nodes.summary: 在选定模型类中极小化残差平方和来拟合带噪声的数据；线性模型的正规方程 AᵀA c = Aᵀb 给出唯一解，几何上是正交投影。
nodes.summaryEn: Fit noisy data by minimizing the sum of squared residuals over a chosen model class; for linear models the normal equations AᵀA c = Aᵀb give the unique solution, interpreted geometrically as an orthogonal projection.
nodes.definition:
实测数据往往带有误差，若像插值那样要求曲线穿过每个数据点，就把噪声也「插」了进去。**最小二乘拟合**改变标准：先选定模型类（例如直线 $\varphi(x)=c_0+c_1x$，或一般的线性组合 $\varphi(x)=\sum_{j=1}^{n}c_j\varphi_j(x)$），再让**残差平方和**
$$Q(c)=\sum_{i=1}^{m}\big(y_i-\varphi(x_i;c)\big)^2$$
最小化；$r_i=y_i-\varphi(x_i;c)$ 称为**残差**。平方的好处是可导、并把正负偏差一起度量；代价是放大了离群点的影响。

对一般（关于系数）线性的模型，把数据写成矩阵形式 $Ac\approx b$，其中 $A_{ij}=\varphi_j(x_i)$ 是 $m\times n$ 矩阵，$b=(y_1,\dots,y_m)^{\top}$，问题就是极小化 $\|Ac-b\|^2$。对每个系数求偏导并令其为零（$\partial Q/\partial c_j=0$），得到**正规方程**
$$A^{\top}A\,c=A^{\top}b.$$
只要 $A$ 列满秩（$n$ 个基函数在数据点上线性无关），$A^{\top}A$ 就对称正定，解存在且唯一；几何上 $Ac$ 是 $b$ 在 $A$ 的列空间上的**正交投影**，残差向量与列空间正交（$A^{\top}(b-Ac)=0$）。

最简单的情形是直线拟合，可直接写出闭式解：
$$c_1=\frac{m\sum x_iy_i-\sum x_i\sum y_i}{m\sum x_i^2-(\sum x_i)^2},\qquad c_0=\bar y-c_1\bar x.$$
最小二乘与插值的区别是本质性的：它不要求过点，用残差平方和（或决定系数 $R^2$）衡量拟合优度；多项式、样条、三角函数等都可充当基函数，而 $\varphi=ae^{bx}$ 这类非线性模型可通过取对数线性化或高斯-牛顿迭代求解。
nodes.definitionEn:
Real data carry noise, and forcing a curve through every point (interpolation) also fits the noise. **Least squares fitting** changes the criterion: choose a model class (e.g. a line $\varphi(x)=c_0+c_1x$, or a general linear combination $\varphi(x)=\sum_{j=1}^{n}c_j\varphi_j(x)$) and minimize the **sum of squared residuals**
$$Q(c)=\sum_{i=1}^{m}\big(y_i-\varphi(x_i;c)\big)^2,$$
where $r_i=y_i-\varphi(x_i;c)$ is the **residual**. Squaring makes the objective differentiable and treats positive and negative deviations alike; the price is extra sensitivity to outliers.

For models linear in the coefficients, write the data as $Ac\approx b$ with $A_{ij}=\varphi_j(x_i)$ (an $m\times n$ matrix) and $b=(y_1,\dots,y_m)^{\top}$; the task is to minimize $\|Ac-b\|^2$. Setting all partial derivatives $\partial Q/\partial c_j$ to zero yields the **normal equations**
$$A^{\top}A\,c=A^{\top}b.$$
If $A$ has full column rank (the basis functions are linearly independent on the data points), then $A^{\top}A$ is symmetric positive definite, so the solution exists and is unique; geometrically $Ac$ is the **orthogonal projection** of $b$ onto the column space of $A$, and the residual is orthogonal to that space ($A^{\top}(b-Ac)=0$).

The simplest case is a straight line, with closed-form coefficients:
$$c_1=\frac{m\sum x_iy_i-\sum x_i\sum y_i}{m\sum x_i^2-(\sum x_i)^2},\qquad c_0=\bar y-c_1\bar x.$$
The difference from interpolation is essential: the curve need not pass through the points, and goodness of fit is measured by the residual sum of squares (or the coefficient of determination $R^2$). Polynomials, splines and trigonometric functions can all serve as basis functions, while nonlinear models such as $\varphi=ae^{bx}$ are handled by linearization or Gauss–Newton iteration.

formulas.note: 最小二乘准则：让残差（竖直偏差）平方和最小；不要求曲线穿过数据点。
formulas.noteEn: The least squares criterion: minimize the sum of squared vertical residuals; the curve need not pass through the data points.

formulas.note: 一般线性模型与矩阵写法：$\varphi_j$ 是任意选定的基函数（$1,x,x^2,\dots$）。
formulas.noteEn: A general linear model in matrix form, where $\varphi_j$ are chosen basis functions ($1,x,x^2,\dots$).

formulas.note: 正规方程：由 $\partial Q/\partial c_j=0$ 得到。$A$ 列满秩时 $A^{\top}A$ 对称正定，解唯一；几何上 $Ac$ 是 $b$ 在 $A$ 列空间上的正交投影。
formulas.noteEn: The normal equations, from $\partial Q/\partial c_j=0$. If $A$ has full column rank, $A^{\top}A$ is symmetric positive definite and the solution is unique; $Ac$ is the orthogonal projection of $b$ onto the column space.

formulas.latex: c_1=\frac{m\sum x_iy_i-\sum x_i\sum y_i}{m\sum x_i^2-(\sum x_i)^2},\qquad c_0=\bar y-c_1\bar x
formulas.note: 直线拟合的闭式解：回归直线过样本中心 $(\bar x,\bar y)$，斜率由协方差与方差之比给出。
formulas.noteEn: Closed form for a straight line: the regression line passes through $(\bar x,\bar y)$, and the slope is the ratio of covariance to variance.

formulas.note: 决定系数：模型解释的数据变差比例，越接近 1 线性拟合越好（但不代表模型本身一定合理）。
formulas.noteEn: Coefficient of determination: the fraction of data variation explained by the model; closer to 1 means a better fit, though not automatically a sensible model.

expression.text: min Σ (yᵢ − φ(xᵢ))²
expression.note: 记住正规方程就记住了线性最小二乘的一切：构造 $A$、解 $2\times2$ 或 $n\times n$ 的对称正定方程组。
expression.noteEn: The normal equations capture all of linear least squares: build $A$, then solve a symmetric positive-definite system.

properties: 正规方程的几何解释：残差向量 $b-Ac$ 与 $A$ 的每一列正交（$A^{\top}(b-Ac)=0$），$Ac$ 是 $b$ 在列空间上的正交投影。
唯一性：$A$ 列满秩时 $A^{\top}A$ 对称正定，拟合系数存在且唯一；若列相关（如重复基函数）则解不唯一。
与插值对比：拟合不穿过全部点，用平方和衡量整体偏差，能平滑掉噪声——点少模型强时会更稳。
对离群值敏感：平方损失放大大误差的权重；必要时改用加权最小二乘或稳健回归。
数值上正规方程会把条件数平方（$\kappa(A^{\top}A)=\kappa(A)^2$），病态数据宜用 QR 分解或 SVD 求解。
propertiesEn: Geometry: the residual $b-Ac$ is orthogonal to every column of $A$ ($A^{\top}(b-Ac)=0$), so $Ac$ is the orthogonal projection of $b$ onto the column space.
Uniqueness: with full column rank, $A^{\top}A$ is symmetric positive definite and the fitted coefficients are unique; dependent columns make the solution non-unique.
Unlike interpolation, the curve misses the points on purpose, balancing overall squared error and smoothing noise.
Sensitivity to outliers: the squared loss over-weights large residuals; weighted or robust least squares are the remedy.
Numerically, normal equations square the condition number ($\kappa(A^{\top}A)=\kappa(A)^2$); ill-conditioned problems are better solved by QR or SVD.

plot.title: 散点与最小二乘回归直线（9 个数据点，R² ≈ 0.993）

examples.solution:
$m=3$，$\sum x_i=6$，$\sum y_i=7$，$\sum x_iy_i=1+4+12=17$，$\sum x_i^2=1+4+9=14$。代入公式
$$c_1=\frac{3\cdot17-6\cdot7}{3\cdot14-6^2}=\frac{9}{6}=1.5,\qquad c_0=\frac73-1.5\cdot2=-\frac23,$$
所以 $y=1.5x-\frac23$。三个残差为 $\frac16,-\frac13,\frac16$，平方和 $Q=\frac16$，比任何其它直线都小。

nodes.title: 数值微分
nodes.summary: 用差商近似导数：前向差商误差 O(h)，中心差商误差 O(h²)；h 太小时舍入误差被放大，存在最优步长。
nodes.summaryEn: Approximate derivatives by difference quotients: forward differences are O(h), central differences are O(h²); too small a step amplifies rounding error, so an optimal step exists.
nodes.definition:
当函数只以表格形式给出、或者解析式太复杂时，可以用函数值的**差商**近似导数。起点是导数定义
$$f'(x)=\lim_{h\to0}\frac{f(x+h)-f(x)}{h}.$$
最直接的是**前向差商** $\dfrac{f(x+h)-f(x)}{h}$。由泰勒展开 $f(x+h)=f(x)+hf'(x)+\dfrac{h^2}{2}f''(\xi)$ 知，它等于 $f'(x)$ 加上约 $\dfrac{h}{2}f''(x)$ 的误差，即**截断误差为 $O(h)$**；**后向差商** $\dfrac{f(x)-f(x-h)}{h}$ 完全对称，误差也是 $O(h)$。

把泰勒展开写成两个方向再相减，偶次项全部抵消：
$$f(x+h)-f(x-h)=2hf'(x)+\frac{h^3}{3}f'''(\xi),$$
于是**中心差商**
$$\frac{f(x+h)-f(x-h)}{2h}=f'(x)+\frac{h^2}{6}f'''(\xi)$$
只有 $O(h^2)$ 的截断误差——用同样多的函数值，精度提高一阶，所以实用中优先用中心差商。**二阶导数**也有中心公式 $\dfrac{f(x+h)-2f(x)+f(x-h)}{h^2}=f''(x)+O(h^2)$。

数值微分有一个独特困难：**不稳定**。实际误差由两部分组成：截断误差约 $M h^2/6$（以中心差商为例，$M\approx|f'''|$）和舍入误差——两点函数值相减会产生抵消，误差约为机器精度 $\varepsilon$，再被除以 $h$，故舍入部分约 $\varepsilon/h$。二者之和在
$$h_*\approx\Big(\frac{3\varepsilon}{M}\Big)^{1/3}$$
处最小。对双精度（$\varepsilon\approx2.2\times10^{-16}$）和 $f=\sin$ 在 $x=1$ 处，$h_*$ 约 $10^{-5}$：$h$ 取得更小，结果反而越来越差。这和数值积分不同——积分是平滑算子的近似，而微分是「病态」放大算子的近似。
nodes.definitionEn:
When a function is known only through a table of values, or its formula is too complicated, derivatives are approximated by **difference quotients** starting from the definition
$$f'(x)=\lim_{h\to0}\frac{f(x+h)-f(x)}{h}.$$
The **forward difference** $\dfrac{f(x+h)-f(x)}{h}$ has, by Taylor expansion $f(x+h)=f(x)+hf'(x)+\dfrac{h^2}{2}f''(\xi)$, an error of about $\dfrac{h}{2}f''(x)$ — that is, **truncation error $O(h)$**; the **backward difference** $\dfrac{f(x)-f(x-h)}{h}$ is symmetric and also $O(h)$.

Subtracting the two Taylor expansions cancels all even-order terms:
$$f(x+h)-f(x-h)=2hf'(x)+\frac{h^3}{3}f'''(\xi),$$
so the **central difference**
$$\frac{f(x+h)-f(x-h)}{2h}=f'(x)+\frac{h^2}{6}f'''(\xi)$$
has truncation error only $O(h^2)$ — one order better for the same amount of work, which is why the central difference is preferred. The **second derivative** has the central formula $\dfrac{f(x+h)-2f(x)+f(x-h)}{h^2}=f''(x)+O(h^2)$.

Numerical differentiation has a distinctive difficulty: **instability**. The total error has two parts: truncation about $M h^2/6$ (for the central difference, $M\approx|f'''|$) and rounding — subtracting two nearby function values loses digits, contributing about the machine epsilon $\varepsilon$ divided by $h$, i.e. $\varepsilon/h$. Their sum is minimized at
$$h_*\approx\Big(\frac{3\varepsilon}{M}\Big)^{1/3}.$$
In double precision ($\varepsilon\approx2.2\times10^{-16}$) for $f=\sin$ at $x=1$, $h_*$ is about $10^{-5}$: making $h$ smaller than that only makes the answer worse. Unlike numerical integration, numerical differentiation approximates an ill-posed amplifying operator.

formulas.note: 前向差商：截断误差 $O(h)$；后向差商 $\frac{f(x)-f(x-h)}{h}$ 误差同样是一阶。
formulas.noteEn: Forward difference with $O(h)$ truncation error; the backward difference $\frac{f(x)-f(x-h)}{h}$ is equally first order.

formulas.note: 中心差商：两个方向展开相减使偶次项抵消，截断误差跳到二阶，是数值微分的首选公式。
formulas.noteEn: Central difference: subtracting the two expansions cancels even-order terms and raises the truncation error to second order — the workhorse formula.

formulas.note: 二阶导数的中心公式：误差 $O(h^2)$；也可看作对一阶中心差商再做一次差商。
formulas.noteEn: Central formula for the second derivative with $O(h^2)$ error; it can also be seen as a difference quotient of central differences.

formulas.note: 中心差商的总误差模型：截断与舍入的折中。双精度下最优步长约 $10^{-5}$ 量级，$h$ 再小舍入误差就占主导。
formulas.noteEn: Total error model for the central difference: a trade-off between truncation and rounding. In double precision the optimal step is about $10^{-5}$; smaller steps are dominated by rounding.

formulas.note: Richardson 外推：用两个步长的中心差商组合，把 $O(h^2)$ 误差项消去，得到四阶精度。
formulas.noteEn: Richardson extrapolation: combining central differences at two step sizes cancels the $O(h^2)$ term and gives fourth-order accuracy.

expression.note: 中心差商是最常用的数值微分公式；节点对称、精度二阶、实现简单。
expression.noteEn: The central difference is the standard numerical derivative formula: symmetric nodes, second-order accuracy, trivial to implement.

properties: 精度阶梯：前向/后向差商 $O(h)$，中心差商 $O(h^2)$，二阶导数中心公式也是 $O(h^2)$；Richardson 外推可到 $O(h^4)$。
中心差商需要节点关于 $x$ 对称；区间端点处没有两侧函数值，只能用单侧（前向或后向）公式。
不稳定：总误差约 $Mh^2/6+\varepsilon/h$，存在最优步长 $h_*\approx(3\varepsilon/M)^{1/3}$，$h$ 过小结果反而变坏。
与插值的关系：用插值多项式的导数可以构造任意求导公式；但高次插值的导数误差可能很大，实用的公式都只用少数几个邻近节点。
应用广泛：为微分方程的离散格式（Euler 法、有限差分）提供基础，也用于估计数值积分误差项中的 $f''$。
propertiesEn: Accuracy ladder: forward/backward $O(h)$, central $O(h^2)$, central second derivative also $O(h^2)$; Richardson extrapolation reaches $O(h^4)$.
The central formula needs nodes symmetric about $x$; at interval endpoints only one-sided (forward or backward) formulas are available.
Instability: the total error is about $Mh^2/6+\varepsilon/h$ with an optimal step $h_*\approx(3\varepsilon/M)^{1/3}$; taking $h$ too small makes things worse.

Connection with interpolation: differentiating an interpolant yields derivative formulas of any order, but high-degree interpolation gives poor derivatives, so practical formulas use only a few nearby nodes.
Widely used: it underlies finite differences for ODEs (Euler's method, finite-difference schemes) and supplies the $f''$ term in quadrature error estimates.

plot.title: 数值微分：y = sin x 在 x = 1 处的差商弦与切线

examples.problem: 取 $h=0.1$，用前向、后向、中心差商分别近似 $f'(2)$，$f(x)=\ln x$。
用中心差商近似 $f'(1)$，$f(x)=\sin x$（真值 $\cos1\approx0.5403023$），观察误差随 $h$ 的变化。

nodes.title: 数值积分：梯形公式与辛普森公式
nodes.titleEn: Numerical Integration: Trapezoidal and Simpson's Rules
nodes.summary: 用函数值的加权和近似定积分：复化梯形误差 O(h²)、代数精度 1；复化辛普森误差 O(h⁴)、代数精度 3。
nodes.summaryEn: Approximate definite integrals by weighted sums of function values: the composite trapezoidal rule is O(h²) with degree of precision 1, Simpson's rule is O(h⁴) with degree of precision 3.
nodes.definition:
当原函数求不出来、或被积函数只以表格形式给出时，可以用**节点函数值的加权和**近似定积分：
$$\int_a^b f(x)\,dx\approx\sum_{i}w_i f(x_i),$$
这类式子称为**求积公式**。最简单的想法是用 $f(a)$、$f(b)$ 两点连线（一次插值）代替 $f$ 再积分，得到**梯形公式**
$$T=\frac{b-a}{2}\big[f(a)+f(b)\big],$$
几何上就是以 $f(a)$、$f(b)$ 为上下底的梯形面积。把 $[a,b]$ 等分成 $n$ 段（$h=(b-a)/n$）逐段用梯形公式再求和，得到**复化梯形公式**
$$T_n=\frac{h}{2}\Big[f(a)+2\sum_{i=1}^{n-1}f(x_i)+f(b)\Big].$$

**辛普森公式**提高一档：每两个子区间用通过三个点 $(x_{2k},f_{2k})$、$(x_{2k+1},f_{2k+1})$、$(x_{2k+2},f_{2k+2})$ 的**抛物线**代替 $f$，对抛物线积分得 $\frac{h}{3}(f_{2k}+4f_{2k+1}+f_{2k+2})$；逐片累加得到复化辛普森公式
$$S_n=\frac{h}{3}\Big[f(a)+4\!\!\sum_{i\ \text{奇数}}\!\!f(x_i)+2\!\!\sum_{i\ \text{偶数}}\!\!f(x_i)+f(b)\Big]\qquad(n\ \text{为偶数}).$$

误差方面，若 $f$ 足够光滑，复化梯形的余项为 $R_T=-\dfrac{(b-a)h^2}{12}f''(\xi)=-\dfrac{(b-a)^3}{12n^2}f''(\xi)$，复化辛普森的余项为 $R_S=-\dfrac{(b-a)h^4}{180}f^{(4)}(\xi)$。这说明 $n$ 加倍时梯形误差约缩小 4 倍、辛普森约缩小 16 倍。

还有一个更细的尺度是**代数精度**（对次数不超过 $k$ 的多项式都精确、对 $k+1$ 次不精确的最大 $k$）：梯形公式的代数精度为 1（$\int_a^b x\,dx$ 精确，$\int_a^b x^2\,dx$ 不精确），而辛普森公式达到 3——虽然它只是二次插值的积分，却由于节点的对称性对三次多项式也精确。
nodes.definitionEn:
When an antiderivative is unavailable, or the integrand is known only from a table, a definite integral is approximated by a **weighted sum of function values**:
$$\int_a^b f(x)\,dx\approx\sum_{i}w_i f(x_i).$$
Such expressions are called **quadrature rules**. The simplest idea replaces $f$ by the straight line through $(a,f(a))$ and $(b,f(b))$ and integrates it, giving the **trapezoidal rule**
$$T=\frac{b-a}{2}\big[f(a)+f(b)\big],$$
the area of the trapezoid with parallel sides $f(a)$ and $f(b)$. Splitting $[a,b]$ into $n$ equal parts ($h=(b-a)/n$) and summing the trapezoids yields the **composite trapezoidal rule**
$$T_n=\frac{h}{2}\Big[f(a)+2\sum_{i=1}^{n-1}f(x_i)+f(b)\Big].$$

**Simpson's rule** goes one level higher: on every pair of subintervals replace $f$ by the **parabola** through $(x_{2k},f_{2k})$, $(x_{2k+1},f_{2k+1})$, $(x_{2k+2},f_{2k+2})$ and integrate it to get $\frac{h}{3}(f_{2k}+4f_{2k+1}+f_{2k+2})$; summing over pairs gives the composite rule
$$S_n=\frac{h}{3}\Big[f(a)+4\!\!\sum_{i\ \text{odd}}\!\!f(x_i)+2\!\!\sum_{i\ \text{even}}\!\!f(x_i)+f(b)\Big]\qquad(n\ \text{even}).$$

For sufficiently smooth $f$, the composite trapezoidal remainder is $R_T=-\dfrac{(b-a)h^2}{12}f''(\xi)=-\dfrac{(b-a)^3}{12n^2}f''(\xi)$, while Simpson's remainder is $R_S=-\dfrac{(b-a)h^4}{180}f^{(4)}(\xi)$. Doubling $n$ therefore cuts the trapezoidal error by about 4 and Simpson's error by about 16.

A finer measure of accuracy is the **degree of precision** (the largest $k$ such that all polynomials of degree $\le k$ are integrated exactly): it is 1 for the trapezoidal rule ($\int_a^b x\,dx$ is exact, $\int_a^b x^2\,dx$ is not) and 3 for Simpson's rule — even though Simpson's rule comes from integrating a quadratic interpolant, the symmetry of the nodes makes cubics exact as well.

formulas.note: 单区间梯形公式：用直线代替被积函数，几何上是一个梯形。
formulas.noteEn: Single-panel trapezoidal rule: approximate the integrand by a straight line; geometrically a trapezoid.

formulas.note: 复化梯形公式及其余项：$h=(b-a)/n$。误差与 $h^2$（即 $1/n^2$）成正比，代数精度为 1 次。
formulas.noteEn: Composite trapezoidal rule and its remainder with $h=(b-a)/n$: the error is proportional to $h^2$ (i.e. $1/n^2$) and the degree of precision is 1.

formulas.note: 复化辛普森公式及其余项：$n$ 必须为偶数（每片抛物线覆盖两段）；误差与 $h^4$（即 $1/n^4$）成正比，代数精度 3 次。
formulas.noteEn: Composite Simpson's rule and its remainder: $n$ must be even (each parabola covers two panels); the error is proportional to $h^4$ (i.e. $1/n^4$) and the degree of precision is 3.

formulas.note: 辛普森余项的另一种写法：便于按 $n$ 直接估计误差——$n$ 加倍误差约降为 $\frac{1}{16}$。
formulas.noteEn: The Simpson remainder rewritten in terms of $n$: doubling $n$ divides the error by about 16.

formulas.note: 辛普森公式的来源：对三点二次插值多项式 $p_2$ 积分。$\int_a^b x^k dx$ 对 $k\le1$（梯形）与 $k\le3$（辛普森）精确。
formulas.noteEn: Origin of Simpson's rule: integrate the quadratic interpolant $p_2$ through three points. Trapezoid is exact for $k\le1$ and Simpson for $k\le3$.

expression.text: Tₙ = h/2·[f(a)+2Σf(xᵢ)+f(b)]，Sₙ = h/3·[f(a)+4Σ奇+2Σ偶+f(b)]
expression.note: 两个复化公式都以节点函数值加权求和；辛普森要求 $n$ 为偶数，精度高得多。
expression.noteEn: Both composite rules are weighted sums of nodal values; Simpson needs even $n$ and is far more accurate.

properties: 两个复化公式都由分段低次插值（直线/抛物线）的积分导出；辛普森复用同一批函数值，精度却提高两阶。
代数精度：梯形为 1（对 $x$ 精确、对 $x^2$ 不精确），辛普森为 3（对 $x^3$ 精确、对 $x^4$ 不精确）。
误差随 $n$ 的变化：梯形 $R_T\propto n^{-2}$、辛普森 $R_S\propto n^{-4}$，$n$ 加倍时误差分别约缩小 4 倍与 16 倍。
复化辛普森要求 $n$ 为偶数——每个抛物线片覆盖两个子区间；$n$ 为奇数时需要对最后几段特殊处理。
误差公式假设 $f$ 足够光滑：若 $f''$ 或 $f^{(4)}$ 无界（尖点、间断），估计失效，应改用自适应细分或高斯求积。
propertiesEn: Both composite rules come from integrating piecewise low-degree interpolants; Simpson reuses the same function values yet gains two orders of accuracy.
Degree of precision: 1 for the trapezoidal rule (exact for $x$, not for $x^2$) and 3 for Simpson (exact for $x^3$, not for $x^4$).
Error scaling: $R_T\propto n^{-2}$ and $R_S\propto n^{-4}$; doubling $n$ shrinks them by about 4 and 16.
Composite Simpson requires even $n$ — each parabolic panel covers two subintervals; odd $n$ needs special treatment of the last pieces.
The error formulas assume smoothness: unbounded $f''$ or $f^{(4)}$ (corners, discontinuities) breaks the estimates; use adaptive refinement or Gaussian quadrature instead.

plot.title: 复化梯形公式逼近 ∫₀² x² dx（n = 4，T₄ = 2.75，真值 8/3）

examples.problem: 用 $n=4$ 的复化梯形公式和复化辛普森公式计算 $\int_0^2 x^2\,dx$，并与真值 $\frac83$ 比较。
计算 $\int_0^{\pi}\sin x\,dx=2$，比较 $n=4$ 的梯形与辛普森结果，并观察 $n$ 加倍时的误差变化。
examples.solution: 梯形 $T_4\approx1.89612$（误差约 $-1.04\times10^{-1}$），辛普森 $S_4=\frac{\pi}{12}(4\sqrt2+2)\approx2.00456$（误差约 $4.6\times10^{-3}$）。把 $n$ 加倍到 8：$S_8\approx2.000269$，误差约 $2.7\times10^{-4}$，比 $S_4$ 的误差小约 16 倍，验证了 $R_S\propto n^{-4}$；相应地 $T_8\approx1.97423$，误差约 $2.58\times10^{-2}$，约为 $T_4$ 误差的 $\frac14$，验证了 $R_T\propto n^{-2}$。

nodes.title: 高斯求积公式
nodes.summary: 节点取 n 次勒让德多项式 P_n(x) 的零点、权重取 A_i=2/[(1-x_i^2)(P_n'(x_i))^2]，n 个节点就达到 2n-1 次代数精度——相同节点数下精度最高的数值积分公式。
nodes.summaryEn: Take the zeros of the n-th Legendre polynomial as nodes with weights A_i=2/[(1-x_i^2)(P_n'(x_i))^2]; n nodes achieve degree 2n-1 exactness, the highest possible for any n-point rule.
nodes.definition:
数值积分公式一般写作 $\int_a^b f(x)\,dx\approx\sum_{i=1}^n A_if(x_i)$。牛顿-科特斯型公式（梯形、辛普森等）把节点固定成等距点，只优化权重；高斯求积反其道而行：**节点位置与权重一起优化**，让 $n$ 个节点能精确积分尽可能高次的多项式。可以证明，$n$ 个节点的求积公式代数精度最高只有 $2n-1$，而达到这一上界的唯一选择是取节点为 **$n$ 次勒让德多项式 $P_n(x)$ 的零点**，权重为
$$A_i=\frac{2}{(1-x_i^2)\,[P_n'(x_i)]^2},$$
于是得到标准区间 $[-1,1]$ 上的高斯-勒让德公式
$$\int_{-1}^{1}f(x)\,dx\approx\sum_{i=1}^{n}A_if(x_i).$$

为什么偏偏是勒让德零点？勒让德多项式在 $[-1,1]$ 上关于权 1 正交。取 $P_n$ 的零点作节点后，任何次数低于 $n$ 的多项式 $q$ 都可写成 $P_0,\dots,P_{n-1}$ 的组合，故 $\int_{-1}^{1}q(x)P_n(x)\,dx=0$。对任意次数不超过 $2n-1$ 的 $f$ 做带余除法 $f=qP_n+r$（$\deg q,\deg r\le n-1$）：积分只留下 $\int r$；而求积公式作用在 $f$ 上时，$P_n(x_i)=0$ 使含 $qP_n$ 的项全部消失，只剩在 $r$ 上的作用——$n$ 个节点恰好能把不高于 $n-1$ 次的多项式精确积分，两边相等。这就是 $2n-1$ 次精度的来源：节点把 $P_n$ 的正交性带进了求积。

低阶公式可以逐一手算核对：$n=1$ 时节点为 $0$、权重 $2$（即中点公式）；$n=2$ 时节点为 $\pm1/\sqrt3$、权重都是 $1$；$n=3$ 时节点为 $0,\pm\sqrt{3/5}$，权重为 $8/9,5/9,5/9$。注意效率对比：辛普森公式用 3 个等距节点才达到 3 次代数精度，而两点高斯公式只用 2 个节点就做到同一件事；$n$ 点高斯的 $2n-1$ 次精度正是「不浪费节点」的含义。

一般区间 $[a,b]$ 上先作线性变换 $x=\frac{a+b}{2}+\frac{b-a}{2}\,t$（$t\in[-1,1]$，$dx=\frac{b-a}{2}\,dt$）：
$$\int_a^b f(x)\,dx=\frac{b-a}{2}\int_{-1}^{1}f\!\left(\frac{a+b}{2}+\frac{b-a}{2}t\right)dt,$$
再套用标准节点与权重即可。当 $f\in C^{2n}[a,b]$ 时误差为
$$R_n=\frac{(b-a)^{2n+1}(n!)^4}{(2n+1)[(2n)!]^3}f^{(2n)}(\xi),$$
与 $f$ 的第 $2n$ 阶导数成正比：对光滑函数增大 $n$ 收敛极快；但对不光滑、有奇性、或在宽区间上高阶导数很大的函数（如 $e^{-x^2}$ 在 $[-2,2]$ 上），固定阶数的误差未必随节点数迅速降低，这时常先把区间分段、每个子区间再用低阶高斯公式。
nodes.definitionEn:
A numerical integration rule is written $\int_a^b f(x)\,dx\approx\sum_{i=1}^n A_if(x_i)$. Newton-Cotes rules (trapezoid, Simpson) fix equispaced nodes and optimise only the weights; Gaussian quadrature does the opposite: it **optimises node positions and weights together**, so that $n$ nodes integrate polynomials of as high a degree as possible. It can be shown that no $n$-point rule can exceed degree $2n-1$, and the unique way to attain this bound is to take the nodes as the **zeros of the $n$-th Legendre polynomial $P_n(x)$**, with weights
$$A_i=\frac{2}{(1-x_i^2)\,[P_n'(x_i)]^2},$$
giving the Gauss-Legendre rule on the standard interval,
$$\int_{-1}^{1}f(x)\,dx\approx\sum_{i=1}^{n}A_if(x_i).$$

Why Legendre zeros? The Legendre polynomials are orthogonal on $[-1,1]$ with weight 1. With the zeros of $P_n$ as nodes, any polynomial $q$ of degree below $n$ is a combination of $P_0,\dots,P_{n-1}$, hence $\int_{-1}^{1}q(x)P_n(x)\,dx=0$. For any $f$ of degree at most $2n-1$ write $f=qP_n+r$ with $\deg q,\deg r\le n-1$: the integral reduces to $\int r$, while the quadrature applied to $f$ kills the whole $qP_n$ part since $P_n(x_i)=0$, leaving its action on $r$ — and $n$ nodes integrate polynomials of degree at most $n-1$ exactly. Hence the $2n-1$ exactness: the nodes import the orthogonality of $P_n$ into the rule.

Low-order rules are easily checked by hand: $n=1$ has node $0$ and weight $2$ (the midpoint rule); $n=2$ has nodes $\pm1/\sqrt3$ with weights $1$; $n=3$ has nodes $0,\pm\sqrt{3/5}$ with weights $8/9,5/9,5/9$. Note the efficiency: Simpson's rule needs three equispaced nodes to reach degree 3, while two Gauss nodes already do the same job.

On a general interval $[a,b]$, first use the linear map $x=\frac{a+b}{2}+\frac{b-a}{2}\,t$ ($t\in[-1,1]$, $dx=\frac{b-a}{2}\,dt$):
$$\int_a^b f(x)\,dx=\frac{b-a}{2}\int_{-1}^{1}f\!\left(\frac{a+b}{2}+\frac{b-a}{2}t\right)dt,$$
then apply the standard nodes and weights. For $f\in C^{2n}[a,b]$ the error is
$$R_n=\frac{(b-a)^{2n+1}(n!)^4}{(2n+1)[(2n)!]^3}f^{(2n)}(\xi),$$
proportional to the $2n$-th derivative: for smooth functions the convergence as $n$ grows is extremely fast, but for nonsmooth or singular integrands — or for wide intervals where high derivatives are huge (e.g. $e^{-x^2}$ on $[-2,2]$) — a fixed low order may improve slowly, and one should subdivide the interval and use a low-order Gauss rule on each piece.

formulas.note: $n$ 点高斯-勒让德求积公式：节点 $x_i$ 是 $P_n$ 的零点，权重由下式给出。
formulas.noteEn: The $n$-point Gauss-Legendre rule: nodes are the zeros of $P_n$, weights as below.

formulas.note: 权重的闭式；所有权重为正，$\sum_i A_i=2$。
formulas.noteEn: Closed form of the weights; all are positive and $\sum_i A_i=2$.

formulas.note: 区间变换：把任意 $[a,b]$ 化到标准区间 $[-1,1]$，权重整体乘以 $\frac{b-a}{2}$。
formulas.noteEn: Change of variables: reduce any $[a,b]$ to $[-1,1]$; all weights are scaled by $\frac{b-a}{2}$.

formulas.latex: n=1:\ x=0,\ A=2;\qquad n=2:\ x=\pm\frac{1}{\sqrt3},\ A=1;\qquad n=3:\ x=0,\ \pm\sqrt{\frac35},\ A=\frac89,\ \frac59,\ \frac59
formulas.note: 最常用的低阶节点与权重；$n=2$ 就有 3 次代数精度。
formulas.noteEn: The standard low-order nodes and weights; the 2-point rule already has degree 3 exactness.

formulas.note: 误差公式（$f\in C^{2n}$）：与第 $2n$ 阶导数成正比，光滑函数收敛极快。
formulas.noteEn: Error formula ($f\in C^{2n}$): proportional to the $2n$-th derivative, hence very fast convergence for smooth functions.

expression.text: ∫₋₁¹ f(x)dx ≈ A₁f(x₁)+…+Aₙf(xₙ)
expression.note: 标准区间上的 n 点高斯公式；一般区间先作线性变换。
expression.noteEn: The n-point Gauss rule on the standard interval; reduce [a,b] with a linear map first.

properties: **代数精度为 $2n-1$，且这是 $n$ 节点公式的理论上限**：不存在用 $n$ 个节点达到 $2n$ 次或更高精度的求积公式，高斯公式恰好达到最优。
节点是 $P_n$ 的 $n$ 个互异实根，全部落在 $(-1,1)$ 内部；关于区间中点对称，对称位置的权重相等，且 $\sum_{i=1}^n A_i=b-a$。
所有权重 $A_i>0$，求积时不出现相消放大，数值上稳定；$n\to\infty$ 时对连续函数收敛到积分真值。
精度阶数随 $n$ 成倍增长（误差依赖 $f^{(2n)}$），光滑函数收敛很快；但 $n$ 大时节点需数值求解（牛顿迭代或查表），实际常取低阶公式分段复使用。
与等距公式相比：达到同样代数精度用的节点最少；代价是节点不固定，不能像复合梯形/辛普森那样直接复用前一层的函数值。
propertiesEn: **The algebraic degree is $2n-1$, and this is the theoretical bound for $n$ nodes**: no $n$-point rule can reach degree $2n$, so Gauss achieves the optimum.
The nodes are the $n$ distinct real roots of $P_n$, all inside $(-1,1)$; they are symmetric about the midpoint, symmetric nodes carry equal weights, and the weights sum to $b-a$.
All weights are positive, so no catastrophic cancellation occurs; the rule is numerically stable and converges to the integral for continuous integrands as $n\to\infty$.

The order of accuracy doubles with each added node (the error involves $f^{(2n})$), so smooth integrands converge extremely fast; for large $n$ the nodes must be computed numerically (Newton iteration or tables), and in practice low-order rules are applied piecewise.
Compared with equispaced rules it uses the fewest nodes for a given algebraic degree; the price is that nodes are not reusable across refinements, unlike composite trapezoid or Simpson.

plot.title: 辛普森法（4 段）逼近 ∫₋₂² e^(-x²)dx：近似 1.6599，精确值 1.7642

examples.problem: 用 3 点高斯公式计算 $\int_{-1}^{1}x^4\,dx$，并说明结果为何精确。
examples.solution:
节点为 $x=0,\pm\sqrt{3/5}$，权重为 $8/9,5/9,5/9$，于是
$$\sum_{i=1}^{3}A_if(x_i)=\frac89\cdot0+\frac59\left(\frac35\right)^2+\frac59\left(\frac35\right)^2=2\cdot\frac59\cdot\frac9{25}=\frac25,$$
与 $\int_{-1}^{1}x^4dx=\frac25$ 完全一致。原因：$x^4$ 的次数 $4\le 2n-1=5$，落在 3 点高斯公式的精确范围之内。

examples.problem: 在 $[0,1]$ 上用 2 点与 4 点高斯公式计算 $\int_0^1e^{-x^2}dx$（精确值约 $0.7468241$），并与辛普森法比较。
examples.solution:
作变换 $x=\frac12+\frac12t$，权重都乘以 $\frac12$。2 点公式的节点为 $x=\frac12\pm\frac{1}{2\sqrt3}\approx0.2113,\ 0.7887$，得
$$\frac12\left(e^{-0.2113^2}+e^{-0.7887^2}\right)\approx0.746595,$$
误差约 $-2.3\times10^{-4}$，只用了 2 次求值。4 点公式得 $0.7468245$，误差约 $+3.4\times10^{-7}$，也只用 4 次求值。对照：4 段辛普森（5 次求值）得 $0.7468554$，误差约 $+3.1\times10^{-5}$；要到 $1.2\times10^{-7}$ 量级需要 16 段辛普森（17 次求值）。同样的精度，高斯公式用的信息少得多。

nodes.title: 矩阵范数与条件数
nodes.summary: 矩阵范数把矩阵当作线性算子度量其放大能力；条件数 cond(A)=‖A‖·‖A⁻¹‖ 度量方程组 Ax=b 的解对扰动的敏感度，远大于 1 意味着病态、误差被放大 cond(A) 倍。
nodes.summaryEn: Matrix norms measure the stretching power of a linear map; the condition number cond(A)=‖A‖‖A⁻¹‖ measures how sensitive the solution of Ax=b is to perturbations — values far above 1 mean ill-conditioning.
nodes.definition:
矩阵既可以看成一堆数，也可以看成线性算子 $x\mapsto Ax$。算子视角下最重要的量是它「最多能把向量放大多少倍」，即由向量范数诱导的**矩阵范数**
$$\|A\|=\max_{x\ne0}\frac{\|Ax\|}{\|x\|}=\max_{\|x\|=1}\|Ax\|.$$
这样定义的范数天然与向量范数**相容**：$\|Ax\|\le\|A\|\,\|x\|$，并满足次可乘性 $\|AB\|\le\|A\|\,\|B\|$——这两条是后面一切误差估计的基石。不同的向量范数给出不同的矩阵范数，最常用的有四种：1-范数（最大列和）、$\infty$-范数（最大行和）、2-范数（最大奇异值）与 Frobenius 范数。最容易记反的是：**1-范数是列和最大，$\infty$-范数是行和最大**；转置恰好把两者互换，$\|A^{\mathsf T}\|_1=\|A\|_\infty$。

2-范数 $\|A\|_2=\sigma_{\max}(A)=\sqrt{\lambda_{\max}(A^{\mathsf T}A)}$ 是最大奇异值：把单位球经 $A$ 映射成椭球后，它是最长半轴的长度。Frobenius 范数 $\|A\|_F=\sqrt{\sum_{i,j}a_{ij}^2}$ 不是算子范数（它不来自某个「最大值」），但与 2-范数相容，且 $\|A\|_2\le\|A\|_F\le\sqrt{r}\,\|A\|_2$（$r$ 为秩），计算方便，常用来估计 2-范数。

实际解方程组 $Ax=b$ 时，$b$ 和 $A$ 都带有测量误差或舍入误差。研究「输入的小扰动会被放大多少倍」，得到的量就是**条件数**
$$\operatorname{cond}(A)=\|A\|\,\|A^{-1}\|.$$
在 2-范数下它等于最大与最小奇异值之比 $\sigma_{\max}/\sigma_{\min}$。由 $1=\|I\|=\|AA^{-1}\|\le\|A\|\,\|A^{-1}\|$ 立刻得到 $\operatorname{cond}(A)\ge1$，且 $\operatorname{cond}(I)=1$；正交（酉）矩阵的 2-范数条件数为 1。几何上，单位球被 $A$ 映成椭球，$\operatorname{cond}_2$ 就是最长与最短半轴之比：条件数越大椭球越「扁」，某些方向的误差被放大得越厉害。若右端有扰动 $\delta b$，解的相对误差满足
$$\frac{\|\delta x\|}{\|x\|}\le\operatorname{cond}(A)\,\frac{\|\delta b\|}{\|b\|},$$
这个界是紧的：存在特定的扰动方向使等号近似成立。经验法则：$\operatorname{cond}(A)\approx10^{k}$ 时，解大约损失 $k$ 位有效数字。

经典病态例子是希尔伯特矩阵 $H_n=\left(\frac{1}{i+j-1}\right)$：$H_3$ 的 2-范数条件数已约 $524$，$H_4$ 约 $1.55\times10^4$，随 $n$ 迅速膨胀。判断病态必须看条件数而不是行列式：$10^{-6}I$ 的行列式是 $10^{-18}$ 却完全良态（条件数为 1）。消元法的误差、迭代法的收敛速度都与 $\operatorname{cond}(A)$ 直接挂钩，因此对病态问题常要先做**预处理**或改用更高精度。
nodes.definitionEn:
A matrix is both a table of numbers and a linear operator $x\mapsto Ax$. In the operator view the key quantity is how much it can stretch a vector, i.e. the induced **matrix norm**
$$\|A\|=\max_{x\ne0}\frac{\|Ax\|}{\|x\|}=\max_{\|x\|=1}\|Ax\|.$$
It is automatically **compatible** with the vector norm, $\|Ax\|\le\|A\|\,\|x\|$, and submultiplicative, $\|AB\|\le\|A\|\,\|B\|$ — the two facts behind all perturbation estimates. Different vector norms give different matrix norms; the four most used are the 1-norm (largest column sum), the $\infty$-norm (largest row sum), the 2-norm (largest singular value) and the Frobenius norm. The easiest pair to confuse: **the 1-norm is the max column sum and the $\infty$-norm is the max row sum**; transposition swaps them, $\|A^{\mathsf T}\|_1=\|A\|_\infty$.

The 2-norm $\|A\|_2=\sigma_{\max}(A)=\sqrt{\lambda_{\max}(A^{\mathsf T}A)}$ is the largest singular value: the longest semi-axis of the ellipsoid into which $A$ maps the unit ball. The Frobenius norm $\|A\|_F=\sqrt{\sum_{i,j}a_{ij}^2}$ is not an operator norm, but it is compatible and satisfies $\|A\|_2\le\|A\|_F\le\sqrt{r}\,\|A\|_2$ ($r$ = rank); it is easy to compute and often used to bound the 2-norm.

When solving $Ax=b$, both $b$ and $A$ carry measurement or rounding errors. How much a small input perturbation is amplified is quantified by the **condition number**
$$\operatorname{cond}(A)=\|A\|\,\|A^{-1}\|.$$
In the 2-norm it equals $\sigma_{\max}/\sigma_{\min}$. From $1=\|I\|=\|AA^{-1}\|\le\|A\|\,\|A^{-1}\|$ we get $\operatorname{cond}(A)\ge1$, with $\operatorname{cond}(I)=1$; orthogonal (unitary) matrices have 2-norm condition number 1. Geometrically the unit ball becomes an ellipsoid and $\operatorname{cond}_2$ is the ratio of its longest to shortest semi-axis: the larger the condition number, the flatter the ellipsoid and the more some directions are amplified. For a right-hand-side perturbation $\delta b$,
$$\frac{\|\delta x\|}{\|x\|}\le\operatorname{cond}(A)\,\frac{\|\delta b\|}{\|b\|},$$
and the bound is sharp: there are perturbations attaining it in the worst direction. Rule of thumb: $\operatorname{cond}(A)\approx10^{k}$ costs about $k$ significant digits in the solution.

The classical ill-conditioned family is the Hilbert matrix $H_n=\left(\frac{1}{i+j-1}\right)$: already $\operatorname{cond}_2(H_3)\approx524$ and $\operatorname{cond}_2(H_4)\approx1.55\times10^4$, growing fast with $n$. Ill-conditioning must be judged by the condition number, not the determinant: $10^{-6}I$ has determinant $10^{-18}$ yet is perfectly conditioned. Elimination error and iterative-method convergence rates are governed directly by $\operatorname{cond}(A)$, so ill-conditioned problems call for **preconditioning** or higher precision.

formulas.note: 诱导矩阵范数的定义，以及与向量范数的相容性、次可乘性。
formulas.noteEn: The induced matrix norm, its compatibility with the vector norm, and submultiplicativity.

formulas.note: 1-范数与 $\infty$-范数；转置互换两者：$\|A^{\mathsf T}\|_1=\|A\|_\infty$。
formulas.noteEn: The 1- and $\infty$-norms: max column sum and max row sum; transposition swaps them.

formulas.note: 2-范数是最大奇异值；Frobenius 范数是全体奇异值的平方和开方。
formulas.noteEn: The 2-norm is the largest singular value; the Frobenius norm is the root-sum-square of all singular values.

formulas.note: 条件数的定义；2-范数下为最大与最小奇异值之比，恒不小于 1。
formulas.noteEn: Definition of the condition number; in the 2-norm it is the singular-value ratio and is never below 1.

formulas.note: 右端扰动引起的解的相对误差上界；界是紧的。
formulas.noteEn: Relative error bound caused by a right-hand-side perturbation; the bound is sharp.

expression.text: cond(A)=‖A‖·‖A⁻¹‖，2-范数下 = σ_max/σ_min
expression.note: 条件数越大，解对扰动越敏感；cond(A) ≥ 1。
expression.noteEn: The larger the condition number, the more sensitive the solution; cond(A) ≥ 1.

properties: $\operatorname{cond}(A)\ge1$ 恒成立，等号只被「不放大误差」的矩阵取到（如单位阵、正交阵）；$\operatorname{cond}(\alpha A)=\operatorname{cond}(A)$，$\operatorname{cond}_2$ 在正交变换下不变。
$\operatorname{cond}_2(A)=\sigma_{\max}/\sigma_{\min}$；对称、正规矩阵的 2-范数条件数为特征值绝对值之比 $|\lambda|_{\max}/|\lambda|_{\min}$；矩阵奇异时条件数视为 $\infty$。
不同范数给出的条件数彼此相差不超过 $n^2$ 倍的因子（范数等价性），因此「是否病态」的判断通常与范数选择无关。
条件数刻画的是最坏情况下的相对误差放大：若扰动恰好落在「良态方向」，实际误差可能远小于上界；但上界是可达的。
消元法的精度、迭代法的收敛速度都与 $\operatorname{cond}(A)$ 有关；病态问题的对策包括更高精度计算、正则化与预处理。
propertiesEn: $\operatorname{cond}(A)\ge1$ always, with equality for matrices that never amplify errors (identity, orthogonal matrices); $\operatorname{cond}(\alpha A)=\operatorname{cond}(A)$ and $\operatorname{cond}_2$ is invariant under orthogonal transformations.
$\operatorname{cond}_2(A)=\sigma_{\max}/\sigma_{\min}$; for symmetric or normal matrices this is $|\lambda|_{\max}/|\lambda|_{\min}$; a singular matrix has condition number $\infty$.
Condition numbers from different norms differ by at most a factor $n^2$ (norm equivalence), so the judgement 'ill-conditioned or not' rarely depends on the norm.
The condition number quantifies worst-case relative error growth: a perturbation along a favourable direction may cause much less error, but the bound is attainable.
Elimination accuracy and iterative-solver convergence rates both involve $\operatorname{cond}(A)$; remedies for ill-conditioning include higher precision, regularisation and preconditioning.

examples.problem: 求 $A=\begin{pmatrix}4&-1\\-1&4\end{pmatrix}$ 的 $\infty$-范数、2-范数与条件数。
examples.solution:
行和分别为 $4+1=5$ 与 $1+4=5$，故 $\|A\|_\infty=5$（列和也相同，$\|A\|_1=5$）。逆矩阵 $A^{-1}=\frac1{15}\begin{pmatrix}4&1\\1&4\end{pmatrix}$，其行和为 $\frac{5}{15}=\frac13$，于是
$$\operatorname{cond}_\infty(A)=5\times\frac13=\frac53.$$
$A$ 对称，特征值为 $3$ 与 $5$，即 $\sigma_{\max}=5,\ \sigma_{\min}=3$，所以 $\operatorname{cond}_2(A)=\frac53\approx1.67$，是良态矩阵。

examples.problem: 设 $A=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\1&1.0001\end{pmatrix}$，$b=(2,2)^{\mathsf T}$。求 $\operatorname{cond}_\infty(A)$，并考察右端扰动 $\delta b=(0,10^{-4})^{\mathsf T}$ 对解的影响。
examples.solution:
行和为 $2$ 与 $2.0001$，故 $\|A\|_\infty=2.0001$；$A^{-1}=10^4\begin{pmatrix}1.0001&-1\\-1&1\end{pmatrix}$，两行行和（取绝对值）分别为 $10^4\times2.0001$ 与 $10^4\times2$，最大者为 $10^4\times2.0001$，故 $\|A^{-1}\|_\infty=10^4\times2.0001$，于是
$$\operatorname{cond}_\infty(A)=2.0001\times2.0001\times10^4\approx4.0\times10^4,$$
严重病态。未扰动时由 $x_1+x_2=2,\ x_1+1.0001x_2=2$ 得 $x=(2,0)^{\mathsf T}$；加扰动后 $x'=(1,1)^{\mathsf T}$。相对误差 $\frac{\|\delta x\|_\infty}{\|x\|_\infty}=\frac12=50\%$，而右端的相对扰动只有 $\frac{\|\delta b\|_\infty}{\|b\|_\infty}=5\times10^{-5}$——放大了约 $10^4$ 倍，与上界 $\operatorname{cond}_\infty(A)\times5\times10^{-5}\approx2$ 相符。

nodes.title: 欧拉法与改进欧拉法
nodes.summary: 欧拉法沿方向场的切线一步步外推，显式、简单，但只有一阶精度且条件稳定；改进欧拉法（Heun）先用它预测、再用两端斜率平均校正，把精度提高到二阶。
nodes.summaryEn: Euler's method marches along tangent lines of the slope field - explicit and simple, but only first order and conditionally stable; the improved Euler (Heun) predictor-corrector averages the endpoint slopes and is second order.
nodes.definition:
给定一阶初值问题 $y'=f(x,y),\ y(x_0)=y_0$，数值解法把区间分成节点 $x_n=x_0+nh$，逐步求出近似值 $y_n\approx y(x_n)$。**欧拉法**是最简单的一种：由 Taylor 展开 $y(x+h)=y(x)+hy'(x)+\frac{h^2}{2}y''(\xi)$，舍去二阶以上项并把导数换成 $f(x_n,y_n)$，得
$$y_{n+1}=y_n+h\,f(x_n,y_n).$$
几何意义：在点 $(x_n,y_n)$ 处沿方向场给出的斜率直线走一步 $h$——整条数值解就是一小段一小段切线拼成的折线。它**显式**（右端只用已知量）、**单步自启动**（不依赖历史点、也不用迭代），是理解一切数值方法的起点。

精度方面：每步被丢弃的项是 $\frac{h^2}{2}y''(\xi)$，称为局部截断误差，量级 $O(h^2)$；但误差逐段累积——固定终点 $x$ 时步数 $n\propto1/h$，整体截断误差只有 $O(h)$。所以欧拉法是**一阶方法**：步长减半，误差大约减半。实际计算中 $h$ 也不能一味取小，因为舍入误差会累积，总误差在「截断误差 $\sim h$」与「舍入误差 $\sim\varepsilon/h$」的折中处最小。数值实验里欧拉解常整体偏向精确解的一侧（切线总在凸曲线同侧），偏差是系统性的。

**改进欧拉法**的出发点是梯形公式 $y_{n+1}=y_n+\frac h2[f(x_n,y_n)+f(x_{n+1},y_{n+1})]$：它是二阶精度的，但右端含未知的 $y_{n+1}$（隐式）。解决办法是先预测、再校正：先用欧拉法算出预测值
$$\bar y_{n+1}=y_n+h\,f(x_n,y_n),$$
再用它近似终点斜率，取两端斜率的平均作校正：
$$y_{n+1}=y_n+\frac h2\left[f(x_n,y_n)+f(x_{n+1},\bar y_{n+1})\right].$$
这一「预测-校正」格式又称 **Heun 方法**：局部截断误差 $O(h^3)$、整体 $O(h^2)$，是**二阶方法**，步长减半误差约降为四分之一。它其实是两级 Runge-Kutta 公式：$k_1=f(x_n,y_n)$，$k_2=f(x_n+h,\ y_n+hk_1)$，$y_{n+1}=y_n+\frac h2(k_1+k_2)$。

两者都是显式单步法，步长合适时收敛到精确解（相容 + 稳定 $\Rightarrow$ 收敛），但稳定区间有限：对试验方程 $y'=\lambda y$，欧拉法的放大因子是 $1+h\lambda$，$\lambda<0$ 时要求 $0<h<2/|\lambda|$；改进欧拉法的放大因子是 $1+h\lambda+\frac{(h\lambda)^2}{2}$，在负实轴上的稳定区间同样是 $(-2,0)$。步长一旦越界，数值解会像坏掉的复利一样振荡放大——这是刚性问题不能直接用它们的原因（见「数值方法的收敛性与稳定性」）。
nodes.definitionEn:
For the initial value problem $y'=f(x,y),\ y(x_0)=y_0$, numerical methods split the interval into nodes $x_n=x_0+nh$ and compute approximations $y_n\approx y(x_n)$. **Euler's method** is the simplest: truncate the Taylor expansion $y(x+h)=y(x)+hy'(x)+\frac{h^2}{2}y''(\xi)$ after the first term and replace the derivative by $f(x_n,y_n)$:
$$y_{n+1}=y_n+h\,f(x_n,y_n).$$
Geometrically, step $h$ along the tangent given by the slope field at $(x_n,y_n)$ — the numerical solution is a polyline of short tangent segments. It is **explicit** (the right-hand side uses known data only) and a **single-step, self-starting** method, the natural starting point for the whole subject.

Accuracy: the term dropped each step is $\frac{h^2}{2}y''(\xi)$, the local truncation error, of size $O(h^2)$; errors accumulate, however, and with $n\propto1/h$ steps to a fixed final $x$ the global error is only $O(h)$. Euler's method is therefore **first order**: halving the step roughly halves the error. The step cannot be taken arbitrarily small either, since rounding errors accumulate; the best total error balances truncation $\sim h$ against rounding $\sim\varepsilon/h$. In experiments the Euler solution often deviates systematically to one side of the exact solution (tangents lie on one side of a convex curve).

The **improved Euler method** starts from the trapezoidal formula $y_{n+1}=y_n+\frac h2[f(x_n,y_n)+f(x_{n+1},y_{n+1})]$, which is second order but implicit. The fix is to predict, then correct: predict $\bar y_{n+1}=y_n+h\,f(x_n,y_n)$ with one Euler step, use it to estimate the slope at the right end, and average the two slopes:
$$y_{n+1}=y_n+\frac h2\left[f(x_n,y_n)+f(x_{n+1},\bar y_{n+1})\right].$$
This predictor-corrector scheme is also called **Heun's method**: local error $O(h^3)$, global error $O(h^2)$ — **second order**, so halving the step cuts the error by about four. It is a two-stage Runge-Kutta method with $k_1=f(x_n,y_n)$, $k_2=f(x_n+h,\ y_n+hk_1)$ and $y_{n+1}=y_n+\frac h2(k_1+k_2)$.

Both are explicit single-step methods that converge to the exact solution for suitable steps (consistency plus stability implies convergence), but their stability intervals are finite: for the test equation $y'=\lambda y$ with $\lambda<0$, Euler has amplification factor $1+h\lambda$ and requires $0<h<2/|\lambda|$, while Heun has $1+h\lambda+\frac{(h\lambda)^2}{2}$ and its interval on the negative real axis is likewise $(-2,0)$. Beyond the limit the numerical solution oscillates and blows up, which is why they cannot be used directly on stiff problems.

formulas.note: 显式欧拉公式：沿当前点的方向场斜率向前走一步，几何上是切线外推。
formulas.noteEn: Explicit Euler: one step along the current slope — tangent extrapolation.

formulas.note: 局部截断误差是二阶，但累积后的整体误差只有一阶。
formulas.noteEn: The local truncation error is second order, but the accumulated global error is only first order.

formulas.note: 改进欧拉法：先预测、再校正，两端斜率的平均即梯形思想的显式实现。
formulas.noteEn: Improved Euler: predict, then correct; averaging endpoint slopes is the explicit version of the trapezoidal idea.

formulas.note: 改进欧拉法的两级 Runge-Kutta 形式，权系数各为 $1/2$。
formulas.noteEn: The improved Euler method as a two-stage Runge-Kutta scheme with weights $1/2$.

formulas.note: 改进欧拉是二阶方法：步长减半，误差约降为四分之一。
formulas.noteEn: Heun is second order: halving the step reduces the error by about a factor of four.

expression.text: y_{n+1}=y_n+h f(x_n,y_n)（欧拉法）；先预测后校正（改进欧拉法）
expression.note: 一步沿一个切线方向；改进版用两个斜率的平均。
expression.noteEn: One tangent step at a time; the improved version averages two slopes.

properties: 显式单步：$y_{n+1}$ 由已知量直接算出，自启动、易编程，步长可以边走边改。
阶数：欧拉法一阶（$h$ 减半误差约减半），改进欧拉法二阶（误差约降 4 倍）；误差常数依赖 $f$ 的光滑性，非光滑右端会跌破理论阶数。
稳定性：对 $y'=\lambda y\ (\lambda<0)$，两种方法在负实轴上的稳定区间都是 $(-2,0)$，即要求 $0<h<2/|\lambda|$；越界的数值解振荡发散。
相容性与收敛性：两种格式的局部截断误差除以 $h$ 都趋于 0（相容），加上稳定即保证收敛——步长合理时会越来越接近真解。
欧拉法常用于为高阶单步法提供起步值，也是用大步长演示误差累积与失稳的最好例子；高精度计算请改用 RK4 或自适应方法。
propertiesEn: Explicit and single-step: $y_{n+1}$ is computed directly from known data; self-starting, easy to code, and the step size may change as you go.
Order: Euler is first order (halving $h$ halves the error), improved Euler is second order (error divided by about four); the constants depend on the smoothness of $f$.
Stability: for $y'=\lambda y$ with $\lambda<0$ both have the same interval $(-2,0)$ on the negative real axis, i.e. $0<h<2/|\lambda|$; beyond it the solution oscillates and diverges.
Both schemes are consistent (local error over $h$ tends to zero) and hence convergent when stable — with a sensible step they approach the true solution.
Euler's method often bootstraps higher-order single-step methods and is the classic laboratory for error accumulation and instability; for accuracy use RK4 or adaptive schemes.

nodes.title: 龙格-库塔方法
nodes.summary: 在一步内取若干中间点的斜率做加权平均，只调用 f 本身就能达到高阶精度；经典四级四阶公式（RK4）是应用最广的通用常微分方程数值解法。
nodes.summaryEn: Slopes sampled at intermediate stages inside each step are combined with suitable weights, reaching high order while calling only f; the classical fourth-order scheme (RK4) is the most widely used ODE solver.
nodes.definition:
显式单步法的一般形式是 $y_{n+1}=y_n+h\,\Phi(x_n,y_n;h)$：取 $\Phi=f$ 得到欧拉法。沿 Taylor 展开逐项匹配可以得到更高阶（Taylor 法），但需要计算 $y'',y''',\dots$，实际并不好用。Runge（1895）与 Kutta（1901）的思路是：**不引入高阶导数，而是用 $f$ 在一整步内若干中间点（称为「级」）的取值组合来模拟 Taylor 展开**。这就是 $s$ 级 Runge-Kutta 方法：
$$y_{n+1}=y_n+h\sum_{i=1}^{s}b_ik_i,\qquad k_i=f\Big(x_n+c_ih,\ y_n+h\sum_{j=1}^{i-1}a_{ij}k_j\Big),$$
系数 $(a_{ij},b_i,c_i)$ 组成 Butcher 表；选得恰当，展开就能与精确解的 Taylor 级数匹配到尽量高的阶。

**经典四级四阶公式（经典 RK4）**是最著名的成员：
$$k_1=f(x_n,y_n),\qquad k_2=f\!\left(x_n+\frac h2,\ y_n+\frac h2k_1\right),$$
$$k_3=f\!\left(x_n+\frac h2,\ y_n+\frac h2k_2\right),\qquad k_4=f\!\left(x_n+h,\ y_n+hk_3\right),$$
$$y_{n+1}=y_n+\frac h6\,(k_1+2k_2+2k_3+k_4).$$
权系数依次为 $\frac16,\frac26,\frac26,\frac16$，与辛普森公式的 1-4-1 结构同源：两个中点级各占 $2/6$，两个端点级各占 $1/6$。事实上当 $f$ 只依赖 $x$ 时，RK4 恰好退化为辛普森公式 $\frac h6\left[f(x_n)+4f(x_n+\frac h2)+f(x_n+h)\right]$。每步需要 4 次 $f$ 求值：$k_1$ 是起点斜率；$k_2,k_3$ 是前半步的两个中点斜率（分别由 $k_1$、$k_2$ 独立预测）；$k_4$ 是用 $k_3$ 推进整步得到的终点斜率。

精度：局部截断误差 $O(h^5)$，整体误差 $O(h^4)$——步长减半误差约降 16 倍（$f$ 足够光滑且 $h$ 位于稳定域内时）。阶数与级数之间有关系：$s\le4$ 时，$s$ 级显式 RK 最高只能达到 $s$ 阶；5 阶公式至少需要 6 级。精度高、无需导数、实现简单，使 RK4 至今仍是很多实际问题的默认选择。

稳定性与局限：把公式用于试验方程 $y'=\lambda y$ 得 $y_{n+1}=R(h\lambda)y_n$，其中 $R(z)=1+z+\frac{z^2}{2}+\frac{z^3}{6}+\frac{z^4}{24}$ 是截断的指数级数；稳定条件是 $|R(z)|<1$。RK4 的稳定域是复平面上的有界区域，与负实轴的交集约为 $(-2.785,\,0)$——它仍是条件稳定的显式方法（步长须小于约 $2.8/|\lambda|$），对刚性方程力不从心，应改用 A-稳定的隐式方法。工程上为自动选步长，常用嵌入低阶公式的自适应 RK 对（如 Dormand-Prince 5(4)）；各类绘图工具中画斜率场解曲线，用的也正是 RK4。
nodes.definitionEn:
An explicit single-step method has the form $y_{n+1}=y_n+h\,\Phi(x_n,y_n;h)$; taking $\Phi=f$ gives Euler's method. Matching Taylor expansions term by term leads to higher order (Taylor methods) but requires $y'',y''',\dots$, which is impractical. Runge (1895) and Kutta (1901) realised that one can **mimic the Taylor expansion using combinations of $f$ evaluated at intermediate points (stages) inside the step, without ever forming higher derivatives**. This yields the $s$-stage Runge-Kutta methods:
$$y_{n+1}=y_n+h\sum_{i=1}^{s}b_ik_i,\qquad k_i=f\Big(x_n+c_ih,\ y_n+h\sum_{j=1}^{i-1}a_{ij}k_j\Big),$$
with coefficients $(a_{ij},b_i,c_i)$ collected in a Butcher tableau; chosen well, the expansion matches the exact Taylor series to high order.

The **classical fourth-order scheme (RK4)** is the most famous member:
$$k_1=f(x_n,y_n),\qquad k_2=f\!\left(x_n+\frac h2,\ y_n+\frac h2k_1\right),$$
$$k_3=f\!\left(x_n+\frac h2,\ y_n+\frac h2k_2\right),\qquad k_4=f\!\left(x_n+h,\ y_n+hk_3\right),$$
$$y_{n+1}=y_n+\frac h6\,(k_1+2k_2+2k_3+k_4).$$
The weights are $\frac16,\frac26,\frac26,\frac16$ — the same 1-4-1 pattern as Simpson's rule: two midpoint stages share weight $2/6$ and the two endpoint stages take $1/6$ each. Indeed, when $f$ depends on $x$ only, RK4 degenerates exactly to Simpson's rule $\frac h6\big[f(x_n)+4f(x_n+\frac h2)+f(x_n+h)\big]$. Each step costs four evaluations: $k_1$ is the slope at the start; $k_2,k_3$ are midpoint slopes predicted independently from $k_1$ and $k_2$; $k_4$ is the endpoint slope from a full step with $k_3$.

Accuracy: the local truncation error is $O(h^5)$ and the global error $O(h^4)$: halving the step divides the error by about 16 (for smooth $f$ and $h$ inside the stability region). Order is limited by the number of stages: for $s\le4$ an $s$-stage explicit RK method has order at most $s$, and a fifth-order formula needs at least six stages. High accuracy, no derivatives, and simple implementation keep RK4 the default general-purpose solver.

Stability and limitations: on the test equation $y'=\lambda y$ the scheme gives $y_{n+1}=R(h\lambda)y_n$ with $R(z)=1+z+\frac{z^2}{2}+\frac{z^3}{6}+\frac{z^4}{24}$, a truncated exponential; stability requires $|R(z)|<1$. The stability region is a bounded set in the complex plane meeting the negative real axis in about $(-2.785,\,0)$ — RK4 is still only conditionally stable (the step must stay below roughly $2.8/|\lambda|$), so it struggles on stiff problems, where A-stable implicit methods are needed. For automatic step-size control, embedded RK pairs such as Dormand-Prince 5(4) are standard.

formulas.latex: k_1=f(x_n,y_n),\quad k_2=f\!\left(x_n+\frac h2,\ y_n+\frac h2k_1\right),\quad k_3=f\!\left(x_n+\frac h2,\ y_n+\frac h2k_2\right),\quad k_4=f(x_n+h,\ y_n+hk_3)
formulas.note: 经典 RK4 的四个级：两个中点级与两个端点级。
formulas.noteEn: The four stages of classical RK4: two at the midpoint and two at the endpoints.

formulas.note: 权系数 $1/6,2/6,2/6,1/6$ 不能记错；$f$ 只依赖 $x$ 时它退化为辛普森公式。
formulas.noteEn: Weights $1/6,2/6,2/6,1/6$; for $f=f(x)$ it reduces to Simpson's rule.

formulas.note: RK4 的系数表；一般 $s$ 级方法由这套系数刻画。
formulas.noteEn: The Butcher tableau of RK4; general $s$-stage methods are described by such coefficients.

formulas.note: 局部五阶、整体四阶：步长减半，误差约降为 $1/16$。
formulas.noteEn: Local order five, global order four: halving the step cuts the error by about 16.

formulas.note: 稳定性多项式与稳定域；RK4 仍是条件稳定的显式方法。
formulas.noteEn: The stability polynomial and region; RK4 remains conditionally stable.

expression.text: y_{n+1}=y_n+h(k₁+2k₂+2k₃+k₄)/6，kᵢ 为一步内四个中间点的斜率
expression.note: 每步 4 次 f 求值，整体四阶精度；无需高阶导数。
expression.noteEn: Four evaluations of f per step for fourth-order accuracy, with no derivatives needed.

properties: 单步显式、自启动：每步 4 次 $f$ 求值，不需任何高阶导数，也不依赖历史点；步长可随走随调。
精度与代价平衡：每步 4 次 $f$ 求值换来四阶精度，通常比把欧拉法或 Heun 法步长缩到同等精度划算得多。
条件稳定：负实轴稳定区间约 $(-2.785,0)$，刚性方程上被迫取过小步长，应改用 A-稳定的隐式方法。
阶数限制：$s$ 级显式 RK 的阶数 $p\le s$（$s\le4$）；$p=5$ 至少需要 $s=6$，高阶公式的系数条件越来越苛刻。
变体丰富：3/8 法则（权 $1/8,3/8,3/8,1/8$）同为四阶；嵌入对（Dormand-Prince 等）实现误差估计与自适应步长；隐式 RK 可兼顾 A-稳定与高阶。
propertiesEn: Explicit, single-step and self-starting: four evaluations of $f$ per step, no higher derivatives, no history; the step size can vary freely.
Favourable accuracy/cost balance: four evaluations per step buy fourth-order accuracy, usually far cheaper than shrinking Euler or Heun steps to the same precision.
Conditionally stable: the stability interval on the negative real axis is about $(-2.785,0)$; stiff problems force tiny steps and call for A-stable implicit schemes.
Order is capped by stages: an $s$-stage explicit RK method has order $p\le s$ for $s\le4$, and $p=5$ requires $s\ge6$.

Many variants: the 3/8 rule (weights $1/8,3/8,3/8,1/8$) is also fourth order; embedded pairs (Dormand-Prince etc.) give error estimates and adaptive steps; implicit RK methods can be both A-stable and high order.
