The matrix is positive definite — $E>0$ and $EG-F^2=|\mathbf r_u\times\mathbf r_v|^2>0$ — hence $\mathrm I>0$ for every nonzero $(du,dv)$.

The purpose of $\mathrm I$ is to compress all metric information into three functions. The arc length of a curve $\gamma(t)=\mathbf r(u(t),v(t))$ is $\int\sqrt{Eu'^2+2Fu'v'+Gv'^2}\,dt$; the angle between two directions is computed from $E,F,G$ as a scalar product; the area element of the surface is $\sqrt{EG-F^2}\,du\,dv$. Once $E,F,G$ are known, all of these follow.

The key point is **intrinsicness**: everything computed from $E,F,G$ — length, angle, area — depends only on the first fundamental form, not on how the surface is bent in space. This is exactly the geometry an observer confined to the surface could measure. For instance, the cylinder (after a suitable reparametrization) and the plane have the same $E,F,G$ and hence the same intrinsic geometry (see surface isometry). How the surface bends in space is a separate matter, recorded by the second fundamental form.

formulas.note: 第一基本形式：参数增量 $(du,dv)$ 对应的曲面位移长度平方。$dudv$ 与 $dvdu$ 两项相同，合并后系数是 $2$，不能只写 $F\,dudv$。
formulas.noteEn: The first fundamental form: the squared length of the surface displacement corresponding to $(du,dv)$. The terms $dudv$ and $dvdu$ coincide, so the combined coefficient is $2$; writing only $F\,dudv$ would be wrong.

formulas.latex: E=\mathbf r_u\cdot\mathbf r_u,\qquad F=\mathbf r_u\cdot\mathbf r_v,\qquad G=\mathbf r_v\cdot\mathbf r_v
formulas.note: 三个基本量：$E$、$G$ 是参数方向速度的平方，$F$ 度量参数网的斜交程度；$F=0$ 表示两族参数曲线正交。
formulas.noteEn: The three fundamental quantities: $E$ and $G$ are the squared speeds of the parameter directions, while $F$ measures how slanted the parameter grid is; $F=0$ means the grid is orthogonal.

formulas.note: 曲线 $\gamma(t)=\mathbf r(u(t),v(t))$ 的弧长：把 $\mathrm I$ 沿曲线积分，是「用 $E,F,G$ 量长度」的标准例子。
formulas.noteEn: Arc length of a curve $\gamma(t)=\mathbf r(u(t),v(t))$: integrate $\mathrm I$ along the curve — the standard example of measuring length with $E,F,G$.

formulas.note: Lagrange 恒等式把面积元与叉积联系起来；正定性保证 $\mathrm I$ 是真正的度量、面积元的根号内为正。
formulas.noteEn: Lagrange's identity links the area element to the cross product; positive definiteness guarantees that $\mathrm I$ is a genuine metric and that the square root in the area element is real.

formulas.note: 半径 $R$ 的球面（极角 $u$、方位角 $v$）：参数网正交（$F=0$），$\sqrt{EG-F^2}=R^2\sin u$ 正是面积元因子。
formulas.noteEn: The sphere of radius $R$ (polar angle $u$, azimuth $v$): the grid is orthogonal ($F=0$) and $\sqrt{EG-F^2}=R^2\sin u$ is precisely the area-element factor.

expression.text: I = E du² + 2F dudv + G dv²，其中 E = r_u·r_u、F = r_u·r_v、G = r_v·r_v
expression.note: 第一基本形式也常写作 $ds^2$ 或度量矩阵 $(g_{ij})=\begin{pmatrix}E&F\\F&G\end{pmatrix}$。
expression.noteEn: The first fundamental form is also written $ds^2$, with metric matrix $(g_{ij})=\begin{pmatrix}E&F\\F&G\end{pmatrix}$.

properties: 内蕴性：曲面上的弧长、夹角、区域面积都只由 $E,F,G$ 决定，与曲面在三维空间中如何放置无关——这是曲面内蕴几何的全部信息来源。
换参数化时 $E,F,G$ 按二次型的协变规律变化（$\tilde G=J^{\mathsf T}GJ$，$J$ 是重参数变换的 Jacobi 矩阵），但 $\mathrm I$ 作为度量不变，由它算出的几何量也不变。
$F=0$ 表示参数曲线网正交（$\mathbf r_u\perp\mathbf r_v$）：此时 $\mathrm I=E\,du^2+G\,dv^2$、面积元为 $\sqrt{EG}\,du\,dv$；球面、旋转面与平面极坐标都是常见的正交网。
系数矩阵正定：$E>0$ 且 $EG-F^2=|\mathbf r_u\times\mathbf r_v|^2>0$；$EG-F^2$ 恒正等价于参数化正则，它同时保证面积元是实数。
第一基本形式是微分 $d\mathbf r$ 的长度平方，等价于把三维欧氏度量沿 $\mathbf r$ 拉回到参数平面：$\mathrm I=d\mathbf r\cdot d\mathbf r$；它只含一阶导数，属于内蕴量。
propertiesEn: Intrinsicness: arc length, angle and area on the surface depend only on $E,F,G$, not on how the surface is placed in three-dimensional space — this is the entire source of intrinsic geometry.

Under reparametrization $E,F,G$ transform according to the covariant rule for quadratic forms ($\tilde G=J^{\mathsf T}GJ$ with $J$ the Jacobian of the reparametrization), but the metric $\mathrm I$ is unchanged, and so is every quantity computed from it.

$F=0$ means the parameter grid is orthogonal ($\mathbf r_u\perp\mathbf r_v$): then $\mathrm I=E\,du^2+G\,dv^2$ and the area element is $\sqrt{EG}\,du\,dv$; spheres, surfaces of revolution and polar coordinates in the plane are standard orthogonal grids.

The coefficient matrix is positive definite: $E>0$ and $EG-F^2=|\mathbf r_u\times\mathbf r_v|^2>0$; positivity of $EG-F^2$ is equivalent to regularity of the parametrization and guarantees a real area element.

The first fundamental form is the squared length of the differential $d\mathbf r$, equivalently the pullback of the Euclidean metric to the parameter plane: $\mathrm I=d\mathbf r\cdot d\mathbf r$. It involves only first derivatives and is intrinsic.

plot.title: 单位球面：E = 1、F = 0、G = sin²u，面积元 √(EG−F²) = sin u

examples.problem: 对球面 $\mathbf r(u,v)=(R\sin u\cos v,\ R\sin u\sin v,\ R\cos u)$ 直接计算 $E,F,G$，并写出面积元因子 $\sqrt{EG-F^2}$。
examples.solution:
先求偏导：
$$\mathbf r_u=R(\cos u\cos v,\ \cos u\sin v,\ -\sin u),\qquad \mathbf r_v=R(-\sin u\sin v,\ \sin u\cos v,\ 0).$$
于是
$$E=\mathbf r_u\cdot\mathbf r_u=R^2(\cos^2u\cos^2v+\cos^2u\sin^2v+\sin^2u)=R^2,$$
$$F=\mathbf r_u\cdot\mathbf r_v=R^2(-\cos u\sin u\cos v\sin v+\cos u\sin u\sin v\cos v)=0,$$
$$G=\mathbf r_v\cdot\mathbf r_v=R^2(\sin^2u\sin^2v+\sin^2u\cos^2v)=R^2\sin^2u.$$
因此 $\mathrm I=R^2\,du^2+R^2\sin^2u\,dv^2$（球面的经纬参数网是正交网），面积元因子
$$\sqrt{EG-F^2}=\sqrt{R^4\sin^2u}=R^2\sin u.$$

examples.problem: 圆柱面 $\mathbf r(u,v)=(R\cos u,\ R\sin u,\ v)$ 的第一基本形式是什么？把它重参数化后与平面比较，说明圆柱面可以无拉伸地摊平（局部等距）。
examples.solution:
对 $\mathbf r$ 直接计算：$\mathbf r_u=(-R\sin u,\ R\cos u,\ 0)$，$\mathbf r_v=(0,0,1)$，故
$$E=R^2,\qquad F=0,\qquad G=1,\qquad \mathrm I=R^2\,du^2+dv^2.$$
做重参数化 $\tilde u=Ru$、$\tilde v=v$（即换用弧长参数），则
$$\tilde E=1,\qquad \tilde F=0,\qquad \tilde G=1,\qquad \mathrm I=d\tilde u^2+d\tilde v^2.$$
而平面 $\mathbf R(x,y)=(x,y,0)$ 的第一基本形式正是 $dx^2+dy^2$，两者形式完全相同。于是圆柱面（去掉一条母线后）与平面有相同的内蕴几何：长度与角度一一对应——这就是把圆柱剪开摊平不会有拉伸或压缩的依据（局部等距）。

nodes.title: 曲面的面积
nodes.summary: 用参数网把曲面切成小片，每片近似为以 r_u du、r_v dv 为边的平行四边形，面积是 |r_u × r_v| dudv = √(EG−F²) dudv；累加取极限得 A = ∬_D √(EG−F²) dudv。
nodes.summaryEn: The parameter grid cuts the surface into small pieces, each approximated by a parallelogram spanned by r_u du and r_v dv with area |r_u × r_v| dudv = √(EG−F²) dudv; summing and passing to the limit gives A = ∬_D √(EG−F²) dudv.
nodes.definition:
设正则曲面 $S$ 由 $\mathbf r(u,v)$（$(u,v)\in D$）参数化。把 $D$ 分成小矩形 $[u,u+du]\times[v,v+dv]$，它们在 $\mathbf r$ 下的像近似为一个**小平行四边形**，两条边是 $\mathbf r_u\,du$ 与 $\mathbf r_v\,dv$，其面积为
$$|\mathbf r_u\,du\times\mathbf r_v\,dv|=|\mathbf r_u\times\mathbf r_v|\,du\,dv=\sqrt{EG-F^2}\;du\,dv,$$
这里用了 Lagrange 恒等式 $EG-F^2=|\mathbf r_u\times\mathbf r_v|^2$。把所有小片面积加起来取极限，就得到曲面的**面积**
$$A=\iint_D|\mathbf r_u\times\mathbf r_v|\,du\,dv=\iint_D\sqrt{EG-F^2}\;du\,dv.$$
两种写法各有用途：叉积形式方便直接计算，第一基本形式的形式则说明面积元 $dA=\sqrt{EG-F^2}\,du\,dv$ 是内蕴的——只靠曲面上量距离也能得到面积，与曲面如何嵌入空间无关。

当曲面是图像 $z=f(x,y)$ 时，$\mathbf r=(x,y,f)$ 且 $\mathbf r_x\times\mathbf r_y=(-f_x,-f_y,1)$，于是
$$A=\iint_D\sqrt{1+f_x^2+f_y^2}\;dx\,dy,$$
这正是多元微积分里熟悉的公式；$f_x=f_y=0$（平面）时退化为普通二重积分 $\iint_D dx\,dy$。

如果一块参数化盖不住整个曲面，就把它切成若干块分别积分再相加：重参数化不改变面积，分块方式与坐标卡的选择都是自由的。需要留神的是，若参数化不单射（有重叠或自交），公式给出的是「计重数面积」；对无自交的单叶参数化或分块拼接，它才等于真正的几何面积。
nodes.definitionEn:
Let a regular surface $S$ be parametrized by $\mathbf r(u,v)$ with $(u,v)\in D$. Cut $D$ into small rectangles $[u,u+du]\times[v,v+dv]$; their images are approximately **small parallelograms** with sides $\mathbf r_u\,du$ and $\mathbf r_v\,dv$, whose area is
$$|\mathbf r_u\,du\times\mathbf r_v\,dv|=|\mathbf r_u\times\mathbf r_v|\,du\,dv=\sqrt{EG-F^2}\;du\,dv,$$
using Lagrange's identity $EG-F^2=|\mathbf r_u\times\mathbf r_v|^2$. Adding the pieces and passing to the limit gives the **area**
$$A=\iint_D|\mathbf r_u\times\mathbf r_v|\,du\,dv=\iint_D\sqrt{EG-F^2}\;du\,dv.$$
The two forms serve different purposes: the cross-product form is convenient for computation, while the $E,F,G$ form shows that the area element $dA=\sqrt{EG-F^2}\,du\,dv$ is intrinsic — it can be obtained by measuring distances inside the surface, independently of how the surface sits in space.

For a graph $z=f(x,y)$ we have $\mathbf r=(x,y,f)$ and $\mathbf r_x\times\mathbf r_y=(-f_x,-f_y,1)$, hence
$$A=\iint_D\sqrt{1+f_x^2+f_y^2}\;dx\,dy,$$
the familiar multivariable-calculus formula; for $f_x=f_y=0$ (a plane) it reduces to the ordinary double integral $\iint_D dx\,dy$.

If one parametrization cannot cover the whole surface, split the surface into pieces, integrate over each and add: reparametrization does not change the area, so the choice of charts is free. One caveat: if the parametrization is not injective (overlaps or self-intersections), the formula computes area counted with multiplicity; for a one-to-one parametrization or after gluing pieces, it equals the genuine geometric area.

formulas.note: 曲面面积公式：两种写法等价。叉积写法便于计算，$E,F,G$ 写法显示面积元的内蕴性。
formulas.noteEn: The surface-area formula in two equivalent forms: the cross-product form is convenient for computation, the $E,F,G$ form reveals intrinsicness of the area element.

formulas.note: 面积元与 Lagrange 恒等式，注意根号内是 $EG-F^2$，不是 $EG+F^2$，也不是它的平方。
formulas.noteEn: The area element together with Lagrange's identity; note that the radicand is $EG-F^2$, not $EG+F^2$, and not a square of it.

formulas.note: 图像曲面 $z=f(x,y)$ 的面积公式；梯度越大，曲面相对平面被撑得越开。
formulas.noteEn: Area of a graph surface $z=f(x,y)$; the larger the gradient, the more the surface is stretched relative to the plane.

formulas.note: 球面面积：$\sqrt{EG-F^2}=R^2\sin u$，极点是零测集，不影响积分值。
formulas.noteEn: Sphere area: $\sqrt{EG-F^2}=R^2\sin u$; the poles form a null set and do not affect the integral.

formulas.note: 环面面积（$R>r>0$）：内圈贡献得少、外圈贡献得多，平均恰好抵消，面积等于 $2\pi R\cdot2\pi r$。
formulas.noteEn: Torus area ($R>r>0$): the inner part contributes less and the outer part more; the average cancels exactly, leaving $(2\pi R)(2\pi r)$.

expression.text: A = ∬_D |r_u × r_v| dudv = ∬_D √(EG − F²) dudv
expression.note: 面积元 $dA=\sqrt{EG-F^2}\,du\,dv$；平面时 $E=G=1,F=0$，退化为 $du\,dv$。
expression.noteEn: The area element is $dA=\sqrt{EG-F^2}\,du\,dv$; for a plane $E=G=1$, $F=0$ and it reduces to $du\,dv$.

properties: 面积元 $\sqrt{EG-F^2}\,du\,dv$ 是曲面自身的测度，与参数化选取无关：重参数化、分块计算、翻转定向都不改变面积。
由 Lagrange 恒等式 $\sqrt{EG-F^2}=|\mathbf r_u\times\mathbf r_v|$：用第一基本形式或叉积算面积完全等价。
平面是最简单情形 $A=\iint_D du\,dv$；图像曲面 $z=f(x,y)$ 增加因子 $\sqrt{1+|\nabla f|^2}$，梯度越大面积被撑得越开。
曲面的面积是曲面积分的测度：任何曲面积分 $\iint_S g\,dS$ 都先化成 $\iint_D g(\mathbf r(u,v))\sqrt{EG-F^2}\,du\,dv$（见曲面积分）。
参数化不单射（自交或重叠）时，公式给出的是计重数面积；无自交的单叶参数化或分块拼接才能得到真正的几何面积。
propertiesEn: The area element $\sqrt{EG-F^2}\,du\,dv$ is a measure belonging to the surface itself: reparametrization, cutting into pieces and reversing orientation all leave the area unchanged.
By Lagrange's identity $\sqrt{EG-F^2}=|\mathbf r_u\times\mathbf r_v|$: computing area via the first fundamental form or via the cross product is entirely equivalent.
A plane is the simplest case, $A=\iint_D du\,dv$; for a graph $z=f(x,y)$ a factor $\sqrt{1+|\nabla f|^2}$ appears — the larger the gradient, the more the surface is stretched.
Surface area is the measure behind surface integrals: every surface integral $\iint_S g\,dS$ is first turned into $\iint_D g(\mathbf r(u,v))\sqrt{EG-F^2}\,du\,dv$ (see surface integral).

If the parametrization is not injective (overlaps or self-intersections), the formula gives area with multiplicity; a one-to-one parametrization or a glued decomposition yields the genuine geometric area.

plot.title: 环面 R=2、r=0.7：面积 = ∬√(EG−F²) dudv = 4π²Rr ≈ 55.3

examples.problem: 用面积公式计算半径 $R$ 的球面面积。
examples.solution:
球面 $\mathbf r(u,v)=(R\sin u\cos v,\ R\sin u\sin v,\ R\cos u)$，$D=[0,\pi]\times[0,2\pi]$，第一基本量已算出 $E=R^2$、$F=0$、$G=R^2\sin^2u$，故 $\sqrt{EG-F^2}=R^2\sin u$。于是
$$A=\int_0^{2\pi}\!\!\int_0^{\pi}R^2\sin u\;du\,dv=2\pi R^2\Bigl[-\cos u\Bigr]_0^{\pi}=2\pi R^2\cdot2=4\pi R^2.$$
这正是球的表面积公式。极点处参数化退化，但那只发生在 $u=0,\pi$ 两条线上（二维积分的零测集），不影响积分值。

examples.problem: 计算环面 $\mathbf r(u,v)=\bigl((R+r\cos u)\cos v,\ (R+r\cos u)\sin v,\ r\sin u\bigr)$（$R>r>0$）的面积。
examples.solution:
先算叉积的模：
$$\mathbf r_u=(-r\sin u\cos v,\ -r\sin u\sin v,\ r\cos u),$$
$$\mathbf r_v=\bigl(-(R+r\cos u)\sin v,\ (R+r\cos u)\cos v,\ 0\bigr),$$
$$|\mathbf r_u\times\mathbf r_v|=r(R+r\cos u)>0$$
（$R>r$ 保证 $R+r\cos u\ge R-r>0$，环面处处正则）。于是
$$A=\int_0^{2\pi}\!\!\int_0^{2\pi}r(R+r\cos u)\;du\,dv=2\pi r\int_0^{2\pi}(R+r\cos u)\,du=2\pi r\,(2\pi R+0)=4\pi^2Rr.$$
例如 $R=2$、$r=0.7$ 时 $A=4\pi^2\cdot1.4\approx55.3$，正好对应图示环面的外圈多、内圈少但平均刚好抵消的几何图像。

nodes.title: 第二基本形式
nodes.summary: II = L du² + 2M dudv + N dv²，其中 L = r_uu·n、M = r_uv·n、N = r_vv·n；它描述曲面在空间中如何「离开」自己的切平面（外蕴弯曲），与第一基本形式一道给出法曲率与主曲率。
nodes.summaryEn: The quadratic form II = L du² + 2M dudv + N dv² with L = r_uu·n, M = r_uv·n, N = r_vv·n; it describes how the surface leaves its tangent plane in space (extrinsic bending) and, together with the first fundamental form, yields normal and principal curvatures.
nodes.definition:
第一基本形式只管「沿曲面量距离」；要谈弯曲，还得看曲面怎样偏离切平面。设 $\mathbf n$ 是单位法向量，**第二基本形式**定义为
$$\mathrm{II}=L\,du^2+2M\,du\,dv+N\,dv^2,\qquad L=\mathbf r_{uu}\cdot\mathbf n,\quad M=\mathbf r_{uv}\cdot\mathbf n,\quad N=\mathbf r_{vv}\cdot\mathbf n.$$
注意 $L,M,N$ 是二阶导向量与单位法向量的内积，而不是与任意法向量的内积。

为什么这样定义？把曲面在 $(u,v)$ 附近做 Taylor 展开：
$$\mathbf r(u+du,v+dv)=\mathbf r(u,v)+\bigl(\mathbf r_u\,du+\mathbf r_v\,dv\bigr)+\tfrac12\bigl(\mathbf r_{uu}\,du^2+2\mathbf r_{uv}\,du\,dv+\mathbf r_{vv}\,dv^2\bigr)+\cdots$$
与 $\mathbf n$ 作内积时，一次项因为 $\mathbf n\perp\mathbf r_u,\mathbf r_v$ 而消失，剩下
$$\bigl\langle\mathbf r(u+du,v+dv)-\mathbf r(u,v),\ \mathbf n\bigr\rangle=\tfrac12\,\mathrm{II}+O(\Delta^3).$$
也就是说，$\tfrac12\mathrm{II}$ 正是曲面在小步长 $(du,dv)$ 处沿法向「抬起」（或凹陷）的高度：**第二基本形式度量曲面离开切平面的二阶速度**。其中 $L$ 是 $u$ 方向的弯曲，$N$ 是 $v$ 方向的弯曲，$M$ 是参数方向的扭曲。

与第一基本形式不同，$\mathrm{II}$ 是**外蕴**的：它依赖曲面在三维空间中的嵌入方式，也依赖 $\mathbf n$ 的取向。翻转法向量 $\mathbf n\to-\mathbf n$ 会使 $\mathrm{II}\to-\mathrm{II}$，而 $\mathrm I$ 不变——所以凡涉及 $\mathrm{II}$ 的量，都要先说清法向约定。本库统一取 $\mathbf n=(\mathbf r_u\times\mathbf r_v)/|\mathbf r_u\times\mathbf r_v|$。

三个标准例子建立直觉：平面 $\mathrm{II}\equiv0$，因为点根本不离开切平面；球面（标准参数化、外向 $\mathbf n$）满足 $L=-R$、$M=0$、$N=-R\sin^2u$，于是 $\mathrm{II}=-\tfrac1R\mathrm I$，各方向弯曲相同（脐点）；柱面 $L=-R$、$M=N=0$，只在圆周方向弯曲。$\mathrm{II}$ 与 $\mathrm I$ 联手几乎供应了全部曲率概念：法曲率 $\kappa_n=\mathrm{II}/\mathrm I$、主曲率、高斯曲率 $K=(LN-M^2)/(EG-F^2)$、平均曲率都从这对二次型出发。
nodes.definitionEn:
The first fundamental form only measures distances along the surface; to speak of bending one must see how the surface leaves its tangent plane. Let $\mathbf n$ be the unit normal. The **second fundamental form** is defined by
$$\mathrm{II}=L\,du^2+2M\,du\,dv+N\,dv^2,\qquad L=\mathbf r_{uu}\cdot\mathbf n,\quad M=\mathbf r_{uv}\cdot\mathbf n,\quad N=\mathbf r_{vv}\cdot\mathbf n.$$
Note that $L,M,N$ are scalar products of second derivatives with the **unit** normal, not with an arbitrary normal vector.

Why this definition? Expand the surface near $(u,v)$:
$$\mathbf r(u+du,v+dv)=\mathbf r(u,v)+\bigl(\mathbf r_u\,du+\mathbf r_v\,dv\bigr)+\tfrac12\bigl(\mathbf r_{uu}\,du^2+2\mathbf r_{uv}\,du\,dv+\mathbf r_{vv}\,dv^2\bigr)+\cdots$$
Dotting with $\mathbf n$ kills the first-order term (since $\mathbf n\perp\mathbf r_u,\mathbf r_v$) and leaves
$$\bigl\langle\mathbf r(u+du,v+dv)-\mathbf r(u,v),\ \mathbf n\bigr\rangle=\tfrac12\,\mathrm{II}+O(\Delta^3).$$
Thus $\tfrac12\mathrm{II}$ is the signed height by which the surface lifts off (or dips below) its tangent plane over the step $(du,dv)$: the second fundamental form measures the second-order speed at which the surface leaves the tangent plane. Here $L$ is the bending in the $u$-direction, $N$ in the $v$-direction, and $M$ the twist of the parameter directions.

Unlike the first fundamental form, $\mathrm{II}$ is **extrinsic**: it depends on how the surface is embedded in space and on the choice of $\mathbf n$. Flipping $\mathbf n\to-\mathbf n$ sends $\mathrm{II}\to-\mathrm{II}$ while $\mathrm I$ stays unchanged; hence every quantity built from $\mathrm{II}$ requires a stated normal convention. Throughout this library we take $\mathbf n=(\mathbf r_u\times\mathbf r_v)/|\mathbf r_u\times\mathbf r_v|$.

Three standard examples build intuition. A plane has $\mathrm{II}\equiv0$: it never leaves its tangent plane. The sphere with its standard parametrization and outward $\mathbf n$ has $L=-R$, $M=0$, $N=-R\sin^2u$, so $\mathrm{II}=-\tfrac1R\mathrm I$: equally curved in every direction (an umbilic surface). A cylinder has $L=-R$, $M=N=0$: it bends only in the circular direction. Together, $\mathrm I$ and $\mathrm{II}$ supply essentially every curvature notion: normal curvature $\kappa_n=\mathrm{II}/\mathrm I$, principal curvatures, Gaussian curvature $K=(LN-M^2)/(EG-F^2)$ and mean curvature.

formulas.note: 第二基本形式：与第一基本形式同样是对称二次型，$dudv$ 的系数同样是 $2M$。
formulas.noteEn: The second fundamental form is again a symmetric quadratic form, with the same coefficient $2M$ for $du\,dv$.

formulas.latex: L=\mathbf r_{uu}\cdot\mathbf n,\qquad M=\mathbf r_{uv}\cdot\mathbf n,\qquad N=\mathbf r_{vv}\cdot\mathbf n
formulas.note: 三个系数是二阶导向量与**单位**法向量的内积；若法向量不单位化，系数会多出 $|\mathbf r_u\times\mathbf r_v|$ 因子。
formulas.noteEn: The three coefficients are scalar products of second derivatives with the **unit** normal; without normalising the normal, an extra factor $|\mathbf r_u\times\mathbf r_v|$ would appear.

formulas.latex: \mathrm{II}=\langle d^2\mathbf r,\ \mathbf n\rangle=-\langle d\mathbf r,\ d\mathbf n\rangle
formulas.note: 两种等价定义：二阶微分的法向分量，或负的一阶微分与法向量微分的配对（Weingarten 形式）。
formulas.noteEn: Two equivalent definitions: the normal component of the second differential, or minus the pairing of the first differential with the differential of the normal (the Weingarten form).

formulas.note: 几何意义：$\tfrac12\mathrm{II}$ 是曲面沿法向偏离切平面的高度，$L,M,N$ 就是这种偏离的二阶系数。
formulas.noteEn: Geometric meaning: $\tfrac12\mathrm{II}$ is the signed normal height of the surface above its tangent plane, and $L,M,N$ are the second-order coefficients of this deviation.

formulas.latex: L=-R,\qquad M=0,\qquad N=-R\sin^2u\qquad(\mathbf n\ \text{外向}),\qquad \mathrm{II}=-\frac1R\,\mathrm I
formulas.note: 球面（半径 $R$，外向 $\mathbf n$）：第二基本形式与第一基本形式成比例，比例系数 $-1/R$；取内向 $\mathbf n$ 则整体变号。
formulas.noteEn: The sphere of radius $R$ with outward $\mathbf n$: the second fundamental form is proportional to the first, with factor $-1/R$; with the inward normal everything changes sign.

expression.text: II = L du² + 2M dudv + N dv²，其中 L = r_uu·n、M = r_uv·n、N = r_vv·n
expression.note: 第二基本形式与第一基本形式配对使用；$L,M,N$ 是与单位法向量 $\mathbf n$ 的内积，符号随 $\mathbf n$ 的取向翻转。
expression.noteEn: The second fundamental form is used in tandem with the first; $L,M,N$ are scalar products with the unit normal $\mathbf n$, and their signs flip with the orientation of $\mathbf n$.

properties: 外蕴性与符号：$\mathrm{II}$ 依赖嵌入方式与 $\mathbf n$ 的取向，$\mathbf n\to-\mathbf n$ 时 $\mathrm{II}\to-\mathrm{II}$；做题必须声明法向量约定，本库取 $\mathbf n=\mathbf r_u\times\mathbf r_v/|\mathbf r_u\times\mathbf r_v|$。
$\mathrm{II}\equiv0$ 当且仅当曲面局部是平面：二阶近似为零，且连通曲面上 $L=M=N\equiv0$ 蕴含曲面落在一个平面内。
球面上 $\mathrm{II}$ 与 $\mathrm I$ 成比例（外向 $\mathbf n$ 时 $\mathrm{II}=-\tfrac1R\mathrm I$）：每点各方向弯曲相同，这类点叫脐点；一般曲面只在孤立点处成比例。
$\mathrm I$ 与 $\mathrm{II}$ 都是对称二次型且 $\mathrm I$ 正定，总可以选到主方向使 $F=M=0$，此时 $\kappa_1=L/E$、$\kappa_2=N/G$ 就是主曲率。
曲率公式：$\kappa_n=\mathrm{II}/\mathrm I$，$K=\dfrac{LN-M^2}{EG-F^2}$，$H=\dfrac{EN-2FM+GL}{2(EG-F^2)}$；$K$ 与 $\mathbf n$ 取向无关，$H$ 在 $\mathbf n\to-\mathbf n$ 时变号。
propertiesEn: Extrinsic nature and signs: $\mathrm{II}$ depends on the embedding and on the orientation of $\mathbf n$, with $\mathbf n\to-\mathbf n$ giving $\mathrm{II}\to-\mathrm{II}$; every statement requires a normal convention, and we always take $\mathbf n=\mathbf r_u\times\mathbf r_v/|\mathbf r_u\times\mathbf r_v|$.
$\mathrm{II}\equiv0$ holds exactly when the surface is locally a plane: the second-order approximation vanishes, and on a connected surface $L=M=N\equiv0$ forces the surface to lie in a plane.

On a sphere $\mathrm{II}$ is proportional to $\mathrm I$ (for outward $\mathbf n$, $\mathrm{II}=-\tfrac1R\mathrm I$): every direction bends equally, a so-called umbilic point; a general surface is umbilic only at isolated points.

Both $\mathrm I$ and $\mathrm{II}$ are symmetric quadratic forms and $\mathrm I$ is positive definite, so principal directions can be chosen with $F=M=0$; then $\kappa_1=L/E$ and $\kappa_2=N/G$ are the principal curvatures.

Curvature formulas: $\kappa_n=\mathrm{II}/\mathrm I$, $K=\dfrac{LN-M^2}{EG-F^2}$ and $H=\dfrac{EN-2FM+GL}{2(EG-F^2)}$; $K$ is independent of the orientation of $\mathbf n$ while $H$ changes sign under $\mathbf n\to-\mathbf n$.

plot.title: 马鞍面 z = x² − y²：L、M、N 度量它如何离开切平面（原点 L=2、N=−2）

examples.problem: 写出图像曲面 $z=f(x,y)$ 的第二基本形式公式，并对马鞍面 $z=x^2-y^2$ 在原点处求出 $\mathrm{II}$（取向上法向量 $\mathbf n$）。
examples.solution:
对 $\mathbf r(x,y)=(x,y,f(x,y))$：$\mathbf r_x=(1,0,f_x)$，$\mathbf r_y=(0,1,f_y)$，二阶导只有 $z$ 分量非零：$\mathbf r_{xx}=(0,0,f_{xx})$、$\mathbf r_{xy}=(0,0,f_{xy})$、$\mathbf r_{yy}=(0,0,f_{yy})$；向上单位法向量为 $\mathbf n=(-f_x,-f_y,1)/\sqrt{1+f_x^2+f_y^2}$。于是
$$L=\frac{f_{xx}}{\sqrt{1+f_x^2+f_y^2}},\qquad M=\frac{f_{xy}}{\sqrt{1+f_x^2+f_y^2}},\qquad N=\frac{f_{yy}}{\sqrt{1+f_x^2+f_y^2}}.$$
对 $f=x^2-y^2$：$f_{xx}=2$、$f_{xy}=0$、$f_{yy}=-2$，原点处 $f_x=f_y=0$，所以 $L=2$、$M=0$、$N=-2$，即
$$\mathrm{II}=2\,dx^2-2\,dy^2,\qquad \mathrm I=dx^2+dy^2\quad(\text{原点}).$$
沿 $x$ 方向曲面朝 $\mathbf n$ 弯曲（$L>0$），沿 $y$ 方向背离 $\mathbf n$ 弯曲（$N<0$）——马鞍的形状被 $L$ 与 $N$ 的符号精确捕捉。

examples.problem: 验证球面（半径 $R$，取外向法向量 $\mathbf n$）满足 $L=-R$、$M=0$、$N=-R\sin^2u$，从而 $\mathrm{II}=-\frac1R\mathrm I$。
examples.solution:
对 $\mathbf r(u,v)=(R\sin u\cos v,\ R\sin u\sin v,\ R\cos u)$，外向单位法向量是 $\mathbf n=(\sin u\cos v,\ \sin u\sin v,\ \cos u)$。直接求二阶导：
$$\mathbf r_{uu}=-R(\sin u\cos v,\ \sin u\sin v,\ \cos u)=-R\,\mathbf n\ \Longrightarrow\ L=\mathbf r_{uu}\cdot\mathbf n=-R,$$
$$\mathbf r_{uv}=R(-\cos u\sin v,\ \cos u\cos v,\ 0)\ \Longrightarrow\ M=\mathbf r_{uv}\cdot\mathbf n=0,$$
$$\mathbf r_{vv}=-R\sin u\,(\cos v,\ \sin v,\ 0)\ \Longrightarrow\ N=\mathbf r_{vv}\cdot\mathbf n=-R\sin^2u.$$
因此
$$\mathrm{II}=-R\,du^2-R\sin^2u\,dv^2=-\frac1R\bigl(R^2du^2+R^2\sin^2u\,dv^2\bigr)=-\frac1R\,\mathrm I.$$
$\mathrm{II}$ 与 $\mathrm I$ 处处成比例（比例系数 $-1/R$），比例系数为负、球面各方向弯曲相同，全是脐点；负号来自外向法向量的约定，若改取内向 $\mathbf n$ 则整体变号。

nodes.title: 法曲率
nodes.summary: 沿切方向 (du:dv) 的法曲率 κ_n = II/I = (L du² + 2M dudv + N dv²)/(E du² + 2F dudv + G dv²)，等于过该点切于此方向的曲线曲率在法向上的投影；球面各方向 κ_n = ±1/R，平面 κ_n ≡ 0。
nodes.summaryEn: Along a tangent direction (du:dv) the normal curvature is κ_n = II/I = (L du² + 2M dudv + N dv²)/(E du² + 2F dudv + G dv²), the projection of a suitable curve's curvature onto the surface normal; on a sphere κ_n = ±1/R in every direction, while a plane has κ_n ≡ 0.
nodes.definition:
设曲面 $S$ 在 $p$ 点有单位法向量 $\mathbf n$。取一个切方向，把它写成参数增量的比值 $du:dv$（对应的切向量是 $\mathbf r_u\,du+\mathbf r_v\,dv$）。过 $p$ 沿该方向的曲面曲线 $\gamma$ 的曲率向量中，只有法向分量与曲面自身的弯曲有关。以单位速度参数化时，定义
$$\kappa_n=\langle\gamma''(0),\ \mathbf n\rangle,$$
称为曲面沿该方向的**法曲率**。一个漂亮的事实是：它只依赖点 $p$ 与方向 $du:dv$，与具体挑哪条曲线无关。把 $\gamma(t)=\mathbf r(u(t),v(t))$ 代入并求导：
$$\gamma''=\mathbf r_u\,u''+\mathbf r_v\,v''+\mathbf r_{uu}\,u'^2+2\mathbf r_{uv}\,u'v'+\mathbf r_{vv}\,v'^2,$$
与 $\mathbf n$ 内积时前两项消失（$\mathbf n\perp\mathbf r_u,\mathbf r_v$），剩下 $Lu'^2+2Mu'v'+Nv'^2=\mathrm{II}$；而分母是速度的平方 $\mathrm I$。于是得到核心公式
$$\kappa_n=\frac{\mathrm{II}}{\mathrm I}=\frac{L\,du^2+2M\,du\,dv+N\,dv^2}{E\,du^2+2F\,du\,dv+G\,dv^2}.$$
分母恒正，所以 $\kappa_n$ 是方向 $du:dv$ 的函数，符号与大小随方向变化。

同一点上 $\kappa_n$ 的最大值与最小值就是**主曲率** $\kappa_1,\kappa_2$（在 $\mathrm I=1$ 的单位方向圆周上取到，对应方向即主方向），它们的乘积是高斯曲率、平均数是平均曲率。$\kappa_n=0$ 的方向叫渐近方向：曲面沿它不向法向弯曲。

**符号约定至关重要**：本库统一取 $\mathbf n=(\mathbf r_u\times\mathbf r_v)/|\mathbf r_u\times\mathbf r_v|$。对球面的标准参数化 $\mathbf r=(R\sin u\cos v,\ R\sin u\sin v,\ R\cos u)$，这个 $\mathbf n$ 指向球外，此时任一方向的法曲率都是
$$\kappa_n\equiv-\frac1R;$$
若改取内向的 $-\mathbf n$，则 $\kappa_n\equiv+\frac1R$。无论哪种约定，$|\kappa_n|=1/R$ 恒定不变——球面上每个点都是脐点。对照之下，平面 $\mathrm{II}\equiv0$ 故 $\kappa_n\equiv0$；圆柱面沿母线方向 $\kappa_n=0$、沿圆周方向 $\kappa_n=\pm1/R$，弯曲全部集中在圆周方向。

最后是 Meusnier 定理，它解释「投影」二字：若曲线 $\gamma$ 以单位速度过 $p$、切向为该方向，曲率为 $\kappa$、单位主法向量为 $\mathbf N$，则
$$\kappa_n=\kappa\cos\theta,\qquad \theta=\angle(\mathbf N,\ \mathbf n).$$
切于同一方向的全部曲线共享同一个 $\kappa\cos\theta$：它们的曲率可以千差万别，但「有效作用于曲面弯曲」的分量完全相同。特别地取法截线（$\theta=0$）时，曲线曲率恰好等于 $|\kappa_n|$。
nodes.definitionEn:
Let $S$ have unit normal $\mathbf n$ at $p$. Take a tangent direction, written as a ratio $du:dv$ of parameter increments (the tangent vector is $\mathbf r_u\,du+\mathbf r_v\,dv$). For a surface curve $\gamma$ through $p$ with that velocity, only the normal component of its curvature vector is relevant to the bending of the surface. Parametrized by unit speed,
$$\kappa_n=\langle\gamma''(0),\ \mathbf n\rangle$$
is the **normal curvature** of the surface in that direction. A beautiful fact: $\kappa_n$ depends only on $p$ and the direction $du:dv$, not on which curve through $p$ is chosen. Substituting $\gamma(t)=\mathbf r(u(t),v(t))$ and differentiating,
$$\gamma''=\mathbf r_u\,u''+\mathbf r_v\,v''+\mathbf r_{uu}\,u'^2+2\mathbf r_{uv}\,u'v'+\mathbf r_{vv}\,v'^2;$$
dotting with $\mathbf n$ removes the first two terms (since $\mathbf n\perp\mathbf r_u,\mathbf r_v$) and leaves $Lu'^2+2Mu'v'+Nv'^2=\mathrm{II}$, while the denominator is the squared speed $\mathrm I$. Hence the central formula
$$\kappa_n=\frac{\mathrm{II}}{\mathrm I}=\frac{L\,du^2+2M\,du\,dv+N\,dv^2}{E\,du^2+2F\,du\,dv+G\,dv^2}.$$
The denominator is always positive, so $\kappa_n$ is a function of the direction $du:dv$, varying in sign and size.

At a fixed point the maximum and minimum of $\kappa_n$ are the **principal curvatures** $\kappa_1,\kappa_2$ (attained on the circle $\mathrm I=1$, in the principal directions); their product is the Gaussian curvature and their average the mean curvature. Directions with $\kappa_n=0$ are called asymptotic: the surface does not bend normally along them.

**The sign convention is essential.** We always take $\mathbf n=(\mathbf r_u\times\mathbf r_v)/|\mathbf r_u\times\mathbf r_v|$. For the standard sphere parametrization $\mathbf r=(R\sin u\cos v,\ R\sin u\sin v,\ R\cos u)$, this $\mathbf n$ points outward and every direction has
$$\kappa_n\equiv-\frac1R;$$
with the inward normal the value is $+\frac1R$. Either way $|\kappa_n|=1/R$ is constant: every point of a sphere is umbilic. By contrast a plane has $\mathrm{II}\equiv0$, hence $\kappa_n\equiv0$; on a cylinder $\kappa_n=0$ along the rulings and $\kappa_n=\pm1/R$ in the circular direction, so all bending is concentrated there.

Finally, Meusnier's theorem explains the word projection. If $\gamma$ passes through $p$ with unit speed in the given direction, with curvature $\kappa$ and unit principal normal $\mathbf N$, then
$$\kappa_n=\kappa\cos\theta,\qquad \theta=\angle(\mathbf N,\ \mathbf n).$$
All curves through $p$ tangent to the same direction share the same $\kappa\cos\theta$: their curvatures may differ wildly, but the component that actually bends the surface is identical. In particular, for a normal section ($\theta=0$) the curve's curvature equals $|\kappa_n|$.

formulas.note: 法曲率的核心公式：只依赖点与方向 $du:dv$，与具体曲线无关；分母 $\mathrm I>0$ 恒成立。
formulas.noteEn: The central formula: $\kappa_n$ depends only on the point and the direction $du:dv$, not on the particular curve; the denominator $\mathrm I>0$ always.

formulas.note: 定义与 Meusnier 定理：$\kappa_n$ 是曲线曲率向量在法向的投影；$\theta$ 是曲线主法向与 $\mathbf n$ 的夹角。
formulas.noteEn: Definition and Meusnier's theorem: $\kappa_n$ is the projection of the curve's curvature vector onto the normal; $\theta$ is the angle between the curve's principal normal and $\mathbf n$.

formulas.note: 主曲率是法曲率在单位方向圆上的极值；高斯曲率等于两主曲率之积，也与 $L,M,N$ 直接相连。
formulas.noteEn: The principal curvatures are the extrema of $\kappa_n$ on the unit direction circle; the Gaussian curvature is their product and is also expressed directly through $L,M,N$.

formulas.note: 半径 $R$ 的球面：任意方向的法曲率都是常数（脐点）；符号随法向量取向翻转，绝对值恒为 $1/R$。
formulas.noteEn: The sphere of radius $R$: the normal curvature is constant in every direction (umbilic); the sign flips with the orientation of the normal while the absolute value stays $1/R$.

formulas.note: 平面的法曲率恒为零；反向也成立：一个连通曲面上若各方向法曲率处处为零，它局部落在某个平面内。
formulas.noteEn: A plane has $\kappa_n\equiv0$; conversely, if on a connected surface the normal curvature vanishes in every direction and at every point, the surface lies locally in a plane.

expression.text: κ_n = II / I = (L du² + 2M dudv + N dv²)/(E du² + 2F dudv + G dv²)
expression.note: 法曲率是方向 $du:dv$ 的函数；本库取 $\mathbf n=(\mathbf r_u\times\mathbf r_v)/|\mathbf r_u\times\mathbf r_v|$，球面上恒为 $-1/R$、平面上恒为 $0$。
expression.noteEn: The normal curvature is a function of the direction $du:dv$; with our convention $\mathbf n=(\mathbf r_u\times\mathbf r_v)/|\mathbf r_u\times\mathbf r_v|$ it is $-1/R$ on a sphere and $0$ on a plane.

properties: 方向依赖性：$\kappa_n$ 只由比值 $du:dv$ 决定，与曲线选取无关；同一点不同方向可有不同值，符号也可能变化（马鞍面原点）。
Meusnier 定理：过 $p$ 切于同一方向的任意曲线都满足 $\kappa\cos\theta=\kappa_n$ 相同；法截线（$\theta=0$）的曲率恰为 $|\kappa_n|$，是一条最能代表曲面弯曲的曲线。
符号约定：$\kappa_n$ 的正负随 $\mathbf n$ 翻转，本库统一 $\mathbf n=\mathbf r_u\times\mathbf r_v/|\mathbf r_u\times\mathbf r_v|$；球面外向时 $\kappa_n=-1/R$，负号只是约定的产物，$|\kappa_n|=1/R$ 与约定无关。
极值给主曲率：$\kappa_1\ge\kappa_2$ 是 $\kappa_n$ 在 $\mathrm I=1$ 圆周上的最大、最小值；沿正交的主方向有欧拉公式 $\kappa_n(\theta)=\kappa_1\cos^2\theta+\kappa_2\sin^2\theta$。
两个极端：平面 $\kappa_n\equiv0$（处处平坦，$K=0$），球面 $\kappa_n\equiv\pm1/R$（处处同样弯，$K=1/R^2$ 为正常数，恒正）。
propertiesEn: Direction dependence: $\kappa_n$ is determined by the ratio $du:dv$ alone, independently of the curve; different directions at the same point can give different values and even different signs (the saddle at the origin).

Meusnier's theorem: every curve through $p$ tangent to the same direction satisfies $\kappa\cos\theta=\kappa_n$ with the same value; a normal section ($\theta=0$) has curvature exactly $|\kappa_n|$ and is the curve that best represents the bending of the surface.

Sign convention: the sign of $\kappa_n$ flips with $\mathbf n$, and we always take $\mathbf n=\mathbf r_u\times\mathbf r_v/|\mathbf r_u\times\mathbf r_v|$; for a sphere with outward normal $\kappa_n=-1/R$, a sign which is a product of the convention, while $|\kappa_n|=1/R$ does not depend on it.

Extrema give the principal curvatures: $\kappa_1\ge\kappa_2$ are the maximum and minimum of $\kappa_n$ on the circle $\mathrm I=1$; along orthogonal principal directions Euler's formula $\kappa_n(\theta)=\kappa_1\cos^2\theta+\kappa_2\sin^2\theta$ holds.
Two extremes: a plane has $\kappa_n\equiv0$ (flat everywhere, $K=0$), a sphere has $\kappa_n\equiv\pm1/R$ (equally curved everywhere, with the positive constant $K=1/R^2$).

plot.title: 球面：任意方向的法曲率都是常数 |κₙ| = 1/R（本库取外向 n 时 κₙ = −1/R）

examples.problem: 在半径 $R$ 的球面上取纬圆 $u=u_0$，用 Meusnier 定理验证球面上的法曲率恒等于 $-1/R$（取外向单位法向量）。
examples.solution:
纬圆是平面 $z=R\cos u_0$ 上半径 $\rho=R\sin u_0$ 的圆，作为空间曲线其曲率 $\kappa=1/\rho=1/(R\sin u_0)$，主法向量指向圆心：
$$\mathbf N=(-\cos v,\ -\sin v,\ 0),\qquad \mathbf n=(\sin u_0\cos v,\ \sin u_0\sin v,\ \cos u_0).$$
于是 $\cos\theta=\mathbf N\cdot\mathbf n=-\sin u_0$，由 Meusnier 定理
$$\kappa_n=\kappa\cos\theta=\frac{1}{R\sin u_0}\cdot(-\sin u_0)=-\frac1R.$$
结果与 $u_0$ 无关：纬圆越靠近极点（$\sin u_0$ 越小）曲线曲率 $\kappa$ 越大，但它在法向上的投影始终是 $-1/R$——这正是「球面各方向法曲率相同」的直观解释。

examples.problem: 马鞍面 $z=x^2-y^2$ 在原点处，求各方向的法曲率 $\kappa_n$、主曲率与渐近方向（取向上法向量）。
examples.solution:
原点处（由上一知识点的计算）$\mathrm I=dx^2+dy^2$，$\mathrm{II}=2\,dx^2-2\,dy^2$，所以
$$\kappa_n=\frac{2\,dx^2-2\,dy^2}{dx^2+dy^2}.$$
沿 $x$ 方向（$dy=0$）：$\kappa_n=2$；沿 $y$ 方向（$dx=0$）：$\kappa_n=-2$。因此主曲率为 $\kappa_1=2$、$\kappa_2=-2$（均在坐标方向上），高斯曲率 $K=\kappa_1\kappa_2=-4<0$，原点是不折不扣的鞍点。再令 $dx=\pm\,dy$ 得 $\kappa_n=0$：两条对角线方向是渐近方向，曲面沿它们不向法向弯曲。

nodes.title: 正弦定理
nodes.summary: 三角形中边与对角正弦的比值相等，都等于外接圆直径。
nodes.summaryEn: In any triangle the ratio of a side to the sine of its opposite angle is the same, equal to the circumdiameter.
nodes.definition:
在任意三角形 $ABC$ 中，设角 $A,B,C$ 的对边分别为 $a,b,c$，外接圆半径为 $R$，则三条边与它们对角的正弦之比恒相等：

$$\frac{a}{\sin A} = \frac{b}{\sin B} = \frac{c}{\sin C} = 2R$$

这就是**正弦定理**。它揭示了三角形的边角关系：大边对大角，边与对角正弦成**正比**。

它的重要性在于——只要知道两角一边，或两边及其中一边的对角，就能把整个三角形「解」出来。它也是把几何长度问题转化为三角函数问题的第一把钥匙，在天文测距、地图测绘和物理的矢量分解中反复出现。
nodes.definitionEn:
In any triangle $ABC$, let $a,b,c$ be the sides opposite to angles $A,B,C$ and let $R$ be the circumradius. Then the ratio of each side to the sine of its opposite angle is constant:

$$\frac{a}{\sin A} = \frac{b}{\sin B} = \frac{c}{\sin C} = 2R$$

This is the **law of sines**. It expresses the fact that larger sides face larger angles — sides are proportional to the sines of their opposite angles.

Its power is that knowing two angles and one side, or two sides and a non-included angle, allows you to solve the whole triangle. It is the first key that converts length problems in geometry into trigonometric ones, and it reappears in astronomy, surveying and vector decomposition.

formulas.note: 正弦定理的核心形式：三组边角比相等，用来由已知边角求未知边角。
formulas.noteEn: The core form: the three side-to-sine ratios are equal, used to find unknown sides or angles.

formulas.note: 比值等于外接圆直径 $2R$，该式可反求外接圆半径 $R = \dfrac{a}{2\sin A}$。
formulas.noteEn: The common ratio equals the circumdiameter $2R$, so $R = \dfrac{a}{2\sin A}$.

formulas.latex: a : b : c = \sin A : \sin B : \sin C
formulas.note: 边长比等于对角正弦比，常用于判断三角形形状或进行边角互化。
formulas.noteEn: Sides are proportional to the sines of opposite angles, useful for converting between sides and angles.

formulas.note: 由正弦定理导出的面积公式，已知两边及其夹角时最方便。
formulas.noteEn: Area formula derived with the law of sines; best when two sides and the included angle are known.

expression.text: a/sin A = b/sin B = c/sin C = 2R
expression.note: 适用于任意三角形，包括锐角、直角和钝角三角形。
expression.noteEn: Valid for every triangle — acute, right or obtuse.

properties: 对任意三角形都成立，不限于直角三角形
比值等于外接圆直径 $2R$，联系了三角形的边角与外界圆
边与对角正弦成正比：大角对大边，$a>b \iff A>B$
已知「两角一边」可唯一确定三角形；已知「两边一对角」可能出现两解（SSA 情形）
是边角互化的重要工具，可将边的关系化为角的关系
propertiesEn: Holds for every triangle, not only right triangles
The common ratio equals the circumdiameter $2R$, linking sides, angles and the circumcircle
Sides are proportional to the sines of opposite angles: $a > b \iff A > B$
Two angles and a side determine a unique triangle; two sides and a non-included angle (SSA) may give two solutions
A key tool for converting between sides and angles

plot.title: 任意三角形中的正弦定理

examples.problem: 在 $\triangle ABC$ 中，已知 $a = 4$，$A = 30^{\circ}$，$B = 45^{\circ}$，求边 $b$ 与外接圆半径 $R$。
examples.solution: 由正弦定理 $\dfrac{a}{\sin A} = \dfrac{b}{\sin B}$，得 $b = \dfrac{a\sin B}{\sin A} = \dfrac{4 \times \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}}{\frac{1}{2}} = 4\sqrt{2}$。再由 $\dfrac{a}{\sin A} = 2R$，得 $R = \dfrac{a}{2\sin A} = \dfrac{4}{2 \times \frac{1}{2}} = 4$。所以 $b = 4\sqrt{2}$，$R = 4$。

nodes.title: 余弦定理
nodes.summary: 三角形中一边的平方等于另两边的平方和减去它们与夹角余弦的二倍积。
nodes.summaryEn: The square of one side equals the sum of the squares of the other two sides minus twice their product times the cosine of the included angle.
nodes.definition:
在任意三角形 $ABC$ 中，角 $A,B,C$ 的对边分别为 $a,b,c$，则

$$a^2 = b^2 + c^2 - 2bc\cos A$$

同理可得关于 $b,c$ 的对称形式。这条规律叫**余弦定理**。

它其实是勾股定理在一般三角形上的推广：把上式移项得 $a^2 - b^2 - c^2 = -2bc\cos A$。当 $A = 90^{\circ}$ 时 $\cos A = 0$，公式就退化为熟悉的 $a^2 = b^2 + c^2$。因此余弦定理可以看作是描述「勾股定理的偏差」：夹角越大，对角边越长。

它最擅长处理「两边夹一角」和「三边求角」两类问题，是解三角形时与正弦定理并用的另一件主要工具。
nodes.definitionEn:
In any triangle $ABC$ with opposite sides $a,b,c$,

$$a^2 = b^2 + c^2 - 2bc\cos A$$

and similarly for the other two sides. This is the **law of cosines**.

It generalises the Pythagorean theorem: rearranged, it reads $a^2 - b^2 - c^2 = -2bc\cos A$. When $A = 90^{\circ}$ we have $\cos A = 0$ and it collapses to $a^2 = b^2 + c^2$. So the law of cosines measures the deviation from a right angle — the larger the included angle, the longer the opposite side.

It handles two problems best: two sides with the included angle, and three sides given. Together with the law of sines it is the main tool for solving triangles.

formulas.note: 余弦定理基本形式：已知两边及夹角求第三边。
formulas.noteEn: Basic form: find the third side from two sides and the included angle.

formulas.note: 变形形式：已知三边求角，也可用来判断三角形的形状。
formulas.noteEn: Rearranged form: find an angle from three sides, or classify the triangle.

formulas.note: 当且仅当 $A$ 为直角时退化为勾股定理，说明它是勾股定理的推广。
formulas.noteEn: It reduces to the Pythagorean theorem exactly when $A$ is a right angle.

formulas.note: 用三边平方关系判断角为锐角；反之 $\cos A < 0$ 时为钝角。
formulas.noteEn: Determine acuteness from squared sides: $\cos A > 0$ means acute, $\cos A < 0$ means obtuse.

expression.text: a² = b² + c² − 2bc·cos A
expression.note: 三个角各有一条对称公式，$bc$ 是夹角的邻边乘积。
expression.noteEn: There is one symmetric formula for each angle; $bc$ is the product of the sides adjacent to the angle.

properties: 对任意三角形都成立，是勾股定理的推广
已知两边及夹角可唯一求第三边，已知三边可解出所有角
由 $\cos A$ 的正负可直接判断三角形为锐角、直角或钝角三角形
当 $A$ 为钝角时 $\cos A < 0$，对角边最长且 $a^2 > b^2 + c^2$
与正弦定理配合使用，可完成任意「解三角形」问题
propertiesEn: Valid for every triangle and generalises the Pythagorean theorem
Two sides plus the included angle determine the third side; three sides determine all angles
The sign of $\cos A$ classifies the triangle as acute, right or obtuse
If $A$ is obtuse then $\cos A < 0$, the opposite side is longest and $a^2 > b^2 + c^2$
Used together with the law of sines to solve any triangle

plot.title: 三角形中的余弦定理（边与夹角）

examples.problem: 在 $\triangle ABC$ 中，$b = 3$，$c = 4$，$A = 60^{\circ}$，求 $a$。
examples.solution: 由余弦定理 $a^2 = b^2 + c^2 - 2bc\cos A = 9 + 16 - 2 \times 3 \times 4 \times \frac{1}{2} = 25 - 12 = 13$，所以 $a = \sqrt{13}$。

examples.problem: 已知 $\triangle ABC$ 三边为 $a = 7$，$b = 5$，$c = 3$，判断它的形状最大角的度数。
examples.solution: 最大角对应最大边 $a = 7$，用变形公式 $\cos A = \dfrac{b^2 + c^2 - a^2}{2bc} = \dfrac{25 + 9 - 49}{2 \times 5 \times 3} = \dfrac{-15}{30} = -\dfrac{1}{2}$。因为 $\cos A < 0$，所以 $A = 120^{\circ}$，该三角形为钝角三角形。

nodes.title: 三角形的面积
nodes.summary: 三角形的面积可由底乘高、两边夹一角或三边长度等多种方式计算。
nodes.summaryEn: A triangle's area can be computed from base and height, from two sides and the included angle, or from three sides.
nodes.definition:
三角形的**面积**度量它所占的平面区域大小。最朴素的定义是「底乘高除以二」：$S = \dfrac{1}{2} \times \text{底} \times \text{高}$。

在解三角形中更有用的是**两边夹一角公式**：

$$S = \frac{1}{2}ab\sin C$$

它把面积与三角形的边角数据直接联系起来，由它配合正弦定理可导出 $S = \dfrac{abc}{4R}$，配合海伦公式又可得到只用三边表示的形式。

面积公式是几何与三角之间的桥梁：许多「求面积」的题目实际是在考如何把已知条件转成边角关系，再套用合适的公式。
nodes.definitionEn:
The **area** of a triangle measures the plane region it encloses. The most basic definition is half the base times the height: $S = \dfrac{1}{2} \times \text{base} \times \text{height}$.

More useful in solving triangles is the **two-sides-and-included-angle** formula:

$$S = \frac{1}{2}ab\sin C$$

It links area directly to side-angle data. Combined with the law of sines it yields $S = \dfrac{abc}{4R}$, and with Heron's formula it becomes an expression in the three sides alone.

Area formulas are the bridge between geometry and trigonometry: many area problems are really about converting given data into side-angle relations and choosing the right formula.

formulas.note: 底乘高除以二，$h_a$ 为 $a$ 边上的高，是最基本的面积公式。
formulas.noteEn: Half base times height, with $h_a$ the height on side $a$; the most basic formula.

formulas.note: 已知两边及其夹角求面积，是解三角形中最常用的面积公式。
formulas.noteEn: Area from two sides and the included angle; the workhorse formula in solving triangles.

formulas.note: 用三边和外接圆半径表示面积，由正弦定理代入面积公式得到。
formulas.noteEn: Area in terms of three sides and the circumradius, obtained by substituting the law of sines.

formulas.note: 海伦公式（$p$ 为半周长），仅用三边即可求面积。
formulas.noteEn: Heron's formula with semiperimeter $p$; uses only the three sides.

formulas.note: $r$ 为内切圆半径，$p$ 为半周长，常用于已知面积的逆问题。
formulas.noteEn: With inradius $r$ and semiperimeter $p$; useful for inverse problems.

expression.text: S = ½ab·sin C
expression.note: 夹角必须是所取两边之间的角，$C$ 是 $a$、$b$ 的夹角。
expression.noteEn: The angle must lie between the chosen sides: $C$ is the angle between $a$ and $b$.

properties: 两边夹一角公式 $S = \frac{1}{2}ab\sin C$ 中角的正弦恒为正，结果总为正
面积随夹角增大而增大：两边固定时，$C = 90^{\circ}$ 取得最大面积 $\frac{1}{2}ab$
同一三角形用不同边角组合计算面积结果相同，可用于检验解法
海伦公式说明三边一旦确定，面积随之唯一确定（SSS 全等）
面积与内切圆、外接圆半径通过 $S = pr = \dfrac{abc}{4R}$ 建立联系
propertiesEn: In $S = \frac{1}{2}ab\sin C$ the sine of the angle is always positive, so the area is positive
Area grows with the included angle; for fixed sides it is largest, $\frac{1}{2}ab$, at $C = 90^{\circ}$
Any valid combination of sides and angles gives the same area, which checks a solution
Heron's formula shows three sides determine the area uniquely (SSS congruence)
Area connects to the inradius and circumradius via $S = pr = \dfrac{abc}{4R}$

plot.title: 三角形面积：底乘高除以二

examples.problem: 在 $\triangle ABC$ 中，$a = 5$，$b = 8$，$C = 30^{\circ}$，求三角形的面积。
examples.solution: 由面积公式 $S = \dfrac{1}{2}ab\sin C = \dfrac{1}{2} \times 5 \times 8 \times \sin 30^{\circ} = 20 \times \dfrac{1}{2} = 10$。所以面积为 $10$。

nodes.title: 解三角形的实际应用
nodes.summary: 用正弦、余弦定理解决测距、测高、测量角度等实际问题。
nodes.summaryEn: Using the laws of sines and cosines to solve real-world distance, height and angle measurement problems.
nodes.definition:
**解三角形的实际应用**指的是：把现实中的测距、测高、测角问题抽象成一个（或几个）三角形，再用正弦定理、余弦定理和面积公式算出未知量。

关键在于「翻译」：把文字描述中的方位、仰角、俯角、坡度等术语画成带标注的三角形。常用的术语有：**仰角**（视线在水平线上方时与水平线的夹角）、**俯角**（视线在水平线下方时的夹角）、**方位角**（从正北方向顺时针旋转到目标方向的角度）、**坡角**（斜面与水平面的夹角）。

由于大多数情形不能直接测量，需要构造两个或多个三角形，通过公共边把已知量传递过去。这类问题在测绘、航海、航空、天文和建筑工程中随处可见，是把三角学从课本带进现实的核心场景。
nodes.definitionEn:
**Applications of solving triangles** means abstracting real-world problems about distances, heights and angles into one or more triangles, then computing unknown quantities with the laws of sines and cosines and area formulas.

The key skill is translation: turning wording about direction, elevation, depression and slope into an annotated triangle. Standard terms include the **angle of elevation** (above the horizontal), the **angle of depression** (below the horizontal), the **bearing** (measured clockwise from north) and the **slope angle** (between a slope and the horizontal).

Since most quantities cannot be measured directly, one constructs two or more triangles and passes known values through a shared side. Such problems appear throughout surveying, navigation, aviation, astronomy and civil engineering — the main route from textbook trigonometry into the real world.

formulas.note: 正弦定理：适用于已知两角一边或两边一对角的测量三角形。
formulas.noteEn: Law of sines: for two angles and a side, or two sides and a non-included angle.

formulas.note: 余弦定理：适用于已知两边及夹角（如两次测距加方位角差）的场景。
formulas.noteEn: Law of cosines: for two measured sides and the angle between them.

formulas.note: 已知水平距离 $d$ 和仰角 $\alpha$，求竖直高度 $h$，是最简单的测高模型。
formulas.noteEn: Height $h$ from horizontal distance $d$ and elevation angle $\alpha$; the simplest height model.

formulas.note: 在两点测同一目标的仰角 $\alpha,\beta$，两点相距 $d$，可消去到目标的水平距离求出高度。
formulas.noteEn: Given elevation angles $\alpha,\beta$ from two points a distance $d$ apart, the unknown horizontal distance cancels.

properties: 解题第一步永远是画图，把仰角、俯角、方位角标在图上
实际量必须有实际意义：求出的边长、角度要为正且满足三角形内角和为 $180^{\circ}$
多个三角形通过公共边（或公共角）联系起来，是测量题的基本结构
已知「两边一对角」时要检验是否出现两解，再结合实际图形取舍
近似计算中注意单位统一与有效数字，测量误差会沿计算链条放大
propertiesEn: Always draw the diagram first, marking elevation, depression and bearing angles
Answers must be physically meaningful: positive lengths and angles summing to $180^{\circ}$
Shared sides or angles link several triangles — the standard structure of surveying problems
Check for the ambiguous two-solution case with two sides and a non-included angle, then use the figure to decide
Keep units consistent and track significant figures; measurement error propagates through the chain

plot.title: 测高模型：由距离与仰角求高度

examples.problem: 要测量河对岸的点 $C$ 到岸边点 $D$ 的距离。在岸上选一点 $A$（与 $D$ 同侧），测得 $AD=100\text{ m}$，$\angle CAD=60^{\circ}$，$\angle ADC=75^{\circ}$，求 $CD$（用正弦定理）。
examples.solution: 在 $\triangle ACD$ 中，$\angle ACD = 180^{\circ} - 60^{\circ} - 75^{\circ} = 45^{\circ}$。由正弦定理 $\dfrac{CD}{\sin 60^{\circ}} = \dfrac{AD}{\sin 45^{\circ}}$，得 $CD = \dfrac{100 \sin 60^{\circ}}{\sin 45^{\circ}} = \dfrac{100 \times \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}}{\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}} = 50\sqrt{6} \approx 122.5\text{ m}$。

examples.problem: 在距塔底水平距离 $60\text{ m}$ 处测得塔顶仰角为 $30^{\circ}$，求塔高。
examples.solution: 设塔高为 $h$，水平距离 $d = 60$，仰角 $\alpha = 30^{\circ}$。由 $h = d\tan\alpha = 60 \times \tan 30^{\circ} = 60 \times \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{3} = 20\sqrt{3} \approx 34.6\text{ m}$。所以塔高约为 $34.6\text{ m}$。

nodes.title: 反三角函数
nodes.summary: 由三角函数值反求角度的函数，包括 arcsin、arccos 和 arctan。
nodes.summaryEn: Functions that recover an angle from a trigonometric value: arcsin, arccos and arctan.
nodes.definition:
三角函数是周期函数，并不单调，因此整体上不可逆。为了让反函数存在，我们给每个三角函数选定一段**单调区间**并限制值域，这样就得到**反三角函数**：

- **反正弦** $y = \arcsin x$：定义域 $[-1, 1]$，值域 $\left[-\dfrac{\pi}{2}, \dfrac{\pi}{2}\right]$；
- **反余弦** $y = \arccos x$：定义域 $[-1, 1]$，值域 $[0, \pi]$；
- **反正切** $y = \arctan x$：定义域 $\mathbb{R}$，值域 $\left(-\dfrac{\pi}{2}, \dfrac{\pi}{2}\right)$。

每个反三角函数都是对应三角函数在该区间上的反函数，图像关于直线 $y = x$ 与限制后的原函数图像对称。它们在工程与物理中用途极广：凡是需要「由比值求角度」的场合（求相位、求倾角、求方位）都要用到它们。

formulas.latex: y = \arcsin x \iff \sin y = x,\ -1\le x\le 1,\ y\in\left[-\tfrac{\pi}{2}, \tfrac{\pi}{2}\right]
formulas.note: 反正弦的定义：由正弦值求角，值域限制保证了唯一性。
formulas.noteEn: Definition of arcsine: recover an angle from a sine value; the restricted range ensures uniqueness.

formulas.latex: y = \arccos x \iff \cos y = x,\ -1\le x\le 1,\ y\in[0, \pi]
formulas.note: 反余弦的定义：值域为 $[0,\pi]$，因此 $\arccos x$ 的符号恒定非负。
formulas.noteEn: Definition of arccosine with range $[0,\pi]$, so $\arccos x$ is never negative.

formulas.latex: y = \arctan x \iff \tan y = x,\ x\in\mathbb{R},\ y\in\left(-\tfrac{\pi}{2}, \tfrac{\pi}{2}\right)
formulas.note: 反正切的定义：定义域为全体实数，常用于求相位角。
formulas.noteEn: Definition of arctangent; the domain is all reals and it is often used for phase angles.

formulas.note: 奇偶与互补关系：$\arcsin$ 是奇函数，$\arccos$ 满足互补恒等式。
formulas.noteEn: Parity and cofunction relations: $\arcsin$ is odd, while $\arccos$ satisfies a supplementary identity.

formulas.note: 重要恒等式，对任意 $x \in [-1, 1]$ 成立。
formulas.noteEn: Fundamental identity valid for every $x \in [-1, 1]$.

expression.note: 注意：$\arcsin(\sin x)$ 不一定等于 $x$，只有当 $x$ 落在限制值域内才成立。
expression.noteEn: Caution: $\arcsin(\sin x)$ need not equal $x$ unless $x$ lies in the restricted range.

properties: $\arcsin x$ 与 $\arctan x$ 是奇函数，$\arccos x$ 既非奇也非偶
三个反三角函数的图像都关于直线 $y = x$ 与限制区间上的原函数对称
$\arcsin x$、$\arccos x$ 的定义域是 $[-1, 1]$，$\arctan x$ 的定义域是 $\mathbb{R}$
$\arctan x$ 有两条水平渐近线 $y = \pm\dfrac{\pi}{2}$，且 $\arctan x + \arctan \dfrac{1}{x} = \pm\dfrac{\pi}{2}$（$x>0$ 取正）
反三角函数值域受限，所以同一三角函数值只对应一个「主值」角度
propertiesEn: $\arcsin x$ and $\arctan x$ are odd; $\arccos x$ is neither odd nor even
Each graph is the reflection of the restricted trigonometric graph in the line $y = x$
$\arcsin x$ and $\arccos x$ have domain $[-1, 1]$; $\arctan x$ has domain $\mathbb{R}$
$\arctan x$ has horizontal asymptotes $y = \pm\dfrac{\pi}{2}$
The restricted ranges mean each trigonometric value corresponds to exactly one principal angle

plot.title: 反三角函数图像（arcsin / arccos / arctan）

examples.problem: 计算 $\arcsin\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2} + \arccos\dfrac{1}{2}$ 的值。
examples.solution: 因为 $\sin\dfrac{\pi}{3} = \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$ 且 $\dfrac{\pi}{3} \in \left[-\dfrac{\pi}{2}, \dfrac{\pi}{2}\right]$，所以 $\arcsin\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = \dfrac{\pi}{3}$。同理 $\cos\dfrac{\pi}{3} = \dfrac{1}{2}$ 且 $\dfrac{\pi}{3} \in [0, \pi]$，故 $\arccos\dfrac{1}{2} = \dfrac{\pi}{3}$。因此原式 $= \dfrac{\pi}{3} + \dfrac{\pi}{3} = \dfrac{2\pi}{3}$。

examples.problem: 求 $\sin\left(\arccos\dfrac{3}{5}\right)$ 的值。
examples.solution: 设 $\theta = \arccos\dfrac{3}{5}$，则 $\cos\theta = \dfrac{3}{5}$，且 $\theta \in [0, \pi]$，所以 $\sin\theta \ge 0$。由 $\sin^2\theta = 1 - \cos^2\theta = 1 - \dfrac{9}{25} = \dfrac{16}{25}$，得 $\sin\theta = \dfrac{4}{5}$。因此 $\sin\left(\arccos\dfrac{3}{5}\right) = \dfrac{4}{5}$。

nodes.title: 辅助角公式
nodes.summary: 把 a sin x + b cos x 合并成一个正弦型函数 R sin(x+φ)。
nodes.summaryEn: Combining a sin x + b cos x into a single sine wave R sin(x+φ).
nodes.definition:
形如 $a\sin x + b\cos x$ 的式子看起来是两个不同频率的三角函数的和，但由于它们频率相同，实际上仍是一个正弦型函数。**辅助角公式**把它合并成：

$$a\sin x + b\cos x = \sqrt{a^2+b^2}\,\sin(x + \varphi)$$

其中辅助角 $\varphi$ 满足 $\cos\varphi = \dfrac{a}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2}}$，$\sin\varphi = \dfrac{b}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2}}$，即 $\tan\varphi = \dfrac{b}{a}$。

这个技巧的价值在于「降维」：把振幅、周期、最值、单调性这些问题的研究对象，从两个函数的和变成一个标准正弦函数。它是求三角函数最值、化解三角方程以及物理中同频简谐振动合成的标准武器。
nodes.definitionEn:
An expression $a\sin x + b\cos x$ looks like a sum of two trigonometric terms, but since they share the same frequency it is still a single sine wave. The **auxiliary angle formula** merges it as

$$a\sin x + b\cos x = \sqrt{a^2+b^2}\,\sin(x + \varphi)$$

where the auxiliary angle $\varphi$ satisfies $\cos\varphi = \dfrac{a}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2}}$ and $\sin\varphi = \dfrac{b}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2}}$, equivalently $\tan\varphi = \dfrac{b}{a}$.

The trick reduces two functions to one standard sine wave, so questions about amplitude, period, extrema and monotonicity can all be answered at once. It is the standard weapon for minimising trigonometric expressions, simplifying equations, and superposing same-frequency harmonic oscillations in physics.

formulas.note: 辅助角公式的一般形式，$\varphi$ 为辅助角，振幅为 $\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$。
formulas.noteEn: General form with auxiliary angle $\varphi$ and amplitude $\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$.

formulas.note: 辅助角的确定方式，同时需结合 $a$ 与 $b$ 的符号判断 $\varphi$ 所在象限。
formulas.noteEn: Determines the auxiliary angle; use the signs of $a$ and $b$ to fix its quadrant.

formulas.note: 最常见的特例（$a = b = 1$），$\varphi = \dfrac{\pi}{4}$。
formulas.noteEn: The most common special case ($a = b = 1$) with $\varphi = \dfrac{\pi}{4}$.

formulas.note: 另一典型特例，说明 $b$ 为负时辅助角为负。
formulas.noteEn: Another typical case showing that a negative $b$ gives a negative auxiliary angle.

formulas.note: 由合并式直接得到的最值结论，值域为 $[-R, R]$。
formulas.noteEn: The extrema read off directly from the merged form; range $[-R, R]$.

expression.text: a·sin x + b·cos x = R·sin(x + φ),  R = √(a²+b²)
expression.note: 要求 $a,b$ 不同时为零；$\varphi$ 由 $\tan\varphi = b/a$ 及符号共同确定。
expression.noteEn: Requires $a,b$ not both zero; $\varphi$ is fixed by $\tan\varphi = b/a$ together with the signs.

properties: 合并后仍是周期为 $2\pi$ 的正弦型函数，振幅为 $\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$
值域为 $\left[-\sqrt{a^2+b^2},\ \sqrt{a^2+b^2}\right]$，最大值与最小值在 $x+\varphi = \pm\dfrac{\pi}{2}$ 处取得
辅助角 $\varphi$ 与 $a,b$ 的符号有关，必须写在正确的象限里
$a=0$ 或 $b=0$ 时公式退化为单一三角函数，仍然成立
可推广为 $a\sin x + b\cos x = \sqrt{a^2+b^2}\cos(x-\theta)$ 的余弦形式
propertiesEn: The result is a sine wave of period $2\pi$ with amplitude $\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$
Its range is $\left[-\sqrt{a^2+b^2},\ \sqrt{a^2+b^2}\right]$, attained when $x+\varphi = \pm\dfrac{\pi}{2}$
The auxiliary angle depends on the signs of $a$ and $b$ and must sit in the correct quadrant
If $a=0$ or $b=0$ it reduces to a single trigonometric term and still holds
It generalises to a cosine form $a\sin x + b\cos x = \sqrt{a^2+b^2}\cos(x-\theta)$

plot.title: 辅助角公式：两条曲线完全重合

examples.problem: 求函数 $f(x) = \sqrt{3}\sin x + \cos x$ 的最大值及取最大值时的 $x$。
examples.solution: 由辅助角公式，$R = \sqrt{(\sqrt{3})^2 + 1^2} = 2$，且 $\tan\varphi = \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$，取 $\varphi = \dfrac{\pi}{6}$，故 $f(x) = 2\sin\left(x + \dfrac{\pi}{6}\right)$。因此最大值为 $2$，当 $x + \dfrac{\pi}{6} = \dfrac{\pi}{2} + 2k\pi$，即 $x = \dfrac{\pi}{3} + 2k\pi\ (k\in\mathbb{Z})$ 时取得。

nodes.title: 正弦型函数模型
nodes.summary: 形如 y = A sin(ωx + φ) + k 的函数，用来描述各种周期现象。
nodes.summaryEn: A function of the form y = A sin(ωx + φ) + k, used to model periodic phenomena.
nodes.definition:
**正弦型函数**具有一般形式

$$y = A\sin(\omega x + \varphi) + k$$

其中 $A$ 叫**振幅**，决定波峰到平衡位置的高度；$\omega$ 是**角频率**，决定周期 $T = \dfrac{2\pi}{\omega}$；$\varphi$ 是**初相**，决定图像左右平移；$k$ 是**纵向位移**，决定平衡位置的高度。

现实世界中大量现象是周期性的：单摆摆动、弹簧振动、交流电电压、声波、潮汐、气温年变化等，都可以用正弦型函数近似描述。这就是它作为**数学模型**的价值——只要测出振幅、周期和相位，就能预言未来任一时刻的状态，也能把不同来源的波动进行叠加分析。

确定这些参数的过程叫「拟合」：通常从最大值和最小值定 $A$ 与 $k$，从相邻两个零点或最值点的间距定周期，再代入一个已知点定 $\varphi$。
nodes.definitionEn:
A **sinusoidal function** has the general form

$$y = A\sin(\omega x + \varphi) + k$$

Here $A$ is the **amplitude** (half the peak-to-trough height), $\omega$ is the **angular frequency** so that the period is $T = \dfrac{2\pi}{\omega}$, $\varphi$ is the **phase shift** controlling horizontal translation, and $k$ is the vertical shift giving the equilibrium level.

Countless real phenomena are periodic: pendulums, springs, alternating-current voltages, sound waves, tides and seasonal temperature. A sinusoidal function approximates them all — that is its value as a **mathematical model**: measure amplitude, period and phase once, and you can predict the state at any future time or superpose several waves.

Fitting the parameters is routine: read $A$ and $k$ from the maximum and minimum, read the period from the spacing of two adjacent zeros or extrema, then substitute one known point to fix $\varphi$.

formulas.note: 正弦型函数的一般式，四个参数各司其职。
formulas.noteEn: The general sinusoidal form; four parameters, four distinct roles.

formulas.note: 周期公式，$\omega$ 越大周期越短，波越密。
formulas.noteEn: Period formula: larger $\omega$ means a shorter period and a denser wave.

formulas.note: 由最大值和最小值反求振幅与纵向位移。
formulas.noteEn: Recover amplitude and vertical shift from the maximum and minimum.

formulas.note: 由周期求角频率；若图像在 $x_0$ 处从平衡位置上升，可由此定初相。
formulas.noteEn: Get $\omega$ from the period; if the graph rises through equilibrium at $x_0$, this fixes the phase.

expression.text: y = A·sin(ωx + φ) + k
expression.note: 习惯上取 $A>0,\ \omega>0$；$|A|$ 才是振幅，$A<0$ 时可把负号并入相位。
expression.noteEn: Conventionally $A>0$ and $\omega>0$; the amplitude is $|A|$, and a negative $A$ can be absorbed into the phase.

properties: 值域为 $[k-|A|,\ k+|A|]$，最大值 $A+k$，最小值 $-A+k$
周期为 $T = \dfrac{2\pi}{|\omega|}$，与振幅无关
图像可由 $y = \sin x$ 经纵向伸缩、横向伸缩和平移复合得到
初相 $\varphi$ 只改变左右位置，不影响形状；可用「五点法」快速作图
多个同频正弦型函数叠加后仍是正弦型函数，可由辅助角公式合并
propertiesEn: Range is $[k-|A|,\ k+|A|]$ with maximum $A+k$ and minimum $-A+k$
The period is $T = \dfrac{2\pi}{|\omega|}$, independent of the amplitude
The graph is built from $y = \sin x$ by vertical and horizontal scaling plus translations
The phase only shifts the graph horizontally; use the five-point method to sketch it
Summing same-frequency sinusoids gives another sinusoid, merged via the auxiliary angle formula

plot.title: 正弦型函数 y = 2sin(3x+1) 与 y = sin x 的对比

examples.problem: 某地一天的气温近似满足 $T(t) = 10 + 8\sin\left(\dfrac{\pi}{12}t - \dfrac{\pi}{2}\right)$（$t$ 为小时，$T$ 为摄氏度）。求该地的最高气温、最低气温与气温变化的周期。
examples.solution: 对照 $T = k + A\sin(\omega t + \varphi)$，得 $A = 8$，$k = 10$，$\omega = \dfrac{\pi}{12}$。故最高气温为 $k + A = 18^{\circ}\text{C}$，最低气温为 $k - A = 2^{\circ}\text{C}$。周期 $T = \dfrac{2\pi}{\omega} = \dfrac{2\pi}{\pi/12} = 24$ 小时，与一天的长度一致。

nodes.title: 三角形中的恒等变换
nodes.summary: 利用 A+B+C=π 推出的三角形内角关系式，如 sin(A+B)=sin C。
nodes.summaryEn: Identities among the angles of a triangle derived from A+B+C=π, such as sin(A+B)=sin C.
nodes.definition:
在三角形 $ABC$ 中，三个内角始终满足

$$A + B + C = \pi$$

这一简单事实带来了一组极其实用的**恒等变换**，因为它们把三个角捆在了一起：

$$\sin(A+B) = \sin C,\qquad \cos(A+B) = -\cos C,\qquad \tan(A+B) = -\tan C$$

以及半角与倍角层面的关系，例如 $\sin\dfrac{A+B}{2} = \cos\dfrac{C}{2}$。这些式子让「角落里」的角可以用另外两个角表示，从而在化简、判定形状、证明恒等式时大幅减少变量。

这类变换是解三角形与三角恒等式的交汇点：判断三角形形状、化简含 $A,B,C$ 的表达式、证明边角关系，几乎都要先做一次这样的转化。
nodes.definitionEn:
In triangle $ABC$ the three interior angles always satisfy

$$A + B + C = \pi$$

This simple fact yields a set of highly useful **identities**, because the three angles are locked together:

$$\sin(A+B) = \sin C,\qquad \cos(A+B) = -\cos C,\qquad \tan(A+B) = -\tan C$$

and half-angle versions such as $\sin\dfrac{A+B}{2} = \cos\dfrac{C}{2}$. They let one angle be expressed through the other two, cutting down the number of variables when simplifying, classifying a triangle or proving an identity.

These transformations sit at the meeting point of solving triangles and trigonometric identities: classifying a triangle, simplifying expressions in $A,B,C$ and proving side-angle relations almost always begin with such a step.

formulas.note: 一切三角形恒等式的出发点，说明三个角独立变量只有两个。
formulas.noteEn: The starting point of every triangle identity; only two of the three angles are independent.

formulas.note: 因为 $A+B = \pi - C$，由诱导公式得到，是最常用的关系。
formulas.noteEn: Since $A+B = \pi - C$, this follows from reduction formulas; the most used relation.

formulas.note: 同理由 $\cos(\pi-C) = -\cos C$ 与 $\tan(\pi-C) = -\tan C$ 得到。
formulas.noteEn: Similarly from $\cos(\pi-C) = -\cos C$ and $\tan(\pi-C) = -\tan C$.

formulas.note: 半角关系，常用于含 $\dfrac{A+B}{2}$ 的化简。
formulas.noteEn: Half-angle relation, often used to simplify expressions with $\dfrac{A+B}{2}$.

formulas.latex: \tan A + \tan B + \tan C = \tan A\tan B\tan C
formulas.note: 当 $A+B+C = \pi$ 时的经典恒等式，用于含正切的三角形问题。
formulas.noteEn: A classical identity when $A+B+C = \pi$; handy for tangent-based problems.

properties: 三角形中至少有两个锐角，因此任意两角之和的正弦必为正
恒等式成立的前提是 $A,B,C$ 确实为同一三角形的三个内角
利用 $A = \pi - B - C$ 可把三变量问题化为两变量问题
当 $\tan A + \tan B + \tan C$ 中出现零或负值时可用来判断三角形为直角或钝角
$\sin 2A + \sin 2B + \sin 2C = 4\sin A\sin B\sin C$ 等对称恒等式常用于综合证明
propertiesEn: A triangle has at least two acute angles, so the sine of any two angles summed is positive
The identities assume $A,B,C$ are the interior angles of one triangle
Using $A = \pi - B - C$ reduces three variables to two
Signs of tangent expressions help detect right or obtuse triangles
Symmetric identities such as $\sin 2A + \sin 2B + \sin 2C = 4\sin A\sin B\sin C$ are used in proofs

plot.title: 三角形内角关系 A + B + C = π

examples.problem: 在 $\triangle ABC$ 中，已知 $\sin(A+B) = \dfrac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$，求角 $C$。
examples.solution: 由三角形内角和 $A+B+C = \pi$，得 $A+B = \pi - C$，于是 $\sin(A+B) = \sin(\pi - C) = \sin C$。所以 $\sin C = \dfrac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$。又因为 $0 < C < \pi$，故 $C = \dfrac{\pi}{4}$ 或 $C = \dfrac{3\pi}{4}$。

examples.problem: 在 $\triangle ABC$ 中（设三个角都不是直角），证明恒等式 $\tan A+\tan B+\tan C = \tan A\tan B\tan C$。
examples.solution: 由 $A+B = \pi - C$ 得 $\tan(A+B) = -\tan C$，而 $\tan(A+B) = \dfrac{\tan A + \tan B}{1 - \tan A\tan B}$。当 $\tan A\tan B \neq 1$ 时，交叉相乘得 $\tan A + \tan B = -\tan C(1 - \tan A\tan B) = -\tan C + \tan A\tan B\tan C$，移项恰好得到 $\tan A + \tan B + \tan C = \tan A\tan B\tan C$，即该恒等式成立。

nodes.title: 勾股定理与三角
nodes.summary: 直角三角形中两直角边平方和等于斜边平方，是三角比与余弦定理的基础。
nodes.summaryEn: In a right triangle the sum of the squares of the legs equals the square of the hypotenuse, the basis of trigonometric ratios and the law of cosines.
nodes.definition:
在直角三角形中，设两条直角边长分别为 $a,b$，斜边长为 $c$，则有

$$a^2 + b^2 = c^2$$

这就是**勾股定理**（毕达哥拉斯定理）。它是平面几何中最著名的结论之一，也是三角学的起点：正因为有了它，才可能对一个锐角 $\theta$ 定义 $\sin\theta = \dfrac{\text{对边}}{\text{斜边}}$，$\cos\theta = \dfrac{\text{邻边}}{\text{斜边}}$，$\tan\theta = \dfrac{\text{对边}}{\text{邻边}}$——这些比值不依赖于三角形的大小，只依赖于角 $\theta$。

把勾股定理与三角比结合起来，可以立即得到恒等式 $\sin^2\theta + \cos^2\theta = 1$；而余弦定理正是它在一般三角形上的推广。反过来，勾股定理的逆定理还能用来判定一个三角形是否为直角三角形。
nodes.definitionEn:
In a right triangle with legs $a,b$ and hypotenuse $c$,

$$a^2 + b^2 = c^2$$

This is the **Pythagorean theorem**, one of the most famous results in plane geometry and the starting point of trigonometry. It is what makes it possible to define, for an acute angle $\theta$, the ratios $\sin\theta = \dfrac{\text{opposite}}{\text{hypotenuse}}$, $\cos\theta = \dfrac{\text{adjacent}}{\text{hypotenuse}}$ and $\tan\theta = \dfrac{\text{opposite}}{\text{adjacent}}$ — ratios that depend only on $\theta$, not on the size of the triangle.

Combining the theorem with these ratios immediately yields $\sin^2\theta + \cos^2\theta = 1$, and the law of cosines is precisely its generalisation to arbitrary triangles. Conversely, the converse of the theorem identifies right triangles from their side lengths.

formulas.note: 直角三角形两直角边平方和等于斜边平方，全定理的核心。
formulas.noteEn: The core statement: legs squared add up to hypotenuse squared.

formulas.note: 已知两直角边求斜边，是实际计算中出现最多的形式。
formulas.noteEn: Find the hypotenuse from the two legs; the most frequent practical form.

formulas.note: 由勾股定理与三角比定义直接推出，是最基本的三角恒等式。
formulas.noteEn: Follows directly from the theorem and the ratio definitions; the most basic trigonometric identity.

formulas.latex: c\ \text{为最长边时：}\quad a^2+b^2>c^2\iff \text{角 }C\text{ 为锐角},\qquad a^2+b^2<c^2\iff \text{角 }C\text{ 为钝角}
formulas.note: 逆定理与推广：先找出最长边作为 c，再由三边判断三角形形状。
formulas.noteEn: Converse and extension: first identify the longest side as c, then classify the triangle from its three sides.

expression.text: a² + b² = c²  （c 为斜边）
expression.note: $c$ 必须是斜边（直角所对的边）；直角三角形中斜边最长。
expression.noteEn: $c$ must be the hypotenuse, the side opposite the right angle, which is the longest side.

properties: 只对直角三角形成立，$c$ 必须是直角所对的斜边
逆定理成立：若三边满足 $a^2+b^2=c^2$，则该三角形是直角三角形
由它可以导出三角基本恒等式 $\sin^2\theta + \cos^2\theta = 1$
余弦定理是其推广：当夹角为直角时 $2bc\cos A$ 项消失，公式退化为勾股定理
propertiesEn: Holds only for right triangles, with $c$ the hypotenuse opposite the right angle
The converse holds: if $a^2+b^2=c^2$ then the triangle is right-angled
Integer solutions are Pythagorean triples such as $(3,4,5)$, $(5,12,13)$, $(8,15,17)$ and their scalings
It yields the fundamental identity $\sin^2\theta + \cos^2\theta = 1$
The law of cosines generalises it: when the included angle is right, the $2bc\cos A$ term vanishes

plot.title: 直角三角形与勾股定理（3-4-5）

examples.problem: 直角三角形两直角边分别为 $6$ 和 $8$，求斜边长及较小锐角的正弦值。
examples.solution: 由勾股定理 $c = \sqrt{6^2 + 8^2} = \sqrt{36 + 64} = \sqrt{100} = 10$。设边 $6$ 所对的锐角为 $\theta$，则 $\sin\theta = \dfrac{\text{对边}}{\text{斜边}} = \dfrac{6}{10} = \dfrac{3}{5}$。所以斜边长为 $10$，较小锐角的正弦值为 $\dfrac{3}{5}$。

nodes.title: 和差化积与积化和差
nodes.summary: 在三角函数的和差形式与乘积形式之间互相转化的恒等式。
nodes.summaryEn: Identities converting between sums and differences of trigonometric functions and their products.
nodes.definition:
三角函数的加法定理（如 $\sin(\alpha+\beta) = \sin\alpha\cos\beta + \cos\alpha\sin\beta$）把乘积与和联系起来。把这些公式两两相加减，就得到两族用途广泛的恒等式：

- **积化和差**：把三角函数的乘积写成和差，如 $\sin\alpha\cos\beta = \dfrac{1}{2}[\sin(\alpha+\beta) + \sin(\alpha-\beta)]$；
- **和差化积**：把三角函数的和差写成乘积，如 $\sin\alpha + \sin\beta = 2\sin\dfrac{\alpha+\beta}{2}\cos\dfrac{\alpha-\beta}{2}$。

这两族公式本质上是一回事——互为逆用。它们的价值在于「形式切换」：遇到乘积求和、解含余弦之差的方程、或者需要对波形进行叠加时，切换到更简单的形式往往能一步化简。它们也是傅里叶分析和信号处理的基础工具。
nodes.definitionEn:
The addition theorems (such as $\sin(\alpha+\beta) = \sin\alpha\cos\beta + \cos\alpha\sin\beta$) link products to sums. Adding and subtracting pairs of them produces two families of widely used identities:

- **Product-to-sum**: turn a product into a sum or difference, e.g. $\sin\alpha\cos\beta = \dfrac{1}{2}[\sin(\alpha+\beta) + \sin(\alpha-\beta)]$;
- **Sum-to-product**: turn a sum or difference into a product, e.g. $\sin\alpha + \sin\beta = 2\sin\dfrac{\alpha+\beta}{2}\cos\dfrac{\alpha-\beta}{2}$.

The two families are really one — each is the reverse of the other. Their value is form-switching: summing products, solving equations containing differences of cosines, or superposing waves all become one-step simplifications. They are also foundational in Fourier analysis and signal processing.

formulas.note: 和差化积：正弦之和化为「半和的正弦乘半差的余弦」。
formulas.noteEn: Sum-to-product for sine: sine of the half-sum times cosine of the half-difference.

formulas.note: 正弦之差化为乘积，注意此处是余弦乘正弦。
formulas.noteEn: Difference of sines as a product; note it is cosine times sine.

formulas.note: 余弦之和化为两余弦之积，是四式中符号最简单的。
formulas.noteEn: Sum of cosines as a product of two cosines; the simplest of the four.

formulas.note: 余弦之差化为乘积，务必不要漏掉前面的负号。
formulas.noteEn: Difference of cosines; do not forget the leading minus sign.

formulas.note: 积化和差：正弦乘余弦化为两个正弦之和的一半。
formulas.noteEn: Product-to-sum: sine times cosine as half the sum of two sines.

formulas.note: 积化和差中的正弦乘正弦，括号内顺序为「差减和」。
formulas.noteEn: Product of two sines; the bracket is difference minus sum.

expression.text: sin α + sin β = 2 sin((α+β)/2) cos((α−β)/2)
expression.note: 口诀：「和差化积，半和半差；积化和差，和差相加减」。
expression.noteEn: Mnemonic: half-sum and half-difference for sum-to-product; add or subtract angle sums for product-to-sum.

properties: 和差化积与积化和差互为逆运算，可任选方向使用
和差化积的结果中只出现半和 $\dfrac{\alpha+\beta}{2}$ 与半差 $\dfrac{\alpha-\beta}{2}$ 两个角
系数的规律：正弦和差系数为 $2$，乘积化为和差时系数为 $\dfrac{1}{2}$
符号规律：余弦之差 $\cos\alpha - \cos\beta$ 前有负号，$\cos\alpha + \cos\beta$ 无负号
是导数公式、傅里叶级数与交流电波形叠加的重要预备工具
propertiesEn: Sum-to-product and product-to-sum are inverses; use whichever direction helps
Sum-to-product results involve only the half-sum $\dfrac{\alpha+\beta}{2}$ and half-difference $\dfrac{\alpha-\beta}{2}$
Coefficient pattern: sums-to-products carry a factor $2$, products-to-sums a factor $\dfrac{1}{2}$
Sign pattern: $\cos\alpha - \cos\beta$ carries a minus sign while the sum does not
A key preparatory tool for derivatives, Fourier series and superposing AC waveforms

plot.title: 和差化积：两条曲线完全重合

examples.problem: 化简 $\dfrac{\sin 2\alpha + \sin 2\beta}{\cos 2\alpha + \cos 2\beta}$。
examples.solution: 由和差化积公式，$\sin 2\alpha + \sin 2\beta = 2\sin(\alpha+\beta)\cos(\alpha-\beta)$，$\cos 2\alpha + \cos 2\beta = 2\cos(\alpha+\beta)\cos(\alpha-\beta)$。因为 $\cos(\alpha-\beta) \neq 0$ 时可约去，得原式 $= \dfrac{2\sin(\alpha+\beta)\cos(\alpha-\beta)}{2\cos(\alpha+\beta)\cos(\alpha-\beta)} = \tan(\alpha+\beta)$。

examples.problem: 化简 $\sin 40^{\circ} + \sin 20^{\circ}$。
examples.solution: 由和差化积公式，$\sin 40^{\circ} + \sin 20^{\circ} = 2\sin\dfrac{40^{\circ}+20^{\circ}}{2}\cos\dfrac{40^{\circ}-20^{\circ}}{2} = 2\sin 30^{\circ}\cos 10^{\circ} = 2 \times \dfrac{1}{2} \times \cos 10^{\circ} = \cos 10^{\circ}$。

nodes.title: 高斯曲率与平均曲率
nodes.summary: 温加滕映射（形状算子）W=−dn 的两个特征值 κ₁、κ₂ 刻画出曲面在两个主方向的弯曲：K=κ₁κ₂ 是内蕴的高斯曲率，H=(κ₁+κ₂)/2 是外蕴的平均曲率。
nodes.summaryEn: The two eigenvalues κ₁, κ₂ of the Weingarten map (shape operator) W = −dn describe how a surface bends: K = κ₁κ₂ is the intrinsic Gaussian curvature and H = (κ₁+κ₂)/2 the extrinsic mean curvature.
nodes.definition:
设 $\Sigma$ 是 $\mathbb{R}^3$ 中的正则曲面，$n$ 是单位法向量场。在每点 $p$ 处，温加滕映射（形状算子）$W_p=-dn_p$ 把切向量 $X$ 映为 $-dn_p(X)$，它是切平面 $T_p\Sigma$ 上的**自伴**线性算子，所以有两个实特征值 $\kappa_1,\kappa_2$，称为**主曲率**，对应的特征方向称为主方向。

把第一、第二基本形式的系数分别记作 $E,F,G$ 与 $L,M,N$。解特征方程 $\det(\mathrm{II}-\kappa\,\mathrm{I})=0$，即
$$(EG-F^2)\kappa^2-(EN-2FM+GL)\kappa+(LN-M^2)=0,$$
两根就是主曲率。由此得到**高斯曲率**与**平均曲率**
$$K=\kappa_1\kappa_2=\det W=\frac{LN-M^2}{EG-F^2},\qquad H=\frac{\kappa_1+\kappa_2}{2}=\frac{1}{2}\mathrm{tr}\,W=\frac{EN-2FM+GL}{2(EG-F^2)}.$$

直观上，$K$ 是两个主方向弯曲程度之积，$H$ 是它们的平均。$K$ 是**内蕴**量（只依赖曲面的度量，见高斯绝妙定理），$H$ 是**外蕴**量（随曲面在空间中的摆放方式而变）。两者合起来完全决定主曲率：$\kappa_{1,2}=H\pm\sqrt{H^2-K}$。

按 $K$ 的符号，曲面上的点分为三类：$K>0$ 的椭圆点（如球面）、$K<0$ 的双曲点（如马鞍面）、$K=0$ 的抛物点（如柱面）。取外法向时，半径 $R$ 的球面 $K=1/R^2$、$H=-1/R$（改取内法向则 $H=+1/R$，$K$ 不变）；平面 $K=H=0$；圆柱面 $K=0$ 但 $H=\pm 1/(2R)\neq 0$。
nodes.definitionEn:
Let $\Sigma\subset\mathbb{R}^3$ be a regular surface with unit normal field $n$. At each point $p$ the Weingarten map (shape operator) $W_p=-dn_p$ sends a tangent vector $X$ to $-dn_p(X)$; it is a **self-adjoint** linear map of the tangent plane $T_p\Sigma$, hence has two real eigenvalues $\kappa_1,\kappa_2$, the **principal curvatures**, whose eigenvectors are the principal directions.

Writing the coefficients of the first and second fundamental forms as $E,F,G$ and $L,M,N$, the principal curvatures solve $\det(\mathrm{II}-\kappa\,\mathrm{I})=0$, that is
$$(EG-F^2)\kappa^2-(EN-2FM+GL)\kappa+(LN-M^2)=0.$$
This defines the **Gaussian curvature** and the **mean curvature**
$$K=\kappa_1\kappa_2=\det W=\frac{LN-M^2}{EG-F^2},\qquad H=\frac{\kappa_1+\kappa_2}{2}=\frac{1}{2}\mathrm{tr}\,W=\frac{EN-2FM+GL}{2(EG-F^2)}.$$

Intuitively $K$ is the product and $H$ the average of the bending in the two principal directions. $K$ is **intrinsic** (it depends only on the metric, see the Theorema Egregium) while $H$ is **extrinsic** (it changes with the way the surface sits in space). Together they determine the principal curvatures: $\kappa_{1,2}=H\pm\sqrt{H^2-K}$.

By the sign of $K$, points are called elliptic ($K>0$, e.g. a sphere), hyperbolic ($K<0$, e.g. a saddle) or parabolic ($K=0$, e.g. a cylinder). With the outward normal a sphere of radius $R$ has $K=1/R^2$ and $H=-1/R$ (the inward normal gives $H=+1/R$ while $K$ stays the same); the plane has $K=H=0$; the circular cylinder has $K=0$ but $H=\pm 1/(2R)\neq 0$.

formulas.note: 高斯曲率：两个主曲率之积，等于第二基本形式行列式与第一基本形式行列式之比；分子是 LN−M²，分母是 EG−F²。
formulas.noteEn: Gaussian curvature: the product of the principal curvatures, the ratio of the determinants of the second and first fundamental forms (numerator LN−M², denominator EG−F²).

formulas.note: 平均曲率：两个主曲率的算术平均；注意中间交叉项是 −2FM。
formulas.noteEn: Mean curvature: the average of the principal curvatures; note the cross term −2FM.

formulas.note: 由 det(II−κI)=0 得到的特征方程，两根即主曲率 κ₁、κ₂。
formulas.noteEn: The characteristic equation det(II − κI) = 0; its two roots are the principal curvatures κ₁ and κ₂.

formulas.note: 半径 R 的球面：K 与法向的取法无关；H 取外法向为 −1/R，取内法向为 +1/R。
formulas.noteEn: Sphere of radius R: K is independent of the orientation; H equals −1/R for the outward normal and +1/R for the inward one.

formulas.note: 大半径 c、管半径 a 的环面（c>a>0）：外侧 cos u>0 处 K>0，内侧 cos u<0 处 K<0，上下两个圆 cos u=0 处 K=0。
formulas.noteEn: Torus with large radius c and tube radius a (c>a>0): K>0 on the outer side (cos u>0), K<0 on the inner side (cos u<0), and K=0 on the top and bottom circles (cos u=0).

properties: K 与法向的取法无关：换法向时 κ₁、κ₂ 同时变号，K=κ₁κ₂ 保持不变；而 H 变号，所以谈 H 时必须先说明法向约定。
平面 K=H=0；圆柱面 K=0 但 H=±1/(2R)≠0 —— 所以 K=0 并不等于「就是平面」。
可展曲面（平面、柱面、锥面）都能剪开摊平，它们处处 K≡0；K≡0 是可展曲面的特征。
按 K 的符号：K>0 的点是椭圆点（球面）、K<0 的点是双曲点（马鞍面）、K=0 的点是抛物点（柱面）。
K 与 H 完全决定主曲率：κ₁,₂=H±√(H²−K)（由 (κ₁−κ₂)²/4=H²−K≥0 保证有实根）；H≡0 的曲面称为极小曲面，肥皂膜就是它的实例。
propertiesEn: K does not depend on the choice of normal: reversing the normal flips the signs of κ₁, κ₂ but leaves K = κ₁κ₂ unchanged, while H changes sign, so the sign of H is a matter of convention.
The plane has K = H = 0; a circular cylinder has K = 0 but H = ±1/(2R) ≠ 0, so K = 0 does not mean the surface is flat.
Developable surfaces (plane, cylinder, cone) can be unrolled without stretching and satisfy K ≡ 0.
By the sign of K: elliptic points (K > 0, sphere), hyperbolic points (K < 0, saddle), parabolic points (K = 0, cylinder).
K and H determine the principal curvatures: κ₁,₂ = H ± √(H²−K), since H² − K = (κ₁−κ₂)²/4 ≥ 0; surfaces with H ≡ 0 are minimal (soap films).

plot.title: 环面：外侧 K>0、内侧 K<0、上下两圆 K=0

examples.problem: 用参数化 $r(u,v)=R(\sin u\cos v,\ \sin u\sin v,\ \cos u)$（$0<u<\pi$）计算半径 R 的球面的 K 与 H（取外法向）。
examples.solution: 计算得 $E=R^2,\ F=0,\ G=R^2\sin^2 u$，$L=-R,\ M=0,\ N=-R\sin^2 u$。于是 $$K=\frac{LN-M^2}{EG-F^2}=\frac{R^2\sin^2 u}{R^4\sin^2 u}=\frac{1}{R^2},\qquad H=\frac{EN-2FM+GL}{2(EG-F^2)}=\frac{-R^3\sin^2 u-R^3\sin^2 u}{2R^4\sin^2 u}=-\frac{1}{R}.$$ 若改取内法向，则 $H=+1/R$，而 $K$ 仍为 $1/R^2$。

examples.problem: 环面 $r(u,v)=((c+a\cos u)\cos v,\ (c+a\cos u)\sin v,\ a\sin u)$，其中 $c>a>0$。求 K 并判断它在环面各处的符号。
examples.solution: 计算得 $E=a^2,\ F=0,\ G=(c+a\cos u)^2$，$L=+a,\ M=0,\ N=+(c+a\cos u)\cos u$，故 $$K=\frac{LN-M^2}{EG-F^2}=\frac{\cos u}{a(c+a\cos u)}.$$ 分母恒为正，于是：$u=0$（外侧）$K=\frac{1}{a(c+a)}>0$；$u=\pi$（内侧）$K=-\frac{1}{a(c-a)}<0$；$u=\frac{\pi}{2},\frac{3\pi}{2}$（上下两个圆）$K=0$。正负曲率的总积分恰好为 0，与环面的 $\chi=0$ 一致（见高斯–博内定理）。

nodes.title: 主曲率与主方向
nodes.summary: 形状算子的特征值 κ₁、κ₂（主曲率）与特征方向（主方向）把曲面每点的弯曲分解为两个互相垂直方向的纯弯曲：它们是法曲率的最大值与最小值。
nodes.summaryEn: The eigenvalues κ₁, κ₂ of the shape operator (principal curvatures) and its eigenvectors (principal directions) split the bending at each point into two perpendicular pure bendings: they are the maximum and minimum of the normal curvature.
nodes.definition:
在曲面 $\Sigma$ 的点 $p$ 处，形状算子 $W=-dn_p$ 是切平面上的**自伴算子**，因此可以正交对角化：存在一组正交的单位切向量 $e_1,e_2$（**主方向**），使 $We_i=\kappa_i e_i$。把特征值排序为 $\kappa_1\ge\kappa_2$，它们就是**主曲率**。

主曲率也可以看作第二基本形式相对第一基本形式的广义特征值：$\mathrm{II}(v,\cdot)=\kappa\,\mathrm{I}(v,\cdot)$，等价于 $\det(\mathrm{II}-\kappa\,\mathrm{I})=0$，即
$$(EG-F^2)\kappa^2-(EN-2FM+GL)\kappa+(LN-M^2)=0.$$

几何意义：固定 $p$，让过 $p$ 的平面沿所有切方向去截曲面，所得法曲率的最大值与最小值就是 $\kappa_1$ 与 $\kappa_2$，取到极值的方向正是主方向。任意方向（从第一主方向量起的角 $\theta$）的法曲率由**欧拉定理**给出：$\kappa_n(\theta)=\kappa_1\cos^2\theta+\kappa_2\sin^2\theta$。另外，沿主方向 $v$ 有罗德里格斯公式 $dn_p(v)=-\kappa v$。

若 $\kappa_1=\kappa_2$，称 $p$ 为**脐点**：此时每个切方向都是主方向，曲面在 $p$ 附近如同球面。球面和平面处处是脐点。
nodes.definitionEn:
At a point $p$ of a surface $\Sigma$ the shape operator $W=-dn_p$ is a **self-adjoint** map of the tangent plane, so it can be orthogonally diagonalized: there is an orthonormal basis $e_1,e_2$ of **principal directions** with $We_i=\kappa_i e_i$. Ordered as $\kappa_1\ge\kappa_2$, the eigenvalues are the **principal curvatures**.

They can also be seen as the generalized eigenvalues of the second fundamental form with respect to the first: $\mathrm{II}(v,\cdot)=\kappa\,\mathrm{I}(v,\cdot)$, equivalently $\det(\mathrm{II}-\kappa\,\mathrm{I})=0$, that is
$$(EG-F^2)\kappa^2-(EN-2FM+GL)\kappa+(LN-M^2)=0.$$

Geometrically, fix $p$ and cut the surface by planes through $p$ in every tangent direction; the maximum and minimum of the resulting normal curvature are $\kappa_1$ and $\kappa_2$, attained exactly in the principal directions. In a direction making angle $\theta$ with the first principal direction, **Euler's theorem** gives $\kappa_n(\theta)=\kappa_1\cos^2\theta+\kappa_2\sin^2\theta$, and along a principal direction $v$ one has the Rodrigues formula $dn_p(v)=-\kappa v$.

If $\kappa_1=\kappa_2$, the point $p$ is called **umbilic**: every tangent direction is then principal and the surface looks like a sphere near $p$. Spheres and planes consist entirely of umbilic points.

formulas.note: 主曲率的特征方程（即 det(II−κI)=0）：两根为 κ₁、κ₂。
formulas.noteEn: Characteristic equation for the principal curvatures, det(II − κI) = 0; its roots are κ₁ and κ₂.

formulas.note: 由高斯曲率 K 与平均曲率 H 反解主曲率：κ₁ 取加号、κ₂ 取减号。
formulas.noteEn: Recovering the principal curvatures from K and H: κ₁ takes the plus sign, κ₂ the minus sign.

formulas.note: 欧拉定理：法曲率随方向变化，κ₁、κ₂ 恰好是它的最大值与最小值。
formulas.noteEn: Euler's theorem: the normal curvature as a function of direction, with κ₁ and κ₂ as its maximum and minimum.

formulas.note: 罗德里格斯公式：沿主方向 v 有 dn(v)=−κv，即 W(v)=κv，这正是特征值方程。
formulas.noteEn: Rodrigues' formula: along a principal direction dn(v) = −κv, i.e. W(v) = κv, the eigenvalue equation itself.

formulas.note: 在主方向的单位正交基下，第一、第二基本形式同时对角化。
formulas.noteEn: In the orthonormal basis of principal directions the first and second fundamental forms are simultaneously diagonal.

properties: 主曲率与参数化无关；把法向整体反号时 κ₁、κ₂ 同时变号（K 不变，而 H 变号）。
κ₁≠κ₂ 时两个主方向必正交；κ₁=κ₂ 的点（脐点）每个方向都是主方向。
κ₁、κ₂ 是法曲率在所有切方向上的最大值与最小值（欧拉定理的直接推论）。
K<0 的点（双曲点）两主曲率异号：沿一个主方向向上弯、沿另一个主方向向下弯，呈马鞍形；K>0 时两主曲率同号。
极小曲面（H=0）上处处 κ₂=−κ₁；球面上处处 κ₁=κ₂=±1/R —— 这是脐点的两个极端例子。
propertiesEn: The principal curvatures do not depend on the parametrization; reversing the normal flips both signs (K is unchanged, H changes sign).
If κ₁ ≠ κ₂ the two principal directions are orthogonal; if κ₁ = κ₂ (an umbilic point) every tangent direction is principal.
κ₁ and κ₂ are the maximum and minimum of the normal curvature over all tangent directions (an immediate consequence of Euler's theorem).

At a hyperbolic point with K < 0 the principal curvatures have opposite signs: the surface bends up along one principal direction and down along the other, like a saddle; for K > 0 they share the same sign.
On a minimal surface (H = 0) one has κ₂ = −κ₁ everywhere; on a sphere κ₁ = κ₂ = ±1/R everywhere — the two extreme umbilic examples.

plot.title: 马鞍面：原点处 κ₁=2、κ₂=−2，两主方向为 x、y 方向

examples.problem: 求马鞍面 $z=x^2-y^2$ 在原点处的主曲率与主方向。
examples.solution: 在原点处 $f_x=f_y=0$，故 $E=G=1,\ F=0$；对函数图像 $z=f(x,y)$ 有 $L=f_{xx}=2,\ M=f_{xy}=0,\ N=f_{yy}=-2$。特征方程化为 $\kappa^2-(L+N)\kappa+(LN-M^2)=\kappa^2-4=0$，两根为 $\kappa_1=2,\ \kappa_2=-2$，主方向是 $x$ 轴与 $y$ 轴方向。附带得到 $K=\kappa_1\kappa_2=-4<0$，原点是双曲点。

examples.problem: 半径 $R$ 的球面上每点的主曲率是多少？主方向是什么？
examples.solution: 球面处处是脐点。取外法向计算得 $\kappa_1=\kappa_2=-1/R$；换内法向则 $\kappa_1=\kappa_2=+1/R$。因为两主曲率相等，任何一组正交切方向都可取作主方向，法曲率与方向无关。由此 $K=1/R^2$、$H=-1/R$（外法向）。

nodes.title: 高斯映射
nodes.summary: 高斯映射把曲面上每一点映成它的单位法向量的终点，得到单位球面上的点；它的微分就是差一个符号的形状算子，其行列式恰为高斯曲率。
nodes.summaryEn: The Gauss map sends each point of a surface to the tip of its unit normal, a point of the unit sphere; its differential is the shape operator up to sign, and its Jacobian determinant is exactly the Gaussian curvature.
nodes.definition:
设 $\Sigma\subset\mathbb{R}^3$ 是定向正则曲面，$n(p)$ 是单位法向量。**高斯映射**定义为 $n:\Sigma\to S^2,\quad p\mapsto n(p)$ —— 把每点的法向量平移到原点，其终点落在单位球面 $S^2$ 上。它是一张光滑映射，并且 $dn_p:T_p\Sigma\to T_{n(p)}S^2$ 与形状算子只差一个符号：$dn_p=-W_p$，特征值为 $-\kappa_1,-\kappa_2$。

**关键事实**：高斯曲率就是高斯映射的雅可比行列式，也就是面积元被高斯映射拉伸的倍数（带符号）：
$$K=\det(dn_p)=\frac{(n_u\times n_v)\cdot n}{|r_u\times r_v|}.$$
因为 $n_u,n_v$ 都垂直于 $n$，向量 $n_u\times n_v$ 与 $n$ 平行，所以这个三重积没有歧义。逐点成立的等式是 $n_u\times n_v=K\,(r_u\times r_v)$，取模得 $|n_u\times n_v|=|K|\,|r_u\times r_v|$，即 $d\sigma=|K|\,dA$。

直观上，$K$ 度量「法向量变化得多快」：$K\equiv 0$ 时法向量只沿一条曲线变化（柱面映为一条大圆、平面映为一点）；$|K|$ 越大，法向量在球面上铺开得越快。
nodes.definitionEn:
Let $\Sigma\subset\mathbb{R}^3$ be an oriented regular surface with unit normal $n(p)$. The **Gauss map** is $n:\Sigma\to S^2,\quad p\mapsto n(p)$: translate the normal at each point to the origin; its tip lies on the unit sphere $S^2$. It is a smooth map whose differential $dn_p:T_p\Sigma\to T_{n(p)}S^2$ differs from the shape operator only by sign, $dn_p=-W_p$, with eigenvalues $-\kappa_1,-\kappa_2$.

**Key fact**: the Gaussian curvature is the Jacobian determinant of the Gauss map, i.e. the (signed) factor by which it stretches area elements:
$$K=\det(dn_p)=\frac{(n_u\times n_v)\cdot n}{|r_u\times r_v|}.$$
Since $n_u,n_v\perp n$, the vector $n_u\times n_v$ is parallel to $n$ and the triple product is unambiguous. Pointwise one has $n_u\times n_v=K\,(r_u\times r_v)$, so $|n_u\times n_v|=|K|\,|r_u\times r_v|$, that is $d\sigma=|K|\,dA$.

Intuitively, $K$ measures how fast the normal direction changes: if $K\equiv 0$ the normal varies only along a curve (a cylinder maps to a great circle, a plane to a point); the larger $|K|$ is, the faster the normals spread over the sphere.

formulas.note: 高斯映射：把曲面的单位法向量平移到原点，终点画在单位球面上。
formulas.noteEn: The Gauss map: translate the unit normal to the origin and record its tip on the unit sphere.

formulas.note: 高斯曲率＝高斯映射的雅可比行列式，即面积伸缩率（带符号）。
formulas.noteEn: Gaussian curvature equals the Jacobian determinant of the Gauss map, a signed area stretching factor.

formulas.note: 逐点成立：高斯映射把曲面面积元按比例 K 映到球面上。
formulas.noteEn: Pointwise identity: the Gauss map scales the surface area element by the factor K.

formulas.note: 面积元的变换关系：dA 被映为球面上的 dσ；K>0 保定向，K<0 反定向。
formulas.noteEn: Transformation of area elements: dA is mapped to dσ on the sphere; K>0 preserves orientation, K<0 reverses it.

formulas.note: 高斯映射像的球面面积（按覆盖重数计）等于 |K| 的积分；严格凸闭曲面（K>0）的高斯映射恰好铺满整个单位球面一次。
formulas.noteEn: The spherical area of the image (counted with multiplicity) equals the integral of |K|; for a strictly convex closed surface the Gauss map covers the whole unit sphere exactly once.

properties: det(dn_p)=K、tr(dn_p)=−2H：高斯映射的微分同时包含 K 与 H 的全部信息。
K≡0 的曲面（平面、柱面、锥面）高斯映射的像退化为曲线甚至一点：圆柱面映为球面上的一条大圆，平面映为一点。
K>0 处高斯映射保定向、局部一对一；K<0 处反定向。
在**非平坦点**（$dn_p\neq 0$）处，$|\kappa_1|=|\kappa_2|$（脐点或极小点）当且仅当高斯映射在 $p$ 处共形（保角）；平坦点处 $dn_p=0$，须除外。球面处处脐点且非平坦，高斯映射是最标准的相似（保角）映射。
闭曲面上高斯映射的映射度等于 χ(Σ)/2：球面为 1，环面为 0 —— 这是高斯–博内定理的映射视角。
propertiesEn: det(dn_p) = K and tr(dn_p) = −2H: the differential of the Gauss map encodes both K and H.
If K ≡ 0 (plane, cylinder, cone) the image of the Gauss map degenerates to a curve or a point: a cylinder maps onto a great circle, a plane onto a single point.
Where K > 0 the Gauss map preserves orientation and is locally one-to-one; where K < 0 it reverses orientation.

At a **non-flat** point ($dn_p\neq 0$), $|\kappa_1|=|\kappa_2|$ (umbilic or minimal) is exactly when the Gauss map is conformal at $p$; flat points ($dn_p=0$) must be excluded. On a sphere every point is umbilic and non-flat, and the Gauss map is a similarity.
For a closed surface the degree of the Gauss map equals χ(Σ)/2: 1 for the sphere and 0 for the torus — the map-theoretic view of Gauss–Bonnet.

plot.title: 高斯映射 n: S → S²：把单位法向量的终点画在单位球面上

examples.problem: 用高斯映射计算半径 R、中心在原点的球面的高斯曲率。
examples.solution: 球面的外法向量场为 $n(p)=p/R$，于是 $dn_p=\frac{1}{R}\mathrm{id}$，$K=\det(dn_p)=\frac{1}{R^2}$。这也说明球面的高斯映射是相似（保角）映射，与球面处处是脐点的事实一致。

examples.problem: 计算圆柱面 $r(u,v)=(R\cos u,\ R\sin u,\ v)$ 的高斯映射与高斯曲率。
examples.solution: 取外法向 $n=(\cos u,\ \sin u,\ 0)$。于是 $n_u=(-\sin u,\ \cos u,\ 0)$、$n_v=(0,0,0)$，得 $n_u\times n_v=0$，从而 $K=\frac{(n_u\times n_v)\cdot n}{|r_u\times r_v|}=0$。几何上，高斯映射的像是球面上的赤道大圆（一条曲线），面积为零，这正对应 $K\equiv 0$。

nodes.title: 高斯绝妙定理
