Relation to homology: $\pi_1$ is generally non-abelian and richer; abelianising it (dividing by the commutator subgroup) gives the first homology group, $H_1(X)\cong\pi_1(X)^{\mathrm{ab}}$ (Hurewicz, for path-connected $X$).

plot.title: 基本群：以 x₀ 为基点的闭路按相对端点同伦分类

examples.problem: 证明反向道路给出逆元：对任意以 $x_0$ 为基点的闭路 $\alpha$，恒有 $\alpha\cdot\bar\alpha\simeq e_{x_0}\ \text{rel}\ \{0,1\}$，其中 $\bar\alpha(s)=\alpha(1-s)$。
examples.solution: 令 $g_t(s)=2s(1-t)$（$0\le s\le\tfrac12$），$g_t(s)=2(1-t)(1-s)$（$\tfrac12\le s\le1$）：两段在 $s=\tfrac12$ 处都等于 $1-t$，故 $g_t$ 连续，且 $g_t(0)=g_t(1)=0$。取 $H(s,t)=\alpha(g_t(s))$。则 $H(0,t)=H(1,t)=\alpha(0)=x_0$；当 $t=0$ 时 $g_0(s)=2s$（$s\le\tfrac12$）、$2-2s$（$s\ge\tfrac12$），恰是 $(\alpha\cdot\bar\alpha)(s)$，故 $H(s,0)=(\alpha\cdot\bar\alpha)(s)$；当 $t=1$ 时 $g_1\equiv0$，$H(s,1)=x_0$。于是 $H$ 是 rel $\{0,1\}$ 的同伦，$[\alpha][\bar\alpha]=[e_{x_0}]$，即 $[\alpha]^{-1}=[\bar\alpha]$。

examples.problem: 设 $f:X\to Y$ 连续，$\alpha,\beta$ 是 $X$ 中以 $x_0$ 为基点的闭路且 $\alpha\simeq\beta\ \text{rel}\ \{0,1\}$。证明 $f_*([\alpha])=f_*([\beta])$，即 $f_*$ 良定义；并验证 $(g\circ f)_*=g_*\circ f_*$。
examples.solution: 设 $H$ 是 rel $\{0,1\}$ 的同伦，$H(\cdot,0)=\alpha$、$H(\cdot,1)=\beta$、$H(0,t)=H(1,t)=x_0$。令 $K=f\circ H$，它连续，且 $K(\cdot,0)=f\circ\alpha$、$K(\cdot,1)=f\circ\beta$、$K(0,t)=K(1,t)=f(x_0)$，所以 $f\circ\alpha\simeq f\circ\beta\ \text{rel}\ \{0,1\}$，即 $f_*([\alpha])=[f\circ\alpha]=[f\circ\beta]=f_*([\beta])$，良定义。同态性：$f_*(\alpha\cdot\beta)$ 的闭路是 $f\circ(\alpha\cdot\beta)$，它在 $s\le\tfrac12$ 时等于 $(f\circ\alpha)(2s)$、在 $s\ge\tfrac12$ 时等于 $(f\circ\beta)(2s-1)$，正是 $(f\circ\alpha)\cdot(f\circ\beta)$，故 $f_*([\alpha][\beta])=f_*([\alpha])f_*([\beta])$。于是 $((g\circ f)\circ\alpha)=g\circ(f\circ\alpha)$ 直接给出 $(g\circ f)_*=g_*\circ f_*$。

nodes.title: 圆周的基本群
nodes.titleEn: The Fundamental Group of the Circle
nodes.summary: $\pi_1(S^1,x_0)\cong\mathbb{Z}$：闭路的同伦类由「绕几圈」这个整数完全决定。这是代数拓扑的第一个非平凡定理，证明靠覆叠空间 $\mathbb{R}\to S^1$ 的提升性质。
nodes.summaryEn: $\pi_1(S^1,x_0)\cong\mathbb{Z}$: the homotopy class of a loop is completely determined by an integer, its winding number. This is the first non-trivial theorem of algebraic topology, proved with the lifting properties of the covering $\mathbb{R}\to S^1$.
nodes.definition:
圆周 $S^1=\{z\in\mathbb{C}:|z|=1\}$ 的基本群是代数拓扑中第一个真正非平凡的例子：
$$\pi_1(S^1,x_0)\cong\mathbb{Z}\qquad(x_0=1).$$
同构由**圈数（绕数）**给出。闭路 $\omega:[0,1]\to S^1$（$\omega(0)=\omega(1)=1$）可写成 $\omega(s)=e^{2\pi i\,\Theta(s)}$，其中 $\Theta:[0,1]\to\mathbb{R}$ 连续；$\Theta$ 就是 $\omega$ 在覆叠 $p:\mathbb{R}\to S^1$、$p(t)=e^{2\pi it}$ 之下的**提升**（把圆周「展开」成直线的角度函数）。定义
$$\deg\omega=\Theta(1)-\Theta(0)\in\mathbb{Z},$$
它与提升的选取无关（换一个提升只能整体平移一个整数 $n$，差被端点相减消掉），并且只依赖 $\omega$ 的同伦类。于是 $[\omega]\mapsto\deg\omega$ 给出同构 $\pi_1(S^1,1)\cong\mathbb{Z}$，生成元是绕一圈的闭路 $\omega_1(s)=e^{2\pi i s}$，且 $[\omega_n]=[\omega_1]^n$（$\omega_n(s)=e^{2\pi i n s}$）。

为什么圈数只依赖同伦类？这正是**覆叠空间的提升性质**在起作用。设 $H:[0,1]\times[0,1]\to S^1$ 是 $\omega$ 到 $\Omega$ 的同伦 rel 端点，取它的提升 $\widetilde H$（$p\circ\widetilde H=H$，$\widetilde H(0,0)=0$）：由**同伦提升的唯一性**，$\widetilde H$ 存在且唯一。函数 $t\mapsto\widetilde H(1,t)$ 连续，且因为 $H(1,t)=1$ 恒成立，它取值全在 $\mathbb{Z}$ 中；而 $[0,1]$ 连通、$\mathbb{Z}$ 离散，故它必为常数，于是 $\deg\omega=\widetilde H(1,0)=\widetilde H(1,1)=\deg\Omega$。反过来，若 $\omega,\Omega$ 的圈数相同，把它们的提升 $\Theta,\Xi$（都从 $0$ 出发，此时 $\Theta(1)=\Xi(1)=n$）做直线同伦 $\widetilde H(s,t)=(1-t)\Theta(s)+t\,\Xi(s)$，再令 $H=p\circ\widetilde H$：由于 $\widetilde H(0,t)=0$、$\widetilde H(1,t)=n$，$H$ 是 rel 端点的同伦，故 $\omega\simeq\Omega$。合起来得到一条干净的结论：**两个以 $1$ 为基点的闭路同伦（rel 端点）当且仅当它们的圈数相同**——这就是日常说法「绕了几圈」的严格版本。

群运算与圈数相容：$\deg(\alpha\cdot\beta)=\deg\alpha+\deg\beta$（衔接处的提升值相加）、$\deg\bar\alpha=-\deg\alpha$，所以 $\deg$ 是群同态，$\pi_1(S^1,1)$ 与 $(\mathbb{Z},+)$ 完全一致。$\pi_1(S^1)=\mathbb{Z}\ne0$ 立刻说明圆周不能收缩成一点；同伦等价地，$\mathbb{R}^2\setminus\{0\}$ 的基本群也是 $\mathbb{Z}$，它不是单连通的（而 $\mathbb{R}^2$ 是单连通的）。在复分析里，这个整数就是闭曲线关于点的**旋转指标**（index）：留数定理、辐角原理用的正是它。
nodes.definitionEn:
The fundamental group of the circle $S^1=\{z\in\mathbb{C}:|z|=1\}$ is the first genuinely non-trivial example of algebraic topology:
$$\pi_1(S^1,x_0)\cong\mathbb{Z}\qquad(x_0=1).$$
The isomorphism is given by the **winding number**. A loop $\omega:[0,1]\to S^1$ with $\omega(0)=\omega(1)=1$ can be written $\omega(s)=e^{2\pi i\,\Theta(s)}$ with $\Theta:[0,1]\to\mathbb{R}$ continuous; $\Theta$ is the **lift** of $\omega$ under the covering $p:\mathbb{R}\to S^1$, $p(t)=e^{2\pi it}$, i.e. an angle function that unrolls the circle onto the line. Define $\deg\omega=\Theta(1)-\Theta(0)\in\mathbb{Z}$; it is independent of the chosen lift (another lift differs by a constant integer, which cancels in the difference) and depends only on the homotopy class of $\omega$. So $[\omega]\mapsto\deg\omega$ is an isomorphism $\pi_1(S^1,1)\cong\mathbb{Z}$, with generator the once-round loop $\omega_1(s)=e^{2\pi is}$ and $[\omega_n]=[\omega_1]^n$ for $\omega_n(s)=e^{2\pi i n s}$.

Why does the degree depend only on the homotopy class? Here the **lifting property** of covering spaces does the work. Let $H:[0,1]\times[0,1]\to S^1$ be a homotopy rel endpoints from $\omega$ to $\Omega$ and let $\widetilde H$ be its lift ($p\circ\widetilde H=H$, $\widetilde H(0,0)=0$), which exists and is unique by homotopy lifting. The map $t\mapsto\widetilde H(1,t)$ is continuous and integer-valued (since $H(1,t)=1$), while $[0,1]$ is connected and $\mathbb{Z}$ discrete, so it is constant; hence $\deg\omega=\deg\Omega$. Conversely, if $\omega,\Omega$ have the same degree, lift both from $0$ to get $\Theta,\Xi$ with $\Theta(1)=\Xi(1)=n$, form the straight-line homotopy $\widetilde H(s,t)=(1-t)\Theta(s)+t\,\Xi(s)$ in $\mathbb{R}$, and set $H=p\circ\widetilde H$: since $\widetilde H(0,t)=0$ and $\widetilde H(1,t)=n$, this is a homotopy rel endpoints, so $\omega\simeq\Omega$. Together: **two loops based at $1$ are homotopic rel endpoints iff they have the same winding number** — the rigorous form of “how many times did it go around”.

The degree is compatible with the group law: $\deg(\alpha\cdot\beta)=\deg\alpha+\deg\beta$ and $\deg\bar\alpha=-\deg\alpha$, so it is an isomorphism onto $(\mathbb{Z},+)$. Since $\pi_1(S^1)=\mathbb{Z}\ne0$, the circle is not contractible; equivalently $\pi_1(\mathbb{R}^2\setminus\{0\})\cong\mathbb{Z}$, so the punctured plane is not simply connected (whereas $\mathbb{R}^2$ is). In complex analysis this integer is the **index** of a closed curve about a point, the quantity behind the argument principle and the residue theorem.

formulas.note: 第一个非平凡定理：圆周的基本群是整数加群，同构由圈数（提升端点之差）给出。
formulas.noteEn: The first non-trivial theorem: the fundamental group of the circle is $\mathbb{Z}$, the isomorphism being given by the winding number, i.e. the difference of the endpoints of a lift.

formulas.note: 把闭路写成提升 $\Theta$（角度函数）与覆叠映射的复合；$\Theta$ 的存在唯一性来自道路提升性质，是全部论证的基础。
formulas.noteEn: Writing the loop as the covering map composed with a lift $\Theta$ (an angle function); existence and uniqueness of $\Theta$ come from path lifting and underlie the whole proof.

formulas.note: 绕 $n$ 圈的闭路：以 $[\omega_1]$ 为生成元时它就是 $n$ 次幂，圈数正是 $n$。$n<0$ 对应反向绕圈。
formulas.noteEn: The loop winding $n$ times: it is the $n$-th power of the generator $[\omega_1]$ and has degree $n$; negative $n$ means winding in the opposite direction.

formulas.note: 圈数把「衔接」翻译成「加法」：这正是 $\pi_1(S^1,1)\cong(\mathbb{Z},+)$ 是同构的原因。
formulas.noteEn: Winding number turns concatenation into addition — precisely why $\pi_1(S^1,1)\cong(\mathbb{Z},+)$ is an isomorphism.

formulas.note: 圈数是闭路同伦类的**完全**不变量：两个闭路同伦当且仅当圈数相同。这个「当且仅当」两个方向分别用同伦提升与直线同伦证明。
formulas.noteEn: Winding number is a complete invariant of homotopy classes rel endpoints: two loops are homotopic iff their winding numbers agree. The two directions use homotopy lifting and the straight-line homotopy respectively.

properties: $\pi_1(S^1,1)\cong\mathbb{Z}$ 是无限循环群，生成元是绕一圈的闭路 $\omega_1$；每个闭路的同伦类由圈数唯一决定，圈数为 $0$ 正是可收缩（零伦）的闭路。
证明工具是覆叠空间：$p:\mathbb{R}\to S^1$ 的道路提升与同伦提升把「同伦分类」变成「提升端点之差」，这是覆叠空间理论的第一个应用，也是代数拓扑的第一个非平凡定理。
圈数是同伦不变量：连续形变（rel 端点）不改变圈数，并且圈数相同就同伦，所以「绕几圈」是闭路的完全不变量；它还是复分析中闭曲线的旋转指标。
同伦等价的应用：$\mathbb{R}^2\setminus\{0\}\simeq S^1$（包含 $i$ 与径向投影 $x\mapsto x/|x|$ 互为同伦逆），故 $\pi_1(\mathbb{R}^2\setminus\{0\})\cong\mathbb{Z}$，挖去一点的平面不单连通；而 $\mathbb{R}^2$ 是单连通的。
与高维对照：$\pi_1(S^1)=\mathbb{Z}\ne0$，但 $n\ge2$ 时 $\pi_1(S^n)=0$（用范坎彭定理把球面拆成两个可缩的开半球）。维数越高、基本群越「平凡」，$S^1$ 是唯一的例外。
propertiesEn: $\pi_1(S^1,1)\cong\mathbb{Z}$ is infinite cyclic with generator the once-round loop $\omega_1$; the homotopy class of a loop is determined by its winding number, and winding number $0$ is exactly the null-homotopic case.

The proof uses covering spaces: path lifting and homotopy lifting for $p:\mathbb{R}\to S^1$ turn “classify loops up to homotopy” into “compare the endpoints of lifts”. This is the first application of covering-space theory and the first non-trivial theorem of algebraic topology.

The winding number is a homotopy invariant — continuous deformation rel endpoints cannot change it — and conversely equal winding numbers imply homotopy; so it is a complete invariant, the index of a closed curve in complex analysis.

Homotopy-equivalence application: $\mathbb{R}^2\setminus\{0\}\simeq S^1$ (the inclusion and the radial projection $x\mapsto x/|x|$ are homotopy inverses), hence $\pi_1(\mathbb{R}^2\setminus\{0\})\cong\mathbb{Z}$ and the punctured plane is not simply connected, while $\mathbb{R}^2$ is.

Contrast with higher dimensions: $\pi_1(S^1)=\mathbb{Z}\ne0$, whereas $\pi_1(S^n)=0$ for $n\ge2$ (van Kampen, using two contractible open hemispheres). The higher-dimensional spheres are the “simpler” ones; $S^1$ is the exception.

nodes.title: 覆叠空间
nodes.summary: 局部同胚、整体多对一的空间 $p:E\to B$：每点在底空间上有被均匀覆叠的邻域。它的道路提升与同伦提升性质把基本群的计算变成「展开成直线」的问题。
nodes.summaryEn: A locally homeomorphic, globally many-to-one map $p:E\to B$: every point of the base has an evenly covered neighbourhood. Its path-lifting and homotopy-lifting properties reduce questions about $\pi_1$ to unrolling the base onto a line.
nodes.definition:
设 $p:E\to B$ 是连续满射。若每点 $b\in B$ 都有开邻域 $U$，使
$$p^{-1}(U)=\bigsqcup_{\alpha}V_\alpha\quad(\text{不交并}),\qquad p|_{V_\alpha}:V_\alpha\to U\ \text{是同胚},$$
就称 $p$ 是**覆叠映射**，$E$ 是 $B$ 的**覆叠空间**；$U$ 叫被**均匀覆叠**的邻域，各 $V_\alpha$ 叫**叶**。于是每个 $e\in E$ 都有一个邻域被同胚映到 $B$ 的开集上——覆叠映射是**局部同胚**；但它一般**不是**整体同胚：$B$ 连通时纤维 $p^{-1}(b)$ 的基数（**重数**，叶片数）是常数，重数 $>1$ 时 $p$ 就不是单射。标准例子是 $p:\mathbb{R}\to S^1$，$p(t)=e^{2\pi it}$：纤维为 $t+\mathbb{Z}$，在圆周上不含 $1$ 的短弧上每叶都同胚地映到该弧，但 $\mathbb{R}$ 与 $S^1$ 整体不同胚。

覆叠空间之所以有用，是因为两条**提升性质**：
- **道路提升**：给定 $e_0\in p^{-1}(b_0)$ 与道路 $\gamma:[0,1]\to B$（$\gamma(0)=b_0$），存在**唯一**道路 $\tilde\gamma:[0,1]\to E$ 使 $\tilde\gamma(0)=e_0$ 且 $p\circ\tilde\gamma=\gamma$。
- **同伦提升**：给定 $H:[0,1]\times[0,1]\to B$ 与满足 $p\circ\widetilde H(\cdot,0)=H(\cdot,0)$ 的初始提升 $\widetilde H(\cdot,0)$，存在**唯一**的 $\widetilde H:[0,1]\times[0,1]\to E$ 使 $p\circ\widetilde H=H$。即覆叠映射是**纤维化**：任何同伦都能唯一提升。
由唯一性立即得到：同一个 $b_0$ 处出发的两个提升若在某一点相等，则处处相等（比较 $\tilde\gamma$ 与 $\tilde\gamma'$ 即可）。这两条性质是计算基本群的机器：$\pi_1(S^1)=\mathbb{Z}$ 的证明、以及复分析中的单值性定理都靠它。

**Galois 对应**：设 $B$ 道路连通、局部道路连通**且半局部单连通**（覆叠 → 子群方向的对应总是有定义；子群 → 连通覆叠方向才需要这个条件）。则 $B$ 的（总空间连通的）覆叠空间与 $\pi_1(B,b_0)$ 的**子群**对应：覆叠 $p:(E,e_0)\to(B,b_0)$ 对应子群 $H=p_*(\pi_1(E,e_0))\le\pi_1(B,b_0)$，而（不指定基点的）同构类对应子群的共轭类。覆叠的重数等于指数 $[\pi_1(B,b_0):H]$（可以是无穷）。覆叠称为**正规覆叠（Galois 覆叠）**，若 $H$ 是正规子群，等价地说**覆叠变换群**
$$\mathrm{Deck}(p)=\{\varphi:E\to E\ \text{同胚}:p\circ\varphi=p\}$$
在每条纤维上传递（自由且传递）。一般地 $\mathrm{Deck}(p)\cong N(H)/H$，其中 $N(H)$ 是 $H$ 的正规化子；正规覆叠时 $\mathrm{Deck}(p)\cong\pi_1(B,b_0)/H$。对应 $H=1$ 的覆叠（总空间单连通）叫**万有覆叠**：它覆叠一切覆叠（对任何覆叠 $q:Y\to B$ 都存在映射 $E\to Y$ 使相应的三角形交换），并且 $\mathrm{Deck}(p)\cong\pi_1(B,b_0)$。万有覆叠存在当且仅当 $B$ 道路连通、局部道路连通且**半局部单连通**——最后这条条件常被漏掉。

**提升判据**：设 $Y$ 道路连通、局部道路连通，$f:(Y,y_0)\to(B,b_0)$ 连续，$p:(E,e_0)\to(B,b_0)$ 是覆叠，则 $f$ 存在提升 $\tilde f:(Y,y_0)\to(E,e_0)$（即 $p\circ\tilde f=f$）**当且仅当** $f_*(\pi_1(Y,y_0))\subseteq p_*(\pi_1(E,e_0))$，且提升唯一。常见例子：$\mathbb{R}\to S^1$ 是万有覆叠（$\mathrm{Deck}\cong\mathbb{Z}$，由 $t\mapsto t+n$ 生成）；$S^1\to S^1$，$z\mapsto z^n$ 是 $n$ 重覆叠，$H=n\mathbb{Z}$；$\mathbb{C}\to\mathbb{C}\setminus\{0\}$，$z\mapsto e^z$ 是万有覆叠（因为 $\mathbb{C}\setminus\{0\}\simeq S^1$）；$S^n\to\mathbb{RP}^n$（$n\ge2$）是二重的万有覆叠（$S^n$ 单连通）。
nodes.definitionEn:
Let $p:E\to B$ be a continuous surjection. If every $b\in B$ has an open neighbourhood $U$ with
$$p^{-1}(U)=\bigsqcup_{\alpha}V_\alpha\quad(\text{disjoint union}),\qquad p|_{V_\alpha}:V_\alpha\to U\ \text{a homeomorphism},$$
then $p$ is a **covering map** and $E$ is a **covering space** of $B$; $U$ is **evenly covered** and the $V_\alpha$ are **sheets**. Thus every $e\in E$ has a neighbourhood mapped homeomorphically onto an open set of $B$ — a covering map is a **local homeomorphism** — but it is in general **not** a global homeomorphism: when $B$ is connected the cardinality of the fibre $p^{-1}(b)$ (the **number of sheets**) is constant, and it exceeds $1$ exactly when $p$ is not injective. The standard example is $p:\mathbb{R}\to S^1$, $p(t)=e^{2\pi it}$, with fibres $t+\mathbb{Z}$: locally a homeomorphism, globally far from one.

The power of covering spaces comes from two **lifting properties**:
- **Path lifting:** given $e_0\in p^{-1}(b_0)$ and a path $\gamma:[0,1]\to B$ with $\gamma(0)=b_0$, there is a **unique** path $\tilde\gamma:[0,1]\to E$ with $\tilde\gamma(0)=e_0$ and $p\circ\tilde\gamma=\gamma$.
- **Homotopy lifting:** given $H:[0,1]\times[0,1]\to B$ and an initial lift $\widetilde H(\cdot,0)$ with $p\circ\widetilde H(\cdot,0)=H(\cdot,0)$, there is a **unique** $\widetilde H:[0,1]\times[0,1]\to E$ with $p\circ\widetilde H=H$. So covering maps are **fibrations**.
Uniqueness also gives: two lifts starting at the same point agree everywhere.

**Galois correspondence:** if $B$ is path-connected, locally path-connected and semi-locally simply connected (the covering-to-subgroup direction is always defined; the subgroup-to-covering direction is what needs this condition), then covering spaces of $B$ with connected total space correspond to **subgroups** $H=p_*(\pi_1(E,e_0))\le\pi_1(B,b_0)$, with isomorphism classes corresponding to conjugacy classes of subgroups. The number of sheets equals the index $[\pi_1(B,b_0):H]$ (possibly infinite). A covering is **normal (Galois)** if $H$ is normal, equivalently if its **deck transformation group** $\mathrm{Deck}(p)=\{\varphi:E\to E\ \text{a homeomorphism}:p\circ\varphi=p\}$ acts transitively on each fibre. In general $\mathrm{Deck}(p)\cong N(H)/H$ with $N(H)$ the normaliser; for a normal covering $\mathrm{Deck}(p)\cong\pi_1(B,b_0)/H$. The covering with $H=1$ (simply connected total space) is the **universal cover**: it covers every other covering and $\mathrm{Deck}(p)\cong\pi_1(B,b_0)$. A universal cover exists iff $B$ is path-connected, locally path-connected and **semilocally simply connected** — a hypothesis that is often forgotten.

**Lifting criterion:** for a path-connected, locally path-connected $Y$ and a covering $p:(E,e_0)\to(B,b_0)$, a map $f:(Y,y_0)\to(B,b_0)$ lifts to $\tilde f:(Y,y_0)\to(E,e_0)$ (with $p\circ\tilde f=f$) **iff** $f_*(\pi_1(Y,y_0))\subseteq p_*(\pi_1(E,e_0))$, and the lift is unique. Examples: $\mathbb{R}\to S^1$ is the universal cover with $\mathrm{Deck}\cong\mathbb{Z}$ generated by $t\mapsto t+1$; $z\mapsto z^n$ on $S^1$ is an $n$-sheeted cover with $H=n\mathbb{Z}$; $z\mapsto e^z$ is the universal cover $\mathbb{C}\to\mathbb{C}\setminus\{0\}$; and $S^n\to\mathbb{RP}^n$ for $n\ge2$ is the two-sheeted universal cover.

formulas.note: 覆叠的定义：每点都有一个被**均匀覆叠**的邻域 $U$，其原像是不交开集之并，每叶同胚地映到 $U$。这使 $p$ 是局部同胚，但不是整体同胚。
formulas.noteEn: Definition of a covering: every point has an evenly covered neighbourhood $U$ whose preimage is a disjoint union of open sets, each mapped homeomorphically onto $U$. This makes $p$ a local but not a global homeomorphism.

formulas.note: 道路提升：给定起点 $e_0$ 与底空间中的道路，提升道路存在且唯一。这是唯一性引理与单值化（monodromy）的根源。
formulas.noteEn: Path lifting: given a starting point $e_0$ and a path in the base, the lifted path exists and is unique — the source of the uniqueness lemma and of monodromy.

formulas.latex: f\ \text{可提升为}\ \tilde f\iff f_*(\pi_1(Y,y_0))\subseteq p_*(\pi_1(E,e_0))
formulas.note: 提升判据：判断一个映射能否提升，只需比较基本群的像。用于证明「圆周上没有连续的单值辐角函数」。
formulas.noteEn: Lifting criterion: a map lifts iff the image of the fundamental groups is contained in the image of $p_*$. It proves, for instance, that no continuous single-valued argument exists on the circle.

formulas.note: 覆叠变换群：一般等于正规化子商掉 $H$；当 $H$ 正规（正规覆叠）时 $\mathrm{Deck}(p)\cong\pi_1(B,b_0)/H$；万有覆叠（$H=1$）时 $\mathrm{Deck}(p)\cong\pi_1(B,b_0)$。
formulas.noteEn: Deck transformations: in general the normaliser modulo $H$; for a normal covering $\mathrm{Deck}(p)\cong\pi_1(B,b_0)/H$; for the universal cover ($H=1$) $\mathrm{Deck}(p)\cong\pi_1(B,b_0)$.

formulas.note: 重数 = 指数的关系：纤维的基数（叶片数）等于子群 $H$ 在 $\pi_1(B,b_0)$ 中的指数，可以为无穷（万有覆叠常如此，如 $\mathbb{R}\to S^1$）。
formulas.noteEn: Number of sheets = index: the fibre cardinality equals the index of $H$ in $\pi_1(B,b_0)$, possibly infinite (as for the universal cover $\mathbb{R}\to S^1$).

properties: 局部同胚而非整体同胚：覆叠映射是连续满射、开映射，每个点局部是同胚；$B$ 连通时重数（纤维基数）恒定，重数为 $1$ 当且仅当 $p$ 是同胚。
提升性质：道路提升与同伦提升都**存在且唯一**；由此两个从同一点出发的提升处处相等，并且「提升端点」给出纤维之间的置换（单值化作用）。
Galois 对应：$B$ 道路连通、局部道路连通且**半局部单连通**时，连通覆叠空间（同构类）与 $\pi_1(B,b_0)$ 的子群（共轭类）一一对应；重数 = 指数；正规覆叠 $\iff H$ 正规 $\iff$ 覆叠变换在纤维上传递。
万有覆叠：对应 $H=1$，总空间单连通，覆叠一切覆叠，且 $\mathrm{Deck}(p)\cong\pi_1(B,b_0)$。它的存在条件是 $B$ 道路连通、局部道路连通且半局部单连通（三条件缺一不可）。
$\pi_1$ 与覆叠互相决定：$\pi_1(E,e_0)\cong H\le\pi_1(B,b_0)$，所以覆叠空间是「基本群子群的几何实现」，把群论问题（子群、指数、正规性）翻译成空间问题。
propertiesEn: Locally a homeomorphism, globally not: a covering map is continuous, surjective and open, and locally a homeomorphism; when $B$ is connected the number of sheets is constant, and it equals $1$ exactly when $p$ is a homeomorphism.

Lifting properties: both path lifting and homotopy lifting hold with uniqueness; consequently two lifts starting at the same point agree everywhere, and lifting endpoints gives a permutation of the fibre (the monodromy action).

Galois correspondence: for path-connected, locally path-connected and **semi-locally simply connected** $B$, connected coverings (up to isomorphism) correspond to subgroups of $\pi_1(B,b_0)$ up to conjugacy; number of sheets = index; normal covering iff $H$ is normal iff deck transformations act transitively on fibres.

Universal cover: corresponds to $H=1$, has simply connected total space, covers every other covering, and satisfies $\mathrm{Deck}(p)\cong\pi_1(B,b_0)$. It exists precisely when $B$ is path-connected, locally path-connected and semilocally simply connected.

Fundamental group and coverings determine each other: $\pi_1(E,e_0)\cong H\le\pi_1(B,b_0)$, so covering spaces are the geometric realisation of subgroups of the fundamental group, translating group theory (subgroups, index, normality) into geometry.

elements.text: t 与 t+1 映到同一点

plot.title: 覆叠映射 exp(2πit)：数轴覆叠圆周（每点有无穷多原像）

examples.problem: 用提升性质证明：不存在连续映射 $\theta:S^1\to\mathbb{R}$ 使 $e^{i\theta(z)}=z$ 对一切 $z\in S^1$ 成立（即辐角不能连续单值化）。
examples.solution: 反设这样的 $\theta$ 存在。令 $\gamma(t)=e^{2\pi it}$，则 $\ell_1(t)=\theta(\gamma(t))/(2\pi)$ 是 $\gamma$ 在覆叠 $p(t)=e^{2\pi it}$ 下的提升（因为 $p(\ell_1(t))=e^{2\pi i\cdot\theta(\gamma(t))/(2\pi)}=e^{i\theta(\gamma(t))}=\gamma(t)$，这里用了假设 $e^{i\theta(z)}=z$，取 $z=\gamma(t)$）。由 $\gamma(0)=1$ 得 $e^{i\theta(1)}=1$，故 $\theta(1)=2\pi k$（某个 $k\in\mathbb{Z}$），即 $\ell_1(0)=k$。另一方面 $\ell_2(t)=k+t$ 也是 $\gamma$ 的提升且 $\ell_2(0)=k$；由道路提升的**唯一性**有 $\ell_1\equiv\ell_2$，取 $t=1$ 得 $\theta(1)/(2\pi)=k+1$，与 $\theta(1)/(2\pi)=k$ 矛盾。所以不存在连续的全局辐角函数——这正是「辐角是多值的」的拓扑原因。

examples.problem: 求覆叠 $p:\mathbb{R}\to S^1$（$p(t)=e^{2\pi it}$）的覆叠变换群，并说明它是万有覆叠。
examples.solution: 设 $\varphi:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ 满足 $p\circ\varphi=p$，即 $e^{2\pi i\varphi(t)}=e^{2\pi it}$，于是 $\varphi(t)-t\in\mathbb{Z}$ 对一切 $t$ 成立。函数 $t\mapsto\varphi(t)-t$ 连续且取值在离散集 $\mathbb{Z}$ 中，而 $\mathbb{R}$ 连通，故它是常数 $n$，即 $\varphi(t)=t+n$。反之每个平移 $\varphi_n(t)=t+n$ 显然满足 $p\circ\varphi_n=p$ 且是同胚。所以 $\mathrm{Deck}(p)=\{\varphi_n:n\in\mathbb{Z}\}\cong\mathbb{Z}$，与 $\pi_1(S^1)\cong\mathbb{Z}$ 一致（万有覆叠时 $\mathrm{Deck}(p)\cong\pi_1(B,b_0)$）。又 $\mathbb{R}$ 可缩、特别地单连通，故 $p$ 是万有覆叠。

nodes.title: 塞弗特–范坎彭定理
nodes.summary: 把空间拆成两个开集 $U,V$，则 $\pi_1(U\cup V)$ 由 $\pi_1(U)$、$\pi_1(V)$ 沿 $\pi_1(U\cap V)$ 并合而成；交单连通时就是自由积。这是计算基本群最有力的工具。
nodes.summaryEn: Split a space into open sets $U$ and $V$: then $\pi_1(U\cup V)$ is built from $\pi_1(U)$ and $\pi_1(V)$ amalgamated over $\pi_1(U\cap V)$; when the intersection is simply connected this is just the free product. The strongest tool for computing fundamental groups.
nodes.definition:
塞弗特–范坎彭定理把**空间的粘合**翻译成**群的粘合**。设 $X=U\cup V$，其中
- $U,V$ 都是 $X$ 的**开集**；
- $U$、$V$、$U\cap V$ **都道路连通**；
- 基点 $x_0\in U\cap V$ 取在交中。
则由包含映射诱导的同态
$$\Phi:\pi_1(U,x_0)*\pi_1(V,x_0)\to\pi_1(X,x_0)$$
是满射，其核是集合 $\{i^U_*(g)\,i^V_*(g)^{-1}:g\in\pi_1(U\cap V,x_0)\}$ 生成的**正规闭包**（其中 $i^U:U\cap V\hookrightarrow U$、$i^V:U\cap V\hookrightarrow V$ 是包含映射）。换句话说
$$\pi_1(X,x_0)\cong\pi_1(U,x_0)*_{\pi_1(U\cap V,x_0)}\pi_1(V,x_0),$$
右端是**并合自由积**（amalgamated free product）：先在交 $U\cap V$ 上把两块「缝」起来，再把其余的生成元自由地放进群里。当交**单连通**（$\pi_1(U\cap V,x_0)=0$）时并合退化，得到最常用的特例
$$\pi_1(X,x_0)\cong\pi_1(U,x_0)*\pi_1(V,x_0)\qquad(\text{自由积}).$$

直观理解：把 $X$ 拆成两块，各自内部的道路都能自由变形；唯一可能的「粘合关系」来自穿过交 $U\cap V$ 的那部分——同一段路在 $U$ 里看和在 $V$ 里看是同一条，范坎彭定理就是把这种「一条路的两重身份」写成商群。自由积的泛性质 $\mathrm{Hom}(G*H,K)\cong\mathrm{Hom}(G,K)\times\mathrm{Hom}(H,K)$ 是它最有用的形式：要给自由积定义一个同态，只需分别给两块定义同态。

**推论（高维球面）**：$n\ge2$ 时 $\pi_1(S^n)=0$。取南北半球的两个**开**邻域 $U,V$（把半球略微撑出一些，得到同胚于 $\mathbb{R}^n$ 的开集，因而可缩，$\pi_1(U)=\pi_1(V)=0$），则 $U\cup V=S^n$，$U\cap V$ 是赤道附近的开带，与 $S^{n-1}$ 同伦等价、从而道路连通（$n\ge2$ 时 $S^{n-1}$ 连通）。于是
$$\pi_1(S^n)\cong 0*_{\pi_1(U\cap V)}0=0$$
——不论 $\pi_1(U\cap V)$ 是什么，并合两块平凡群只能得到平凡群。**特别注意 $n=2$ 的情形**：此时 $\pi_1(U\cap V)=\pi_1(S^1)=\mathbb{Z}\ne0$，交**不**单连通，所以 $\pi_1(S^2)=0$ **不能**用「交单连通 ⟹ 自由积」的特例，必须用一般的并合形式。

定理还有一个更宽的形式：若 $X$ 被有限多个开集覆盖，且每个非空有限交都道路连通并取同一基点，则结论照旧（可对覆盖逐个迭代）。而「交道路连通」这一条不能省：例如用两个开弧覆盖 $S^1$，它们的交是两个不连通的开弧，此时定理的前提不满足——若强行套用就会得到 $\pi_1(S^1)=0$ 这种错误结论。

**应用**：$\pi_1(S^1\vee S^1,x_0)=\mathbb{Z}*\mathbb{Z}=F_2$（两个生成元的自由群，非交换）；连通图的基本群是自由群，秩为 $1-\chi$（$\chi$ 为欧拉示性数）；闭曲面的基本群可由多边形表示逐条粘合算出；$\mathbb{R}^n\setminus\{0\}\simeq S^{n-1}$ 在 $n\ge3$ 时单连通，而 $n=2$ 时基本群为 $\mathbb{Z}$。
nodes.definitionEn:
The Seifert–van Kampen theorem translates **gluing of spaces** into **gluing of groups**. Let $X=U\cup V$ where
- $U$ and $V$ are **open** in $X$;
- $U$, $V$ and $U\cap V$ are **path-connected**;
- the basepoint $x_0$ lies in $U\cap V$.
Then the homomorphism $\Phi:\pi_1(U,x_0)*\pi_1(V,x_0)\to\pi_1(X,x_0)$ induced by the inclusions is surjective, and its kernel is the **normal closure** of $\{i^U_*(g)\,i^V_*(g)^{-1}:g\in\pi_1(U\cap V,x_0)\}$, where $i^U,i^V$ are the inclusions of $U\cap V$ into $U$ and $V$. Equivalently
$$\pi_1(X,x_0)\cong\pi_1(U,x_0)*_{\pi_1(U\cap V,x_0)}\pi_1(V,x_0),$$
an **amalgamated free product**: first sew the two pieces together along the intersection, then add all remaining generators freely. When the intersection is **simply connected** the amalgamation degenerates to the most-used special case $\pi_1(X,x_0)\cong\pi_1(U,x_0)*\pi_1(V,x_0)$, the free product.

Intuitively, each piece deforms its own loops freely, and the only relations come from loops crossing the intersection: the same path seen inside $U$ and inside $V$ must be identified. The universal property of the free product, $\mathrm{Hom}(G*H,K)\cong\mathrm{Hom}(G,K)\times\mathrm{Hom}(H,K)$, is the most useful form: to define a homomorphism out of a free product, define it on each factor.

**Corollary (higher spheres):** $\pi_1(S^n)=0$ for $n\ge2$. Take two slightly fattened **open** hemispheres $U,V$, each homeomorphic to $\mathbb{R}^n$ and hence contractible, so $\pi_1(U)=\pi_1(V)=0$. Then $U\cup V=S^n$ and $U\cap V$ is an open equatorial band homotopy equivalent to $S^{n-1}$, which is path-connected for $n\ge2$. Hence $\pi_1(S^n)\cong 0*_{\pi_1(U\cap V)}0=0$ regardless of $\pi_1(U\cap V)$. **Note the case $n=2$:** there $\pi_1(U\cap V)=\pi_1(S^1)=\mathbb{Z}\ne0$, the intersection is *not* simply connected, so the free-product special case does not apply; one must use the general amalgamated form (both factors trivial).

A wider form: if $X$ is covered by finitely many open sets whose nonempty finite intersections are path-connected (with a common basepoint), the conclusion still holds, by iteration. The hypothesis on the intersection cannot be dropped: two open arcs covering $S^1$ meet in two disjoint arcs, and applying the theorem blindly would give the false conclusion $\pi_1(S^1)=0$.

**Applications:** $\pi_1(S^1\vee S^1,x_0)=\mathbb{Z}*\mathbb{Z}=F_2$, a free group on two generators (non-abelian); the fundamental group of any connected graph is free of rank $1-\chi$; surface groups come from polygon presentations; and $\mathbb{R}^n\setminus\{0\}\simeq S^{n-1}$ is simply connected for $n\ge3$ while its $\pi_1$ is $\mathbb{Z}$ for $n=2$.

formulas.note: 范坎彭定理的主结论：并合自由积。前提是 $U,V$ 为开集、$U,V,U\cap V$ 道路连通且 $x_0\in U\cap V$——条件缺一条结论就可能失效。
formulas.noteEn: Main conclusion: the amalgamated free product. The hypotheses are that $U,V$ are open, $U,V,U\cap V$ are path-connected, and $x_0\in U\cap V$; dropping any of them can break the conclusion.

formulas.note: 并合的具体写法：把自由积模掉「同一元素在 $U$ 与 $V$ 中的像相等」所生成的正规闭包，这就是「沿交缝起来」的代数含义。
formulas.noteEn: The explicit form: the free product modulo the normal closure of the relations identifying the images of each element of $\pi_1(U\cap V)$ in $U$ and in $V$ — the algebraic meaning of sewing along the intersection.

formulas.note: 最常用的特例：交单连通时没有粘合关系，得到自由积。适用于粘合两个圆的楔积、沿可缩子空间粘合等情形。（沿一条曲线粘合闭曲面时交不单连通——$\pi_1(U\cap V)=\mathbb{Z}$——必须用并合形式。）
formulas.noteEn: The most-used special case: a simply connected intersection contributes no relation, so one gets the free product — e.g. wedges of circles, or gluing along a contractible subspace. (Gluing surfaces along a curve needs the amalgamated form, since then $\pi_1(U\cap V)=\mathbb{Z}$.)

formulas.note: 推论：把 $S^n$ 写成两个可缩开半球之并，两块的基本群都平凡，所以整个球面的基本群平凡（$n=2$ 时交不单连通，必须用并合形式）。
formulas.noteEn: Corollary: writing $S^n$ as the union of two contractible open hemispheres, both factors are trivial, so the sphere is simply connected ($n=2$ needs the amalgamated form since the intersection is not simply connected).

formulas.note: 自由积的泛性质：定义自由积上的同态等价于在每一块上分别定义同态。判断群是否同构、给出显式表示时最方便。
formulas.noteEn: Universal property of the free product: a homomorphism on $G*H$ is the same as a homomorphism on each factor. This is the handiest way to identify the resulting group.

properties: 条件必须齐备：$U,V$ 要是**开集**，$U$、$V$、$U\cap V$ 都要**道路连通**，基点必须取在 $U\cap V$ 中；诱导的同构由**包含映射**给出，不是任意同构。
交单连通时的特例（自由积）最常用；一般情形是并合自由积，其泛性质是「对每一块给出同态、并在交上一致即可」。
推论：$n\ge2$ 时 $\pi_1(S^n)=0$；$\pi_1(S^1\vee S^1)=F_2$；连通图的基本群是自由群，秩 $=1-\chi$；这些计算都归结为「块的 π₁ + 交中的关系」。
更宽的形式：有限多个开集覆盖，只要所有非空有限交都道路连通（且含基点），结论仍成立；可对覆盖逐个迭代应用。
前提不可省：用两个开弧覆盖 $S^1$ 时交不连通，强行套用会得出 $\pi_1(S^1)=0$ 的错误结论；用两个闭半球覆盖 $S^2$ 也违反开性——这正是定理中「开」与「交道路连通」两条的用处。
propertiesEn: All hypotheses are needed: $U,V$ must be **open**, $U$, $V$ and $U\cap V$ must be **path-connected**, and the basepoint must lie in $U\cap V$; the isomorphism is induced by the **inclusions**, not by an arbitrary isomorphism.

The simply-connected-intersection case (free product) is the most-used; the general statement is the amalgamated free product, whose universal property says: give a homomorphism on each piece, agreeing on the intersection.

Consequences: $\pi_1(S^n)=0$ for $n\ge2$; $\pi_1(S^1\vee S^1)=F_2$; the fundamental group of a connected graph is free of rank $1-\chi$. Each computation reduces to “the $\pi_1$ of the pieces plus the relations from the intersection”.
Wider form: for a finite open cover whose nonempty finite intersections are path-connected (and contain the basepoint) the conclusion still holds, by iterating over the cover.

The hypotheses cannot be dropped: for two open arcs covering $S^1$ the intersection is disconnected and a blind application would give the false $\pi_1(S^1)=0$; two closed hemispheres covering $S^2$ violate openness. This is exactly what the openness and path-connectedness hypotheses are for.

elements.text: X = U ∪ V：三块都道路连通，基点取在交中

plot.title: 范坎彭定理：π₁(X) 由 π₁(U) 与 π₁(V) 沿交并合而成

examples.problem: 用范坎彭定理计算楔积 $X=S^1\vee S^1$（两个圆周在公共点 $x_0$ 粘成一点）的基本群。
examples.solution: 记两个圆周为 $A,B$，公共点为 $x_0$。取 $p\in A\setminus\{x_0\}$、$q\in B\setminus\{x_0\}$，令 $U=X\setminus\{p\}$、$V=X\setminus\{q\}$。$X$ 是 Hausdorff 空间、单点是闭集，故 $U,V$ 是开集，且 $x_0\in U\cap V$。$U$ 中圆周 $A$ 被挖去一点成为可缩的开弧，故 $U$ 可形变收缩到 $B$，$\pi_1(U,x_0)\cong\mathbb{Z}$；同理 $\pi_1(V,x_0)\cong\mathbb{Z}$。而 $U\cap V=X\setminus\{p,q\}$ 可形变收缩到 $\{x_0\}$，因而是单连通的，$\pi_1(U\cap V,x_0)=0$。由 $U\cup V=X$、三块都道路连通，范坎彭定理给出 $$\pi_1(X,x_0)\cong\mathbb{Z}*\mathbb{Z}=F_2,$$ 即两个生成元 $a,b$ 生成的自由群：除形式上的关系外没有别的等式，故 $ab\ne ba$，$\pi_1(S^1\vee S^1)$ 非交换。

examples.problem: 用范坎彭定理证明 $\pi_1(S^2)=0$，并逐条核对定理的条件，说明为什么不能改用「交单连通」的特例。
examples.solution: 取 $U$ 为「比上半球稍大」的开集、$V$ 为「比下半球稍大」的开集：每个都与 $\mathbb{R}^2$ 同胚，从而是可缩的，$\pi_1(U)=\pi_1(V)=0$；$U\cup V=S^2$；$U\cap V$ 是赤道附近的开带，与 $S^1$ 同伦等价，因而是道路连通的（这是 $S^2$ 的情形的关键核对）。条件齐备：$U,V$ 开、$U,V,U\cap V$ 道路连通、基点 $x_0$ 取在交中。于是 $$\pi_1(S^2,x_0)\cong 0*_{\pi_1(U\cap V,x_0)}0=0,$$ 因为并合两个平凡群只能得到平凡群，与 $\pi_1(U\cap V)=\pi_1(S^1)=\mathbb{Z}\ne0$ 是什么无关。但这里**不能**用「交单连通 ⟹ 自由积」的特例：$\pi_1(U\cap V)=\mathbb{Z}\ne0$，交并不单连通，必须用带并合的一般形式。（若错误地把交当成单连通而直接写 $\pi_1(S^2)=0*0=0$，虽然结论对，理由却不成立。）

nodes.title: 布劳威尔不动点定理
nodes.summary: 闭球上任何连续自映射都有不动点；等价说法是「$S^{n-1}$ 不是 $\overline{B^n}$ 的收缩核」。一维用中值定理，高维必须用代数拓扑（$\pi_{n-1}(S^{n-1})\cong\mathbb{Z}$）。
nodes.summaryEn: Every continuous self-map of a closed ball has a fixed point; equivalently $S^{n-1}$ is not a retract of $\overline{B^n}$. The case $n=1$ follows from the intermediate value theorem; higher dimensions require algebraic topology ($\pi_{n-1}(S^{n-1})\cong\mathbb{Z}$).
nodes.definition:
**布劳威尔不动点定理**：设 $\overline{B^n}=\{x\in\mathbb{R}^n:\|x\|\le1\}$ 是闭单位球，$f:\overline{B^n}\to\overline{B^n}$ 连续，则存在 $x\in\overline{B^n}$ 使 $f(x)=x$。它对一切 $n\ge1$ 成立。一维情形就是中值定理：$f:[0,1]\to[0,1]$ 连续，令 $g(x)=f(x)-x$，则 $g(0)=f(0)-0\ge0$、$g(1)=f(1)-1\le0$，由介值定理存在 $g(x)=0$。高维情形必须动用代数拓扑。注意条件：$\overline{B^n}$ **紧且凸**（任何与它同胚的紧凸集同样适用），并且映射必须把球映入**自己**——例如 $\mathbb{R}$ 上的平移 $x\mapsto x+1$ 就没有不动点。

**等价形式**：这个定理还有一个更便于使用的说法，「每个连续自映射都有不动点」等价于「**$S^{n-1}=\partial\overline{B^n}$ 不是 $\overline{B^n}$ 的收缩核**」，即不存在连续映射 $r:\overline{B^n}\to S^{n-1}$ 使 $r|_{S^{n-1}}=\mathrm{id}_{S^{n-1}}$。两个方向都不难看清：
- （非收缩核 ⟹ 不动点）若连续 $f$ 没有不动点，即 $f(x)\ne x$ 对一切 $x$ 成立，就从 $f(x)$ 出发、过 $x$ 作射线，取它与球面的交点
$$r(x)=f(x)+t(x)\,(x-f(x)),\qquad t(x)\ge1,\ \|r(x)\|=1;$$
$t(x)$ 是二次方程 $\|f(x)+t(x-f(x))\|^2=1$ 在 $t\ge1$ 中的唯一根，且随 $x$ 连续（$|p(t)|$ 对足够大的 $t$ 严格递增）。于是 $r$ 连续；当 $x\in S^{n-1}$ 时该射线在 $t=1$ 处离开球面，$r(x)=x$。这就得到一个收缩，与「非收缩核」矛盾。
- （不动点 ⟹ 非收缩核）若存在收缩 $r$，则 $g(x)=-r(x)$ 是 $\overline{B^n}$ 到自身的连续映射，由布劳威尔不动点定理有 $x$ 使 $-r(x)=x$；于是 $\|x\|=\|r(x)\|=1$，故 $x\in S^{n-1}$，从而 $r(x)=x$，代回得 $x=-x$，即 $x=0$，与 $\|x\|=1$ 矛盾。

**代数拓扑证明思路**：只需证明「不存在收缩」。设 $i:S^{n-1}\hookrightarrow\overline{B^n}$ 为包含映射。若存在收缩 $r$，则 $r\circ i=\mathrm{id}_{S^{n-1}}$，取 $(n-1)$ 阶同伦群得
$$r_*\circ i_*=\mathrm{id}_{\pi_{n-1}(S^{n-1})}.$$
但 $\pi_{n-1}(S^{n-1})\cong\mathbb{Z}\ne0$（$S^{n-1}$ 的 $(n-1)$ 阶同伦群由**度**给出，与圆周的 $\pi_1(S^1)=\mathbb{Z}$ 同源），而 $\overline{B^n}$ 可缩、$\pi_{n-1}(\overline{B^n})=0$，所以 $i_*$ 是零同态，$r_*\circ i_*$ 也必须是零同态——与它是恒等同态矛盾。$n=1$ 的情形改用一个更初等的论证：连续满射把连通空间映成连通空间，而 $S^0=\{-1,1\}$ 不连通，故不存在收缩 $r:[-1,1]\to\{-1,1\}$。

**应用**：若 $f:\mathbb{R}^n\to\mathbb{R}^n$ 连续且 $f(\mathbb{R}^n)$ 有界，取足够大的闭球 $\overline{B}_R\supseteq f(\overline{B}_R)$，对 $f|_{\overline{B}_R}$ 用定理即得不动点（这是「$\mathbb{R}^n$ 上的布劳威尔型结果」）。在经济学中，纳什均衡的存在性用的是布劳威尔定理的多值推广——角谷（Kakutani）不动点定理；无穷维版本 Schauder 不动点定理则用于证明非线性微分方程、积分方程解的存在性。
nodes.definitionEn:
**Brouwer's fixed point theorem:** let $\overline{B^n}=\{x\in\mathbb{R}^n:\|x\|\le1\}$ be the closed unit ball and $f:\overline{B^n}\to\overline{B^n}$ continuous. Then $f(x)=x$ for some $x\in\overline{B^n}$. It holds for all $n\ge1$. For $n=1$ it is the intermediate value theorem: with $g(x)=f(x)-x$ one has $g(0)=f(0)\ge0$ and $g(1)=f(1)-1\le0$, so $g$ vanishes somewhere. Higher dimensions need algebraic topology. Note the hypotheses: $\overline{B^n}$ is **compact and convex** (any compact convex set homeomorphic to it works), and the map must take the ball into **itself** — the translation $x\mapsto x+1$ on $\mathbb{R}$ is a counterexample otherwise.

**Equivalent form:** “every continuous self-map has a fixed point” is equivalent to “**$S^{n-1}=\partial\overline{B^n}$ is not a retract of $\overline{B^n}$**”, i.e. there is no continuous $r:\overline{B^n}\to S^{n-1}$ with $r|_{S^{n-1}}=\mathrm{id}_{S^{n-1}}$. Both directions are elementary:
- (non-retract $\Rightarrow$ fixed point) If a continuous $f$ had no fixed point, i.e. $f(x)\ne x$ for all $x$, shoot the ray from $f(x)$ through $x$ and take its intersection with the sphere, $r(x)=f(x)+t(x)(x-f(x))$ with $t(x)\ge1$ and $\|r(x)\|=1$. Here $t(x)$ is the unique root $\ge1$ of $\|f(x)+t(x-f(x))\|^2=1$ and depends continuously on $x$; moreover $r(x)=x$ for $x\in S^{n-1}$. This is a retraction, contradicting the assumption.
- (fixed point $\Rightarrow$ non-retract) If a retraction $r$ existed, then $g(x)=-r(x)$ maps $\overline{B^n}$ into itself, so by Brouwer there is $x$ with $-r(x)=x$; then $\|x\|=\|r(x)\|=1$, so $x\in S^{n-1}$ and $r(x)=x$, giving $x=-x$, i.e. $x=0$, contradicting $\|x\|=1$.

**Proof via algebraic topology:** it suffices to rule out a retraction. Let $i:S^{n-1}\hookrightarrow\overline{B^n}$ be the inclusion. A retraction $r$ would satisfy $r\circ i=\mathrm{id}_{S^{n-1}}$, hence $r_*\circ i_*=\mathrm{id}_{\pi_{n-1}(S^{n-1})}$. But $\pi_{n-1}(S^{n-1})\cong\mathbb{Z}\ne0$ (the $(n-1)$-st homotopy group of the sphere is given by degree, the same phenomenon as $\pi_1(S^1)=\mathbb{Z}$), while $\overline{B^n}$ is contractible with $\pi_{n-1}(\overline{B^n})=0$; so $i_*$ is the zero map and $r_*\circ i_*$ must be zero, contradicting that it is the identity. For $n=1$ a more elementary argument works: a continuous surjection maps connected spaces to connected spaces, but $S^0=\{-1,1\}$ is disconnected, so no retraction $[-1,1]\to\{-1,1\}$ exists.

**Applications:** if $f:\mathbb{R}^n\to\mathbb{R}^n$ is continuous with bounded image, choose $R$ with $f(\overline{B}_R)\subseteq\overline{B}_R$ and apply the theorem to $f|_{\overline{B}_R}$ — this is the Brouwer-type result on $\mathbb{R}^n$. In economics the existence of Nash equilibria follows from Kakutani's set-valued generalisation of Brouwer; the infinite-dimensional Schauder theorem proves existence of solutions of nonlinear differential and integral equations.

formulas.note: 布劳威尔不动点定理本体，对一切 $n\ge1$ 成立。条件是：闭球紧且凸、映射把球映入自身。
formulas.noteEn: The theorem itself, valid for every $n\ge1$. The hypotheses: the closed ball is compact and convex, and the map sends the ball into itself.

formulas.note: 一维情形的证明：$g$ 连续且两端异号（含零点），由介值定理得不动点。高维没有这样简单的手段，必须用代数拓扑。
formulas.noteEn: Proof in dimension one: $g$ is continuous and changes sign (allowing a zero), so the intermediate value theorem gives a fixed point. No such elementary argument exists in higher dimensions.

formulas.note: 等价形式：$S^{n-1}$ 不是 $\overline{B^n}$ 的收缩核。定理的两种说法互相等价，证明中真正使用的是这一条。
formulas.noteEn: Equivalent form: $S^{n-1}$ is not a retract of $\overline{B^n}$. The two statements are equivalent, and this is the form actually used in the proof.

formulas.note: 由「无不动点的 $f$」构造收缩的显式公式：从 $f(x)$ 过 $x$ 作射线交球面于 $r(x)$，$t(x)$ 取 $\|f(x)+t(x-f(x))\|^2=1$ 的、$\ge1$ 的那个根。
formulas.noteEn: Explicit construction of a retraction from a fixed-point-free $f$: shoot the ray from $f(x)$ through $x$ to the sphere; $t(x)$ is the root $\ge1$ of $\|f(x)+t(x-f(x))\|^2=1$.

formulas.note: 矛盾的核心：收缩要求复合是恒等同态，但 $i_*$ 要穿过平凡群 $\pi_{n-1}(\overline{B^n})=0$（$\overline{B^n}$ 可缩），只能是零同态。
formulas.noteEn: The heart of the contradiction: a retraction would force the composite to be the identity, but $i_*$ factors through the trivial group $\pi_{n-1}(\overline{B^n})=0$ since the ball is contractible, so it is zero.

properties: 对一切 $n\ge1$ 成立：一维由介值定理（令 $g(x)=f(x)-x$），$n\ge2$ 必须用代数拓扑，用 $\pi_{n-1}(S^{n-1})\cong\mathbb{Z}\ne0$（或同调群、度）得出矛盾。
与「非收缩核」等价：$\overline{B^n}$ 上「连续自映射都有不动点」$\iff$「不存在连续收缩 $r:\overline{B^n}\to S^{n-1}$」。两个方向分别用射线构造与对径技巧（$g=-r$）证明。
可推广到一切与 $\overline{B^n}$ 同胚的紧凸集（如 $[0,1]^n$、单纯形）：它们上的连续自映射都有不动点。
条件不能削弱：把 $\overline{B^n}$ 换成不含边界的开球或换成 $S^{n-1}$ 本身就可能没有不动点——圆周上的对径映射 $x\mapsto-x$ 就没有不动点；$\mathbb{R}$ 上的平移 $x\mapsto x+1$ 也没有。
有诸多推广：角谷（Kakutani）定理把定理推广到集值映射（纳什均衡存在性的工具），Schauder 定理推广到 Banach 空间，Lefschetz 不动点定理用同调与 Lefschetz 数给出更一般的判据。
propertiesEn: Holds for all $n\ge1$: for $n=1$ it is the intermediate value theorem applied to $g(x)=f(x)-x$; for $n\ge2$ one needs algebraic topology — the contradiction comes from $\pi_{n-1}(S^{n-1})\cong\mathbb{Z}\ne0$ (or from homology, or degree theory).

Equivalent to the non-retract statement: “every continuous self-map of $\overline{B^n}$ has a fixed point” iff “there is no continuous retraction $r:\overline{B^n}\to S^{n-1}$”. The two directions use the ray construction and the antipodal trick ($g=-r$).
It extends to every compact convex set homeomorphic to $\overline{B^n}$ (e.g. $[0,1]^n$, a simplex): every continuous self-map has a fixed point.

The hypotheses cannot be weakened: replacing the closed ball by an open ball or by $S^{n-1}$ itself may destroy fixed points — the antipodal map $x\mapsto-x$ on the circle has none, and neither has the translation $x\mapsto x+1$ on $\mathbb{R}$.

Many generalisations exist: Kakutani's theorem for set-valued maps (the tool behind Nash equilibrium existence), Schauder's theorem in Banach spaces, and the Lefschetz fixed point theorem using homology and the Lefschetz number.

plot.title: y = cos x 与 y = x 的交点即不动点（虚线为该点切线）

examples.problem: 用介值定理证明 $[0,1]$ 上的连续自映射必有不动点，并求出 $f(x)=1-x^2$ 在 $[0,1]$ 上的不动点。
用布劳威尔不动点定理证明：不存在连续收缩 $r:\overline{B^n}\to S^{n-1}$（即 $S^{n-1}$ 不是 $\overline{B^n}$ 的收缩核）。
examples.solution: 反设存在这样的 $r$，则 $r(x)\in S^{n-1}$ 恒成立，特别地 $\|r(x)\|=1$。定义 $g(x)=-r(x)$，则 $g$ 是 $\overline{B^n}$ 到自身的连续映射（因为 $\|g(x)\|=1\le1$）。由布劳威尔不动点定理，存在 $x$ 使 $g(x)=x$，即 $-r(x)=x$，于是 $\|x\|=\|r(x)\|=1$，故 $x\in S^{n-1}$。但 $x$ 在球面上时收缩条件给出 $r(x)=x$，代入得 $x=-x$，即 $x=0$，与 $\|x\|=1$ 矛盾。故不存在收缩。反过来（非收缩核 ⟹ 不动点）可用定义中的射线构造：若 $f$ 无不动点，从 $f(x)$ 过 $x$ 作射线交球面即得收缩 $r$。

nodes.title: 单纯复形与三角剖分
nodes.summary: 由点、线段、三角形、四面体这些标准积木按两条严格规则粘成的有限组合结构；它把连续空间的拓扑问题翻译成有限组合计算，是单纯同调与组合拓扑的入口。
nodes.summaryEn: A finite combinatorial structure glued from standard blocks — points, segments, triangles, tetrahedra — under two strict rules; it translates continuous topology into finite combinatorial computation and is the doorway to simplicial homology.
nodes.definition:
**单形**是最简单的几何积木：0 维是一个点，1 维是线段，2 维是三角形，3 维是四面体。一般地，取 $n+1$ 个**仿射无关**的点 $v_0,\dots,v_n$（它们不落在同一个低维仿射平面上），其凸包 $\sigma=[v_0,\dots,v_n]$ 称为 **$n$ 维单形**，$\dim\sigma=n$；由一部分顶点张成的凸包叫 $\sigma$ 的**面**，例如三角形 $[a,b,c]$ 的面是 $[a,b],[b,c],[c,a],[a],[b],[c]$ 以及它自己。

**单纯复形**是一族单形 $\mathcal K$，要求同时满足两条规则：① **面封闭**：若 $\sigma\in\mathcal K$，则 $\sigma$ 的每个面也属于 $\mathcal K$（有三角形就必须带上它的三条棱与三个顶点）；② **交条件**：若 $\sigma,\tau\in\mathcal K$，则 $\sigma\cap\tau$ 要么为空，要么是两者的**公共面**（即由公共顶点张成的那个面）。第二条把「两条棱只粘半条」「一个三角形贴在另一个三角形半条边上」这类粘法排除掉——它们不是剖分。复形中单形的最大维数叫 $\mathcal K$ 的**维数**；只有有限多个单形时叫**有限复形**，记 $f_n$ 为 $n$ 维单形的个数（$f_0$ 顶点、$f_1$ 棱、$f_2$ 面）。

把顶点放进某个 $\mathbb R^N$ 的仿射无关位置、每个单形放成它的凸包，就得到 $\mathcal K$ 的**几何实现** $|\mathcal K|=\bigcup_{\sigma\in\mathcal K}|\sigma|$；反过来，只记录「有哪些单形、谁包含谁」而不放入空间，就叫**抽象单纯复形**。若拓扑空间 $X$ 同胚于某个 $|\mathcal K|$，就说 $\mathcal K$ 是 $X$ 的一个**三角剖分**（剖分），$X$ 叫**可剖分空间**。剖分的全部威力在于：$X$ 的拓扑信息被压成一份**有限的组合清单**（单形清单加包含关系）。

把这份清单翻译回拓扑，用的是**单纯映射**：$f:\mathcal K\to\mathcal L$ 把顶点映到顶点，并且把每个单形映为 $\mathcal L$ 的某个单形（维数允许下降——三角形的三个顶点可以映成一条棱甚至一个点）；按重心坐标线性延拓，就得到连续映射 $|f|:|\mathcal K|\to|\mathcal L|$。于是组合与拓扑可以互译：复形之间的组合映射给出几何实现之间的连续映射，复合与恒等都被保持。Radó 定理进一步保证每个紧曲面都能三角剖分，所以这套有限语言足以装下曲面（闭曲面、带边曲面、黎曼面）——这正是「单纯同调」能够定义的前提。
nodes.definitionEn:
A **simplex** is the simplest geometric block: a point in dimension 0, a segment in dimension 1, a triangle in dimension 2, a tetrahedron in dimension 3. In general, take $n+1$ **affinely independent** points $v_0,\dots,v_n$ (not lying in any lower-dimensional affine plane); their convex hull $\sigma=[v_0,\dots,v_n]$ is an **$n$-simplex** with $\dim\sigma=n$, and the convex hull of a subset of the vertices is a **face** of $\sigma$; for the triangle $[a,b,c]$ the faces are $[a,b],[b,c],[c,a],[a],[b],[c]$ together with itself.

A **simplicial complex** is a family $\mathcal K$ of simplices satisfying two rules: (1) **closure under faces**: if $\sigma\in\mathcal K$ then every face of $\sigma$ lies in $\mathcal K$; (2) the **intersection condition**: if $\sigma,\tau\in\mathcal K$ then $\sigma\cap\tau$ is either empty or a **common face** of both (spanned by their common vertices). Rule (2) excludes gluing two edges along half an edge, or a triangle along half of another triangle's edge—those are not triangulations. The largest dimension occurring is the **dimension** of $\mathcal K$; when there are finitely many simplices we call it a **finite complex** and write $f_n$ for the number of $n$-simplices ($f_0$ vertices, $f_1$ edges, $f_2$ faces).

Placing the vertices in affinely independent positions in some $\mathbb R^N$ and taking convex hulls yields the **geometric realization** $|\mathcal K|=\bigcup_{\sigma\in\mathcal K}|\sigma|$; forgetting the ambient space and keeping only which simplices exist and which contain which gives an **abstract simplicial complex**. If a topological space $X$ is homeomorphic to some $|\mathcal K|$, then $\mathcal K$ is a **triangulation** of $X$ and $X$ is called **triangulable**. The power of a triangulation is that all topological information is compressed into a **finite combinatorial list**.

Translating the list back into topology uses **simplicial maps**: $f:\mathcal K\to\mathcal L$ sends vertices to vertices and every simplex to some simplex of $\mathcal L$ (dimension may drop—a triangle's three vertices may map to an edge or a point); extending linearly via barycentric coordinates gives a continuous map $|f|:|\mathcal K|\to|\mathcal L|$. Compositions and identities are respected, so combinatorics and topology can be intertranslated. Radó's theorem guarantees every compact surface admits a triangulation, so this finite language covers surfaces (closed, with boundary, Riemann surfaces)—which is exactly what makes simplicial homology definable.

formulas.note: n 维单形是 $n+1$ 个仿射无关点的凸包；顶点顺序此时只是记号（定向与边界算子才会用到顺序）。
formulas.noteEn: An $n$-simplex is the convex hull of $n+1$ affinely independent points; the ordering of vertices is mere notation until orientations and boundary operators come in.

formulas.latex: \sigma\in\mathcal K,\ \tau\subseteq\sigma\ \Longrightarrow\ \tau\in\mathcal K;\qquad \sigma,\tau\in\mathcal K\ \Longrightarrow\ \sigma\cap\tau=\varnothing\ \text{ 或为两者的公共面}
formulas.note: 两条公理：面封闭 + 交条件。两个三角形沿一条整棱粘合是复形，只沿半条棱粘合则不是。
formulas.noteEn: The two axioms: closure under faces plus the intersection condition. Two triangles glued along a whole edge form a complex; glued along half an edge they do not.

formulas.note: 几何实现与三角剖分：$X$ 同胚于某个复形的几何实现，就说该复形剖分了 $X$。
formulas.noteEn: Geometric realization and triangulation: when $X$ is homeomorphic to $|\mathcal K|$, the complex $\mathcal K$ triangulates $X$.

formulas.note: 欧拉示性数直接由单形个数（$f$ 向量）算出，同一空间的不同剖分给同一结果。
formulas.noteEn: The Euler characteristic is read off directly from the numbers of simplices and is independent of the chosen triangulation.

formulas.note: 实心三角形的标准剖分：1 个 2-单形、3 个 1-单形、3 个 0-单形；删去 $[a,b,c]$ 剩下的就是它的边界复形。
formulas.noteEn: The standard triangulation of the solid triangle: one 2-simplex, three 1-simplices, three 0-simplices; deleting $[a,b,c]$ leaves its boundary complex.

properties: 有限复形只有有限多个单形，全部信息是一份有限的组合清单；同调群、欧拉示性数等都能逐步算出，不需要度量、极限或光滑结构。
两条公理缺一不可：只要求面封闭、允许任意粘合的框架叫 $\Delta$-复形（胞腔粘合）；若允许「粘半条棱」，连 $\Delta$-复形都不是，因为交集不是任何单形的面。
抽象复形由单形集合与包含关系决定，其几何实现在同构意义下唯一；单纯映射诱导几何实现之间的连续映射，并且保持复合与恒等（构成函子）。
三角剖分不唯一：正方形可以先切一条对角线，也可以先细分再剖分；但由剖分算出的拓扑不变量（同调群、欧拉示性数）与剖分无关。
有限复形的几何实现是紧致且可度量的；Radó 定理指出每个紧曲面都能三角剖分，所以曲面的拓扑问题可以完全放进单纯复形框架。
propertiesEn: A finite complex has finitely many simplices, so all its information is a finite combinatorial list; homology groups and the Euler characteristic can be computed step by step, with no metric, limit or smooth structure needed.

Both axioms matter: requiring only closure under faces while allowing arbitrary gluing leads to $\Delta$-complexes (cellular gluing); allowing gluing along half an edge yields not even a $\Delta$-complex, since the intersection is not a face of either simplex.

An abstract complex is determined by its simplices and inclusions, and its geometric realization is unique up to isomorphism; simplicial maps induce continuous maps of realizations and preserve compositions and identities (a functor).
Triangulations are not unique: a square can be cut along one diagonal or subdivided further; yet the invariants computed from a triangulation (homology, Euler characteristic) do not depend on it.
The realization of a finite complex is compact and metrizable; Radó's theorem says every compact surface can be triangulated, so surface topology fits entirely into the simplicial framework.

plot.title: 把方块曲面剖分成 4 个三角形（面封闭 + 交条件都满足）

examples.problem: 判断下列三种粘法是否构成单纯复形，并求第一种的 $f$ 向量与欧拉示性数：(i) 三角形 $[a,b,c]$ 与 $[b,c,d]$ 沿公共棱 $[b,c]$ 粘合，并取齐所有面；(ii) 两个三角形沿「半条棱」粘合（$[a,b,c]$ 的棱 $[a,c]$ 的中点粘到 $[c,d,e]$ 的棱 $[c,d]$ 的中点上）；(iii) 三角形 $[a,b,c]$ 与 $[c,d,e]$ 只在顶点 $c$ 相碰。
examples.solution:
(i) **是复形**。面封闭已取齐；两个 2-单形的交是 $[b,c]$，恰好是由公共顶点 $b,c$ 张成的面，满足交条件。$f_0=4$（$a,b,c,d$），$f_1=5$（$[a,b],[b,c],[a,c],[b,d],[c,d]$，公共棱只算一次），$f_2=2$，故 $\chi=4-5+2=1$，与「两张圆盘沿一段弧粘成一个圆盘」相符。
(ii) **不是复形**。$[a,b,c]$ 与 $[c,d,e]$ 的交是「半条棱」，它既不空、也不是由公共顶点张成的单形（公共顶点只有 $c$，只能张成 $[c]$），违反交条件。要合法必须先把中点加为顶点，把两条棱各劈成两条棱。
(iii) **是复形**。交集是单个顶点 $[c]$，它同时是两个三角形的面。$f_0=5$，$f_1=6$，$f_2=2$，$\chi=5-6+2=1$，与「两张圆盘粘于一点得 $1+1-1=1$」一致。

examples.problem: 设 $\mathcal K$ 是正方形的三角剖分：$a(0,0),b(1,0),c(1,1),d(0,1)$，单形为 $[a,b,c],[a,c,d]$ 及全部面。目标复形 (A) $\mathcal L=\{[0],[1],[0,1]\}$；(B) $\mathcal L'=\{[0],[1],[2],[0,1],[1,2]\}$（只有两条棱，没有 $[0,2]$）。判断顶点映射 $f(a)=0,\ f(b)=1,\ f(c)=1,\ f(d)=0$ 是否给出 $\mathcal K\to\mathcal L$ 的单纯映射；再判断 $g(a)=0,\ g(b)=1,\ g(c)=2,\ g(d)=2$ 是否给出 $\mathcal K\to\mathcal L'$ 的单纯映射。
examples.solution:
(A) **是单纯映射**。逐条检查单形：$f(\{a,b,c\})=\{0,1\}$，$\mathcal L$ 含有 $[0,1]$；$f(\{a,c,d\})=\{0,1\}$，同样可以；1-单形与 0-单形的像显然也都是 $\mathcal L$ 的成员（0-单形映为 0-单形）。几何实现 $|f|$ 把正方形压到线段上：两个三角形都被压成整条棱，维数从 2 降到 1——这是允许的。
(B) **不是单纯映射**。$g(\{a,b,c\})=\{0,1,2\}$，要求 $\mathcal L'$ 含有 2-单形 $[0,1,2]$，但 $\mathcal L'$ 只含两条 1-单形，故条件不满足。要点：单纯映射要求「每个单形的**顶点集的像**必须在目标复形中张成一个单形」，$\{0,1,2\}$ 在 $\mathcal L'$ 中不张成单形，所以 $g$ 不合格（尽管它仍能线性延拓成某个连续映射）。

expression.text: 𝒦 = {单形族}，满足面封闭与交条件；|𝒦| ≅ X 时 𝒦 是 X 的三角剖分
expression.note: 复形的全部信息是一份有限组合清单：单形清单 + 包含关系；单纯映射 F: 𝒦→ℒ 送单形到单形。
expression.noteEn: A complex is exactly a finite combinatorial list: its simplices plus the inclusion relations; a simplicial map sends simplices to simplices.

nodes.title: 单纯同调群
nodes.summary: 把各维单形组织成链群、用边界算子 $\partial$ 串成链复形；由 $\partial\circ\partial=0$ 得 $B_n\subseteq Z_n$，从而定义 $H_n=Z_n/B_n$——一套纯组合、解线性方程组就能算出的拓扑不变量。
nodes.summaryEn: Organize simplices into chain groups and chain them into a chain complex via the boundary operator; since ∂∘∂ = 0 we have Bₙ ⊆ Zₙ and may set Hₙ = Zₙ/Bₙ — a purely combinatorial topological invariant computable by linear algebra.
nodes.definition:
设 $\mathcal K$ 是单纯复形。**链群** $C_n(\mathcal K)$ 是以全体 $n$ 维单形为基的自由阿贝尔群：$C_n=\bigl\{\sum_i a_i\sigma_i:\ a_i\in\mathbb Z\bigr\}\cong\mathbb Z^{f_n}$。为了让边界算子带正负号，要先给单形**定向**：把顶点排成次序写成有序单形 $[v_0,\dots,v_n]$，并约定交换相邻两个顶点变号，$[v_0,\dots,v_i,v_{i+1},\dots]=-[v_0,\dots,v_{i+1},v_i,\dots]$。系数也可以取某个域 $\mathbb F$（$\mathbb Q,\mathbb R,\mathbb F_2$ 等），这时 $C_n$ 是 $\mathbb F$ 上的向量空间，理论更简单，但会丢掉**挠元**信息。

**边界算子** $\partial_n:C_n\to C_{n-1}$ 在每个单形上定义为删去一个顶点、带交替符号：$\partial_n[v_0,\dots,v_n]=\sum_{i=0}^{n}(-1)^i[v_0,\dots,\hat v_i,\dots,v_n]$，再线性延拓。例如 $\partial_1[a,b]=[b]-[a]$，$\partial_2[a,b,c]=[b,c]-[a,c]+[a,b]$。它满足最关键的性质 **$\partial\circ\partial=0$**（「边界的边界为零」）：三角形上直接验证，$\partial_1\partial_2[a,b,c]=([c]-[b])-([c]-[a])+([b]-[a])=0$；一般情形是因为展开 $\partial\partial\sigma$ 后每个 $(n-2)$ 维面恰好出现两次、符号相反。于是 $\{C_n,\partial_n\}$ 成为一个**链复形** $\cdots\to C_{n+1}\xrightarrow{\partial_{n+1}}C_n\xrightarrow{\partial_n}C_{n-1}\to\cdots$。

有了 $\partial^2=0$，就能定义两个子群：**闭链** $Z_n=\ker\partial_n=\{n\text{-链 }c:\ \partial_nc=0\}$（自身没有边界的 $n$-链，如一整圈三角形的边），与**边界链** $B_n=\operatorname{im}\partial_{n+1}$（是某个 $(n+1)$-链的边界的 $n$-链）。由 $\partial_n\circ\partial_{n+1}=0$，任何形如 $\partial_{n+1}c$ 的链都被 $\partial_n$ 杀死，故 **$B_n\subseteq Z_n$**，于是可以作商，得到 **同调群** $H_n(\mathcal K)=Z_n/B_n=\ker\partial_n\big/\operatorname{im}\partial_{n+1}$。商群的顺序绝不能颠倒：分子是**闭链**（自身边界为零），分母是**边界链**（是更高维链的边界）；同调群的元素是闭链的等价类，而把「本身是边界的闭链」当作零——剩下的恰好是「绕洞不回缩」的部分，这就是 $n$ 维洞的代数化身。

从链复形出发，$H_n$ 只是若干线性方程组的解空间之商，有限复形时是有限生成阿贝尔群：$H_n\cong\mathbb Z^{b_n}\oplus\mathbb Z_{t_1}\oplus\cdots$，其中 $b_n$ 是第 $n$ 个 **Betti 数**，$\mathbb Z_{t_i}$ 是**挠元**（如 $\mathrm{RP}^2$ 的 $\mathbb Z_2$）。计算靠秩公式 $b_n=f_n-\operatorname{rank}\partial_n-\operatorname{rank}\partial_{n+1}$（矩阵秩或 Smith 标准形），所以整个拓扑问题变成有限线性代数。最重要的结论是：$H_n$ 不依赖顶点怎么放、选哪个剖分，它是**拓扑不变量**（更精确地说，是**同伦不变量**）。
nodes.definitionEn:
Let $\mathcal K$ be a simplicial complex. The **chain group** $C_n(\mathcal K)$ is the free abelian group on the $n$-simplices: $C_n=\bigl\{\sum_i a_i\sigma_i:\ a_i\in\mathbb Z\bigr\}\cong\mathbb Z^{f_n}$. To give the boundary operator signs we **orient** simplices: order their vertices to write an oriented simplex $[v_0,\dots,v_n]$, with the convention that swapping two adjacent vertices changes the sign, $[v_0,\dots,v_i,v_{i+1},\dots]=-[v_0,\dots,v_{i+1},v_i,\dots]$. Coefficients may also be taken in a field $\mathbb F$ ($\mathbb Q,\mathbb R,\mathbb F_2,\dots$); then $C_n$ is a vector space and the theory is simpler, at the cost of losing **torsion** information.

The **boundary operator** $\partial_n:C_n\to C_{n-1}$ is defined on simplices by deleting one vertex at a time with alternating signs, $\partial_n[v_0,\dots,v_n]=\sum_{i=0}^{n}(-1)^i[v_0,\dots,\hat v_i,\dots,v_n]$, and extended linearly. For instance $\partial_1[a,b]=[b]-[a]$ and $\partial_2[a,b,c]=[b,c]-[a,c]+[a,b]$. Its crucial property is **$\partial\circ\partial=0$** ("the boundary of a boundary is zero"): on a triangle, $\partial_1\partial_2[a,b,c]=([c]-[b])-([c]-[a])+([b]-[a])=0$, and in general each $(n-2)$-face appears twice with opposite signs. Thus $\{C_n,\partial_n\}$ is a **chain complex** $\cdots\to C_{n+1}\xrightarrow{\partial_{n+1}}C_n\xrightarrow{\partial_n}C_{n-1}\to\cdots$.

With $\partial^2=0$ we obtain two subgroups: the **cycles** $Z_n=\ker\partial_n$ (chains with no boundary of their own, such as one full tour around the edges of a triangle) and the **boundaries** $B_n=\operatorname{im}\partial_{n+1}$ (chains that bound some $(n+1)$-chain). Since $\partial_n\circ\partial_{n+1}=0$, every $\partial_{n+1}c$ is killed by $\partial_n$, hence **$B_n\subseteq Z_n$**, and we may form the quotient: the **homology group** $H_n(\mathcal K)=Z_n/B_n=\ker\partial_n\big/\operatorname{im}\partial_{n+1}$. The order can never be reversed: the numerator consists of **cycles** (zero boundary) and the denominator of **boundaries** (boundaries of higher chains). Elements of $H_n$ are classes of cycles, and cycles that already bound something are declared zero—what survives is precisely the part that wraps around holes, the algebraic incarnation of $n$-dimensional holes.

From the chain complex, $H_n$ is merely a quotient of solution spaces of linear systems; for finite complexes it is finitely generated: $H_n\cong\mathbb Z^{b_n}\oplus\mathbb Z_{t_1}\oplus\cdots$, where $b_n$ is the $n$-th **Betti number** and the $\mathbb Z_{t_i}$ are **torsion**. Computations use the rank formula $b_n=f_n-\operatorname{rank}\partial_n-\operatorname{rank}\partial_{n+1}$ (matrix ranks or Smith normal form), so topology becomes finite linear algebra. Above all, $H_n$ does not depend on how vertices are placed or which triangulation is chosen: it is a **topological invariant**—more precisely, a **homotopy invariant**.

formulas.latex: C_n(\mathcal K)=\Bigl\{\sum_i a_i\sigma_i:\ a_i\in\mathbb Z\Bigr\}\cong\mathbb Z^{f_n},\qquad \cdots\to C_{n+1}\xrightarrow{\partial_{n+1}}C_n\xrightarrow{\partial_n}C_{n-1}\to\cdots
formulas.note: 链群由 $n$ 维单形自由生成，系数取 $\mathbb Z$（或任意环、域）；它们与边界算子一起构成链复形。
formulas.noteEn: The chain group is freely generated by the $n$-simplices, with coefficients in $\mathbb Z$ (or any ring/field); together with $\partial$ it forms a chain complex.

formulas.note: 边界算子：删顶点、符号交替（$\hat v_i$ 表示删去 $v_i$）；这就是有向单形的「边界」。
formulas.noteEn: The boundary operator deletes a vertex with alternating signs ($\hat v_i$ means $v_i$ omitted); this is the boundary of an oriented simplex.

formulas.note: 「边界的边界为零」：它保证边界链都是闭链，是能作商定义同调群的前提。
formulas.noteEn: "Boundary of a boundary is zero": every boundary is a cycle, which is exactly what makes the quotient defining homology possible.

formulas.note: 关键顺序：**闭链除以边界链**；写反了（边界除以闭链）毫无意义。
formulas.noteEn: Key order: **cycles modulo boundaries**; reversing it (boundaries modulo cycles) is meaningless.

formulas.note: 用秩公式算 Betti 数：分别解 $\partial_nc=0$ 与求 $\partial_{n+1}$ 的像，剩下的商就是同调（挠部分由 Smith 标准形的非平凡不变因子给出）。
formulas.noteEn: The rank formula computes Betti numbers: solve $\partial_nc=0$ and find the image of $\partial_{n+1}$; torsion comes from the nontrivial invariant factors in Smith normal form.

properties: 同调群只依赖链复形（单形清单加边界矩阵）这份有限数据，因此是**组合可计算量**：不需要几何实现，也不需要顶点放在哪里。
$\partial^2=0$ 是全部定义的支点：它保证 $B_n\subseteq Z_n$，商群 $Z_n/B_n$ 才有意义；若 $\partial^2\neq0$，$B_n$ 一般不再是 $Z_n$ 的子群，同调群无从定义。
系数域的选择会影响结果：取域 $\mathbb F$ 时 $H_n(\mathcal K;\mathbb F)$ 是向量空间且**看不到挠元**——$H_1(\mathrm{RP}^2;\mathbb Z)=\mathbb Z_2$，而 $H_1(\mathrm{RP}^2;\mathbb Q)=0$。
有限复形时 $H_n$ 有限生成，形如 $\mathbb Z^{b_n}\oplus(\text{挠部分})$；$H_n=0$ 当 $n>\dim\mathcal K$，而且 $H_n$ 与剖分、与顶点标号无关。
单纯同调与连续拓扑一致：$H_n(\mathcal K)\cong H_n(|\mathcal K|)$（与奇异同调同构），于是可以在有限的组合层面算拓扑不变量，并且 $\chi(\mathcal K)=\sum_n(-1)^nb_n$。
propertiesEn: Homology depends only on the chain complex (the list of simplices plus the boundary matrices), hence it is **combinatorially computable**: no geometric realization is needed and the placement of vertices is irrelevant.
$\partial^2=0$ is the linchpin: it guarantees $B_n\subseteq Z_n$ so that $Z_n/B_n$ makes sense; without it $B_n$ is generally not a subgroup of $Z_n$ and homology cannot be defined.

The coefficient field matters: with coefficients in a field $\mathbb F$, $H_n(\mathcal K;\mathbb F)$ is a vector space and **torsion becomes invisible**—$H_1(\mathrm{RP}^2;\mathbb Z)=\mathbb Z_2$ whereas $H_1(\mathrm{RP}^2;\mathbb Q)=0$.

For a finite complex $H_n$ is finitely generated of the form $\mathbb Z^{b_n}\oplus(\text{torsion})$, vanishes for $n>\dim\mathcal K$, and is independent of the triangulation and of the labelling of vertices.

Simplicial homology agrees with the topology of the realization: $H_n(\mathcal K)\cong H_n(|\mathcal K|)$ (isomorphic to singular homology), so invariants can be computed at the finite combinatorial level, and $\chi(\mathcal K)=\sum_n(-1)^nb_n$.

plot.title: 三角形边界是一个 1-闭链：∂([a,b]+[b,c]+[c,a]) = 0

examples.problem: 计算三角形边界复形 $\partial\Delta^2$（顶点 $a,b,c$，棱 $[a,b],[b,c],[c,a]$，不含 2-单形）的 $H_0$ 与 $H_1$。
examples.solution:
此时 $C_2=0$，$C_1=\mathbb Z[a,b]\oplus\mathbb Z[b,c]\oplus\mathbb Z[c,a]$，$C_0=\mathbb Z[a]\oplus\mathbb Z[b]\oplus\mathbb Z[c]$。
$H_1=\ker\partial_1$：设 $c_1=x[a,b]+y[b,c]+z[c,a]$，则
$\partial_1c_1=x([b]-[a])+y([c]-[b])+z([a]-[c])=(z-x)[a]+(x-y)[b]+(y-z)[c]=0$，
得 $x=y=z$，故 $\ker\partial_1=\mathbb Z\cdot\bigl([a,b]+[b,c]+[c,a]\bigr)\cong\mathbb Z$，于是 $H_1\cong\mathbb Z$。
$H_0=C_0/\operatorname{im}\partial_1$：$\operatorname{im}\partial_1$ 中的链系数满足总和为零（因为 $\partial_1$ 的每个像的三个系数之和为 0），故商群由 $[a]$ 生成、$\cong\mathbb Z$，即 $H_0\cong\mathbb Z$（复形连通）。结论 $H_0=\mathbb Z$，$H_1=\mathbb Z$，与 $|\partial\Delta^2|\cong S^1$ 相符。

examples.problem: 计算实心三角形 $\Delta^2$（含 2-单形 $[a,b,c]$ 及其全部面）的 $H_0,H_1,H_2$，并与上题的边界复形对照。
examples.solution:
$C_2=\mathbb Z[abc]$，$C_1,C_0$ 与上题相同。边界矩阵：
$\partial_2[abc]=[b,c]-[a,c]+[a,b]=[a,b]+[b,c]+[c,a]$（末步用了 $[c,a]=-[a,c]$），
它恰好等于上题中 $\ker\partial_1$ 的生成元，因此 $Z_1=\operatorname{im}\partial_2=B_1$，$H_1=Z_1/B_1=0$。
$\partial_2$ 是单射（$[abc]\mapsto$ 非零链），故 $H_2=\ker\partial_2=0$；$H_0=\mathbb Z$ 同上。结论：$\Delta^2$ 只有 $H_0=\mathbb Z$、其余为 0，与圆盘（可缩）相符。两个复形只差一个 2-单形，$H_1$ 就从 $\mathbb Z$ 变成 $0$——「把洞填上」在同调上的表现正是这个。

expression.text: Hₙ(𝒦) = Zₙ / Bₙ = ker ∂ₙ / im ∂ₙ₊₁   （闭链 / 边界链）
expression.note: 边界算子满足 ∂∘∂ = 0，故 Bₙ ⊆ Zₙ，商才有意义；元素是闭链的等价类。
expression.noteEn: The boundary operator satisfies ∂∘∂ = 0, hence Bₙ ⊆ Zₙ and the quotient makes sense; its elements are classes of cycles.

nodes.title: 同调群
nodes.summary: 给每个空间配上「第 $n$ 维洞」的代数测量：$H_0$ 数连通分支、$H_1$ 数一维的环、$H_2$ 数二维空腔；它是同伦不变量，也是 $\pi_1$ 的阿贝尔化（对道路连通空间），比同伦群好算得多。
nodes.summaryEn: An algebraic measurement of the $n$-dimensional holes of a space: $H_0$ counts path components, $H_1$ counts one-dimensional loops, $H_2$ counts two-dimensional cavities; it is a homotopy invariant, the abelianization of $\pi_1$, and far easier to compute than homotopy groups.
nodes.definition:
**同调群**是给每个空间 $X$ 与每个 $n\ge0$ 配一个阿贝尔群 $H_n(X)$ 的构造（可用单纯同调、奇异同调、胞腔同调等模型定义，结果一致）。它有两条决定性性质：**同伦等价（因而同胚）的空间有同构的同调群**，而且 $H_n$ 通常能**纯代数地算出来**。直观上 $H_n$ 度量「$n$ 维的洞」：$H_0$ 说空间有多少块，$H_1$ 说有多少条绕不过去的环（圆周、环面的两条经线），$H_2$ 说有多少个被包起来的空腔（球面内部的空腔、环面内部的管子）。

三条最常用的经验：① $H_0(X)\cong\mathbb Z^{c}$，$c$ 是**道路连通分支**的个数——每个分支贡献一个 $\mathbb Z$；② $H_1(X)$ 的自由秩数出独立的「一维环」个数（环面 2、圆周 1、球面 0）；③ $H_n(X)=0$ 当 $n>\dim X$。但同调不只是数数：$\mathrm{RP}^2$ 的 $H_1=\mathbb Z_2$ 是**挠元**，反映不可定向的「扭转」；它数不出洞的个数，却是真实的拓扑信息。

**同调与基本群**：$H_1$ 是 $\pi_1$ 的**阿贝尔化**（**要求 $X$ 道路连通**，基点任取），即 $H_1(X)\cong\pi_1(X,x_0)/[\pi_1(X,x_0),\pi_1(X,x_0)]$。直觉：在亏格 $\ge2$ 的闭曲面上（或 $S^1\vee S^1$ 上）「先绕 $m$ 圈再绕 $n$ 圈」与「先 $n$ 圈再 $m$ 圈」在 $\pi_1$ 中不同，但同调把顺序抹平，只记住总圈数。所以同调是基本群的**弱化**（丢掉了非交换信息），换来的好处是：同调群是阿贝尔群、有结构定理、有计算工具（Mayer–Vietoris 长正合序列、对 $(X,A)$ 的长正合序列、切除定理）。例如克莱因瓶的 $\pi_1$ 非交换、写起来要小心，而 $H_1$ 直接给出 $\mathbb Z\oplus\mathbb Z_2$。

计算时模型可以随便挑：有限单纯复形用 $\partial$ 矩阵（Smith 标准形），胞腔复形用**胞腔链复形**（第 $n$ 个胞腔群是自由群，$\partial$ 由粘合映射的度数给出），一般空间用奇异同调；只要模型同伦等价，答案必然相同。还有几条常用性质：**可加性** $H_n(X\sqcup Y)\cong H_n(X)\oplus H_n(Y)$；对良对 $(X,A)$ 的长正合序列 $\cdots\to H_n(A)\to H_n(X)\to H_n(X,A)\to H_{n-1}(A)\to\cdots$；$H_n$ 与系数环无关的部分是自由秩（Betti 数），而**挠元随系数变化**。
nodes.definitionEn:
**Homology** assigns to every space $X$ and every $n\ge0$ an abelian group $H_n(X)$ (definable via simplicial, singular or cellular homology—all agree). Two properties are decisive: **homotopy equivalent spaces (hence homeomorphic spaces) have isomorphic homology**, and $H_n$ can usually be **computed purely algebraically**. Intuitively $H_n$ measures $n$-dimensional holes: $H_0$ counts the pieces of the space, $H_1$ counts independent loops (one for the circle, two for the torus), $H_2$ counts enclosed cavities (the inside of a sphere, the tube of a torus).

Three rules of thumb: (1) $H_0(X)\cong\mathbb Z^{c}$ where $c$ is the number of **path components**—each component contributes one $\mathbb Z$; (2) the free rank of $H_1(X)$ counts independent one-dimensional loops (2 for the torus, 1 for the circle, 0 for the sphere); (3) $H_n(X)=0$ for $n>\dim X$. Homology is more than counting, though: $H_1(\mathrm{RP}^2)=\mathbb Z_2$ is **torsion**, encoding the twist of non-orientability; it counts no holes, yet it is genuine topological information.

**Relation to the fundamental group**: $H_1$ is the **abelianization** of $\pi_1$, i.e. $H_1(X)\cong\pi_1(X)/[\pi_1(X),\pi_1(X)]$. Intuitively, going $m$ times around one loop and then $n$ times around another differs from the reversed order inside $\pi_1$, but homology flattens the order and remembers only total winding. So homology is a **weaker but tamer** invariant than the fundamental group: what is gained is that homology groups are abelian, obey a structure theorem, and come with computational tools (Mayer–Vietoris, the long exact sequence of a pair, excision). For the Klein bottle $\pi_1$ is non-abelian and delicate, whereas $H_1$ is simply $\mathbb Z\oplus\mathbb Z_2$.

Any model may be used for computation: for a finite simplicial complex, the boundary matrices (Smith normal form); for a CW complex, the **cellular chain complex** (the $n$-th chain group is free and $\partial$ is given by degrees of attaching maps); in general, singular homology. Homotopy equivalent models always give the same answer. Standard properties: **additivity** $H_n(X\sqcup Y)\cong H_n(X)\oplus H_n(Y)$; the long exact sequence of a good pair, $\cdots\to H_n(A)\to H_n(X)\to H_n(X,A)\to H_{n-1}(A)\to\cdots$; the free rank (Betti number) is coefficient-independent, while **torsion varies with the coefficient ring**.

formulas.note: 通用定义：闭链模边界链。任何模型（单纯、奇异、胞腔）算出的结果都同构。
formulas.noteEn: The general definition: cycles modulo boundaries. Every model (simplicial, singular, cellular) yields isomorphic groups.

formulas.latex: H_0(X)\cong\mathbb Z^{\,c},\qquad c=\#\{\text{道路连通分支}\}
formulas.note: $H_0$ 的自由秩正好是道路连通分支个数；空间连通时 $H_0=\mathbb Z$。
formulas.noteEn: The free rank of $H_0$ equals the number of path components; for a connected space $H_0=\mathbb Z$.

formulas.note: $H_1$ 是基本群的阿贝尔化：丢掉「顺序」信息，只保留总圈数。
formulas.noteEn: $H_1$ is the abelianization of the fundamental group (for **path-connected** $X$, any base point): order information is discarded, total winding retained.

formulas.latex: H_i(S^n)=\mathbb Z\ (n\ge1,\ i=0,n),\ \text{其余为 }0;\qquad \bigl(H_0,H_1,H_2\bigr)(T^2)=\bigl(\mathbb Z,\mathbb Z^2,\mathbb Z\bigr)
formulas.note: 球面：只有一个连通分支、一个 $n$ 维空腔；环面：连通、两条独立的一维环、一个二维空腔。
formulas.noteEn: Sphere: one component and one $n$-dimensional cavity; torus: connected, two independent loops, one two-dimensional cavity.

formulas.note: 挠元的经典例子：$H_1$ 是 2 阶循环群，自由秩为 0，因此对欧拉示性数没有贡献（$\chi=1-0+0=1$）。
formulas.noteEn: The classical torsion example: $H_1$ is cyclic of order 2 with free rank 0, so it contributes nothing to the Euler characteristic ($\chi=1-0+0=1$).

properties: 同伦不变量：同伦等价的空间同调群同构（同胚自然同构）；且有可加性 $H_n(X\sqcup Y)\cong H_n(X)\oplus H_n(Y)$，以及 $H_n=0$ 当 $n>\dim X$。
$H_0(X)\cong\mathbb Z^{c}$（$c$ 为道路连通分支数），连通空间 $H_0=\mathbb Z$；$H_0$ 永远是自由群，不含挠元。
$H_1\cong\pi_1/[\pi_1,\pi_1]$：$\pi_1$ 交换时（如 $T^2$，$\pi_1=\mathbb Z^2$）两者一致；$\pi_1$ 非交换（亏格 $\ge2$ 曲面、克莱因瓶）时同调严格更小、更易算。$H_1$ 的洞解释是「绕不过去的独立环」，$H_2$ 度量二维空腔。
挠元只有整数系数下才看得见：$\mathbb Q$ 或 $\mathbb R$ 系数时 $H_n(X;\mathbb F)$ 是向量空间、维数等于 Betti 数 $b_n$，并且 $\chi=\sum_n(-1)^nb_n$；例如 $H_1(\mathrm{RP}^2;\mathbb Z)=\mathbb Z_2$ 而 $H_1(\mathrm{RP}^2;\mathbb Q)=0$。

四个必背例子：$S^1$：$(\mathbb Z,\mathbb Z)$；$S^n\ (n\ge1)$：$H_0=H_n=\mathbb Z$、其余 $0$；$T^2$：$(\mathbb Z,\mathbb Z^2,\mathbb Z)$；$\mathrm{RP}^2$：$(\mathbb Z,\mathbb Z_2,0)$。用 $\chi=\sum(-1)^n\operatorname{rank}H_n$ 校验 $\mathrm{RP}^2$：$1-0+0=1=\chi(\mathrm{RP}^2)$。
propertiesEn: A homotopy invariant: homotopy equivalent spaces have isomorphic homology (homeomorphic spaces certainly do); it is additive, $H_n(X\sqcup Y)\cong H_n(X)\oplus H_n(Y)$, and $H_n=0$ for $n>\dim X$.
$H_0(X)\cong\mathbb Z^{c}$ with $c$ the number of path components, so $H_0=\mathbb Z$ for connected spaces; $H_0$ is always free, with no torsion.

$H_1\cong\pi_1/[\pi_1,\pi_1]$: when $\pi_1$ is abelian (e.g. $T^2$ with $\pi_1=\mathbb Z^2$) the two coincide; when $\pi_1$ is non-abelian (surfaces of genus $\ge2$, the Klein bottle) homology is strictly smaller and easier. $H_1$ counts independent loops, $H_2$ measures two-dimensional cavities.

Torsion is visible only with integer coefficients: over $\mathbb Q$ or $\mathbb R$, $H_n(X;\mathbb F)$ is a vector space of dimension the Betti number $b_n$ and $\chi=\sum_n(-1)^nb_n$; for instance $H_1(\mathrm{RP}^2;\mathbb Z)=\mathbb Z_2$ while $H_1(\mathrm{RP}^2;\mathbb Q)=0$.

Four examples to remember: $S^1$: $(\mathbb Z,\mathbb Z)$; $S^n\ (n\ge1)$: $H_0=H_n=\mathbb Z$ and the rest $0$; $T^2$: $(\mathbb Z,\mathbb Z^2,\mathbb Z)$; $\mathrm{RP}^2$: $(\mathbb Z,\mathbb Z_2,0)$. Check via $\chi=\sum(-1)^n\operatorname{rank}H_n$ for $\mathrm{RP}^2$: $1-0+0=1=\chi(\mathrm{RP}^2)$.

examples.problem: 用胞腔链复形计算环面 $T^2$ 的同调群。$T^2$ 有胞腔结构：1 个 0-胞腔 $v$、2 个 1-胞腔 $a,b$、1 个 2-胞腔 $f$（正方形对边粘合），$a,b$ 都是 $v$ 上的闭路，$f$ 的边界绕 $a$ 一圈、$b$ 一圈、$a$ 反向、$b$ 反向。
examples.solution:
胞腔链复形为 $0\to C_2=\mathbb Z\langle f\rangle\xrightarrow{\partial_2}C_1=\mathbb Z\langle a,b\rangle\xrightarrow{\partial_1}C_0=\mathbb Z\langle v\rangle\to0$。
$\partial_1a=v-v=0$，$\partial_1b=0$；$\partial_2f=a+b-a-b=0$。
于是 $H_0=\mathbb Z/\operatorname{im}\partial_1=\mathbb Z$（连通，$c=1$ ✓）；$H_1=\ker\partial_1/\operatorname{im}\partial_2=\mathbb Z^2/0=\mathbb Z^2$（两条独立的环 $[a],[b]$）；$H_2=\ker\partial_2=\mathbb Z$（整个环面的基本类），$n\ge3$ 时 $H_n=0$。
校验：$\chi=1-2+1=0=\chi(T^2)$ ✓；$\pi_1(T^2)=\mathbb Z^2$ 本来就交换，故 $H_1=\pi_1$ 与「$H_1$ 是 $\pi_1$ 的阿贝尔化」一致 ✓。

examples.problem: 用胞腔链复形计算实射影平面 $\mathrm{RP}^2$ 的同调群，并说明其 $H_1$ 的挠元为什么不影响欧拉示性数。$\mathrm{RP}^2$ 的胞腔结构与粘合度数为：1 个 0-胞腔 $v$、1 个 1-胞腔 $a$（$v$ 上的环路）、1 个 2-胞腔 $e^2$ 沿 $a$ 走**两圈**贴上（粘合映射 $z\mapsto z^2$，度数 2）。
examples.solution:
胞腔链复形：$\partial_1a=v-v=0$，$\partial_2e^2=2a$，即
$0\to\mathbb Z\xrightarrow{\ \times2\ }\mathbb Z\xrightarrow{\ 0\ }\mathbb Z\to0$。
$H_0=\mathbb Z/\operatorname{im}\partial_1=\mathbb Z$ ✓（连通）；$H_1=\ker\partial_1/\operatorname{im}\partial_2=\mathbb Z/2\mathbb Z=\mathbb Z_2$——**挠元**；$H_2=\ker\partial_2=0$（$\times2$ 是单射，没有 2-闭链）。
所以 $H_*=(\mathbb Z,\mathbb Z_2,0)$。欧拉示性数只用**自由秩**：$\chi=\operatorname{rank}H_0-\operatorname{rank}H_1+\operatorname{rank}H_2=1-0+0=1$，与 $\chi(\mathrm{RP}^2)=1$ 相符；$\mathbb Z_2$ 的秩为 0，所以在 $\chi$ 里完全看不见（这也说明 $\chi$ 无法区分挠元）。另外 $\pi_1(\mathrm{RP}^2)=\mathbb Z_2$ 已是阿贝尔群，故 $H_1=\pi_1$ ✓。

expression.text: H₀ ≅ ℤ^c（c 为道路连通分支数）；H₁ ≅ π₁ / [π₁, π₁]
expression.note: 同调群是同伦不变量：H₀ 数分支、H₁ 数一维环、H₂ 数二维空腔，挠元只有整数系数才看得见。
expression.noteEn: Homology is a homotopy invariant: H₀ counts components, H₁ loops, H₂ cavities, and torsion is visible only with integer coefficients.

nodes.title: 欧拉示性数
nodes.summary: 把各维单形个数带交错符号相加得到的数 $\chi=V-E+F-\cdots$：它是同伦不变量，等于 Betti 数的交错和，并且是闭曲面分类的数值标尺（$\chi(S^2)=2$、$\chi(T^2)=0$、$\chi(\mathrm{RP}^2)=1$）。
nodes.summaryEn: The alternating sum of the numbers of simplices, $\chi=V-E+F-\cdots$: a homotopy invariant equal to the alternating sum of Betti numbers, and the numerical ruler of surface classification ($\chi(S^2)=2$, $\chi(T^2)=0$, $\chi(\mathrm{RP}^2)=1$).
nodes.definition:
**欧拉示性数**是最好用的拓扑不变量。若复形 $\mathcal K$ 有 $f_n$ 个 $n$ 维单形（$f_0=V$ 顶点、$f_1=E$ 棱、$f_2=F$ 面……），定义 $\chi(\mathcal K)=\sum_{n\ge0}(-1)^nf_n=V-E+F-\cdots$。对曲面只有三种单形，于是 $\chi=V-E+F$。欧拉最早发现任何凸多面体都满足 $V-E+F=2$；这不是巧合——多面体的表面作为曲面就是球面，$V-E+F$ 正是 $\chi(S^2)=2$。

$\chi$ 为什么与剖分无关？把它改用同调（Betti 数）写出来最清楚：$\chi=\sum_n(-1)^n\operatorname{rank}H_n=\sum_n(-1)^nb_n$（**Euler–Poincaré 公式**），右端只含各维同调群的自由秩。因此 $\chi$ 是先天的**拓扑不变量**，更是**同伦不变量**：圆盘与点同伦，$\chi=1$；实心圆环与圆周同伦，$\chi=0$；任意两个三角剖分给出的 $\chi$ 必然相同。注意挠元完全不参与：$\mathrm{RP}^2$ 的 $H_1=\mathbb Z_2$ 秩为 0，所以 $\chi$ 对它「视而不见」。

曲面上的数值表：$\chi(S^2)=2$，环面 $\chi(T^2)=0$，$\chi(\mathrm{RP}^2)=1$，克莱因瓶 $\chi=0$，莫比乌斯带 $\chi=0$。与亏格的关系：闭**可定向**曲面（球面加 $g$ 个柄）满足 $\chi=2-2g$（球面 $g=0$ 给 2，环面 $g=1$ 给 0，双环面 $g=2$ 给 $-2$，总为偶数）；闭**不可定向**曲面（$k$ 个交叉帽，$\mathrm{RP}^2$ 是 $k=1$）满足 $\chi=2-k$（$\mathrm{RP}^2$ 给 1，克莱因瓶 $k=2$ 给 0，可奇可偶）。要小心：$\chi$ 单独不能定出曲面——环面与克莱因瓶 $\chi$ 都是 0，却不同胚，必须补上可定向性（这正是曲面分类定理的判据）。

$\chi$ 的运算性质同样好用：连通和满足 $\chi(M\#N)=\chi(M)+\chi(N)-2$（各挖去一个开圆盘，$\chi$ 各减 1）；乘积满足 $\chi(X\times Y)=\chi(X)\cdot\chi(Y)$，于是环面 $T^2=S^1\times S^1$ 立刻有 $\chi=0\cdot0=0$。最漂亮的一条是 **Gauss–Bonnet 定理** $\int_MK\,dA=2\pi\chi(M)$：左边的曲率积分是分析量、右边是组合量，两者恒等——$\chi$ 同时站在组合、拓扑与几何三岔路口。
nodes.definitionEn:
The **Euler characteristic** is the friendliest topological invariant. If $\mathcal K$ has $f_n$ simplices of dimension $n$ ($f_0=V$ vertices, $f_1=E$ edges, $f_2=F$ faces), set $\chi(\mathcal K)=\sum_{n\ge0}(-1)^nf_n=V-E+F-\cdots$. For surfaces only three types occur, so $\chi=V-E+F$. Euler discovered that every convex polyhedron satisfies $V-E+F=2$; this is no accident—the surface of such a polyhedron is a sphere and $V-E+F$ computes $\chi(S^2)=2$.

Why is $\chi$ independent of the triangulation? Rewriting it homologically makes it clear: $\chi=\sum_n(-1)^n\operatorname{rank}H_n=\sum_n(-1)^nb_n$ (the **Euler–Poincaré formula**), and the right-hand side involves only free ranks. Hence $\chi$ is a genuine **topological invariant**, and in fact a **homotopy invariant**: the disk is homotopy equivalent to a point with $\chi=1$, a solid annulus to a circle with $\chi=0$, and any two triangulations of a space give the same value. Torsion plays no role: $H_1(\mathrm{RP}^2)=\mathbb Z_2$ has rank 0, so $\chi$ cannot see it.

Values for surfaces: $\chi(S^2)=2$, $\chi(T^2)=0$, $\chi(\mathrm{RP}^2)=1$, $\chi(\text{Klein bottle})=0$, $\chi(\text{Möbius band})=0$. Relation to genus: a closed **orientable** surface (sphere plus $g$ handles) has $\chi=2-2g$ (sphere $g=0$ gives 2, torus $g=1$ gives 0, double torus $g=2$ gives $-2$; always even), while a closed **non-orientable** surface ($k$ crosscaps, with $\mathrm{RP}^2$ the case $k=1$) has $\chi=2-k$ ($\mathrm{RP}^2$ gives 1, the Klein bottle $k=2$ gives 0; parity varies). Careful: $\chi$ alone does not determine a surface—the torus and the Klein bottle both have $\chi=0$ yet are not homeomorphic, so orientability must be added (this is exactly the criterion in the classification theorem).

$\chi$ also behaves well under operations: connected sums satisfy $\chi(M\#N)=\chi(M)+\chi(N)-2$ (two open disks are removed, each lowering $\chi$ by 1), products satisfy $\chi(X\times Y)=\chi(X)\cdot\chi(Y)$, giving $\chi(T^2)=\chi(S^1)^2=0$ instantly. Most beautiful is the **Gauss–Bonnet theorem** $\int_MK\,dA=2\pi\chi(M)$: the curvature integral on the left is analysis, the right-hand side is combinatorics, and they agree—$\chi$ sits at the crossroads of combinatorics, topology and geometry.

formulas.note: 定义：各维单形个数带交错符号求和；曲面上就是「顶点 − 棱 + 面」。
formulas.noteEn: Definition: alternating sum of the numbers of simplices; on a surface it is vertices − edges + faces.

formulas.note: Euler–Poincaré 公式：$\chi$ 只由同调群的自由秩（Betti 数）决定，故与剖分无关、看不见挠元。
formulas.noteEn: The Euler–Poincaré formula: $\chi$ depends only on free ranks (Betti numbers), hence is triangulation-independent and blind to torsion.

formulas.note: 曲面标准值；配合可定向性即可定出曲面的同胚类（环面与克莱因瓶同为 0，靠可定向性区分）。
formulas.noteEn: Standard surface values; together with orientability they pin down the homeomorphism type (torus and Klein bottle share 0 and are told apart by orientability).

formulas.latex: \chi=2-2g\ (\text{闭可定向曲面，亏格 }g);\qquad \chi=2-k\ (\text{闭不可定向曲面，}k\text{ 个交叉帽})
formulas.note: 亏格与交叉帽数：$\mathrm{RP}^2$ 是 $k=1$ 给 $\chi=1$；球面 $g=0$ 给 $\chi=2$，逆用可解出 $g=(2-\chi)/2$。
formulas.noteEn: Genus versus crosscaps: $\mathrm{RP}^2$ is $k=1$ giving $\chi=1$; the sphere is $g=0$ giving $\chi=2$; conversely $g=(2-\chi)/2$.

formulas.note: 连通和、乘积与 Gauss–Bonnet：前两条把未知曲面化到已知曲面，第三条把曲率积分与组合量锁在一起。
formulas.noteEn: Connected sum, products and Gauss–Bonnet: the first two reduce new surfaces to known ones, the third ties curvature integrals to a combinatorial quantity.

properties: 拓扑（更强：同伦）不变量：由 Euler–Poincaré 公式 $\chi=\sum(-1)^nb_n$ 知它与剖分无关，同伦等价的空间 $\chi$ 相同；反过来 $\chi$ 相同不代表同胚。
只看得见自由部分：$H_n$ 的挠元对 $\chi$ 没有贡献。$\mathrm{RP}^2$ 的 $H_1=\mathbb Z_2$ 秩为 0，故 $\chi(\mathrm{RP}^2)=1-0+0=1$，与「用 $V-E+F$ 算出的 1」一致。
连通和与乘积：$\chi(M\#N)=\chi(M)+\chi(N)-2$，$\chi(X\times Y)=\chi(X)\chi(Y)$；由此 $\chi(T^2)=\chi(S^1)^2=0$、$\chi(T^2\#T^2)=-2$。
与曲面分类配合：闭可定向曲面的 $\chi=2-2g$ 必为偶数，闭不可定向曲面的 $\chi=2-k$ 可奇可偶；特别地闭曲面若 $\chi=2$ 必为球面，若 $\chi=1$ 必为 $\mathrm{RP}^2$。
Gauss–Bonnet：$\int_MK\,dA=2\pi\chi(M)$。例如半径 $r$ 的球面 $K=1/r^2$、面积 $4\pi r^2$，故 $\int K\,dA=4\pi=2\pi\chi(S^2)$ ✓，说明 $\chi$ 也是曲率的整体积分的组合化身。
propertiesEn: A topological (in fact homotopy) invariant: by the Euler–Poincaré formula $\chi=\sum(-1)^nb_n$ it does not depend on the triangulation, and homotopy equivalent spaces share $\chi$; conversely, equal $\chi$ does not imply homeomorphic.
It sees only the free part: torsion in $H_n$ contributes nothing. Since $H_1(\mathrm{RP}^2)=\mathbb Z_2$ has rank 0, $\chi(\mathrm{RP}^2)=1-0+0=1$, matching $V-E+F=1$.
Connected sums and products: $\chi(M\#N)=\chi(M)+\chi(N)-2$ and $\chi(X\times Y)=\chi(X)\chi(Y)$; hence $\chi(T^2)=\chi(S^1)^2=0$ and $\chi(T^2\#T^2)=-2$.

Combined with classification: a closed orientable surface has even $\chi=2-2g$, a closed non-orientable one has $\chi=2-k$ of any parity; in particular $\chi=2$ forces the sphere and $\chi=1$ forces $\mathrm{RP}^2$.

Gauss–Bonnet: $\int_MK\,dA=2\pi\chi(M)$. For a sphere of radius $r$, $K=1/r^2$ and area $4\pi r^2$, so $\int K\,dA=4\pi=2\pi\chi(S^2)$, showing $\chi$ is also the combinatorial face of total curvature.

plot.title: 四面体表面：4 个顶点、6 条棱、4 个三角形面，χ = 2（球面）

examples.problem: 对四面体的表面和立方体的表面分别计算 $\chi=V-E+F$，并解释为什么结果相同；再用 Gauss–Bonnet 验证球面的结果。
examples.solution:
四面体表面：$V=4$，$E=6$，$F=4$，$\chi=4-6+4=2$。立方体表面：$V=8$，$E=12$，$F=6$，$\chi=8-12+6=2$。两次都得 2 是因为两张表面都同胚于球面 $S^2$，而 $\chi$ 是拓扑不变量（与具体剖分无关）——这正是欧拉公式 $V-E+F=2$ 对一切凸多面体成立的原因。
Gauss–Bonnet 验证：取半径 $r$ 的球面，$K=1/r^2$，$\int_{S^2}K\,dA=\frac{1}{r^2}\cdot4\pi r^2=4\pi=2\pi\cdot2=2\pi\chi(S^2)$ ✓。

examples.problem: 某闭曲面的三角剖分有 $f=(f_0,f_1,f_2)=(7,21,14)$。(1) 求 $\chi$；(2) 若它是可定向曲面，求亏格并说出曲面类型；(3) 若它是不可定向曲面，$k$ 是多少？（先判断这种情形是否可能）(4) 再计算 $T^2\#T^2$ 的 $\chi$ 与亏格。
examples.solution:
(1) $\chi=7-21+14=0$。
(2) 可定向：$2-2g=0\Rightarrow g=1$，即环面 $T^2$——(7,21,14) 正是环面著名的 7 顶点最小三角剖分的 $f$ 向量。
(3) 不存在这种情形：克莱因瓶的单纯三角剖分至少需要 8 个顶点（Franklin 定理），而 7 个顶点、$\chi=0$ 的闭曲面只能是环面——所以该曲面必为环面，不能是不可定向曲面。（这同时说明：要凭 $f$ 向量区分环面与克莱因瓶，至少需要 8 个顶点。）
(4) $\chi(T^2\#T^2)=\chi(T^2)+\chi(T^2)-2=0+0-2=-2$；可定向曲面 $\chi=2-2g\Rightarrow g=(2-(-2))/2=2$，即亏格 2 的双环面。

expression.text: χ = V − E + F − ⋯ = Σ (−1)ⁿ bₙ     （曲面：χ = V − E + F）
expression.note: 组合定义与同调定义等价（Euler–Poincaré），同伦不变量；闭可定向曲面 χ = 2 − 2g，不可定向 χ = 2 − k。
expression.noteEn: The combinatorial and homological definitions agree (Euler–Poincaré) and give a homotopy invariant; χ = 2 − 2g orientable, χ = 2 − k non-orientable.

nodes.title: 曲面的分类
nodes.summary: 闭曲面的同胚类只有三种：球面、$n$ 个环面的连通和、$m$ 个射影平面的连通和；判定两张闭曲面是否同胚，只需比较可定向性与欧拉示性数。
nodes.summaryEn: Closed surfaces fall into exactly three homeomorphism types: the sphere, connected sums of $n$ tori, and connected sums of $m$ projective planes; two closed surfaces are homeomorphic iff they share orientability and Euler characteristic.
nodes.definition:
**曲面**是每点局部同胚于平面的空间（二维流形）；**闭曲面**指紧致、连通、无边界。人们早就发现曲面可以按「有几个柄、几个洞」分类，结论干净得惊人：**曲面分类定理**——每个闭曲面同胚于下列三类之一：
① 球面 $S^2$；
② $n$ 个环面的**连通和** $T^2\#T^2\#\cdots\#T^2$（$n\ge1$）：可定向曲面，**亏格**为 $n$（球面加 $n$ 个「柄」，也叫 $n$ 柄曲面）；
③ $m$ 个射影平面的连通和 $\mathrm{RP}^2\#\cdots\#\mathrm{RP}^2$（$m\ge1$）：不可定向曲面，$m$ 叫**交叉帽数**。
三类互不同胚，而且每个闭曲面都落在且只落在一类里。

**连通和** $M\#N$ 的做法：在 $M$ 与 $N$ 中各挖掉一个开圆盘（各留下一条边界圆），再沿这两条边界圆粘起来。对闭曲面有 $\chi(M\#N)=\chi(M)+\chi(N)-2$，于是（环面参数）与（交叉帽参数）都能从 $\chi$ 反解：可定向时 $g=\dfrac{2-\chi}{2}$，不可定向时 $k=2-\chi$。判定定理因此变得极其简单：**两个闭曲面同胚 $\Longleftrightarrow$ 可定向性相同且 $\chi$ 相同**。例子：环面与克莱因瓶 $\chi$ 都是 0，但前者可定向、后者不可定向，所以不同胚；$\mathrm{RP}^2$ 与球面 $\chi$ 分别为 1 与 2，也立刻区分开。

**可定向性**指能在曲面上整体一致地选好「正面」，等价地：某个（因而一切）三角剖分上的三角形可以定向，使每条公共边在两侧三角形中方向相反；做不到的曲面叫不可定向，$\mathrm{RP}^2$、克莱因瓶、莫比乌斯带是典型例子。几何上：可定向曲面用「加柄」描述（球面加 $g$ 个柄，$g=1$ 是环面，$g=2$ 是双环面），不可定向曲面用「交叉帽」描述（$\mathrm{RP}^2$ 是 $k=1$，克莱因瓶 $k=2$）。还有一条反直觉的恒等式：$T^2\#\mathrm{RP}^2\cong\mathrm{RP}^2\#\mathrm{RP}^2\#\mathrm{RP}^2$（左端 $\chi=0+1-2=-1$ 且不可定向，故 $k=3$）——连通和挤在一起时柄会被「吞掉」，所以它不像数字加法那样满足消去律。

分类定理的证明走「三角剖分 + 组合化简」路线：**Radó 定理**保证每个紧曲面都能三角剖分，于是曲面化为有限复形；再把任意剖分通过一系列贴边、翻边、切开的操作化简成标准形（球面，或 $2n$ 边形的柄形式，或 $m$ 边形的交叉帽形式），标准化后按亏格与交叉帽数互不相同。同调与基本群随之给出：可定向的亏格 $g$ 曲面有 $H_0=\mathbb Z$、$H_1\cong\mathbb Z^{2g}$、$H_2=\mathbb Z$，而不可定向的 $N_k$ 有 $H_1\cong\mathbb Z^{k-1}\oplus\mathbb Z_2$——例如 $\mathrm{RP}^2$（$k=1$）的 $H_1=\mathbb Z_2$ 正是不可定向性留下的代数痕迹。（带边曲面多一个参数：紧连通带边曲面由可定向性、$\chi$ 与边界分支数 $b$ 决定。）顺便一提，这种「一个维数一种完整分类」只在二维发生：维数 $\ge4$ 的流形的同胚问题不可判定（Markov 定理），三维虽可判定但极其复杂。
nodes.definitionEn:
A **surface** is a space locally homeomorphic to the plane (a two-dimensional manifold); a **closed surface** is compact, connected and without boundary. Surfaces were long known to be classified by their number of handles or holes, and the conclusion is strikingly clean: the **classification theorem for surfaces**—every closed surface is homeomorphic to exactly one of:
(1) the sphere $S^2$;
(2) a **connected sum** of $n$ tori $T^2\#\cdots\#T^2$ ($n\ge1$): orientable, of **genus** $n$ (a sphere with $n$ handles);
(3) a connected sum of $m$ projective planes $\mathrm{RP}^2\#\cdots\#\mathrm{RP}^2$ ($m\ge1$): non-orientable, with $m$ **crosscaps**.

The **connected sum** $M\#N$ is formed by removing an open disk from each surface (leaving a boundary circle) and gluing along the two circles. For closed surfaces $\chi(M\#N)=\chi(M)+\chi(N)-2$, so the invariants can be read back: $g=\dfrac{2-\chi}{2}$ in the orientable case and $k=2-\chi$ in the non-orientable case. Hence the criterion is simply: **two closed surfaces are homeomorphic $\Longleftrightarrow$ they have the same orientability and the same $\chi$**. For example the torus and the Klein bottle share $\chi=0$ but differ in orientability, so they are not homeomorphic; $\mathrm{RP}^2$ and the sphere are separated by $\chi=1$ versus $2$.

**Orientability** means one can choose a consistent "front side" globally; equivalently, the triangles of some (hence every) triangulation can be oriented so that each shared edge is traversed in opposite directions by the two adjacent triangles. Surfaces where this fails are non-orientable; $\mathrm{RP}^2$, the Klein bottle and the Möbius band are the standard examples. Geometrically, orientable surfaces are described by adding handles (the sphere plus $g$ handles: $g=1$ is the torus, $g=2$ the double torus), non-orientable ones by crosscaps ($\mathrm{RP}^2$ is $k=1$, the Klein bottle $k=2$). One counterintuitive identity: $T^2\#\mathrm{RP}^2\cong\mathrm{RP}^2\#\mathrm{RP}^2\#\mathrm{RP}^2$ (the left side has $\chi=0+1-2=-1$ and is non-orientable, so $k=3$)—handles can be swallowed, so connected sum obeys no cancellation law.

The proof proceeds by "triangulate, then simplify combinatorially": **Radó's theorem** provides a triangulation of every compact surface, turning it into a finite complex; then gluing/flipping/splitting moves reduce any triangulation to a standard form (a sphere, a handlebody form on a $2n$-gon, or a crosscap form on an $m$-gon), and the standardized forms are distinguished by genus or crosscap number. Homology and the fundamental group follow: an orientable surface of genus $g$ has $H_0=\mathbb Z$, $H_1\cong\mathbb Z^{2g}$ and $H_2=\mathbb Z$, while the non-orientable $N_k$ has $H_1\cong\mathbb Z^{k-1}\oplus\mathbb Z_2$—for $\mathrm{RP}^2$ ($k=1$) this is $\mathbb Z_2$, the algebraic trace of non-orientability. (For surfaces with boundary one more parameter is needed: orientability, $\chi$ and the number $b$ of boundary components determine the type.) Incidentally, such a complete classification exists only in dimension two: for manifolds of dimension $\ge4$ the homeomorphism problem is undecidable (Markov's theorem), and dimension three, while decidable, is extremely intricate.

formulas.note: 曲面分类定理：每个闭曲面恰同胚于三类标准形之一（可定向亏格 $n$、不可定向交叉帽数 $m$、球面）。
formulas.noteEn: The classification theorem: every closed surface is homeomorphic to exactly one of these standard models (orientable genus $n$, non-orientable with $m$ crosscaps, or the sphere).

formulas.note: 判定定理：闭曲面只由「可定向性 + 欧拉示性数」两个数据决定，其余（亏格、交叉帽数、基本群）都能算出来。
formulas.noteEn: The criterion: two closed surfaces are homeomorphic iff orientability and Euler characteristic agree; genus, crosscap number and the fundamental group then follow.

formulas.latex: \chi=2-2g\ (\text{可定向，亏格 }g);\qquad \chi=2-k\ (\text{不可定向，}k\text{ 个交叉帽})
formulas.note: 两类标准形的参数与 $\chi$ 一一对应：$g=\frac{2-\chi}{2}$，$k=2-\chi$。
formulas.noteEn: Parameters of the two standard families correspond bijectively to $\chi$: $g=\frac{2-\chi}{2}$ and $k=2-\chi$.

formulas.note: 连通和的 $\chi$ 公式，以及「柄会被吞掉」的恒等式（左端 $\chi=-1$、不可定向，故 $k=3$），说明连通和不满足消去律。
formulas.noteEn: The $\chi$ formula for connected sums, plus the identity showing handles can be swallowed (left side has $\chi=-1$ and is non-orientable, so $k=3$): connected sum admits no cancellation.
