nodes.title: 空间向量与空间角
nodes.summary: 用方向向量与法向量求异面直线所成角、线面角、二面角以及点面距离。
nodes.summaryEn: Using direction and normal vectors to find angles between lines, line-plane angles, dihedral angles and point-to-plane distances.
nodes.definition:
有了空间向量，空间角问题可以统一用坐标计算。做法是三步：建系（选三条两两互相垂直的直线作坐标轴）、写坐标（写出关键点的坐标，得到直线的方向向量）、用公式（直接代角公式，或先求平面的**法向量**再代）。

三类角要分清。异面直线所成角（线线角）$\theta\in[0^{\circ},90^{\circ}]$，$\cos\theta=\frac{|\vec{a}\cdot\vec{b}|}{|\vec{a}||\vec{b}|}$，分子加绝对值保证余弦非负。直线与平面所成角（线面角）用**正弦**：$\sin\theta=\frac{|\vec{a}\cdot\vec{n}|}{|\vec{a}||\vec{n}|}$，其中 $\vec{a}$ 是直线的方向向量、$\vec{n}$ 是平面的法向量——写成余弦是最常见的错误之一；线面角的范围也是 $[0^{\circ},90^{\circ}]$。二面角 $\theta\in[0^{\circ},180^{\circ}]$，用两个半平面的法向量 $\vec{n}_1$、$\vec{n}_2$ 计算时，$\theta$ 与 $\langle\vec{n}_1,\vec{n}_2\rangle$ **可能相等也可能互补**，必须结合图形判断；点面距 $d=\frac{|\overrightarrow{AP}\cdot\vec{n}|}{|\vec{n}|}$ 用的也是法向量。

求平面法向量的标准流程：设 $\vec{n}=(x,y,z)$，在平面内找两个不共线的向量 $\vec{a}$、$\vec{b}$，解方程组 $\vec{n}\cdot\vec{a}=0$、$\vec{n}\cdot\vec{b}=0$，取一组非零解即可。
nodes.definitionEn:
With space vectors, every angle problem becomes a coordinate computation in three steps: set up axes (choose three mutually perpendicular lines), write coordinates (of the key points, giving direction vectors), and apply formulas (directly, or after finding a **normal vector** of the relevant plane).

Distinguish the three kinds of angles. For two lines (including skew lines) the angle $\theta\in[0^{\circ},90^{\circ}]$ satisfies $\cos\theta=\frac{|\vec{a}\cdot\vec{b}|}{|\vec{a}||\vec{b}|}$, the absolute value keeping the cosine non-negative. The angle between a line and a plane uses the **sine**: $\sin\theta=\frac{|\vec{a}\cdot\vec{n}|}{|\vec{a}||\vec{n}|}$, where $\vec{a}$ is the line's direction vector and $\vec{n}$ a normal vector of the plane — writing a cosine here is one of the most common mistakes; this angle also lies in $[0^{\circ},90^{\circ}]$. A dihedral angle lies in $[0^{\circ},180^{\circ}]$: computed from the normals $\vec{n}_1,\vec{n}_2$ of the two half-planes, it may **equal or supplement** $\langle\vec{n}_1,\vec{n}_2\rangle$, so judge from the figure. The point-to-plane distance $d=\frac{|\overrightarrow{AP}\cdot\vec{n}|}{|\vec{n}|}$ also uses a normal vector.

The standard recipe for a normal vector: write $\vec{n}=(x,y,z)$, take two non-collinear vectors $\vec{a},\vec{b}$ in the plane, solve $\vec{n}\cdot\vec{a}=0$ and $\vec{n}\cdot\vec{b}=0$, and keep any nonzero solution.

formulas.note: 线线角（含异面直线所成角）：a、b 是两条直线的方向向量，θ 的范围是 0° 到 90°，绝对值保证余弦非负。
formulas.noteEn: Angle between two lines: a, b are direction vectors; θ lies in [0°, 90°] and the absolute value keeps the cosine non-negative.

formulas.note: 线面角：a 是直线的方向向量，n 是平面的法向量；方向向量与法向量夹角的余角才是线面角，所以用正弦，θ 的范围是 0° 到 90°。
formulas.noteEn: Line-plane angle: a is the line's direction vector and n a normal of the plane; the sine appears because this angle complements the angle between a and n. θ lies in [0°, 90°].

formulas.note: 二面角：n₁、n₂ 是两半平面的法向量；二面角与两个法向量的夹角相等或互补，须结合图形判断，二面角范围是 0° 到 180°。
formulas.noteEn: Dihedral angle: n₁, n₂ are normals to the two half-planes; the angle equals or supplements the angle between the normals — decide from the figure. Range: [0°, 180°].

formulas.note: 点面距离：A 是平面内任意一点，P 是平面外一点，n 是平面的法向量。
formulas.noteEn: Point-to-plane distance: A any point in the plane, P a point outside it, n a normal vector of the plane.

formulas.note: 求平面法向量的方法：在平面内取两个不共线的向量 a、b，设 n=(x,y,z)，列方程组后取一组非零解。
formulas.noteEn: Finding a normal vector: take two non-collinear vectors a, b in the plane, set n=(x,y,z), solve the two equations and keep a nonzero solution.

properties: 线线角的范围是 0° 到 90°；公式中加绝对值正是为了保证余弦非负，无需再讨论方向向量的夹角是锐角还是钝角。
线面角的范围是 0° 到 90°；方向向量与法向量夹角的余角才是线面角，这就是公式用正弦而不是余弦的原因。
二面角的范围是 0° 到 180°；由两个法向量算出的夹角与二面角可能相等也可能互补，必须结合原图判断，图上是钝角时余弦取负。
点面距公式中，平面内任取一点作 A 都不影响结果，实际计算时常选坐标最简单的点。
程序化的解题流程：建系 → 写出关键点坐标 → 求方向向量与法向量 → 代入对应公式。
propertiesEn: The angle between two lines lies in [0°, 90°]; the absolute value in the formula keeps the cosine non-negative, so no case discussion is needed.
The line-plane angle lies in [0°, 90°]; it is the complement of the angle between the direction vector and the normal, which is why the sine is used.
A dihedral angle lies in [0°, 180°]; the angle between the two normals may equal or supplement it, so judge from the figure and take the negative cosine for an obtuse dihedral angle.
In the point-to-plane distance formula, any point A of the plane may be used; choose the one with the simplest coordinates.
The standard workflow: set up coordinates, write the key points, find direction and normal vectors, then substitute into the formulas.

examples.problem: 在棱长为 1 的正方体 ABCD-A₁B₁C₁D₁ 中，求异面直线 A₁B 与 B₁C 所成角的大小。
examples.solution: 以 A 为原点，AB、AD、AA₁ 所在直线分别为 x、y、z 轴建系，则 A₁(0,0,1)，B(1,0,0)，B₁(1,0,1)，C(1,1,0)。方向向量 A₁B=(1,0,-1)，B₁C=(0,1,-1)。由线线角公式 $\cos\theta=\frac{|\vec{a}\cdot\vec{b}|}{|\vec{a}||\vec{b}|}$ 得 $\cos\theta=\frac{|1\times 0+0\times 1+(-1)\times(-1)|}{\sqrt{2}\times\sqrt{2}}=\frac{1}{2}$，所以所成角为 60°。

examples.problem: 在棱长为 1 的正方体 ABCD-A₁B₁C₁D₁ 中，求直线 A₁B 与平面 BB₁D₁D 所成角的大小。
examples.solution: 建系同上，A₁B 的方向向量 a=(1,0,-1)。平面 BB₁D₁D 内取 BD=(-1,1,0)，BB₁=(0,0,1)。设其法向量为 n=(x,y,z)，由 n·BD=-x+y=0 且 n·BB₁=z=0，取 x=1 得 n=(1,1,0)。由线面角公式 $\sin\theta=\frac{|\vec{a}\cdot\vec{n}|}{|\vec{a}||\vec{n}|}$ 得 $\sin\theta=\frac{|1\times 1+0\times 1+(-1)\times 0|}{\sqrt{2}\times\sqrt{2}}=\frac{1}{2}$，所以所成角为 30°。

nodes.title: 分类加法与分步乘法计数原理
nodes.titleEn: Addition and Multiplication Principles of Counting
nodes.summary: 计数的两条基本法则：能单独完成任务的各类方法相加，必须依次完成的各步方法相乘。
nodes.summaryEn: The two basic rules of counting: add the counts of the mutually exclusive classes that can each finish the task, and multiply the counts of the steps that must all be done in sequence.
nodes.definition:
数东西是数学里最基础的工作。当「一个一个数」行不通时，我们就把一件事拆成能分别计数的小块。**分类加法计数原理**：完成一件事有 $n$ 类不同的方案，第 $i$ 类方案中有 $m_i$ 种方法，并且每一类中的任意一种方法都能**单独**完成这件事，各类方法互不重复、合起来覆盖全部，那么完成这件事的方法总数是 $N=m_1+m_2+\cdots+m_n$。

**分步乘法计数原理**：完成一件事需要依次经过 $n$ 个步骤，第 $i$ 步有 $m_i$ 种方法，必须逐步做完才能完成这件事，那么完成这件事的方法总数是 $N=m_1m_2\cdots m_n$。

两条原理的区别只有一句话：**分类**是「或」的关系——用哪一类中的方法都可以把事情办成，所以方法数**相加**；**分步**是「且」的关系——每一步都必须完成，所以方法数**相乘**。判断该用哪条原理，不是看题目的字面，而是问一句：只用其中一种方法，能不能把这件事办完？

使用加法原理最容易犯的错是「重」和「漏」：分类标准要一致，各类之间不能有重复的方法，合起来又要覆盖全部可能；使用乘法原理时要注意各步的选取确实相互独立，步骤的划分不重不漏。排列数、组合数公式和二项式定理，都是在两条原理之上建立起来的。
nodes.definitionEn:
Counting is one of the most basic activities in mathematics. When counting one by one is impossible, we split a task into pieces whose numbers of choices we can handle separately. **Addition principle**: suppose a task can be done in $n$ classes of mutually exclusive ways, with $m_i$ ways in the $i$-th class, and suppose any single way inside a class finishes the task by itself; then the total number of ways is $N=m_1+m_2+\cdots+m_n$.

**Multiplication principle**: suppose a task must be carried out through $n$ successive steps, with $m_i$ choices at the $i$-th step, and the task is completed only when every step is done; then the total number of ways is $N=m_1m_2\cdots m_n$.

The difference is one word: classification is an "or" — any one class alone can finish the task, so the counts are **added**; a step-by-step process is an "and" — every step is required, so the counts are **multiplied**. To decide which principle applies, ask whether one single method can finish the whole task.

The most common mistakes are double counting or missing cases in classification (classes must be disjoint and exhaustive), and treating steps as independent when the choices at a later step actually depend on earlier choices. The formulas for permutations and combinations and the binomial theorem are all built on these two principles.

formulas.note: 分类加法计数原理：各类方案都能**单独**完成任务，所以把各类的方法数相加。
formulas.noteEn: Addition principle: each class of methods alone finishes the task, so the counts are added.

formulas.note: 分步乘法计数原理：必须依次完成全部 $n$ 步才能完成任务，所以把各步的方法数相乘。
formulas.noteEn: Multiplication principle: all $n$ steps are required in order, so the numbers of choices are multiplied.

formulas.note: 先分类、类内分步：第 $i$ 类中两步分别有 $m_i$、$n_i$ 种方法，类内相乘得 $m_in_i$，类间再相加。例如按首位数字分类讨论「组成多少个数」的问题。
formulas.noteEn: Classify first and count within each class by steps: multiply inside a class, add across classes, as in problems about forming numbers, classified by the leading digit.

formulas.note: 由分步乘法原理：$n$ 元集合的每个元素都有「取」或「不取」$2$ 种选择，故共有 $2^n$ 个子集。
formulas.noteEn: By the multiplication principle: each of the $n$ elements is either chosen or not, so an $n$-element set has $2^n$ subsets.

properties: 分类时各类方法必须**互斥**（不重）且合起来**覆盖全部**（不漏），重复计数或漏计都会让答案出错。
分步时各步相互独立、又必须依次完成；如果某一步的做法取决于前面步骤的具体选择，就应改用分类讨论。
判断用哪条原理的标准是「用一种方法能否单独完成任务」：能独立完成就用分类（相加），必须各步配合才能完成就用分步（相乘）。
两条原理常嵌套使用（先分类、类内分步，或先分步、每步再分类）；遇到有特殊要求的元素或位置（如数字的首位不能为 $0$）先安排它们，往往最省事。
propertiesEn: The classes must be mutually exclusive (no double counting) and exhaustive (nothing left out); either mistake makes the answer wrong.
The steps are independent of one another yet all of them are required; if the choices at one step depend on the choices made earlier, switch to a case-by-case discussion.
Decide by asking whether a single method can finish the task: if it can, classify and add; if the steps must work together, multiply.

The two principles are often nested (classify first and multiply inside each class, or split into steps and classify inside a step); handling restricted elements or positions first, such as a leading digit that cannot be $0$, is usually the shortest route.

examples.problem: 书架上有 $5$ 本不同的语文书、$3$ 本不同的数学书、$2$ 本不同的英语书。(1) 从中任取 $1$ 本，有多少种不同的取法？(2) 从三种书中各取 $1$ 本，有多少种不同的取法？
examples.solution:
(1) 取 $1$ 本书，可以从语文书中取（$5$ 种）、从数学书中取（$3$ 种）或从英语书中取（$2$ 种）。每一类办法都能单独完成「取 $1$ 本书」这件事，且各类方法不重复，用**分类加法计数原理**：$N=5+3+2=10$ 种。
(2) 「三种书各取 $1$ 本」必须三步都完成：第 $1$ 步取语文书 $5$ 种，第 $2$ 步取数学书 $3$ 种，第 $3$ 步取英语书 $2$ 种，用**分步乘法计数原理**：$N=5\times3\times2=30$ 种。

examples.problem: 用数字 $0,1,2,3,4$ 可以组成多少个没有重复数字的三位数？
examples.solution:
分步安排各个数位。第 $1$ 步排百位：百位不能是 $0$，有 $4$ 种选法（$1,2,3,4$）；第 $2$ 步排十位：从剩下的 $4$ 个数字中选（包括 $0$），有 $4$ 种；第 $3$ 步排个位：从剩下的 $3$ 个数字中选，有 $3$ 种。由分步乘法计数原理，共有 $4\times4\times3=48$ 个。
**检验**：不加限制时，从 $5$ 个数字中取 $3$ 个排列有 $A_5^3=60$ 种，其中百位是 $0$ 的情况有 $A_4^2=12$ 种，$60-12=48$，两种算法结果一致，说明「特殊位置优先安排」既简便又不易出错。

nodes.title: 排列与排列数
nodes.summary: 从 $n$ 个不同元素中取出 $m$ 个按一定顺序排成一列，个数为 $A_n^m=\dfrac{n!}{(n-m)!}$。
nodes.summaryEn: Taking $m$ of $n$ distinct objects and arranging them in order gives $A_n^m=\dfrac{n!}{(n-m)!}$ arrangements.
nodes.definition:
从 $n$ 个**不同**元素中取出 $m$（$m\le n$）个元素，按照**一定的顺序**排成一列，叫做从 $n$ 个不同元素中取出 $m$ 个元素的一个**排列**；所有不同排列的个数叫做**排列数**，记作 $A_n^m$（也写作 $A(n,m)$ 或 $P(n,m)$）。当 $m=n$ 时，叫做 $n$ 个元素的一个**全排列**，排列数为 $n!$。

判断一个问题是否与排列有关，只需问一句：**交换所选元素的位置，结果算不算不同？** 算不同就是排列（与顺序有关）。例如「从 $5$ 人中选 $3$ 人分别担任三种不同的职务」是排列，「从 $5$ 人中选 $3$ 人组成一个小组」不是排列（那是组合）。

排列数公式可以用**分步乘法计数原理**推出：排第 $1$ 个位置有 $n$ 种选法，第 $2$ 个位置有 $n-1$ 种选法……第 $m$ 个位置有 $n-m+1$ 种选法，于是 $A_n^m=n(n-1)(n-2)\cdots(n-m+1)=\dfrac{n!}{(n-m)!}$。规定 $0!=1$，于是 $A_n^0=1$，$A_n^n=n!$。

排列数是后续内容的基础：排列问题常可拆成「先选后排」，排列与组合通过 $A_n^m=m!\,C_n^m$ 相互联系；含限制条件的排列则常用「特殊优先」与捆绑、插空两种技巧处理。
nodes.definitionEn:
Taking $m$ objects ($m\le n$) from $n$ **distinct** objects and arranging them in a row in some order is called a **permutation** of $m$ objects chosen from $n$; the number of all such permutations is the **permutation number** $A_n^m$ (also written $A(n,m)$ or $P(n,m)$). When $m=n$ it is a **full permutation** with $n!$ arrangements.

To test whether a problem is about permutations, ask one question: **does swapping the positions of the chosen objects produce a different result?** If yes, order matters and we count permutations. Choosing three people from five to hold three different posts is a permutation problem; merely choosing three people to form a group is not (that is a combination).

The formula follows from the multiplication principle: the first position has $n$ choices, the second $n-1$, and the $m$-th has $n-m+1$, so $A_n^m=n(n-1)\cdots(n-m+1)=\dfrac{n!}{(n-m)!}$. By convention $0!=1$, hence $A_n^0=1$ and $A_n^n=n!$.

Permutation numbers prepare the later material: permutation problems can often be split into "choose then arrange", permutations and combinations are linked by $A_n^m=m!\,C_n^m$, and restricted arrangements are usually handled by giving priority to special elements and by the bundle and gap methods.

formulas.note: 排列数公式的阶乘形式（$m\le n$，规定 $0!=1$）。
formulas.noteEn: The factorial form of the permutation number ($m\le n$, with $0!=1$).

formulas.note: 连乘形式：从 $n$ 开始每次减 $1$ 往下乘，共 $m$ 个因式；由分步乘法计数原理得到。
formulas.noteEn: The product form: start at $n$ and decrease by $1$, with $m$ factors in total; it comes from the multiplication principle.

formulas.note: 全排列公式：$n$ 个不同元素全部取出排成一列，共有 $n!$ 种排法（规定 $0!=1$）。
formulas.noteEn: Full permutations: arranging all $n$ distinct objects in a row can be done in $n!$ ways (with $0!=1$).

formulas.note: 递推关系：按某个指定元素「没有被选中」或「被选中」分类——不选它有 $A_{n-1}^m$ 种，选它则先定位置（$m$ 种）再排其余元素（$A_{n-1}^{m-1}$ 种）。
formulas.noteEn: Recurrence: classify by whether a fixed element is chosen. If not, there are $A_{n-1}^m$ arrangements; if it is, choose its position ($m$ ways) and arrange the others ($A_{n-1}^{m-1}$ ways).

properties: 排列与**顺序**有关：交换排列中两个元素的位置，得到的是不同的排列——这也正是区分排列与组合的检验方法。
当 $m\le n$ 时 $A_n^m$ 一定是正整数，且 $m$ 可取 $0,1,\cdots,n$；其中 $A_n^0=1$，$A_n^n=n!$。
排列数满足递推关系 $A_n^m=A_{n-1}^m+m\,A_{n-1}^{m-1}$ 与 $A_n^m=n\,A_{n-1}^{m-1}$，常用来推导与验证结果。
带限制条件的排列：特殊元素或特殊位置**优先安排**；「相邻」用**捆绑法**（看成一个整体再乘内部排列数），「不相邻」用**插空法**（先排其余元素再插入空位）。
propertiesEn: Order matters: swapping two objects in a permutation gives a different permutation, which is exactly the test that separates permutations from combinations.
For $m\le n$ the number $A_n^m$ is always a positive integer, and $m$ runs over $0,1,\cdots,n$; in particular $A_n^0=1$ and $A_n^n=n!$.
Permutation numbers satisfy the recurrences $A_n^m=A_{n-1}^m+m\,A_{n-1}^{m-1}$ and $A_n^m=n\,A_{n-1}^{m-1}$, which are handy for deriving and checking results.

For restricted arrangements, handle special elements or positions first; use the **bundle method** when objects must be adjacent (treat them as one block and multiply by their internal arrangements) and the **gap method** when they must not be adjacent (place the others first, then insert into the gaps).

examples.problem: 从 $5$ 名同学中选出 $3$ 人分别担任班长、学习委员、生活委员，共有多少种不同的选法？
examples.solution:
三个职务不同，调换两位同学担任的职务会产生不同的安排，所以是**有序**问题，用排列数：$A_5^3=5\times4\times3=60$ 种。
也可以直接用分步乘法计数原理理解：班长有 $5$ 种选法，学习委员有 $4$ 种，生活委员有 $3$ 种，$5\times4\times3=60$，与公式一致。

examples.problem: 甲、乙等 $5$ 人排成一排照相。(1) 甲站在正中间，有多少种排法？(2) 甲、乙两人相邻，有多少种排法？
examples.solution:
(1) 甲的位置已经固定，只需排其余 $4$ 人：$A_4^4=4!=24$ 种。
(2) 用**捆绑法**：把甲、乙看成一个整体，与其余 $3$ 人一起算作 $4$ 个元素排成一排，有 $4!=24$ 种；甲、乙在整体内部还能互换位置，有 $2!=2$ 种。由分步乘法计数原理，共有 $24\times2=48$ 种排法。

nodes.title: 组合与组合数
nodes.summary: 从 $n$ 个不同元素中取出 $m$ 个不考虑顺序合成一组，个数为 $C_n^m=\dfrac{n!}{m!\,(n-m)!}$。
nodes.summaryEn: Choosing $m$ of $n$ distinct objects without regard to order gives $C_n^m=\dfrac{n!}{m!\,(n-m)!}$ combinations.
nodes.definition:
从 $n$ 个**不同**元素中取出 $m$（$m\le n$）个元素**合成一组**（不考虑顺序），叫做从 $n$ 个不同元素中取出 $m$ 个元素的一个**组合**；所有不同组合的个数叫做**组合数**，记作 $C_n^m$（也写作 $\binom{n}{m}$）。

组合与排列的唯一区别是「顺序」：如果交换所选元素的位置**不算**新的结果，就是组合。例如从 $3$ 名同学中选 $2$ 人去打扫卫生，甲乙与乙甲是同一件事，应该用组合数计算：$C_3^2=3$。

组合数与排列数的关系是「**先选后排**」：先从 $n$ 个元素中选出 $m$ 个（$C_n^m$ 种），再把这 $m$ 个元素排成一列（$m!$ 种），合起来正好是排列数，即 $A_n^m=C_n^m\cdot m!$，于是 $$C_n^m=\frac{A_n^m}{m!}=\frac{n!}{m!\,(n-m)!}.$$

组合数有两条常用性质：$C_n^m=C_n^{n-m}$（选出的 $m$ 个与剩下的 $n-m$ 个一一对应）与 $C_n^m=C_{n-1}^m+C_{n-1}^{m-1}$（按某个指定元素「没被选出」或「被选出」分类，这正是杨辉三角的生成规则）。
nodes.definitionEn:
Choosing $m$ objects ($m\le n$) from $n$ **distinct** objects and forming a group **without regard to order** is called a **combination** of $m$ objects from $n$; the number of all such combinations is the **combination number** $C_n^m$ (also written $\binom{n}{m}$).

The only difference from a permutation is order: if swapping the chosen objects does **not** give a new result, we have a combination. Choosing two of three students to clean the room is one and the same task no matter which is named first, so $C_3^2=3$ is the right count.

The link with permutation numbers is "**choose first, then arrange**": choose $m$ of the $n$ objects ($C_n^m$ ways), then arrange the $m$ chosen objects in a row ($m!$ ways), which together give a permutation: $A_n^m=C_n^m\cdot m!$. Hence $$C_n^m=\frac{A_n^m}{m!}=\frac{n!}{m!\,(n-m)!}.$$

Two properties are used constantly: $C_n^m=C_n^{n-m}$ (the chosen $m$ objects correspond one-to-one to the remaining $n-m$) and $C_n^m=C_{n-1}^m+C_{n-1}^{m-1}$ (classify by whether a fixed element is chosen — the rule that builds Pascal's triangle).

formulas.note: 组合数公式：「先选后排」——从 $n$ 个不同元素中取出 $m$ 个（无序）的方法数。
formulas.noteEn: Combination number: choose $m$ of $n$ distinct objects without order, obtained from "choose then arrange".

formulas.note: 对称性：选出的 $m$ 个与留下的 $n-m$ 个一一对应；当 $m$ 接近 $n$ 时用它简化计算。
formulas.noteEn: Symmetry: the $m$ chosen objects correspond to the $n-m$ left behind; use it to simplify computations when $m$ is close to $n$.

formulas.note: 递推公式（帕斯卡公式）：按某个指定元素是否被选出分类，是杨辉三角的生成规律。
formulas.noteEn: Pascal's rule: classify by whether a fixed element is chosen; it generates Pascal's triangle.

formulas.note: 常用特殊值：$C_n^2$ 也等于 $n$ 个点两两连线的条数（两两配对的方案数）。
formulas.noteEn: Frequently used values; $C_n^2$ also counts the segments joining $n$ points in pairs.

formulas.note: 所有组合数之和：$n$ 元集合的每个子集对应一个组合，故共有 $2^n$ 个子集。
formulas.noteEn: Sum of all combination numbers: each subset of an $n$-element set corresponds to one combination, so there are $2^n$ subsets.

properties: 组合与**顺序无关**：交换所选元素的位置仍是同一个组合；判断办法是问「交换顺序是否算不同」，不算就是组合。
对称性 $C_n^m=C_n^{n-m}$ 与递推公式 $C_n^m=C_{n-1}^m+C_{n-1}^{m-1}$ 是两条核心性质，后者给出了杨辉三角。
关系式 $A_n^m=m!\,C_n^m$：排列问题常可拆成「先组合（选出哪些）再排列（怎么排）」两步。
组合数一定是正整数，且 $C_n^0+C_n^1+\cdots+C_n^n=2^n$，因为一个组合恰好对应一个子集。
含「至少」「至多」的组合问题，除了分类相加，还可以用**正难则反**：先算全部组合数，再减去不符合条件的组合数。
propertiesEn: Order does **not** matter: rearranging the chosen objects gives the same combination; the test is whether swapping the order produces a new result.
The symmetry $C_n^m=C_n^{n-m}$ and Pascal's rule $C_n^m=C_{n-1}^m+C_{n-1}^{m-1}$ are the two core properties, and the latter builds Pascal's triangle.
The identity $A_n^m=m!\,C_n^m$ lets a permutation problem be split into choosing (a combination) and arranging.
Combination numbers are positive integers and $C_n^0+C_n^1+\cdots+C_n^n=2^n$, because each combination corresponds to exactly one subset.
For combinations with "at least" or "at most" conditions, besides adding cases you can work backwards: count all combinations and subtract those that fail the condition.

examples.problem: 从 $8$ 名同学中选出 $4$ 人参加座谈会，共有多少种不同的选法？
examples.solution: 选出的 $4$ 人没有职务差别，交换顺序不算新的选法，所以是**组合**问题：$$C_8^4=\frac{8\times7\times6\times5}{4\times3\times2\times1}=\frac{1680}{24}=70 \text{ 种}.$$

examples.problem: 从 $7$ 名男生、$5$ 名女生中选出 $4$ 人参加比赛，要求至少有 $1$ 名女生，共有多少种选法？
examples.solution:
用**正难则反**：不加限制共 $C_{12}^4=\dfrac{12\times11\times10\times9}{4!}=495$ 种；「没有女生」即从 $7$ 名男生中选 $4$ 人，有 $C_7^4=C_7^3=\dfrac{7\times6\times5}{3!}=35$ 种。所以至少 $1$ 名女生的选法有 $495-35=460$ 种。
分类相加也可验证：$C_5^1C_7^3+C_5^2C_7^2+C_5^3C_7^1+C_5^4=175+210+70+5=460$，两种算法结果一致。

nodes.title: 二项式定理
nodes.summary: $(a+b)^n$ 展开为 $\sum_{k=0}^{n}C_n^ka^{n-k}b^k$，共 $n+1$ 项，通项为第 $k+1$ 项 $T_{k+1}=C_n^ka^{n-k}b^k$。
nodes.summaryEn: The expansion of $(a+b)^n$ is $\sum_{k=0}^{n}C_n^ka^{n-k}b^k$ with $n+1$ terms, and the general term is $T_{k+1}=C_n^ka^{n-k}b^k$.
nodes.definition:
把 $(a+b)^n$（$n\in N^*$）看成 $n$ 个因式 $(a+b)$ 相乘，每个因式都提供 $a$ 或 $b$ 中的一个。若恰有 $k$ 个因式提供 $b$（其余 $n-k$ 个提供 $a$），得到的项就是 $a^{n-k}b^k$，而「哪 $k$ 个因式提供 $b$」有 $C_n^k$ 种选法。把这些项合并，就得到**二项式定理**：$$(a+b)^n=C_n^0a^n+C_n^1a^{n-1}b+\cdots+C_n^ka^{n-k}b^k+\cdots+C_n^nb^n.$$

展开式中的第 $k+1$ 项叫做**通项**：$T_{k+1}=C_n^ka^{n-k}b^k$（$k=0,1,2,\cdots,n$）。**注意 $k$ 从 $0$ 开始**：$C_n^0a^n$ 是第 $1$ 项，$C_n^1a^{n-1}b$ 是第 $2$ 项。求常数项、含 $x^r$ 的项、某项的系数，标准做法都是先写出通项、合并幂指数，再令指数等于目标值解出 $k$，并检查 $k$ 是 $0$ 到 $n$ 之间的整数。

必须区分两个概念：**二项式系数** $C_n^k$ 只是组合数，与 $a$、$b$ 自身携带的系数无关；**项的系数**是整项合并后 $a^{n-k}b^k$ 前面的因数，要把 $a$、$b$ 的系数与符号一起算进去。例如 $(2x-1)^4$ 的第 $3$ 项是 $T_3=C_4^2(2x)^2(-1)^2=24x^2$，它的二项式系数是 $C_4^2=6$，而 $x^2$ 的系数是 $24$，两者不同。

二项式系数沿用组合数的性质：对称且先增后减，$n$ 为偶数时中间一项的二项式系数最大，$n$ 为奇数时中间两项相等且最大。给展开式中的字母赋特殊值（$x=1$、$x=-1$、$x=0$）可以不解出各项系数而直接求出系数和、奇偶项系数和，这种「赋值法」是二项式定理最重要的应用之一。
nodes.definitionEn:
Think of $(a+b)^n$ ($n\in N^*$) as a product of $n$ factors $(a+b)$, each contributing either $a$ or $b$. If exactly $k$ factors contribute $b$, the resulting term is $a^{n-k}b^k$, and there are $C_n^k$ ways to choose those $k$ factors. Collecting all terms gives the **binomial theorem**: $$(a+b)^n=C_n^0a^n+C_n^1a^{n-1}b+\cdots+C_n^ka^{n-k}b^k+\cdots+C_n^nb^n.$$

The term of index $k+1$ is called the **general term**: $T_{k+1}=C_n^ka^{n-k}b^k$ with $k=0,1,2,\cdots,n$. Note that $k$ starts at $0$: $C_n^0a^n$ is the first term and $C_n^1a^{n-1}b$ is the second. To find a constant term, a term containing $x^r$, or the coefficient of a term, write the general term, combine the powers of $x$, set the exponent equal to the target value, solve for $k$, and check that $k$ is an integer between $0$ and $n$.

Two notions must be kept apart: the **binomial coefficient** $C_n^k$ is just a combination number, independent of the coefficients carried by $a$ and $b$; the **coefficient of the term** is the whole factor multiplying $a^{n-k}b^k$, including the coefficients and signs of $a$ and $b$. For instance, the third term of $(2x-1)^4$ is $T_3=C_4^2(2x)^2(-1)^2=24x^2$; its binomial coefficient is $C_4^2=6$, while the coefficient of $x^2$ is $24$ — different numbers.

Binomial coefficients inherit the properties of combination numbers: they are symmetric and increase then decrease, the maximum being attained at the middle term when $n$ is even, and at the two middle terms (equal) when $n$ is odd. Substituting special values such as $x=1$, $x=-1$ or $x=0$ into the expansion yields sums of coefficients and sums of odd- and even-indexed coefficients directly; this "substitution trick" is one of the most important applications of the theorem.

formulas.note: 二项式定理（$n\in N^*$）：展开式共 $n+1$ 项，每项中 $a$ 与 $b$ 的指数之和恒为 $n$。
formulas.noteEn: The binomial theorem ($n\in N^*$): the expansion has $n+1$ terms, and the exponents of $a$ and $b$ in each term add up to $n$.

formulas.note: 通项公式：$T_{k+1}$ 是第 $k+1$ 项，**$k$ 从 $0$ 开始**，$C_n^0a^n$ 才是第 $1$ 项。
formulas.noteEn: General term: $T_{k+1}$ is the $(k+1)$-th term and $k$ starts at $0$, so $C_n^0a^n$ is the first term.

formulas.note: 赋值法的常用形式：令 $x=1$ 得系数和 $2^n$；令 $x=-1$ 得 $C_n^0-C_n^1+C_n^2-\cdots=0$（$n\ge1$）。
formulas.noteEn: A convenient form for substitution: $x=1$ gives the sum of coefficients $2^n$, while $x=-1$ gives $C_n^0-C_n^1+C_n^2-\cdots=0$ for $n\ge1$.

formulas.note: 所有二项式系数之和等于 $2^n$：令 $a=b=1$，或看作 $n$ 元集合的子集个数。
formulas.noteEn: All binomial coefficients sum to $2^n$: put $a=b=1$, or read it as the number of subsets of an $n$-element set.

formulas.note: 奇数项（第 $1,3,5,\cdots$ 项）与偶数项的二项式系数之和相等，都是 $2^{n-1}$（$n\ge1$），由 $x=1$ 与 $x=-1$ 两式相加减得到。
formulas.noteEn: The odd-indexed terms (1st, 3rd, 5th, $\dots$) and the even-indexed terms have equal sums of binomial coefficients, both equal to $2^{n-1}$ for $n\ge1$, obtained by adding and subtracting the cases $x=1$ and $x=-1$.

properties: 展开式共有 $n+1$ 项；$a$ 的指数从 $n$ 递减到 $0$，$b$ 的指数从 $0$ 递增到 $n$，每项两指数之和恒为 $n$。
**二项式系数** $C_n^k$ 与**项的系数**不同：前者只是组合数，后者要把 $a$、$b$ 自带的系数与符号一起算入。如 $(2x-1)^4$ 第 $3$ 项的二项式系数是 $C_4^2=6$，而 $x^2$ 的系数是 $24$。
二项式系数具有对称性 $C_n^k=C_n^{n-k}$，并且先增后减：$n$ 为偶数时第 $\frac{n}{2}+1$ 项的二项式系数最大；$n$ 为奇数时第 $\frac{n+1}{2}$ 项与第 $\frac{n+3}{2}$ 项的二项式系数相等且最大。
求指定项（常数项、含 $x^r$ 的项、有理项）的步骤：写出通项 → 合并指数 → 令指数等于目标值 → 解出 $k$，并检验 $k$ 是 $0$ 到 $n$ 之间的整数。
赋值法：在恒等式中代入 $x=1$（各项系数和）、$x=-1$（奇偶项系数之差）、$x=0$（常数项）等特殊值，可不解出每一项而直接得到系数之间的关系。
propertiesEn: The expansion has $n+1$ terms; the exponent of $a$ decreases from $n$ to $0$ while that of $b$ increases from $0$ to $n$, and the two exponents always sum to $n$.

The **binomial coefficient** $C_n^k$ differs from the **coefficient of the term**: the former is just a combination number, the latter also contains the coefficients and signs of $a$ and $b$. In $(2x-1)^4$ the third term has binomial coefficient $C_4^2=6$ but coefficient of $x^2$ equal to $24$.

Binomial coefficients are symmetric, $C_n^k=C_n^{n-k}$, and increase then decrease: for even $n$ the maximum is at the $(\frac{n}{2}+1)$-th term, while for odd $n$ the $(\frac{n+1}{2})$-th and $(\frac{n+3}{2})$-th terms are equal and maximal.

To find a particular term (constant term, the term containing $x^r$, a rational term): write the general term, combine the exponents, set the exponent equal to the target value, solve for $k$, and check that $k$ is an integer with $0\le k\le n$.

Substitution: plugging $x=1$ (sum of all coefficients), $x=-1$ (difference of odd and even parts) or $x=0$ (constant term) into the identity gives relations among coefficients without computing them one by one.

examples.problem: 求 $\left(x^2+\dfrac{1}{x}\right)^6$ 的展开式中的常数项。

nodes.title: 排列与组合的综合应用
nodes.titleEn: Comprehensive Applications of Permutations and Combinations
nodes.summary: 分组分配、隔板法、插空与捆绑、正难则反——排列组合综合题的常用模型与「计数不重不漏」的检验方法。
nodes.summaryEn: Grouping and distribution, the partition (stars-and-bars) method, gap and bundle techniques, and counting by complement — the standard models for mixed counting problems and how to make sure nothing is counted twice or missed.
nodes.definition:
排列组合的综合题，难点不在公式，而在**识别模型**与**不重不漏**。读题时先判断两件事：元素是否**可区分**（互不相同还是完全相同），结果是否与**顺序**有关（有序用排列 $A_n^m$，无序用组合 $C_n^m$）。再找出限制条件——「相邻」「不相邻」「至少」「至多」「平均分成几组」——它们分别对应捆绑、插空、正难则反、均匀分组这几类模型。

**分组与分配**是考查最多的一类。把 $n$ 个不同元素分成若干**组**（组没有编号）时：若各组元素个数各不相同，直接把组合数连乘；若有几个组的元素个数**相同**（尤其是平均分组），这些组在连乘中被重复计数了，必须除以相同组数的阶乘。若组**有编号**（或要分给不同的人、放到不同的位置），则不除，等价于「先分组、再排序」。

**隔板法**处理「相同元素分组」：把 $n$ 个**相同**的小球排成一排，它们之间有 $n-1$ 个空档，插入 $m-1$ 块板就分成 $m$ 组，每组至少 $1$ 个，方案数为 $C_{n-1}^{m-1}$（要求 $n\ge m$）；若允许空组，先用「借一个再还一个」的办法转化，方案数为 $C_{n+m-1}^{m-1}$。**插空法**处理「不相邻」：先排其余元素，再把要求不相邻的元素插入它们之间及两端的空位。**捆绑法**处理「相邻」：把必须相邻的元素捆成一个整体参与排列，最后乘上整体内部的排列数。

含「至少」「至多」的问题，正面分类往往又多又碎，用**正难则反**——先算不加限制的总数，再减去反面的计数——通常更快。做完之后一定要检验：换一种分类方式再算一遍，或检查「各类计数之和是否等于总数」，这是保证计数正确、不重不漏的最后一道关卡。
nodes.definitionEn:
In mixed counting problems the difficulty lies not in the formulas but in **recognising the model** and in counting **without repetition or omission**. Read the problem and decide two things first: are the objects **distinguishable**, and does **order** matter (ordered means $A_n^m$, unordered means $C_n^m$)? Then look for the restrictions — adjacent, not adjacent, at least, at most, split into equal groups — which correspond to the bundle, gap, complement and equal-grouping models.

**Grouping and distribution** is tested most often. Dividing $n$ distinct objects into unlabelled groups: if the group sizes are all different, multiply the combination numbers directly; if some groups have **equal** size (in particular an equal division), those groups are counted repeatedly in the product and one must divide by the factorial of the number of equal groups. If the groups are **labelled** (or are handed to different people or placed in different positions), do not divide — it is the same as "group first, then order the groups".

**Stars and bars** handles equal objects: line up $n$ identical balls; there are $n-1$ gaps between them, and inserting $m-1$ bars splits them into $m$ nonempty groups, giving $C_{n-1}^{m-1}$ ways ($n\ge m$). If empty groups are allowed, borrow one ball for each group and return it later, which changes the count to $C_{n+m-1}^{m-1}$. The **gap method** handles "not adjacent": arrange the other objects first, then insert the required objects into the gaps between them and at the two ends. The **bundle method** handles "adjacent": tie the objects that must stay together into one block, permute the blocks, and multiply by the permutations inside the block.

For "at least" and "at most" conditions, direct classification is often long and messy, so use the **complement**: count everything with no restriction and subtract the forbidden cases. Always check the result afterwards — count again by a different classification, or verify that the case counts add up to the total. That is the last line of defence against double counting and omissions.

formulas.note: 均匀分组：把 $n$ 个不同元素平均分成 $m$ 个**无编号**的组（每组 $k=\frac{n}{m}$ 个），必须除以 $m!$，否则同一分组被重复计数 $m!$ 次。
formulas.noteEn: Equal grouping: splitting $n$ distinct objects into $m$ **unlabelled** groups of size $k=\frac{n}{m}$ requires division by $m!$, otherwise each grouping is counted $m!$ times.

formulas.note: 隔板法：$n$ 个**相同**元素分成 $m$ 组、每组至少 $1$ 个的方案数（元素相同、组有区别、$n\ge m$）。
formulas.noteEn: Stars and bars: $n$ **identical** objects split into $m$ nonempty, distinguishable groups ($n\ge m$).

formulas.note: 允许空组的情形：$n$ 个相同元素分给 $m$ 个不同对象，允许有的对象分不到（先给每组借 $1$ 个，最后再还）。
formulas.noteEn: Allowing empty groups: distributing $n$ identical objects among $m$ distinct holders, some possibly empty (lend one to each group, then take it back).

formulas.note: 插空法：先排 $n$ 个元素（$n!$ 种），再把 $m$ 个**互不相同**且要求不相邻的元素插进 $n+1$ 个空位（选空位 $C_{n+1}^m$，排序 $m!$）。
formulas.noteEn: Gap method: arrange $n$ objects ($n!$ ways), then insert $m$ **distinct** objects that must not be adjacent into the $n+1$ gaps ($C_{n+1}^m$ gaps, $m!$ orders).

formulas.note: 正难则反：先数全部情况，再减去不满足条件的反面情况，用于「至少」「至多」类问题。
formulas.noteEn: Counting by complement: count all cases, then subtract those that fail the condition; useful for "at least" and "at most" problems.

properties: **均匀分组必除阶乘**：把元素平均分成 $m$ 个无编号的组时，连乘的组合数把同一分组重复计数了 $m!$ 次，必须除以 $m!$；若组有编号或要分给不同的人，则不除（等价于再乘 $m!$）。
隔板法只适用于**元素相同、每组至少 $1$ 个、组有区别**的情形；元素可区分时不能套用（应改用分组分配的办法），允许空组时结果换成 $C_{n+m-1}^{m-1}$。
插空法用于「不相邻」：先安排其余元素，再把要求的元素插入空位；$n$ 个元素排好后（含两端）共有 $n+1$ 个空位，插入的元素互不相同时还要乘上排列数。
捆绑法用于「相邻」：把必须相邻的元素看成一个整体参与排列，再乘以整体内部的排列数；有几个整体就依次处理。
「至少」「至多」类问题优先用**正难则反**：总数减去反面数，避免繁琐的多重分类；算完用「另一种分类求和是否等于总数」来验算有无重复或遗漏。
propertiesEn: **Equal grouping needs division by a factorial**: dividing objects into $m$ unlabelled groups of equal size counts each grouping $m!$ times, so divide by $m!$; if the groups are labelled or go to different people, do not divide (equivalently, multiply back by $m!$).

Stars and bars applies only when the objects are **identical**, every group gets at least one, and the groups are distinguishable; it cannot be used for distinct objects, and if empty groups are allowed the answer becomes $C_{n+m-1}^{m-1}$.

The gap method handles "not adjacent": arrange the other objects first, then insert the required ones. After $n$ objects are placed there are $n+1$ gaps (including the two ends), and distinct inserted objects bring a factor $m!$.
The bundle method handles "adjacent": treat the objects that must stay together as one block, permute the blocks, then multiply by the permutations inside each block.
For "at least" and "at most" questions prefer the complement — total minus forbidden — and then check the answer by summing over another classification to make sure nothing is repeated or missed.

examples.problem: (1) 把 $6$ 本不同的书平均分成 $3$ 堆，每堆 $2$ 本，有多少种分法？(2) 把这 $6$ 本书平均分给甲、乙、丙三人，有多少种分法？
examples.solution:
(1) 先按顺序取：$C_6^2C_4^2C_2^2=15\times6\times1=90$。因为 $3$ 堆没有编号，同一分组在取的过程中被重复计算了 $3!=6$ 次，所以分法为 $\dfrac{C_6^2C_4^2C_2^2}{3!}=\dfrac{90}{6}=15$ 种。
(2) 分给甲、乙、丙三人时三堆有了编号，不必除以 $3!$：$15\times3!=90$ 种（也就是直接用连乘 $C_6^2C_4^2C_2^2=90$）。

examples.problem: 4 名男生和 3 名女生排成一排，要求 3 名女生两两不相邻，共有多少种排法？
examples.solution: 用**插空法**。先排 4 名男生，有 $A_4^4=4!=24$ 种；4 名男生排好后（含两端）共形成 $5$ 个空位，3 名女生两两不相邻，需要选 $3$ 个不同的空位并把她们排进去，有 $A_5^3=5\times4\times3=60$ 种。由分步乘法计数原理，共有 $24\times60=1440$ 种排法。

nodes.title: 复数的三角表示
nodes.summary: 用模与辐角把复数写成 $z=r(\cos\theta+i\sin\theta)$：乘法模相乘、辐角相加，乘方有棣莫弗定理。
nodes.summaryEn: Writing a complex number as $z=r(\cos\theta+i\sin\theta)$ with modulus $r$ and argument $\theta$; multiplication multiplies moduli and adds arguments, and powers obey de Moivre's theorem.
nodes.definition:
复数 $z=a+bi$ 与复平面上的点 $(a,b)$、向量 $\overrightarrow{OZ}$ 一一对应。对非零复数 $z$，记 $r=|z|=\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$ 为 $z$ 的**模**，记 $\theta$ 为以 $x$ 轴正半轴为始边、向量 $\overrightarrow{OZ}$ 为终边的角，则 $a=r\cos\theta$，$b=r\sin\theta$，于是 $$z=r(\cos\theta+i\sin\theta).$$ 这个式子叫做复数 $z$ 的**三角形式**。本节点中非零复数的**辐角主值**统一定在 $[0,2\pi)$ 内取值。

三角形式有四个特征必须同时满足：模 $r\ge0$；括号内 $\cos\theta$ 在前、$\sin\theta$ 在后，两处是同一个角 $\theta$；两项之间用「$+$」连接。像 $-2\left(\cos\dfrac{\pi}{3}+i\sin\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right)$ 与 $2\left(\cos\dfrac{\pi}{3}-i\sin\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right)$ 都不是三角形式的规范写法，先要化成 $2\left(\cos\dfrac{4\pi}{3}+i\sin\dfrac{4\pi}{3}\right)$ 和 $2\left(\cos\dfrac{5\pi}{3}+i\sin\dfrac{5\pi}{3}\right)$，才能直接套用下面的运算公式。

三角形式最大的好处是把「乘除」化成「模与角」的运算：两复数相乘时**模相乘、辐角相加**，相除时**模相除、辐角相减**。几何上，乘以 $z_2$ 就是把 $z_1$ 对应的向量绕原点**逆时针**旋转角 $\theta_2$，再把长度伸缩为原来的 $r_2$ 倍。特别地，乘以 $i=\cos\dfrac{\pi}{2}+i\sin\dfrac{\pi}{2}$，就是逆时针旋转 $90\,{}^{\circ}$（模不变）。

反复使用乘法公式可得**棣莫弗定理**：$[r(\cos\theta+i\sin\theta)]^n=r^n(\cos n\theta+i\sin n\theta)$（$n\in N^*$），它把复数的乘方化归为「模取 $n$ 次方、角变成 $n$ 倍」。代数形式与三角形式互化时，先用 $r=\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$ 求模，再由 $\cos\theta=\dfrac{a}{r}$、$\sin\theta=\dfrac{b}{r}$ **结合点 $(a,b)$ 所在象限**确定 $\theta$，不能只用 $\tan\theta=\dfrac{b}{a}$ 定角（它只能确定相差 $\pi$ 的两个候选值）。
nodes.definitionEn:
A complex number $z=a+bi$ corresponds to the point $(a,b)$ in the complex plane and to the vector $\overrightarrow{OZ}$. For $z\ne0$, let $r=|z|=\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$ be the **modulus**, and let $\theta$ be the angle from the positive real axis to that vector, so that $a=r\cos\theta$ and $b=r\sin\theta$; then $$z=r(\cos\theta+i\sin\theta).$$ This is the **trigonometric form** of $z$. Throughout this topic the principal argument of a nonzero complex number is taken in $[0,2\pi)$.

Four features must hold at the same time: the modulus satisfies $r\ge0$; inside the bracket $\cos\theta$ comes first and $\sin\theta$ second, with the *same* angle $\theta$ in both; and the two parts are joined by a plus sign. Expressions such as $-2\left(\cos\dfrac{\pi}{3}+i\sin\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right)$ or $2\left(\cos\dfrac{\pi}{3}-i\sin\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right)$ are not yet in standard trigonometric form: they must first be rewritten as $2\left(\cos\dfrac{4\pi}{3}+i\sin\dfrac{4\pi}{3}\right)$ and $2\left(\cos\dfrac{5\pi}{3}+i\sin\dfrac{5\pi}{3}\right)$ before the formulas below can be applied directly.

The great advantage of this form is that multiplication and division act on moduli and arguments separately: **multiply the moduli and add the arguments**; **divide the moduli and subtract the arguments**. Geometrically, multiplying $z_1$ by $z_2$ rotates the vector of $z_1$ counterclockwise through the angle $\theta_2$ and scales its length by the factor $r_2$. In particular, multiplying by $i=\cos\dfrac{\pi}{2}+i\sin\dfrac{\pi}{2}$ is a counterclockwise rotation by $90\,{}^{\circ}$ with the modulus unchanged.

Iterating the multiplication rule gives **de Moivre's theorem**: $[r(\cos\theta+i\sin\theta)]^n=r^n(\cos n\theta+i\sin n\theta)$ for $n\in N^*$, which reduces powers to taking the $n$-th power of the modulus and multiplying the angle by $n$. To convert between algebraic and trigonometric forms, first compute $r=\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$, then use $\cos\theta=\dfrac{a}{r}$ and $\sin\theta=\dfrac{b}{r}$ **together with the quadrant of the point $(a,b)$** to determine $\theta$; $\tan\theta=\dfrac{b}{a}$ alone only fixes the angle up to a difference of $\pi$.

formulas.note: 复数的三角形式：$r\ge0$ 是模，$\theta$ 是辐角（本节点辐角主值取 $[0,2\pi)$）。
formulas.noteEn: Trigonometric form: $r\ge0$ is the modulus and $\theta$ the argument (taken in $[0,2\pi)$ here).

formulas.note: 乘法：模相乘、辐角相加；几何意义是旋转加伸缩。
formulas.noteEn: Multiplication: multiply the moduli and add the arguments; geometrically a rotation combined with a scaling.

formulas.note: 除法：模相除、辐角相减（除数不为 $0$）。
formulas.noteEn: Division: divide the moduli and subtract the arguments (the divisor is nonzero).

formulas.note: 棣莫弗定理：乘方时模取 $n$ 次方、辐角乘 $n$，用于计算 $(\cos\theta+i\sin\theta)^n$ 一类的问题。
formulas.noteEn: De Moivre's theorem: for a power, raise the modulus to the $n$-th power and multiply the argument by $n$.

formulas.note: 代数形式化三角形式时用来定角：必须结合点 $(a,b)$ 的象限，不能只靠 $\tan\theta=\dfrac{b}{a}$。
formulas.noteEn: Used to determine the angle when passing from algebraic to trigonometric form: the quadrant of $(a,b)$ is essential, and $\tan\theta=\dfrac{b}{a}$ alone is not enough.

properties: 三角形式的四个特征要同时满足：模 $r\ge0$；括号内 $\cos$ 在前、$\sin$ 在后；两项之间用「$+$」连接；两处的角相同。不满足时要先变形（如把负号提到括号外，或把 $\cos\theta-i\sin\theta$ 改写成 $\cos(-\theta)+i\sin(-\theta)$；若要求辐角主值落在 $[0,2\pi)$ 内，再把角换成 $2\pi-\theta$）。
辐角不唯一：若 $\theta$ 是 $z$ 的辐角，则 $\theta+2k\pi$（$k\in Z$）都是 $z$ 的辐角；本节点把辐角主值规定在 $[0,2\pi)$ 内。两个非零复数相等，当且仅当模相等且辐角相差 $2\pi$ 的整数倍。
乘法的几何意义：$z_1z_2$ 是把 $z_1$ 对应的向量绕原点逆时针旋转角 $\theta_2$、并把长度变为 $r_2$ 倍的结果；特别地乘 $i$ 是逆时针旋转 $90\,{}^{\circ}$（模不变），乘 $-1$ 是旋转 $180\,{}^{\circ}$。
棣莫弗定理是乘方公式的推广：模取 $n$ 次方、辐角乘 $n$；它能快速算出 $(1+i)^6$、$(\cos\theta+i\sin\theta)^n$ 这类结果。
只有非零复数才有辐角：$z=0$ 的模为 $0$，不能写成三角形式；互化结束时务必检验 $\cos\theta$、$\sin\theta$ 的符号与 $a$、$b$ 的符号是否一致。
propertiesEn: Four features must hold at once: $r\ge0$; $\cos$ before $\sin$ inside the bracket; a plus sign between the two parts; and the same angle in both. Otherwise rewrite first (pull a negative sign out, or replace $\cos\theta-i\sin\theta$ by $\cos(-\theta)+i\sin(-\theta)$).

Arguments are not unique: if $\theta$ is an argument of $z$, so is $\theta+2k\pi$ for every integer $k$; here the principal argument is taken in $[0,2\pi)$. Two nonzero complex numbers are equal exactly when their moduli agree and their arguments differ by an integer multiple of $2\pi$.

Geometric meaning of multiplication: $z_1z_2$ is obtained by rotating the vector of $z_1$ counterclockwise through $\theta_2$ and scaling its length by $r_2$. In particular multiplication by $i$ is a counterclockwise rotation by $90\,{}^{\circ}$ leaving the modulus unchanged, while multiplication by $-1$ is a rotation by $180\,{}^{\circ}$.

De Moivre's theorem generalises the multiplication rule: raise the modulus to the $n$-th power and multiply the argument by $n$, which quickly yields results such as $(1+i)^6$ or $(\cos\theta+i\sin\theta)^n$.

Only nonzero complex numbers have arguments: $z=0$ has modulus $0$ and no trigonometric form. When converting, always check that the signs of $\cos\theta$ and $\sin\theta$ agree with the signs of $a$ and $b$.

examples.problem: 把复数 $z=-1+\sqrt{3}\,i$ 化为三角形式。
examples.solution:
先求模：$r=|z|=\sqrt{(-1)^{2}+(\sqrt{3})^{2}}=\sqrt{1+3}=2$。
再由 $a=-1<0$、$b=\sqrt{3}>0$ 知点 $(-1,\sqrt{3})$ 在第二象限，且 $\cos\theta=\dfrac{-1}{2}=-\dfrac{1}{2}$，$\sin\theta=\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$，所以 $\theta=\dfrac{2\pi}{3}$。
于是 $z=2\left(\cos\dfrac{2\pi}{3}+i\sin\dfrac{2\pi}{3}\right)$。

examples.problem: (1) 计算 $(1+i)^{6}$；(2) 求 $z=2\left(\cos\dfrac{\pi}{3}+i\sin\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right)$ 与 $i$ 的乘积，并说明它的几何意义。
examples.solution:
(1) 因为 $1+i=\sqrt{2}\left(\cos\dfrac{\pi}{4}+i\sin\dfrac{\pi}{4}\right)$，由棣莫弗定理 $$(1+i)^{6}=(\sqrt{2})^{6}\left(\cos\dfrac{6\pi}{4}+i\sin\dfrac{6\pi}{4}\right)=8\left(\cos\dfrac{3\pi}{2}+i\sin\dfrac{3\pi}{2}\right)=8(0-i)=-8i.$$
（检验：$(1+i)^2=2i$，故 $(1+i)^6=(2i)^3=8i^3=-8i$，结果一致。）
(2) 把 $i$ 写成三角形式 $i=\cos\dfrac{\pi}{2}+i\sin\dfrac{\pi}{2}$，由乘法公式 $$zi=2\cdot1\left[\cos\left(\dfrac{\pi}{3}+\dfrac{\pi}{2}\right)+i\sin\left(\dfrac{\pi}{3}+\dfrac{\pi}{2}\right)\right]=2\left(\cos\dfrac{5\pi}{6}+i\sin\dfrac{5\pi}{6}\right).$$
几何意义：乘以 $i$ 使模不变、辐角增加 $\dfrac{\pi}{2}$，即把 $z$ 对应的向量逆时针旋转 $90\,{}^{\circ}$。

plot.title: w = iz：网格逆时针旋转 90°（模不变、辐角加 π/2）

nodes.title: 不定积分
nodes.summary: 不定积分是求导的逆运算，结果是一个含任意常数的函数族，而不是一个数。
nodes.summaryEn: The indefinite integral reverses differentiation; it yields a family of functions differing by a constant, not a single number.
nodes.definition:
求导回答的是「已知函数，求它的变化率」；不定积分把这个问题反过来：**已知导数，求原来的函数**。如果函数 $F(x)$ 与 $f(x)$ 都在区间 $I$ 上有定义，并且满足
$$F'(x)=f(x),\quad x\in I,$$
就称 $F(x)$ 是 $f(x)$ 在区间 $I$ 上的一个**原函数**，并把 $f(x)$ 的所有原函数记作
$$\int f(x)\,dx=F(x)+C,$$
其中 $C$ 是任意常数，称为积分常数，这个记号就叫**不定积分**。

要注意：同一个 $f(x)$ 的原函数不止一个。若 $F(x)$ 是 $f$ 的一个原函数，则对任意常数 $C$，$F(x)+C$ 也是 $f$ 的原函数；反过来，$f$ 在区间 $I$ 上的任意两个原函数之差必为常数。所以不定积分表示的是一族函数，图像是同一条曲线沿 $y$ 轴方向上下平移得到的无穷多条曲线，因此 $+C$ 绝不能漏写。

不定积分与定积分是两个不同的对象：不定积分是一个函数族，而定积分是一个具体的数。二者由微积分基本定理联系起来——计算定积分时，可以先求被积函数的原函数，再代入上下限。求不定积分的常用方法有直接积分（基本公式与线性性质）、换元积分法和分部积分法。
nodes.definitionEn:
Differentiation answers the question 「given a function, find its rate of change」; the indefinite integral asks the reverse question: given the derivative, recover the original function. If $F(x)$ and $f(x)$ are defined on an interval $I$ and satisfy
$$F'(x)=f(x),\quad x\in I,$$
then $F(x)$ is called an **antiderivative** of $f(x)$ on $I$, and the set of all antiderivatives of $f$ is written
$$\int f(x)\,dx=F(x)+C,$$
where $C$ is an arbitrary constant, called the constant of integration. This is the **indefinite integral**.

A function has infinitely many antiderivatives: if $F$ is one of them, then so is $F(x)+C$ for every constant $C$; conversely, any two antiderivatives of $f$ on an interval differ by a constant. The indefinite integral therefore represents a family of functions whose graphs are vertical shifts of one another, so the constant $C$ must never be dropped.

The indefinite integral and the definite integral are different objects: the former is a family of functions, the latter is a single number. They are connected by the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus, which lets us evaluate a definite integral by finding an antiderivative first and then substituting the endpoints. The main techniques are direct integration (basic table and linearity), substitution, and integration by parts.

formulas.note: 不定积分的定义：求不定积分就是求「导数等于被积函数」的所有函数，$C$ 为任意常数。
formulas.noteEn: Definition: finding an indefinite integral means finding every function whose derivative is the integrand, with $C$ an arbitrary constant.

formulas.note: 幂函数积分公式：指数加一，再除以新指数；$n=-1$ 时公式失效，需要单独处理。
formulas.noteEn: Power rule: raise the exponent by one and divide by the new exponent; it fails for $n=-1$.

formulas.note: 对数型积分公式：$x=0$ 处无定义，必须加绝对值，且在 $(-\infty,0)$ 与 $(0,+\infty)$ 上分别成立。
formulas.noteEn: Logarithmic formula: the absolute value is required, and it holds separately on $(-\infty,0)$ and $(0,+\infty)$.

formulas.note: 两个必须熟记的基本公式，都可以对右侧求导直接验证。
formulas.noteEn: Two basic results every student should know; both are verified by differentiating the right-hand side.

formulas.note: 线性性质：常数因子可以提到积分号外，和与差可以逐项积分。
formulas.noteEn: Linearity: constant factors come out, and sums or differences can be integrated term by term.

expression.text: ∫ f(x) dx = F(x) + C
expression.note: 结果是函数族而不是一个数；对结果求导应回到 f(x)，可用于验算。
expression.noteEn: The result is a family of functions, not a number; differentiating it returns f(x), which is a useful check.

properties: 若 $F$ 是 $f$ 的一个原函数，则 $f$ 的全部原函数恰为 $F(x)+C$（$C$ 为任意常数），所以结果必须带 $+C$。
原函数存在定理：区间上的连续函数一定有原函数，因此常见的初等函数在定义区间上都可以求不定积分。
验算方法：把结果求导，若得到被积函数，则计算正确；求导比积分容易得多，这是自我检验的好办法。
原函数族中的每条曲线在同一横坐标处的切线斜率相同，图像互相之间只差一个竖直平移。
不定积分满足线性性质，可以逐项计算；但乘积与复合结构没有类似的简单公式，需要换元积分法或分部积分法。
propertiesEn: If $F$ is one antiderivative of $f$, then the complete set of antiderivatives is $F(x)+C$ with $C$ an arbitrary constant, so $+C$ must always be written.
Existence theorem: every function continuous on an interval has an antiderivative, so familiar elementary functions can be integrated on their domains.
Check by differentiation: if the derivative of your answer is the integrand, the computation is correct — differentiating is far easier than integrating.
All curves in the antiderivative family share the same slope at each x-value; their graphs differ only by a vertical shift.
The indefinite integral is linear and can be computed term by term, but products and compositions have no equally simple rule and need substitution or integration by parts.

plot.title: f(x)=x² 与它的原函数族 F(x)=x³/3+C（C=−1,0,1）

examples.solution:
利用线性性质与幂函数积分公式逐项计算：
$$\int (3x^2-2x+1)\,dx=3\cdot\frac{x^3}{3}-2\cdot\frac{x^2}{2}+x+C=x^3-x^2+x+C.$$
验算：$(x^3-x^2+x+C)'=3x^2-2x+1$，与被积函数一致，结果正确。

examples.problem: 已知一条曲线在点 $(x,y)$ 处的切线斜率为 $3x^2$，且曲线经过点 $(1,2)$，求该曲线的方程。
examples.solution: 由 $y'=3x^2$ 得 $y=\int 3x^2\,dx=x^3+C$。代入 $(1,2)$：$2=1^3+C$，得 $C=1$。所以曲线方程为 $y=x^3+1$。这说明「经过某点」这样的初始条件可以把函数族中唯一的那条曲线挑出来。

nodes.title: 换元积分法
nodes.summary: 换元积分法是链式法则的逆运算，通过引入新变量把复杂的积分化成基本积分；定积分换元后上下限必须同时更换。
nodes.summaryEn: Substitution reverses the chain rule and simplifies an integral by changing variables; for definite integrals the limits must be changed too.
nodes.definition:
换元积分法是**复合函数求导法则（链式法则）的逆运算**。如果 $\int f(u)\,du=F(u)+C$，而 $u=g(x)$ 可导，那么
$$\frac{d}{dx}F(g(x))=f(g(x))g'(x),$$
两边同时积分就得到
$$\int f(g(x))g'(x)\,dx=\int f(u)\,du=F(g(x))+C,\quad u=g(x).$$
把 $g'(x)\,dx$ 整体凑成 $du$ 的做法叫**第一类换元法（凑微分法）**：只要被积表达式里能拆出一个因子与 $dx$ 凑成某个函数的微分，就可以整体替换。

用换元法计算**定积分**时，最关键的一条是：**换元之后，上下限也要跟着换**。设 $u=g(x)$，则 $x=a$ 对应 $u=g(a)$，$x=b$ 对应 $u=g(b)$，于是
$$\int_a^b f(g(x))g'(x)\,dx=\int_{g(a)}^{g(b)}f(u)\,du.$$
如果不想换限，就必须在求出原函数后把 $u$ 换回 $x$，再代入原来的上下限。换限与回代必须二选一、贯穿到底，中途混用是换元法最常见的错误来源。

当被积函数含有 $\sqrt{a^2-x^2}$、$\sqrt{a^2+x^2}$、$\sqrt{x^2-a^2}$ 这类根式时，还可以主动作三角代换 $x=a\sin t$、$x=a\tan t$、$x=a\sec t$，这称为**第二类换元法**。无论哪一类，换元的目标都是一致的：把陌生的积分变成积分表里认得的形式。
nodes.definitionEn:
Integration by substitution is the **inverse of the chain rule**. If $\int f(u)\,du=F(u)+C$ and $u=g(x)$ is differentiable, then
$$\frac{d}{dx}F(g(x))=f(g(x))g'(x),$$
and integrating both sides gives
$$\int f(g(x))g'(x)\,dx=\int f(u)\,du=F(g(x))+C,\quad u=g(x).$$
Folding $g'(x)\,dx$ into a single differential $du$ is called the **first type of substitution** (the 「make the differential」 technique): whenever part of the integrand together with $dx$ forms the differential of some function, the whole piece can be replaced.

For **definite** integrals the essential point is that **the limits of integration must be changed as well**. With $u=g(x)$, the endpoint $x=a$ corresponds to $u=g(a)$ and $x=b$ to $u=g(b)$, hence
$$\int_a^b f(g(x))g'(x)\,dx=\int_{g(a)}^{g(b)}f(u)\,du.$$
Alternatively, keep the old limits but convert the antiderivative back to $x$ before substituting. You must choose one route and follow it to the end; mixing the two is the most common source of errors.

When the integrand contains radicals such as $\sqrt{a^2-x^2}$, $\sqrt{a^2+x^2}$, or $\sqrt{x^2-a^2}$, one may deliberately set $x=a\sin t$, $x=a\tan t$, or $x=a\sec t$; this is called the **second type of substitution** (trigonometric substitution). Either way the goal is the same: turn an unfamiliar integral into one that appears in the standard table.

formulas.note: 第一类换元法（凑微分）：把 $g'(x)\,dx$ 凑成 $du$，被积表达式整体改写为关于 $u$ 的形式。
formulas.noteEn: First-type substitution: fold $g'(x)\,dx$ into $du$ and rewrite the whole integrand in terms of $u$.

formulas.note: 定积分换元公式：上下限必须由 $x$ 的 $a,b$ 换成 $u$ 的 $g(a),g(b)$，这是换元法最易出错的地方。
formulas.noteEn: Definite-integral substitution: the limits change from $a,b$ to $g(a),g(b)$ — the step students most often forget.

formulas.note: 微分关系：它是换元法的操作依据，把 $g'(x)\,dx$ 整体看成一个微分记号 $du$。
formulas.noteEn: The differential relation is the working tool of substitution: it treats $g'(x)\,dx$ as the single symbol $du$.

formulas.note: 三角代换（第二类换元）：用于消去 $\sqrt{a^2-x^2}$ 型根式；当 $t\in\left[-\frac{\pi}{2},\frac{\pi}{2}\right]$ 时 $\cos t\ge 0$，开方不必加绝对值。
formulas.noteEn: Trigonometric substitution for square roots of the form $\sqrt{a^2-x^2}$; on $t\in[-\pi/2,\pi/2]$ the cosine is nonnegative, so no absolute value is needed.

formulas.note: 典型例子：$u=x^2$ 时 $du=2x\,dx$，被积表达式恰好凑成 $e^u\,du$。
formulas.noteEn: A model example: with $u=x^2$ we get $du=2x\,dx$, so the integrand becomes exactly $e^u\,du$.

expression.text: ∫ f(g(x))·g′(x) dx = ∫ f(u) du,  u = g(x)
expression.note: 换元后积分里不能同时残留 x 与 u 两种变量；定积分换元后立即写出新的上下限。
expression.noteEn: After substituting, the integral must not contain both x and u; for definite integrals write the new limits immediately.

properties: 换元法的本质是逆用链式法则，凑微分的依据是 $dF(u)=F'(u)\,du$。
定积分换元后必须同时更换上下限；若保留原上下限，就必须把原函数换回原变量再代入。
换元要换得「干净」：化成关于 $u$ 的积分后，除常数外不能再出现原来的变量 $x$。
三角代换的选取规律：$\sqrt{a^2-x^2}$ 令 $x=a\sin t$，$\sqrt{a^2+x^2}$ 令 $x=a\tan t$，$\sqrt{x^2-a^2}$ 令 $x=a\sec t$。
换元后要检查积分区间是否落在代换函数单调可导的范围内，避免开方或回代时取错符号。
propertiesEn: Substitution is the chain rule run backwards; folding a differential relies on $dF(u)=F'(u)\,du$.
After a substitution in a definite integral the limits must be changed; if the old limits are kept, the antiderivative must be converted back to the original variable before substituting.
A substitution must be complete: once the integral is written in terms of $u$, no trace of the old variable $x$ may remain except in constants.
Choice of trigonometric substitution: use $x=a\sin t$ for $\sqrt{a^2-x^2}$, $x=a\tan t$ for $\sqrt{a^2+x^2}$, and $x=a\sec t$ for $\sqrt{x^2-a^2}$.
Check that the integration interval lies where the substitution is monotone and differentiable, so that signs are taken correctly when removing a square root.

plot.title: 换元法：令 u=x²，则 du=2x dx，被积式化为 e^u du

examples.problem: 求 $\int 2x e^{x^2}\,dx$。
examples.solution:
令 $u=x^2$，则 $du=2x\,dx$，代入得
$$\int 2x e^{x^2}\,dx=\int e^u\,du=e^u+C=e^{x^2}+C.$$
验算：$(e^{x^2}+C)'=2xe^{x^2}$，正确。

令 $u=x^2$。**换元同时换限**：当 $x$ 从 $0$ 变到 $1$ 时，$u$ 从 $0^2=0$ 变到 $1^2=1$，于是
$$\int_0^1 2x e^{x^2}\,dx=\int_0^1 e^u\,du=\Big[e^u\Big]_0^1=e-1.$$
注意这里的上下限已经是 $u$ 的范围，不能再代入 $x$。

examples.problem: 计算 $\int_0^1\sqrt{1-x^2}\,dx$（用三角代换）。
examples.solution:
令 $x=\sin t$，$t\in\left[0,\frac{\pi}{2}\right]$，则 $dx=\cos t\,dt$，且 $\sqrt{1-x^2}=\cos t$（此区间上 $\cos t\ge 0$）。换限：$x=0$ 时 $t=0$，$x=1$ 时 $t=\frac{\pi}{2}$。于是
$$\int_0^1\sqrt{1-x^2}\,dx=\int_0^{\pi/2}\cos^2 t\,dt=\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{1+\cos 2t}{2}\,dt=\frac{\pi}{4}.$$
结果正好是四分之一单位圆的面积，与几何直观一致。

nodes.title: 分部积分法
nodes.summary: 分部积分法由乘积求导法则反推而来，把 ∫u dv 转化为 uv − ∫v du，用于处理乘积形式的积分。
nodes.summaryEn: Integration by parts comes from the product rule and turns ∫u dv into uv − ∫v du, handling integrands that are products.
nodes.definition:
分部积分法来自**乘积的求导法则**。由
$$(uv)'=u'v+uv'$$
移项得 $uv'=(uv)'-u'v$，两边同时积分，并注意 $\int(uv)'dx=uv$，就得到**分部积分公式**
$$\int u\,dv=uv-\int v\,du.$$
它把求 $\int u\,dv$ 换成了求 $\int v\,du$：只要后者更容易算，这次变形就是值得的。

对定积分，公式相应地写成
$$\int_a^b u\,dv=\Big[uv\Big]_a^b-\int_a^b v\,du,$$
即 $uv$ 这一项要连同上下限一起代入求值，剩下的积分仍然带原来的上下限。

使用的关键是**选好 $u$ 与 $dv$**：希望 $u$ 求导后变简单，$dv$ 容易积出来。经验原则是：反三角函数、对数函数适合取作 $u$；指数函数、三角函数适合凑进 $dv$；幂函数通常取作 $u$，把它与指数或三角函数搭配时，每分部一次幂次就降低一次。如果分部一次后积分没有变简单（如 $\int e^x\sin x\,dx$ 出现循环），可以把原积分记为 $I$，移项解方程求出它。
nodes.definitionEn:
Integration by parts comes from the **product rule**. From
$$(uv)'=u'v+uv'$$
we get $uv'=(uv)'-u'v$; integrating both sides, and using $\int(uv)'dx=uv$, yields the **integration by parts formula**
$$\int u\,dv=uv-\int v\,du.$$
It replaces $\int u\,dv$ by $\int v\,du$; the transformation pays off whenever the new integral is easier.

For definite integrals the formula becomes
$$\int_a^b u\,dv=\Big[uv\Big]_a^b-\int_a^b v\,du,$$
so the $uv$ term is evaluated at the limits, while the remaining integral keeps the original limits.

The key step is **choosing $u$ and $dv$ well**: $u$ should become simpler after differentiation, and $dv$ should be easy to integrate. A useful rule of thumb: inverse trigonometric and logarithmic functions make good choices for $u$; exponential and trigonometric functions are good candidates for $dv$; a power function usually serves as $u$, and pairing it with an exponential or a trigonometric factor lowers its degree with each application. If the integral reappears after one application (as in $\int e^x\sin x\,dx$), denote the original integral by $I$ and solve the resulting equation for $I$.

formulas.note: 分部积分公式：把难算的 $\int u\,dv$ 换成可能好算的 $\int v\,du$。
formulas.noteEn: The integration by parts formula: it trades the integral $\int u\,dv$ for the hopefully simpler $\int v\,du$.

formulas.note: 定积分的分部积分公式：$uv$ 项要代入上下限，剩余积分保留原上下限。
formulas.noteEn: The definite-integral version: evaluate $uv$ at the limits and keep the same limits for the remaining integral.

formulas.note: 乘积求导法则——分部积分公式的来源，也是记忆它的最好方式。
formulas.noteEn: The product rule is the source of the formula and the easiest way to remember it.

formulas.note: 典型用法：取 $u=x$（求导后变成常数）、$dv=e^x\,dx$（易积分）。
formulas.noteEn: A model use: take $u=x$, which differentiates to a constant, and $dv=e^x\,dx$, which integrates easily.

formulas.note: 对数函数没有现成积分公式，取 $u=\ln x$、$dv=dx$ 是标准处理方式。
formulas.noteEn: Logarithms have no ready-made integral; taking $u=\ln x$ and $dv=dx$ is the standard move.

expression.text: ∫ u dv = u·v − ∫ v du
expression.note: u 与 dv 的选取决定计算难易：反三角、对数适合当 u，指数、三角适合凑进 dv。
expression.noteEn: The choice of u and dv decides how hard the computation is: inverse trig and log functions make good u, exponentials and trig functions good dv.

properties: 分部积分法与换元积分法是两大基本积分技巧：换元法针对复合结构，分部积分法针对乘积结构。
选择 $u$ 的经验原则：反三角函数、对数函数优先取作 $u$；指数函数、三角函数优先凑成 $dv$；幂函数看搭配对象，通常取作 $u$。
定积分分部时，$uv$ 项必须代入上下限，剩余积分仍使用原来的上下限。
有些积分（如 $\int e^x\sin x\,dx$）分部两次后会回到原积分，此时可通过解方程求出结果。
对含幂函数的乘积（如 $\int x^2 e^x\,dx$），反复使用分部积分，幂函数的次数会逐次降低，直到变成常数。
propertiesEn: Integration by parts and substitution are the two basic techniques: substitution targets compositions, while parts targets products.
Rule of thumb for $u$: inverse trigonometric and logarithmic functions are preferred for $u$; exponential and trigonometric functions for $dv$; power functions usually go into $u$.
In the definite version the $uv$ term is evaluated at the limits, while the remaining integral keeps the original limits.
Some integrals, such as $\int e^x\sin x\,dx$, return to the original after two applications; the value is then found by solving an equation.
For products with a power factor (such as $\int x^2e^x\,dx$), repeated integration by parts decreases the power step by step until it becomes a constant.

plot.title: F(x)=(x−1)e^x 是 f(x)=x·e^x 的原函数：F′(x)=f(x) 体现为切线斜率

examples.problem: 求 $\int x e^x\,dx$。
examples.solution:
取 $u=x$，$dv=e^x\,dx$，则 $du=dx$，$v=e^x$，由分部积分公式得
$$\int x e^x\,dx=xe^x-\int e^x\,dx=(x-1)e^x+C.$$
验算：$\big((x-1)e^x+C\big)'=e^x+(x-1)e^x=xe^x$，正确。

examples.problem: 计算 $\int_0^1 x e^x\,dx$。
求 $\int \ln x\,dx$（$x>0$）。
examples.solution:
取 $u=\ln x$，$dv=dx$，则 $du=\frac{1}{x}\,dx$，$v=x$，于是
$$\int \ln x\,dx=x\ln x-\int x\cdot\frac{1}{x}\,dx=x\ln x-\int 1\,dx=x\ln x-x+C.$$

nodes.title: 定积分
nodes.summary: 定积分是黎曼和的极限，表示带符号的面积，其结果是一个与积分变量记号无关的数。
nodes.summaryEn: The definite integral is the limit of Riemann sums — a signed area and a single number that does not depend on the name of the variable.
nodes.definition:
定积分是由「求曲边梯形的面积」这类问题提炼出来的概念，它的严格定义是**黎曼和的极限**。设 $f(x)$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上有界，把 $[a,b]$ 任意分成 $n$ 个小区间，第 $i$ 个小区间的长度为 $\Delta x_i$，在其中任取一点 $\xi_i$，作黎曼和
$$S=\sum_{i=1}^{n}f(\xi_i)\Delta x_i,$$
并令 $\lambda=\max\{\Delta x_1,\Delta x_2,\dots,\Delta x_n\}$。如果当 $\lambda\to 0$ 时 $S$ 总趋于同一个确定的极限，并且这个极限**既不依赖于区间的分法，也不依赖于 $\xi_i$ 的取法**，就称 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积，该极限称为 $f(x)$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上的**定积分**，记作
$$\int_a^b f(x)\,dx=\lim_{\lambda\to 0}\sum_{i=1}^{n}f(\xi_i)\Delta x_i.$$
这里 $a$、$b$ 分别称为积分下限与积分上限，$f(x)$ 称为被积函数。

要牢记：定积分的结果是一个**数**。它只与积分区间 $[a,b]$ 和被积函数 $f$ 有关，与积分变量用什么字母无关：
$$\int_a^b f(x)\,dx=\int_a^b f(t)\,dt=\int_a^b f(u)\,du.$$
也就是说积分变量是「哑变量」，把它改名不会改变积分的值；这与不定积分中变量仍然参与书写的情况很不一样，也正是「定积分是一个数」的直接体现。

当 $f(x)\ge 0$ 时，定积分的值等于曲线 $y=f(x)$、两条直线 $x=a$、$x=b$ 与 $x$ 轴围成的曲边梯形的面积；当 $f(x)$ 取负值时，对应部分的面积计入负号。因此定积分表示**带符号的面积**，而不是几何面积的简单累加。
nodes.definitionEn:
The definite integral grew out of the problem of finding the area of a curved trapezoid, and its rigorous definition is the **limit of Riemann sums**. Let $f(x)$ be bounded on $[a,b]$. Split $[a,b]$ into $n$ subintervals, the $i$-th having length $\Delta x_i$, choose any point $\xi_i$ in each, and form the Riemann sum
$$S=\sum_{i=1}^{n}f(\xi_i)\Delta x_i,$$
with $\lambda=\max\{\Delta x_1,\Delta x_2,\dots,\Delta x_n\}$. If, as $\lambda\to 0$, $S$ always tends to the same definite limit, **independent both of the partition and of the chosen points $\xi_i$**, then $f$ is called integrable on $[a,b]$ and that limit is called the **definite integral** of $f$ over $[a,b]$:
$$\int_a^b f(x)\,dx=\lim_{\lambda\to 0}\sum_{i=1}^{n}f(\xi_i)\Delta x_i.$$
Here $a$ and $b$ are the lower and upper limits of integration, and $f(x)$ is the integrand.

Remember that a definite integral is a **number**. It depends only on the interval $[a,b]$ and the function $f$, not on the letter used for the variable:
$$\int_a^b f(x)\,dx=\int_a^b f(t)\,dt=\int_a^b f(u)\,du.$$
The variable of integration is a 「dummy variable」: renaming it does not change the value. This is quite different from the indefinite integral and is the direct expression of the fact that a definite integral is a number.

When $f(x)\ge 0$, the integral equals the area of the region bounded by $y=f(x)$, the lines $x=a$, $x=b$, and the $x$-axis; where $f(x)<0$, that part of the area counts as negative. The definite integral therefore measures a **signed area**, not a plain sum of geometric areas.

formulas.note: 定积分的定义：黎曼和的极限，要求极限存在且与分法、取点方式都无关。
formulas.noteEn: The definition: the limit of Riemann sums, required to exist and to be independent of both the partition and the sample points.

formulas.note: 等分区间并取右端点时的黎曼和，是「用定义计算定积分」这类题目最常用的形式。
formulas.noteEn: The equal-partition, right-endpoint form — the most convenient version for computing an integral straight from the definition.

formulas.note: 积分变量的记号无关性（哑变量）：把 $x$ 改写成 $t$ 或 $u$，积分值不变。
formulas.noteEn: Dummy variables: renaming $x$ as $t$ or $u$ leaves the value of the integral unchanged.

formulas.note: 方向性与零区间：交换上下限要变号，上下限相同时积分为零。
formulas.noteEn: Orientation and the empty interval: swapping the limits changes the sign, and equal limits give zero.

formulas.note: 区间可加性：对任意使积分有意义的 $c$ 都成立，是分段处理的基础。
formulas.noteEn: Additivity over intervals: valid for any $c$ for which the integrals make sense, and the basis for splitting the range.

expression.text: ∫ₐᵇ f(x) dx = lim Σ f(ξᵢ)Δxᵢ   (λ→0)
expression.note: 结果是一个数；只有 f ≥ 0 时才等于曲边梯形面积，否则是带符号面积。
expression.noteEn: The result is a number; it equals the area under the curve only when f ≥ 0, otherwise it is a signed area.

properties: 可积的必要条件是有界；连续函数一定可积，单调函数、只有有限个间断点的有界函数也可积，但有界不一定可积（如狄利克雷函数）。
线性性质：$\int_a^b[\alpha f(x)+\beta g(x)]dx=\alpha\int_a^b f(x)\,dx+\beta\int_a^b g(x)\,dx$。
保号与保序：若 $f(x)\ge 0$ 则 $\int_a^b f\,dx\ge 0$；若 $f(x)\le g(x)$ 则 $\int_a^b f\,dx\le\int_a^b g\,dx$。
绝对值不等式：$\left|\int_a^b f(x)\,dx\right|\le\int_a^b|f(x)|\,dx$，等号一般取不到。
积分中值定理：若 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上连续，则存在 $\xi\in[a,b]$ 使 $\int_a^b f(x)\,dx=f(\xi)(b-a)$。
propertiesEn: Boundedness is necessary for Riemann integrability; continuous functions are always integrable, as are monotone functions and bounded functions with finitely many discontinuities, but a bounded function such as the Dirichlet function need not be.
Linearity: $\int_a^b[\alpha f(x)+\beta g(x)]dx=\alpha\int_a^b f(x)\,dx+\beta\int_a^b g(x)\,dx$.
Sign and order preservation: if $f(x)\ge 0$ then $\int_a^b f\,dx\ge 0$, and if $f(x)\le g(x)$ then $\int_a^b f\,dx\le\int_a^b g\,dx$.
Triangle inequality: $\left|\int_a^b f(x)\,dx\right|\le\int_a^b|f(x)|\,dx$, where equality is usually not attained.
Mean value theorem for integrals: if $f$ is continuous on $[a,b]$, there is a point $\xi\in[a,b]$ with $\int_a^b f(x)\,dx=f(\xi)(b-a)$.

plot.title: 定积分的几何意义：∫₀²x²dx = 8/3 等于曲边梯形的面积

examples.problem: 用定积分的定义计算 $\int_0^1 x\,dx$。
examples.solution:
把 $[0,1]$ 等分成 $n$ 份，$\Delta x=\frac{1}{n}$，取 $\xi_i=\frac{i}{n}$，则
$$S_n=\sum_{i=1}^{n}\frac{i}{n}\cdot\frac{1}{n}=\frac{1}{n^2}\cdot\frac{n(n+1)}{2}=\frac{n+1}{2n},$$
令 $n\to\infty$ 得 $\int_0^1 x\,dx=\lim_{n\to\infty}\frac{n+1}{2n}=\frac{1}{2}$。这与三角形面积 $\frac{1}{2}\times 1\times 1=\frac{1}{2}$ 一致。

examples.problem: 利用几何意义求 $\int_0^2\sqrt{4-x^2}\,dx$。
examples.solution:
曲线 $y=\sqrt{4-x^2}$ 是圆心在原点、半径为 $2$ 的上半圆（$y\ge 0$），而积分区间 $[0,2]$ 只取右半部分，因此所求积分等于四分之一圆的面积：
$$\int_0^2\sqrt{4-x^2}\,dx=\frac{1}{4}\pi\cdot 2^2=\pi.$$

nodes.title: 微积分基本定理
nodes.summary: 微积分基本定理说明微分与积分互为逆运算，并给出用原函数计算定积分的牛顿–莱布尼茨公式。
nodes.summaryEn: The Fundamental Theorem of Calculus makes differentiation and integration inverse operations and gives the Newton–Leibniz rule for evaluating definite integrals.
nodes.definition:
微积分基本定理是连接「微分」与「积分」的桥梁，它包含两部分内容。

**第一部分（变上限积分求导）**：若 $f(x)$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上连续，则对任意 $x\in[a,b]$，面积函数
$$\Phi(x)=\int_a^x f(t)\,dt$$
在 $[a,b]$ 上可导，并且
$$\Phi'(x)=f(x),\quad x\in[a,b].$$
也就是说：连续函数的变上限积分就是它的一个原函数，求导与积分在这一点上互为逆运算。

**第二部分（牛顿–莱布尼茨公式）**：若 $f(x)$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上连续，且 $F(x)$ 是 $f(x)$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上的任意一个原函数（即 $F'(x)=f(x)$），则
$$\int_a^b f(x)\,dx=F(b)-F(a)=\Big[F(x)\Big]_a^b.$$
使用前必须核对两个条件：$f$ 在闭区间 $[a,b]$ 上连续、$F$ 确实是 $f$ 的原函数，缺一不可；如果 $f$ 在区间内有无界或跳跃间断，直接套用公式可能得到错误结果（此时应按反常积分或分段处理）。

这条定理把「求黎曼和的极限」这一困难操作简化为「求原函数并代入端点」，是定积分能够被广泛计算的根本原因，也是整个微积分体系中最重要的结论。
nodes.definitionEn:
The Fundamental Theorem of Calculus is the bridge between differentiation and integration, and it has two parts.

**Part 1 (derivative of an area function).** If $f(x)$ is continuous on $[a,b]$, then for every $x\in[a,b]$ the area function
$$\Phi(x)=\int_a^x f(t)\,dt$$
is differentiable on $[a,b]$, and
$$\Phi'(x)=f(x),\quad x\in[a,b].$$
In other words, the variable-upper-limit integral of a continuous function is an antiderivative of that function: differentiation and integration are inverse operations in this sense.

**Part 2 (the Newton–Leibniz formula).** If $f(x)$ is continuous on $[a,b]$ and $F(x)$ is any antiderivative of $f(x)$ on $[a,b]$ (that is, $F'(x)=f(x)$), then
$$\int_a^b f(x)\,dx=F(b)-F(a)=\Big[F(x)\Big]_a^b.$$
Both hypotheses must be verified: continuity of $f$ on the closed interval and the fact that $F'=f$. If the integrand is unbounded or has a jump inside the interval, applying the formula blindly can give a wrong answer; such cases must be treated as improper integrals or split into pieces.

By reducing the hard operation of taking the limit of Riemann sums to finding an antiderivative and substituting the endpoints, this theorem is the reason definite integrals can be computed at all, and it is the single most important result of calculus.

formulas.note: 变上限积分求导：连续函数的积分上限函数就是它的一个原函数。
formulas.noteEn: Differentiating a variable-upper-limit integral: for a continuous function this integral is an antiderivative.

formulas.note: 上下限都可变时的求导公式，需要配合链式法则使用。
formulas.noteEn: When both limits depend on $x$, combine with the chain rule as shown.

formulas.note: 牛顿–莱布尼茨公式；使用条件：$f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上连续，$F$ 是 $f$ 的原函数。
formulas.noteEn: The Newton–Leibniz formula; hypotheses: $f$ continuous on $[a,b]$ and $F$ an antiderivative of $f$.

formulas.note: 取定 $\Phi$ 为变上限积分时，牛顿–莱布尼茨公式成为恒等式，第二部分由第一部分直接推出。
formulas.noteEn: Choosing the area function $\Phi$ makes the Newton–Leibniz formula an identity, so Part 2 follows directly from Part 1.

expression.text: ∫ₐᵇ f(x) dx = F(b) − F(a),  F′(x) = f(x)
expression.note: 使用前提是 f 在 [a,b] 上连续、F 是 f 的原函数；先代上限再减代下限。
expression.noteEn: Valid when f is continuous on [a,b] and F is an antiderivative of f; substitute the upper limit first, then subtract the lower limit.

properties: 变上限积分 $\Phi(x)=\int_a^x f(t)\,dt$ 是 $f$ 的一个原函数，这给出了「连续函数必有原函数」的构造性证明。
牛顿–莱布尼茨公式把定积分的计算归结为求原函数，使定积分从极限定义变成可以具体算出的数。
差额 $F(b)-F(a)$ 与原函数的选取无关：不同原函数只相差常数 $C$，相减时自动消去。
$F'(x)=f(x)$ 与 $f(x)\ge 0$ 时，$\Phi'(x)=f(x)\ge 0$ 说明面积函数随上限增大而不减（在 $f$ 取正值的部分严格增大），与几何直观一致。
若 $f$ 在区间内有间断点或趋于无穷，不能直接使用公式，需要分段积分或按反常积分处理。
propertiesEn: The area function $\Phi(x)=\int_a^x f(t)\,dt$ is an antiderivative of $f$, which gives a constructive proof that every continuous function has an antiderivative.
The Newton–Leibniz formula reduces the computation of a definite integral to finding an antiderivative, turning a limit of sums into a concrete number.
The difference $F(b)-F(a)$ does not depend on which antiderivative is chosen: two antiderivatives differ by a constant, which cancels on subtraction.
When $F'=f$ and $f(x)\ge 0$, we have $\Phi'(x)=f(x)\ge 0$, so the area function is nondecreasing in the upper limit (strictly increasing where f is positive), as geometric intuition suggests.
If the integrand has a discontinuity or blows up inside the interval, the formula cannot be applied directly; split the interval or treat the integral as improper.

plot.title: 面积函数 Φ(x)=∫₀ˣ t²dt 随 x 增大不断累积

examples.problem: 设 $\Phi(x)=\int_0^x e^{-t^2}\,dt$，求 $\Phi'(x)$。
examples.solution: 被积函数 $e^{-t^2}$ 在 $\mathbb{R}$ 上连续，由定理第一部分直接得 $\Phi'(x)=e^{-x^2}$。注意 $e^{-t^2}$ 的原函数不能用初等函数表示，但变上限积分仍然处处可导。

examples.problem: 求 $\frac{d}{dx}\int_0^{x^2}\sin t\,dt$。
examples.solution:
令 $u=x^2$，则 $\frac{d}{du}\int_0^u\sin t\,dt=\sin u$，再由链式法则乘上 $u'=2x$：
$$\frac{d}{dx}\int_0^{x^2}\sin t\,dt=\sin(x^2)\cdot 2x=2x\sin(x^2).$$

examples.problem: 计算 $\int_0^{\pi/2}\cos x\,dx$。
examples.solution:
$f(x)=\cos x$ 在 $\left[0,\frac{\pi}{2}\right]$ 上连续，$F(x)=\sin x$ 是它的一个原函数，由牛顿–莱布尼茨公式：
$$\int_0^{\pi/2}\cos x\,dx=\Big[\sin x\Big]_0^{\pi/2}=\sin\frac{\pi}{2}-\sin 0=1.$$
被积函数 $\frac{1}{x^2}$ 在 $x=0$ 处无定义且在附近无界，不满足「在闭区间 $[-1,1]$ 上连续」这一条件，因此**不能**直接使用牛顿–莱布尼茨公式。该积分应作为反常积分处理，它在 $[0,1]$ 上已经发散（趋于 $+\infty$），所以原积分发散，无值可言；而上面算出的 $-2$ 与被积函数恒正的事实矛盾，正好暴露了条件的缺失。

nodes.title: 反常积分
nodes.summary: 反常积分把定积分推广到无穷区间或无界函数的情形，用极限来定义，并判断其收敛与发散。
nodes.summaryEn: Improper integrals extend the definite integral to infinite intervals or unbounded functions; they are defined by limits and classified as convergent or divergent.
nodes.definition:
定积分要求积分区间有限、被积函数有界。当这两个条件之一被打破时，就用**极限**来定义积分，这样的积分称为**反常积分**（也叫广义积分）。反常积分分为两类。

**第一类：无穷区间上的反常积分。** 例如
$$\int_a^{+\infty}f(x)\,dx=\lim_{b\to+\infty}\int_a^b f(x)\,dx.$$
若右端的极限存在（为有限数），就说该反常积分**收敛**，并把极限值作为积分的值；若极限不存在（包括趋于无穷），就说它**发散**。对 $(-\infty,b]$ 同理；对 $(-\infty,+\infty)$ 上的积分，需任取一点 $c$，要求 $\int_{-\infty}^{c}$ 与 $\int_c^{+\infty}$ **都收敛**，只要有一段发散，整体就发散。

**第二类：无界函数的反常积分（瑕积分）。** 若 $f(x)$ 在 $b$ 的左侧无界（称 $b$ 为瑕点），则
$$\int_a^b f(x)\,dx=\lim_{t\to b^-}\int_a^t f(x)\,dx,$$
同样以极限是否存在来判断收敛与发散；瑕点在区间内部时，必须以瑕点为界拆成两段分别讨论，两段都收敛才算收敛。

判断敛散性最常用的标准是**$p$ 积分**：$\int_1^{+\infty}\frac{dx}{x^p}$ 当 $p>1$ 时收敛（值为 $\frac{1}{p-1}$）、当 $p\le 1$ 时发散；而 $\int_0^1\frac{dx}{x^p}$ 恰好相反，当 $p<1$ 时收敛（值为 $\frac{1}{1-p}$）、当 $p\ge 1$ 时发散。注意两者的不等式方向相反，这是最经典的易错点。
nodes.definitionEn:
A definite integral requires a finite interval and a bounded integrand. When either requirement fails, the integral is defined by a **limit** and is called an **improper integral**. There are two kinds.

**Type 1: infinite intervals.** For example,
$$\int_a^{+\infty}f(x)\,dx=\lim_{b\to+\infty}\int_a^b f(x)\,dx.$$
If this limit exists as a finite number, the improper integral is said to **converge**, and the limit is its value; if the limit fails to exist (in particular, if it is infinite), the integral **diverges**. The case $(-\infty,b]$ is analogous, and for $(-\infty,+\infty)$ we pick any $c$ and require **both** $\int_{-\infty}^{c}$ and $\int_c^{+\infty}$ to converge; if either diverges, so does the whole integral.

**Type 2: unbounded functions (integrals with a singular point).** If $f(x)$ is unbounded to the left of $b$ (so $b$ is a singular point), then
$$\int_a^b f(x)\,dx=\lim_{t\to b^-}\int_a^t f(x)\,dx,$$
and convergence is again decided by the existence of the limit. If the singular point lies inside the interval, the integral must be split there, and both pieces must converge.

The most useful test is provided by the **$p$-integrals**: $\int_1^{+\infty}\frac{dx}{x^p}$ converges for $p>1$ (with value $\frac{1}{p-1}$) and diverges for $p\le 1$; by contrast $\int_0^1\frac{dx}{x^p}$ converges exactly for $p<1$ (with value $\frac{1}{1-p}$) and diverges for $p\ge 1$. The two inequalities point in opposite directions — the classic trap of this topic.

formulas.note: 无穷区间型反常积分：用上限趋于无穷的极限来定义，极限存在才收敛。
formulas.noteEn: Improper integral over an infinite interval: defined by a limit as the upper endpoint tends to infinity; it converges only when that limit exists.

formulas.note: 无界函数型（瑕点在 $b$）：用积分上限趋近瑕点的极限定义；瑕点在内部时必须拆成两段。
formulas.noteEn: Unbounded integrand with singular point at $b$: defined by letting the endpoint approach the singular point; an interior singular point forces a split into two pieces.

formulas.note: 无穷区间的 $p$ 积分判据：$p=1$ 时就是发散的调和积分 $\int_1^{+\infty}\frac{dx}{x}$。
formulas.noteEn: The $p$-test on an infinite interval; the case $p=1$ is the divergent harmonic integral $\int_1^{+\infty}\frac{dx}{x}$.

formulas.note: 无界函数的 $p$ 积分判据：收敛范围与无穷区间的情形方向相反，务必区分。
formulas.noteEn: The $p$-test for an unbounded integrand: the convergence range is the opposite of the infinite-interval case — do not mix them up.

formulas.note: 一个重要的收敛反常积分：原函数不是初等函数，但极限值为 $\frac{\sqrt{\pi}}{2}$，是概率论中正态分布归一化的基础。
formulas.noteEn: An important convergent improper integral: the antiderivative is not elementary, yet the limit equals $\frac{\sqrt{\pi}}{2}$, the normalisation constant of the normal distribution.

expression.note: p > 1 收敛（值为 1/(p−1)），p ≤ 1 发散；判断别的反常积分时常以它作为比较标准。
expression.noteEn: Converges for p > 1 with value 1/(p−1), diverges for p ≤ 1; it is the standard yardstick for comparison.

properties: 反常积分的值由极限定义，所以讨论的第一步永远是判断它收敛还是发散，而不是直接算出数值。
比较判别法：若 $0\le f(x)\le g(x)$（$x\ge a$），则 $\int_a^{+\infty}g\,dx$ 收敛可推出 $\int_a^{+\infty}f\,dx$ 收敛，$\int_a^{+\infty}f\,dx$ 发散可推出 $\int_a^{+\infty}g\,dx$ 发散。
无穷区间的 $p$ 积分在 $p>1$ 时收敛、$p\le 1$ 时发散；无界函数的 $p$ 积分恰好相反，在 $p<1$ 时收敛、$p\ge 1$ 时发散。
牛顿–莱布尼茨公式不能直接用在有瑕点的区间上：例如 $\int_{-1}^{1}\frac{dx}{x^2}$ 发散，而形式代入原函数会错误地得到 $-2$。
收敛的反常积分仍满足线性性质与区间可加性；$(-\infty,+\infty)$ 上的积分必须两段都收敛才算收敛。
propertiesEn: The value of an improper integral is defined by a limit, so the first question is always whether it converges rather than what number it equals.

Comparison test: if $0\le f(x)\le g(x)$ for $x\ge a$, then convergence of $\int_a^{+\infty}g\,dx$ implies convergence of $\int_a^{+\infty}f\,dx$, while divergence of $\int_a^{+\infty}f\,dx$ implies divergence of $\int_a^{+\infty}g\,dx$.
The $p$-integral over an infinite interval converges for $p>1$ and diverges for $p\le 1$; for an unbounded integrand the opposite holds — convergence for $p<1$, divergence for $p\ge 1$.
The Newton–Leibniz formula must not be applied across a singular point: $\int_{-1}^{1}\frac{dx}{x^2}$ diverges, although formally substituting the antiderivative gives the wrong value $-2$.
Convergent improper integrals are linear and additive over intervals; an integral over $(-\infty,+\infty)$ converges only if both halves do.

plot.title: ∫₁^∞ dx/x² 收敛（尾面积有限），∫₁^∞ dx/x 发散（尾面积无限）

examples.problem: 计算 $\int_1^{+\infty}\frac{dx}{x^2}$。
examples.solution:
按定义先算有限区间上的积分，再取极限：
$$\int_1^{+\infty}\frac{dx}{x^2}=\lim_{b\to+\infty}\int_1^b x^{-2}\,dx=\lim_{b\to+\infty}\left[-\frac{1}{x}\right]_1^b=\lim_{b\to+\infty}\left(1-\frac{1}{b}\right)=1.$$
这是 $p=2>1$ 的 $p$ 积分，与判据一致：虽然曲线无限延伸，尾部的面积却是有限的。

examples.problem: 判断 $\int_0^1\frac{dx}{\sqrt{x}}$ 的敛散性并求值。
examples.solution:
被积函数在 $x\to 0^+$ 时趋于 $+\infty$，瑕点在 $x=0$，按第二类反常积分定义：
$$\int_0^1\frac{dx}{\sqrt{x}}=\lim_{t\to 0^+}\int_t^1 x^{-1/2}\,dx=\lim_{t\to 0^+}\Big[2\sqrt{x}\Big]_t^1=\lim_{t\to 0^+}\big(2-2\sqrt{t}\big)=2.$$
这里 $p=\frac{1}{2}<1$，收敛，与 $p$ 积分判据一致。

examples.problem: 判断下列反常积分的敛散性：(1) $\int_1^{+\infty}\frac{dx}{x}$；(2) $\int_0^{+\infty}\frac{dx}{1+x^2}$。
examples.solution:
(1) $\int_1^b\frac{dx}{x}=\ln b\to+\infty$，故发散；这正是 $p=1$ 的临界情形，说明 $\int_1^{+\infty}\frac{dx}{x^p}$ 的收敛范围必须写成 $p>1$ 而不能放宽到 $p\ge 1$。
(2) $\int_0^b\frac{dx}{1+x^2}=\arctan b-\arctan 0$，当 $b\to+\infty$ 时 $\arctan b\to\frac{\pi}{2}$，故积分收敛，值为 $\frac{\pi}{2}$。

nodes.title: 定积分求面积
nodes.summary: 由曲线围成的平面图形面积可用定积分计算：区间内「上减下」再取绝对值，两曲线相交时先求交点再分段。
nodes.summaryEn: Areas bounded by curves are computed by integrating the upper curve minus the lower one, splitting the interval at intersection points.
nodes.definition:
定积分最直接的几何应用就是求平面图形的面积。设 $f(x)$ 与 $g(x)$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上连续，若在 $[a,b]$ 上恒有 $f(x)\ge g(x)$，则曲线 $y=f(x)$、$y=g(x)$ 与直线 $x=a$、$x=b$ 围成的图形面积为
$$A=\int_a^b\big[f(x)-g(x)\big]dx,$$
也就是口诀「**上减下**」。当 $g(x)\equiv 0$ 时它退化成曲线与 $x$ 轴之间的面积。

如果两条曲线的上下位置在区间内发生互换，就应该先求出交点，把区间分成若干段，在每一段内分别判断谁上谁下，再把各段结果相加；更紧凑的写法是利用绝对值：
$$A=\int_a^b\big|f(x)-g(x)\big|dx.$$
绝对值保证被积函数非负，所以算出的 $A$ 一定不小于 $0$——这正是「定积分求面积」与「带符号的定积分」的区别。

有时曲线用 $x=\varphi(y)$ 的形式给出更方便（例如 $x=y^2$ 这类开口朝右的抛物线），这时把图形切成水平窄条，用**右减左**：
$$A=\int_c^d\big[x_R(y)-x_L(y)\big]dy.$$
选择对 $x$ 还是对 $y$ 积分，原则是「哪种切法不需要分段，就用哪种」。面积问题的通用步骤是：画草图、求交点定区间、判断上下（或左右）关系、列出积分并计算。
nodes.definitionEn:
The most immediate geometric application of the definite integral is finding the area of a plane region. Let $f(x)$ and $g(x)$ be continuous on $[a,b]$ with $f(x)\ge g(x)$ throughout. Then the area bounded by $y=f(x)$, $y=g(x)$ and the lines $x=a$, $x=b$ is
$$A=\int_a^b\big[f(x)-g(x)\big]dx,$$
the familiar rule 「upper minus lower」. Taking $g(x)\equiv 0$ reduces this to the area between a curve and the $x$-axis.

If the two curves swap their relative positions inside the interval, first find the intersection points, split the interval there, decide which curve is on top in each piece, and add the results; a compact way to write this is
$$A=\int_a^b\big|f(x)-g(x)\big|dx.$$
The absolute value keeps the integrand nonnegative, so the area $A$ computed this way can never be negative — precisely the difference between 「area by integration」 and a signed definite integral.

Sometimes the curves are more conveniently given as $x=\varphi(y)$ (for instance the right-opening parabola $x=y^2$). Then slice the region into horizontal strips and subtract left from right:
$$A=\int_c^d\big[x_R(y)-x_L(y)\big]dy.$$
The rule for choosing between integrating in $x$ and in $y$ is simple: use the slicing that keeps the 「upper minus lower」 relation valid on the whole interval. The general plan is to sketch the region, find the intersections to fix the interval, decide which curve is above (or on the right), and then set up and evaluate the integral.

formulas.note: 上减下：区间内上方的曲线减去下方的曲线，结果就是图形面积。
formulas.noteEn: Upper minus lower: integrating the difference gives the area when one curve lies above the other throughout the interval.

formulas.note: 通用公式：用绝对值自动处理上下互换；实际计算时在交点处分段去掉绝对值。
formulas.noteEn: The general formula: the absolute value handles any change of order; in practice split at the intersection points and remove the absolute value piecewise.

formulas.note: 右减左：把图形切成水平条时使用，适合 $x=y^2$ 这类关于 $y$ 更易表达的曲线。
formulas.noteEn: Right minus left: used when slicing horizontally, ideal for curves such as $x=y^2$ that are simpler in terms of $y$.

formulas.note: 曲线与 $x$ 轴之间的面积，相当于取 $g(x)=0$ 的特例。
formulas.noteEn: The area between a curve and the $x$-axis, the special case $g(x)=0$ of the general rule.

expression.text: A = ∫ₐᵇ (上曲线 − 下曲线) dx
expression.note: 两曲线相交时必须先求交点再分段；被积函数必须保证非负（上减下）。
expression.noteEn: If the curves intersect, find the intersection points and split; the integrand must be nonnegative (upper minus lower).

properties: 面积恒为非负，所以被积函数是「上减下」；把上下关系写反会得到与原面积互为相反数的结果。
两曲线相交时必须以交点为分界点分段积分，或者在绝对值内统一处理。
对 $x$ 积分还是对 $y$ 积分可以自由选择，标准是能否在整个区间上保持「上减下（右减左）」关系不变。
与 $x$ 轴围成的面积等于 $\int_a^b|f(x)|dx$；曲线穿过 $x$ 轴时同样需要分段。
面积、体积、弧长公式都是「微元法」的产物：把图形切成窄条，用矩形近似，再取极限求和。
propertiesEn: Areas are never negative, so the integrand must be 「upper minus lower」; reversing the order yields the negative of the true area.
When two curves intersect, the interval must be split at the intersection points, or the absolute value must be handled uniformly.
One may integrate with respect to $x$ or with respect to $y$; the criterion is whether the upper-minus-lower (right-minus-left) relation holds unchanged over the whole interval.
The area between a curve and the $x$-axis is $\int_a^b|f(x)|dx$; if the curve crosses the axis, split again.
Area, volume and arc length all come from the element method: slice the figure into thin strips, approximate by rectangles, and pass to the limit.

plot.title: y=x 与 y=x² 之间的面积：上减下得 A=∫₀¹(x−x²)dx=1/6

examples.problem: 求曲线 $y=x$ 与 $y=x^2$ 围成的图形面积。
examples.solution:
先求交点：由 $x=x^2$ 得 $x=0$ 或 $x=1$。在 $(0,1)$ 内 $x>x^2$，即直线在上、抛物线在下，于是
$$A=\int_0^1(x-x^2)\,dx=\left[\frac{x^2}{2}-\frac{x^3}{3}\right]_0^1=\frac{1}{2}-\frac{1}{3}=\frac{1}{6}.$$

examples.problem: 求由抛物线 $y^2=x$ 与直线 $y=x-2$ 围成的图形面积。
examples.solution:
两曲线改写为 $x=y^2$ 与 $x=y+2$。求交点：$y^2=y+2$，得 $y=2$（此时 $x=4$）或 $y=-1$（此时 $x=1$）。由于曲线在 $y$ 方向表达更方便，切成水平条、用「右减左」，在 $y\in[-1,2]$ 上 $y+2\ge y^2$：
$$A=\int_{-1}^{2}\big[(y+2)-y^2\big]dy=\left[\frac{y^2}{2}+2y-\frac{y^3}{3}\right]_{-1}^{2}=\frac{10}{3}-\left(-\frac{7}{6}\right)=\frac{9}{2}.$$

nodes.title: 定积分求体积
nodes.summary: 旋转体体积可用圆盘法 V=π∫[f(x)]²dx（绕 x 轴）或壳层法 V=2π∫x·f(x)dx（绕 y 轴）计算。
nodes.summaryEn: Volumes of solids of revolution come from the disk method V=π∫[f(x)]²dx or the shell method V=2π∫x·f(x)dx.
nodes.definition:
立体的体积可以用**微元法**求：把立体沿某个方向切成许多薄片，用柱体体积公式近似每一片，再求和取极限，就得到一般公式
$$V=\int_a^b A(x)\,dx,$$
其中 $A(x)$ 是垂直于 $x$ 轴、位于位置 $x$ 处的截面面积。这是体积问题的一般框架。

最常用的一类立体是**旋转体**：把平面图形绕某条坐标轴旋转一周得到的立体。若曲线为 $y=f(x)\ge 0$（$a\le x\le b$），绕 $x$ 轴旋转时，垂直于 $x$ 轴的截面是半径为 $f(x)$ 的圆，面积 $A(x)=\pi[f(x)]^2$，于是
$$V=\pi\int_a^b\big[f(x)\big]^2\,dx,$$
这称为**圆盘法**。如果旋转的图形夹在两条曲线之间，截面变成圆环，面积是 $\pi[R(x)^2-r(x)^2]$，对应称为**垫圈法**。

如果绕 $y$ 轴旋转，也可以竖直切片：把半径为 $x$、高为 $f(x)$、厚为 $dx$ 的薄圆柱壳展开，体积为 $2\pi x f(x)\,dx$，因此
$$V=2\pi\int_a^b x f(x)\,dx,$$
这称为**壳层法**。其适用条件是 $f(x)\ge 0$ 且在积分区间上 $a\ge 0$（保证壳层半径 $x$ 非负）。壳层法的优点是：绕 $y$ 轴旋转时不必先把 $y=f(x)$ 解成 $x=\varphi(y)$。
nodes.definitionEn:
Volumes of solids can be computed by the **element method**: slice the solid into thin slabs perpendicular to some axis, approximate each slab by a cylinder, and pass to the limit. This gives
$$V=\int_a^b A(x)\,dx,$$
where $A(x)$ is the cross-sectional area at position $x$. This is the general framework.

The most common solids of this type are **solids of revolution**, obtained by rotating a plane region about a coordinate axis. If the curve is $y=f(x)\ge 0$ on $a\le x\le b$ and it is rotated about the $x$-axis, each cross-section perpendicular to the axis is a disk of radius $f(x)$, so $A(x)=\pi[f(x)]^2$ and
$$V=\pi\int_a^b\big[f(x)\big]^2\,dx,$$
the **disk method**. If the rotated region lies between two curves, the cross-section is a washer of area $\pi[R(x)^2-r(x)^2]$, giving the **washer method**.

When rotating about the $y$-axis one may instead slice vertically: a thin cylindrical shell of radius $x$, height $f(x)$ and thickness $dx$ unfolds to volume $2\pi x f(x)\,dx$, hence
$$V=2\pi\int_a^b x f(x)\,dx,$$
the **shell method**. It requires $f(x)\ge 0$ and $a\ge 0$ on the interval of integration, so that the shell radius $x$ is nonnegative. Its advantage is that one does not have to solve $y=f(x)$ for $x=\varphi(y)$ when rotating about the $y$-axis.

formulas.note: 圆盘法（绕 $x$ 轴）：要求 $f(x)\ge 0$，截面是半径为 $f(x)$ 的圆。
formulas.noteEn: Disk method about the $x$-axis, requiring $f(x)\ge 0$: each cross-section is a disk of radius $f(x)$.

formulas.note: 垫圈法：$R$ 为外半径、$r$ 为内半径，适用于旋转截面是圆环的图形。
formulas.noteEn: Washer method: $R$ and $r$ are the outer and inner radii, used when the cross-section is an annulus.

formulas.note: 壳层法（绕 $y$ 轴）：$x$ 是壳层半径、$f(x)$ 是壳层高度；要求 $f(x)\ge 0$ 且 $a\ge 0$。
formulas.noteEn: Shell method about the $y$-axis: $x$ is the shell radius and $f(x)$ the shell height; it requires $f(x)\ge 0$ and $a\ge 0$.

formulas.note: 一般截面法：只要能把垂直于 $x$ 轴的截面面积写成函数 $A(x)$，就可以用这个公式。
formulas.noteEn: General slicing: as long as the cross-sectional area can be written as a function $A(x)$, this formula applies.

formulas.note: 因为 $(\sqrt{x})^2=x$，圆盘法的积分立即化为幂函数积分。
formulas.noteEn: Since $(\sqrt{x})^2=x$, the disk integral immediately reduces to a power function.

expression.text: V = π∫ₐᵇ [f(x)]² dx   （绕 x 轴）
expression.note: 圆盘法：把旋转体切成薄圆盘；若截面是圆环，改用 π∫(R²−r²)dx。
expression.noteEn: Disk method: slice the solid into thin disks; if a cross-section is an annulus, use π∫(R²−r²)dx instead.

properties: 旋转轴是每个截面的对称轴：绕 $x$ 轴旋转时截面垂直于 $x$ 轴，圆盘半径就是 $f(x)$。
圆盘法与壳层法只是切片方向不同，结果必然相同，选哪一种取决于半径与高度用哪个变量表达更简单。
壳层法 $V=2\pi\int_a^b x f(x)\,dx$ 要求 $a\ge 0$ 且 $f(x)\ge 0$（壳层半径与高度都非负）；若图形跨越 $y$ 轴，需要分段或利用对称性。
垫圈法的被积函数 $R^2-r^2$ 恒非负；如果算出的体积为负，说明内外半径或上下曲线选反了。
同样的微元法适用于非旋转体：只要能写出截面面积 $A(x)$（如正三角形、半圆截面），都可以用 $V=\int A(x)\,dx$。
propertiesEn: The axis of rotation is the symmetry axis of every cross-section: rotating about the $x$-axis makes each disk perpendicular to that axis with radius $f(x)$.
The disk and shell methods differ only in the direction of slicing; they must give the same volume, and the choice depends on whether the radius and height are simpler in $x$ or in $y$.

The shell formula $V=2\pi\int_a^b x f(x)\,dx$ requires $a\ge 0$ and $f(x)\ge 0$, so that both the shell radius and height are nonnegative; a region crossing the $y$-axis must be split or handled by symmetry.
