nodes.title: 齐次线性方程组与基础解系
nodes.titleEn: Homogeneous Linear Systems and Fundamental Systems of Solutions
nodes.summary: 齐次方程组 Ax=0 的全部解构成解空间，维数为 n−r(A)；取解空间的一组基作基础解系，通解就是基础解系的任意线性组合。
nodes.summaryEn: The solutions of a homogeneous system Ax=0 form a subspace of dimension n−r(A); choosing a basis of it (a fundamental system of solutions) turns the general solution into arbitrary linear combinations of that basis.
nodes.definition:
形如 $A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{0}$（右边常数项全为零）的方程组称为**齐次线性方程组**，其中 $A$ 是 $m\times n$ 矩阵，$\boldsymbol{x}\in\mathbb{R}^n$。它永远有解：$\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{0}$ 总是解，称为**零解**；如果还有别的解，那些解称为**非零解**。有没有非零解只看秩：**有非零解 ⟺ r(A)<n**（$n$ 是未知数个数）；当 $r(A)=n$ 时只有零解。
齐次方程组最漂亮的地方是解集的形状。若 $\boldsymbol{x},\boldsymbol{y}$ 都是 $A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{0}$ 的解，则 $\boldsymbol{x}+\boldsymbol{y}$ 也是解、$k\boldsymbol{x}$ 也是解（因为 $A(\boldsymbol{x}+\boldsymbol{y})=A\boldsymbol{x}+A\boldsymbol{y}=\boldsymbol{0}$，$A(k\boldsymbol{x})=kA\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{0}$）。也就是说**解集对加法与数乘封闭**，是 $\mathbb{R}^n$ 的一个子空间，称为**解空间**，记作 $N(A)$。设 $r(A)=r$，则
$$\dim N(A)=n-r.$$
直观地说：未知数有 $n$ 个，独立的方程只有 $r$ 条，剩下的 $n-r$ 个变量可以自由取值——维数正好是自由度的个数；行化简后，非主元列的个数（自由变量个数）就是这个 $n-r$。
取解空间 $N(A)$ 的一组基 $\eta_1,\dots,\eta_{n-r}$，称为方程组的一个**基础解系**：它们是 $n-r$ 个线性无关的解，且方程组的每一个解都能由它们线性表示。于是方程组的**通解**为
$$\boldsymbol{x}=k_1\eta_1+\cdots+k_{n-r}\eta_{n-r},\qquad k_1,\dots,k_{n-r}\in\mathbb{R},$$
其中 $k_i$ 是任意常数。基础解系不唯一（解空间的任何一组基都可以），但它含的向量个数 $n-r$ 是唯一确定的。
nodes.definitionEn:
A system of the form $A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{0}$ (all constant terms zero) is a **homogeneous linear system**, where $A$ is an $m\times n$ matrix and $\boldsymbol{x}\in\mathbb{R}^n$. It is always consistent: $\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{0}$, the **zero solution**, always works; any other solution is called a **nonzero solution**. Whether nonzero solutions exist depends only on the rank: **there is a nonzero solution iff $r(A)<n$** ($n$ = number of unknowns); if $r(A)=n$ the zero solution is the only one.
The beauty of homogeneous systems lies in the shape of the solution set. If $\boldsymbol{x},\boldsymbol{y}$ solve $A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{0}$, then so do $\boldsymbol{x}+\boldsymbol{y}$ and $k\boldsymbol{x}$, since $A(\boldsymbol{x}+\boldsymbol{y})=A\boldsymbol{x}+A\boldsymbol{y}=\boldsymbol{0}$ and $A(k\boldsymbol{x})=kA\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{0}$. The solution set is thus **closed under addition and scalar multiplication**: a subspace of $\mathbb{R}^n$, called the **solution space** (or null space) $N(A)$. If $r(A)=r$, then $\dim N(A)=n-r$. Intuitively: there are $n$ unknowns but only $r$ independent equations, leaving $n-r$ free variables — precisely the number of degrees of freedom, and also the number of non-pivot columns after row reduction.
Choosing a basis $\eta_1,\dots,\eta_{n-r}$ of $N(A)$ gives a **fundamental system of solutions**: $n-r$ linearly independent solutions in terms of which every solution can be expressed. The **general solution** is then
$$\boldsymbol{x}=k_1\eta_1+\cdots+k_{n-r}\eta_{n-r},\qquad k_1,\dots,k_{n-r}\in\mathbb{R},$$
with arbitrary constants $k_i$. A fundamental system is not unique — any basis of the solution space will do — but the number of vectors in it, $n-r$, is uniquely determined.

formulas.note: n 是未知数个数；等价地，方程个数少于未知数个数（m<n）时必有非零解。
formulas.noteEn: n is the number of unknowns; equivalently, fewer equations than unknowns (m<n) always forces a nonzero solution.

formulas.note: 解空间（齐次方程组全部解的集合）的维数等于未知数个数减去系数矩阵的秩，即自由变量的个数。
formulas.noteEn: The dimension of the solution space equals the number of unknowns minus the rank, i.e. the number of free variables.

formulas.note: 齐次方程组的通解：基础解系 η₁,…,η_{n−r} 的任意线性组合，k_i 为任意常数。
formulas.noteEn: General solution of the homogeneous system: arbitrary linear combinations of a fundamental system η₁,…,η_{n−r}, with arbitrary constants k_i.

formulas.note: 解集对加法与数乘封闭——这正是它能成为向量空间、能谈「基」的原因。
formulas.noteEn: The solution set is closed under addition and scalar multiplication — the reason it is a vector space admitting a basis.

properties: 齐次方程组必有零解；只有零解 ⟺ r(A)=n；有非零解（因而有无穷多解）⟺ r(A)<n。
方程个数少于未知数个数时（m<n）必有非零解，因为 r(A)≤m<n；此时解空间维数至少为 1。
解空间是 ℝⁿ 的子空间，dim N(A)=n−r(A)；基础解系恰含 n−r(A) 个向量——个数唯一，但基础解系本身不唯一（解空间的任何一组基都是基础解系）。
给定基础解系后，通解是其任意线性组合，系数为任意常数；反过来，每个解写成基础解系的组合时系数还是唯一的（因为基础解系线性无关）。
齐次方程组的任意两个解之差仍是解、任意有限个解之和仍是解、解的任意倍数仍是解；所有这些解合起来正好取遍解空间。
propertiesEn: A homogeneous system always has the zero solution; the zero solution is unique iff r(A)=n, and nonzero solutions (hence infinitely many) exist iff r(A)<n.
If there are fewer equations than unknowns (m<n) then nonzero solutions always exist, since r(A)≤m<n; the solution space then has dimension at least 1.

The solution space is a subspace of ℝⁿ with dim N(A)=n−r(A); a fundamental system contains exactly n−r(A) vectors — that number is unique although the fundamental system itself is not (any basis of the solution space qualifies).

Once a fundamental system is fixed, the general solution is an arbitrary linear combination of it; conversely the coefficients expressing a given solution are unique, because a fundamental system is linearly independent.
Differences, finite sums and scalar multiples of solutions are again solutions; taken together they fill the entire solution space.

plot.title: 齐次方程组 x+2y=0 的解空间：过原点的直线，维数 = n−r(A) = 2−1 = 1

examples.problem:
求齐次方程组
$$\begin{cases}x_1+x_2+x_3+x_4=0,\\ x_1+2x_2+3x_3+4x_4=0\end{cases}$$
的基础解系与通解。
examples.solution:
系数矩阵 $A=\begin{pmatrix}1&1&1&1\\1&2&3&4\end{pmatrix}$，第 2 行减第 1 行得 $\begin{pmatrix}1&1&1&1\\0&1&2&3\end{pmatrix}$，所以 $r(A)=2$，而 $n=4$，基础解系应含 $n-r=2$ 个向量。
主变量取 x₁,x₂，自由变量取 x₃,x₄：由 $x_2+2x_3+3x_4=0$ 得 $x_2=-2x_3-3x_4$，代入第一式得 $x_1=-x_2-x_3-x_4=x_3+2x_4$。
令 (x₃,x₄)=(1,0) 得 $\eta_1=(1,-2,1,0)^{\mathrm T}$；令 (x₃,x₄)=(0,1) 得 $\eta_2=(2,-3,0,1)^{\mathrm T}$。通解为
$$\boldsymbol{x}=k_1\eta_1+k_2\eta_2,\qquad k_1,k_2\in\mathbb{R}.$$
验算：Aη₁=(1−2+1+0, 1−4+3+0)ᵀ=(0,0)ᵀ ✓；Aη₂=(2−3+0+1, 2−6+0+4)ᵀ=(0,0)ᵀ ✓。

examples.problem:
讨论 a 的取值，求齐次方程组
$$\begin{cases}x_1+x_2+x_3=0,\\ x_1+ax_2+ax_3=0\end{cases}$$
的通解。
examples.solution:
无论 a 取何值，$r(A)\le2<3=n$，所以必有非零解。两式相减得 $(a-1)(x_2+x_3)=0$。
当 **a≠1** 时：$x_2+x_3=0$，即 $x_2=-x_3$，代回第一式得 $x_1=0$，于是解空间维数为 $3-2=1$，基础解系取 $\eta=(0,-1,1)^{\mathrm T}$，通解 $\boldsymbol{x}=k(0,-1,1)^{\mathrm T}$，$k\in\mathbb{R}$。
当 **a=1** 时：两个方程完全相同（都是 $x_1+x_2+x_3=0$），$r(A)=1$，解空间维数为 $3-1=2$，取基础解系 $\eta_1=(-1,1,0)^{\mathrm T}$，$\eta_2=(-1,0,1)^{\mathrm T}$，通解 $\boldsymbol{x}=k_1\eta_1+k_2\eta_2$，$k_1,k_2\in\mathbb{R}$。
验算：a≠1 时 η=(0,−1,1)ᵀ 满足第一式 0+(−1)+1=0 ✓，第二式 0+a(−1)+a(1)=0 ✓；a=1 时 η₁=(−1,1,0)ᵀ：−1+1+0=0 ✓，η₂=(−1,0,1)ᵀ：−1+0+1=0 ✓。

nodes.title: 非齐次线性方程组解的结构
nodes.titleEn: Structure of Solutions of Nonhomogeneous Linear Systems
nodes.summary: 非齐次方程组 Ax=b 有解的充要条件是 r(A)=r(A|b)；有解时，通解 = 一个特解 + 导出组（齐次方程组）的通解。
nodes.summaryEn: A nonhomogeneous system Ax=b is consistent exactly when r(A)=r(A|b); when consistent, its general solution is one particular solution plus the general solution of the associated homogeneous system.
nodes.definition:
常数项不全为零（$\boldsymbol{b}\ne\boldsymbol{0}$）的方程组 $A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{b}$ 称为**非齐次线性方程组**；把右边改成 0 得到的 $A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{0}$ 称为它的**导出组**（对应齐次方程组）。判别有解没有新公式，还是看两个秩（$n$ 为未知数个数，$(A|\boldsymbol{b})$ 为增广矩阵）：（1）$r(A)=r(A|\boldsymbol{b})=n$ 时**唯一解**；（2）$r(A)=r(A|\boldsymbol{b})<n$ 时**无穷多解**（解集含 $n-r$ 个自由参数）；（3）$r(A)<r(A|\boldsymbol{b})$ 时**无解**。注意增广矩阵的秩最多比系数矩阵的秩大 1，所以无解时必定 $r(A|\boldsymbol{b})=r(A)+1$。
有解时，解集的形状非常规整。设 $\boldsymbol{x}^*$ 是 $A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{b}$ 的一个**特解**，$\eta$ 是导出组 $A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{0}$ 的任一解，那么
$$A(\boldsymbol{x}^*+\eta)=A\boldsymbol{x}^*+A\eta=\boldsymbol{b}+\boldsymbol{0}=\boldsymbol{b},$$
所以 $\boldsymbol{x}^*+\eta$ 还是 $A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{b}$ 的解；反过来，若 $\boldsymbol{x}$ 是 $A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{b}$ 的任一解，则 $A(\boldsymbol{x}-\boldsymbol{x}^*)=\boldsymbol{b}-\boldsymbol{b}=\boldsymbol{0}$，即 $\boldsymbol{x}-\boldsymbol{x}^*$ 是导出组的解。两边一凑就得到结构定理：$\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{x}^*+\eta$，其中 $\eta$ 取遍导出组的全部解。写成通解就是
$$\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{x}^*+k_1\eta_1+\cdots+k_{n-r}\eta_{n-r},$$
其中 $\eta_1,\dots,\eta_{n-r}$ 是导出组的基础解系，$k_i$ 为任意常数。
非齐次方程组的解集不再是向量空间（零向量不是它的解），它的形状是把导出组的解空间沿 $\boldsymbol{x}^*$ 平移得到的集合 $\boldsymbol{x}^*+N(A)$，称为仿射子空间。一个常用推论是：**任意两个特解之差必是导出组的解**——所以已知多个特解时，两两相减就能得到导出组的解，进而凑出基础解系。
nodes.definitionEn:
A system $A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{b}$ with $\boldsymbol{b}\ne\boldsymbol{0}$ is called a **nonhomogeneous linear system**; replacing the right-hand side by 0 gives the **associated homogeneous system** $A\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{0}$. Consistency is tested by ranks, with $n$ the number of unknowns and $(A|\boldsymbol{b})$ the augmented matrix: (i) $r(A)=r(A|\boldsymbol{b})=n$ gives a **unique solution**; (ii) $r(A)=r(A|\boldsymbol{b})<n$ gives **infinitely many solutions** ($n-r$ free parameters); (iii) $r(A)<r(A|\boldsymbol{b})$ means **no solution**. Appending one column raises the rank by at most 1, so in the inconsistent case necessarily $r(A|\boldsymbol{b})=r(A)+1$.
When the system is consistent, the solution set has a clean structure. Let $\boldsymbol{x}^*$ be one **particular solution** and $\eta$ any solution of the associated homogeneous system. Then $A(\boldsymbol{x}^*+\eta)=\boldsymbol{b}+\boldsymbol{0}=\boldsymbol{b}$, so $\boldsymbol{x}^*+\eta$ is again a solution; conversely, for any solution $\boldsymbol{x}$ we have $A(\boldsymbol{x}-\boldsymbol{x}^*)=\boldsymbol{0}$, so $\boldsymbol{x}-\boldsymbol{x}^*$ solves the associated homogeneous system. This yields the structure theorem $\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{x}^*+\eta$, with $\eta$ running over all homogeneous solutions — the general solution is **one particular solution plus the general solution of the associated homogeneous system**: $\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{x}^*+k_1\eta_1+\cdots+k_{n-r}\eta_{n-r}$, where $\eta_1,\dots,\eta_{n-r}$ form a fundamental system of the associated homogeneous system and the $k_i$ are arbitrary.
The solution set itself is no longer a vector space (the zero vector is not a solution), but an affine set $\boldsymbol{x}^*+N(A)$: the homogeneous solution space translated by $\boldsymbol{x}^*$. A useful consequence: **the difference of any two particular solutions is a solution of the associated homogeneous system**, so several known particular solutions can be subtracted to build homogeneous solutions and hence a fundamental system.

formulas.note: 判别准则：系数矩阵与增广矩阵同秩就有解；无解时增广矩阵的秩恰好大 1。
formulas.noteEn: Consistency test: the system is solvable iff the coefficient and augmented matrices have equal rank; in the inconsistent case the augmented rank is exactly one larger.

formulas.note: 三种情形（n 为未知数个数）：两秩相等且等于 n 唯一解；两秩相等且小于 n 无穷多解（含 n−r 个自由参数）；两秩不等无解。
formulas.noteEn: The three cases (n = number of unknowns): equal ranks equal to n give a unique solution; equal ranks below n give infinitely many solutions with n−r free parameters; unequal ranks mean no solution.

formulas.note: 通解 = 一个特解 x* + 导出组的通解；η_i 为导出组的基础解系，k_i 为任意常数。
formulas.noteEn: General solution = one particular solution plus the general solution of the associated homogeneous system; η_i form a fundamental system, k_i are arbitrary constants.

formulas.note: 两个特解之差是对应齐次方程组的解——用多个特解构造齐次解、求通解的关键技巧。
formulas.noteEn: The difference of two particular solutions solves the associated homogeneous system — the key trick for building homogeneous solutions from known particular solutions.

formulas.note: 有解时解集是一次特解加上解空间：把 N(A) 沿 x* 整体平移，称为仿射子空间。
formulas.noteEn: When consistent, the solution set is a particular solution plus the solution space: the null space N(A) translated by x*, an affine subspace.

properties: 增广矩阵只比系数矩阵多一列，所以 r(A)≤r(A|b)≤r(A)+1；无解时恰好 r(A|b)=r(A)+1，有解时两秩相等。
三种情形彼此不相容（记 r=r(A)）：r(A)=r(A|b)=n 唯一解；r(A)=r(A|b)=r<n 无穷多解，解集含 n−r 个自由参数；r(A)<r(A|b) 无解。
解集不是向量空间（b≠0 时零向量不是解），但形状是仿射子空间 x*+N(A)：一个特解加上导出组的解空间。
特解与齐次解可以自由组合：特解 + 导出组的任何解仍是解；两个解之差是导出组的解。已知基础解系 η₁,…,η_{n−r} 与一个特解 x*，就掌握了解集的全貌。
求通解三步：① 行化简增广矩阵，由两秩判断有解性与主元；② 解导出组得基础解系（令自由变量依次取 1 与 0 的标准取法）；③ 找一个特解（常令自由变量全取 0 解出主变量），相加即得通解。
propertiesEn: The augmented matrix has only one extra column, so r(A)≤r(A|b)≤r(A)+1; in the inconsistent case r(A|b)=r(A)+1 exactly, while consistency means equal ranks.
The three cases are mutually exclusive (write r=r(A)): r(A)=r(A|b)=n gives a unique solution; r(A)=r(A|b)=r<n gives infinitely many solutions with n−r free parameters; r(A)<r(A|b) means no solution.
The solution set is not a vector space (for b≠0 the zero vector is not a solution) but an affine set x*+N(A): one particular solution plus the homogeneous solution space.

Particular and homogeneous solutions combine freely: a particular solution plus any homogeneous solution is again a solution, and the difference of two solutions is homogeneous. Knowing a fundamental system η₁,…,η_{n−r} and one particular solution x* determines the whole solution set.

Recipe: (i) row-reduce the augmented matrix and read off consistency and pivots from the two ranks; (ii) solve the associated homogeneous system for a fundamental system (setting free variables to 1 and 0 in turn); (iii) find one particular solution (often by setting all free variables to 0), then add.

plot.title: 非齐次方程组 x+2y=3 的解集：x=(3,0)+k(−2,1)，过点 (3,0)、与导出组的解直线平行

examples.problem:
求解非齐次方程组
$$\begin{cases}x_1+x_2+x_3=1,\\ x_1+2x_2+3x_3=3,\\ 2x_1+3x_2+4x_3=4.\end{cases}$$
examples.solution:
增广矩阵为
$$(A|\boldsymbol{b})=\begin{pmatrix}1&1&1&1\\1&2&3&3\\2&3&4&4\end{pmatrix}\longrightarrow\begin{pmatrix}1&1&1&1\\0&1&2&2\\0&0&0&0\end{pmatrix},$$
其中第 3 行等于第 1 行加第 2 行（化为零行），$r(A)=r(A|\boldsymbol{b})=2<3=n$，故有无穷多解，自由参数 1 个。
由 $x_2+2x_3=2$ 得 $x_2=2-2x_3$，再由第一式得 $x_1=1-x_2-x_3=-1+x_3$。取 x₃=0 得特解 $\boldsymbol{x}^*=(-1,2,0)^{\mathrm T}$；导出组同解过程给出基础解系 $\eta=(1,-2,1)^{\mathrm T}$。通解为
$$\boldsymbol{x}=(-1,2,0)^{\mathrm T}+k(1,-2,1)^{\mathrm T},\qquad k\in\mathbb{R}.$$
验算：特解代入三式分别得 1、3、4 ✓；η 代入左端三式均为 0 ✓。

examples.problem:
设 4 元非齐次线性方程组 Ax=b 满足 r(A)=r(A|b)=2，已知它的三个解
x₁=(0,1,0,0)ᵀ，x₂=(1,-1,1,0)ᵀ，x₃=(2,-2,0,1)ᵀ，求 Ax=b 的通解。
examples.solution:
两个解之差是导出组 Ax=0 的解，于是
$$x_2-x_1=(1,-2,1,0)^{\mathrm T},\qquad x_3-x_1=(2,-3,0,1)^{\mathrm T}$$
都是齐次解。导出组的解空间维数为 $n-r=4-2=2$，而这两个向量线性无关（它们的第 3、4 个分量分别是 (1,0)、(0,1)，一眼可见无关），所以它们恰好构成导出组的基础解系。
取特解 x₁，通解为
$$\boldsymbol{x}=(0,1,0,0)^{\mathrm T}+k_1(1,-2,1,0)^{\mathrm T}+k_2(2,-3,0,1)^{\mathrm T},\qquad k_1,k_2\in\mathbb{R}.$$
说明：改用 x₂ 或 x₃ 作特解，写出的公式形式不同，但表示的解集完全相同——这正是「通解 = 特解 + 导出组通解」的含义。

nodes.title: 向量的内积、正交性与施密特正交化
nodes.titleEn: Inner Products, Orthogonality and Gram–Schmidt Orthogonalization
nodes.summary: 内积把长度和夹角搬到任意维数；正交是垂直的推广，施密特正交化能把任意线性无关组变成标准正交组。
nodes.summaryEn: The inner product carries length and angle into any dimension; orthogonality generalizes perpendicularity, and Gram–Schmidt turns any independent set into an orthonormal one.
nodes.definition:
在 $\mathbb{R}^n$ 中，两个列向量 $\alpha=(a_1,\dots,a_n)^T$ 与 $\beta=(b_1,\dots,b_n)^T$ 的**内积**定义为 $(\alpha,\beta)=\alpha^T\beta=a_1b_1+\cdots+a_nb_n$。它把点积推广到任意维数：结果是一个数，而不是向量。由内积立刻得到**长度（范数）** $\|\alpha\|=\sqrt{(\alpha,\alpha)}$ 以及夹角 $\cos\theta=\dfrac{(\alpha,\beta)}{\|\alpha\|\,\|\beta\|}$。

当 $(\alpha,\beta)=0$ 时，称 $\alpha$ 与 $\beta$ **正交**，记作 $\alpha\perp\beta$。正交就是「垂直」在高维的推广——没有图可看，但「内积为零」这个定义完全够用。零向量与任何向量正交，不过正交向量组里约定向量都非零：**两两正交的非零向量组一定线性无关**，这让正交组比普通的线性无关组好用得多。

给定线性无关组 $\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_m$，**施密特（Gram–Schmidt）正交化**的做法是逐个减掉它在前面所有方向上积累的投影：先取 $\beta_1=\alpha_1$，再取 $\beta_2=\alpha_2-\dfrac{(\alpha_2,\beta_1)}{(\beta_1,\beta_1)}\beta_1$，一般地 $\beta_i=\alpha_i-\sum_{j=1}^{i-1}\dfrac{(\alpha_i,\beta_j)}{(\beta_j,\beta_j)}\beta_j$。注意分子是 $\alpha_i$ 与 $\beta_j$ 的内积，**分母是 $(\beta_j,\beta_j)$**，两者不能写反。最后把每个 $\beta_i$ 单位化，$\eta_i=\beta_i/\|\beta_i\|$，就得到**标准正交组**。

如果 $\eta_1,\dots,\eta_n$ 是 $\mathbb{R}^n$ 的一组标准正交基，那么向量的坐标可以直接用内积读出：$x=(\eta_1^Tx)\eta_1+\cdots+(\eta_n^Tx)\eta_n$。把标准正交基按列排成矩阵 $Q$，就得到正交矩阵（$Q^TQ=E$，因而 $Q^{-1}=Q^T$）。配备内积的 $n$ 维实向量空间称为**欧几里得空间（简称欧氏空间）**——这里就是 $\mathbb{R}^n$；上面的长度、夹角、正交与标准正交基本来就是欧氏空间的语言。这套工具是后面实对称矩阵正交对角化、二次型化标准形的技术底座。
nodes.definitionEn:
In $\mathbb{R}^n$, the **inner product** of two column vectors $\alpha=(a_1,\dots,a_n)^T$ and $\beta=(b_1,\dots,b_n)^T$ is $(\alpha,\beta)=\alpha^T\beta=a_1b_1+\cdots+a_nb_n$. It generalizes the dot product to any dimension: the result is a scalar, not a vector. It immediately yields the **norm (length)** $\|\alpha\|=\sqrt{(\alpha,\alpha)}$ and the angle through $\cos\theta=\dfrac{(\alpha,\beta)}{\|\alpha\|\,\|\beta\|}$.

When $(\alpha,\beta)=0$ we call $\alpha$ and $\beta$ **orthogonal**, written $\alpha\perp\beta$. Orthogonality is perpendicularity in higher dimensions — there is nothing to draw, but the definition 'the inner product is zero' is exactly right. The zero vector is orthogonal to everything, yet vectors of an orthogonal set are required to be nonzero: **any set of pairwise orthogonal nonzero vectors is linearly independent**, which makes orthogonal sets far more convenient than merely independent ones.

Given a linearly independent set $\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_m$, **Gram–Schmidt orthogonalization** subtracts, step by step, the projection onto everything accumulated so far: start with $\beta_1=\alpha_1$, then $\beta_2=\alpha_2-\dfrac{(\alpha_2,\beta_1)}{(\beta_1,\beta_1)}\beta_1$, and in general $\beta_i=\alpha_i-\sum_{j=1}^{i-1}\dfrac{(\alpha_i,\beta_j)}{(\beta_j,\beta_j)}\beta_j$. The numerator is the inner product of $\alpha_i$ with $\beta_j$, while **the denominator is $(\beta_j,\beta_j)$** — the two must never be swapped. Normalizing each $\beta_i$ as $\eta_i=\beta_i/\|\beta_i\|$ produces an **orthonormal set**.

If $\eta_1,\dots,\eta_n$ is an orthonormal basis of $\mathbb{R}^n$, the coordinates of a vector can be read off directly by inner products: $x=(\eta_1^Tx)\eta_1+\cdots+(\eta_n^Tx)\eta_n$. Placing an orthonormal basis as the columns of a matrix $Q$ gives an orthogonal matrix ($Q^TQ=E$, hence $Q^{-1}=Q^T$). A real vector space of dimension $n$ equipped with an inner product is called a **Euclidean space**—here it is $\mathbb{R}^n$; length, angle, orthogonality and orthonormal bases are precisely the language of Euclidean spaces. This machinery is the technical foundation for the orthogonal diagonalization of real symmetric matrices and for reducing quadratic forms to canonical form.

formulas.note: 内积的定义：对应分量相乘再相加，结果是数。写成 αᵀβ 便于套用矩阵运算。
formulas.noteEn: Definition of the inner product: multiply matching components and add; the result is a scalar. Writing it as αᵀβ lets matrix algebra do the work.

formulas.note: 范数（长度）由内积诱导；模长为 1 的向量称为单位向量（标准向量）。
formulas.noteEn: The norm (length) is induced by the inner product; a vector of norm 1 is called a unit vector.

formulas.note: 柯西–施瓦茨不等式，等号成立当且仅当 α 与 β 线性相关；有了它，夹角才有定义。
formulas.noteEn: The Cauchy–Schwarz inequality; equality holds exactly when α and β are linearly dependent. It is what makes the angle well defined.

formulas.note: 施密特正交化：分子是 αᵢ 与 βⱼ 的内积，分母是 (βⱼ,βⱼ)，写反是最常见的错误。
formulas.noteEn: Gram–Schmidt: the numerator is the inner product of αᵢ with βⱼ, the denominator is (βⱼ,βⱼ); swapping them is the classic mistake.

formulas.note: 单位化得到标准正交组；按列排成 Q 就是正交矩阵，满足 QᵀQ=E。
formulas.noteEn: Normalizing gives an orthonormal set; placing the vectors as columns gives an orthogonal matrix Q with QᵀQ=E.

properties: 内积是双线性的：对两个变量都满足加性与数乘，(α,β)=(β,α)，且 (kα,β)=k(α,β)。
(α,α)≥0，并且 (α,α)=0 当且仅当 α=0；因此只有非零向量才有正的长度、才能单位化。
正交就是内积为零；当 α⊥β 时勾股定理成立：‖α+β‖²=‖α‖²+‖β‖²。
两两正交的非零向量组一定线性无关；反过来，线性无关组未必正交，这正是需要施密特正交化的原因。
正交矩阵满足 AᵀA=E ⟺ A⁻¹=Aᵀ，其行列式为 ±1；正交变换保持内积、长度与夹角不变。
propertiesEn: The inner product is bilinear: additive and homogeneous in each variable, with (α,β)=(β,α) and (kα,β)=k(α,β).
(α,α)≥0, and (α,α)=0 exactly when α=0; hence only nonzero vectors have positive length and can be normalized.
Orthogonality means the inner product vanishes; when α⊥β the Pythagorean identity holds: ‖α+β‖²=‖α‖²+‖β‖².
A set of pairwise orthogonal nonzero vectors is always linearly independent; conversely, an independent set need not be orthogonal, which is exactly why Gram–Schmidt is needed.
An orthogonal matrix satisfies AᵀA=E ⟺ A⁻¹=Aᵀ and has determinant ±1; orthogonal transformations preserve inner products, lengths and angles.

plot.title: 正交分解：β = 投影 + 垂直分量，α=(3,1) 与 β=(1,2) 的夹角为 45°

examples.problem: 把线性无关组 $\alpha_1=(1,1,1)^T$，$\alpha_2=(0,1,1)^T$，$\alpha_3=(0,0,1)^T$ 用施密特正交化变成标准正交组。
求 $\alpha=(1,1,0)^T$ 与 $\beta=(1,0,1)^T$ 的夹角，以及 α 在 β 方向上的投影向量。
examples.solution:
$(\alpha,\beta)=1\cdot1+1\cdot0+0\cdot1=1$，$\|\alpha\|=\|\beta\|=\sqrt{2}$，所以 $\cos\theta=\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}\cdot\sqrt{2}}=\dfrac{1}{2}$，即夹角 $\theta=\dfrac{\pi}{3}$。

投影系数为 $\dfrac{(\alpha,\beta)}{(\beta,\beta)}=\dfrac{1}{2}$（**分母是被投影方向的 (β,β)**），故投影向量为 $\dfrac{1}{2}\beta=(\frac{1}{2},0,\frac{1}{2})^T$。

验算：余量 $\alpha-\frac{1}{2}\beta=(\frac{1}{2},1,-\frac{1}{2})^T$ 与 $\beta$ 正交，$(\frac{1}{2})\cdot1+1\cdot0+(-\frac{1}{2})\cdot1=0$，说明投影分解正确。

nodes.title: 特征值与特征向量
nodes.summary: 特征向量是被矩阵作用后方向不变的向量，特征值是它的伸缩倍数；特征方程 |λE−A|=0 把问题变成求多项式的根。
nodes.summaryEn: An eigenvector keeps its direction under a matrix and its eigenvalue is the stretch factor; the characteristic equation |λE−A|=0 turns the search into finding roots of a polynomial.
nodes.definition:
设 $A$ 是 $n$ 阶方阵。若存在**非零**向量 $\alpha$ 与数 $\lambda$ 使 $A\alpha=\lambda\alpha$，就称 $\lambda$ 是 $A$ 的**特征值**，$\alpha$ 是 $A$ 的属于 $\lambda$ 的**特征向量**。$\alpha\neq 0$ 这个条件不能省：零向量对任何 $\lambda$ 都满足等式，没有任何信息量。几何上看，特征向量是在 $A$ 作用下方向不变的向量，$\lambda$ 是伸缩倍数（$\lambda>0$ 保持指向并伸缩，$\lambda<0$ 反向，$\lambda=0$ 被压到原点）。

把 $A\alpha=\lambda\alpha$ 改写成 $(\lambda E-A)\alpha=0$：这是齐次线性方程组，它有非零解当且仅当系数矩阵不可逆，即 $|\lambda E-A|=0$。左端是关于 $\lambda$ 的 $n$ 次多项式，称为**特征多项式**，所以 $n$ 阶方阵在复数域内恰有 $n$ 个特征值（计代数重数）。注意 $|A-\lambda E|$ 与 $|\lambda E-A|$ 只相差符号 $(-1)^n$，根完全相同，本页统一使用 $|\lambda E-A|$。

对固定的 $\lambda$，属于它的全部特征向量再加上零向量构成 $(\lambda E-A)x=0$ 的解空间，称为 $\lambda$ 的**特征子空间**；它的维数 $n-r(\lambda E-A)$ 叫**几何重数**，而 $\lambda$ 作为特征多项式根的重数叫**代数重数**，恒有几何重数 ≤ 代数重数。

两条免费的校验：$n$ 个特征值之和等于 $\operatorname{tr}(A)$，之积等于 $|A|$，算完特征值代回去查一查即可。还要小心：**属于不同特征值的特征向量之和一般不再是特征向量**，因为 $A(\alpha+\beta)=\lambda_1\alpha+\lambda_2\beta$ 一般提不出公共倍数；只有同一个特征值的特征向量的线性组合（非零时）仍是特征向量。特征值与特征向量是线性代数的「主轴」：对角化、二次型、微分方程组、主成分分析都从这里出发。
nodes.definitionEn:
Let $A$ be an $n\times n$ matrix. If there is a **nonzero** vector $\alpha$ and a number $\lambda$ with $A\alpha=\lambda\alpha$, then $\lambda$ is an **eigenvalue** of $A$ and $\alpha$ is an **eigenvector** belonging to $\lambda$. The condition $\alpha\neq 0$ cannot be dropped: the zero vector satisfies the equation for every $\lambda$ and carries no information. Geometrically, an eigenvector keeps its direction under $A$, while $\lambda$ is the stretch factor ($\lambda>0$ stretches, $\lambda<0$ reverses, $\lambda=0$ collapses it to the origin).

Rewriting $A\alpha=\lambda\alpha$ as $(\lambda E-A)\alpha=0$ makes it a homogeneous system, which has a nonzero solution exactly when the coefficient matrix is singular, i.e. $|\lambda E-A|=0$. The left side is a polynomial of degree $n$ in $\lambda$, the **characteristic polynomial**, so an $n\times n$ matrix has exactly $n$ eigenvalues over the complex numbers, counted with algebraic multiplicity. Note that $|A-\lambda E|$ differs from $|\lambda E-A|$ only by the factor $(-1)^n$, so the roots are identical; throughout this page we use $|\lambda E-A|$.

For a fixed $\lambda$, all eigenvectors belonging to it, together with the zero vector, form the solution space of $(\lambda E-A)x=0$, called the **eigenspace** of $\lambda$; its dimension $n-r(\lambda E-A)$ is the **geometric multiplicity**, while the multiplicity of $\lambda$ as a root of the characteristic polynomial is the **algebraic multiplicity**, and the geometric multiplicity never exceeds the algebraic one.

Two free sanity checks: the eigenvalues sum to $\operatorname{tr}(A)$ and multiply to $|A|$, so plug your answers back in. Beware too that **the sum of eigenvectors belonging to different eigenvalues is usually not an eigenvector**, since $A(\alpha+\beta)=\lambda_1\alpha+\lambda_2\beta$ generally has no common factor; only a linear combination of eigenvectors of the *same* eigenvalue remains an eigenvector (when it is nonzero). Eigenpairs are the 'principal axes' of linear algebra: diagonalization, quadratic forms, linear ODE systems and principal component analysis all start here.

expression.text: Aα = λα  (α ≠ 0)
expression.note: 先由特征方程 |λE−A| = 0 解出全部 λ，再解齐次方程组 (λE−A)x = 0 得特征向量。
expression.noteEn: First solve |λE−A| = 0 for all λ, then solve the homogeneous system (λE−A)x = 0 for the eigenvectors.

formulas.note: 定义式。特征向量必须非零，特征值可以是实数也可以是复数。
formulas.noteEn: The definition: an eigenvector must be nonzero, while an eigenvalue may be real or complex.

formulas.note: 特征方程：解它得到全部特征值（含重数）。等价写法 |A−λE|=0 只差一个符号，根完全一样。
formulas.noteEn: The characteristic equation: solve it for all eigenvalues with multiplicities. The variant |A−λE|=0 differs only by a sign and has the same roots.

formulas.note: 迹与行列式两个不变量给出快速校验；特别地 |A|=0 当且仅当 0 是特征值。
formulas.noteEn: Trace and determinant give quick checks; in particular |A|=0 holds exactly when 0 is an eigenvalue.

formulas.note: 解这个齐次方程组得到属于 λ 的全部特征向量（再加零向量即特征子空间）；基础解系含 n−r(λE−A) 个向量，就是几何重数。
formulas.noteEn: Solving this homogeneous system yields all eigenvectors for λ (plus the zero vector they form the eigenspace); a fundamental system has n−r(λE−A) vectors, the geometric multiplicity.

formulas.note: 同一个 α 也是幂矩阵与逆矩阵的特征向量：A^k 的特征值为 λ^k；当 A 可逆（即全部特征值均非零）时 A⁻¹ 的特征值为 1/λ。
formulas.noteEn: The same α is an eigenvector of powers and inverses: λ^k for A^k, and 1/λ for A⁻¹ when A is invertible (equivalently, when all eigenvalues are nonzero).

properties: 特征值与特征向量是矩阵固有的量：相似矩阵有相同的特征多项式与特征值，换基不会改变伸缩倍数。
n 阶矩阵在复数域内恰有 n 个特征值（计代数重数）；实矩阵的复特征值成共轭对出现。
属于不同特征值的特征向量线性无关；属于同一特征值的全部特征向量连同零向量构成特征子空间，其维数（几何重数）不大于该特征值的代数重数。
不同特征值的特征向量之和一般不是特征向量；只有同一特征值的特征向量的线性组合（非零时）仍是特征向量。
λ 是 A 的特征值 ⟺ |λE−A|=0 ⟺ 齐次方程组 (λE−A)x=0 有非零解 ⟺ r(λE−A)<n。
propertiesEn: Eigenvalues and eigenvectors are intrinsic to a matrix: similar matrices share the same characteristic polynomial and eigenvalues, since changing bases does not change stretch factors.
An n×n matrix has exactly n eigenvalues over the complex numbers, counted with algebraic multiplicity; a real matrix has its complex eigenvalues in conjugate pairs.

Eigenvectors for distinct eigenvalues are linearly independent; all eigenvectors for one eigenvalue λ, together with the zero vector, form the eigenspace of λ, whose dimension (the geometric multiplicity) never exceeds the algebraic multiplicity of λ.
The sum of eigenvectors for different eigenvalues is generally not an eigenvector; only linear combinations of eigenvectors for the same eigenvalue (when nonzero) remain eigenvectors.
λ is an eigenvalue of A ⟺ |λE−A|=0 ⟺ the system (λE−A)x=0 has a nonzero solution ⟺ r(λE−A)<n.

examples.problem: 求 $A=\begin{pmatrix}2&1\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$ 的全部特征值与特征向量，并说明 $A(1,0)^T$ 与 $A(1,1)^T$ 的几何效果。
examples.solution:
特征方程：$|\lambda E-A|=\begin{vmatrix}\lambda-2&-1\\0&\lambda-1\end{vmatrix}=(\lambda-2)(\lambda-1)=0$，得 $\lambda_1=2$，$\lambda_2=1$。

校验：$\operatorname{tr}(A)=3=2+1$ ✓；$|A|=2=2\times1$ ✓。

对 $\lambda=2$：解 $(2E-A)x=0$，$2E-A=\begin{pmatrix}0&-1\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$，得 $x_2=0$，特征向量取 $\alpha_1=(1,0)^T$。

对 $\lambda=1$：$E-A=\begin{pmatrix}-1&-1\\0&0\end{pmatrix}$，得 $x_1+x_2=0$，特征向量取 $\alpha_2=(1,-1)^T$。

几何效果：$A(1,0)^T=(2,0)^T$，方向不变、长度变成 2 倍（$\lambda=2$）；$A(1,-1)^T=(1,-1)^T$，方向与长度都不变（$\lambda=1$）；而 $A(1,1)^T=(3,1)^T$ 与 $(1,1)^T$ 不成比例、方向已改变，所以 $(1,1)^T$ 不是特征向量。

examples.problem: 求 $A=\begin{pmatrix}1&2&2\\2&1&2\\2&2&1\end{pmatrix}$ 的全部特征值与特征向量，并验证特征值之和、之积与 $\operatorname{tr}(A)$、$|A|$ 的关系。
examples.solution:
注意到 $A=2J-E$（$J$ 为全 1 矩阵），也可直接算：$A(1,1,1)^T=(5,5,5)^T$，故 $\lambda_1=5$，特征向量 $\alpha_1=(1,1,1)^T$。

特征多项式 $|\lambda E-A|=(\lambda-5)(\lambda+1)^2=\lambda^3-3\lambda^2-9\lambda-5$，所以特征值为 $5,-1,-1$（代数重数 2）。

校验：$5+(-1)+(-1)=3=\operatorname{tr}(A)$ ✓；$5\times(-1)\times(-1)=5=|A|$（按第一行展开：$1(1-4)-2(2-4)+2(4-2)=-3+4+4=5$）✓。

对 $\lambda=-1$：解 $(A+E)x=0$，$A+E=\begin{pmatrix}2&2&2\\2&2&2\\2&2&2\end{pmatrix}$，即 $x_1+x_2+x_3=0$，得两个线性无关的特征向量 $(1,-1,0)^T$ 与 $(1,0,-1)^T$。几何重数 2 = 代数重数 2，特征子空间是平面 $x_1+x_2+x_3=0$。

nodes.title: 矩阵的相似与可对角化
nodes.summary: 相似就是「同一个线性变换在不同基下的矩阵」；可对角化当且仅当存在 n 个线性无关的特征向量，也就是每个特征值的几何重数等于代数重数。
nodes.summaryEn: Similarity means the same linear transformation written in different bases; a matrix is diagonalizable exactly when it has n linearly independent eigenvectors, i.e. when every geometric multiplicity equals the matching algebraic multiplicity.
nodes.definition:
设 $A,B$ 都是 $n$ 阶方阵。若存在可逆矩阵 $P$ 使 $P^{-1}AP=B$，就称 $A$ 与 $B$ **相似**，记作 $A\sim B$。同一个线性变换在不同基下的矩阵恰好相似（$P$ 就是两组基之间的过渡矩阵），所以相似是「换个角度看同一个变换」。相似关系是等价关系：自反、对称、传递。

相似矩阵共享一切与基无关的量：特征多项式、特征值（含重数）、行列式、迹、秩都相同。但**反过来不成立**：特征值相同不一定相似。例如 $E=\begin{pmatrix}1&0\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$ 与 $\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$ 的特征值都是 $1,1$，却不相似（否则 $A=PEP^{-1}=E$，矛盾）。

若 $A$ 相似于对角矩阵，就称 $A$ **可对角化**。判据是：$A$ 有 $n$ 个线性无关的特征向量；等价地，$A$ 的每个特征值的几何重数都等于它的代数重数。此时 $A=P\Lambda P^{-1}$，其中 $P$ 的**第 $i$ 列**是特征向量、$\Lambda$ 的第 $i$ 个对角元是对应的特征值——**列的次序必须和特征值的次序一一对应**，写错位置是常见错误。

还有一条漂亮的充分条件：$n$ 阶矩阵若有 $n$ 个互不相同的特征值，则必可对角化；但它不是必要条件——单位矩阵只有特征值 1，却已经是对角矩阵。可对角化的价值在于「降低幂次」：$A^k=P\Lambda^kP^{-1}$，把矩阵乘法变成对角元的幂，这是线性递推、图论计数与马尔可夫链的常用手法。
nodes.definitionEn:
Let $A$ and $B$ be $n\times n$ matrices. If $P^{-1}AP=B$ for some invertible $P$, then $A$ and $B$ are **similar**, written $A\sim B$. Matrices of the same linear transformation with respect to two different bases are exactly similar ($P$ is the transition matrix between the bases), so similarity means 'the same transformation viewed from another angle'. Similarity is an equivalence relation: reflexive, symmetric and transitive.

Similar matrices share everything independent of the basis: the characteristic polynomial, the eigenvalues with multiplicities, the determinant, the trace and the rank. The converse fails: equal eigenvalues do not imply similarity. For instance $E=\begin{pmatrix}1&0\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$ and $\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$ both have eigenvalues $1,1$, yet they are not similar, since otherwise $A=PEP^{-1}=E$, a contradiction.

If $A$ is similar to a diagonal matrix, it is called **diagonalizable**. The criterion: $A$ has $n$ linearly independent eigenvectors; equivalently, the geometric multiplicity of every eigenvalue equals its algebraic multiplicity. Then $A=P\Lambda P^{-1}$, where the **i-th column** of $P$ is an eigenvector and the i-th diagonal entry of $\Lambda$ is the matching eigenvalue — **the order of the columns must agree with the order of the eigenvalues**, and mismatching them is a classic mistake.

There is also a neat sufficient condition: an $n\times n$ matrix with $n$ distinct eigenvalues is always diagonalizable; this is not necessary, since the identity matrix has only the eigenvalue 1 and is already diagonal. The payoff is reducing powers: $A^k=P\Lambda^kP^{-1}$ turns matrix multiplication into powers of diagonal entries, a standard device in linear recurrences, graph counting and Markov chains.

formulas.note: 相似的定义：P 必须可逆；P 就是两组基之间的过渡矩阵，所以相似是同一个线性变换的两种写法。
formulas.noteEn: Definition of similarity: P must be invertible, and it is the transition matrix between two bases, so similar matrices are two descriptions of one transformation.

formulas.note: 可对角化的含义：P 的列依次是 Λ 对角元所对应的特征向量，次序必须对齐。
formulas.noteEn: What diagonalizability means: the columns of P are the eigenvectors matching the diagonal entries of Λ in order.

formulas.note: 相似矩阵的特征多项式相同（代入 B=P⁻¹AP 并用 |P⁻¹||P|=1），于是特征值、行列式、迹也全都相同。
formulas.noteEn: Similar matrices have the same characteristic polynomial (substitute B=P⁻¹AP and use |P⁻¹||P|=1), hence the same eigenvalues, determinant and trace.

formulas.note: 重数判据：每个特征值的几何重数 n−r(λᵢE−A) 都必须等于它的代数重数 mᵢ。由于几何重数 ≤ 代数重数，只需检查特征向量是否「掉维」。
formulas.noteEn: Multiplicity criterion: the geometric multiplicity n−r(λᵢE−A) must equal the algebraic multiplicity mᵢ for every eigenvalue. Since the geometric one never exceeds the algebraic one, one only checks for lost dimensions.

formulas.note: 对角化最实用的功能：求高次幂时把矩阵乘法换成对角元的 k 次幂再夹上 P、P⁻¹。
formulas.noteEn: The main use of diagonalization: for high powers, matrix multiplication is replaced by k-th powers of the diagonal entries, sandwiched by P and P⁻¹.

properties: 相似是等价关系（自反、对称、传递）；相似矩阵的特征多项式、特征值、行列式、迹、秩完全相同。
特征值相同（甚至特征多项式完全相同）不一定相似；相似是比「特征值相同」强得多的条件。
A 可对角化 ⟺ A 有 n 个线性无关的特征向量 ⟺ 每个特征值的几何重数等于代数重数。
n 个互异特征值是可对角化的充分条件，却不是必要条件（单位矩阵、数量矩阵都可对角化）。
若 A 可对角化，则 A^k 与 A 的多项式 f(A) 也可对角化，特征值为 λᵢ^k 与 f(λᵢ)；A 可逆时 A⁻¹ 也可对角化，特征值为 1/λᵢ。
propertiesEn: Similarity is an equivalence relation (reflexive, symmetric, transitive); similar matrices have identical characteristic polynomials, eigenvalues, determinants, traces and ranks.
Having the same eigenvalues — even the same characteristic polynomial — does not imply similarity; similarity is far stronger.
A is diagonalizable ⟺ A has n linearly independent eigenvectors ⟺ the geometric multiplicity of every eigenvalue equals its algebraic multiplicity.
Having n distinct eigenvalues is sufficient for diagonalizability but not necessary (the identity and scalar matrices are diagonalizable).
If A is diagonalizable, then so are A^k and every polynomial f(A), with eigenvalues λᵢ^k and f(λᵢ); and if A is invertible, so is A⁻¹, with eigenvalues 1/λᵢ.

plot.title: 相似对角化：A=[[4,2],[1,3]] 在特征向量基下成为 diag(5,2)（P⁻¹AP=Λ）

examples.problem: 把 $A=\begin{pmatrix}3&-1\\-1&3\end{pmatrix}$ 对角化，即求可逆矩阵 $P$ 使 $P^{-1}AP$ 为对角矩阵。
examples.solution:
特征方程：$|\lambda E-A|=(\lambda-3)^2-1=\lambda^2-6\lambda+8=0$，得 $\lambda_1=4$，$\lambda_2=2$（校验：$4+2=6=\operatorname{tr}(A)$ ✓，$4\times2=8=|A|=9-1$ ✓）。

$\lambda=4$：$4E-A=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\1&1\end{pmatrix}$，得 $x_1+x_2=0$，取 $p_1=(1,-1)^T$。

$\lambda=2$：$2E-A=\begin{pmatrix}-1&1\\1&-1\end{pmatrix}$，得 $x_1-x_2=0$，取 $p_2=(1,1)^T$。

令 $P=(p_1,p_2)=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\-1&1\end{pmatrix}$，$\Lambda=\operatorname{diag}(4,2)$，列与特征值次序一致。

代回验算：$|P|=2$，$P^{-1}=\frac{1}{2}\begin{pmatrix}1&-1\\1&1\end{pmatrix}$；$AP=\begin{pmatrix}4&2\\-4&2\end{pmatrix}$；$P^{-1}AP=\frac{1}{2}\begin{pmatrix}8&0\\0&4\end{pmatrix}=\operatorname{diag}(4,2)$ ✓。

examples.problem: 说明 $A=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$ 不可对角化，并解释为什么「特征值相同」不等于「相似」。
examples.solution:
特征方程 $|\lambda E-A|=(\lambda-1)^2=0$，唯一特征值 $\lambda=1$（代数重数 2）。

解 $(E-A)x=0$：$E-A=\begin{pmatrix}0&-1\\0&0\end{pmatrix}$，得 $x_2=0$，即特征子空间为 $\{(x_1,0)^T\}$，几何重数 1 < 代数重数 2，凑不齐 2 个线性无关的特征向量，所以 A 不可对角化。

另一方面，若 A 与 $E=\operatorname{diag}(1,1)$ 相似，则存在可逆 P 使 $A=PEP^{-1}=E$，与 $A\neq E$ 矛盾。可见 E 与 A 的特征值都是 1,1（特征多项式相同），却不相似——相似要求「连 Jordan 结构都一样」；A 的 Jordan 形就是 A 自己。

nodes.title: 实对称矩阵的对角化
nodes.summary: 实对称矩阵一定能被正交矩阵对角化：特征值全为实数，不同特征值的特征向量自动正交，重特征值也恰好凑得齐特征向量。
nodes.summaryEn: Every real symmetric matrix can be diagonalized by an orthogonal matrix: its eigenvalues are all real, eigenvectors for distinct eigenvalues are automatically orthogonal, and repeated eigenvalues still supply enough independent eigenvectors.
nodes.definition:
若 $A^T=A$，就称 $A$ 是**实对称矩阵**。它是最「乖」的一类矩阵：不仅一定可对角化，而且能用**正交矩阵**对角化——存在正交矩阵 $Q$（$Q^TQ=E$）使 $Q^{T}AQ=Q^{-1}AQ=\operatorname{diag}(\lambda_1,\dots,\lambda_n)$。由于 $Q^{-1}=Q^T$，这一个变换同时实现了「相似」与「合同」两种关系。

三条硬性质。第一，特征值全为实数：设 $A\alpha=\lambda\alpha$（在复数范围内），由对称性与内积的性质得 $\lambda(\alpha,\alpha)=(A\alpha,\alpha)=(\alpha,A\alpha)=\bar{\lambda}(\alpha,\alpha)$，而 $(\alpha,\alpha)=|\alpha|^2>0$，故 $\lambda=\bar{\lambda}$。第二，属于不同特征值的特征向量**自动正交**：设 $A\alpha=\lambda\alpha$，$A\beta=\mu\beta$，$\lambda\neq\mu$，由 $(A\alpha,\beta)=(\alpha,A\beta)$ 得 $\lambda(\alpha,\beta)=\mu(\alpha,\beta)$，于是 $(\lambda-\mu)(\alpha,\beta)=0$，只能 $(\alpha,\beta)=0$。

第三，$k$ 重特征值恰有 $k$ 个线性无关的特征向量（几何重数 = 代数重数），所以永远凑得齐 $n$ 个。实际操作时：对单重特征值取一个特征向量；对重特征值解 $(\lambda E-A)x=0$ 取基础解系，只需在这一个特征子空间内部做施密特正交化——不同特征值的向量之间已经正交，不必再管。

正交对角化是「无坐标偏袒」的分解：$A=Q\Lambda Q^{T}=\sum_{i=1}^{n}\lambda_iq_iq_i^{T}$（**谱分解**），其中 $q_i$ 是标准正交特征向量。几何上它说明实对称矩阵只是沿着一组互相垂直的主轴做伸缩；统计学中的协方差矩阵、力学中的惯量张量、以及二次型化标准形都依赖它。反过来，能被正交矩阵对角化的实矩阵必为对称矩阵（因为它等于 $Q\Lambda Q^{T}$），所以这个性质是实对称矩阵的**特征刻画**。
nodes.definitionEn:
A real matrix with $A^T=A$ is called **symmetric**. Such matrices are the best behaved of all: not only are they always diagonalizable, they can be diagonalized by an **orthogonal** matrix — there is an orthogonal $Q$ ($Q^TQ=E$) with $Q^{T}AQ=Q^{-1}AQ=\operatorname{diag}(\lambda_1,\dots,\lambda_n)$. Since $Q^{-1}=Q^T$, this single transformation is simultaneously a similarity and a congruence.

Three rigid facts. First, all eigenvalues are real: let $A\alpha=\lambda\alpha$ with complex α; symmetry and the inner product give $\lambda(\alpha,\alpha)=(A\alpha,\alpha)=(\alpha,A\alpha)=\bar{\lambda}(\alpha,\alpha)$, and since $(\alpha,\alpha)=|\alpha|^2>0$ we get $\lambda=\bar{\lambda}$. Second, eigenvectors for distinct eigenvalues are **automatically orthogonal**: from $A\alpha=\lambda\alpha$, $A\beta=\mu\beta$, $\lambda\neq\mu$ and $(A\alpha,\beta)=(\alpha,A\beta)$ we get $\lambda(\alpha,\beta)=\mu(\alpha,\beta)$, hence $(\lambda-\mu)(\alpha,\beta)=0$ and therefore $(\alpha,\beta)=0$.

Third, an eigenvalue of multiplicity $k$ has exactly $k$ linearly independent eigenvectors (geometric multiplicity = algebraic multiplicity), so $n$ eigenvectors are always available. In practice: take one eigenvector for each simple eigenvalue; for a repeated eigenvalue solve $(\lambda E-A)x=0$, take a fundamental system, and apply Gram–Schmidt *inside that single eigenspace* — eigenvectors for different eigenvalues are already orthogonal and need no further work.

Orthogonal diagonalization is the coordinate-free decomposition $A=Q\Lambda Q^{T}=\sum_{i=1}^{n}\lambda_iq_iq_i^{T}$ (the **spectral decomposition**), where the $q_i$ are orthonormal eigenvectors. Geometrically, a real symmetric matrix merely stretches space along a set of mutually perpendicular principal axes; covariance matrices in statistics, inertia tensors in mechanics and the reduction of quadratic forms all rely on it. Conversely, a real matrix diagonalized by an orthogonal matrix must be symmetric (it equals $Q\Lambda Q^{T}$), so this property characterizes symmetric matrices.

formulas.note: 实对称矩阵的定义；由它可推出特征值全为实数、不同特征值的特征向量正交。
formulas.noteEn: Definition of a real symmetric matrix; it implies that all eigenvalues are real and that eigenvectors for distinct eigenvalues are orthogonal.

formulas.note: 正交对角化：Q 的列是一组标准正交特征向量，对角元按列序与特征值一一对应；这里的相似变换与合同变换是同一个 Q。
formulas.noteEn: Orthogonal diagonalization: the columns of Q are orthonormal eigenvectors matching the diagonal entries in order; here similarity and congruence use the same Q.

formulas.note: 对称性在内积下的表现（一般地 (Aα,β)=(α,Aᵀβ)）；用它两步就能证明不同特征值的特征向量正交。
formulas.noteEn: How symmetry shows up in the inner product (in general (Aα,β)=(α,Aᵀβ)); it yields the orthogonality of eigenvectors for distinct eigenvalues in two lines.

formulas.note: 谱分解：A 沿 n 个互相垂直的主轴分别伸缩 λᵢ 再叠加，qᵢ 是标准正交特征向量。
formulas.noteEn: Spectral decomposition: A stretches space by λᵢ along n mutually perpendicular principal axes, where the qᵢ are orthonormal eigenvectors.

formulas.note: 瑞利商总介于最小与最大特征值之间，是二次型正定性、极值与特征值估计的桥梁。
formulas.noteEn: The Rayleigh quotient always lies between the smallest and largest eigenvalues; it links quadratic forms, optimization and eigenvalue estimates.

properties: 实对称矩阵的特征值全部为实数，特征向量可以取实向量。
属于不同特征值的特征向量相互正交，不需要再做正交化。
k 重特征值恰有 k 个线性无关的特征向量（几何重数 = 代数重数），所以实对称矩阵必定可对角化。
存在正交矩阵 Q 使 QᵀAQ=Q⁻¹AQ=Λ；即实对称矩阵既可正交相似、也可正交合同于对角矩阵。
反过来，能正交对角化的实矩阵必为对称矩阵；对角化后对角元中正数的个数就是二次型的正惯性指数。
propertiesEn: All eigenvalues of a real symmetric matrix are real, and its eigenvectors can be chosen real.
Eigenvectors belonging to distinct eigenvalues are mutually orthogonal, so no further orthogonalization is needed.
An eigenvalue of multiplicity k has exactly k linearly independent eigenvectors (geometric multiplicity = algebraic multiplicity), so every real symmetric matrix is diagonalizable.
There exists an orthogonal Q with QᵀAQ=Q⁻¹AQ=Λ; that is, a real symmetric matrix is both orthogonally similar and orthogonally congruent to a diagonal matrix.
Conversely, any real matrix that can be orthogonally diagonalized must be symmetric; the number of positive diagonal entries is the positive inertia index of the associated quadratic form.

plot.title: 实对称矩阵的对角化：单位圆在 A=[[2,1],[1,2]] 下变成椭圆，两条主轴正好是正交特征方向 (1,1) 与 (1,−1)

examples.problem: 求正交矩阵 $Q$ 把 $A=\begin{pmatrix}0&1&1\\1&0&1\\1&1&0\end{pmatrix}$ 对角化。
证明：实对称矩阵 $A$ 的不同特征值对应的特征向量相互正交。
examples.solution:
设 $A\alpha=\lambda\alpha$，$A\beta=\mu\beta$，其中 $\alpha,\beta\neq 0$，$\lambda\neq\mu$。

由 $A^T=A$ 得 $(A\alpha,\beta)=(\alpha,A^T\beta)=(\alpha,A\beta)$。左端 $=(\lambda\alpha,\beta)=\lambda(\alpha,\beta)$，右端 $=(\alpha,\mu\beta)=\mu(\alpha,\beta)$。

于是 $(\lambda-\mu)(\alpha,\beta)=0$。因为 $\lambda\neq\mu$，只能 $(\alpha,\beta)=0$，即 $\alpha\perp\beta$。

这个证明恰恰用到了对称性 $A^T=A$：一般矩阵没有 $(A\alpha,\beta)=(\alpha,A\beta)$ 这一步，结论也就不成立。由此还可知道，不同特征值的特征子空间两两正交。

nodes.title: 二次型及其标准形
nodes.summary: 二次型是只含二次项的 n 元齐次多项式 f=xᵀAx；化标准形（只含平方项）有正交变换法与配方法两条路，本质都是合同变换。
nodes.summaryEn: A quadratic form is a homogeneous degree-two polynomial f=xᵀAx; reducing it to a canonical form with only squares can be done by an orthogonal transformation or by completing the square, and both are congruence transformations.
nodes.definition:
只含二次项的 $n$ 元多项式 $$f(x_1,\dots,x_n)=\sum_{i,j=1}^{n}a_{ij}x_ix_j$$ 称为**二次型**。把它写成矩阵形式 $f=x^{T}Ax$ 时，**约定 $A$ 取对称矩阵**：平方项 $x_i^2$ 的系数直接放在对角线 $a_{ii}$ 上，交叉项 $x_ix_j$（$i\neq j$）的系数平分给 $a_{ij}$ 与 $a_{ji}$。这一步不能省：只有 $A$ 对称，二次型与矩阵才一一对应，特征值方法才可用。例如 $f=x_1^2+2x_1x_2+x_2^2$ 的矩阵是 $\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\1&1\end{pmatrix}$，而不是 $\begin{pmatrix}1&2\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$。

若二次型只含平方项 $d_1y_1^2+\cdots+d_ny_n^2$，就称它为**标准形**。作可逆线性变换 $x=Cy$，则 $f=x^{T}Ax=y^{T}(C^{T}AC)y$，即 $A$ 变成 $C^{T}AC$。这种「两边夹一个可逆矩阵」的关系叫**合同**，记作 $A\simeq C^{T}AC$。合同与相似（$P^{-1}AP$）是两种不同的关系：相似保持特征值，合同保持二次型的正负结构；而且只要 $A$ 对称，$C^{T}AC$ 自动对称（因为 $(C^{T}AC)^T=C^{T}A^{T}C=C^{T}AC$）。

**正交变换法**：由实对称矩阵的谱定理，取正交矩阵 $Q$ 使 $Q^{T}AQ=\Lambda=\operatorname{diag}(\lambda_1,\dots,\lambda_n)$，令 $x=Qy$ 便得 $f=\lambda_1y_1^2+\cdots+\lambda_ny_n^2$。此时标准形的系数**恰好是 $A$ 的特征值**，而且变换是旋转或反射（保持长度），讨论几何形状最方便；代价是要解特征方程。

**配方法（拉格朗日法）**：逐个变量把含它的项配成完全平方，再把剩下的变量集中处理。如果所有平方项系数都为 0（例如 $f=2x_1x_2$），先用可逆替换 $x_1=y_1+y_2$，$x_2=y_1-y_2$ 制造出平方项。关键要求是每一步替换都可逆——只要配方时除掉的系数非零、所用替换取三角形式或互逆形式，整体变换就可逆，二次型的秩不会改变。标准形一般不唯一，但由惯性定理，正、负平方项的个数（正、负惯性指数）是唯一确定的。
nodes.definitionEn:
A polynomial in $n$ variables containing only degree-two terms, $$f(x_1,\dots,x_n)=\sum_{i,j=1}^{n}a_{ij}x_ix_j$$ is called a **quadratic form**. When writing it as $f=x^{T}Ax$ we **require $A$ to be symmetric**: the coefficient of $x_i^2$ goes straight onto the diagonal entry $a_{ii}$, while the coefficient of a cross term $x_ix_j$ ($i\neq j$) is split equally between $a_{ij}$ and $a_{ji}$. This step cannot be skipped — only with symmetric $A$ do forms and matrices correspond one-to-one and do eigenvalue methods apply. For example, $f=x_1^2+2x_1x_2+x_2^2$ has matrix $\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\1&1\end{pmatrix}$, never $\begin{pmatrix}1&2\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$.

If a quadratic form contains only squares, $d_1y_1^2+\cdots+d_ny_n^2$, it is called a **canonical form**. For an invertible linear change $x=Cy$ we get $f=x^{T}Ax=y^{T}(C^{T}AC)y$, i.e. $A$ is replaced by $C^{T}AC$. This sandwich relation is called **congruence**, written $A\simeq C^{T}AC$. Congruence and similarity ($P^{-1}AP$) are different relations: similarity preserves eigenvalues, congruence preserves the sign structure of the form; moreover, $C^{T}AC$ is automatically symmetric whenever $A$ is, since $(C^{T}AC)^T=C^{T}A^{T}C=C^{T}AC$.

The **orthogonal transformation method**: by the spectral theorem for real symmetric matrices there is an orthogonal $Q$ with $Q^{T}AQ=\Lambda=\operatorname{diag}(\lambda_1,\dots,\lambda_n)$; setting $x=Qy$ gives $f=\lambda_1y_1^2+\cdots+\lambda_ny_n^2$. The coefficients of the canonical form are then **exactly the eigenvalues of $A$**, and the transformation is a rotation or reflection (length preserving), which is ideal for geometric questions; the price is solving a characteristic equation.

The **method of completing the square (Lagrange)**: eliminate one variable at a time by forming a perfect square, then treat the remaining variables. If every square coefficient is zero (say $f=2x_1x_2$), first create a square with the invertible substitution $x_1=y_1+y_2$, $x_2=y_1-y_2$. The essential point is that every substitution be invertible: as long as no division by zero occurs and the substitutions are triangular or mutually inverse, the composite change is invertible and the rank is preserved. Canonical forms are not unique, but by the law of inertia the numbers of positive and negative squares (the inertia indices) are uniquely determined.

formulas.note: 二次型的两种写法；写成矩阵形式时必须把 A 取成对称矩阵，否则矩阵与二次型不能一一对应。
formulas.noteEn: The two ways to write a quadratic form; the matrix A must be taken symmetric, otherwise forms and matrices do not correspond one-to-one.

formulas.note: cᵢⱼ 表示 f 中 xᵢxⱼ 的系数：交叉项系数平分给 aᵢⱼ 与 aⱼᵢ（各一半），平方项系数直接放对角线——这一步最容易写错。
formulas.noteEn: Here cᵢⱼ is the coefficient of xᵢxⱼ in f: a cross-term coefficient is split equally between aᵢⱼ and aⱼᵢ, while a square-term coefficient goes straight to the diagonal — the most error-prone step.

formulas.note: 可逆线性变换下二次型的矩阵按合同 CᵀAC 变化；C 可逆时二次型的秩不变。
formulas.noteEn: Under an invertible linear change the matrix of the form transforms by the congruence CᵀAC; invertible C preserves the rank of the form.

formulas.note: 正交变换法：令 x=Qy，标准形的系数就是 A 的特征值，且变换保持长度（只是旋转或反射）。
formulas.noteEn: The orthogonal method: with x=Qy the coefficients of the canonical form are the eigenvalues of A, and the transformation preserves length (it is a rotation or reflection).

formulas.note: 配方法示意：先按 x₁ 配成完全平方，剩下的 x₂² 已是平方项；所用替换呈三角形式，因此可逆。
formulas.noteEn: A sample completion of the square: complete the square in x₁ first, and the leftover x₂² is already a square; the substitution is triangular, hence invertible.

properties: 二次型与实对称矩阵一一对应：平方项系数进对角线，交叉项系数平分给对称的两个位置。
标准形只含平方项，一般不唯一；但正、负平方项的个数（正、负惯性指数）由惯性定理唯一确定。
对二次型作可逆线性变换就是作合同变换 CᵀAC：它保持秩、保持正负惯性指数，但不保持特征值。
正交变换法得到的标准形系数恰为特征值，变换保长度与内积；配方法无需解特征方程，但同样必须保证变换可逆。
合同（CᵀAC，C 可逆）与相似（P⁻¹AP）是两种不同的等价关系：相似保持特征值，合同保持正负惯性指数。
propertiesEn: Quadratic forms correspond one-to-one with real symmetric matrices: square coefficients go on the diagonal and cross coefficients are split equally between symmetric positions.
A canonical form contains only squares and is generally not unique, but the numbers of positive and negative squares (the inertia indices) are unique by the law of inertia.
An invertible linear change of variables for a form is a congruence CᵀAC: it preserves the rank and the inertia indices, but not the eigenvalues.

The orthogonal method produces coefficients equal to the eigenvalues and preserves lengths and inner products; completing the square avoids the characteristic equation but must also use invertible transformations.
Congruence (CᵀAC with invertible C) and similarity (P⁻¹AP) are different equivalence relations: similarity preserves eigenvalues, congruence preserves the inertia indices.

plot.title: 二次型 f=x²+2xy+2y² 的等值线：同心椭圆，正交变换后化标准形 2.618y₁²+0.382y₂²（两系数皆正）

examples.problem: 用配方法把 $f(x_1,x_2,x_3)=2x_1x_2+2x_1x_3-2x_2x_3$ 化为标准形，写出所用变换并验证可逆。

nodes.title: 正定二次型与惯性定理
nodes.titleEn: Positive Definite Quadratic Forms and the Law of Inertia
nodes.summary: 正定就是二次型对一切非零向量都取正值；惯性定理说标准形虽然不唯一，正、负平方项的个数却由二次型本身唯一决定。
nodes.summaryEn: Positive definiteness means the form takes positive values on every nonzero vector; the law of inertia says that although canonical forms vary, the counts of positive and negative squares are intrinsic.
nodes.definition:
设 $f(x)=x^{T}Ax$（$A$ 对称）。若对一切 $x\neq 0$ 都有 $f(x)>0$，就称 $f$ 是**正定二次型**，$A$ 是**正定矩阵**，记作 $A>0$。这个定义要求「处处为正」，比「有最小值」强得多；它等价于 $A$ 的特征值全为正，也等价于 $A$ 与单位矩阵 $E$ 合同。

只用特征值判定往往要解高次方程，于是有纯代数的**顺序主子式判别法**：$A$ 正定当且仅当 $A$ 的各阶顺序主子式全大于零：$$D_1=a_{11}>0,\quad D_2=\begin{vmatrix}a_{11}&a_{12}\\a_{21}&a_{22}\end{vmatrix}>0,\quad\dots,\quad D_n=|A|>0.$$ 注意两个细节：必须是**顺序**主子式（左上角的 $k$ 阶子式），而且不等式是严格大于 0 而不是「非负」；前者漏掉会误判一部分矩阵，后者会把半正定混进来。

**惯性定理**：不论用什么可逆线性变换把二次型化成标准形，标准形里正平方项的个数 $p$ 与负平方项的个数 $q$ 都是唯一确定的，分别称为**正惯性指数**与**负惯性指数**；再作一次缩放 $y_i\mapsto y_i/\sqrt{|d_i|}$ 就得到**规范形** $z_1^2+\cdots+z_p^2-z_{p+1}^2-\cdots-z_r^2$，其中 $r=p+q=\operatorname{rank}(A)$。也就是说，同一个二次型的所有标准形共享同一个「正负结构」：系数可以变，正负号的个数不能变。

由此得到完整分类：正定（特征值全 >0，$p=n$）；负定（特征值全 <0，$q=n$，等价于奇数阶顺序主子式 <0 且偶数阶顺序主子式 >0）；半正定（特征值全 ≥0，当 $|A|=0$ 时只是半正定而非正定）；不定（正、负特征值都有）。可逆线性变换（合同变换）既保持正定性、也保持惯性指数，这正是配方法与正交变换法结论一致的原因。正定矩阵在优化（二阶充分条件要求 Hessian 正定）、最小二乘、数值分析（对称正定方程组）中都是核心对象。
nodes.definitionEn:
Let $f(x)=x^{T}Ax$ with $A$ symmetric. If $f(x)>0$ for every $x\neq 0$, the form is **positive definite** and $A$ is a **positive definite matrix**, written $A>0$. This demands positivity everywhere, much stronger than merely having a minimum; it is equivalent to all eigenvalues of $A$ being positive, and to $A$ being congruent to the identity matrix $E$.

Testing eigenvalues may require solving a high-degree equation, so there is a purely algebraic criterion using **leading principal minors**: $A$ is positive definite exactly when all its leading principal minors are positive: $$D_1=a_{11}>0,\quad D_2=\begin{vmatrix}a_{11}&a_{12}\\a_{21}&a_{22}\end{vmatrix}>0,\quad\dots,\quad D_n=|A|>0.$$ Two details matter: the minors must be the **leading** ones (top-left $k\times k$), and the inequalities are strict, not '≥'; missing the first point misjudges some matrices, while using '≥' mixes in semidefinite forms.

The **law of inertia**: no matter which invertible linear change turns the form into a canonical form, the number $p$ of positive squares and the number $q$ of negative squares are uniquely determined; they are the **positive and negative inertia indices**. One further rescaling $y_i\mapsto y_i/\sqrt{|d_i|}$ produces the **normal form** $z_1^2+\cdots+z_p^2-z_{p+1}^2-\cdots-z_r^2$, where $r=p+q=\operatorname{rank}(A)$. In other words all canonical forms of one quadratic form share the same sign structure: coefficients may change, but the numbers of plus and minus signs may not.

This yields the full classification: positive definite (all eigenvalues >0, $p=n$); negative definite (all <0, $q=n$, equivalently odd-order leading principal minors <0 and even-order ones >0); positive semidefinite (all eigenvalues ≥0; when $|A|=0$ it is semidefinite but not definite); and indefinite (eigenvalues of both signs). Invertible linear changes (congruences) preserve both definiteness and the inertia indices, which is exactly why completing the square and orthogonal transformations always give the same verdict. Positive definite matrices are central to optimization (the second-order condition requires a positive definite Hessian), to least squares, and to numerical analysis (symmetric positive definite linear systems).

formulas.note: 正定的特征值判据：全部特征值为正。反过来特征值有零或负值就不正定。
formulas.noteEn: Eigenvalue criterion: positive definite ⟺ all eigenvalues are positive; a zero or negative eigenvalue rules it out.

formulas.note: 顺序主子式判别法：Dₖ 是左上角 k 阶子式；全部严格大于 0 当且仅当正定。
formulas.noteEn: Leading principal minor criterion: Dₖ is the top-left k×k minor; all strictly positive ⟺ positive definite.

formulas.note: 规范形：正惯性指数 p、负惯性指数 q 唯一，秩 r 等于两者之和。
formulas.noteEn: The normal form: the positive index p and negative index q are unique, and the rank r equals their sum.

formulas.note: 正定 ⟺ A 与单位矩阵 E 合同；相应地，半正定 ⟺ A 与 diag(1,…,1,0,…,0) 合同。
formulas.noteEn: Positive definite ⟺ A is congruent to the identity E; likewise, positive semidefinite ⟺ A is congruent to diag(1,…,1,0,…,0).

formulas.note: 正定的等价刻画：A 可分解为可逆矩阵的转置乘积（取 C 为 Cholesky 因子即可），此时 f=‖Cx‖²>0。
formulas.noteEn: An equivalent description: A factors as CᵀC with invertible C (take the Cholesky factor); then f=‖Cx‖²>0.

properties: 正定 ⟺ 特征值全 >0 ⟺ 各阶顺序主子式全 >0 ⟺ 与单位矩阵合同 ⟺ 存在可逆矩阵 C 使 A=CᵀC。
可逆线性变换（合同变换）既保持二次型的正定性，也保持正、负惯性指数不变。
负定 ⟺ 特征值全 <0 ⟺ 奇数阶顺序主子式 <0 且偶数阶顺序主子式 >0；半正定 ⟺ 特征值全 ≥0，此时 |A|≥0，若 |A|=0 则只是半正定而非正定。
惯性定理：标准形不唯一，但正惯性指数 p 与负惯性指数 q 唯一，秩 r=p+q；两个二次型合同当且仅当它们的 p、q 相同（规范形相同）。
正定矩阵必可逆，且对角元 aᵢᵢ>0；不但各阶顺序主子式为正，它的所有主子式都大于 0。
propertiesEn: Positive definite ⟺ all eigenvalues >0 ⟺ all leading principal minors >0 ⟺ congruent to the identity ⟺ A=CᵀC for some invertible C.
Invertible linear changes (congruences) preserve positive definiteness and both inertia indices of a quadratic form.

Negative definite ⟺ all eigenvalues <0 ⟺ odd-order leading principal minors <0 and even-order ones >0; positive semidefinite ⟺ all eigenvalues ≥0, in which case |A|≥0, and |A|=0 means semidefinite but not definite.

Law of inertia: canonical forms are not unique, but the positive index p and the negative index q are; the rank is r=p+q, and two forms are congruent ⟺ they share the same p and q (equivalently the same normal form).
A positive definite matrix is invertible and has positive diagonal entries; moreover all of its principal minors (not just the leading ones) are positive.

plot.title: 正定二次型 f=x²+2y² 的曲面：开口向上的椭圆抛物面，除原点外处处为正（p=2，q=0）

examples.problem: 判断 $f(x_1,x_2,x_3)=5x_1^2+x_2^2+5x_3^2+4x_1x_2-8x_1x_3-4x_2x_3$ 是否正定，并在正定时用配方法求出标准形。
求 $t$ 的取值范围，使二次型 $f=t(x_1^2+x_2^2+x_3^2)+2x_1x_2+2x_1x_3-2x_2x_3$ 正定；并说明 $t$ 取其它值时它的正、负惯性指数。

nodes.title: 线性空间：定义与性质
nodes.summary: 在数域上装备加法与数乘、满足八条公理的集合；向量、矩阵、多项式、连续函数都是它的成员，是线性代数全部概念的共同舞台。
nodes.summaryEn: A set with addition and scalar multiplication over a number field satisfying eight axioms — the common stage of linear algebra, with vectors, matrices, polynomials and continuous functions as members.
nodes.definition:
设 $F$ 是数域（本节点取 $F=\mathbb{R}$ 或 $\mathbb{C}$），$V$ 是非空集合。如果在 $V$ 上定义了两种运算——**加法**（任意 $\alpha,\beta\in V$ 对应 $V$ 中的一个元素 $\alpha+\beta$）与**数乘**（任意 $k\in F$、$\alpha\in V$ 对应 $V$ 中的一个元素 $k\alpha$）——并且对任意 $\alpha,\beta,\gamma\in V$、$k,l\in F$ 满足下面八条公理，就称 $V$ 为数域 $F$ 上的**线性空间**（也叫向量空间），$V$ 中的元素称为**向量**。

八条公理分两组。**加法四条**：① 结合律 $(\alpha+\beta)+\gamma=\alpha+(\beta+\gamma)$；② 交换律 $\alpha+\beta=\beta+\alpha$；③ 存在零向量 $\mathbf{0}$，使 $\alpha+\mathbf{0}=\alpha$；④ 每个 $\alpha$ 都有负向量 $-\alpha$，使 $\alpha+(-\alpha)=\mathbf{0}$。**数乘四条**：⑤ 数乘结合律 $k(l\alpha)=(kl)\alpha$；⑥ 单位元 $1\alpha=\alpha$；⑦ 分配律 $k(\alpha+\beta)=k\alpha+k\beta$；⑧ 分配律 $(k+l)\alpha=k\alpha+l\alpha$。两种运算都必须「运算结果仍在 $V$ 中」（封闭性）——这是检验反例时的第一站。

典型例子：$\mathbb{R}^n$（数组空间）；次数不超过 $n$ 的实多项式全体 $P_n(\mathbb{R})$（含零多项式）；$m\times n$ 实矩阵全体 $M_{m\times n}(\mathbb{R})$；闭区间上的连续函数全体 $C[a,b]$。它们的加法与数乘都按「逐点」进行，八条公理逐条可见。反例：$V=\{(x,y)\in\mathbb{R}^2: x\ge 0\}$ 按通常运算不是线性空间——取 $k=-1$，$(1,1)\in V$ 但 $k(1,1)=(-1,-1)\notin V$，对数乘不封闭。

由公理可直接推出：零向量与负向量都唯一、$0\alpha=\mathbf{0}$、$k\mathbf{0}=\mathbf{0}$、$(-1)\alpha=-\alpha$（左边的 $0$ 是数零，右边是零向量，别混）。**子空间判定**：$V$ 的非空子集 $W$ 是子空间，当且仅当三条同时成立——① $W\neq\varnothing$（验证 $\mathbf{0}\in W$ 通常最省事）；② 对加法封闭：$\alpha,\beta\in W\Rightarrow\alpha+\beta\in W$；③ 对数乘封闭：$\alpha\in W,\ k\in F\Rightarrow k\alpha\in W$。三条缺一不可：第一象限非空、对加法也封闭，但对 $k=-1$ 不封闭；空集虽然使两条封闭性空真成立，却不是子空间（三条里第一条就不满足）。$\{\mathbf{0}\}$ 与 $V$ 本身叫**平凡子空间**；子空间的交仍是子空间，而两个子空间的并一般不是子空间。
nodes.definitionEn:
Let $F$ be a number field ($F=\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$) and $V$ a nonempty set. If two operations are defined on $V$ — **addition**, turning any $\alpha,\beta\in V$ into some $\alpha+\beta\in V$, and **scalar multiplication**, turning $k\in F$ and $\alpha\in V$ into some $k\alpha\in V$ — and the following eight axioms hold for all $\alpha,\beta,\gamma\in V$ and $k,l\in F$, then $V$ is called a **linear space** (or vector space) over $F$, and its elements are called **vectors**.

The axioms form two groups. **Four for addition**: (1) associativity $(\alpha+\beta)+\gamma=\alpha+(\beta+\gamma)$; (2) commutativity $\alpha+\beta=\beta+\alpha$; (3) a zero vector $\mathbf{0}$ with $\alpha+\mathbf{0}=\alpha$; (4) a negative $-\alpha$ for each $\alpha$ with $\alpha+(-\alpha)=\mathbf{0}$. **Four for scalar multiplication**: (5) $k(l\alpha)=(kl)\alpha$; (6) the unit law $1\alpha=\alpha$; (7) $k(\alpha+\beta)=k\alpha+k\beta$; (8) $(k+l)\alpha=k\alpha+l\alpha$. Both operations must stay inside $V$ (closure) — the first thing to test in a counterexample.

Standard examples: $\mathbb{R}^n$; real polynomials of degree at most $n$, $P_n(\mathbb{R})$ (including the zero polynomial); all real $m\times n$ matrices $M_{m\times n}(\mathbb{R})$; all continuous functions $C[a,b]$ on a closed interval. Addition and scalar multiplication act pointwise, and the axioms are visible term by term. A counterexample: $V=\{(x,y)\in\mathbb{R}^2: x\ge 0\}$ with the usual operations is not a linear space, since with $k=-1$ the vector $(1,1)\in V$ gives $k(1,1)=(-1,-1)\notin V$.

Immediate consequences: the zero vector and each negative are unique, and $0\alpha=\mathbf{0}$, $k\mathbf{0}=\mathbf{0}$, $(-1)\alpha=-\alpha$ (keep the scalar $0$ and the zero vector $\mathbf{0}$ apart). **Subspace test**: a nonempty subset $W\subseteq V$ is a subspace iff all three conditions hold — (1) $W\neq\varnothing$ (showing $\mathbf{0}\in W$ is usually easiest); (2) closed under addition; (3) closed under scalar multiplication. None can be dropped: the first quadrant is nonempty and closed under addition but fails for $k=-1$, while the empty set vacuously satisfies both closure rules yet is not a subspace. $\{\mathbf{0}\}$ and $V$ are the **trivial subspaces**; intersections of subspaces are subspaces, but a union of two subspaces generally is not.

formulas.note: 加法结合律与交换律（公理①、②）。
formulas.noteEn: Associativity and commutativity of addition (axioms 1 and 2).

formulas.note: 零向量与负向量（公理③、④）：两者都由 α 唯一确定。
formulas.noteEn: Zero vector and negatives (axioms 3 and 4); each is uniquely determined by α.

formulas.note: 数乘结合律与单位元（公理⑤、⑥）。
formulas.noteEn: Associativity of scalar multiplication and the unit law (axioms 5 and 6).

formulas.note: 两条分配律（公理⑦、⑧）：数乘对向量加法分配，数加法也对数乘分配。
formulas.noteEn: The two distributive laws (axioms 7 and 8): scalars distribute over vector addition, and scalar addition distributes over scalar multiplication.

formulas.note: 由公理推出的常用结论；最后一条用到数域中非零元可作除数。
formulas.noteEn: Standard consequences of the axioms; the last one uses that nonzero scalars are invertible in a number field.

properties: 零向量与每个向量的负向量都唯一；0α = 0、(−1)α = −α 是公理的推论，不是追加假设。
kα = 0（零向量）当且仅当 k = 0 或 α = 0；这条结论用到数域里非零数可作除数，是「数域」而非一般环上的性质。
子空间的判定三条（非空、对加法封闭、对数乘封闭）缺一不可；一个非空却不含零向量的集合必违反某条封闭性（否则 0α = 0 会落入其中），对加法不封闭的反例常取 α + β 越出集合。
{0} 与 V 是每个线性空间的平凡子空间；子空间的交仍是子空间，两个子空间的并一般不是（除非一个包含另一个）。
线性组合、线性表出、线性相关、基与维数等概念只用八条公理推出，因此对数组、多项式、矩阵、函数空间同样适用——这正是公理化定义的价值。
propertiesEn: The zero vector and the negative of each vector are unique; 0α = 0 and (−1)α = −α are consequences of the axioms rather than extra assumptions.
kα = 0 (the zero vector) holds iff k = 0 or α = 0; this relies on dividing by a nonzero scalar, so it is a property of a number field rather than of a general ring.

The three subspace conditions — nonempty, closed under addition, closed under scalar multiplication — are all indispensable; a nonempty set missing the zero vector must violate some closure (otherwise 0α = 0 would land in it), and typical addition failures take α + β outside the set.
{0} and V are the trivial subspaces of every linear space; an intersection of subspaces is a subspace, whereas a union of two subspaces generally is not (unless one contains the other).

Linear combinations, span, independence, bases and dimension follow from the eight axioms alone, so they apply equally to arrays, polynomials, matrices and function spaces — the payoff of the axiomatic definition.

examples.problem: 判断 $W=\{(x,y,z)\in\mathbb{R}^3: x+2y-z=0\}$ 是否为 $\mathbb{R}^3$ 的子空间，并说明 $W$ 的几何形状。
examples.solution: 按三条逐一检查。① 非空：代入原点得 $0+0-0=0$，所以 $(0,0,0)\in W$。② 对加法封闭：设 $u=(x_1,y_1,z_1)$、$v=(x_2,y_2,z_2)\in W$，则 $x_1+2y_1-z_1=0$、$x_2+2y_2-z_2=0$，于是 $u+v$ 的坐标满足 $(x_1+x_2)+2(y_1+y_2)-(z_1+z_2)=0+0=0$，故 $u+v\in W$。③ 对数乘封闭：设 $k\in\mathbb{R}$，则 $(kx_1)+2(ky_1)-(kz_1)=k\cdot 0=0$，故 $ku\in W$。三条全过，$W$ 是子空间。事实上 $z=x+2y$，所以 $W=\{(x,y,x+2y): x,y\in\mathbb{R}\}=\operatorname{span}\{(1,0,1),(0,1,2)\}$，是 $\mathbb{R}^3$ 中过原点的一张平面，维数为 2。

对 $W_1$：零函数满足 $f(0)=0$，非空；若 $f,g\in W_1$，则 $(f+g)(0)=f(0)+g(0)=0$；若 $k\in\mathbb{R}$，则 $(kf)(0)=k\cdot 0=0$。三条全过，$W_1$ 是子空间。对 $W_2$：取 $f,g\in W_2$，则 $(f+g)(0)=1+1=2\neq 1$，对加法不封闭；等价地，$0\cdot f$ 是零函数而不在 $W_2$ 中，说明只要非空却不含零向量，就至少违反一条封闭性。$W_2$ 不是子空间——它是子空间 $W_1$ 的一个平移，属于「仿射集」而不是线性子空间。

nodes.title: 基变换与坐标变换
nodes.titleEn: Change of Basis and Coordinate Transformations
nodes.summary: 同一向量换一组基来读，坐标就换了；两组基之间由可逆的过渡矩阵联系，坐标遵守「旧坐标 = P × 新坐标」。
nodes.summaryEn: Reading the same vector in a new basis changes its coordinates; the two bases are linked by an invertible transition matrix, and coordinates obey old = P times new.
nodes.definition:
设 $V$ 是数域上的 $n$ 维线性空间，$\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_n$ 与 $\beta_1,\dots,\beta_n$ 是 $V$ 的两组基。每个 $\beta_j$ 都能唯一地用 $\alpha$ 组线性表出；把这些坐标按列排成矩阵 $P$，记作 $$(\beta_1,\dots,\beta_n)=(\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_n)P,$$ 即 $P$ 的第 $j$ 列恰是 $\beta_j$ 在旧基 $\alpha$ 下的坐标。这个 $P$ 称为从旧基 $\alpha$ 到新基 $\beta$ 的**过渡矩阵**（换基矩阵）。

本节点的约定（与库内其它节点保持一致）：$P$ 的列 = 新基向量在旧基下的坐标。由此得到核心公式「**旧坐标 = P × 新坐标**」：设 $\xi$ 在旧基下的坐标为 $x$、在新基下的坐标为 $x'$，则 $x=Px'$，反向换算为 $x'=P^{-1}x$。这个方向极易写反——做题第一步先把 $(\beta)=(\alpha)P$ 写下来，再代坐标。

$P$ 一定**可逆**。理由：若 $Pc=\mathbf{0}$ 且 $c\neq\mathbf{0}$，则 $(\beta)c=(\alpha)Pc=\mathbf{0}$，说明 $\beta$ 组线性相关，与「$\beta$ 是基」矛盾。反过来，若 $\alpha$ 是基、$P$ 可逆，则由上式定义的 $\beta$ 组也自动是基（一般结论：$n$ 个向量构成基，当且仅当它们关于某组基的坐标矩阵可逆）。于是从新基回到旧基的过渡矩阵是 $P^{-1}$：$$(\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_n)=(\beta_1,\dots,\beta_n)P^{-1}.$$

坐标公式的推导：把 $\xi=(\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_n)x=(\beta_1,\dots,\beta_n)x'$ 中的 $(\beta)=(\alpha)P$ 代入，得 $\xi=(\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_n)(Px')$。由于 $\alpha$ 组线性无关，表示系数唯一，比较即得 $x=Px'$。若再换一组基 $\gamma$ 且 $(\gamma)=(\beta)Q$，则 $(\gamma)=(\alpha)PQ$——过渡矩阵可以接力相乘。特别地，$\mathbb{R}^n$ 中把基向量按列排成矩阵 $A$（在标准基下），则从标准基到该基的过渡矩阵就是 $A$。
nodes.definitionEn:
Let $V$ be an $n$-dimensional linear space over a number field, with two bases $\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_n$ and $\beta_1,\dots,\beta_n$. Each $\beta_j$ is uniquely a linear combination of the $\alpha$'s; arranging those coordinates as the $j$-th column of a matrix $P$ gives $$(\beta_1,\dots,\beta_n)=(\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_n)P,$$ so column $j$ of $P$ holds the coordinates of $\beta_j$ in the old basis. The matrix $P$ is called the **transition matrix** from the old basis $\alpha$ to the new basis $\beta$.

The convention of this node (consistent across the library): the columns of $P$ are the coordinates of the new basis vectors in the old basis. It yields the core rule **old coordinates = P × new coordinates**: if $\xi$ has coordinates $x$ in the old basis and $x'$ in the new one, then $x=Px'$, and conversely $x'=P^{-1}x$. The direction is easily reversed by mistake — always write $(\beta)=(\alpha)P$ first, then substitute the coordinates.

$P$ is always **invertible**. Indeed, if $Pc=\mathbf{0}$ with $c\neq\mathbf{0}$, then $(\beta)c=(\alpha)Pc=\mathbf{0}$, contradicting linear independence of the $\beta$'s. Conversely, if $\alpha$ is a basis and $P$ is invertible, the $\beta$'s defined above form a basis too (in general, $n$ vectors form a basis iff their coordinate matrix with respect to some basis is invertible). Hence the transition matrix from the new basis back to the old one is $P^{-1}$.

Derivation of the coordinate rule: substitute $(\beta)=(\alpha)P$ into $\xi=(\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_n)x=(\beta_1,\dots,\beta_n)x'$ to get $\xi=(\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_n)(Px')$. Uniqueness of coordinates in the independent set $\alpha$ gives $x=Px'$. For a further basis $\gamma$ with $(\gamma)=(\beta)Q$, one has $(\gamma)=(\alpha)PQ$, so transition matrices compose by multiplication. In particular, in $\mathbb{R}^n$, placing the basis vectors as the columns of a matrix $A$ (in the standard basis) makes $A$ the transition matrix from the standard basis.

formulas.note: 换基约定：P 的第 j 列是 βⱼ 在旧基 α 下的坐标。
formulas.noteEn: Change-of-basis convention: column j of P gives the coordinates of β_j in the old basis α.

formulas.note: 坐标变换核心公式：旧坐标 = P × 新坐标；新坐标 = P⁻¹ × 旧坐标。
formulas.noteEn: Core coordinate rule: old coordinates = P × new coordinates; new coordinates = P⁻¹ × old.

formulas.note: 分量形式：P 的第 i 行与新坐标列向量做内积，得到旧坐标的第 i 个分量。
formulas.noteEn: Component form: row i of P dotted with the new coordinate vector gives the i-th old coordinate.

formulas.note: P 一定可逆；从新基回到旧基的过渡矩阵是 P⁻¹。
formulas.noteEn: P is always invertible; the matrix P⁻¹ takes the new basis back to the old one.

formulas.note: 连续换基：过渡矩阵相乘，顺序与基的书写顺序一致（α→β→γ 对应 PQ）。
formulas.noteEn: Successive changes compose: for α→β→γ the transition matrix is PQ, in the same order as the bases are written.

properties: 过渡矩阵一定可逆；反之，若 (β) = (α)P 而 P 不可逆，则 β 组线性相关，不能是基。
方向约定：「旧坐标 = P × 新坐标」，即 x = Px′、x′ = P⁻¹x；写反方向会让全部坐标出错。
复合律：α→β 用 P、β→γ 用 Q，则 α→γ 用 PQ；从新基回旧基用 P⁻¹。
ℝⁿ 中把新基向量按列排成矩阵 A，则 A 就是从标准基到新基的过渡矩阵，标准坐标 = A × 新坐标（可用它快速心算验证方向）。
换基只改变坐标、不改变向量本身；许多问题（对角化、二次型化简、正交化）本质上都是「选一组好基」。
propertiesEn: A transition matrix is always invertible; conversely, if (β) = (α)P with P singular, the β's are linearly dependent and cannot be a basis.
Direction of the convention: old coordinates = P × new coordinates, x = Px′ and x′ = P⁻¹x; reversing it corrupts every coordinate.
Composition: α→β uses P and β→γ uses Q, so α→γ uses PQ, while going back from a new basis to the old one uses P⁻¹.

In ℝⁿ, putting the new basis vectors as columns of a matrix A makes A the transition matrix from the standard basis, with standard coordinates = A × new coordinates (a quick way to double-check the direction).
A change of basis changes coordinates but never the vector itself; many problems (diagonalization, reducing quadratic forms, orthogonalization) are really about choosing a good basis.

examples.problem: 在 $\mathbb{R}^2$ 中取旧基 $\alpha_1=(1,0)$、$\alpha_2=(0,1)$（标准基），新基 $\beta_1=(1,1)$、$\beta_2=(1,-1)$。(1) 写出过渡矩阵 $P$；(2) 求向量 $\xi=(3,1)$ 在新基下的坐标。
examples.solution: (1) 按约定，$P$ 的列是新基向量在标准基下的坐标，故 $P=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\1&-1\end{pmatrix}$。(2) 由 $x=Px'$ 得 $x'=P^{-1}x$。$\det P=1\cdot(-1)-1\cdot 1=-2$，$P^{-1}=\dfrac{1}{-2}\begin{pmatrix}-1&-1\\-1&1\end{pmatrix}=\dfrac12\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\1&-1\end{pmatrix}$。于是 $x'=\dfrac12\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\1&-1\end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix}3\\1\end{pmatrix}=\dfrac12\begin{pmatrix}4\\2\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}2\\1\end{pmatrix}$。验算：$2\beta_1+1\beta_2=(2,2)+(1,-1)=(3,1)=\xi$。

examples.problem: 设两组基满足 $(\beta)=(\alpha)P$ 与 $(\gamma)=(\beta)Q$，其中 $P=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$，$Q=\begin{pmatrix}2&0\\1&3\end{pmatrix}$。已知 $\xi$ 在 $\alpha$ 下的坐标为 $x=(1,1)^{\mathrm T}$，求 $\xi$ 在 $\gamma$ 下的坐标。
examples.solution: 先求 $\alpha\to\gamma$ 的过渡矩阵 $R=PQ=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\0&1\end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix}2&0\\1&3\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}3&3\\1&3\end{pmatrix}$。由 $x=Rx_\gamma$ 得 $x_\gamma=R^{-1}x$。$\det R=9-3=6$，$R^{-1}=\dfrac16\begin{pmatrix}3&-3\\-1&3\end{pmatrix}$，故 $x_\gamma=\dfrac16\begin{pmatrix}3-3\\-1+3\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}0\\1/3\end{pmatrix}$。分步验算：先去 β 系，$x_\beta=P^{-1}x=\begin{pmatrix}1&-1\\0&1\end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix}1\\1\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}0\\1\end{pmatrix}$，即 $\xi=\beta_2$；再由 $x_\gamma=Q^{-1}x_\beta$，$Q^{-1}=\dfrac16\begin{pmatrix}3&0\\-1&2\end{pmatrix}$，得 $x_\gamma=\dfrac16\begin{pmatrix}0\\2\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}0\\1/3\end{pmatrix}$，一致。最后核对：$\xi=\beta_2=\alpha_1+\alpha_2$，而 $\gamma_2=3\beta_2=3(\alpha_1+\alpha_2)$，所以 $\dfrac13\gamma_2=\alpha_1+\alpha_2=\xi$。

nodes.title: 线性变换及其矩阵表示
nodes.summary: 保持加法与数乘的映射；取定基后每个线性变换恰好对应一个矩阵，换基时矩阵按 A′ = P⁻¹AP 相似变化。
nodes.summaryEn: Maps preserving addition and scalar multiplication; once bases are fixed, each linear transformation is represented by exactly one matrix, which changes by similarity A′ = P⁻¹AP under a change of basis.
nodes.definition:
设 $V,W$ 是数域 $F$ 上的线性空间。映射 $T:V\to W$ 如果对任意 $\alpha,\beta\in V$ 和任意 $k,l\in F$ 都满足 $$T(k\alpha+l\beta)=kT(\alpha)+lT(\beta),$$ 就称为从 $V$ 到 $W$ 的**线性变换**（线性映射）。这条定义等价于两条：**保加法** $T(\alpha+\beta)=T(\alpha)+T(\beta)$ 与**保数乘** $T(k\alpha)=kT(\alpha)$。取 $k=l=0$ 立即得到 $T(\mathbf{0})=\mathbf{0}$，所以「$T(0)=0$」是线性的必要条件，但不是充分条件。当 $W=V$ 时称 $T$ 为 $V$ 上的线性变换。

典型例子：恒等变换 $I$、数乘变换 $T(\alpha)=k\alpha$、投影 $P(x,y,z)=(x,y,0)$、多项式空间上的求导算子 $D(p)=p'$、积分算子 $T(f)(x)=\int_0^x f(t)\,\mathrm dt$、以及「左乘矩阵」$T(x)=Ax$。非线性反例：$T(x)=x+1$（连原点都不固定）、$T(x)=x^2$、$T(x)=\lVert x\rVert$。

**矩阵表示**：设 $\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_n$ 是 $V$ 的基，$\beta_1,\dots,\beta_m$ 是 $W$ 的基。把每个像 $T(\alpha_j)$ 用 $\beta$ 基表出：$T(\alpha_j)=a_{1j}\beta_1+\cdots+a_{mj}\beta_m$，以这些系数为第 $j$ 列排成 $m\times n$ 矩阵 $A$，就得到 $T$ 在给定基下的矩阵。坐标公式：若 $\xi=(\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_n)x$，则 $T(\xi)=(\beta_1,\dots,\beta_m)(Ax)$——**矩阵的第 j 列就是 T(αⱼ) 的坐标**，矩阵乘法一次性完成「变换 + 换坐标」。取定基后 $T\mapsto A$ 是一一对应：复合对应矩阵乘法 $T_2T_1\leftrightarrow A_2A_1$，可逆变换对应可逆矩阵。

**换基下的变化**：设 $T$ 是 $V$ 上的线性变换，在旧基 $\alpha$ 下矩阵为 $A$，在新基 $\beta$ 下矩阵为 $A'$，且 $(\beta)=(\alpha)P$（约定同「基变换与坐标变换」节点：$P$ 的列是新基在旧基下的坐标）。则 $$A'=P^{-1}AP,$$ 即同一线性变换在不同基下的矩阵**相似**，$P$ 正是那个过渡矩阵。推导：旧基下坐标满足 $y=Ax$；由于 $x=Px'$、$y=Py'$，代入得 $Py'=APx'$，于是 $y'=P^{-1}APx'$。
nodes.definitionEn:
Let $V,W$ be linear spaces over a number field $F$. A map $T:V\to W$ is called a **linear transformation** (linear map) if $$T(k\alpha+l\beta)=kT(\alpha)+lT(\beta)$$ for all $\alpha,\beta\in V$ and all $k,l\in F$. The definition is equivalent to two rules: $T(\alpha+\beta)=T(\alpha)+T(\beta)$ (preserving addition) and $T(k\alpha)=kT(\alpha)$ (preserving scalar multiplication). Taking $k=l=0$ gives $T(\mathbf{0})=\mathbf{0}$, so $T(0)=0$ is necessary for linearity but far from sufficient. If $W=V$, one says $T$ is a linear transformation on $V$.

Examples: the identity $I$, scalar maps $T(\alpha)=k\alpha$, the projection $P(x,y,z)=(x,y,0)$, the derivative operator $D(p)=p'$ on polynomials, the integral operator $T(f)(x)=\int_0^x f(t)\,\mathrm dt$, and left multiplication by a matrix $T(x)=Ax$. Non-linear counterexamples: $T(x)=x+1$ (it does not even fix the origin), $T(x)=x^2$, $T(x)=\lVert x\rVert$.

**Matrix representation**: let $\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_n$ be a basis of $V$ and $\beta_1,\dots,\beta_m$ a basis of $W$. Express each image, $T(\alpha_j)=a_{1j}\beta_1+\cdots+a_{mj}\beta_m$, and arrange the coefficients as the $j$-th column of an $m\times n$ matrix $A$. Coordinate formula: if $\xi=(\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_n)x$ then $T(\xi)=(\beta_1,\dots,\beta_m)(Ax)$ — **column j of A is the coordinate vector of $T(\alpha_j)$**, and one matrix multiplication performs the transformation and the coordinate bookkeeping at once. With bases fixed, $T\mapsto A$ is a bijection: composition corresponds to matrix multiplication $T_2T_1\leftrightarrow A_2A_1$, and invertibility to invertible matrices.

**Under a change of basis**: let $T$ be a linear transformation on $V$, with matrix $A$ in the old basis $\alpha$ and $A'$ in the new basis $\beta$, where $(\beta)=(\alpha)P$ (same convention as in the change-of-basis node: columns of $P$ are the new basis vectors in the old basis). Then $$A'=P^{-1}AP,$$ i.e. matrices of the same transformation in different bases are **similar**, with $P$ the transition matrix. Derivation: coordinates in the old basis satisfy $y=Ax$; since $x=Px'$ and $y=Py'$, substitution gives $Py'=APx'$, hence $y'=P^{-1}APx'$. For a map between two different spaces, changing the basis of $V$ by $P$ and that of $W$ by $Q$ gives $A'=Q^{-1}AP$ instead; the similarity formula above is the special case $V=W$ with the same transition matrix applied on both sides.

formulas.note: 线性变换的定义式；等价于保加法 + 保数乘。
formulas.noteEn: The defining identity of a linear transformation; equivalent to preserving addition and scalar multiplication.

formulas.note: 矩阵表示：A 的第 j 列是 T(αⱼ) 在给定基下的坐标。
formulas.noteEn: Matrix representation: column j of A is the coordinate vector of T(α_j) in the chosen bases.

formulas.note: 坐标公式：用矩阵乘法计算线性变换的作用（先取坐标，再乘矩阵）。
formulas.noteEn: Coordinate formula: matrix multiplication computes the action of T (take coordinates, then multiply).

formulas.note: 换基公式：同一变换在新基下的矩阵是 P⁻¹AP，P 为过渡矩阵（方向与「旧坐标 = P × 新坐标」一致）。
formulas.noteEn: Change-of-basis formula: in a new basis the matrix becomes P⁻¹AP, with P the transition matrix (the same P as in old coordinates = P × new coordinates).

formulas.note: 复合与逆的对应：复合顺序与矩阵乘法顺序一致（先作用的在右边）。
formulas.noteEn: Composition and inverses: the order of composition matches matrix multiplication (the map applied first sits on the right).

properties: T 线性 ⟺ 保加法且保数乘；线性一定把零向量映为零向量，但 T(0) = 0 不代表线性（例如 T(x,y) = (x², y)，原点不动却不是线性映射）。
取定 V 与 W 的基后，线性变换与 m×n 矩阵一一对应；口诀「第 j 列 = T(αⱼ) 的坐标」是写出矩阵的快捷方式。
复合对应矩阵乘法：T₁: V→W 的矩阵为 A₁（基 α→β），T₂: W→U 的矩阵为 A₂（基 β→γ），则 T₂T₁ 的矩阵为 A₂A₁。
同空间换基：A′ = P⁻¹AP，P 是基变换的过渡矩阵；相似矩阵是同一变换的不同基版本，所以行列式、迹、秩、特征多项式都是相似不变量。
线性变换的核与像都是子空间；T 可逆 ⟺ 在任意给定基下其矩阵可逆，且此时 T⁻¹ 的矩阵为 A⁻¹。
propertiesEn: T is linear iff it preserves addition and scalar multiplication; linearity forces T(0) = 0, but T(0) = 0 does not imply linearity (e.g. T(x,y) = (x², y) fixes the origin yet is not linear).
With bases of V and W fixed, linear maps correspond one-to-one to m×n matrices; the motto column j = coordinates of T(α_j) is the fastest way to write the matrix down.
Composition corresponds to matrix multiplication: T₁: V→W with matrix A₁ (bases α→β) and T₂: W→U with matrix A₂ (bases β→γ) compose to T₂T₁ with matrix A₂A₁.

For transformations of one space, a change of basis gives A′ = P⁻¹AP with P the transition matrix; similar matrices are two views of the same transformation, so determinant, trace, rank and characteristic polynomial are similarity invariants.
The kernel and the image of a linear map are subspaces; T is invertible iff its matrix in any chosen bases is invertible, and then T⁻¹ has matrix A⁻¹.

examples.problem: 设 $P_2(\mathbb{R})$ 是次数不超过 2 的多项式空间（取基 $1,x,x^2$），$D(p)=p'$ 是求导算子。求 $D$ 在该基下的矩阵，并用矩阵乘法计算 $D$ 作用于 $p=3+2x-x^2$ 的结果。
examples.solution: $D(1)=0$、$D(x)=1$、$D(x^2)=2x$，按列排坐标得 $D$ 的矩阵 $A=\begin{pmatrix}0&1&0\\0&0&2\\0&0&0\end{pmatrix}$。$p$ 的坐标向量为 $x=(3,2,-1)^{\mathrm T}$，逐行相乘得 $Ax=(0\cdot 3+1\cdot 2+0\cdot(-1),\ 0+0+2\cdot(-1),\ 0)^{\mathrm T}=(2,-2,0)^{\mathrm T}$，对应多项式 $2-2x$，与直接求导 $p'=2-2x$ 一致。另外 $A^3=O$：求导作用三次就是零算子，这是幂零变换的典型例子（与若尔当标准型相呼应）。

examples.problem: 在 $\mathbb{R}^2$ 中，$T$ 是逆时针旋转 $90^\circ$，在标准基 $\alpha_1=(1,0)$、$\alpha_2=(0,1)$ 下矩阵为 $A=\begin{pmatrix}0&-1\\1&0\end{pmatrix}$。取新基 $\beta_1=(1,1)$、$\beta_2=(1,-1)$，求 $T$ 在新基下的矩阵 $A'$。
examples.solution: 过渡矩阵 $P=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\1&-1\end{pmatrix}$（列 = 新基在标准基下的坐标），$P^{-1}=\dfrac12\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\1&-1\end{pmatrix}$。由换基公式 $A'=P^{-1}AP$：先算 $AP=\begin{pmatrix}0&-1\\1&0\end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\1&-1\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}-1&1\\1&1\end{pmatrix}$，再算 $A'=\dfrac12\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\1&-1\end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix}-1&1\\1&1\end{pmatrix}=\dfrac12\begin{pmatrix}0&2\\-2&0\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}0&1\\-1&0\end{pmatrix}$。验算：$T(\beta_1)=(-1,1)=0\cdot\beta_1-1\cdot\beta_2$，$T(\beta_2)=(1,1)=1\cdot\beta_1+0\cdot\beta_2$，故矩阵两列分别为 $(0,-1)^{\mathrm T}$ 与 $(1,0)^{\mathrm T}$，与 $A'$ 一致。

nodes.title: 线性变换的核、像与维数定理
nodes.titleEn: Kernel, Image and the Rank–Nullity Theorem
nodes.summary: 核是被压成零的向量集合，像是能取到的值域；维数定理 dim Ker T + dim Im T = dim V 把单射、满射与方程解集的自由度统一起来。
nodes.summaryEn: The kernel collects the vectors crushed to zero and the image collects attainable values; the rank–nullity theorem dim Ker T + dim Im T = dim V unifies injectivity, surjectivity and degrees of freedom.
nodes.definition:
设 $T:V\to W$ 是数域上的线性变换。称 $$\ker T=\{\alpha\in V: T(\alpha)=\mathbf{0}\}$$ 为 $T$ 的**核**（零空间），称 $$\operatorname{Im}T=\{T(\alpha):\alpha\in V\}=T(V)$$ 为 $T$ 的**像**（值域）。$\ker T$ 是 $V$ 的子空间，$\operatorname{Im}T$ 是 $W$ 的子空间：核含零向量，且当 $\alpha,\beta\in\ker T$ 时 $T(k\alpha+l\beta)=kT(\alpha)+lT(\beta)=\mathbf{0}$，仍落在核中；当 $u=T(\alpha),v=T(\beta)\in\operatorname{Im}T$ 时 $ku+lv=T(k\alpha+l\beta)$，仍落在像中。

**维数定理**（秩零化度定理）：设 $V$ 是有限维线性空间，$T:V\to W$ 是线性变换，则 $$\dim\ker T+\dim\operatorname{Im}T=\dim V.$$ 其中 $\dim\operatorname{Im}T$ 称为 $T$ 的**秩**，$\dim\ker T$ 称为**零化度**。注意等号右边是**定义域 $V$ 的维数**，不是 $W$ 的维数——这是最容易记错的地方。矩阵版本：$m\times n$ 矩阵 $A$ 满足 $\operatorname{rank}(A)+\operatorname{nullity}(A)=n$；把 $A$ 看成 $T:\mathbb{R}^n\to\mathbb{R}^m$，$x\mapsto Ax$，则 $\operatorname{rank}(A)=\dim\operatorname{Im}T$，而齐次方程组 $Ax=0$ 的解空间正是 $\ker T$，其维数为 $n-\operatorname{rank}(A)$。

**单射与满射**：$T$ 是单射 $\iff\ker T=\{\mathbf{0}\}$（即 $Ax=0$ 只有零解）；$T$ 是满射 $\iff\operatorname{Im}T=W\iff\dim\operatorname{Im}T=\dim W$；当 $\dim V=\dim W<\infty$ 时，「单射」「满射」「可逆（同构）」三者互相等价。直观理解：核度量被 $T$ 压成零的「信息量」，像度量 $T$ 能到达的范围，两者维数之和恒等于 $\dim V$——压掉多少，到达的就少多少。

**两个模型与不变子空间**：投影 $P(x,y,z)=(x,y,0)$ 的核是 $z$ 轴（1 维），像是 $xy$ 平面（2 维），$1+2=3$；求导 $D:P_n\to P_n$ 的核是常数多项式（1 维），像是次数不超过 $n-1$ 的多项式（$n$ 维），$1+n=n+1$。若子空间 $W_0\subseteq V$ 满足 $T(W_0)\subseteq W_0$，就称 $W_0$ 为 $T$ 的**不变子空间**：$\ker T$、$\operatorname{Im}T$、以及后面要学的特征子空间都是典型例子。把 $W_0$ 的基扩充成 $V$ 的基，$T$ 的矩阵呈**分块上三角** $\begin{pmatrix}B&C\\O&D\end{pmatrix}$，左下角的零块 $O$ 正是 $T(W_0)\subseteq W_0$ 的矩阵体现；反过来，矩阵若关于某组基呈这种形状，则前 $\dim W_0$ 个基向量张成的子空间是不变子空间。
nodes.definitionEn:
Let $T:V\to W$ be a linear transformation over a number field. The **kernel** (null space) and **image** (range) are $$\ker T=\{\alpha\in V: T(\alpha)=\mathbf{0}\},\qquad \operatorname{Im}T=\{T(\alpha):\alpha\in V\}=T(V).$$ The kernel is a subspace of $V$ and the image is a subspace of $W$: the kernel contains the zero vector and is closed under $k\alpha+l\beta$ (whose image is zero), while for $u=T(\alpha)$ and $v=T(\beta)$ the combination $ku+lv=T(k\alpha+l\beta)$ is again an image.

**Rank–nullity theorem**: if $V$ is finite-dimensional and $T:V\to W$ is linear, then $$\dim\ker T+\dim\operatorname{Im}T=\dim V.$$ Here $\dim\operatorname{Im}T$ is the **rank** of $T$ and $\dim\ker T$ its **nullity**. Note that the right-hand side is the dimension of the **domain** $V$, not of $W$ — the most commonly misremembered point. Matrix form: an $m\times n$ matrix $A$ satisfies $\operatorname{rank}(A)+\operatorname{nullity}(A)=n$; viewing $A$ as $T:\mathbb{R}^n\to\mathbb{R}^m$, $x\mapsto Ax$, the rank is $\dim\operatorname{Im}T$ and the solution space of $Ax=0$ is exactly $\ker T$, of dimension $n-\operatorname{rank}(A)$.

**Injectivity and surjectivity**: $T$ is injective iff $\ker T=\{\mathbf{0}\}$ (i.e. $Ax=0$ has only the trivial solution); $T$ is surjective iff $\operatorname{Im}T=W$ iff $\dim\operatorname{Im}T=\dim W$; when $\dim V=\dim W<\infty$, injective, surjective and invertible (isomorphism) are all equivalent. Intuitively, the kernel measures how much information is crushed to zero, the image measures how much of the target is reached, and the two dimensions always add up to $\dim V$.

**Two models and invariant subspaces**: the projection $P(x,y,z)=(x,y,0)$ has kernel the $z$-axis (dimension 1) and image the $xy$-plane (dimension 2), and $1+2=3$; the derivative $D:P_n\to P_n$ has kernel the constant polynomials (dimension 1) and image the polynomials of degree at most $n-1$ (dimension $n$), and $1+n=n+1$. A subspace $W_0\subseteq V$ with $T(W_0)\subseteq W_0$ is called an **invariant subspace** of $T$; $\ker T$, $\operatorname{Im}T$ and eigenspaces are the standard examples. Extending a basis of $W_0$ to a basis of $V$ makes the matrix of $T$ **block upper triangular** $\begin{pmatrix}B&C\\O&D\end{pmatrix}$ (the entries below the first $\dim W_0$ columns vanish); conversely, a matrix of that shape with respect to some basis exhibits the span of the first $\dim W_0$ basis vectors as an invariant subspace.

formulas.note: 核与像的定义；核是 V 的子空间，像是 W 的子空间。
formulas.noteEn: Definitions of kernel and image; the kernel is a subspace of V and the image a subspace of W.

formulas.note: 维数定理（秩零化度定理）：右边恒为定义域 V 的维数，与 W 的维数无关。
formulas.noteEn: The rank–nullity theorem: the right-hand side is always dim V, the dimension of the domain, independent of W.

formulas.note: 矩阵版本：rank 是像的维数，nullity 是 Ax = 0 解空间的维数，两数之和等于未知数个数 n。
formulas.noteEn: Matrix version for an m×n matrix A: rank is the dimension of the image and nullity the dimension of the solution space of Ax = 0; the two add up to the number of unknowns n.

formulas.latex: T\ \text{单射}\iff\ker T=\{\mathbf{0}\},\qquad T\ \text{满射}\iff\dim\operatorname{Im}T=\dim W
formulas.note: 单射与满射判别；在 dim V = dim W 的有限维情形，单射、满射、可逆三者等价。
formulas.noteEn: Tests for injectivity and surjectivity; for finite-dimensional V, W with dim V = dim W the three notions injective, surjective, invertible coincide.

formulas.latex: T(W_0)\subseteq W_0\quad\Longrightarrow\quad A\ \text{在适当基下为}\ \begin{pmatrix}B&C\\O&D\end{pmatrix}
formulas.note: 不变子空间与分块上三角：取 W₀ 的基再扩充为 V 的基，前 dim W₀ 列的下方为零块；反之亦然。
